title: Beginner talents P2 - How to swap and use all talents effectively
summary: Last week we did a talent guide for beginners with the basics of what are talents, and how to setup something for beginners. This lead to quite a few of you asking me what precisely they should run as their three talent…
markdown:
Last week we did a [talent guide for beginners](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/infinity-kingdom-new-player-talent-guide/) with the basics of what are talents, and how to setup something for beginners. This lead to quite a few of you asking me what precisely they should run as their three talent trees and how swapping works. So this is what we will dive into today!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-84-1024x565.png)

### Talents

## How does swapping work, and why is it such a huge deal?

The recent update to *Infinity Kingdom* has completely transformed how players can utilize **talents**, making it easier than ever to optimize your kingdom’s growth and battle readiness. For new players, understanding and using talent trees effectively can give you a massive advantage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-101-1024x560.png)

What you need to understand before understanding why this is so hugely valuable for us, is the fact that any new upgrade will have its duration based on the precise buffs and boosts active for the player at that precise snapshot in time. So if you have a city buff for 3% dragon speed + 10% dragon speed from talents active BEFORE you begin your upgrade, then your entire upgrade will be 13% faster. You can drop the city and remove the talents immidiately upon beginning the dragon upgrade without the upgrade timer changing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-99-1024x444.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-100-1024x456.png)

Thus, you can take huge advantage of the new free-swap-talents!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-102-1024x539.png)

Let’s dive into this beginner’s guide to help you make the most of your talents!

---

### Big Changes to Talent Swapping

In the past, switching between talent trees came with a hefty cost of **200 gems per swap**. This meant players had to carefully consider their decisions and stick with one tree unless absolutely necessary, such as before a major dragon upgrade or a critical PvP event.

But now, **talent swapping is completely free!**

This is a game-changer. You can now equip the perfect set of talents for any situation, whether it’s upgrading your kingdom, preparing for combat, or boosting your dragon’s power. Flexibility is key, and this update makes it easy to stay ahead.

---

### Talent Tree Guides and Recommendations

There are multiple talent trees tailored for specific tasks, including:

- **Gold Talents:** Optimize your gold production for the long game.
- **Dragon Talents:** Focused on upgrading and enhancing your dragons.
- **Leveling & Raid Talents:** For fast progression and efficient gnome farming.
- **Building & Resource Talents:** Boost building speeds and resource generation.
- **Illusion Battlefield (IB) Talents:** Designed for competitive events.
- **Combat (General PvP) Talents:** Essential for battles and raids.

While advanced players will master each tree, beginners can stick with a few key setups to cover most situations effectively.

---

## Three Essential Talent Trees for Beginners

As a beginner, you can focus on these three talent builds to maximize your progress:

### 1. Techno-Gnome Talent Tree

- **Purpose:** Technology upgrades and gnome farming.
- **When to Use:** At least once daily for tech upgrades and before hunting gnomes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-104-1024x543.png)

- **Key Benefits:**  - Speeds up technology upgrades.
- Unlocks crucial gnome-killing talents like **EXP Boost**, **Enchanted Stone Bonus**, and **No Troop Loss** (ensuring sustainable growth).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-105-1024x514.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-106-1024x524.png)

- **Pro Tip:** Always use all talent hits on gnomes while in this tree to maximize double EXP, enchanted stones, and deathless hits. This ensures steady immortal progression.

### 2. Dragon Talent Tree

- **Purpose:** Boosting dragon upgrades and efficiency.
- **When to Use:** At least once daily and before starting a new dragon upgrade.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-107-1024x505.png)

- **Key Benefits:**  - Increases dragon upgrade speed.
- Reduces gold cost for dragon upgrades (important later in the game).
- Enables **Divine Walker**, allowing you to hunt gnomes without spending AP—a huge saver for your stamina.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-108-1024x445.png)

### 3. Two choices: a default Versatile Combat Talent Tree OR a full combat tree only for intense combat situations

Because we can so easily swap between talent builds, what you want for your third build is much more combat heavy than it was 1, 2 or 3 years ago. So what we can do for our last talent tree is two things based on your preferred playstyle:

a) Either you can go full combat and always swap into this talent tree when you are raiding gnomes, or fighting in PvP.

b) .. or you can make sure you get the must-have 10% gold production from the development tree and then sink the rest into combat. That way, you can use it as a default tree for all times and only swap away once per day or to begin a building, tech or dragon upgrades.

**Plan A continued...**

**If you chose to go full into combat talents here, you should only be in these talents while engaged in active combat. You need the gold buff passive active as many hours as possible.** Note that the below talents are just what suits my personal immortal composition. Combat talents are not set in stone as to which are better (like with development). Therefore, you want to make sure to find a good fit based on your specific setup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-110-1024x546.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-111-1024x378.png)

**Plan B continued...**

**If you choose to have a mixed versatile talent setup for your third tree, you have room for a lot of the combat talents while spending 11 points into development for the maximum gold production boon.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-109-1024x454.png)

---

### Getting Started as a Beginner

If you’re just starting out, follow this simple routine:

1. Use the **Techno-Gnome Tree** daily to farm gnomes and boost your technology upgrades.
2. Swap to the **Dragon Tree** at least once a day for dragon upgrades and efficient gnome farming with **Divine Walker**.
3. Set up your third tree as a **combat-focused build** for raiding and PvP.

By mastering these three setups, you’ll cover most of your needs while learning the game.

---

### Additional Resources

For detailed information on specific talent trees, check out these advanced guides:

- [**[Gold Talents Guide]**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/gold-talents/)
- [**[Dragon Talents Guide]**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/dragon-talent-builds/)
- [**[Leveling & Raid Talents Guide]**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/leveling-raid-talent-builds/)
- [**[Building & Resource Talents Guide]**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/building-resource-talents-build/)
- [**[Illusion Battlefield Talents Guide]**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/ib-talents-illusion-battle/)
- [**[Combat Talents Guide]**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/combat-talent-builds/)

---

### Free talent swapping is a Game-Changer

Free talent swapping lets you adapt instantly to any situation without worrying about gem costs. As you progress and unlock more strategies, you’ll find endless ways to optimize your talent builds.

Stick to this beginner setup, and you’ll be well on your way to becoming an *Infinity Kingdom* expert. Let me know if you have any questions or need help tailoring your talent trees further. Happy gaming!

title: Beginner Technology Research
summary: In the academy you have a ton of research into new technology. This is extreemly important to do, as there are huge growth buffs and crucial combat buffs to be gained here. Furthermore, you want to be efficient about…
markdown:
In the academy you have a ton of research into new **technology**. This is extreemly important to do, as there are huge growth buffs and crucial combat buffs to be gained here. Furthermore, you want to be efficient about it, since you are going to be doing **Technology Research the entire game**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-27-1024x127.png)

## What should I research? So many options!

You want to prio **build speed**before all else. Get that shit going hard! Once u do that, I like having a little in **rss development** too to help out getting more rss for builds.

You also need to move into **Gold Piles**for that extra gold. At end game, gold will be the most valuable ressource. You will run out of things to do with all other ressources before gold! Dragon levels and Immortal boost levels is extreemly expensive, hence gold production a high prio.

Lastly, you want to eventually get into **tech speed**too. However, you should wait a bit on that and get your troop boosts up once you unlock this at academy level 8.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-213009-1024x604.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/tech-1024x522.png)

### This is my prefered tech priority:

1. Always max **Speedy Construction** (Development)
2. Keep **Gold Piles** as high level as possible (Development)
3. Grab **Enhanced Crossbows** as soon as possible (Troops)
4. Then go for **Mounted Charge / Spear Dance / Frontal Strike** (Troops)
5. After these first troop tech tiers, go for **Bowman tech** in Immortal Tab.
6. Go ahead and get up your **Boost Consumption** now, you will have quite a few levels by now and boosts are beginning to become expensive.
7. Keep this logic, **upgrade troop tech over Immortal tech** untill you cap out at all level 40 tech. Upgrade Immortal tech secondary to troop and **ALWAYS prioritize bowmen** over all other types (since you are running 2x bowmen troops and they are most of your damage output).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-213025-1024x538.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-213137-1024x568.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-213043-1024x514.png)

title: Beginner’s Guide: Elemental Progression on New Servers
summary: Starting a new Infinity Kingdom server is an exciting time filled with opportunities to grow and plan your elemental progression. With access to Water, Earth, Lightning, Fire, and Wind at the start, there’s no shortage…
markdown:
### Elemental Progression on New Servers

Starting a new *Infinity Kingdom* server is an exciting time filled with opportunities to grow and plan your elemental progression. With access to **Water**, **Earth**, **Lightning**, **Fire**, and **Wind** at the start, there’s no shortage of options to build strong teams. However, the game’s evolving meta—and the eventual arrival of **Shadow** and later **Holy**—can make choosing your path feel overwhelming for new players.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-192.png)

This guide will walk you through the basics of elemental progression for new servers, offer insight into the early meta, and help you prepare for the changes as your server matures.

---

### Starting Elements: What to Know

In the early days of a new server, all elements are viable, but some have a natural edge due to their synergy, Immortal availability, and overall strength. Here’s a quick breakdown of each starter element:

- **Water**: Balanced, with strong survivability and good synergy. An accessible starting option for new players. Focusing on Control and adding e.g. Hippolyta will make this beginner friendly element viable also later in the game. Very cheap and beginner friendly, however loses out to the earth meta of early days. Comes back around later if played well (given your enemies are of the same spender level ofc).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-179-1024x397.png)

- **Earth**: High durability and excellent synergy. It becomes a dominant force early on for spenders. Excellent at both PvP and PvE. Holds its own well throughout all seasons if you are able to make ajustments later on like adding Himiko, etc.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-180.png)

- **Lightning**: Offensive powerhouse with great burst potential. Lightning marches can dominate PvP early on. Before shadow is released, lightning will dominate the meta. It remains powerful especially against heal-based setups such as earth and to some degree holy later on.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-181.png)

- **Fire**: Strong offensive option. However, it will take a long time to get online since it requires many of the later ToK skills to work well. As exit preperation stage and enter the season climb, fire grows in strength. Strong fire setups rely on spending, however cheap or even free to play versions are very strong options and the fire elemental is my personal favorite as your secondary setup. Cheap and effective.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-182-1024x413.png)

- **Earth-Wind-Hybrid**: An extreemly powerful setup later on. In the early game, you do not have the skills and artifacts required to make this team function optimally. While it can still be played as a viable option, it is not until you unlock Unique Artfacts for all slots that this build takes off. However, once it does you have one of the absolute best builds in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-183-1024x300.png)

---

### Shadow: The Early Meta Shifter

One of the most common questions from new players is: *“When does Shadow become available?”*

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-185-1024x557.png)

**Shadow Immortals and Dragon** become available during the **first Theia’s Roulette event**, which typically starts after the first **Contention of Relics (CoR)**. This is around the **3-4 week mark** on most servers, often when the server reaches Chronicle Stage 16, *Battle Fury*.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-186-1024x292.png)

Once Shadow is released, it quickly becomes a top-tier elemental for whales and higher spenders, as it counters all the starter elements natively. However, it’s important to note that **Shadow isn’t unbeatable**, and several setups can hold their own against it if wielded by a skilled spender.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-187.png)

---

### Early Meta Progression: Pre-Season and Season 1

In the early server stages (Pre-Season and Season 1):

- **Earth and Lightning** tend to dominate across all spending levels.
- Water is quite weak at this stage, however later as you get Assist and are able to add a Hippolyta to your frontline, it becomes a lot stronger.
- After Shadow’s release, the meta shifts toward Shadow-dominant setups, though counter builds such as **specific Water**, **Earth**, and specific hybrids remain competitive.
- **[Builds here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/elements/)**

---

### Building for the Meta: Elemental Rules of Thumb

While there’s no single “best” elemental, here are some guidelines to consider:

1. **For F2P Players**:  - Start with **Water** or **Lightning** for balanced growth.
- Progress gradually toward counters for Shadow, like **Water-Hippo** or **Earth-Himiko or E/W-hybrid.**
2. **For Low to Mid-Spenders**:  - Build **Earth** with Himiko for a strong, scalable march that remains viable even in the endgame.
- Alternatively, consider **Lightning** with Hammurabi and Genghis Khan for high burst damage or **water** Hippo for control setup.
3. **For Whales**:  - Aim for **Shadow** as soon as it’s available. Build a full Shadow team to dominate the meta until Holy is released then you need to whale into holy as your main, since Shadows are hard-countered by Holy. Your shadow then become an excellent secondary setup in place of e.g. fire which I usually recommend as secondary setups.
- Bank and collect Shadow Dragon fragments early and wisely, as they are key to maximizing Shadow’s potential.

---

### Tips for Countering Shadow

While Shadow is strong, it’s not unbeatable. Here are some setups to consider if you’re looking to hold your ground:

1. **Water-Hippo (Hippo-Attila Setup)**:  - Focuses on energy regeneration control to neutralize Shadow teams.
- Protect Merlin with **Assist** and **Fighting Master** to sustain damage output.
- Remain viable later, and can actually work surprisingly well against holy later on.
2. **Earth-Wind Hybrid**:  - Combines some of the best frontloaded normal attack damage and attack speed to pressure Shadow’s front line. As a heavily frontloaded damage setup, you can win the battle before shadow setups get their powerful skills truely working. Hybrids need the grace-based setup and Unique Artifacts. Remains a powerhouse well into the end-game.
- Shadow teams often struggle against hybrid setups due to their strong frontal offense. However, if you want to play shadow against a hybrid, running defensive versions have proven highly succesful.
3. **Pure Earth with Himiko**:  - A tried-and-true option for low and mid-spenders. Himiko’s utility allows Earth to compete even in Shadow-dominated metas. Remains a powerhouse well into the end-game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-189.png)

---

### Final Thoughts on Elemental Progression

At the start of a new server, **all elements are viable**, but **Earth** and **Lightning** often stand out for their early strength. As Shadow enters the picture, the meta shifts, but with proper preparation, you can remain competitive. Ultimately, success in *Infinity Kingdom* comes down to teamwork, strategy, and adapting to the evolving meta.

No matter which element you choose, remember: **Your march’s strength lies not just in its meta placement, but in how you build and use it.** Learn the nuances of your chosen element, lean into its inherent strengths, and adapt as your server grows.

Good luck, and may your marches dominate the battlefield!

title: Beginners Guide: Everything about server migration
summary: Migration in Infinity Kingdom is a significant decision that can shape your experience in the game. Whether you’re looking for a more competitive environment, better allies, or just a fresh start, moving to a new server…
markdown:
Migration in *Infinity Kingdom* is a significant decision that can shape your experience in the game. Whether you’re looking for a more competitive environment, better allies, or just a fresh start, moving to a new server requires planning and preparation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-110-1024x530.png)

This guide will walk you through the essential aspects of migration, from obtaining portals to understanding server restrictions, and help you decide whether relocating is the right move for you.

---

## Understanding Migration

### What is Migration?

Migration allows players (Lords) to transfer their accounts from one server to another. This can be beneficial for finding a stronger alliance, joining friends, or escaping an inactive server. However, migration comes with costs, requirements, and risks.

### Why Migrate?

- **Stronger Competition:** Some players prefer to migrate to more competitive servers to improve their skills and face greater challenges.
- **Better Alliances:** Your current alliance may be weak or inactive, prompting you to seek a more organized and active group.
- **Server Wars and Strategy:** Winning *Legion of Frostborn* wars can be easier on certain servers, depending on power balance and alliances.
- **Reuniting with Friends:** Many players migrate to join friends or follow their alliance.

**Basics - the right portal**
There are two versions of the Portal item, the purple version only works for players of low level. What you need it the Epic version and you need quite a few depending on your Power. More on that later. For now, just know that you are looking for this!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-109-1024x510.png)

---

## How to Migrate

### 1. Understanding Portal Requirements

Portals are required to migrate, and the number you need depends on your **maximum achieved Lord power**. Your current power doesn’t matter—what matters is the highest power you have ever reached.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-99-1024x564.png)

#### Portal Cost Based on Power Level

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-98.png)

### Reducing Power for Migration

If your power is close to the next portal threshold, consider:

- **Removing Dragons from Marches:** Dragons increase power but aren’t necessary for farming.
- **Using Low-Level Immortals for Farming:** Keep different elements to avoid extra power boosts.
- **Avoiding Upgrades Before Migration:** Holding off on major upgrades can keep your power lower before moving.

OBS: Migration Power Limits AND the number of Portals you need to migrate is ONLY based on your Maximum Historical Power. As such, you cannot remove dragons to drop below a threshold once you surpassed it. You can however, reduce your power in order to keep growing while you collect portals without reaching the next threshold.

*Important:* If you increase your power beyond a threshold, your portal cost will also increase. Plan ahead!

### 2. Acquiring Portals

There are several ways to obtain portals:

#### Free-to-Play Methods

### Alliance Coin Shop:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-100.png)

- Portals cost 20,000 alliance coins each.
- Coins can be earned by:  - Constructing alliance cities.
- Donating to alliance technology.
- Donating to alliance-occupied cities in *Legion of Frostborn*.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-101.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-102.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-103.png)

### Mini-Events:

- Occasionally, the game provides portals through events and login rewards.

#### Paid Methods

- **Special Bundles:** Available in the shop for real money.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-104.png)

- **Weekly Portal Bundles:** Post-Legion of Frostborne seasons often feature double-value Portal bundles, providing an opportune moment for spenders to stock up on Portals at a more economical rate. Prices range from $5 to $100, with the number of Portals increasing with the bundle’s value:
- $5 pack – 1 portal
- $10 pack- 2 portals
- $20 pack – 3 portals
- $50 pack – 4 portals
- $100 pack – 5 portals

### Golden Path - huge value for your money

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-107-1024x488.png)

For just 50 Merit Coins you collect a portal with a seasonal cap of 10. I would recommend anyone to collect all 10 until you have a bank - just in case you want to migrate later. There are not many things worse than playing in a server you do not want to be in.

### 3. Checking Server Restrictions

You have decided to migrate, you are on your way to collect portals or maybe you already finished collecting and are ready to find a new home - but you can't get in? There are limitations to migration that you must understand.

Each server has different migration conditions depending on the season and leadership:

- **Season 1:** Lower power cap for migration.
- **Season 2:** Increased power cap and improved rewards.
- **Season 3+:** Free migration between non-war servers.
- **Conquest Season:** No return to previous seasons, only migration within conquest servers.
- **Power Limits:** Some servers restrict migration based on Lord power; you may need approval from leadership.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-106.png)

Server Migration Conditions which restrict migration coming into a server is set by the King of the server, i.e. the player who has been crowned King by the winning Alliance during the most recent Contention of Relics.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-108-1024x503.png)

### 5. Planning and Coordination

- **Start Saving Early:** Gathering portals can take months, so plan ahead.
- **Scout Your Target Server:** Create a small account to check activity and leadership.
- **Communicate with the Server Leadership:** Ensure they will accept you and your alliance.
- **Ensure Your Team is Ready:** Migration is easier with a strong, coordinated group.

---

## Pros and Cons of Migration

### Pros:

✔️ Find a stronger alliance and community.
✔️ Experience better competition.
✔️ Improve rewards and growth opportunities.
✔️ Escape dead or toxic servers.
✔️ Join friends or reunite with old allies.

### Cons:

❌ Gathering portals is time-consuming.
❌ Leaving friends behind can be difficult.
❌ New server dynamics can be unpredictable.
❌ Risk of not being accepted into alliances.
❌ Higher power might mean a more expensive migration.

---

## Final Thoughts

Migration is a big decision in *Infinity Kingdom*, and it requires preparation and strategy. Whether you’re a free-to-play player or a spender, planning ahead will ensure a smoother transition. Consider the costs, research the server you’re moving to, and work with your alliance to make the best choice for your growth and enjoyment in the game.

Happy gaming, and may your migration lead you to victory!

title: Beginners guide to resources and resource management in Infinity Kingdom
summary: Welcome to the world of Infinity Kingdom! As you start your journey, one of the most critical aspects to master is resource management. Whether you're a new player just figuring things out or an intermediate player…
categoryPath: tips and tricks for newer players
markdown:
Welcome to the world of Infinity Kingdom! As you start your journey, one of the most critical aspects to master is resource management. Whether you're a new player just figuring things out or an intermediate player looking to refine your approach, understanding how to gather and use resources efficiently is the foundation for your success. Let me guide you through the essentials and share some tips to ensure you’re always ahead of the curve.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-42-1024x553.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-52-1024x472.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-51-1024x472.png)

---

### Why Resources Are Key to Your Growth

In Infinity Kingdom, resources are the lifeblood of progress. They fuel everything from upgrading your castle to training troops and researching technologies. Early on, you’ll notice that resources seem plentiful. Completing quests, defeating gnomes, and playing regularly will give you enough to cover the costs of building upgrades and troop training. However, as you advance beyond Castle Level 20, the resource requirements increase dramatically.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-42-1024x553.png)

- **Castle Level 10:** Costs a manageable 105,000 resources combined.
- **Castle Level 20:** Jumps to a hefty 1.45 million resources.
- **Castle Level 40:** A staggering 140 million resources.

You can read much more about the costs of **[upgrading your castle](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/buildings/castle-upgrade-costs/)** and all other buildings in Infinity Kingdom **[here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/buildings/)**. On this page you find details on all costs for all levels across all buildings. Furthermore, you can use this link **[here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/buildings/castle-upgrade-requirements/)**to see a list of the prerequisites for upgrading your castle. Use this to plan your progress.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-43-1024x406.png)

These escalating costs mean you need a solid plan to keep up with the demand. Without one, you risk stagnating and falling behind other players.

---

### Basic Resource Collection: The Starting Point

The first and most straightforward way to gather resources is through your resource production buildings within your castle. These include farms, sawmills, quarries, and mines.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-46-1024x348.png)

Upgrading these buildings increases their production rate and capacity. ***While this may seem like the logical first step, I’d advise caution:***

- **Why not prioritize production buildings?** Upgrading these buildings early can slow down your castle level progression. Higher-level castles unlock more powerful features and troops, which are crucial for growth. Instead, focus your efforts on other methods to supplement your resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-45-1024x569.png)

**Key Tip:** Upgrade production buildings sparingly and focus on castle progression for long-term benefits.

---

### Efficient Resource Collection Outside Your Castle

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-52-1024x472.png)

#### 1. Resource Nodes on the Map

Resource nodes scattered across the map are a reliable source of resources. When your troops aren’t busy raiding gnomes or garrisoning, always send them out to gather from these nodes. The higher the level of the node, the more resources you can collect. Be vigilant and strategic about node placement to maximize your gathering efficiency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-44.png)

**Key Tip:** Use immortals with gathering boosts or skills to improve collection speed and capacity.

#### 2. Alt-Account Farming

Creating alternate accounts (alt accounts) dedicated to resource farming is one of the most efficient ways to supplement your main account. There are two main strategies for alt farming:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-47.png)

- **Focused Alt Farms:** Fewer alt accounts that you actively play and use for resource node collection and upkeep.
- **Passive Alt Farms:** Multiple alt accounts that you develop just enough to produce resources passively. These require less daily attention and serve as consistent suppliers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-48.png)

Setting up a network of farms will significantly enhance your resource income without slowing down your main account’s progress. See multiple guides to running alt-farms efficiently **[here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/resources/resources/)**.

**Key Tip:** Join an alliance with your alts to gain benefits while avoiding unnecessary attacks.

#### 3. Dead Castles

In any server, players inevitably quit or become inactive. These “dead castles” can be goldmines for resources. Scout and mark them for daily collection. Over time, this can become one of your most lucrative resource-gathering strategies.

**Key Tip:** Watch for server merges and growth stages, as new dead castles often appear after these events.

---

### Conserving and Timing Your Resource Usage

#### Inventory Resource Items

Throughout the game, you’ll collect resource items stored in your inventory. While it’s tempting to use these as soon as you’re short, conserving them for critical moments is essential. I’ve found that the sweet spot for using your inventory resources is between Castle Level 30 and 40. At this stage:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-49-1024x518.png)

- Costs are skyrocketing.
- The server is still relatively active with fewer dead castles.
- You’ll need a resource boost to maintain momentum.

**Key Tip:** Use inventory resources strategically to push through significant upgrades or during timed events for extra rewards.

---

## Wrapping It Up: Your Path to Resource Mastery

Efficient resource management isn’t just about collecting as much as you can—it’s about planning and prioritizing. Here’s a quick recap of what you should do:

- Focus on castle progression over upgrading resource production buildings.
- Always gather from resource nodes when your troops aren’t occupied.
- Create alt accounts for dedicated farming, either actively or passively.
- Scout for dead castles and collect from them daily.
- Conserve your inventory resources for crucial stages like Castle Level 30-40.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-50.png)

By following these tips, you’ll set yourself up for success and ensure you’re never caught short when those massive upgrades come knocking. Resource management may seem tedious at first, but once you get into the rhythm, it’s incredibly rewarding. Now, go forth and conquer—your castle awaits!

title: 🌊 Beginner's Guide to the Season 1 Water March (v2.8.3)
summary: In Infinity Kingdom, the Water March has long stood as a stable and reliable composition for new and experienced players alike. Especially in Preparation Season and Season 1, it is one of the most accessible and…
markdown:
### Merlin, Yoshi, Herald, Attila – The Foundation of Water Domination

In *Infinity Kingdom*, the Water March has long stood as a stable and reliable composition for new and experienced players alike. Especially in **Preparation Season** and **Season 1**, it is one of the most accessible and powerful builds available to free-to-play and light spenders. This guide covers the default **Season 1 Water setup**, focusing on core strategies, synergy, skill choices, and progression paths.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/image-10.png)

Let’s dive into how this beginner-friendly composition becomes a powerhouse on the battlefield.

---

## 💧 The Standard Season 1 Water Setup

- **Merlin** – Your main magic damage dealer.
- **Yoshitsune (Yoshi)** – Secondary DPS and support.
- **Herald** – The tanky support providing defense and disruption.
- **Attila** – Frontline control/DPS hybrid with strong regeneration and utility.

### Skill Loadout:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-172.png)

### Merlin

- **Death Breath**
- **Annihilation**
- **Concentration**
Your primary DPS. Merlin’s role is to obliterate the backline with AoE magic. His synergy with chill effects and crit-based burst makes these three Tower of Knowledge skills ideal for raw magic output. Against Shadow teams, swap **Concentration** for **Fighting Master** to avoid control lockdown.

### Yoshitsune (Yoshi)

- **Anger**
- **Assist**
- **Absolute Defense**
Yoshi plays a dual role: early-game nuke and bodyguard. **Anger** helps his first ultimate hit hard, while **Assist** redirects pressure away from Merlin. **Absolute Defense** ensures he survives long enough to cast and protect.

### Herald

- **Oaken Guard**
- **Energy Suppression**
- **Malice**
A classic support tank. His goal is to reduce enemy damage, delay ultimates, and mitigate crits. Herald’s scaling is weak late-game, but he’s indispensable in S1 water builds. All three skills are defensive staples.

### Attila

- **Adrenaline Rush**
- **Fighting Master**
- **Duel Master**
Attila here is used not just for control immunity but also solid single-target and disruption value. He regenerates energy quickly and avoids crowd control, giving him decent uptime with his own disruptive skills and survivability with the Water Dragon’s healing.

---

## 🧠 Strategy & Playstyle

This water build is centered around **Merlin’s explosive AoE output**, protected by **Yoshi’s Assist**, **Herald’s bulk**, and **Attila’s control resistance**. In the early game, you’ll face opponents who are still figuring out their builds, and the sheer damage from Merlin will often carry you to victory.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-174.png)

**Yoshi functions as an early-game wildcard**: not only does he dish out damage, but his **Assist** plays a crucial role in protecting Merlin, allowing him to consistently reach his damage peaks. This makes your march highly durable and dangerous in prolonged fights.

**Attila’s flexibility** also helps adapt to various matchups. If he is being heavily targeted and dies too quickly, you can reconfigure him as a support-focused Immortal instead of a semi-DPS role.

---

## 🔧 Strategic Skill Adjustments Based on Enemy Matchups

No build exists in a vacuum. Every composition must adapt to **what your rivals are using**. In Season 1, you’ll face primarily Fire, Shadow, and Mirror Water marches. Use these tips to customize your build:

### 1. Misleading (for Physical Defense)

Early game opponents lack Accuracy due to limited tech. Adding **Misleading** to Attila can greatly reduce enemy physical damage. This is especially effective against hybrid builds and Tutankhamun Shadow compositions.

> Swap Misleading into Attila’s skill set **in place of Fighting Master or Duel Master**, depending on his survivability and output.

### 2. Weakness (to Boost Crit Rate)

A powerful way to enhance **Merlin’s burst**. If you notice his crit rate is a little low, placing **Weakness** on Attila (or Herald) can increase Merlin’s crit consistency dramatically.

### 3. Rage Blessing (Post Adrenaline Rush Nerf)

Due to the recent nerf to **Adrenaline Rush**, **Rage Blessing** is gaining traction. Its bonus energy regen synergizes with this water build, especially if you swap **Duel Master or AR** from Attila.

### 4. Blessing of Defense (For Survivability)

Always solid when you need to tank heavy frontloaded damage, especially against enemy Shadow or burst Hybrid setups. Place this on Herald or Attila depending on who is being targeted more.

---

## 💰 Spender Tips & Replacements

For spenders and light payers, there are a few quality-of-life upgrades you can pursue:

- **Elizabeth Bathory** (replaces Yoshi): She’s strictly better than Yoshi in terms of survivability and utility, but only worth investing in if you’re already spending.
- **Dido** (Season 1): A major improvement over Yoshi. Replace him ASAP once unlocked.
- **Artemisia**: Unlike Dido’s RNG-based chill, **Arte has guaranteed chill application**, making Merlin’s output significantly more reliable. She is a **great paid upgrade** in Season 1 or Season 2.
- **Ragnar** (Season 2): A must-have. Swap Herald for Ragnar to get a **Tank-class Immortal**, allowing you to run key Tier-2 ToK skills like **Coercion** or **Absolute Defense** more effectively.

---

## 🔄 Progression Path After Season 1

Once you’re out of S1, you can keep building around **Merlin** or switch to other Immortal cores. Here’s how to evolve your Water build:

- **Merlin / Dido / Ragnar / Attila**  - Standard S2+ Water team for F2P or light spenders
- Offers more debuffs, tankiness, and consistent chill uptime
- **Merlin / Artemisia / Ragnar / Bathory or Attila**  - Mid-spend build with enhanced control and damage.
- More consistent chill for Merlin and better frontline performance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/image-12-1024x461.png)

- **Bjorn integration** (Advanced)  - Use to stack additional debuffs alongside Ragnar for max Merlin synergy.

In Conquest and beyond, **Water remains strong** if you keep your skills and synergies up to date. Many players evolve it into control-heavy builds or focus on frontlining Merlin using Blessing of Defense or Energy Suppression combinations.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/image-11.png)

---

## ⚖️ Conclusion

This **default Season 1 Water March** is one of the most powerful and well-rounded beginner builds available. It delivers on everything a new player needs: survivability, AoE damage, flexibility, and control immunity. The synergy between **Merlin's high damage output**, **Yoshi's protection**, **Herald’s tank support**, and **Attila’s disruption** creates a march that punches well above its weight.

Use this setup as your **foundation**—and then grow it, adapt it, and evolve it to match the meta of your server and your own playstyle.

> “Master the basics of Water early, and you’ll never be left out in the cold.”

title: Beginners: How to Trade Honor with a Friend
summary: Honor trading is a crucial strategy in Infinity Kingdom, yet many players do it inefficiently. I’ve seen too many players simply sending weak attacks at a friend, or removing their main march and garrisoning themselves…
markdown:
### Trading Honor with Your Friends - A Guide

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-47.png)

## Why Trade Honor?

Honor trading is a crucial strategy in *Infinity Kingdom*, yet many players do it inefficiently. I’ve seen too many players simply sending weak attacks at a friend, or removing their main march and garrisoning themselves with a secondary march, then letting their friend attack with honor talents active. While this does generate honor, it’s **extremely inefficient** compared to the optimal method.

Players in my preparation-stage server (I play on Server 325 now) have been asking how to trade honor correctly. The right way ensures **maximum value** from your Talented attacks by letting you cleave through **four weak marches** from your friend, doubling your honor gain.

## Why Honor Matters in Infinity Kingdom

Honor is one of the most important resources in *Infinity Kingdom*, yet many players don’t fully understand how vital it is to their overall growth and strength. Whether you're competing for dominance in PvP battles, defending your territory, or simply trying to keep up with the top players in your server, Honor plays a crucial role in your success.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-46-1024x543.png)

## What is Honor?

Honor is a **prestige-based ranking system** that provides direct **stat bonuses** to your troops. Unlike temporary buffs from items or research, Honor-based buffs are permanent **as long as you maintain your ranking**. This means that players with high Honor not only have an edge in fights but also scale their power faster than others.

## The Benefits of Honor

1. **Troop Attribute Buffs**  - Honor increases key attributes like **attack, defense, and HP**.
- These percentage-based increases boost overall troop effectiveness, making your armies stronger in every fight.
2. **Troop Count Increases**  - One of the most significant advantages of Honor is **the ability to bring more troops into battle**.
- Since army size is one of the most critical power factors, increasing troop count gives you a **direct advantage over lower-rank players**.

Since troop count is the key to overall strength, maximizing Honor Ranking gives you a **competitive advantage** in battles.

---

## How to Trade Honor Efficiently

Alright, let’s break it down in a simple, easy-to-follow way. If you want to trade honor **efficiently**, you and your friend need to **work together properly**. Don’t just randomly attack and hope for the best. Follow this **step-by-step process** to maximize your honor gain every day!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-48.png)

### Step 1: One of You Leaves the Alliance

- If you and your friend are in the same alliance, one of you needs to temporarily leave so you can attack each other.
- Make sure to **coordinate** so they can rejoin quickly afterward.

### Step 2: Positioning - Get Close

**Relocate right next to each other** to avoid march travel time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-53.png)

The closer you are, the faster the process will go! You can do this at a little range, but you must be able to send three attacks before the 5 min relocation build timer runs out. So just move next to each other before you being!

### Step 3: The Defender Sets Up (Weaken Yourself!)

- The **defender** (Player One starts first) removes:  - **All Tower of Knowledge (ToK) skills**
- **All Dragons**
- **All Equipment** (optional, but makes it even better)
- This ensures **weak marches** with **maximum troop deaths**, which means **more honor per battle**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-52-1024x564.png)

### Step 4: Defender Garrisoning

- Player One **uses a relocation** right next to themselves.
- They send **all four weak, naked marches** to **garrison the relocated spot**.
- This sets up the perfect opportunity for the attacker!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-54-1024x539.png)

### Step 5: Attacker Goes All-In with Honor Talent

- Player Two **activates the Honor Talent** (**Rank Advancement** in the talent tree).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-55-1024x518.png)

- Player Two **attacks the four garrisons** with their **strongest main march**.
- Repeat this process **three times** (until all three Honor Talent stacks are used).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-51.png)

### Step 6: Swap and Repeat

- Now, Player Two removes all ToK skills, dragons, and equipment.
- Player Two uses a relocation and garrisons four weak marches.
- Player One **activates Honor Talent** and attacks.
- Repeat three times.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-56.png)

---

## The Result?

- Both players **maximize their Honor gain** in **a short time**.
- **More Honor = More buffs = More power!**
- Repeat **daily** with a trusted friend for consistent ranking gains.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-58.png)

### Summary - Quick Steps to Follow

1. One player **leaves the alliance**.
2. **Teleport close** to each other.
3. The **defender removes** ToK skills, dragons, and equipment.
4. The defender **garrisons four weak marches** at a relocation spot.
5. The attacker **uses Honor Talent** and **attacks three times**.
6. **Swap roles** and repeat.
7. **Rejoin the alliance** when done.
8. Do this **every day** for the best results!

Using this method ensures that both players **get the most Honor possible** while minimizing wasted attacks. If you see players using inefficient methods, share this guide with them!

## General Notes - Honor Gains

1. **Trade Honor with Friends**  - The most efficient way to farm Honor is through coordinated **Honor Trading** (see separate guide for details).
- This involves setting up weak marches for your friend to attack while their **Honor Talent is active**, and then swapping roles.
2. **Participate in KE and PvP Events**  - High-risk, high-reward: Defeating enemy players in KE events can yield huge Honor gains.
- However, be strategic—avoid unnecessary troop losses and always attack from a position of strength.
3. **Stay Active in Server Wars**  - Many servers have large-scale battles that **reward Honor for successful attacks**.
- Join your alliance’s war efforts to consistently gain Honor over time.

Happy Honor farming!

## Conclusion

By focusing on passive skills that benefit from increased attack speed and physical damage, players can circumvent the limitations imposed by "Berserker" and unleash the full potential of their combatants.
