title: Alex-Khubilai boss killer build (patch 2.4)
summary: Today I have a very special guide for you guys, this is going to be a boss-build special and one that I am very hyped about myself. Killing bosses in one swift blow not needing the AP-expensive 3x attack perk loaded is…
markdown:
Today I have a very special guide for you guys, this is going to be a boss-build special and one that I am very hyped about myself. Killing bosses in one swift blow not needing the AP-expensive 3x attack perk loaded is incredibly important to the growth rate of any player throughout the entire Infinity Kingdom journey.

From beginner to the biggest of end-game whales are all limited by AP. Moreover, if you want to compete in the Titantula Spider Event on wednesdays and sundays you are going to need a top tier boss killer build that gets you comfortably into the top 10 consistently and gives you a solid window to win the killing blow.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-1-1.png)

I have published a fair bit of guides on making boss-killer builds with different elements, but **never before have I seen a march as powerful as the one we are going to have a look at here today!**

## What does “best” mean?

For **bosses**and **spider**you need one thing: **Damage and tons of it!** Now you may be thinking - well what about my troop losses? And yes, that's well and good to take less damage fighting a boss, but how do you do that? You kill it fast.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-11.png)

For **Titantula Spider**you want to focus on two things: **(1)**Maximizing your damage to rank top 10 in as many spider kills as possible during the day.**(2)** getting the killing blow. And the best way to achieve that is more damage per strike. **We need raw damage**!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image.png)

So the question is, how do we make the biggest and badest spider march on the playgound? We need **high damage** output Immortals, a **damage boosting dragon** (never run e.g. earth dragon!!) and we want our damage types from both Immortals and passives to have the highest possible **single-target damage** output (very different from gnomes or PvP).

## Genious boss-killer

This is where things gets interesting. I would like to present you all to a boss-killer build made by the player "Heavystyle" from NFG in server 121. Heavystyle has made the single best boss-killing build I have ever seen and has been kind enough to share it with me and with you in the Infinity Kingdom Community! All credit for this build goes to him, he did an amazing job with it and it works insanely well. I have been looking over reports and testing this build out myself. I am absolutely amazed so as the last thing before going into details with our build here I want to thank Heavystyle for wanting to share this with us all.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-1.png)

## The build setup

This build involves a number of different Immortals and no elemental synergies what so ever. As I outlined in the beginning we need raw damage and we need as much single-target damage as possible. The elemental synergy buffs are nice but they are by no means a match for stacking raw single-target damage. As such we are running **Yoshi, Qin, Alex and Khubilai Khan**.

This setup is masterfully skilled at dealing tons of single-target damage from Yoshi, Alexander and Khubilai Khan while maintaing high attack speed (Qin) and an insane physical damage debuff from Khubilai.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-10.png)

1. **Yoshitsune**. Is extreemely easy to obtain and very very powerful in single target combat since his skill will hit for full damage on a single target instead of spreading it across multiple enemies.
2. **Khubilai Khan**. The same concept applies to Khubilai Khan. He deals multiple damage instances which all hit a single target when there is only one to hit! Therefore, he is a very strong Immortal for pure damage. In addition, he has a unique stacking physical damage debuff on the enemy which pumps up the damage of this setup to absurd amounts!
3. **Emperor Qin**. This may seem like an odd choice, he deals no noteworthy damage what so ever, but what he can do is buff attack speed like no others. This means our other Immortals gain a huge buff to the attack speed and thus damage output.
4. **Alexander**. King of single-target damage, Alexander will deal rediculous amounts of damage with the buffs and debuffs of this setup. He is unmatches by any other Immortal in Infinity Kingdom when used in this setup. Moreover, you should note that this is even **WITHOUT**the Tower of Knowledge skill Wind Rage! If you do have Wind Rage available he is unstopable and borderline OP in his ability to kill bosses.

## Passive Loadout

We need to boost our damage as much as possible. This means, shelter, fighting will, life link, assist and all the other meta-passives for PvP are utterly useless. Instead, we are running all the damage and single-target passives we can muster.

So the idea for this build is to get as much dmg as you can in 48seconds. That’s how long a spider fight typically lasts, after that most immortals get annihilated.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-2-1.png)

### Emperor Qin

**Qin**has sacrifice to boost dmg on any of the 3 dmg dealers since he is support. War blessing and speed blessing further that point with the dmg and speed boosts. The important point for him is to have as close to 100% uptime on his attack speed buff as possible from his ultimate. The **artifact**we have for him boosts energy regen, the primary reason for using this artifact over others.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-4.png)

### Alexander the Great

**Alex**is the main dmg dealer so he has duel master to boost his normal attack damage. Combo is great for Alex because of the single target focus on the ability and his insane attack speed. Weakness is there to make most hits crits to optimize damage output in the alotted time window while also boosting Yoshi’s **energy regen** through energy burst. His **artifact**is huge for this build especially if you can proc **rapid**for attack speed and have **physical attack**as it’s main stats.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-5.png)

### Yoshitsune

**Yoshi**has berserk to speed up auto attacks which synergizes well with Alex and kublai while boosting energy regen for Yoshi with his next skill. Energy burst is on him for more ultimate casts since that’s his primary source of damage. Anger is there to just beef up his hits. Having his artifact helps add more damage padding with the 4th shot.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-3.png)

### Khubilai Khan

**Kublai**has adrenaline rush to get more ultimates off to boost both his and the other immortals dmg due to the physical defense debuff it stacks. **Life link** is the key to the next level of damage for **spider**specifically. The damage redirection with how strong the spider hits gives you insane damage output potential. When you add absolute defense to the mix you get a multiplier for the life link damage potential.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/ll2.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/ll.png)

This combo Life Link + Absolute Defense is how you can drag a fight to its max duration (RNG permitting). The damage you block gets redirected to the spider and keeps you alive longer to get more Life Link procs. His **artifact**is geared for **energy regen** and **attack damage**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-6.png)

**Be aware that you MUST place Khubilai Khan on the front left in order to have him tank bosses.**

## Dragon - the last key to the puzzle

The dragon is the final piece to the puzzle. It needs to be into the talent tree to benefit the most. **The skills you choose for it that are important are the ones that give the dragons breath the ability to boost immortal dmg by X% for 12seconds after the breath.** That will scale the further into the dragon tree you go.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/4.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/3.png)

This build will work without a maxed lightning dragon but that boost helps get to the insane damage levels. Fire dragon or Shadow dragon can be used as substitutes for perfectly fine effect, however we do not have much data for those dragons in this specific build at the time of writing, but you can rest assured that they will both perform quite well as replacements.

## Performance: (1) Spider

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-1-3.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/2-1.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-8.png)

You get higher damage if you attack once spider is below 50% HP. When I’ve hit spider above 50% I tend to get into mid to high 2% range aka 2.5-2.9% whereas **hitting a spider below 50% enables hits well beyond 3-3.5%**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-6-1.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-5-1.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-4-1.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-3-1.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-2-2.png)

## Performance: (2) All Bosses

Life-Link and Absolute Defense can be replaced when you are fighting bosses, however, there is not much point in making the effort to do so, simply because this crazy build will kill any boss level 15 with ease!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-6-2.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-4-2.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-2-3.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-9.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-5-3.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-3-2.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-1-4.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-7-1.png)

title: Best Castle Skins for Combat in Infinity Kingdom – Complete PvP Tier List
summary: Castle skins have become one of the most important sources of combat
markdown:
![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120519-53hqxg.png)

However, not all castle skins are equally powerful, and perhaps more importantly, **not all percentage-based combat bonuses are equally valuable**.

A skin providing 15% Immortal Defense might sound incredibly strong, but in practice it can be considerably less valuable than one providing 5% Troop Attack. The difference becomes particularly noticeable in the late game, where enormous troop counts make troop-based attributes an increasingly important part of combat performance.

With the introduction of several powerful upgradeable castle skins, we now have multiple options providing up to 15% Troop Attack or Defense. This makes choosing the best skin more interesting than ever.

In this guide, we'll rank the strongest combat castle skins, compare their bonuses at different upgrade levels, explain why certain attributes are more valuable than others, and discuss when specialized skins such as Sun Chariot are worth using.

## TL;DR – Best Castle Skins for Combat

Our current ranking of the strongest combat castle skins in Infinity Kingdom is:

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120315-1ev8bx.png)

These rankings compare the skins at their maximum upgrade levels.

However, it's important to remember that a fully upgraded castle skin is considerably stronger than a newly unlocked one. A level 1 Abyssal Temple only provides +5% Troop Attack, meaning a significantly upgraded alternative can outperform it.

The ranking also reflects our assessment of overall competitive PvP value. Individual matchups and specialized builds can favor different attributes.

**Our recommendation:** For most players, prioritize a castle skin providing Troop Attack. Abyssal Temple is the strongest overall choice, while Throne of Blood and Hall of Divine Might offer exactly the same offensive scaling with different secondary benefits.

Lunar Grace Pavilion is the strongest alternative for defensive compositions, while Sun Chariot becomes interesting when movement speed is more important than winning a direct fight.

## Understanding Castle Skin Combat Attributes

Before comparing individual skins, it's important to understand why some combat attributes are considerably more valuable than others.

Infinity Kingdom has several different types of combat modifiers.

Some affect the personal attributes of your Immortals, while others affect the troops commanded by those Immortals.

This distinction becomes especially important in the late game.

### Why Troop Attributes Are So Powerful

Every Immortal commands thousands of soldiers, and both the Immortal's attributes and those soldiers' attributes contribute to combat performance.

As accounts develop, their troop counts increase dramatically. At the same time, higher troop tiers provide significantly stronger base attributes.

For example, a T9 Bowman has 225 base Attack.

If an Immortal commands 18,000 Bowmen, those troops represent an aggregate base Attack value of 4,050,000.

A 5% Troop Attack modifier adds the equivalent of 202,500 Attack to that aggregate base value, before accounting for other bonuses and the actual combat damage calculation.

At 15% Troop Attack, the corresponding increase becomes 607,500.

And that's just one troop stack.

The same type of modifier can improve the soldiers commanded by all four Immortals in your march.

This is why Troop Attack becomes exceptionally attractive as players develop larger armies with stronger troop tiers.

However, these aggregate values aren't direct damage numbers. Existing attributes, other bonuses, damage formulas, and enemy defenses all affect the final result.

Also, the number of troops doesn't make the percentage bonus itself larger. Rather, the same percentage applies to a larger underlying attribute pool.

### Our Combat Attribute Ranking

When evaluating castle skins for general late-game combat, I would usually prioritize the main attributes in the following order:

**1. Troop Attack**

The strongest general-purpose offensive attribute. It improves your soldiers' damage potential, helps finish battles faster, and can indirectly improve survivability by reducing how long your army remains exposed to enemy damage.

**2. Troop Defense**

An extremely powerful defensive modifier. Particularly valuable for frontline-heavy formations, sustained combat, and compositions that benefit from surviving long enough to activate additional skills.

**3. Troop HP**

Still useful, but generally the weakest of the three main troop attributes. Additional HP improves survivability without directly increasing damage output or reducing incoming damage per hit.

**4. Immortal Attributes**

Immortal Physical Attack, Magical Attack, and Defense can all be useful, but they affect a different part of the combat calculation and generally offer less broad scaling than troop-based attributes in highly developed marches.

This is a practical ranking rather than an absolute rule. Certain Immortal builds, defensive mechanics, and damage formulas can change the relative value of individual attributes.

Nevertheless, Troop Attack and Troop Defense are the two modifiers I would prioritize most heavily when choosing a combat castle skin.

## S+ Tier – Abyssal Temple: The Best Overall Combat Skin

Abyssal Temple remains my number-one recommendation for players who want the strongest all-around PvP castle skin.

Its main advantage is straightforward: it provides one of the best combat modifiers in Infinity Kingdom, alongside an additional benefit that makes prolonged warfare more sustainable.

### Abyssal Temple Upgrade Bonuses

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-115831-23tykq.png)

Each upgrade increases Troop Attack by one percentage point, eventually reaching +15%.

Meanwhile, Death Rate reduction improves from −3% to −6%, increasing by 0.3 percentage points per upgrade.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120341-b97m5c.png)

These bonuses make Abyssal Temple useful in almost every offensive combat situation.

The Troop Attack modifier improves the offensive capabilities of your entire march, regardless of which element or Immortal composition you're using.

This means it remains relevant whether you're fighting with Earth, Fire, Lightning, Holy, Shadow, or another formation.

### Why Abyssal Temple Takes First Place

Abyssal Temple doesn't provide more Troop Attack than Throne of Blood or Hall of Divine Might when all three are equally upgraded.

All three reach the same maximum of +15%.

The difference is the secondary attribute.

Abyssal Temple reduces Soldier Death Rate, while the other two skins provide development or gathering-related bonuses.

Death Rate reduction doesn't directly make your army deal more damage or improve its immediate defensive attributes.

However, it reduces permanent troop losses during battles where the modifier applies.

During prolonged PvP conflicts, where players repeatedly attack, defend, heal, and rebuild their armies, this becomes extremely valuable.

Even a relatively small reduction in permanent troop deaths can save substantial training resources and speedups across an entire KvK season.

And because the skin also provides maximum Troop Attack, you don't have to sacrifice your strongest offensive modifier to obtain that benefit.

This combination is what makes Abyssal Temple our S+ choice.

**Verdict: S+ Tier**

The best overall combat skin for competitive players. It matches the highest available Troop Attack bonus while also improving troop conservation during sustained warfare.

If I could choose only one fully upgraded skin for ordinary PvP, this would be it.

## S Tier – Throne of Blood: Troop Attack and Technology Progression

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-115844-b3th47.png)

Throne of Blood was introduced during the May 2026 Hunting Festival and immediately became one of the strongest offensive castle skins available.

It provides the same Troop Attack progression as Abyssal Temple, but replaces Death Rate reduction with Technology Upgrade Speed.

### Throne of Blood Upgrade Bonuses

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120355-9l4o9r.png)

The Troop Attack bonus increases by one percentage point per upgrade.

Technology Upgrade Speed increases more gradually, gaining 0.5 percentage points per upgrade until it reaches +10%.

### Why Throne of Blood Is So Strong

For direct offensive combat, Throne of Blood is effectively identical to Abyssal Temple at the same upgrade level.

Both provide the same Troop Attack modifier.

That makes Throne of Blood an excellent choice for players who want powerful combat attributes but don't necessarily need Death Rate reduction.

Its secondary bonus is also one of the better development attributes available on castle skins.

Technology is a major progression bottleneck in Infinity Kingdom, especially during Conquest and Legendary Season.

Players frequently complete their most important buildings long before finishing the enormous research requirements associated with advanced account development.

Additional Technology Speed therefore remains useful for a very long time.

Of course, this attribute doesn't provide an immediate advantage during battle.

But by allowing you to progress research more quickly, it can contribute to stronger combat capabilities over time.

### Abyssal Temple vs. Throne of Blood

This is one of the easiest comparisons in the guide.

At equal upgrade levels:

* Both provide identical Troop Attack.
* Abyssal Temple provides fewer permanent soldier deaths.
* Throne of Blood provides faster technology research.

For players fighting constantly in KvK, Abyssal Temple is my preferred option.

For accounts still developing their technology, Throne of Blood may actually provide greater overall account value.

It deserves to stand alongside Abyssal Temple for raw offensive strength, with Abyssal retaining the overall PvP advantage through its Death Rate reduction.

## S Tier – Hall of Divine Might: Another Top Troop Attack Skin

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-115941-c1rr1n.png)

Hall of Divine Might is another extremely powerful offensive castle skin.

Like Abyssal Temple and Throne of Blood, it provides up to +15% Troop Attack.

Its secondary bonus increases Troop Load rather than reducing deaths or improving research.

### Hall of Divine Might Upgrade Bonuses

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120257-wnenvx.png)

Again, Troop Attack increases by one percentage point per upgrade, while the secondary attribute increases by 0.5 percentage points.

### How Good Is Hall of Divine Might?

From a pure offensive perspective, Hall of Divine Might is just as strong as Abyssal Temple and Throne of Blood when upgraded to the same level.

This is the important distinction.

**You are not sacrificing any raw Troop Attack simply because you're using Hall of Divine Might instead of Abyssal Temple.**

The difference is what happens outside the direct damage calculation.

Troop Load determines how much resources your soldiers can transport.

This can be useful for resource collection and other logistical activities, but it doesn't improve damage output, durability, or combat survivability.

Consequently, Hall of Divine Might offers less overall PvP utility than Abyssal Temple.

It also lacks the development advantages provided by Throne of Blood.

However, that doesn't make it a weaker offensive combat skin.

For a player who already owns an upgraded Hall of Divine Might, there's little reason to spend heavily chasing an equally upgraded Throne of Blood purely for combat damage. Both provide the same Troop Attack.

**Verdict: S Tier**

One of the strongest offensive castle skins in Infinity Kingdom.

Its secondary bonus is less attractive than those of Abyssal Temple and Throne of Blood, but its maximum Troop Attack makes it an excellent choice for direct combat.

## A Tier – Lunar Grace Pavilion: The Defensive Powerhouse

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120001-blzkma.png)

Lunar Grace Pavilion is particularly interesting because it offers something different from the three offensive skins discussed above.

Instead of Troop Attack, it provides Troop Defense.

And not just a small amount.

At maximum level, Lunar Grace Pavilion provides **+15% Troop Defense**, making it one of the strongest defensive castle skins available.

### Lunar Grace Pavilion Upgrade Bonuses

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120421-83472l.png)

Troop Defense follows the same progression as Troop Attack on the premium offensive skins, increasing by one percentage point per upgrade.

Resource Gathering Speed improves by 0.5 percentage points per upgrade.

### Why Troop Defense Is So Valuable

Troop Defense is one of the most important combat attributes available in Infinity Kingdom.

Like Troop Attack, it affects your soldiers rather than only your Immortals.

This makes it particularly attractive at higher troop tiers, where the underlying Defense attributes of individual soldiers are already substantial.

For example, T9 Shieldmen have 213 base Defense.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120026-tg79xx.png)

A 15% Troop Defense modifier provides the equivalent of an additional 31.95 base Defense per Shieldman, before accounting for other bonuses and the full combat calculation.

Across thousands of soldiers, that represents a meaningful defensive improvement.

More importantly, additional Defense can help your formation survive long enough to activate more skills and maintain its damage output.

For certain builds, this can be extremely valuable.

### When Lunar Grace Can Outperform Troop Attack

Although I generally favor Troop Attack over Troop Defense, there are situations where Lunar Grace Pavilion becomes especially attractive.

The most obvious is a defensive formation designed to survive rather than defeat its opponent as quickly as possible.

Certain compositions rely heavily on healing, shields, damage reduction, Energy manipulation, and other defensive mechanics.

Their objective may be to survive until a powerful late-battle effect activates or simply to remain alive until the battle timer expires.

For these formations, additional Troop Defense can be exceptionally useful.

The same applies to defensive ramp-up builds that grow stronger as the battle continues.

If your formation needs to survive a prolonged opening period before becoming effective, increasing Troop Defense might contribute more to its success than adding another offensive modifier.

That is why Lunar Grace Pavilion deserves special attention for timeout-oriented and defensive builds.

### Why It Ranks Below the S-Tier Skins

For most ordinary PvP compositions, I still prefer Troop Attack.

Additional Attack helps defeat enemies more quickly, potentially reducing incoming damage by shortening the battle.

Troop Defense improves survivability but doesn't directly increase your damage output.

And while Lunar Grace Pavilion's Gathering Speed bonus is useful, it generally offers less long-term progression value than Throne of Blood's Technology Speed.

**Verdict: A Tier**

An exceptionally strong defensive skin and potentially an S-tier choice for specific timeout, tank, and defensive scaling formations.

For general-purpose PvP, however, I would prioritize the Troop Attack skins first.

## B Tier – Sun Chariot: Powerful Mobility, Limited Raw Combat Strength

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120056-2pgm2x.png)

Sun Chariot is probably the most interesting specialized castle skin on this list.

Unlike the others, its main attraction isn't increasing Troop Attack or Defense.

Instead, it provides substantial Marching Speed alongside bonuses to Immortal Physical and Magical Defense.

### Sun Chariot Upgrade Bonuses

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120434-w4ag2p.png)

All three attributes increase by one percentage point per upgrade.

At maximum level, +15% Marching Speed is a significant mobility bonus.

However, the distinction between Immortal Defense and Troop Defense is extremely important.

Sun Chariot improves the personal defensive attributes of your Immortals. It doesn't provide the same broad Troop Defense modifier as Lunar Grace Pavilion.

That makes it considerably less attractive for maximizing raw defensive combat strength.

### Why Marching Speed Can Be Extremely Useful

While Marching Speed doesn't directly improve your damage or durability once battle begins, it can be incredibly valuable during open-world PvP.

Moving faster creates opportunities that slower opponents cannot always respond to.

For example, you may be able to attack an enemy march and recall before their reinforcement arrives.

You can also intercept enemy movements, reinforce objectives more quickly, and reposition between engagements with greater flexibility.

This is particularly useful when you're fighting with your main march and need to balance offensive pressure with defensive responsibilities.

A faster march can attack an enemy and return to reinforce an important position sooner than a slower one.

During KvK, Norheim PvP, and other map-based activities, that kind of mobility can be a meaningful tactical advantage.

### When Sun Chariot Is a Bad Choice

The problem is that Marching Speed only matters when movement is relevant.

In Arena, or in other combat situations where both armies simply fight until one is defeated, the speed bonus does virtually nothing.

The same applies to many rallies and direct battles where the outcome is determined primarily by combat strength rather than positioning.

In those situations, Sun Chariot's Immortal Defense bonuses are significantly less attractive than Troop Attack or Troop Defense.

That means you could be sacrificing considerable combat strength in exchange for mobility you aren't actually using.

**Verdict: B Tier**

A specialized utility skin.

When you need speed, Sun Chariot can be excellent. When you don't need speed, it's generally a poor alternative to the premium Troop Attack and Defense skins.

I would obtain it for tactical flexibility, but I wouldn't prioritize expensive upgrades over improving Abyssal Temple, Throne of Blood, Hall of Divine Might, or Lunar Grace Pavilion.

## What About the Older Combat Skins?

Before these powerful upgradeable skins were introduced, most of the best combat-oriented options offered relatively small bonuses to Troop HP, Immortal attributes, Marching Speed, or other utility effects.

Several remain useful, particularly for players who haven't unlocked newer premium skins.

### Skyriver Palace

Skyriver Palace provides upgradeable Immortal Physical Attack and Magical Attack bonuses, alongside Death Rate reduction.

At maximum level, its offensive modifiers reach +15%.

This makes it useful for improving Immortal damage, but generally less attractive than the same percentage of Troop Attack in highly developed late-game marches.

It remains a reasonable alternative when a player doesn't own one of the stronger troop-based offensive skins.

### Mt. Paradise

Mt. Paradise provides +2% Troop HP and +5% Marching Speed.

It's a useful alternative to Sun Chariot for players who want additional mobility without investing in an expensive premium skin.

The Troop HP bonus is modest, but the ability to move more quickly can still provide tactical advantages.

### Goddess of Victory

Goddess of Victory provides +2% Troop HP and −3% Death Rate.

Its main value is reducing permanent troop losses during repeated combat.

It doesn't compete with a developed Abyssal Temple in raw fighting power, but can remain useful for troop conservation when stronger alternatives aren't available.

### City of Glory and Corridor of Ghostflame

These skins provide Troop HP alongside bonuses to Honor Gain, making them useful when farming Honor and progressing through Nobility ranks.

However, Honor Gain doesn't directly improve the strength of your army during a battle.

They're better understood as progression and farming skins rather than competitive combat skins.

### Colosseum

Colosseum provides Marching Speed and Honor Gain.

It can be useful for mobile Honor farming, but offers no direct Troop Attack, Defense, or HP bonus.

For competitive combat, it falls behind the more specialized options.

## Which Castle Skin Should You Use?

Although Abyssal Temple takes first place in our overall rankings, there are situations where another castle skin makes more sense.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120453-03705t.png)

This is why it's worth owning more than one castle skin.

You might use Abyssal Temple for competitive PvP, Throne of Blood while developing research, and Sun Chariot for situations where movement speed allows you to outmaneuver an opponent.

The most important thing is understanding why you're switching.

## Should You Upgrade One Skin or Unlock Several?

Upgradeable castle skins have become some of the most powerful premium bonuses available in Infinity Kingdom.

However, developing them can be extremely expensive.

The difference between the starting +5% Troop Attack and the maximum +15% is substantial.

But obtaining the additional skin fragments required for those upgrades can involve major spending or extensive participation in limited-time events.

This creates an important decision for players.

Should you focus on maximizing one powerful skin, or unlock several different skins for flexibility?

### For Low and Moderate Spenders

I would generally prioritize obtaining one good Troop Attack skin.

Even at its starting level, +5% Troop Attack is an excellent bonus.

If you already have Throne of Blood or Hall of Divine Might, there's little reason to purchase a level 1 Abyssal Temple purely because of its S+ ranking.

The offensive bonuses are identical at the same upgrade level.

Instead, evaluate which skin is easiest and cheapest for you to develop further.

You should also consider whether your resources would provide greater value through Immortal progression, artifacts, Dragon upgrades, or Tower of Knowledge skills.

### For Competitive Spenders

Players with highly developed accounts should consider prioritizing one strong Troop Attack skin toward its maximum level.

Abyssal Temple is the most attractive overall choice due to its combination of combat strength and Death Rate reduction.

However, if you've already developed Throne of Blood or Hall of Divine Might significantly further, switching to an underdeveloped Abyssal Temple may be a downgrade in immediate offensive power.

A fully upgraded Hall of Divine Might provides considerably more Troop Attack than a newly unlocked Abyssal Temple.

After developing a strong offensive skin, Lunar Grace Pavilion becomes a particularly interesting second investment for players who use defensive formations.

Sun Chariot is worth considering for players who frequently engage in tactical open-world PvP, although upgrading it should generally remain a lower priority.

### Compare Your Actual Bonuses, Not Just the Tier List

Our rankings assume equal development levels.

In practice, players may own skins at very different upgrade stages.

For example:

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261104-120509-mzezqz.png)

In this situation, Hall of Divine Might provides the strongest direct offensive modifier, even though Abyssal Temple is ranked higher overall.

The secondary bonuses don't change that basic difference in Troop Attack.

This is why you should always evaluate the actual bonuses displayed on your skins before choosing which one to apply.

## Final Thoughts – The Best Castle Skins in 2026

Infinity Kingdom's castle skin system has changed considerably over the years.

The older generation of skins offered modest bonuses to Troop HP, Immortal attributes, Marching Speed, and resource efficiency.

Today, several premium skins can reach +15% Troop Attack or Troop Defense, making them significantly more impactful in competitive combat.

Our ranking places **Abyssal Temple in S+ Tier**, thanks to its combination of maximum Troop Attack and reduced permanent troop losses.

**Throne of Blood and Hall of Divine Might belong in S Tier**, providing exactly the same Troop Attack scaling with different secondary bonuses.

**Lunar Grace Pavilion earns A Tier** because Troop Defense is an exceptionally powerful attribute, particularly for defensive, timeout-oriented, and scaling formations.

Finally, **Sun Chariot belongs in B Tier**, not because Marching Speed is useless, but because it only becomes valuable when you can take advantage of movement and positioning.

For most players looking to maximize raw combat performance, the decision is straightforward.

Prioritize Troop Attack, consider Troop Defense for specialized compositions, and treat Marching Speed as a tactical tool rather than a replacement for combat strength.

And most importantly, don't assume that a skin is automatically stronger simply because it belongs to a higher tier in our rankings.

A +15% Troop Attack skin is stronger offensively than a +5% Troop Attack skin, regardless of its secondary bonus.

**My recommendation: Develop one powerful Troop Attack skin as your main combat option, preferably Abyssal Temple for sustained PvP, and use specialized alternatives only when their bonuses directly support your strategy.**

For more information about why troop modifiers become so powerful at higher troop tiers, read our updated [Troop Tiers Guide](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/troop-tiers), covering the progression from T1 to T9 and the scaling of Attack, Defense, and HP.



### Related Guides

* [Throne of Blood – Troop Attack and Technology Speed](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/throne-of-blood/)
* [Sun Chariot – Defensive Buffs and Marching Speed](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/sun-chariot/)
* [Troop Tiers – T1 to T9 Stats and Power Scaling](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/troop-tiers/)

title: Best Conquest Spider build 2.8.3? (credit Yawg)
summary: The Spider Boss appears twice a week, and it is available to all alliances that have unlocked the boss through alliance building progression. Once summoned, the Spider Boss becomes a shared challenge where all alliance…
markdown:
The Spider Boss appears **twice a week**, and it is available to all alliances that have unlocked the boss through alliance building progression. Once summoned, the Spider Boss becomes a shared challenge where all alliance members can contribute damage to take it down.

This guide features a top-tier setup provided by **Yawgmoth**, who has managed to push some of the highest spider boss damage totals we've seen, despite not having maxed talents or fully upgraded skills yet. The potential of this composition is enormous, and it should be considered one of the premier builds for any player seeking to dominate spider raids.

The *Spider Boss*, formally known as the *World Spider*, is one of the most important PvE activities in Infinity Kingdom, especially for players looking to maximize progression through equipment upgrades and artifact enhancement.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-29.png)

### 📅 When and Where

---

## 🎯 Why You Must Do the Spider Boss

The Spider Boss is the **#1 source of Enchanted Stones**, the resource used to upgrade your equipment — and equipment upgrades are what skyrocket your Immortals’ stats as you move into mid- and late-game content. Without a steady supply of stones, your power will stagnate.

### 💎 Rewards You Can Expect:

- **Dragon Crystal Chest Keys** – Used to open Dragon Crystal Chests that contain crucial dragon upgrade materials. These are essential for advancing your elemental dragon to higher stages and unlocking powerful passives.
- **Tons of Enchanted Stones** – At high levels, each hit on the spider boss can net *tens of thousands* of stones. This is the most efficient way to collect large amounts for equipment upgrades.
- **Ranking Rewards** - Philosopher stones, gems and speed-ups

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-21-1024x560.png)

**This is why you need a top tier build! In the following we feature a build from Yawgmoth that has done incredibly well. He has been kind enough to share it with us all! Thank you!**

---

## 💥 Core Strategy: Maximize Redirect and Burst

The **Spider Boss** in *Infinity Kingdom* remains one of the most challenging yet rewarding PvE encounters in the game. The fight is all about **single-target burst damage**, careful synergy between immortals, and most importantly, the **Life-Link + Absolute Defense** combo, which redirects massive amounts of damage back at the boss. With the right build, players can achieve incredible damage numbers.

- **Single-target damage** is king in spider fights.
- Stack **damage amplification** and **energy regeneration** to optimize ultimates.
- Key synergy: **Life-Link + Absolute Defense** on your tank transfers incoming damage to the boss.
- Battle duration allows time for **ramp-up skills** to fully scale.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-22.png)

---

## 🔥 Immortal Setup Breakdown

### 🧙 Mathilda (Support / Energy Engine)

- **Purpose**: Energy regeneration + buffs
- **Key Skills**:  - **Weakness Aura** – Critical chance boost
- **Soul Synergy** – Keeps Tutankhammun at high HP
- **Energy Shield** – Shields also amplify Life-Link redirects
- **Synergy**: Buffs team survivability and enables stronger ultimates.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-23.png)

### 🔥 Seondeok (Backline DPS)

- **Purpose**: Main magic damage dealer
- **Key Skills**:  - **Anger** – Physical damage amplification
- **Energy Master** (or **Absolute Radiance**/**Energy Burst** if unavailable)
- **Fire Protection** – Crit-based bonus damage
- **Synergy**: High crit rate due to Weakness Aura and low boss resilience means big numbers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-24-1024x578.png)

### 🛡 Khubilaikhan (Debuff Utility)

- **Purpose**: Amplify physical damage taken by boss
- **Key Skills**:  - **Guard** – Support Tutankhammun survivability
- **Life-Link** – Mandatory for redirect combo
- **Absolute Defense** – Must-have for redirect damage
- **Synergy**: Debuffs boost Tutankhammun damage output significantly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-25.png)

### 💀 Tutankhammun (Core DPS / Redirect Tank)

- **Purpose**: Primary damage dealer and tank via redirect combo
- **Key Skills**:  - **Battle Stance** – 100% damage boost after ramp
- **Demonic Contract** – 150% boost over time
- **Blade Dodge** – Additional 70% damage after 20s
- **Total Damage Scaling**:  - +100% Battle Stance
- +70% Blade Dodge
- +150% Demonic Contract
- +20% Mathilda Buff
- = **340% Total Damage Boost**!
- **Tip**: Start slow, ramp high. You don't care about early damage — you're preparing for the explosion mid-fight.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-26-1024x595.png)

---

## 🧠 Summary Tips:

- Focus your skill investment on **Tutankhammun**, he’s the damage engine.
- **Do NOT skip Life-Link or Absolute Defense**; they define the strategy.
- Let Mathilda and Khubilaikhan keep the team alive long enough to scale.
- Aim for max uptime on critical buffs like Anger and Demonic Contract.
- Survivability is crucial — running out of HP before scaling kills the setup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-28.png)

This build, even in its incomplete form, is **one of the highest potential spider boss builds tested in Conquest 2.8.3**. If you're chasing top-tier rankings or just trying to farm efficiently, this team is well worth your investment.

Happy hunting!

title: Best Gnomes to Raid - levels 1-40
summary: Equipment items are super important in Infinity Kingdom. They provide large attribute buffs for your immortals and are an invaluable part of your power. Upgrading them as much as possible means raiding gnome camps for…
markdown:
Equipment items are super important in Infinity Kingdom. They provide large attribute buffs for your immortals and are an invaluable part of your power. Upgrading them as much as possible means raiding gnome camps for Enchanted Stones. Mastering gnome raids is one of the **biggest advantages** you can give yourself in Infinity Kingdom. Whether you’re a casual player or pushing for top-tier dominance, knowing **when and where to strike** will dramatically boost your growth.

Every piece of equipment you craft and upgrade is a direct **power increase** for your immortals, making them stronger in battle. But without a steady supply of Enchanted Stones and high-tier gear, you’ll fall behind. This is where efficient gnome raiding comes in—**the smarter you farm, the stronger you become!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-3-1024x471.png)

But it’s not just about gear. The **EXP** you earn from gnome raids is crucial for leveling up **three full marches** of immortals, ensuring you have the depth to compete in PvP, PvE, and major kingdom wars. If you’re not raiding the right camps at the right time, you’re simply slowing yourself down.

Want to **keep up with the strongest players?** Want to **make sure you’re not wasting AP on bad raids?** Then let’s break down exactly how to optimize your gnome farming strategy!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-1-1024x468.png)

Additionally, you’ll need three full marches of max-level immortals, which requires farming gnome camps for massive amounts of EXP. So, let’s break down which gnome camps to raid at different stages of your progression.

## Best Gnome Camps for Farming

When we talk about the best gnome camps, we mean those that offer the highest loot and experience relative to the losses sustained in battle. As you grow stronger, you can take on higher-level camps for better rewards.

### Gnome Loot Drops:

- **Trynt** drops: Helmet & Weapon
- **Bakan** drops: Chest & Weapon
- **Rogue** drops: Offhand & Weapon

Mastering gnome raids is one of the **biggest advantages** you can give yourself in Infinity Kingdom. Whether you’re a casual player or pushing for top-tier dominance, knowing **when and where to strike** will dramatically boost your growth.

Every piece of equipment you craft and upgrade is a direct **power increase** for your immortals, making them stronger in battle. But without a steady supply of Enchanted Stones and high-tier gear, you’ll fall behind. This is where efficient gnome raiding comes in—**the smarter you farm, the stronger you become!**

## Optimal Gnome Camps to Raid

At endgame, the best gnome camps to farm are **Earth and Water** element gnomes, meaning most players should follow this path:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-1024x561.png)

### Inside Forbidden Zone:

- **Trynt** – Level 38
- **Bakan** – Level 39
- **Rogue** – Level 39

### Outside Forbidden Zone:

- **Trynt** – Level 36
- **Bakan** – Level 36
- **Rogue** – Level 37

**Special Case: Fire March Players** If your main march is **Fire**, Water gnomes are not optimal due to their elemental advantage. Instead, raid the following:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-2-1024x445.png)

### Inside Forbidden Zone:

- **Trynt** – Level 36 or 40
- **Bakan** – Level 39
- **Rogue** – Level 37

### Outside Forbidden Zone:

- **Trynt** – Level 36
- **Bakan** – Level 34
- **Rogue** – Level 37

---

## Gnome Camp Element Breakdown

All gnome camps drop valuable equipment (see Equipment Guide for details). Once you reach level **36+ camps**, **epic+** and **epic equipment with elemental bonuses** start appearing.

There is a clear pattern in the best gnome camps for each level range. As you progress, the best camps increase by **10 levels** in each section:

- **Levels 1-9:** Trynt 6 or 8, Bakan 6 or 9, Rogue 7 or 9.
- **Levels 10-19:** Trynt 16 or 18, Bakan 16 or 19, Rogue 17 or 19.

title: Best Path to Upgrading Dragon Talents (Universal Dragon)
summary: In this guide we are going to answer the question I have been getting so many times: How should I upgrade my Dragon Talents? Which nodes should I take first? Do I upgrade to level 3?
markdown:
In this guide we are going to answer the question I have been getting so many times: How should I upgrade my Dragon Talents? Which nodes should I take first? Do I upgrade to level 3?

The answer is: Not like you think. **Prioritize Major nodes first**. Get both **Claw**and **Armor**first, then move to your prefered unique Dragon Skill **([read more about major nodes](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/dragon-talents-major-and-minor-nodes/))**. Let me explain!

## Talents 1:1 Moving around the talent tree

You have a large tree, and not all of the buffs and stats are relevant for you. For instance, my earth-wind hybrid main does not benefit from magic damage at all, so why would I want to spend crystals on that? Well I need to move around the talent tree and to do that I need to level up the minor nodes on the tree.

**Once you level up a minor node you can access the node behind it.** As you can see below, the arrows show how I unlock new minor nodes once I level up the first nodes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-67.png)

## Universal progression path

The unique nodes are more difficult. Because these depend on the setup, element and build that you are using. For instance, running Earth-Wind Hybrid you want attack speed as quickly as possible. As such you want the attack speed uniques from Aftershock as your main unique-priority. I cannot give a comprehensive list here of the uniques you want to have for your dragon, since that is wholly dependent on the build you are using. For instance, a control water would want energy regen control for unique effect, whereas a dual mage Merlin-Himiko water would want the magic damage boost from Coalescence.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-68.png)

However, whatis **UNIVERSAL** is the fact that you always want to prioritize key major nodes, even above uniques! They are simply too good and cheap to pass on. However, you shouldn't max them, their value are most efficient at rank 3 to begin with. Then you want to move on to the uniques that fit your build.

That's the first step in a long journey to complete your dragon's talent tree. In the following I have outlined a universal journey that any player should follow. **I have used the earth dragon as an example, but it dosen't matter what dragon you use**:

## THE progression path

I have changed the marking slightly in the next image, go pair better with the path progression guide. Beware that the concept is the same as the above, merely more CLEAR markings on what to get when.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-90.png)

### (1) Red get two-two and unlock majors Claw and Armor

So for the journey you want we want to begin with taking our key majors. In order to unlock the pathway to the two best majors in the game we need to have our dragon at 2-2-10. As such, you first move on the path is to follow the red lines. Unlock dragon uniques on both sides getting 2-2.

### (2) Blue. Upgrade majors to level 3

Claw provides you increased damage dealt by an increment of 1% and Armor provides reduced damage taken also by increments of 1%.

You have now completed your pathway to unlock Claw and Armor (major nodes). You want to upgrade these to level 3 out of 5. They are quite cheap at these levels and the 3% flat damage and reduces damage taken boost is MASSIVE. For comparison, some uniques costs both dragon essences and a lot more crystals and give you less % and even in a temporal buff. These two major nodes are KEY to the entire dragon progression and by far where most players make mistakes. You are most likely hungry to get the uniques to high level and flash off to your dragon, but you shouldn't. You should invest a bit more time and patience and get Claw and Armor up first.

### (3) Green: Max out your best unique

It is finally time for you to get those flashy uniques once you have completed rank 3 Claw and Armor. Now you need to figure out which dragon talent unique is best for your build and setup. You want to complete this unique node to rank 5 (as of current patch limitations at the time of recording).

**(3.1) At this stage you want to also upgrade all Physical damage / Magical damage as well as the physical damage taken / magical damage taken minor nodes to 3/3.**

Should I do both physical and magical damage and damage taken you may now be wondering? NO. You want to do ONE of them. Figure out which benefit your setup the most as well as which one provides the most value based on your most common enemies.

**Example 1:** Let's say I am doing an Earth/Wind Hybrid build. I want my Earth dragon maxed on physical damage dealt, since that is ALL of my damage! Furthermore, I am most often having problems fighting against big holy players. As such, I want to max out on reduced physical damage taken too.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-91.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-92.png)

**Example 2:** I am running Empress Wu + Cyrus and I have a really hard time winning particularly against Water Merlin-Himiko. I need to get as much magic damage boost to my Wu as possible and I want to protect myself against the big Merlin-Himiko magic damage burst, hence maxing magical damage protection.

**Example 3:** I am using a mix of magical and physical damage, maybe I run Baldwin-Atalanta or Seon-Wu. I often fight against a mixture of both magical and physical setups and they are all providing me equal trouble! Well, then you want to go ahead and not skip on anything. Get all of both physical damage, magical damage, physical protection and magical protection minors to rank 3. They are after all not incredibly expensive to max out.

The point here is that you want to skip some upgrades if you can, progressing faster through the tree if you have the option of doing so, i.e. being in a situation where you are always comfortably winning against e.g. physical setups or magic setups.

**(5) Yellow: Unlock the last two major nodes (accuracy and resiliance) lvl 1/5 & Finish your uniques to 5-5**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-93.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-94.png)

First up you want to complete the pathway throughout the tree and unlock your dragon's other unique ability to rank 5/5.

You are now quite far along your progression. You have the main majors to rank 3, unique skills to rank 5. You also have your key dmg modifier minors up to rank 3 and now you are ready to begin taking second tier majors: **Robust and Gaze**.

Robust provides you resilience rate by an increment of 1% and Gaze provides accuracy also by increments of 1%.

You need to think a bit on these majors too. While they should never be rushed to, you can entirely skip Gaze (accuracy) and just do Robust if you are relying on e.g. a duel-mage build for your setup. However, if you are doing a physical damage build like e.g. our wind/earth hybrid here, then accuracy is above resilience in your priority scheme.

**You want to unlock only rank 1 of these majors**, since their percentage value is less cost-effective at this stage.

### (5) Resiliance & Accuracy

At this last stage you want to upgrade all the minors for accuracy (if you run physical damage) and resiliance minors to lvl 3 as well as any of the damage defense minors if you skipped these in step 3.1.

Once you get these minors upgraded to rank 3 you want to focus on their corresponding major node and get that to rank 3/5.

Example 1: You are using earth/wind hybrid and as such you want to focus on accuracy. Accuracy is incredibly important for you and as such you prioritize this well above resilience. You want to upgrade minor accuracy nodes throughout the entire tree to rank 3/3 --> Then you upgrade your accuracy major Gaze to rank 3/5. Once this is done, you can do the same with resilience. At this stage, all that is left if maxing majors out to 5/5 again with Gaze (accuracy) before Robust (resilience).

Example 2: You are running Merlin-Himiko (dual mage). As such, you have absolutely no interest in getting accuracy what so ever. Your Attila may benefit slightly from hitting a hit or two more every now and then, but it is very low value for you since your damage is all magical and thus cannot be dodged. What you want to do is forget you ever heard about accuracy and max out on all of the resilience minors. Then you want to MAX resilience major to 5/5.

Example 3: You use a mixed damage type build, maybe you run our darling Seon-Wu build - well what you want to do then is you upgrade accuracy minors to rank 3/3, then you upgrade resilience minors to rank 3/3. Once that is complete you go ahead and upgrade your accuracy major (Gaze) to rank 3/5. Then you upgrade resiliance major (Robust) to 3/5. Lastly, you complete Gaze and then complete Robust.

**(6) Congratulations!**

You are done with your dragon talent tree! What you have left now are either irrelevant or nothing at all! What you want to do now is go kick some a** and begin progression on your secondary dragon. Luckily, it dosen't matter what element you run second, you simply begin again from step 1!

markdown:
## Why Season 1 Players Should Prioritize the Stardust Wheel Over All Other Spender Events

In *Infinity Kingdom*, every dollar you spend should push your account toward long-term growth and power. For Season 1 players, however, that’s easier said than done. The event options available are few, and most offer relatively poor returns compared to what becomes available later in the game. But there is one exception: **the Stardust Wheel (Primal Pinball event)**. If you’re considering spending during Season 1, this is where you get the best value—and here’s why.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-90-1024x586.png)

---

## The Key Problem: Season 1 Has Poor Spending Options

Let’s face it:

- We don’t have access to chaos immortals in seasonal events.
- We don’t have **Sparks of Galaxy**, which provides high-value holy/shadow immortal fragments.
- Even the most common seasonal spending events yield **less value per dollar** than what later seasons enjoy.

What we are left with are spender events like Theias Roulette costing thousands of dollars for a holy or shadow immortal which will cost hundres instead a couple months later!

But there’s one crucial upgrade system that *is* available in Season 1: **Immortal Portrait Levels**. And to max just one Immortal’s portrait, you’ll need a staggering **6,341 Stardust**.

***[Stardust upgrade costs, read more.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/immortal-portraits/portait-upgrade-costs-level-1-50/)***

Multiply that by 4 immortals across your main marches—and you quickly realize that Stardust is your biggest bottleneck to power in the early game.

This is why the **Stardust Wheel** is so important.

---

## Why the Stardust Wheel Is Better in Season 1

In Season 1, the Stardust Wheel offers **pure Stardust rewards**—and nothing else. That’s not a downside. In fact, it’s the reason this event is so valuable for us.

Starting from Season 2 and in Conquest, the wheel gets diluted with **Crimson Crystals**, a new resource required for chaos immortals. These are incredibly rare, incredibly expensive, and almost completely useless unless you’re spending $5,000+ to unlock and max Chaos immortals. That means that later versions of this wheel are far less efficient unless you’re a high spender chasing chaos.

In Season 1, though?

- **Every Pearl you spend goes toward Stardust**.
- You can stockpile it efficiently while avoiding future event dilution.

---

## Efficiency Confirmed: Real Drop Rates and Value

According to extensive data testing from the [**IK-Wiki Stardust Wheel guide**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/new-lucky-spin-stardust-edition/) and the [**Stardust Wheel drop rate breakdown**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/new-lucky-spin-stardust-edition/stardust-wheel-actual-droprates-pricing-of-stardust-and-stardust-per-pearl/), the drop rates for Stardust are solid:

- Jackpot: 400 Stardust (0.3% chance)
- 250–200 Stardust prizes (combined ~1.3% chance)
- Remaining prizes: 5 Stardust with decent probability

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-92-1024x424.png)

On top of that, bonus milestone rewards from the event add another layer of return for committed spenders.

---

## Compared to Other Season 1 Events

Other spender events in Season 1 generally provide:

- Poor value per dollar
- Randomized or diluted rewards
- No Crimson Crystals (which are irrelevant anyway pre-Chaos)
- Few ways to directly improve portrait levels, which are your most powerful long-term boosts

The Stardust Wheel, on the other hand, gives you:

- A **straightforward path to portrait power**
- Value that remains useful even into Conquest seasons
- One of the **only events that gets worse over time** (due to Crimson dilution)

So instead of saving your budget for Sparks of Galaxy or Chaos unlocks you can’t even access yet, **invest in the only system that scales with your power and will never go to waste: Stardust.**

---

## Final Recommendation: Go All-In While It’s Clean

If you’re a spender in Season 1—even a modest one—**the Stardust Wheel should be your top priority**.

Why?

- It’s the only event where later versions are *less* efficient.
- It solves your biggest early-game bottleneck.
- It boosts a system (portrait levels) that provides power long-term.

Build smart. Spend smart. If you’re in Season 1, **this is your moment to build power before Crimson clutter hits the event wheel**. Once it’s gone, it’s not coming back until next season cycle.

So get spinning.

markdown:
### Bestow the Blessings: Empowering Immortals in Infinity Kingdom

In the dynamic realm of Infinity Kingdom, blessings have the power to elevate your immortals and turn the tide of battle in your favor. Understanding the blessings that can empower your heroes is essential for crafting a formidable strategy. In this guide, we'll explore the blessings designed to enhance your immortals and the heroes who can best wield their effects to become unstoppable forces on the battlefield.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-45-1024x521.png)

### 1. Oaken Guard, Resist, and Defense Blessing

Oaken Guard, Resist, and Defense Blessing are blessings that shine when bestowed upon support immortals or heroes who don't rely on HP to be effective in battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-46.png)

Immortals like Trajan, Qin, and Dido can benefit greatly from these blessings, even if they are allowed to drop and face defeat quickly. These blessings enhance their survivability and overall resilience on the battlefield.

### 2. Rage Blessing

Rage Blessing is a blessing that thrives when assigned to support immortals or heroes who don't depend on HP for their effectiveness, much like Trajan, Qin, and Dido.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-47.png)

This blessing is especially effective when used in marches featuring immortals who require a significant amount of energy or can burst before the first dragon skill is activated. Heroes like Hippolyta, Wu (sometimes), or Kubilai (with Adrenaline Rush) can make the most of Rage Blessing to ensure their abilities are ready when needed most.

### 3. Energy Suppression

Energy Suppression is a blessing that excels when assigned to support immortals or heroes who can be effective without relying on HP, similar to Richard, Bjorn, Trajan, Dido, and Qin. Its effectiveness varies depending on the battlefield:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-48.png)

- In water (and wind), it ensures healing occurs before the Wound status is triggered, keeping your immortals in top condition.
- In lightning, it delays the opponent's first burst until after your dragon's nuke, reducing the damage your opponent can inflict due to lost troop HP.
- In shadow, it delays the opponent's first burst, often causing it to overlap with your dragon's silence, further delaying or canceling the first ultimate of your opponent.

### 4. War Blessing and Speed Blessing

War Blessing and Speed Blessing are blessings tailored for support immortals like Qin, Cyrus, and others. These blessings shine in marches featuring immortals who deal damage early on, such as Alex and Hannibal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-49.png)

When combined, they create a powerful synergy that not only boosts your immortals' attack capabilities but also enhances their speed, ensuring they reach their full potential quickly.

In conclusion, blessings are a critical component of your strategy in Infinity Kingdom, offering various ways to empower your immortals. Whether you're enhancing survivability with Oaken Guard, Resist, and Defense Blessing, unleashing devastating attacks with Rage Blessing, manipulating energy with Energy Suppression, or boosting both offense and speed with War Blessing and Speed Blessing, these blessings can turn your heroes into unstoppable forces on the battlefield.

So, embrace the power of blessings, refine your tactics, and watch as your immortals become the champions who lead your army to victory in the world of Infinity Kingdom.

title: Betting and maximizing bet-rewards
summary: Throne of the Supreme is a cross-server PvP tournament in Infinity
markdown:
Throne of the Supreme is a **cross-server PvP tournament** in *Infinity Kingdom* that showcases the top players from many servers battling it out in a grand arena. It typically **opens around the same time as a server's first Season 1 of KvK (Conquest Season)** and is one of the most exciting competitive events in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-9-1024x562.png)

### What Is the Betting System in Throne of the Supreme?

During the **Throne of the Supreme (ToS)** cross-server tournament, players can earn massive rewards **without even fighting** by participating in the **Lucky Guess** side event — the betting system. Here, you place bets on the outcomes of PvP battles and win **Lucky Amulets** if your predictions are correct. These are later exchanged for high-value items in the **Supreme Trove**.

---

### How Betting Works

- **Three Betting Slots per Day**: During the **group stages**, there are **three separate times each day** when you can place bets.
- **Multiple Bets per Slot**: In each slot, you can bet on **8 matches**. Later in the tournament (knockouts), this reduces to 4, then 2, then 1 (the finals).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-10-1024x402.png)

- **Odds Multiply**: The more matches you bet on correctly in a single slot, the **higher the total payout** due to **compounding odds**. Even if the individual match odds are low, combining 8 correct predictions can lead to **multipliers of 4x to 10x or more**.

---

### Betting Schedule and Timing

- **Two Combat Rounds per Day**: Battles happen **twice a day** during the group stage, and betting rounds open around those.
- **Odds Start Neutral**: When betting opens, **all players have equal odds** (e.g., 1.00 vs 1.00). The odds adjust based on how many players bet on each side.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-11-1024x471.png)

- **Frequent Odds Refreshes**: Odds refresh multiple times per hour, especially in the first couple of hours after bets open.

---

### How to Maximize Value – Step-by-Step Strategy

Here’s the optimal strategy to make **thousands of Lucky Amulets per day** with minimal risk:

#### 1. Save Up Betting Currency

- Earn basic **Lucky Guess Coins** during the first stage (group battles).
- Don't spend recklessly — **save up** to go hard when odds are favorable. Always have atleast 3x 90 coins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-12-1024x535.png)

#### 2. Use Alts to Manipulate Odds (Allowed!)

- It is **not against the Terms of Service** to use alt accounts to bet.
- Right after betting opens, use alts to **place bets on players you know will lose**.
- This will **skew the odds** and raise the return rate for the actual winners.

#### 3. Place Bets on Your Main After Odds Adjust

- Wait for the **first odds refresh** (usually within 15–30 minutes).
- Now place bets on the likely winners **on your main account**.
- With just one betting slot, you can easily get **4x to 5x returns on safe bets**.

#### 4. Repeat 3x a Day

- Do this in **all three betting windows per day**.
- If you hit 8 safe bets with 5x odds each round, you’re earning around **4,000–5,000 amulets per slot**, or up to **15,000 per day**.

---

### Tips for Winning Bets

- **Scout the Tournament**: Watch battles or use ranking lists to know who the top players are.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-13-1024x329.png)

- **Stick to Favorites**: Bet on reliable players with strong records — the odds manipulation will still make these profitable.
- **Don’t Overthink It**: Stick to the strategy. You’re not gambling, you're farming.

---

### Final Thoughts

The **Lucky Guess system in Throne of the Supreme** isn’t just for fun — it’s one of the **best value farming mechanics** in Infinity Kingdom. With a little planning and some clever odds manipulation, you can walk away with **tens of thousands of Lucky Amulets**, which translate directly into powerful rewards.

Use the system smartly, and **the Supreme Trove is yours to loot**.

### Guide to Birthday Wishes Rewards in Infinity Kingdom

In the enchanting realm of Infinity Kingdom, players are not only treated to epic battles and grand adventures but also to the warm embrace of camaraderie and celebration. One such heartwarming feature is the "Birthday Wishes" rewards, a delightful tradition that has graced the game since its inception. This guide will shed light on how to partake in this charming feature and reap the rewards on your special day.

## Embrace the Infinity Club

To embark on this journey of birthday surprises, you must first become a member of the exclusive "Infinity Club." The club can be found within the game's Customer Service section. Here's how to get started:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-101-1024x563.png)

1. **Access Customer Service**: Launch the game and navigate to the Customer Service section, usually located in the game's settings or options menu.
2. **Join the Infinity Club**: Within Customer Service, look for the option to join the Infinity Club. It may be labeled as "Club Membership" or something similar.
3. **Enter Your Birthday**: When prompted, provide your birthdate to register with the club. Ensure that the date is accurate to receive your rewards on your special day.

## The Birthday Wishes Rewards

As your birthday approaches, anticipation builds as you eagerly await the arrival of your Birthday Wishes rewards. When your big day finally arrives, here's what you can expect:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-102-1024x570.png)

1. Dragon Crystal selection chests 3x
2. Philosopher stones x9
3. Resources

## Make Your Birthday Memorable

To fully enjoy the Birthday Wishes rewards, remember to:

- **Keep Your Birthdate Updated**: Ensure that your birthdate is accurately recorded in the Infinity Club. This guarantees that you receive your rewards on the correct date.
- **Share the Joy**: Don't hesitate to share your special day with your in-game friends and alliance members. The Infinity Kingdom community often comes together to make birthdays even more memorable.
- **Use Your Rewards Wisely**: The gifts you receive can be immensely helpful in your journey. Plan how you will use them strategically to advance your kingdom and Immortals.

## Conclusion

The Birthday Wishes rewards in Infinity Kingdom are a testament to the game's commitment to creating a vibrant and engaging player experience. By becoming a member of the Infinity Club and sharing your birthdate, you open the door to a delightful tradition that adds a touch of warmth and celebration to your gaming adventure.

So, as your birthday approaches, make sure to join the Infinity Club and prepare for a day of surprises and joy in Infinity Kingdom. It's not just a game; it's a community that cares about making your special day truly special. Happy gaming and happy birthday! 🎂🎉

markdown:
### Blade Dodge Skill Guide – Patch 2.8.1 Overview & Strategy

With the release of **Patch 2.8.1** in *Infinity Kingdom*, a new skill called **Blade Dodge** has been introduced, targeting **physical attack Immortals**—particularly **frontline and backline archers**. In this guide, we’ll break down what the skill does, theorycraft potential team setups and skill combinations, highlight ideal Immortals, and finish off by explaining **how to acquire the skill** and whether it's worth your investment.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-41.png)

---

## Blade Dodge Skill Description

> **Blade Dodge (Level 1 to 8)**:

- **First 20 seconds** of battle: Reduces **damage dealt and received** by **21% ➔ 70%**
- **After 20 seconds**: Every time you deal damage with an **ultimate**, you gain **2.1% ➔ 7% physical damage**, stacking up to **10 times** for a total of **70% bonus physical damage**

### First Impressions:

- It acts like a **slow ramp-up skill**, which heavily benefits **long fights** and **tanky team compositions**.
- It’s similar to a **hybrid of Void Realm and Victory Pursuit**, making it a promising skill for backline archers who peak mid-to-late battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-42.png)

---

## Recommended Skill Combos

When building around Blade Dodge, consider matching it with skills that **synergize with delayed power spikes** or **high ultimate usage**.

### 🔹 Suggested Skill Combinations:

### 1. Blade Dodge + Battle Stance + Demonic Contract

- **Battle Stance** activates at the 20s mark, lining up perfectly with Blade Dodge’s post-delay effect.
- **Demonic Contract** scales up after 25–30 seconds, making this a perfect synergy trio.

### 2. Blade Dodge + Void Realm + Victory Pursuit

- Mimics the effects of Blade Dodge, stacking damage via ultimates.
- Great for **sustained fights** and **backline archers** with good uptime.

These combos work best in **defensive or tank-heavy teams**, where Immortals survive long enough to benefit from the delayed damage scaling.

> “You want your backline to live long enough to build up 70% physical damage—so sustainability is key.”

---

## Best Immortals to Use with Blade Dodge

Here are some Immortals that could make strong use of Blade Dodge, depending on your team setup:

### 🔹 Manco Capac

- The #1 candidate for Blade Dodge
- Excellent synergy with other delayed scaling skills like Victory Pursuit and Void Realm

### 🔹 Apollo

- Works great in **backline archer setups**
- Can deal significant damage after 20s when combined with Wukong or other frontline damage dealers

### 🔹 Khan

- Can act as a **secondary damage dealer**
- Ideal for hybrid teams with a strong frontline absorbing damage

### 🔹 Poseidon

- Commonly run with **Battle Stance + Demonic Contract** already
- Blade Dodge fits right into this established combo

These Immortals excel when given **time to ramp**, and Blade Dodge complements that perfectly.

---

## Team Composition Tips

Blade Dodge is best used in:

- **Tanky, defensive teams** that extend fights past the 20-second mark
- **Backline archer-focused comps** where you want scaling damage rather than burst
- **Sustain-based teams** that don't rely on early aggression

Avoid using Blade Dodge in:

- **Fast-paced burst teams** (it won't have time to stack)
- **Mage-based teams** (it only boosts physical damage)

> “If your comp isn’t lasting much more than 20 seconds, this skill won’t help much.”

---

## How to Get Blade Dodge

Currently, Blade Dodge is available in the **Recharge Pack rotation** following the Lightning Strike event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-43-1024x524.png)

### 🔹 Cost:

- Approximately **$140 total** to unlock via Recharge Pack (daily purchases over a week)

### 🔹 Future Availability:

- The skill will likely enter the **Wisdom Well** in the future.
- Expect **much higher cost** there compared to the Recharge Pack route

> “If you're planning to get it, do so during a Recharge event (rotation). Waiting for Wisdom Well could cost significantly more.”

---

## Is Blade Dodge Worth It?

### 👍 Pros:

- High **scaling physical damage** after 20s
- Synergizes well with many **archer-based backliners**
- Strong for **PvP in sustained fights**

### 👎 Cons:

- Weak during first 20 seconds
- Useless for **magical damage teams**
- Requires **long fights** to get full value

If your team is **built around physical damage**, and you're focused on **archers or backline synergy**, Blade Dodge is a worthwhile investment. If you run **magic-based** teams, you may want to pass.

---

## Final Thoughts

Blade Dodge is a powerful and unique skill for **scaling physical damage** in the late phase of a fight. It brings something new to the table and adds variety to backline builds—especially those involving **Manco**, **Apollo**, or **Khan**.

However, it does require **careful planning and synergy** to get the most out of it, and not every team will benefit.

> "If you're building a backline DPS team that peaks after 20s, Blade Dodge might be your new favorite skill."

We hope this guide helps you better understand Blade Dodge and whether it fits into your team. Let us know what combos you discover!

Happy battling!
