### Player Guide: Unleashing the Power of "Blade Vortex" in Infinity Kingdom

"Blade Vortex" stands out as an exceptional Tower of Knowledge skill in Infinity Kingdom, offering unparalleled damage potential. Its introduction marked a significant shift in combat dynamics, further amplified by subsequent buffs that elevated its damage output. Renowned for its high damage per second (DPS), "Blade Vortex" excels in synergy with specific immortals, cementing its place as a top-tier skill for players aiming to maximize their battlefield efficacy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-160-1024x572.png)

## Skill Overview

### Description

"Blade Vortex" is described as follows: "Every 12 seconds after the battle starts, cause physical damage (150%) to 3 random enemy units. Upon a successful hit, the enemy will suffer from the Tear effect, taking physical Damage (150%) every 3 seconds for 12 seconds." This continuous application ensures a 100% uptime on 3 out of 4 enemy units, with a staggering total of 2250% physical damage dealt upon activation, averaging at 187.5% physical damage per second.

### Comparative Damage Output

When compared to other skills like "Spear Impale," which averages around 60% DPS, "Blade Vortex" significantly outpaces its counterparts, offering the highest damage per second in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-161.png)

*All credit for the above information to PO PandaMora who came up with this information in an excel sheet.*

## Strategic Application

### Core Usage

Given its potency, "Blade Vortex" should be a staple in your main march. Its assured debuff application synergizes well with other game mechanics, particularly:

- **Lightning Setups**: It ensures a debuff on the enemy, enhancing the lightning dragon’s bonus skill for increased damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-162-1024x364.png)

- **Combination with Loki**: Especially effective since Loki's skills gain potency against enemies suffering from Tear or Bleed debuffs, with "Blade Vortex" increasing Loki's confuse chance by 25% on debuffed targets.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-163-1024x530.png)

### Ideal Immortals for "Blade Vortex"

This skill is best suited for physical damage dealers, with prime candidates including Khubilai Khan, Poseidon, Peter, and Khan. In non-lightning or holy setups, prioritize immortals with the highest physical damage attributes to maximize the skill's impact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-164-1024x608.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-165-1024x614.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-166-1024x612.png)

## Cautions for Use

Avoid pairing "Blade Vortex" with "Garrote" as both apply the Tear effect, and using one will overwrite the other rather than stacking, diminishing potential effectiveness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-167-1024x411.png)

## Acquiring "Blade Vortex"

Initially exclusive to the Triss event and behind a paywall, the 2.6.7 patch introduced a new pathway for acquisition. Players can now sell skill stones obtained from the Legion of Frostborne for Triss Cinder currency, enabling even free-to-play gamers to secure "Blade Vortex."

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-168.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-169.png)

## Conclusion

"Blade Vortex" is a game-changer for players in Infinity Kingdom, providing an unmatched DPS advantage. Its strategic implementation, especially in combination with specific immortals and setups, can significantly elevate combat performance. By leveraging the new ability stone selling feature, players have a viable route to acquire this formidable skill, enhancing their arsenal for both PvP and PvE battles. Remember to tailor your strategy to the strengths of "Blade Vortex," ensuring its optimal use on the battlefield for maximum impact.

title: How Blood Frenzy Works and Which Immortals Benefit Most
summary: Blood Frenzy is one of the newer Physical skills introduced to Infinity Kingdom, and it has quickly become a popular choice for several high-end physical damage dealers. Unlike many offensive skills that provide an…
markdown:
## Introduction

Blood Frenzy is one of the newer Physical skills introduced to *Infinity Kingdom*, and it has quickly become a popular choice for several high-end physical damage dealers. Unlike many offensive skills that provide an immediate damage increase, Blood Frenzy builds its power over the course of a battle, rewarding immortals capable of repeatedly dealing direct damage with their ultimate skills.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-135-1024x481.png)

Because of its unique stacking mechanic, Blood Frenzy performs very differently depending on the immortal using it and the length of the battle. Understanding how the skill builds its stacks—and which immortals can take advantage of them most effectively—is the key to unlocking its full potential.

---

## Understanding Blood Frenzy

At maximum level, Blood Frenzy grants **20% Physical Damage** each time its effect is triggered, stacking up to three times for a total bonus of **60% Physical Damage**.

Unlike skills that provide their full benefit from the opening seconds of combat, Blood Frenzy has to earn its value. The first few ultimates establish the stacks, while every attack that follows benefits from the increased Physical Damage. As a result, the skill becomes progressively stronger as the battle continues.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-136.png)

This naturally favours encounters where immortals have enough time to cast several ultimates. In shorter fights, the battle may be decided before Blood Frenzy has reached its full potential, whereas longer engagements allow the skill to spend much more time at maximum effectiveness.

---

## Building Around Blood Frenzy

Blood Frenzy performs best alongside skills that strengthen ultimate damage or increase the number of ultimates an immortal can cast during a battle. Rather than competing with existing offensive options, it complements them by adding another layer of scaling that continues to grow as the fight progresses.

**Corrosive Power** is its most natural partner. While Blood Frenzy gradually increases Physical Damage, Corrosive Power directly amplifies ultimate skill damage, allowing every fully stacked ultimate to hit considerably harder. Since most physical carries derive a large portion of their damage from ultimates, the two skills naturally reinforce one another.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-137.png)

**Battle Stance** approaches the same goal from a different angle. Once it activates, the additional Energy Recovery allows immortals to cycle ultimates more quickly, helping Blood Frenzy reach maximum stacks sooner while also increasing the number of empowered ultimates cast during the remainder of the fight. The timing works particularly well, as Battle Stance comes online just as Blood Frenzy begins reaching its highest value.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-138.png)

**Demonic Contract** fills a similar role as another scaling offensive skill, although it follows a much slower curve. In battles that continue well beyond a minute it can eventually surpass Blood Frenzy, but many Arena matches end long before that happens. In most situations, Blood Frenzy reaches meaningful value much earlier, making it the more consistent option.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-139.png)

The immortals that benefit most from Blood Frenzy share a similar characteristic: they rely on repeated direct-damage ultimates rather than a single burst window. The longer they continue casting, the more opportunity they have to establish and benefit from the skill's full damage bonus.

**Tutankhamun** is arguably the skill's best user. His damage profile revolves around repeated ultimate casts, so Blood Frenzy follows almost exactly the same rhythm. Both spend the opening portion of combat building momentum before reaching full effectiveness, which is why many experienced players pair him with Corrosive Power and Battle Stance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-140.png)

**Genghis Khan** is another excellent candidate thanks to his multi-target ultimate. He already excels in prolonged engagements where repeated ultimates steadily wear down the enemy team, making Blood Frenzy a natural addition to his kit. If Blood Frenzy proves to count individual damage instances rather than ultimate activations, Genghis Khan would become even more effective thanks to his ability to hit multiple targets with every cast.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-141.png)

**Manco Cápac** benefits for similar reasons. His damage naturally ramps up over the course of a fight, making Blood Frenzy feel like an extension of his own playstyle rather than a separate mechanic. By the time Manco reaches his strongest phase, Blood Frenzy is often fully stacked as well.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-143.png)

**Darius** also makes good use of the skill. His ultimate strikes every enemy, allowing him to take advantage of the increasing Physical Damage bonus throughout extended battles. Although his slower Energy Recovery limits his overall efficiency compared with the strongest physical carries, Blood Frenzy remains a solid choice for players building around him.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-144.png)

---

## PvP and PvE

Blood Frenzy's value changes depending on how long a battle lasts.

In Arena, where many fights are decided quickly, the skill may not always have enough time to establish all three stacks before combat ends. That doesn't make it a poor choice, but it does place greater importance on using it with immortals capable of casting ultimates consistently throughout the fight.

Longer PvE encounters tell a different story. World bosses and other sustained battles provide ample opportunity for Blood Frenzy to reach maximum stacks, allowing physical carries to spend a significant portion of the fight benefiting from the full 60% Physical Damage bonus. As encounters become longer, Blood Frenzy becomes increasingly attractive compared with skills that provide only a short burst of damage.

---

## Obtaining Blood Frenzy

Unlike many Tower of Knowledge skills, **Blood Frenzy is not currently available through the Cinder Wish Shop or the Kingdom vs Kingdom Shop**. At the time of writing, the only way to obtain the skill is through **Ability Stone Selection Chest VI**.

These chests are awarded as part of the weekly **5-Day Combo** recharge event. Each daily bundle includes **5 Ability Stone Selection Chest VI**, while purchasing five consecutive days unlocks an additional bonus chest containing **25 more Ability Stone Selection Chest VI**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-145-1024x540.png)

Unlocking Blood Frenzy requires **60 Ability Stone Fragments**, which means obtaining the skill from scratch currently requires:

- Purchasing all seven daily bundles during the event.
- Receiving **35 fragments** from the daily rewards (7 × 5).
- Claiming the **25-fragment bonus chest** for completing five consecutive purchases.
- Collecting **60 fragments** in total to unlock the skill.

At the current bundle price of **$19.99 USD per day**, unlocking Blood Frenzy costs approximately **$140 USD** if starting with no fragments.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-146-1024x487.png)

Because the skill is exclusive to Ability Stone Selection Chest VI, players should consider carefully whether Blood Frenzy fits their long-term physical march before committing to the event. Unlike skills available through permanent shops, there is currently no gradual free-to-play path to unlocking it.

---

## Conclusion

Blood Frenzy is best viewed as a long-term investment rather than an immediate damage boost. It rewards immortals capable of casting repeated ultimates, steadily increasing their damage ceiling as the battle progresses and making it particularly effective in sustained PvP fights and longer PvE encounters.

Its greatest strength lies in how naturally it fits alongside established offensive skills rather than replacing them. Combined with Corrosive Power and Battle Stance, it creates a build that scales throughout the battle instead of relying on a single burst window. Although its acquisition cost makes it one of the more exclusive Tower of Knowledge skills, players investing in physical marches will find that it offers excellent long-term value on the right immortal.

---

title: Bon Voyage
summary: Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.

**Castle Skins serve two purposes:**(**1)** they provide **unique buff effects**to specific activities such as e.g. tech speed, dragon speed, combat buffs, recovery speed, resource collection rate, etc. and **(2)** they provide **unique cosmetic effects** that change the way your castle looks inside the game. The cosmetic effects work in all aspects of the game, any game mode, and provides some awesome customization to make youself more unique and your castle look.. well.. more awesome!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-103-1024x518.png)

In this article we shall look to one of my personal favorite cosmetic skins in all of **Infinity Kingdom: Bon Voyage**

## What does Bon Voyage do?

Every castle skin has unique beneficial effects, from building speed to rss gathering and troop HP. The Harvest Song provides you a 3% increase to your honor gain. This is a massive buff that makes it arguable one of the most sought after castle skins in all of Infinity Kingdom. The effect is very simple, you just get more honor from killing the same amount of enemy troops.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-104.png)

For example, killing 100,000 worth of enemy troops will net you an added 3K honor - not a lot you say? Well for thoes who are stacking alts and using the Personal Talent Point skill "Rank Advancement" an added 3% provides a lot of value!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-105.png)

For example, in this image we are getting 278K honor per attack using the rank advancement talent. For this single hit alone, our Bon Voyage castle skin provides us 8K additional honor without loosing any more troops on our alts! That is quite a good chunck of honor and certainly something that stacks up when you are competing for a Kill Event or for Nobility Rankings.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-1-6.png)

If you can do around 1 million honor per day (which is doable if you run alts well) then you earn a daily 30,000 honor for free! Not bad for basically no effort!

All in all, a nice and powerful effect and one I recommend you to go after if you are looking to make a lot of honor consistently. It also have the added bonus of being a pretty cool look for you as you fly around killing people and looks even better when you are ratting ;)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-106.png)

## How to get it?

There is only one way to obtain this skin**: (1) Pirate Festival and (2) Golden Path seasonal shop**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-109.png)

This skin was first released with the very first version of the Priate Festival which occur every **September**in Infinity Kingdom. During this seasonal event, players have been able to complete quests and earn the Bon Voyage Casle Skin. You should beware that these seasonal events tends to change every year, and as such I cannot give any guarantees as to how or if you will be able to collect this skin from the seasonal even when September comes around again.

However, lucky for you guys there is a place where you can be sure to collect this skin - in the Golden Path seasonal shop!

## Golden Path

The Harvest Song Castle Skin can be found in the second and third rotation of the Golden Path shop.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-94.png)

This skin is available in the golden path rotation! **[Check out my article here to read more about the Castle skins offered via Golden Path as well as the full rotation](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/market/golden-path/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-107-1024x219.png)

Published: 23-03-23

https://youtu.be/kMakyJnTza4

Welcome to a boss-killer special! In this guide I will share my findings on how to efficiently kill bosses without having to spend additional time and AP on multiple attacks. Instead, we rely on the fire dragon in combination with the two best single-target damage Immortals in the game.

Using this build I am able to reliably kill level 15 bosses with my third march (level 40 Immortals at boost level 20). This means no spending valuable gold and EXP on Immortals for PvE activities when you want to max out your PvP marches.

## The Dragon

You want to run Ignatius the fire dragon in your march. He deals a ton of damage with his breath.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-13.png)

In addition to the raw damage of his breath, Ignatius' second ability is PERFECT for a boss-killing army. By providing a crit damage buff (an insanely strong one at that) with a high proc chance, he is a must have if you want to be the very best at killing bosses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-12.png)

## Immortals

We need to run 3 fire Immortals to get that juicy damage buff

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-15.png)

Luckily, fire also have some of the very best Immortals at dealing raw damage. You want to run:

1. **Hippo**. She is tied with Yoshiu for best single-target Immortal in the game (with unique artifact she is insane, without she is tied with Yoshi for best damage dealer).
2. **William**. He deals decent damage, but more importantly he buffs your Immortals with crit buff that is very strong. He will be our support while maintaining a default decent damage output.
3. **Empress Wu**. She deals very nice magic damage and gives us the ability to utilize the strong magic damage passives available. Her own raw damage is quite strong also in single target, and as fire she finished the 4x elemental buff for us.
4. **Yoshitsune**. He is tied with Hippo for best single-target DPS in the game. Give him the right passives, and he will blast any single target out of the waters.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-16-1024x543.png)

## Passive Loadout

We need to boost our damage as much as possible. This means, shelter, fighting will, life link, assist and all the other meta-passives for PvP are utterly **useless**.

**Maxmium output** passives are as follow:

- **Hippo**: DB + Burst + Anger

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-18.png)

- **William**: Weakness + Rage Blessing + War Blessing

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-19.png)

- **Empress Wu:** Annihilation + Concentration + Root

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-20.png)

- **Yoshitsune:**Adrenaline Rush + Duel Master + Combo

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-21.png)

## Testing with level 40 Immortals

The damage output is very solid! In fact, you do not need to max out or even prioritize leveling and boosting your Immortals to make a very efficient Boss-hunting team when you are flying the fire-dragon. I personally rely on my third team to kill level 15 bosses reliably.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-22.png)

These are some standard results from killing 15 gnome bosses "Giant Breakers" with tripple buff.

This guide is part of my article series on lightning builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the earth build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

This article is pretty simple and streight forward yet something I think everyone who has ever been using lightning has had a hard time with - when we are maining lightning, **how the hell do we kill a boss?**

The answer is the right passive loadout and removing Richard from the march and replacing him with our beloved Hippolyta. She is free to play via CoR shop and is the second best single-target DPS after Yoshi (water). Since our lightning march lacks a frontline dps, we need to use Hippo in here and not Yoshi.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-30-1024x568.png)

## Setup

This setup will ONLY work versus bosses. It is not good for PvP or gnome farming. We are simply trying to kill a single target quickly with the limited tools of lightning and an addition of single-target specialist, Hippolyta.

### You want to run this passive loadout:

**Hippolyta**: Anger + Burst + Death Breath

**Peter**: Combo + Adrenaline Rush + Duel Master

**Hammurabi**: Annihilation + Root + Concentration

**Genghis Khan**: War Blessing + Weakness + Rage Blessing

title: Bountiful Resource Nodes in Legion of Frostborne
summary: Bountiful Resource Nodes are one of the most overlooked mechanics inside the Legion of Frostborne map. They are exclusive to the the Legion of Frostborne battlefield and do not exist in Norheim.
markdown:
Bountiful Resource Nodes are one of the most overlooked mechanics inside the Legion of Frostborne map. They are exclusive to the the Legion of Frostborne battlefield and do not exist in Norheim.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-27.png)

In practical terms, they are oversized, high-speed resource nodes that allow players to collect significantly more resources at a much faster rate than normal tiles. During PvP-heavy Legion of Frostborne seasons - when troop losses are constant and food consumption is relentless - these nodes go a long way to maintain resources during heavy troop training.

Let's have a closer look at these nodes!

---

## How Bountiful Nodes Work

Bountiful nodes differ from normal nodes in two key ways:

1. **Massively increased total resources**
2. **Significantly higher base gathering speed**

All four resource types (Food, Wood, Stone, Iron) can appear as Bountiful nodes—but only **one type is active per day**. The resource rotates daily.

Because of this rotation, efficient players track the cycle and adjust gathering priorities accordingly. For most players, you are going to be pressed for food to train troops during the season of combat - so make sure to take advantage of the food-days!

---

## Bountiful Node Stats (Level 9–11)

Below is a direct comparison of Bountiful nodes by level.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-25.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-26.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-27.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-28.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-29.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-30.png)

### Level 9 – Bountiful

- **Total Resources:** 18,000,000
- **Default Gathering Speed:** 2.3M/hour
- **City Ownership Bonus:** +750k/hour

### Level 10 – Bountiful

- **Total Resources:** 24,000,000
- **Default Gathering Speed:** 2.8M/hour
- **City Ownership Bonus:** +900k/hour

### Level 11 – Bountiful

- **Total Resources:** 30,000,000
- **Default Gathering Speed:** 3.3M/hour
- **City Ownership Bonus:** +1.1M/hour

## Normal Nodes (For Comparison)

To understand how strong Bountiful nodes are, compare them to standard nodes:

### Level 9 – Normal

- **Total:** 9,000,000
- **Speed:** 890k/hour
- **City Bonus:** +500k/hour

### Level 10 – Normal

- **Total:** 12,000,000
- **Speed:** 1M/hour
- **City Bonus:** +600k/hour

### Level 11 – Normal

- **Total:** 15,000,000
- **Speed:** 1.2M/hour
- **City Bonus:** +700k/hour

---

## The Thermal Tower Bonus

When a node is inside **Thermal Tower range (not in snow)**, gathering speed increases by **25%** for both normal and Bountiful nodes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-31.png)

This multiplier applies to the base gathering rate and stacks with the city ownership bonus as listed above.

For example:

- A Level 11 Bountiful node at 3.3M/hour
- With Thermal Tower bonus → ~4.125M/hour
- With city ownership bonus (+1.1M/hour) → ~5.225M/hour

At that rate, even a 30M node empties extremely quickly.

Positioning matters. Securing large areas of Thermal coverage to increase your chances of high-level Bountiful nodes in your owned zones is a huge resource engine.

---

## Why Food-Day Matters Most

For most active PvP players, **Food-day is the most important rotation**.

Food is consumed in three primary ways during Legion of Frostborne:

1. **Troop training**
2. **Hospital recovery**
3. **Ongoing troop upkeep**

During heavy fighting weeks, Food becomes the bottleneck resource far more often than Wood, Stone, or Iron. I have consistently found that during high-intensity wars, Wood and Stone remain stable while Food drops to zero repeatedly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-32.png)

When I ran extended front-line pushes in a PvP-dense Frostborne season, securing Bountiful Food nodes allowed me to maintain continuous troop training without dipping into speedups or resource items. Without them, I would have stalled within two days.

For competitive players, Food-day is effectively a scheduled recovery window.

---

## Rotation Strategy: PvP vs Relaxed Seasons

### During PvP-Heavy Seasons

- Prioritize the daily Bountiful resource, especially focus on Food-day.
- But do not go out of your way for the other resource nodes, since maintaining strategic positioning is key - you can't farm all days!
- Gather under Thermal Tower coverage if possible even from long range in your secured zones with none-combat ready armies (low STP).

### During Relaxed or Low-Conflict Seasons

- If PvP pressure is low, rotate gathering evenly across all resource days.
- Spend your thermals to cover zones you own the city off to increase the thermal coverage for optimal farming.

In calmer Frostborne seasons, your bottleneck shifts toward overall development—research, buildings, and general progression. In these cases, maximizing total gathering throughput across all rotations provides better long-term growth than over-focusing on Food alone.

---

## Conclusion Summary

Bountiful Resource Nodes are one of the most powerful economic mechanics inside Legion of Frostborne:

- They contain **double the total resources** of normal nodes.
- They offer **dramatically faster base gathering speeds**.
- They benefit from both **Thermal Tower (25%) and city ownership bonuses**.
- Only **one resource type appears per day**, rotating regularly.
- **Food-day is usually the highest priority** during heavy PvP seasons.

Players who track rotations and position intelligently will sustain troop production longer, recover faster, and apply more battlefield pressure over time.

---

title: Builds: Farming lvl 43's minimal losses
summary: Infernal Assault is an incredibly important event for every player in Infinity Kingdom – why? Simple, it is the single best method of obtaining vast piles of gold. Gold is arguably the most precious resource in the game…
markdown:
### Guide to Infernal Assault in Infinity Kingdom

Infernal Assault is an incredibly important event for every player in Infinity Kingdom – why? Simple, it is the single best method of obtaining vast piles of gold. Gold is arguably the most precious resource in the game (perhaps only surpassed by pure gems and VIP points). Gold is required in massive amounts to upgrade your Immortals and Dragons and is something that every player struggles to ever get enough of. Therefore, you need to take advantage of every Infernal Assault event and earn as much gold as you can.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-19-1024x569.png)

There are two important limitations to understand when dealing with Infernal Camps. Firstly, you are limited in the number of troops you can/want to spend on farming these camps. Secondly, you are limited by your Action Points (AP) in terms of how many camps you can kill without draining your AP-bank.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-21-1024x626.png)

The higher the level of the enemy camps, the harder the fight is but the more gold you are rewarded from clearing. This is why you need to find a sweet-spot, i.e. the highest level camp you can clear without taking massive losses. This way you retain troops and AP and get as much gold as possible during the event.

For me, my sweet-spot has previously been level 28, then 33-34 and now with my new builds that I would like to share with you all I am comfortably clearing level 43 Infernal Camps and Infernal Core with minimal losses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-22-1024x563.png)

## My Builds

So let’s get on with it and have a look at the builds. There are two builds here, you can either choose to make two different formations and swap between them or make them as your first and second team. If you are having problems clearing cores with this build as a second team (maybe due to lower technology, boost levels or Immortal levels) you should go for two formations and make small modifications to the core-build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-25-1024x598.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-24-1024x581.png)

The first build you want is for clearing the camps. These function as normal gnome camps which you need to clear as quickly as possible with low losses. This means area of effect damage (AOE) since we have four gnome enemies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-30-1024x504.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-33-1024x568.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-32-1024x531.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-34-1024x565.png)

For the second build, we are building a boss-killing build, because the Core will always be a Gnome Boss. Use your normal boss-killing build in a different formation if you can’t run both of my builds here comfortably, you can also checkout more boss-killing builds on ik-wiki under Boss Killing Builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-35-1024x567.png)

## Camp-clearing build

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-26-1024x434.png)

**(1) Build for killing camps Himiko + Zeno + Alexander + Charles. Note, that because this is my main march for PvP this is what works best for me. You can use your Immortals from your main setup with small modifications to obtain similar results.**

- *Himiko:* Berserk for attack speed. This is needed to get high damage quickly from Alexander and to get Charles to quickly reach max energy and use his shields (because he has Adrenaline Rush, increased attack speed helps here). Annihilation and Concentration are also used on Himiko, because they are the highest damage output in AOE for a magic user.
- *Zenobia:* Oaken Guard to reduce the damage taken from enemy normal attacks, Purify for the healing effects (although this is low number value, it is fast and works well given the relatively low damage hits of gnomes). Lastly, we have Misleading here, because we want the gnomes to miss as many attacks as possible to protect our troops and minimize losses.
- *Alexander:* Berserker (or anger/wind-rage if you do not have Berserker) for the added damage and attack speed. Combined with Cleave and Death Breath, your Alexander will make quick work of the gnome enemies dealing high and fast AOE damage.
- *Charles:* Weakness to tab into as many critical hits as we can, increasing the chance to crit makes a big difference when you Immortals deal this much damage to the enemy you basically wipe the camp with one good crit on Himiko. Blessing of Defense is used to reduce the damage taken, it is brilliant for this kind of encounter because you are going to have the buff active for almost the entire fight (if not the entire fight) given how quickly you will each gnome army in the camp. Finally, Adrenaline Rush is used on Charles to get his shield effects active as quickly as possible. Getting his shield up almost prevents all damage taken from that point onwards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-39-1024x592.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-40-1024x579.png)

## Core killing build

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-27-1024x418.png)

**(2) Build for killing core – boss Fire builds are always amazing for killing bosses, both because of the fire dragon and because of Hippo and Empress Wu. They are amazing single-target damage dealers and vital in this setup. I use Empress Wu + Yoshi + Hippolytta + Khubilaikhan for my boss core killing build.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-44-1024x606.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-45-1024x572.png)

- *Empress Wu:* Poison Thorn for high single-target damage. I would like to use concentration too, but we use that in the gnome camp build and I am building a second team here instead of a new formation. So instead, we use Blessing of War to provide us the damage we need to quickly kill a boss. Lastly, Root is an amazing skill for bosses both because it deals good single-target damage and because it roots the boss making it unable to attack your Immortals during the control effect.
- *Yoshitsune:* Anger (or onslaught), Snipe and Duel Master for maximum physical damage to a single target. If you do two formations you can use Adrenaline Rush here for very good effect.
- *Hippolytta:* Wind Rage with Combo and Energy Burst. This makes her deal surprisingly high normal attack and combo damage while also giving a good chance to proc critical hits and hence regen energy with Energy Burst. If you run her in a second formation you can do hyper regen builds and you can opt to include weakness in your boss killer formation – perhaps on Khubilai.
- *Khubilai:* In this build as a second march, we use Life-Link and Absolute defense. This is a nice combination for bosses to minimize the damage you take. While you are not going to see massive damage from this on these bosses akin to what we see on Spider bosses, you will take a lot fewer losses which is very important since Khubilai will be tanking all normal hits – and Hippolytta’s ultimate ability makes the boss unable to do anything but normal attacks! Neat right? Lastly, I run Blessing of Rage here, because all of our Immortals in this build scale incredibly well with increased energy regen and hence we get a big increase to our damage.

With these builds, I am able to kill Infernal Assault camps and cores at level 43 with very low losses with an avg. troop loss of around 300-350 per fight. Very manageable and hugely rewarding! I hope you enjoyed this guide; good luck farming your billions!

title: Bundle from june 2025 - Parthenon Temple castle skin and Goddess Might teleportation skin
summary: The latest Gift of Bonding event has gone live, offering a new rotation of rewards and cosmetics for players willing to spend. As with previous iterations, the event is structured around three escalating purchase tiers…
markdown:
### Gift of Bonding Event Guide: Parthenon Temple Edition

## Overview

The latest **Gift of Bonding** event has gone live, offering a new rotation of rewards and cosmetics for players willing to spend. As with previous iterations, the event is structured around three escalating purchase tiers: $5, $50, and $100. This edition's featured cosmetic is the **Parthenon Temple** castle skin, along with a new frame and teleport effect.

Let’s dive into what you get at each tier, and evaluate whether these bundles are worth the price.

---

## Tier 1 - $5 Bundle

- **Cosmetic Frame**: Qin-themed castle frame
- **Artifact Fragments**: A small number
- **Philosopher Stones**: Minimal amount
- **VIP Points**: Modest bonus

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-30-1024x524.png)

**Verdict**: This is a decent micro-purchase if you like collecting cosmetic frames or want to slightly top up your stones or VIP progression. Nothing game-changing.

---

## Tier 2 - $50 Bundle

- **Teleport Effect**: *Goddess Might* visual effect
- **Buff**: +3% resource production (all types)
- **Additional Resources**: More artifact fragments and philosopher stones

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-29-1024x473.png)

**Analysis**:
The **Goddess Might** teleport effect looks fine but isn't particularly unique or jaw-dropping. The **buff itself is very weak** – a 3% production speed increase has negligible impact, especially for high-level players or whales who are already resource-capped most of the time. In practice, this is one of the weakest buffs attached to any teleport effect so far.

**Verdict**: **Poor value** unless you're a collector. This tier is easily skippable.

---

## Tier 3 - $100 Bundle

- **Castle Skin**: *Parthenon Temple*
- **Buffs**:  - +5% Healing Speed
- +5% Resource Production

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-31-1024x473.png)

**Visual**: The Parthenon Temple is a handsome castle skin, with a classical Greek aesthetic. If you're collecting skins for their art style, this one might be appealing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-32-1024x472.png)

**Gameplay Buffs Analysis**:

- **Healing Speed**: Helpful in mid-war and recovery phases, but very niche. Does not help you win fights.
- **Resource Production**: Same underwhelming utility as discussed above.

This makes the Parthenon Temple one of the **least impactful castle skins in terms of PvP performance**.

**Verdict**: **Only worth it if you love the aesthetic**. At $155 total for the full bundle route, this offers very poor combat utility.

---

## Castle Skin Comparison

To better understand the Parthenon Temple's place in the castle skin meta, here are a few comparisons:

### 1. Mont Saint Michel

- **Buffs**: +5% Resource Production + Troop Training Speed
- **Availability**: Past Recharge Event reward
- **Value**: Much better than Parthenon thanks to the training speed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-33-1024x465.png)

### 2. Frozen Dragon Hive

- **Buffs**: +5% Healing Speed + +5% Resource Production
- **Availability**: Golden Path ($20 premium pass)
- **Value**: **Identical buffs** to Parthenon Temple, but significantly cheaper or even obtainable via free progression.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-34-1024x457.png)

---

## Final Thoughts

This version of **Gift of Bonding is one of the weakest** we've seen from a gameplay standpoint. The **cosmetics are decent**, but the **buffs are underwhelming**, especially compared to previously released or more affordable options.

Unless you're a cosmetic collector or completionist, you are better off saving your money for:

- Golden Path skins
- High-impact teleport effects
- Skins with troop stat bonuses (HP, training speed, etc.)

As always, spend wisely and within your budget. We'll continue to cover each Gift of Bonding release, so check back regularly to see whether future ones are worth it!

title: Bundle from may 2025 - Paradeisos castle skin and Singular Realm teleportation skin

markdown:
### Gift of Bondings May 2025: Bundle Review and Recommendations

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-97-1024x652.png)

Infinity Kingdom's monthly "Gift of Bondings" bundle series continues in May 2025 with a fresh cosmetic theme and functional castle skin rewards. While past bundles have seen mixed reception, the current edition raises a few eyebrows due to the nature of its rewards and their practical value. Let’s take a closer look at this month’s offering and evaluate whether it’s worth your investment.

## Bundle Structure and Contents

The Gift of Bondings event is always structured in three stages:

### 1. First Tier Bundle (~$5 USD)

- **Peter Avatar Frame**
- **1x Dragon Essence**
- **Artifact Fragments**
- **VIP Points**

This initial tier is generally cosmetic-heavy and offers minimal functional value. The Peter frame is a neat addition for collectors, and the dragon essence is mildly useful if you are still progressing through your Dragon Talent Trees. However, this tier primarily serves as the entry point to unlock the more substantial second bundle.

### 2. Second Tier Bundle ($50USD)

- **Singular Realm Teleport Effect**
- **3% Gathering Speed**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-96.png)

This tier is where the bundle series takes a dip. The **Singular Realm teleport effect** is purely cosmetic for the most part, and the functional buff of **3% Gathering Speed** is extremely underwhelming. Given that gathering is largely done with downtime anyway, this bonus won’t significantly impact your gameplay. Moreover, the abundance of high resource collection buffs makes this a drop in a bucket. Most players are not keeping 100% uptime on their gatheres, I would actually venture to go as far as to say no player does. Hence you will have downtime regardless and if you truely do care about efficient resource collection, you are using better buffs from item buffs and talent trees making this not matter anyway.

### 3. Third Tier Bundle ($100 USD)

- **Paradeisos Castle Skin**
- **5% Prosperity Recovery Speed**
- **5% Building Speed**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-95.png)

This tier is the highlight of this month’s Gift of Bondings. The **Paradeisos** skin is visually pleasing, but more importantly, offers solid functional buffs. The **5% Building Speed** is particularly useful for players racing to upgrade their castles to levels 50 or 55 depending on the season. However, the **5% Prosperity Recovery Speed** is the standout buff here, especially for players active in **Squad Tournament** formats in the Conquest season where Prosperity regeneration is a real factor.

## Overall Evaluation

This month’s Gift of Bondings bundle is one of the weaker ones we’ve seen:

- **Pros:** The **Paradeisos skin** offers decent buffs and might be worth it for players chasing server-first progression or actively participating in IB formats.
- **Cons:** The **third-tier reward is largely cosmetic**, and the gathering speed buff is not impactful enough to justify the high price.

If you're selective about your spending, **this is one bundle you can likely skip** unless you're specifically looking to complete your castle skin collection or want that slight edge in building and recovery speed.

## Final Recommendation

- **Buy the first tier only if you're a collector** or need the dragon essence.

This month’s Gift of Bondings is a pass for most players. Save your resources for higher-value bundles or strategic upgrades elsewhere.

title: Bundle from september 2025 - Thunderstorm and Bon Voyage
summary: Alright, so a lot of you have been sending me DMs about the new Gift of Bondings Bundles: “What’s behind the Gifts of Bonding this time? What’s the TP skin? What’s the castle skin?”. So let us take a detailed look at…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-102-1024x530.png)

Alright, so a lot of you have been sending me DMs about the new Gift of Bondings Bundles: ***“What’s behind the Gifts of Bonding this time? What’s the TP skin? What’s the castle skin?”***. So let us take a detailed look at the full breakdown for September’s three-bundle chain.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-108.png)

---

## Bundle 1 – $5

- **Cosmetic:** Hippolyta Profile Picture Frame
- **Other stuff:** Minor resources, speedups, and the new addition: a tiny **unique artifact element selection chest**.

Now, don’t get baited by the artifact chest. It’s nice in theory, but the amount is way too small to be efficient (compared to e.g. Sparks). You don’t buy this for efficiency. You buy it either because:

1. You like Hippolyta and want her frame.
2. You’re unlocking bundle 2 because you’re chasing the skins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-103.png)

---

## Bundle 2 – $50

- **Teleportation Skin:** **“Thunderstorm”** (Lightning Dragon TP effect)
- **Buff:** +3% SP Recovery Speed

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-105-1024x599.png)

Here’s where most of the questions were aimed. The Thunderstorm TP skin looks flashy and it pairs amazingly with Wrath of Thunder if you are looking to build a full lightning-themed account (perhaps even with a lightning main march). Stat-wise? Meh. The effect is certainly not the worst one (resource collection rate) but it isnt hugely impactful either.

Let’s do the math:

- Default regen = 288 SP/day.
- With Thunderstorm = +8.64 SP/day.

That’s literally a couple more marches per week. Not exactly meta-breaking.

If we’re comparing:

- Death rate reduction TP effects = Best effect.
- Resource rate = Worst effect.
- Honor rate = Situational
- Thunderstorm = sits comfortably in the “not terrible, but not worth it for stats” tier.

In essence, what is important to realize here is that you buy this one if you like the *look*. Like, I am personally holding out for the Fire Dragon TP skin, because that one just *fits* my fire march thematically. You should think about these as 'pay for the cosmetics not the effect value'.

---

## Bundle 3 – $100

- **Castle Skin:** **“Bon Voyage”** (Pirate Festival throwback)
- **Buff:** +3% Honor Gain

This is where my nostalgia kicks in. A couple years ago, when Bon Voyage first dropped during the Pirate Festival, it was *the* skin to get, because back then, there weren’t combat skins giving HP boosts or better combat buffs. Having +3% honor was actually useful when climbing the competitive ladders.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-106-1024x473.png)

I remember it clearly — people who had this skin stood out. It was the king of skins for a good while. Now though? The game has shifted and a lot of skins with actual power effects that impact combat are live and easily obtainable. For comparison the best combat skins are unlocked for 50$ in the seasonal events nowadays whereas this Bon Voyage from Bondings will cost you 155$ and has no combat effects and only 3% honor gain.

- **City of Glory** → +2% HP and +5% honor.
- **Corridor of Ghostflame** → upgradeable to +3% HP and +15% honor.

So yeah… Bon Voyage is outdated in terms of usefulness. But style-wise? Still badass. You slap that Pirate skin on while running rat-pack style raids and you just *look* good.

---

## My Take

So, is it worth the $155 total for all three bundles? If you’re efficiency-minded, absolutely not. You’re way better off buying Sparks or artifact packs.

But if you’re a **collector** or you just love flexing old-school cosmetics, then this lineup is actually a fun one:

- Bundle 1: Unlocks the chain, small perk if you like Hippolyta.
- Bundle 2: Flashy TP effect, tiny buff. *Players looking to complete a lightning-themed castle, now is your time for a cosmetic upgrade!*
- Bundle 3: A straight-up throwback to when Pirate skin ruled the scene. Cool old school look, but not a good skin anymore.

---

title: Bundles from March 2026 - Cleopatra and Land of Goddesses
summary: The March 2026 Gift of Bondings follows the recent structural shift in how these bundles are delivered. The familiar three-tier format has been reduced to just two bundles, with the teleportation effect tier removed…
markdown:
## Introduction

### Gift of Bondings – March 2026 Edition

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-124-1024x526.png)

The March 2026 **Gift of Bondings** follows the recent structural shift in how these bundles are delivered. The familiar three-tier format has been reduced to just **two bundles**, with the teleportation effect tier removed entirely.

That missing piece has not disappeared—it has simply been relocated. Teleport effects are now sold directly through the GTarcade store in permanent bundles, meaning Bondings is no longer the gatekeeper for TP skins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-96.png)

As a result, this month’s Bondings feels more focused, but also more clearly positioned as a **cosmetic-first offering with limited gameplay value**.

---

## Bundle Structure Overview (New Format)

This rotation includes:

- **$5 Bundle → Profile Frame Tier**
- **$99 Bundle → Castle Skin Tier**

Notably absent:

- The traditional **$50 Teleport Effect bundle**

### What Changed

- Teleport skins are no longer part of Bondings
- They are now **permanently available in GTarcade shop bundles**
- Bondings has effectively become a **2-step cosmetic progression path**

This removes the mid-tier purchase decision and shifts the event toward either:

- Light cosmetic pickup ($5), or
- Full commitment ($99)

---

## $5 Bundle – Cleopatra Profile Frame

This bundle follows the usual pattern: a low-cost entry point centered around a themed cosmetic.

The Cleopatra frame is the primary draw. The additional items—artifact fragments, essence, and resources—are present but minimal in scale.

- You are already collecting themed visuals

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-126.png)

## $99 Bundle – Land of Goddesses Castle Skin

### Contents

- VIP Points
- Resources

### Overview

This bundle replaces what would traditionally be the “top-tier” Bondings purchase, now standing alone as the premium option.

## Castle Skin & Buff Breakdown

### Land of Goddesses – Practical Value

- **−3% Death Rate**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-128-1024x558.png)

#### In Practice

- Reduces troop losses over time
- Lowers training/healing pressure across multiple fights

However:

- It does not change outcomes in individual fights
- It only becomes noticeable across **many engagements**

---

## Value Assessment – Materials vs Cost

Across both bundles, the included materials are:

- **Artifact Selection Chests (standard elements)**
- **Dragon Essence**
- **VIP Points and resources**

While these are always useful, the quantities here do not make the bundles efficient from a progression standpoint.

### Key Considerations

- Artifact fragments are helpful but not rare enough to justify the price
- Dragon Essence can be valuable, but quantities are still limited
- No exclusive or high-impact progression items are included

### Player Perspective

If you’re evaluating purely on efficiency: **These bundles are not cost-effective.**

You can obtain similar progression value through other purchases or events more efficiently. What you are really paying for here is the **cosmetic layer**, with materials acting as secondary bonuses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-126.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-128-1024x558.png)

---

## Conclusion Summary

The March 2026 Gift of Bondings is defined more by what it removes than what it adds.

- The **$50 teleport bundle is gone**, with TP effects moved to the GTarcade store
- The event is now a **2-tier structure** focused on profile and castle cosmetics

### Bundle value:

- $5 bundle: low-cost cosmetic pickup, minimal progression value
- $99 bundle: visually strong castle skin, minor long-term utility via −3% death rate

This month’s Bondings is not about efficiency or power progression.
It is a **cosmetic-driven event**, aimed at collectors or players who value visual identity.

Competitive players can skip both bundles without falling behind.
Collectors—or players who appreciate the Land of Goddesses design—will find the value in how their account looks, not how it performs.

### 🎃 Gift of Bondings — October 2025 Edition: “Blazing Fire & Night Phantoms”

Every time Gift of Bondings pops up, the same question floods Discord, alliance chats, and the forums: *“What’s in this bonding?”*
And honestly, it’s a fair question — because you can’t even see which cosmetics are available until you’ve bought the first bundle. It’s always that little mystery that makes players hesitate: is it worth diving in, or should you skip this one?

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-129-1024x470.png)

So, let’s take a look at what’s hiding inside this round of **Gift of Bondings**, which just went live today — and see if it’s time to grab a new look for your marches or castle.

---

## 🔥 The Theme This Time

This bonding is clearly themed around **Halloween and Fire aesthetics** — a mix between spooky and blazing visuals. You’ll see that right away with the **Shriek Ghost Fiesta** frame and **Night Phantoms Castle Skin**, both originally from older Halloween events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-130.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-132-1024x434.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-133-1024x479.png)

And tying it together? The new **Blazing Fire Teleport Effect**, a flashy fire dragon-style teleport animation that really suits any Fire main who likes to go full thematic.

---

## 💎 Bundle Breakdown

### Bundle 1 — $4.99

- **Shriek Ghost Fiesta Profile Picture Frame**
A returning Halloween frame — perfect timing for October and still one of the more eye-catching seasonal looks.
- **520 Gems**
- **4x Elemental Selection Unique Artifact Fragments**
- **2x Philosopher Stones**
- **500 VIP Points**
- **Some basic resources**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-129-1024x470.png)

This first one’s mostly the gateway purchase — you’ll need it if you want to unlock Bundles 2 and 3 to even *see* what cosmetics are in this rotation. But the Halloween frame itself is actually solid if you like themed visuals for this season.

### Bundle 2 — $49.99

This is the main draw here. The effect looks great — very dramatic, fiery dragon wings as you teleport — and the small 3% honor buff is just a bonus. But let’s be honest: you’re not buying this for efficiency. This is about finishing that perfect Fire march look.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-139.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-140-1024x434.png)

- **Resources**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-136-1024x646.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-134-1024x636.png)

If you’re a Fire main like me, this one’s tempting. But the price tag stings. You’re paying $55 total (including the first bundle) for a teleport effect and some decent but not game-breaking materials.

### Bundle 3 — $99.99

- **Night Phantoms Castle Skin**: Giving you 3% technology upgrade speed, used to be an amazing skin to boost technology, but with the new generation of castle skins offering 5% (Realm of Blaze) obtainable in the Golden Path, this isnt something impressive and on its own is not worth the 155$, if you buy, it is for the looks!

This one’s for collectors or anyone who wants to complete the full Halloween theme. Expensive, yes, but as usual with Bondings, you’re really paying for exclusivity and looks here.

This Gift of Bondings is **aesthetic-first, value-second**.

summary: Death Breath (DB) is a Triggered Tower of Knowledge skill that automatically activates every 6 seconds, dealing significant magical and physical damage based on your Immortal’s stats. At max level, it inflicts 75% of…
markdown:
## ⚔️ Infinity Kingdom Guide: The Power of Death Breath + Chase Combo

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-93-1024x591.png)

---

## 1. What is Death Breath ?

**Death Breath (DB)** is a **Triggered** Tower of Knowledge skill that automatically activates every **6 seconds**, dealing significant magical and physical damage based on your Immortal’s stats. At max level, it inflicts **75% of both Physical and Magical Damage** as a one-time burst.

### Why it's strong:

- **Consistent damage instances**every 6 seconds throughout a battle. **Causing 8 damage instances per 6 seconds** (on avg. 5-6 instances since enemies die and cycles dont line perfectly with battle durations).
- **Hybrid scaling**—effective for both physical and magical Immortals.
- Ideal for **backline burst**, especially when paired with other multipliers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-94.png)

---

## 2. What is Chase ?

**Chase** is an **Elite Triggered skill** that activates on **critical hits** with a **~30% chance**. When triggered, it often deals a burst of damage or applies a damaging effect—multiplying your critical bursts.

### Why it's powerful:

- Stacks with crit-heavy builds.
- Every extra damage instance from Death Breath is another chance to **proc Chase**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-95.png)

---

## 3. How the Combo Works

Here’s why this setup is *explosively effective*:

### 🔁 Multiple Damage Instances

- In a 12-second window, **Death Breath will fire twice** giving you 16 damage instances if all enemies are alive and able to be hit.
- That means **16 independent damage instances**, each with 30% chance of triggering **Chase** on a crit.

### 🎯 Crit + Crit = Damage Explosion

- If you have high Crit Rate and Crit Damage, each DB hit is likely to crit.
- With Chase triggering on crits, each DB can lead to **a double burst**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-96-1024x602.png)

---

## 4. Optimal Build Setup

To maximize burst with DB + Chase:

- **Crit Rate Focus**
Prioritize Crit% and Crit Damage% in Talents, Artifacts, Gems, and Dragon nodes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-97.png)

- **Timing Synchronization**
Build your build around the **6-second DB cooldown**—aim for maximum output during that window using e.g. Blessing of War.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-98.png)

---

## 5. Real-World Use Cases

Players on Reddit and forums have confirmed that pairing **Death Breath with Chase** transforms Immortals into near-unstoppable burst DPS machines.

This setup excels in:

- **Arena / PvP**: Out-burst rival immortals quickly.
- **Shard / Boss Battles**: Stack rapid cooldown bursts to shave off health spikes.
- **Hybrid March**: Fits in both physical and magical teams due to DB's dual scaling.

---

## 6. How to Build It

1. **Unlock both skills** in the Tower of Knowledge (DB at level 39, Chase at level 25).
2. **Gear and Sculpt for Crit**:  - Artifacts with Crit Chance/Damage.
- Talents favoring Crit buildouts.
3. Use **Weakness Aura** togeather with this combo to boost your crit rate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-100-1024x396.png)

Both Chase and Death Breath are free to play skills, making this combo a very good one for anyone able to stack enough crit!

TIP: As you progress, you can use skills like Nova's on lower levels while you progress to level 40 for Death Breath.

---

## 7. Limitations & Counters

- **Skill RNG**: If DB doesn’t crit, fewer Chase procs.
- **Resilience Counters**: High enemy resilience can block crits. This is for instance **hardcountered**by high resiliance enemies using **Malice**.
- **Battle Length Sensitive**: Best for quick, high-damage windows (12–24s).

---

## 🧠 Final Verdict

Death Breath + Chase is a **devastating burst combo**, leveraging:

- **Time-based burst frequency** (every 6s)
- **Multiple damage instance triggers**
- **High probability of compounding burst damage**

It’s a **top-tier build choice** for players aiming to maximize their Immortals’ burst potential, and well worth including in any competitive PvP or PvE setup. Stack Crit, sync bursts, and watch your enemies crumble.

title: Candy Boss Madness! 2026 Original Festival Edition
summary: The Candy Defenders system looks simple on the surface: throw candy at a boss, get rewards. But once you break it down properly, it becomes clear that this is one of the most efficient progression systems we’ve had in a…
markdown:
## Introduction

The Candy Defenders system looks simple on the surface: throw candy at a boss, get rewards. But once you break it down properly, it becomes clear that this is one of the most efficient progression systems we’ve had in a seasonal event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-53-1024x563.png)

To understand its real value, you need to look at three things:

1. What you actually get from candy (on average)
2. How much candy it takes to kill a boss
3. What that translates to if you decide to spend

I’ll walk through each of these the same way I would evaluate it in-game—starting from the raw drop rates and turning that into practical expectations.

---

## Rewards per 1000 Candy

The first step is converting all the probabilities into something usable. Instead of thinking in percentages, we scale everything to **1000 candy**, which gives a stable baseline.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-54.png)

### Boss Damage

From the drop table:

- 40% → 1 bomb (15 damage)
- 20% → 2 bombs (30 damage)
- 12% → 4 bombs (60 damage)
- 8% → 6 bombs (90 damage)

If you average that out:

- Each candy deals **26.4 damage**
- Per 1000 candy → **26,400 total damage**

That’s important because it ties directly into boss kills later.

---

### Purple Soul Crystals

You have a 3% chance per candy to get an epic spirit chest.
Each chest averages out to **607 crystals** when you factor in all outcomes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-55-1024x648.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-56-1024x495.png)

So over 1000 candy:

- ~30 chests
- → **18,210 purple crystals**

This alone is already a serious amount. In practice, this is enough to noticeably move immortal progression even on mid-late accounts.

---

### Philosopher Stones & Extras

Again, 3% drop rate → ~30 chests per 1000 candy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-57-1024x640.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-58-1024x447.png)

From the internal probabilities, each chest averages:

- **1.77 Philosopher Stones**
- **3,500 EXP**
- **1.95 hours of universal speedups**
- **15 gems**

So over 1000 candy:

- **~53 Philosopher Stones**
- **~105,000 EXP**
- **~58.5 hours universal speedups**
- **~450 gems**

This is a very efficient conversion into Tower of Knowledge progress and general account acceleration.

---

### Speedup Chests

At 4% drop rate:

- ~40 chests per 1000 candy

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-64-1024x497.png)

The exact value depends on how the chest works in your version:

- Minimum case → **~40 hours total**
- Best case (one of each type) → **~160 hours total**

Either way, this stacks on top of the universal speedups, which is why the total speedup gain feels so high in practice.

---

### Resources

At 10% drop rate:

- ~100 procs per 1000 candy

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-59-1024x557.png)

Each gives a large bundle, resulting in:

- **10M Food / Wood / Stone / Iron**
- **2M Gold**

Not the main reason to farm candy, but it removes a lot of friction when pushing upgrades.

---

### Summary – 1000 Candy

What you are effectively getting:

- **26,400 boss damage**
- **18,210 purple crystals**
- **53 Philosopher Stones**
- **105,000 EXP**
- **58.5+ hours universal speedups**
- **40 speedup chests**
- **450 gems**
- **10M resources + 2M gold**

From experience, this is already above what most seasonal side systems provide—even before considering scaling.

---

## Candy Required per Boss Kill

Now that we know how much damage candy produces, we can convert that into boss kills.

- Boss HP: **100,000**
- Average damage per candy: **26.4**

So:100,000÷26.4≈3,788100,000 \div 26.4 \approx 3,788

### Practical Result

- **~3,800 candy per boss kill**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-61-1024x357.png)

Note that there are also rewards for killing the bosses! You have 10x bosses maximum per day, yielding Tokens of Light as well as a few speed ups upon kill. Token of Light drops scale from 4 on first three kills to 5 on the next three, 6 on two more and 7 tokens on the last kill.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-62.png)

This is quite good value! But the main attraction of this event is in the speedups, philosopher stones and soul crystals which are in absolute abundance!

---

### What This Means in Practice

Every ~3,800 candy you spend gives you:

- ~69,000+ purple crystals
- ~200+ Philosopher Stones
- Hundreds of hours of speedups

When I ran the numbers against actual gameplay, this lined up very closely with what you feel in-game: boss kills come steadily, and the reward flow is consistent rather than spiky.

---

## Cost Analysis (If You Choose to Spend)

**Bundle Structure (Daily Limits)** - Available both **in-game and via Gtarcade (effectively double stock):**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-60.png)

### Total per day (one platform)

- **22,500 candy**
- **$55 total cost**

### Total per day (both platforms)

- **45,000 candy**
- **$110 total cost**

The bundles are straightforward, which makes the math unusually clean for an event like this.

### Daily Purchase (One Platform)

- Total cost: **$55**
- Total candy: **22,500**

This gives a cost of: **~$0.00244 per candy**

---

### Cost per Boss Kill

We already know: ~3,800 candy per boss

So:3,800×0.00244≈9.33,800 \times 0.00244 \approx 9.3

### Result ~$9.30 per boss kill

---

### What One Full Day of Buying Gives

With **22,500 candy**, you get:

- **~594,000 damage**
- → **~6 boss kills**

And from the reward averages:

- **~410,000 purple crystals**
- **~1,195 Philosopher Stones**
- **~1,316 hours universal speedups**
- **~900 speedup chests**
- **~10,000 gems**
- **~225M basic resources**

---

## Conclusion Summary

- **1000 candy = extremely high, stable resource output**
- **~3800 candy = 1 boss kill**
- **~$9.30 per boss kill if spending**

If you treat candy as a primary resource and push it from all available sources, this event will outperform most previous seasonal formats in terms of raw account progression.

### Guide to Provincial Capitals and Their Provincial Orders in Norheim

## Understanding Provincial Capitals and Orders

In *Infinity Kingdom*, every city is part of a province, and each province has a Capital City. These capitals hold immense strategic importance as they grant access to **Provincial Orders**, powerful buffs that apply throughout the entire province. Utilizing these orders effectively can provide significant advantages in both resource generation and war strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-42-1024x499.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-43-1024x474.png)

## The Three Provincial Orders

These orders are on quite long Cooldown (10 hours of War Tax and 1day + for the others). They last for 1 hour and provide quite powerful buffs for the duration.

### 1. War Tax (Best Order - Always Use!)

- **Effect:** Increases tax speed (gold production in dwellings) by **20%**.
- **Why It’s Essential:** Gold is the backbone of your economy. More gold means faster upgrades, stronger armies, and a better war economy.
- **Strategy:** This order should **always** be active and on cooldown. The increased gold generation massively outweighs any other benefits from alternative orders.
- **Alliance Tactics:** Alliances should mark territories where War Tax is active and ensure members stay **within Capital Province Territory** to benefit from this buff.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-44-1024x556.png)

### 2. Quick Repair (Situational - Use During KE if Necessary)

- **Effect:** Reduces **Bloody Rage** duration by **50%**.
- **Use Case:** Primarily useful during **Kill Events (KE)** where faster recovery is needed.
- **Why It’s Less Favored:** Reducing Bloody Rage is good, but gold production is **far more valuable**. In KE situations, most experienced players will relocate rather than rely on shorter rage durations.
- **When to Use:** If your alliance is under heavy attack and needs shorter rage durations, this can be activated **briefly**, but War Tax should still be the priority.

### 3. Hold All Territory (Situational - Use for Extended Shields)

- **Effect:** Increases **Truce (Shield) duration** by **50%**.
- **Use Case:** Useful when defending key locations or preparing for an extended absence.
- **Why It’s Less Favored:** Shield extensions are nice, but War Tax is the true powerhouse. If you are actively managing your city, you should not need to rely on this as much.
- **When to Use:** If expecting a massive invasion or during major downtime, this could be useful, but again, **gold trumps everything**.

## Alliance Strategy: Maximizing War Tax Benefits

To optimize the benefits of War Tax:

1. **Always be within Capital Province Territory.**  - The provincial buff applies to **the entire province**, not just the immediate area around the Capital City.
2. **Place Alliance Markers for Guidance.**  - **R5 and R6 leaders** should mark active War Tax territories to guide members.
3. **Encourage Province Control.**  - Prioritize capturing and holding **Provincial Capitals** to ensure constant access to War Tax.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-45-1024x564.png)

## Conclusion: War Tax Reigns Supreme

While the other orders have their uses, **War Tax should always be the go-to choice**. The additional gold generation fuels progress, ensuring faster upgrades and a stronger economy. Alliances should coordinate their movements, placing markers to help members remain within capital-controlled provinces.

Stay within War Tax provinces, maximize your gold, and dominate Norheim!
