title: Understanding Concentration versus Wisdom (magic)
summary: In this guide we are going to have a closer look at the Tower of Knowledge Passives “Wisdom” and “Concentration”. A few players have asked me how these work and which one is “best”? So today we are going to dive into…
markdown:
In this guide we are going to have a closer look at the Tower of Knowledge Passives “Wisdom” and “Concentration”. A few players have asked me how these work and which one is “best”? So today we are going to dive into these two passives with the goal of understanding how “Magic Attack” and “Magic Damage” are similar in the sense that they both interact and boost the damage equation, yet they are also two very different types of value and affects the output damage in different ways when you are fighting in Infinity Kingdom.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Design-uden-navn-9-1024x413.png)

## What is Wisdom and Concentration

First things first, Wisdom and Concentration are both Tower of Knowledge Passives which you can unlock and max to equip on your Immortal of choice. They affect Magic damage and should be paired with a Mage-type Immortal.

Wisdom is unlocked at level 1 and at max level **increase** **magical attack by 60%**

Concentration is unlocked at level 24 and at max level **increase** **magical damage by 30%**

## What is the difference between magical attack and magical damage?

The damage your mage deal is based on multiple things: Magical Attack attribute value of your Immortal, the Ultimate/Passive Ability’s % and by Magical Penetration Attribute Value relative to the enemy’s Magical Protection Attribute Value. These values interact with the current Troop Count on your Immortal to determine the actual damage output. Furthermore, your damage output can be amplified by debuffs, buffs and other modifiers – such as concentration. In addition to this, your attack has a chance to hit as a critical hit, amplifying the damage by around 170% on average.

**At this point it is important for me to mention that the precise damage equation remains a closely guarded secret, and one that as far as I am aware, no player has ever come close to uncovering. Especially the interaction of Troop Count on the equation is a big mystery, all we can see is that it matters a great deal! But we can also see that the way the damage is calculated changes during the fight based on fight duration and seemingly troop count as a relative number more than purely static. As such, we cannot simply plot our values and simulate the expected damage output. Unfortunately...**

We cannot do the mats and calculate precisely how each passive / type of upgrade affects the damage output result. Instead, I did a few tests to see how running Wisdom and Concentration affects the actual damage of an Empress Wu.

## Testing

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-39-1024x530.png)

What I did was pair and Empress Wu against Charles in Training Grounds and run a couple tests. Training grounds is a good place to test this because we want minimal interference from troop count on our data. If you try and test this in arena or other combat, the numbers will change a lot between a fight where your Empress Wu takes a big crit right off the bat relative to one where her troop count is preserved for longer.

So I made a simple test: First let them fight **without any passives**at all for a baseline. We expect the damage from BOTH wisdom and concentration to be greater than the damage without either one.

Secondly, we let them fight it out with only **Wisdom**equipped. And lastly, we make them fight with only **concentration**equipped.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/magical-attack-1024x200.png)

## The Results

The outcome of these fights shows us which is best in a controlled environment with level 50 Immortals, with max equipment and tier 7 troops but with the limitations of no technology, alliance buffs, etc. that we have in Training grounds.

**The output was as follow:**Our baseline damage of running without any passives was on avg. **528K**damage on Imperial Fire
Our damage running Wisdom Passive was on avg. **580K**damage on Imperial Fire
Our damage running Concentration Passive was on avg. **723K**damage on Imperial Fire

As such, we can see that the damage amplification of Concentration’s Magical Damage % booster is significantly greater than the increase provided by Wisdom. However, Wisdom does provide a solid increase in its own right.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/magical-attack-1-1024x370.png)

## Speculations

I have read many speculations and claims that at high enough Magical Attack Attribute Values, Wisdom is superior to Concentration. So I thought I would put this to the test.

If we at one point are able to increase our base attribute value enough, would Wisdom overtake Concentration in damage output?

**I tested this by removing the Equipment on Empress Wu**:
**With**her Attack Wand and Off-Hander level 50 in Fire elemental S2 Epic + quality, we have a total of**2,432.8** magical attack.
**Without**this Attack Wand and Off-hand, her magical attack attribute drops to **1,045.2** magical attack.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/magical-attack-2-1024x399.png)

I now did the same test as above, running her without any passives, then with Wisdom and finally with Concentration.

**The output was as follow:**Our baseline damage of running without any passives was on avg. **489K**damage on Imperial Fire
Our damage running Wisdom Passive was on avg. **545K**damage on Imperial Fire
Our damage running Concentration Passive was on avg. **651K**damage on Imperial Fire

## Conclusion

What this means is, that it **does NOT seem to be true**that by increasing the base value of Magical Attack enough Wisdom would gain more value relative to Concentration.

How precisely Wisdom interacts in the damage equation remain a mystery. **But we have a pretty clear indication that for any player Concentration will be superior value than Wisdom.**

title: Concentration
summary: \"Concentration\" is a fundamental Tower of Knowledge skill available to all players in Infinity Kingdom. Despite its simplicity, it's a powerhouse that can significantly boost the effectiveness of your magical units…
markdown:
### Player Guide: Maximizing the "Concentration" Skill in Infinity Kingdoma

"Concentration" is a fundamental Tower of Knowledge skill available to all players in Infinity Kingdom. Despite its simplicity, it's a powerhouse that can significantly boost the effectiveness of your magical units throughout all stages of the game. This guide will delve into why "Concentration" is a must-have skill and how to leverage it effectively in your strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-17-1024x293.png)

## Skill Overview

### Unlocking and Upgrading

- **Availability**: "Concentration" becomes available at level 24, a relatively early stage, making it accessible to new players.
- **Upgrade Value**: Investing in upgrading "Concentration" is highly cost-effective, as the benefits it provides remain valuable well into the late game. The investment in purple crystals for upgrading this skill yields substantial returns in enhanced combat performance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-18.png)

### Skill Mechanics

- **Effect**: "Concentration" increases the magical damage dealt by the equipped immortal by 30%.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-15-1024x378.png)

- **Direct Damage Increase**: Unlike skills that boost magical attack attributes, such as "Wisdom" which increases the magical attack stat by 60%, "Concentration" directly amplifies the damage output. This direct increase is crucial because it translates into more impactful hits in battle, bypassing the complex calculations that convert magical attack stats into actual damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-13.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-14.png)

## Strategic Applications

### Optimal Use Cases

- **Main Mage Enhancement**: "Concentration" is ideally suited for your primary mage, whose role is to deal substantial magical damage. By enhancing their output by 30%, "Concentration" ensures that your mage can capitalize on their spells to maximum effect.
- **Synergy with Magical Skills**: The skill also amplifies the damage of other Tower of Knowledge skills that deal magical damage. This makes "Concentration" a versatile addition, enhancing not just basic attacks but also skill-based damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-16-1024x603.png)

### Tactical Considerations

- **Skill Slot Efficiency**: When evaluating the utility of "Concentration" compared to other skills, consider the percentage increase it offers. If you have a skill equipped that provides less than a 30% damage increase and doesn't offer crucial synergies like "Chase" or "Burst," replacing it with "Concentration" might boost your overall effectiveness.
- **Balancing Damage and Synergies**: While "Concentration" provides a significant damage boost, always weigh this against the benefits of skills that might offer lower damage increases but critical synergistic effects or tactical advantages.

## Practical Tips

### New Player Strategy

- **Early Prioritization**: New players should prioritize acquiring and upgrading "Concentration" as soon as it becomes available. It's a strategic asset that will serve well from early to late-game scenarios.
- **Skill Evaluation**: Regularly assess the contribution of "Concentration" to your team's performance, especially as you acquire new skills and immortals. Ensure it aligns with your evolving strategy and the strengths of your squad.

### Advanced Player Consideration

- **End-Game Scenarios**: For end-game players, particularly whales, there might be scenarios where attribute boosts can outperform direct damage increases due to specific game mechanics or interactions. However, for the vast majority, the straightforward damage boost from "Concentration" remains superior.

## Conclusion

"Concentration" stands out as an indispensable skill for any player in Infinity Kingdom looking to enhance their magical damage output. Its simplicity in boosting damage directly makes it a reliable and powerful tool in your arsenal. Whether you are a new player establishing your foundation or a veteran optimizing your lineup, "Concentration" offers a clear advantage that can significantly impact your battle outcomes. Prioritize this skill, and watch as your mages become formidable forces on the battlefield.

title: Conquest P1
summary: Legion of Frostborne is the ultimate competition between the Infinite worlds of Infinity Kingdom. Servers are matched togeather and thrown into a shared new map where they battle for weeks on end to claim the gnome…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-41-1024x197.png)

Legion of Frostborne is the ultimate competition between the Infinite worlds of Infinity Kingdom. Servers are matched togeather and thrown into a shared new map where they battle for weeks on end to claim the gnome capital of Ymir and ultimate victory. For this guide, we shall instead look at the progression structure of Legion of Frostborne as well as the rewards available.

Legion of Frostborne is structured into seasons, the server worlds of Infinity Kingdom are not on the same progressional level, with almost two years between the oldest and youngest server, it would never be a fair fight. As such, we have a progression structure where all worlds are grouped into battlegroups and goes through three seasons of SvS before being added to the final battlegroup "Conquest". During conquest, your server progresses through phases where rewards will change slightly for your server based on the number of Conquest seasons you have participated in.

Legion of Frostborne have very very powerful rewards for all participants. These include Ability Stones for the locked Tower of Knowledge Skills such as Spell Disintegration and Wind Rage, to name a few. These Stones are available both in the seasonal SvS shop to be purchased for Cold Coins as well as in the SvS Ancient Chest loot boxes which can be bought with Cold Coins and Gems. Besides Ability Stones for ToK skills, we are also able to unlock new unique Immortals as we progress through the seasons of SvS. Each of the seasons including conquest phases hold new Immortal Fragments for you to unlock. After completing a season you can also access these Immortals in the Bundle Recharge Shop and you unlock new Immortals in the King of the Hill event (during the first seasons).

## Conquest P1 Rewards

After completing season 3, your server has now finished it's maturity journey and is officially part of the Conquest battlegroup. This means migration to all servers is now possible, and you will be matched with much more powerful servers. You can now be matched against any of the old servers as well as the biggest servers in the game.

### The Cold Coin shop is now complete and will offer the following:

1. Snipe Ability Stones
2. Stormeye Ability Stones
3. Spell Disintegrator
4. Wind Rage Ability Stones

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-42-1024x597.png)

### In the Ancient Remnant Chest Lootboxes you are able to find:

1. Snipe Ability Stones
2. Stormeye Ability Stones
3. Siren's Gaze Ability Stones
4. Spell Disintegrator
5. Full Coverage Ability Stones
6. Victorious Pursuit Ability Stones
7. Rind Rage Ability Stones
8. Berserker Ability Stones
9. Louis Immortal Fragments
10. Toyotomi Immortal Fragments

Let us dive a bit deeper and review each of these rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-43-1024x564.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-44-1024x555.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/stormeye-1-1024x583.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/siren-1-1024x604.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/full-coverage-1024x555.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/s2-snipe-1024x601.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Skaermbillede-2023-01-13-134228-1024x622.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Skaermbillede-2023-01-13-134245-1024x593.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/wind-rage-1024x592.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/berserker-1024x607.png)

## Tower of Knowledge unlocks

**Spell Disintegrator**is the main reward from this season of SvS along with Trajan. It is another Fire-season and it is now that your fire team can truely take off and do insane things if you main it. This is the single best magic damage passive in the game and you always want to unlock this if you are doing anything with a mage. **I highly recommend that you have stacked all cold coin from previous seasons and max Spell Disintegrator asap.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-35.png)

**Sniper**is a powerful skill and one that many players are using in their main setup. It is particularly strong in back-line pressure and AOE setups.This is because the skill procs dealing damage to the target **furthest**away from you meaning you will always secure backline damage from this ability's procs. It works extreemly well on Immortals such as **Gilgamesh, Khan, Atalanta, Bathory, Yoshi.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-23.png)

**Stormeye**is also in the shop for cold coin. It is a magic skill which work well in any mage-dependent setup. It is a very good skill and one you want to get if you use more than one mage. However, it is not as strong as Spell Disintegration which will be available next season, and as such I would advise most players to keep stacking Cold Coin even if you rely on a mage in your main.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-20.png)

**Siren's Gaze** is an interesting skill, one which I have never seen in play for real thus far. However, that does not mean it is bad. While I don't think it is amongst the best skills in the game, I can see some specialized builds make very good use of this skill. E.g. in combo with Void Realm or with Life-Link on a tank Immortal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-21.png)

**Full Coverage** is a lot harder to get, since it is from Ancient Chests only. This means you will not be able to get it finished anytime soon. It will take a long time. However, it is a decent skill to get for certain setups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-22.png)

If you are running a Fire team, I would encourage you to get this ability skill eventually. You will run it on Hippolyta for massive damage in a crit-regen build. That being said, it is a solid skills for any physical Immortal, however one you want to run paired with high energy regen builds with Adrenaline Rush, Rage Blessing, Energy Burst.

**Victorious Pursuit**is an interesting skill. While it is not being used a lot, it does have it's use cases and can be very powerful in the right build. The problem with this skill is getting a high enough count of damage instances for it do stack it's damage buff. However, once you get 10x5% = 50% damage buff active, it is extreemly powerful. The problem of triggering it means that it is only viable on extreem attack speed builds (maybe on an Alex in a hybrid setup) and for niche Immortals with extreem amounts of damage instances. This would be a Hippolytta with unique artifact and energy regen build or a Gilgamesh with high-dmg instance passives such as DoT's or DB.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-34.png)

**Berserker** is the most nerf'ed skill of all in Infinity Kingdom. Since it's release it has been nerfed 3 or 4 times by massive amounts. However, it remains a very powerful passive in certain situations. It should be used on an Immortal with e.g. a unique artifact effect that makes it's ultimate into a passive ability (thus no downside from regen loss) and one that likes attack speed. I for one, am looking forward to some day get this for my Barca in my wind-earth hybrid.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-46.png)

**Wind Rage** is a highly valued skill. In certain setups it can provide rediculess value, like on a well crafted Alex build you can get very high value from this passive. It basically works extreemly well with anything that relies on normal damage, attack speed and normal attacks as a trigger (combo, cleave, heavenly thunder, etc.).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-45.png)

## Immortal's SvS rewards

### Louis

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-47.png)

**Louis**is a decent Immortal addition to the lightning roster. While he is not one of the absolute best Immortals ever, he performs very well and has the unique advantage of allowing you to use magic passives on a front-line immortal. This is great for many of us running too many physical immortals. Furthermore, paired with Hammurabi he will deal quite solid damage, certainly better than Richard and if you do not have Spearman technology, he is a perfect replacement for Peter!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-48.png)

### Toyotomi

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-49.png)

**Toyotomi**is an excellent Immortal and one that wind has been missing! He completes the dodge build for wind element, as you are now able to run Atalanta + Qin + Barca + Toyotomi. This composition is very powerful against physical setups and therefore very good in the current meta. In my opinion the best wind build out there and this guys is the key to making it work!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-50.png)

## King of the Hill Progression

With the first SvS seasons, server progress is meassured by SvS seasons. As such, the release of new Immortals in the King of the Hill event relies on your server's SvS progression.

After finishing Season 3 every single Immortal in rotation is available. No additional Immortals are being added thus far.

Hammurabi is very very good for lightning setups pumping huge magic damage. Arash should be ignored. He is just not very good...

summary: Legion of Frostborne has come to an end for all of the conquest servers. If you are in Conquest and you are wondering if it is worth spending all the gems you have banked on the Ancient Remanents chests - then you have…
markdown:
**Legion of Frostborne has come to an end for all of the conquest servers. If you are in Conquest and you are wondering if it is worth spending all the gems you have banked on the Ancient Remanents chests - then you have come to the right place!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-54-1024x528.png)

title: Conquest P2
summary: Legion of Frostborne is the ultimate competition between the Infinite worlds of Infinity Kingdom. Servers are matched togeather and thrown into a shared new map where they battle for weeks on end to claim the gnome…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-51-1024x177.png)

Legion of Frostborne is the ultimate competition between the Infinite worlds of Infinity Kingdom. Servers are matched togeather and thrown into a shared new map where they battle for weeks on end to claim the gnome capital of Ymir and ultimate victory. For this guide, we shall instead look at the progression structure of Legion of Frostborne as well as the rewards available.

Legion of Frostborne is structured into seasons, the server worlds of Infinity Kingdom are not on the same progressional level, with almost two years between the oldest and youngest server, it would never be a fair fight. As such, we have a progression structure where all worlds are grouped into battlegroups and goes through three seasons of SvS before being added to the final battlegroup "Conquest". During conquest, your server progresses through phases where rewards will change slightly for your server based on the number of Conquest seasons you have participated in.

Legion of Frostborne have very very powerful rewards for all participants. These include Ability Stones for the locked Tower of Knowledge Skills such as Spell Disintegration and Wind Rage, to name a few. These Stones are available both in the seasonal SvS shop to be purchased for Cold Coins as well as in the SvS Ancient Chest loot boxes which can be bought with Cold Coins and Gems. Besides Ability Stones for ToK skills, we are also able to unlock new unique Immortals as we progress through the seasons of SvS. Each of the seasons including conquest phases hold new Immortal Fragments for you to unlock. After completing a season you can also access these Immortals in the Bundle Recharge Shop and you unlock new Immortals in the King of the Hill event (during the first seasons).

## Conquest P2 Rewards

After completing conquest P1, your server will continue it's journey in the Conquest battlegroup into the P2 stage with slight changes to rewards.

### The Cold Coin shop is now complete and will offer the following:

1. Snipe Ability Stones
2. Stormeye Ability Stones
3. Spell Disintegrator
4. Wind Rage Ability Stones

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-52-1024x623.png)

### In the Ancient Remnant Chest Lootboxes you are able to find:

1. Snipe Ability Stones
2. Stormeye Ability Stones
3. Siren's Gaze Ability Stones
4. Spell Disintegrator
5. Full Coverage Ability Stones
6. Victorious Pursuit Ability Stones
7. Rind Rage Ability Stones
8. Berserker Ability Stones
9. Tokugawa Immortal Fragments
10. Margaret l Immortal Fragments

Let us dive a bit deeper and review each of these rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-53-1024x523.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-44-1024x555.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/stormeye-1-1024x583.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/siren-1-1024x604.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/full-coverage-1024x555.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/s2-snipe-1024x601.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Skaermbillede-2023-01-13-134228-1024x622.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Skaermbillede-2023-01-13-134245-1024x593.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/wind-rage-1024x592.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/berserker-1024x607.png)

## Tower of Knowledge unlocks

**Spell Disintegrator**is the main reward from this season of SvS along with Trajan. It is another Fire-season and it is now that your fire team can truely take off and do insane things if you main it. This is the single best magic damage passive in the game and you always want to unlock this if you are doing anything with a mage. **I highly recommend that you have stacked all cold coin from previous seasons and max Spell Disintegrator asap.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-35.png)

**Sniper**is a powerful skill and one that many players are using in their main setup. It is particularly strong in back-line pressure and AOE setups.This is because the skill procs dealing damage to the target **furthest**away from you meaning you will always secure backline damage from this ability's procs. It works extreemly well on Immortals such as **Gilgamesh, Khan, Atalanta, Bathory, Yoshi.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-23.png)

**Stormeye**is also in the shop for cold coin. It is a magic skill which work well in any mage-dependent setup. It is a very good skill and one you want to get if you use more than one mage. However, it is not as strong as Spell Disintegration which will be available next season, and as such I would advise most players to keep stacking Cold Coin even if you rely on a mage in your main.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-20.png)

**Siren's Gaze** is an interesting skill, one which I have never seen in play for real thus far. However, that does not mean it is bad. While I don't think it is amongst the best skills in the game, I can see some specialized builds make very good use of this skill. E.g. in combo with Void Realm or with Life-Link on a tank Immortal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-21.png)

**Full Coverage** is a lot harder to get, since it is from Ancient Chests only. This means you will not be able to get it finished anytime soon. It will take a long time. However, it is a decent skill to get for certain setups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-22.png)

If you are running a Fire team, I would encourage you to get this ability skill eventually. You will run it on Hippolyta for massive damage in a crit-regen build. That being said, it is a solid skills for any physical Immortal, however one you want to run paired with high energy regen builds with Adrenaline Rush, Rage Blessing, Energy Burst.

**Victorious Pursuit**is an interesting skill. While it is not being used a lot, it does have it's use cases and can be very powerful in the right build. The problem with this skill is getting a high enough count of damage instances for it do stack it's damage buff. However, once you get 10x5% = 50% damage buff active, it is extreemly powerful. The problem of triggering it means that it is only viable on extreem attack speed builds (maybe on an Alex in a hybrid setup) and for niche Immortals with extreem amounts of damage instances. This would be a Hippolytta with unique artifact and energy regen build or a Gilgamesh with high-dmg instance passives such as DoT's or DB.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-34.png)

**Berserker** is the most nerf'ed skill of all in Infinity Kingdom. Since it's release it has been nerfed 3 or 4 times by massive amounts. However, it remains a very powerful passive in certain situations. It should be used on an Immortal with e.g. a unique artifact effect that makes it's ultimate into a passive ability (thus no downside from regen loss) and one that likes attack speed. I for one, am looking forward to some day get this for my Barca in my wind-earth hybrid.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-46.png)

**Wind Rage** is a highly valued skill. In certain setups it can provide rediculess value, like on a well crafted Alex build you can get very high value from this passive. It basically works extreemly well with anything that relies on normal damage, attack speed and normal attacks as a trigger (combo, cleave, heavenly thunder, etc.).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-45.png)

## Immortal's SvS rewards

### Tokugawa

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-57.png)

**Tokugawa**is a very interesting Immortal.

- Recieving 10% more damage + dealing 10% less damage while having 10% lower energy regen and 10% reduced attack speed, has a gigantic impact on ANY Immortal.

I think this guy is extreemly interesting and will be quite powerful upon release. I know I am going to unlock him as soon as I can, in fact. He will be very strong in many setups and builds since he is such a strong counter to the physical meta that dominates. However, I think the true value will be from teaming him with Louis and Hammurabi for Lightning massive magic damage. Stacking insane amounts of negative effects/debuffs on the enemy while remaining safe from physical attacks. Critically, he will counter the meta hybrid wind-earth team as 10% reduced attack speed and 10% reduced damage makes even Alex a wet noodle.

He does have **one weakness**, magic damage. His shields absorb physical damage, as such, if you are wielding a dual mage fire this guy is a paper weight with zero impact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-56.png)

### Margaret l

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-55.png)

Contraty **Margaret**is not a very interesting Immortal. She seems like a slightly better Yoshi, but her energy regen is horrible which makes it useless to provide chill before Merlin hits with his first ultimate. That would be the window where she could out perform Dido and other backliners. But in this current version of attribute value I do not see a point in getting her.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-54.png)

## King of the Hill Progression

With the first SvS seasons, server progress is meassured by SvS seasons. As such, the release of new Immortals in the King of the Hill event relies on your server's SvS progression.

After finishing Season 3 every single Immortal in rotation is available. No additional Immortals are being added thus far.

Hammurabi is very very good for lightning setups pumping huge magic damage. Arash should be ignored. He is just not very good...

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-118.png)

Since physical damage can be dodges, we are able to massively reduce the amount of damage taken.

Not only does he provide an extreemly strong dodge buff to our build, we are also getting a very very strong defensive and offensive buff every time we dodge. Since we are running a dodge build, in training grounds testing I have 90% uptime on Myojin Defense and Damage buff! That is MASSIVE for any setup.

On the drawback side, you do **HAVE**to run this as a dodge build. That means you are weak against shadow and fire as well as other magic heavy setups. Moreover, you **MUST**run Toyotomi with Missleading, After Image in order to get any effect. title: Coordinate Alliance City Buffs for Maximum Efficient Progression
summary: City Buffs in Infinity Kingdom are a powerful but often underutilized tool that can significantly impact the progression speed of an alliance. With the right coordination, alliances can optimize building speed…
markdown:
City Buffs in *Infinity Kingdom* are a powerful but often underutilized tool that can significantly impact the **progression speed** of an alliance. With the right coordination, alliances can **optimize building speed, technology research, and dragon upgrades**, allowing their members to advance faster while saving valuable speedups. In this guide, we’ll cover **how** and **why** alliances should coordinate these buffs efficiently to maximize progression.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-105-1024x494.png)

---

## Understanding City Buffs and Their Importance

Across **Norheim**, there are **multiple cities that provide buffs** to enhance progression efficiency. While some cities offer **combat buffs**, we’ll focus on the ones that grant **economic progression buffs**, which include:

- **Building Speed Buff (+3%)** – Reduces the time required for construction upgrades.
- **Technology Research Speed Buff (+3%)** – Speeds up research, allowing faster unlocks and upgrades.
- **Dragon Upgrade Speed Buff (+3%)** – Reduces the time needed for leveling up dragons.

### Buff Distribution in Norheim

- **Dragon Upgrade Speed Buff Cities:** 19 total, **3 also provide combat buffs**.
- **Building Speed Buff Cities:** 13 total, **4 also provide combat buffs**.
- **Technology Research Speed Buff Cities:** 11 total, **3 also provide combat buffs**.

*See complete list of all cities and buffs on the bottom of this guide.*

Since **combat buffs apply to all alliance members**, but **economic buffs only apply to the mayor**, **strategic distribution** is essential for efficiency.

---

## Strategic Coordination of City Buffs

### 1. Distributing Cities Among Alliances

To ensure **all active alliances** benefit from city buffs, **the strongest alliances** should control cities with **combat buffs**, while the remaining cities should be **distributed among other active alliances**. This ensures:

- **Top alliances** retain an edge in combat while maintaining economic efficiency.
- **Mid-tier alliances** have access to valuable speed buffs, improving server-wide progression.
- **No single alliance hoards all buff cities**, promoting server balance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-109-1024x522.png)

### 2. Setting Up Communication for City Buff Requests

To **maximize the use of buffs**, alliances should establish a **dedicated communication channel** for city buff management. This ensures that:

- Players can **request a buff** before major upgrades.
- Officers can **quickly assign mayorship** to the requesting player.
- Players **return the position** after activating their upgrade.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-107-1024x571.png)

A simple **chat format** could be:

📢 *Request:* "Please assign me **Dragon Buff** for my upgrade."

🔄 *Officer Action:* Assigns mayor position and **tags** the player.

✅ *Player Response:* Starts upgrade and **immediately steps down** from mayorship.

### 3. Assigning and Rotating City Mayors

Since only **one player at a time** benefits from the mayor’s buff, **quick transitions** are key.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-106-1024x366.png)

- Officers should **check requests regularly** and **promptly assign mayorship**.
- **Players must release the role immediately after initiating an upgrade**.
- **Officers now have the ability to remove inactive mayors**, ensuring smooth rotation.

### 4. Understanding Buff Activation Timing

Unlike combat buffs that apply **continuously**, **economic buffs only need to be active at the start of an upgrade**. This means:

- Players **do not need to hold mayorship for the entire duration** of an upgrade.
- Once the upgrade starts, the buff **locks in**, and the player can **vacate the position**.
- Another player can then **request the buff**, ensuring **maximum efficiency**.

### 5. Leadership Responsibility and Long-Term Benefits

While **this requires some attention from officers**, it is **not difficult to manage**. The long-term benefits include:

- **Consistently saving speedups** for every alliance member.
- **Faster individual progression**, leading to **stronger alliances overall**.
- **Better coordination between alliances**, strengthening **server-wide cooperation**.

---

## New Officer Controls: Removing Mayors

Previously, **players had to manually step down** from mayorship, leading to bottlenecks when someone forgot. However, a recent **game update** now allows **officers to remove players** from the mayor position, ensuring a **smooth transition** when another player requests the buff.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-108.png)

---

## Final Thoughts

Properly managing **City Buffs** can provide a **huge advantage** for alliances willing to coordinate. By setting up **efficient communication channels**, distributing **cities strategically**, and **rotating mayors quickly**, alliances can drastically **reduce upgrade times**, **save speedups**, and **grow stronger together**.

🔥 *A well-organized alliance is a powerful alliance!* 🔥

### Guide to Efficiently Killing Golem Bosses in Infinity Kingdom

In Infinity Kingdom, conquering Golem Bosses efficiently requires a strategic approach that differs from regular combat scenarios. This guide will provide you with a comprehensive strategy to tackle Golem Bosses effectively using a specific Immortal team composition and skill setup. We will also highlight the importance of control over defense and healing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-93-1024x543.png)

## The Immortal Team

Your Immortal team is the cornerstone of your success in defeating Golem Bosses efficiently. The recommended Immortals for this strategy are Alexander, Khubilaikhan, Qin, and Zenobia. Equip them with unique artifacts to maximize their attack speed and damage output. The unique synergy of this team lies in their ability to control the Golem Boss while dealing substantial damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-94.png)

### Skill Setup

For this strategy to work optimally, ensure that your Immortals have the following skills:

1. **Zenobia:**  - Weakness
- Blessing of War
- Wine and Dine
2. **Emperor Qin:**  - Berserk
- Root
- Blessing of Speed
3. **Alexander:**  - Wind Rage
- Combo
- Anger
4. **Khubilaikhan:**  - Adrenaline Rush
- Energy Burst
- Intimidation

## The Key to Efficiency: Control Over Defense and Healing

Many players make the mistake of prioritizing defense and healing when facing Golem Bosses. However, this approach is less effective against these formidable foes. Instead, the key to efficiency is to focus on damage and control.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-95-1024x371.png)

### Control Mechanisms

Control mechanisms play a pivotal role in this strategy. Your team should be equipped to continuously control the Golem Boss, preventing it from unleashing devastating attacks and allowing your Immortals to maintain high damage output. Here's how control is achieved:

- **Alexander's Technology Procs:** These trigger stuns, disrupting the Golem Boss's actions and providing precious seconds for your team to deal damage without interruptions.
- **Qin's Root:** Emperor Qin's Root skill further enhances control by immobilizing the Golem Boss, rendering it unable to attack your team.
- **Khubilaikhan's Intimidation:** Khubilaikhan's Intimidation skill adds another layer of control, adding more root effects to the boss.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-96-1024x549.png)

## Efficiency in Action

To witness this efficient strategy in action, we recommend watching the accompanying video (insert video link here). In this video, you can observe how the Golem Boss is consistently controlled through roots and stuns, ensuring your team's safety and maximizing damage output.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Infinity-Kingdom-2023-08-29-10-50-36.mp4)

With this strategy, you can not only defeat Golem Bosses efficiently but also take on level 15 bosses with minimal troop losses. By prioritizing control over defense and healing and optimizing your Immortal team with the recommended skill setup, you'll become a formidable force in Infinity Kingdom's Golem Boss battles. Good luck, and may your conquests be swift and victorious!

## 🏰 Corridor of Ghostflame Castle Skin Guide

A brand new combat castle skin is arriving with the upcoming **Hunting Festival 2025** event, and it’s shaping up to be one of the best-looking and most useful skins to date. Let's take a closer look at the **Corridor of Ghostflame**, how to obtain it, and why it’s an important addition to your collection.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-62-1024x451.png)

---

## 🌟 Overview: Corridor of Ghostflame

The **Corridor of Ghostflame** is the newest limited-time **castle skin** in *Infinity Kingdom*, launching alongside the **Hunting Festival 2025**, which begins today **May 14th** **2025**and runs for 10 days. Visually stunning and bathed in eerie blue-green flame aesthetics, this skin is more than just cosmetics—it offers real combat value.

### Corridor of Ghostflame Stats:

- **Troop HP +2%**
- **Honor Gain +5%**

**IMPORTANT**: These are the **same**powerful buffs found on **City of Glory**, making this one of the few castle skins in the game that provides a **direct combat stat boost** while also supporting your **honor farming efforts**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-60-1024x441.png)

---

## 💰 How to Obtain It

This castle skin is **exclusive** to the **premium tier** of the **Hunting Festival Battle Pass**. To unlock it, you must:

1. Purchase the **$49.99 Premium Battle Pass**.
2. Complete the full 30 levels of the pass by earning **Battle Pass EXP** through daily tasks.
3. Reach the final reward tier to claim the Corridor of Ghostflame.

You’ll also receive additional rewards such as gems, Resonance Crystals, and a full random Light/Shadow immortal, adding further value to your purchase.

> ⚠️ Important: The pass requires **4,800 EXP** to complete, and you can earn **700 EXP per day** from tasks, meaning you have room to skip a couple of days or tasks and still finish it before the event ends.

---

## ⚔️ Why It Matters

Like **City of Glory** and **Goddess of Victory**, the **Corridor of Ghostflame** provides **2% bonus HP to all troops**, which is a significant combat stat, especially in **PvP** and **season-based warfare**. On top of that, it boosts **honor gain by 5%**, giving you an edge in **climbing the Nobility ladder** and unlocking powerful **title buffs** faster.

When compared to other top-tier castle skins:

| Skin | Combat Buff | Utility Buff | Use Case |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| City of Glory | 2% Troop HP | +5% Honor Gain | Best for PvP/Honor Farming |
| Goddess of Victory | 2% Troop HP | -3% Death Rate | Best for Troop Preservation & IB |
| Mt. Paradise | 2% Troop HP | +5% Marching Speed | Best for Sieging/Map Control |
| Corridor of Ghostflame | 2% Troop HP | +5% Honor Gain | Best for PvP/Honor Farming |

So, while the stats are not unique, **having more than one skin with strong bonuses** lets you **alternate based on your playstyle** and the **needs of your current season**. If you missed City of Glory or want a second skin with identical buffs and a different visual flavor, this is your opportunity.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-61-1024x429.png)

Even if you did obtain the Glory Castle Skin, in my humble opinion Ghostflame just simply looks incredible!

---

## 📝 Final Thoughts

The **Corridor of Ghostflame** is not just another skin—it’s a **combat-relevant and honor-efficient** asset that fits perfectly into any PvP-focused player’s toolkit. Combined with the other strong rewards in the Hunting Festival Battle Pass, this skin makes the $50 investment well worth it for most spenders.

> **Recommendation:** If you’re serious about PvP and Honor grinding—or if you simply want one of the game’s best-looking skins—this is one castle you won’t want to miss.

title: Corrosive Power
summary: Corrosive Power is one of the most expensive epic skills available in Infinity Kingdom, and that alone makes it a skill many players hesitate to invest in. The appeal is easy to understand: extra energy, stronger…
markdown:
## Introduction

Corrosive Power is one of the most expensive epic skills available in Infinity Kingdom, and that alone makes it a skill many players hesitate to invest in. The appeal is easy to understand: extra energy, stronger ultimate skills, and the potential to significantly increase damage output over the course of a battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-112-1024x574.png)

The real question is whether those benefits justify the cost. While Corrosive Power can produce impressive results in the right setup, its value depends heavily on an Immortal's ability to cycle ultimates consistently and take advantage of the buff window after activation.

This guide explains exactly how the skill works, which Immortals benefit most, where it fits in modern builds, and whether it deserves a place in your long-term progression plans.

---

## How Corrosive Power Works

Corrosive Power is an Epic Passive Skill, meaning it remains active throughout the entire battle once equipped.

The skill activates after the Immortal has dealt direct damage with an ultimate skill three times. Once triggered, Corrosive Power provides two effects:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-113.png)

- Restores Energy
- Increases Ultimate Skill Damage for 9 seconds

At Skill Level 1:

- Restores 60 Energy
- Increases Ultimate Skill Damage by 18%

At Skill Level 8:

- Restores 200 Energy
- Increases Ultimate Skill Damage by 60%

The activation condition never changes as the skill levels up. Only the amount of energy restored and the damage bonus increase.

One important detail is that **only direct ultimate damage**contributes toward activation. Damage-over-time effects do not count toward the three-hit requirement.

Because of this, Corrosive Power performs best on Immortals whose ultimate skills deal direct damage in AoE (3 instance requirement) consistently throughout the fight.

---

## Why the Skill Is Strong

Corrosive Power effectively combines two valuable mechanics into a single skill slot.

The first is energy acceleration. Receiving 200 energy after activation helps an Immortal reach their next ultimate sooner, improving overall skill rotation and pressure.

The second is burst amplification. A 60% increase to ultimate damage can dramatically increase the impact of subsequent casts, especially on Immortals whose ultimates already represent a large percentage of their total damage output.

In longer fights, these two effects begin feeding into each other. More energy leads to more ultimates, while stronger ultimates create larger damage spikes whenever the buff is active.

This scaling effect is what makes Corrosive Power particularly attractive in extended PvP battles and boss encounters.

---

## Investment Cost

Corrosive Power is considered a premium Epic Skill.

To unlock it, players must acquire:

- 60 Ability Stones
- 300 Elixir total

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-114-1024x615.png)

Unlike many premium Epic Skills obtained through Kingdom versus Kingdom rewards, Corrosive Power uses Elixir rather than traditional KVK Ability Stones.

After unlocking the skill, upgrades require Soul Crystals.

To fully max Corrosive Power from Level 1 to Level 8, the total cost reaches:

- 60 Ability Stones
- 143,400 Soul Crystals

This makes it one of the more expensive skill investments in the game, which is why prioritization matters.

---

## Best Immortals for Corrosive Power

The game recommends the skill for Attack, Ranged, and Magic Immortals, and in practice that recommendation is largely accurate.

The strongest users tend to share three characteristics:

- High ultimate damage
- Atleast 3 damage instances per ultimate cast
- Reliable ultimate uptime
- Good energy generation

### Loki

Loki is one of the most natural fits.

His ultimate already deals substantial area magical damage, and players running his Exclusive Artifact will see even greater value from stronger repeated casts. Corrosive Power helps amplify his strongest damage source while improving ultimate frequency throughout longer engagements.

### Khan

Khan benefits for similar reasons.

His ultimate delivers powerful team-wide physical damage, and Corrosive Power increases both the frequency and impact of those casts. The skill fits naturally into builds focused on sustained offensive pressure.

### Hippolyta

Among current options, Hippolyta may be one of the most interesting users.

Her kit naturally supports strong energy generation, allowing her to take greater advantage of the energy refund than many other Immortals. Since she already relies on frequent skill usage to maintain pressure, Corrosive Power complements her playstyle exceptionally well.

The skill is especially noticeable in longer PvE encounters where maintaining ultimate tempo becomes increasingly valuable.

### Other Viable Users

Many backline damage dealers can use Corrosive Power effectively if their build revolves around repeated ultimate casts.

The key consideration is not the Immortal's class but whether they can reliably reach additional ultimates during the nine-second buff window.

---

## Skill Pairings

Corrosive Power performs best when paired with skills that either accelerate energy generation or increase the value of repeated ultimate casts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-117.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-116.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-119.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-115.png)

### Energy Mastery

This is the most common pairing. Both skills focus on energy generation and ultimate enhancement, creating extremely strong ultimate cycling. Together they can dramatically increase the number of ultimates cast during a fight.

### Psionic Tide

A strong option for magical damage dealers. Psionic Tide contributes additional energy generation while supporting sustained magical damage output. The combination creates a smooth cycle of repeated ultimates and increasing pressure.

### Battle Stance

A more specialized choice. After the twenty-second mark, Battle Stance provides increased damage and faster energy recovery. In battles that regularly reach the later stages, the combination can become very powerful.

The drawback is sacrificing early-fight value.

### Time to Shine

A solid choice for physical damage dealers. The additional critical rate and physical damage improve the effectiveness of ultimate casts during Corrosive Power's damage window and increase overall burst consistency.

---

## Corrosive Power vs Energy Mastery

This comparison is important because both skills compete for similar resources.

Corrosive Power is undeniably powerful, but Energy Mastery remains the more universally valuable investment for most accounts. Energy Mastery tends to provide stronger overall consistency and broader applicability across ultimate-focused builds. Because both skills require a significant investment, many experienced players choose to unlock and upgrade Energy Mastery first.

That does not make Corrosive Power a poor choice and Corrosive Power offer more versatility in the sense that you can equip it on e.g. a Saladin or Hippolyta in your frontline whereas Mastery is locked. Moreover, most players that build into either of these skills want to make use of both in synergy with oneanother. For players who already have Energy Mastery built, Corrosive Power becomes a much more attractive second investment.

---

## How to Obtain Corrosive Power

There are currently two primary ways to acquire the skill.

### Elixir Purchase

The standard method is obtaining the required Ability Stones through the premium Elixir system.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-120-1024x607.png)

Players need 60 Ability Stones to unlock the skill.

### 1,000-Day Login Reward

Players who reach 1,000 consecutive logins may receive a special reward selection that can include:

- A Skin
- An Epic Immortal
- An Epic Skill

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-121-1024x313.png)

Many long-term players choose Corrosive Power from this reward pool due to its rarity and high value.

---

## Conclusion Summary

Corrosive Power is a powerful A-Tier Epic Skill that rewards builds focused on repeated ultimate usage.

Its combination of energy restoration and ultimate damage amplification can significantly increase overall damage output, particularly in longer battles where multiple activation cycles occur. The skill works best on Immortals capable of maintaining strong energy tempo and consistently casting ultimates throughout the fight.

The main drawback is its cost. Because Energy Mastery generally provides broader value for a similar investment, most players should prioritize Energy Mastery first.

Once that foundation is established, however, Corrosive Power becomes one of the strongest premium Epic Skills available and a worthwhile addition to any ultimate-focused roster.

---

title: Cost Efficiency Guide: Eternal Grail vs. Chaos Roulette
summary: With the 5th Anniversary Eternal Grail event, many players are asking a straightforward question:
markdown:
With the 5th Anniversary **Eternal Grail** event, many players are asking a straightforward question:

> Is spending Tokens of Light for Chaos Immortal fragments more cost-efficient than building them through the traditional Chaos Roulette?

This guide compares the **fragment cost efficiency** of the Eternal Grail event against the long-established Chaos Roulette system.

We are **not including Tengu** in this comparison. If you are targeting Tengu specifically, Eternal Grails are the only source and comparison is irrelevant. This guide applies to all other Chaos Immortals.

The goal here is simple: calculate the real expected cost per fragment in Eternal Grail, then compare it to the established Chaos Roulette benchmark.

---

## Part 1 – Eternal Grail Event Economics

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-67-1024x558.png)

## Grail Drop Rates per Token of Light

Each Token of Light gives one roll with the following rewards:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-65-1024x264.png)

### Expected Grails per Token

I calculate the weighted average:

```
300 × 0.0045 = 1.35
50 × 0.0155  = 0.775
25 × 0.035   = 0.875
5 × 0.12     = 0.6
1 × 0.825    = 0.825
```

**Total expected Grails per token ≈ 4.425**. That number is critical for all further calculations.

---

## Cost of Tokens of Light

### In-Game & GTarcade Shop Pricing

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-64-1024x305.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-68-1024x567.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-69-1024x365.png)

### Average Price per Token

Across all bundles, the rough blended average is approximately: **$1.37 per Token of Light**

*Note:* If you only buy the most efficient bundles (3 and 5 token packs at $1 per token), your effective price drops closer to $1.00 per token. Most spenders, however, end up mixing bundles due to daily stock limits, so we will use $1.37 as a realistic working average.

---

## Part 2 – Cost to Fully Build a Chaos Immortal via Eternal Grail

Each 80 Chaos Immortal fragments costs **450 Grails**.

That means: 1 fragment = 5.625 Grails

---

## Unlocking Immortal Stars + Artifact Slot (1640 Fragments)

You need 1640 immortal fragments to upgrade a chaos immortal from nothing to 8 stars plus artifact slot unlock. Let's have a look at the pricing given the above calculations.

### Grails Required

```
1640 × 5.625 = 9,225 Grails
```

### Tokens Required

```
9,225 ÷ 4.425 ≈ 2,084 Tokens
```

### Cost

```
2,084 × $1.37 ≈ $2,854
```

### Eternal Grail Cost for 1640 Fragments ≈ $2,850

---

## Talents to Level 8 (Additional 2190 Fragments)

You need 2190 immortal fragments to upgrade a chaos immortal from 8 stars plus artifact slot unlock **to achieve level 8 immortal talent**. Let's have a look at the pricing given the above calculations.

### Grails Required

```
2190 × 5.625 = 12,318.75 Grails
```

### Tokens Required

```
12,318.75 ÷ 4.425 ≈ 2,783 Tokens
```

### Cost

```
2,783 × $1.37 ≈ $3,812
```

### Eternal Grail Cost for 2190 Fragments ≈ $3,810

---

## Total Cost via Eternal Grail

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-63-1024x176.png)

If purchasing only $1/token bundles, total would still be roughly **$4,867**, but stock limitations make this unrealistic for large builds.

---

## Chaos Roulette Benchmark

From established Chaos Roulette math:

## Upgrading stars, artifact and talents to level 8 on a chaos immortal

- You need **1640 fragments to unlock all stars and artifact slot** on a Chaos immortal.  - 1640 ÷ 131.1 ≈ **12.5 weeks**. In practice, players should plan for **13 weeks**.
- Assuming efficient GTarcade bundles at **$0.50 per Eye**: 209.9 Eyes × $0.50 ≈ **$105 per week**. **Total cost:** ≈ **$1,365**
- You need another **2190 immortal fragments to upgrade immortal talent to level 8** (all nodes level 1 for quickest progression to level 8).  - 2190 ÷ 131.1 ≈ **16,7 weeks**. In practice, players should plan for **17 weeks**.
- Assuming efficient GTarcade bundles at **$0.50 per Eye**: 209.9 Eyes × $0.50 ≈ **$105 per week** **for 17 weeks.** **Total cost:** ≈ **$1,784**

Total cost to get a Chaos from nothing to level 8 talents: **$3150**.

**[Read the full article about Chaos Roulette cost efficiency here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/chaos-roulette-updated-for-3-1-9/)**

---

## Direct Comparison

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-66-1024x137.png)

### Key Observation

Eternal Grail costs **more than double** Chaos Roulette for existing Chaos Immortals.

---

## Conclusion Summary

- Eternal Grail averages **4.425 Grails per token**.
- Realistic average cost per token ≈ **$1.37**.
- Full Chaos Immortal (stars + talent 8) costs **~$6,660** via Grails.
- The same progression costs **~$3,150** via Chaos Roulette.
- Eternal Grail is **more than 2× as expensive** for existing Chaos Immortals.

For practical players planning long-term investment, Chaos Roulette remains the significantly more cost-efficient method for building Chaos Immortals outside of Tengu.

title: Cost efficiency obtain holy/shadow immortals: Goddesses event versus Theias
summary: When you move beyond the free rewards in seasonal events, the real comparison becomes straightforward: what does each fragment actually cost if you’re actively spending?
markdown:
## Introduction

When you move beyond the free rewards in seasonal events, the real comparison becomes straightforward: *what does each fragment actually cost if you’re actively spending?*

Theia’s Roulette gives a fixed and familiar path, while seasonal events require converting Tokens → Grails → Fragments. That extra layer makes it less intuitive, so it’s worth breaking it down step by step the same way most experienced players evaluate event efficiency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Myrahk-PO-Thumbnail-4-1024x576.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-84.png)

Let’s take a closer look at what you’re actually paying when building Holy or Shadow immortals through these two systems. On the surface, both seasonal events and Theia’s Roulette offer reliable access to fragments—but the way costs accumulate is very different.

To make a fair comparison, we’ll break both methods down into their real cost per fragment, using practical spending patterns rather than idealized assumptions. This gives a clearer picture of which path holds up better over time for players actively investing in progression.

---

## Seasonal Events — Token to Fragment Conversion

This is the core mechanic behind seasonal value. You’re not buying fragments directly—you’re buying Tokens of Light and converting them through Grails. Read more about the seasonal event **[Goddesses Celebration Festival 2026 here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/spring-fiesta/goddesses-festival-2/goddesses-celebration-festival-2026/)**. This guide goes over collecting Grails via the Token of Lights and Dazzling Wish event tab.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-85.png)

While these calculations are made using the recent seasonal event, it seems they are sticking to this event format and as such it is reasonable to assume future seasonal event will hold exact or very similar values.

Via the seasonal event shop:

- **160 Grails → 60 fragments**
→ 1 fragment = **2.667 Grails**
- **1 Token of Light = 4.325 Grails (average)**
- Final conversion:
→ **~0.616 Tokens per fragment**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-86-1024x395.png)

From a player perspective, this is the key ratio to remember. Once you know how much a token costs, you can immediately estimate your fragment price.

---

## Token Pricing Scenarios

The real cost depends on how aggressively you buy bundles. In practice, most players fall into one of two patterns: either they stick to the most efficient bundles and stop once value drops off, or they push further during events and clear out all available packs despite the worse exchange rate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-87-1024x501.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-88-1024x484.png)

### Efficient Spending (Best Bundles Only)

This assumes you only buy bundles where the exchange rate stays clean and consistent.

- $3 → 3 Tokens
- $5 → 5 Tokens

These maintain a **$1 per Token** ratio, which is the baseline for efficient spending.

Using our earlier conversion:

- **0.616 Tokens per fragment**
- → 0.616 × $1 = **$0.62 per fragment**

This is the realistic floor. Players who manage their spending carefully and avoid inflated packs will stay close to this value.

### Full Spend (Buying All Bundles)

This includes buying higher-tier bundles where the value drops off:

- $10 → 8 Tokens (~$1.25 per Token)
- $20 → 12 Tokens (~$1.67 per Token)
- $50 → 30 Tokens (~$1.67 per Token)
- $100 → 60 Tokens (~$1.67 per Token)

When averaged out across all bundles, this lands at roughly:

- **~$1.667 per Token**

Applying the same conversion:

- **0.616 Tokens per fragment**
- → 0.616 × $1.667 ≈ **$1.03 per fragment**

This reflects a more aggressive approach—typical during competitive seasons or when pushing an immortal quickly—where efficiency is traded for speed.

This distinction matters because it defines your real cost range in seasonal events. You’re not locked into a single price point—you’re choosing it through how far you go on the bundle ladder.

The real cost depends on how aggressively you buy bundles. Most players fall into one of these two patterns.

---

### Efficient Spending (Best Bundles Only)

This assumes you stick to the most cost-efficient packs and ignore inflated ones.

- **~$1 per Token**
- Cost per fragment:
→ 0.616 × $1 = **$0.62 per fragment**

In practice, this is what disciplined spenders aim for—buying out the best-value tiers daily and stopping there.

---

### Full Spend (Buying All Bundles)

This reflects players pushing harder during events and clearing all available bundles.

- **~$1.667 per Token**
- Cost per fragment:
→ 0.616 × $1.667 ≈ **$1.03 per fragment**

This is a more realistic upper bound for active spenders. Even here, the system remains relatively efficient.

---

## Theia’s Roulette — Baseline Cost

Roulette is much simpler: you’re directly converting spins into fragments, so the pricing is more transparent. To read more about pricing of the Theia's event, see in-depth **[guide here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/theias-roulette-pricing-chance-calculations-and-more-updated-nov-2025/#google_vignette)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-89-1024x512.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-90-1024x552.png)

- **Fast route (900 spins/week):**
→ **$1.52 per fragment**
- **Slow route (200 spins/week):**
→ **$1.46 per fragment**
→ ~52 weeks to complete an immortal

Most players targeting Holy/Shadow seriously will lean toward the faster route, so **$1.52** is the practical benchmark.

---

## Direct Comparison

Putting both systems side by side:

- **Seasonal (efficient bundles):** $0.62 per fragment
- **Seasonal (all bundles):** $1.03 per fragment
- **Theia (fast route):** $1.52 per fragment
- **Theia (slow route):** $1.46 per fragment

Even without factoring in free Tokens from battle pass or shops, seasonal events come out ahead. What this means in practice is that we’re comparing both systems purely on **paid input**, ignoring all the extra value players naturally accumulate during a season.

In reality, seasonal events quietly include several additional sources of Tokens of Light:

- Free battle pass track
- Paid battle pass efficiency tiers
- Event shop exchanges

These don’t show up in a strict cost calculation, but they directly reduce the number of Tokens you actually need to buy. As a result, your *effective* cost per fragment in seasonal events is often **lower than the $0.62–$1.03 range we calculated**.

By contrast, Theia’s Roulette has very limited passive value. Outside of minor event rewards, most of your fragments come directly from spins you pay for. That means its calculated cost per fragment is much closer to what you actually experience in-game.

So when you compare the two systems strictly on paper, seasonal events are already cheaper. Once you include the natural flow of free Tokens during a season, the gap widens further in practice.

---

## Player Perspective

Having run both approaches across multiple seasons, the difference shows up clearly over time.

- Seasonal events **scale better with spending**
→ Every Token consistently converts at a strong rate
- Theia’s Roulette is **steady but capped in efficiency**
→ You’re locked into its spin-to-fragment ratio
- Seasonal also has **hidden value layers**
→ Free Tokens (battle pass, shop) quietly reduce real costs further

In practice, Roulette feels smoother week-to-week, especially for slower progression. But once you start spending consistently, seasonal events overtake it in efficiency without much ambiguity.

---

## Conclusion Summary

- Seasonal conversion: **$0.62–$1.03 per fragment**
- Theia’s Roulette: **$1.46–$1.52 per fragment**

**Bottom line:**
If you’re spending with the goal of building Holy/Shadow immortals efficiently, seasonal events provide significantly better value. Theia’s Roulette remains a steady option, but it doesn’t compete on cost once you commit resources.

---

### Infinity Kingdom: Deep Dive into the Costs of Maxing the Legendary Hunter Event

The Hunting Festival 2024 brings us the Legendary Hunter event, where players can hunt beasts using two types of arrows: free arrows and gem-arrows. Gem-arrows cost 100 gems each and deal 50 points of damage, with a 25% chance to critically hit for an additional 50 damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-93-1024x540.png)

In this guide, we will explore the costs associated with maxing out the Legendary Hunter event using only gem-arrows. This will give you a clear understanding of the maximum price tag for obtaining the amazing artifact rewards offered in the event.

## Damage Calculation for Gem-Arrows

Each gem-arrow deals an average of 62.5 damage:

- Base damage: 50 points
- Critical hit chance: 25%
- Critical hit damage: 50 additional points

Average damage calculation: **Average Damage=50+(0.25×50)=62.5**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-94.png)

## Total Damage Required

The total damage required to kill all beasts in the Legendary Hunter event is 30,780 points.

| Lvl | Health Points |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 50 |
| 2 | 70 |
| 3 | 90 |
| 4 | 110 |
| 5 | 130 |
| 6 | 150 |
| 7 | 170 |
| 8 | 200 |
| 9 | 230 |
| 10 | 260 |
| 11 | 290 |
| 12 | 320 |
| 13 | 360 |
| 14 | 400 |
| 15 | 450 |
| 16 | 500 |
| 17 | 550 |
| 18 | 600 |
| 19 | 650 |
| 20 | 700 |
| 21 | 750 |
| 22 | 800 |
| 23 | 850 |
| 24 | 900 |
| 25 | 950 |
| 26 | 1000 |
| 27 | 1050 |
| 28 | 1100 |
| 29 | 1150 |
| 30 | 1200 |
| 31 | 1250 |
| 32 | 1300 |
| 33 | 1350 |
| 34 | 1400 |
| 35 | 1450 |
| 36 | 1500 |
| 37 | 1550 |
| 38 | 1600 |
| 39 | 1650 |
| 40 | 1700 |
|  | TOTAL: 30780 |

Assuming the beasts had a shared health pool, you need to achieve this damage output to max out the event. Bare in mind, that you WILL overcap on damage on multiple levels even when being careful and using Free to Play arrows to finish off the beasts.

## Number of Gem-Arrows Needed

To calculate the number of gem-arrows required: Number of Gem-Arrows = 30,780 points / 62.5 points per arrow ≈ **493 Number of Gem-Arrows**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-95-1024x485.png)

This is up quite significantly from last year. Last year, we had the HP of levels 17-40 being capped out at 550 HP. This year, that cap has been removed which means that where we had a total of 17,000 HP to shoot through in 2023 we need to get through a massive 30,800 HP in 2024! A huge increase in HP which is why the total arrow count needed this year is a whopping **493 gem-arrows** up from just 272 last year.

**[Read more about the 2023 event here if you want to compare yourself.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/spring-fiesta/hunting-festival/cost-of-maxing-legendary-hunter-with-gems/)**

## Total Gem Cost

Each gem-arrow costs 100 gems. Therefore, the total cost to max out the event using gem-arrows is:
Total Cost = 493 gem-arrows ×100 gems per arrow = **49,300 gems.**

Additionally, you need to spend **3,500 gems** to unlock the gem reward tier.

Total gem cost to max out the event: 49,300 gems + 3,500 gems = **52,800 gems.**

## Consideration of Free-to-Play Arrows

While the above calculation is based on using only gem-arrows, it's important to note that free-to-play arrows are also available. These can be obtained by killing gnomes and participating in other event activities. However, it is unlikely that you will be able to max out the event using only free arrows.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-96-1024x236.png)

For comparison, last year's Hunting Festival had a total of 17,000 HP, nearly half of this year's event, and players still couldn't complete it for free. Therefore, you should expect to spend at least 30,000-40,000 gems to complete this year's event, even with the use of free-to-play arrows.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-97-1024x483.png)

## Conclusion

Maxing out the Legendary Hunter event in the Hunting Festival 2024 using only gem-arrows will cost you a substantial amount of 52,800 gems. Given the high cost, it is essential to consider whether the rewards are worth the expenditure. While the artifact rewards are attractive, they may not provide enough value compared to what you could obtain from other in-game activities and events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-98-1024x299.png)

For most players, it may be more strategic to save gems for other opportunities and make use of free arrows to progress as far as possible in the event. Balancing your resources and spending wisely will ensure you get the most out of the game without overspending on a single event.

Happy hunting, and may your arrows fly true!

title: Countering Blade Vortex Executioner combo

markdown:
### Player Guide: Countering the Blade Vortex and Executioner Combo

The Blade Vortex and Executioner combo is currently dominating the meta in Infinity Kingdom, achieving insane damage numbers and quickly nuking down anything in its path. However, this combo has a key weakness: it relies heavily on negative effects in the form of DoTs (damage over time) plus damage amplification debuffs. This gives us a few tools to counter this devastating combo effectively. Here are some ideas and concepts to counter the Blade Vortex and Executioner meta.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-99-1024x599.png)

## Key Counters

Most of these "how to counter" guides will give you an explanation of how to render something obsolete. This however is not the case, while Athena does render this combo obsolete, she is not available for everyone and therefore most players should expect to take significant damage from the combo. However, that does not mean you must have Athena to counter. There are many more ways to get advantages against an enemy Blade Vortex + Execution combo.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-34-1024x590.png)

### 1. Theodora

Theodora is a powerful Holy Immortal healer who has been a staple in sustain Holy teams for years. Her unique ability to heal is rivaled only by her capacity to dispel damage over time effects, making her an excellent counter to Blade Vortex and the DoTs that activate Executioner.

- **Healing and Dispel**: Theodora's healing ability, combined with her capacity to remove DoTs, makes her an effective tool against this combo. By consistently dispelling these negative effects, she mitigates a significant portion of the damage output from Blade Vortex and Executioner.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-100.png)

### 2. Purification

Purification is a top-tier Tower of Knowledge skill that can activate on any Immortal, giving you a 25% chance to clear debuffs from each Immortal every cycle. While Purification alone may not be strong enough to hard counter the combo, it can still dampen the ramp-up damage from Blade Vortex and Executioner.

- **Debuff Removal**: By regularly dispelling some of the DoTs, Purification can reduce the overall damage your team receives. This makes it a useful skill to include in your strategy, especially when combined with other countermeasures.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-101.png)

### 3. Athena

Athena is an absolute beast of an S-tier Immortal and the true hard counter to the Blade Vortex and Executioner combo. Her ability to remove all negative effects from all allies consistently makes her the best counter against this combo.

- **Comprehensive Cleanse**: Athena’s ultimate ability to cleanse all negative effects from her team makes her incredibly powerful against debuff-reliant strategies like Blade Vortex and Executioner. However, Athena is a Chaos Immortal, meaning she is more challenging to obtain and upgrade.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-102.png)

## Effective Strategies

For most players, having access to Athena may not be feasible. Here’s a strategy that combines Purification and Theodora to effectively counter the Blade Vortex and Executioner combo:

### Combination of Theodora and Purification

- **Theodora + Adrenaline Rush**: Using Adrenaline Rush to activate Theodora's ultimate ability more frequently ensures that her healing and dispel capabilities are maximized. This combination helps to mitigate a significant portion of the damage from Blade Vortex and Executioner.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-103.png)

- **Purification**: Including Purification in your setup adds an additional layer of debuff removal, further reducing the impact of the DoTs and damage amplification debuffs from the combo.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-104.png)

### Conclusion

In practice, **you will still receive significant damage from the Blade Vortex and Executioner combo**, but by mitigating it effectively with Theodora and Purification, your own physical damage dealers, such as Bathory or Alexander, can ramp up and overtake the opponent's damage output, ultimately winning the fight.

By using these strategies and counters, you can effectively manage and counter the current Blade Vortex and Executioner meta, ensuring your team remains competitive and resilient in battles.

title: Countering Chaos-Holy on a budget
