markdown:
## Infinity Kingdom Build Guide: Fire Dragon Baldwin-Alexander Burst Setup

*Adapting to the meta with an unconventional but powerful burst build.*

If you’ve been watching Infinity Kingdom’s PvP meta evolve lately, you’ve probably noticed an explosion of **Holy teams** with Wukong, Apollo, and heavy support cores. Breaking through those setups as a non-whale can feel impossible.

This guide takes a look at an **off-meta, adaptable burst team** built around **Alexander and Baldwin** — using **Fire Dragon** for fast, hard-hitting engagements — and explains how to make it work.

This is **not** a “just copy this and win” build. It’s a flexible framework that adapts to what you have and what your opponents are running.

---

## Why This Build?

*Before we get too far in - **huge thanks to Hades for sharing this build**. I found this one particularly interesting and high value for players looking to fight back against whales. While you may not go toe to toe with whales using this setup, this is an important build because it allows players to greatly impact whales in group play, e.g. rallies and garrisons. We need more of those builds and therefore I want to share this Hades build with you all.*

The Infinity Kingdom meta is full of **slow-healing Holy teams**. They sustain through huge amounts of damage and grind down opponents over long fights. To counter this, you need **front-loaded burst damage** — hit them hard before their healing stabilizes.

That’s what this build does.

- **Alexander** provides single-target pressure and scales well with attack-speed boosts.
- **Baldwin** offers high burst magic damage (even after his nerf) and synergizes well with Fire Dragon.
- **YSS** provides frontline durability and energy support.
- **Qin Emperor** is the ultimate budget support: he’s cheap to build, easy to max, and provides **Battle Excitation**, making your carries start stronger.

---

## Immortal Choices & Why They Work

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-83.png)

### Frontline:

- **Alexander the Great** – **high speed-focused DPS** with flexible skill options. His artifact and talents make him one of the best single-target frontliners in the game.

### Support:

- **Qin Emperor** – Free-to-play friendly, frequent in the Market (8% appearance), and with a **level 8 specialization** he supercharges your backline with **Battle Excitation (+200 energy and +40 damage at battle start)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-87-1024x266.png)

### Backline DPS:

- **Baldwin** – Even post-nerf, Baldwin offers strong burst AoE magic damage. He benefits massively from Qin’s excitation and Fire Dragon’s burst amplification. His artifact is also now easily obtainable from selection boxes.

### Secondary Frontline/Utility:

- **Yi Sun-Shin (YSS)** – Easy to acquire fragments through the Market (Conquest only). Provides tankiness and balance to the march while helping protect your main carries.

---

## Dragon Choice: Fire

Why Fire?
This is a **burst comp** — you want to hit first and hard.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-84-1024x425.png)

Fire Dragon adds:

- **Burn DoT damage**
- **Debuffs enemy damage output**, giving you an edge in the opening.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-85-1024x455.png)

It accelerates your damage window before healers can stabilize.

---

## Skill Setup

This build thrives on **adaptability**. Here’s the core setup with some flexible slots:

### Core Skills:

- **Fighting Master** – Mandatory for anti-control (Himiko’s Realm is everywhere — without this, you lose instantly).
- **Heart of Arcana** – Boosts Baldwin’s damage output significantly.
- **Side Assist** – Sustain and durability for key Immortals.

### Flexible Slots:

- **No Escape** – Consistent energy advantage; helps you strike first.
- **Energy Suppression** – Use against spell-heavy teams.
- **Weakening Curse** – Helps against hybrid builds.
- **Fear of Domination** – Useful vs. high-sustain comps.
- **Malice** – When countering crit-based opponents.
- **Combo vs. Cleave** –  - **Combo** for single-target burst (kill Wukong, Poseidon, or frontline carries).
- **Cleave** for broader AoE when facing backline-reliant teams.
- **War Blessing** – For a front-loaded +25% burst at battle start.

This setup **changes match-to-match** depending on what you’re fighting.

---

## Performance & Reports

This march was tested against high-power players in the **780–790K range** (while the build sits at around **730K power**).

### Results:

- Consistent ability to **pressure or even kill** high-priority targets like Poseidon or Wukong.
- **Burst windows** sometimes land decisive kills before sustain kicks in.
- Even when losing, the reports show high effectiveness in damage trading against top-tier builds.

It’s important to note that this **isn’t an auto-win build**. It’s designed to give you a **chance against meta Holy comps** even when out-powered.

---

## Why Qin Emperor?

- **Free and fast to build** (appears in Market often, costs only purples).
- His **artifact is now free in Mysterium**.
- **Battle Excitation** makes your carries hit earlier and harder.
- Provides backline protection and flexible utility.

---

## Adapting to the Meta

This build changes **constantly**.

- Facing crit-heavy teams? Swap to **Malice**.
- Need more burst? Go **Weakness + War Blessing**.
- Fighting sustain-heavy Holy? Use **Energy Suppression** to slow their ultimates.

**Don’t treat this as static.** The build succeeds because it adjusts to enemy comps.

---

## TL;DR

- **Goal:** Burst down sustain-heavy Holy teams before their healing stabilizes.
- **Core:** **Alexander + Baldwin + YSS + Qin Emperor** under **Fire Dragon**.
- **Why Qin?** Cheap, strong, Battle Excitation supercharges your DPS.
- **Skills:** Fighting Master, Arcana, Side Assist + flexible damage/control slots.
- **Key Adaptation:** Swap between **Combo** or **Cleave** for Alex depending on the matchup.

---

## Final Thoughts

This build is a great example of **adapting with what you have** instead of chasing the meta. It’s **budget-friendly**, **scales with artifacts and talents**, and **offers a realistic way for mid-spenders or F2P to compete** with the dominant Holy teams.

If you want to climb in a Wukong-heavy meta but don’t have all the shiny Chaos tools, **this is a strong path forward.**

### Countering Tower of Knowledge Skills: A PvP Guide Series

PvP in Infinity Kingdom is a complex dance of immortal combinations and skill synergy. It's a world where building the right team and honing your immortals' skills can be the difference between victory and defeat. As you engage in fierce battles, it's not only about harnessing your own immortals' strengths; you must also adeptly counter the unique strengths of your adversaries. In this realm of strategic warfare, knowing how to counter specific enemy skills becomes a critical skill set.

Welcome to our guide series where we venture into the heart of PvP strategy in Infinity Kingdom. Here, we unravel the intricate tapestry of immortal combinations, skill configurations, and the tactical knowledge necessary to neutralize the formidable abilities emerging from the Tower of Knowledge. In a world where each immortal and their skills define the outcome of battles, understanding how to thwart your opponents' advantages is the ultimate path to triumph. Join us as we embark on this journey to master the art of countering Tower of Knowledge skills, skill by skill, and equip yourself to become a commanding presence in the arena of PvP combat.

## Countering Energy Regeneration Skills in Infinity Kingdom

In the dynamic world of Infinity Kingdom, mastering the art of countering enemy skills is an indispensable skill set for any commander seeking victory in PvP battles. One category of skills that often takes center stage in these confrontations is energy regeneration skills. In this guide, we will delve into the intricacies of countering energy regen skills, focusing on three specific abilities: Energy Burst, Adrenaline Rush, and Blessing of Rage. These skills enhance your immortals' energy regeneration, providing them with a significant advantage in the heat of battle.

### 1. Countering Energy Burst (EB): Nullifying the Power of Critical Hits

Energy Burst is a skill that thrives on critical hits to provide energy regeneration. It is often utilized by immortals like Hippolytta or Khubilaikhan, whose ultimate abilities involve multiple smaller damage hits. The more hits per second, the greater the chance of landing critical hits and, consequently, energy regeneration from EB.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-68.png)

To counter this skill effectively, consider the following tactics:

- **Control Effects**: Limit the enemy's opportunities to cast ultimates by using control effects such as stun, silence, or other crowd control methods. By doing so, you reduce the enemy's chance to land those critical hits and regenerate energy.
- **Dodge and Misdirection**: Skills like Misleading and After-image can enhance your dodge chance against the enemy. A physical attack cannot land a critical hit if it doesn't hit at all. These skills provide a strategic way to reduce the effectiveness of Energy Burst.
- **Energy Suppression**: This potent skill directly counters enemy energy regeneration. It is especially effective against opponents who heavily rely on energy regen.

### 2. Countering Adrenaline Rush: Disrupting Normal Hits for Energy Gain

Adrenaline Rush operates differently, relying on normal hits for a chance to activate energy regeneration.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-67.png)

Countering Adrenaline Rush involves minimizing the enemy's opportunities to hit you with normal attacks. Here are some strategies to thwart this skill:

- **Dodge and Misdirection**: Utilize skills like Misleading and After-image to increase your dodge chance against the enemy's normal attacks, which are always physical. If they can't land their hits, they can't trigger Adrenaline Rush.
- **Control Effects**: Employ stun, silence, or root effects to reduce the enemy's attack speed and limit their normal attacks. These controls play a pivotal role in diminishing the impact of Adrenaline Rush.
- **Energy Suppression**: As with Energy Burst, Energy Suppression is an excellent counter to Adrenaline Rush, especially against opponents heavily invested in energy regeneration.

### 3. Countering Blessing of Rage: Silencing the Energy Surge

Blessing of Rage poses a unique challenge as it provides energy regeneration to three immortals for the initial 12 seconds of a battle, without relying on critical hits or normal attacks.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-66.png)

To counter this effect, consider the following approaches:

- **Silence Effects**: Employ skills that silence the enemy, removing their ability to regenerate energy. Silencing disrupts Blessing of Rage's energy surge effectively.
- **Energy Suppression**: As an overarching counter to energy regeneration, Energy Suppression can counteract the effects of Blessing of Rage by limiting the enemy's ability to build energy.

In the world of Infinity Kingdom, countering energy regeneration skills is a strategic imperative. By mastering these tactics, you can mitigate your opponents' advantages and emerge as a commanding presence on the battlefield. Remember that every counter has its own strengths, and the key to success lies in choosing the right approach for each situation.

### Mastering the Art of Countering Normal Attack Damage in Infinity Kingdom

Prepare to navigate the challenges posed by high-speed normal attack immortals with this comprehensive infographic guide. Here's a quick breakdown to help you explore and maximize the information presented in this visual guide.

### Normal Attack Skills to counter

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-16.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-17.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-19.png)

First, we delve into the potent skills employed by normal attack immortals. Understanding these abilities is key to formulating an effective defense strategy.

- **Anger, Duel Master, Onslaught**: Skills that enhance normal attack damage output.
- **Wind Rage, Cleave, Berserker, Combo**: Skills used in combination with high-speed normal attacks.

### Physical Damage Mitigation

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-14.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-15.png)

Secondly, let us discover skills that specifically mitigate physical damage, countering the high normal attack immortals effectively.

- **Oaken Guard**: Offers a protective aura that reduces incoming damage.
- **Blessing of Defense**: Provides universal damage reduction, including physical attacks.
- **Physical Shield**: Additional protection against physical damage.
- **Fighting Master**: Enhances resistance to physical damage and makes the user immune to Cavalry Stun.
- **Weakness Protection**: Guards against physical damage and strengthens your immortals.
- **Void Realm**: Bolsters damage mitigation abilities.

Here you can see my hybrid Alexander against someone running Physical shield and against a similar enemy without physical protection:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-24-1024x613.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-25-1024x565.png)

It is very important that you counter with strong physical damage mitigation skills when facing an enemy like Alexander in a hybrid build.

### Control and Counterplay

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-10.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-11.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-12.png)

We can also explore control tactics and counterplay strategies to reduce the impact of high-speed normal attacks.

- **Paralysis**: Slows down enemy normal attack frequency.
- **Root**: A control skill that prevents normal attacks, countered by control immunity.
- **Fighting Will**: Enhances control through root effects.
- **Weakening Curse**: Disarms the enemy, providing high defense against physical damage.

### Dodge and Evasion: Dodging the Onslaught

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-53.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-9.png)

In this section, we explore the art of dodging physical attacks to mitigate damage.

- **Manco**: An immortal known for stacking dodge rating.
- **Misleading and After-image**: Skills that enhance dodge chance and allow you to outpace the enemy's accuracy rating.

### Toxin Barrier: Turning the Tables

Discover how to leverage the high attack speed of normal attack immortals to your advantage with the Toxin Barrier skill. Against an Immortal such as Alexander in a hyper-attack speed build, we can quickly turn the tables and use the high frequency of incomming attacks to quickly activate the high damage of Toxin Barrier back at our attacker.

### General Damage Mitigation: Universal Protection

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-75.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-77.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-56.png)

While not specific to normal attack defense, these skills offer general protection and sustenance against damage.

- **Shelter**: Provides healing upon taking hits.
- **Malice**: Guards against critical hits.
- **Healing and Shielding Effects**: General sustain and protection against damage.

With this infographic as your guide, you're equipped to craft an effective strategy to counter the onslaught of high-speed normal attack immortals in Infinity Kingdom. Learn to maximize your defenses and outsmart your adversaries as you embark on your grand adventures.

## Additional countermeasures

In addition to setting up the correct Tower of Knowledge skills builds to counter your enemy, you can also use Immortal configurations like Cid or Hippo to hard counter attack speed and normal attack damage. And you can build your artifacts towards greater physical defense. Read more about artifacts [here](http://countermeasure).

### Aura Tactics: A Comprehensive Guide to Defensive Auras in Infinity Kingdom

In the ever-changing landscape of Infinity Kingdom's battlefield, mastering the art of defensive auras is a pivotal element in constructing an impregnable team. As we explore the defensive prowess of auras, it's essential to understand when and how to deploy these strategic enhancements. This guide will delve into the specific scenarios in which each defensive aura shines, providing commanders with the knowledge needed to outmaneuver and outlast their opponents.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-136.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-137.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-140.png)

1. **Malice - The Crit Counter:**
*Scenario:* Facing a formidable fire team with a high critical hit rate.
*Strategy:* Swap into Malice to reduce the enemy's damage output, mitigating the impact of critical hits. Malice excels in sustain-focused marches aiming to withstand bursts of damage.
2. **Misleading - Elusive Tactics:**
*Scenario:* Using a wind or holy marches with naturally high dodge rates. Or facing an enemy without complete Dragon talents for accuracy. Fighting against physical damage that is not hit-capped makes dodge incredibly powerful.
*Strategy:* Combine Misleading with evasion-enhancing skills like Afterimage and Wind Protection to make critical hits challenging for opponents. Deploy this aura to ensure your immortals remain resilient and hard to defeat against physical damage teams.
3. **Paralysis - Slowing the Agile:**
*Scenario:* Battling wind-earth hybrid teams relying on high attack speed.
*Strategy:* Utilize Paralysis to disrupt the flow of battle, impairing the enemy's immortals and gaining a crucial advantage against fast-paced, agile opponents.
4. **Shelter - Against Consistent Low Damage:**
*Scenario:* Facing opponents with consistent, many instances of damage (e.g., holy teams).
*Strategy:* Deploy Shelter to provide additional protection, ensuring your immortals remain resilient and can withstand prolonged assaults from enemies with sustained, but less impactful, damage.
5. **Berserk - Amplifying Attackers:**
*Scenario:* You are using marches with numerous immortals relying on normal attacks (e.g., Alex and Hannibal).
*Strategy:* Activate Berserk to boost the damage output of your immortals, transforming them into relentless attackers capable of swiftly dealing with opponents relying on normal attacks while gaining a surprisingly high rate of healing from Berserk cementing your defensive position.
6. **Spring of Life - Sustained Healing:**
*Scenario:* Assigning auras to heroes like Theodora and Zenobia.
*Strategy:* Combine Spring of Life with other healing skills to ensure continuous healing for your immortals, allowing them to endure longer and maintain their combat effectiveness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-139.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-141.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-142.png)

**Conclusion**:

In the strategic realm of Infinity Kingdom, the key to victory lies in understanding the nuances of defensive auras. Each aura is a specialized tool, and commanders must tailor their choices to counter specific threats. By analyzing the strengths and weaknesses of your opponents and strategically selecting defensive auras, you'll be better equipped to lead your immortals to triumph on the battlefield. So, commanders, consider the battlefield context, choose your auras wisely, and let your strategic prowess shine in the world of Infinity Kingdom!

markdown:
### Unveiling the Unconventional: A Remarkably Effective Water Build in Infinity Kingdom

In the vast realm of Infinity Kingdom, where strategy and tactics reign supreme, players are constantly seeking innovative ways to gain the upper hand. Among the countless builds and strategies that have emerged, one stands out as a shining example of the unexpected: a peculiar water build that defies conventional wisdom and delivers astonishing results. As an avid player with 845 days of experience, I can confidently say that this build is one of the most intriguing, fun, and effective strategies I have ever encountered in the game.

**You must place Richard in front of the enemy Alexander and then sit back and enjoy seeing earth melt on your water build! Amazing build for all of you water mains who need a counter to strong earth setups. In particular, this build is amazing for younger servers where pute earth dominates the rankings. If you cannot go lightning Khan or join the earth horde - then kill them with this instead!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-105-1024x472.png)

Imagine diving into uncharted waters, where the rules of engagement are rewritten and the familiar tropes are shattered. This unique water build challenges the norms, offering a fresh perspective that will leave you both surprised and delighted. It proves that in the ever-evolving world of Infinity Kingdom, there is always room for innovation and experimentation. **All in all it's one of the most powerful cheap and interesting setups i've ever seen and I am super hyped to share it with you all!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-106-1024x472.png)

What makes this water build truly exceptional is its surprising effectiveness. While it may seem strange and unconventional at first glance, the combination of different Immortals in this build showcases an unexpected synergy that catches opponents off guard. The tide turns in your favor as you witness the remarkable power of this unorthodox strategy, surpassing expectations and achieving victories that defy conventional wisdom. We are used to builds that reap the benefits of elemental synergy buffs. In this setup, we have only two parts water and as such we do not even get the 3/5 elemental boost, despite most of us thinking 'you can't run something without elemental bonuses' this setup truely defies that with quite extraordinary results.

Beyond its impressive performance, what truly sets this build apart is the sheer joy and fascination it brings to the game. Playing with this unconventional strategy breathes new life into your gaming experience, offering an engaging and entertaining approach that keeps you on the edge of your seat. It's a testament to the boundless creativity and endless possibilities that Infinity Kingdom has to offer. Huge respect to Deej from server 73 BUNS who came up with the crazy cool build!

## The build setup

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-107-1024x472.png)

For Merlin we have a very standard setup. **Concentration + Annihilation + Death Breath** is a very run of the mill build for Merlin that will always secure impressive performance from our master damage dealer Merlin.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-108-1024x472.png)

For Emperor Qin we have **Berserk + Assist + Fighting Master**. Basically, Qin becomes a wounds and attack speed vending machine. He functions very well in this role and has huge synergies with Hannibal Barca (especially if you obtain his Unique Artifact). Moreover, because we are only interested in attack speed buffs and wounds from Qin we can comfortably run assist on him and allow his troop count to be nuked instead of Merlin's.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-109-1024x472.png)

For Hannibal Barca we have a pretty standard cleave - attack speed setup: **Anger + Combo + Cleave**. It is clear that we are relying on the attack speed buffs from Qin and from a powerful Hannibal Unique Artifact to make this build work. I would argue that he can be replaced 1:1 with Alex if you are in a situation where you have high level Alex unique but not Hannibal.

However, with this build setup it is clear that this is an extreemly powerful build that costs you almost nothing to run if you are in a younger server and you have had the chance to obtain free or cheap Hannibal Barca unique artifacts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-110-1024x472.png)

Last up we have Richard. A surprising choice of Immortal for me personally, but also a very underrated Immortal. Richard's stun is very powerful and he performs the role of tank quite well too. In this build we are running: **Misleading + Life Link + Oaken Guard**. Playing on our enemies being non hit-capped will work very well until you reach the 400k+ threshold giving huge defensive value to misleading. Moreover, Life Link is an amazing tower of knowledge skill mitigating damage and even turning a tanky Richard into a thorns-damage-dealer. Lastly, Oaken guard is just solid solid solid and a must have in the current physical damage meta.

For the Dragon this team wants to get the control from the water Dragon in combination with Richard stuns to take control of the battlefield. To further the control this team wields we use the energy regen dragon specialization, effectively removing the energy regen of up to 3 enemy Immortals while Frozen. A very powerful control mechanic.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-111.png)

Moreover, you want the healing from the water dragon to keep your troop count up. This does leave you vulnerable to wounds, but if your enemy does not have access to wounds you get a nice and healthy boost from the added healing over time from the dragon specialization talents.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-112.png)

## Results

This team makes cheap / free water mains able to kill even earths at much higher levels! It overperforms greatly and provides a very fun an different way of winning against much bigger opponents. Overall a very impressive build that I am super hyped to see work so well!

You must place Richard in front of the enemy Alexander and then sit back and enjoy seeing earth melt on your water build! Amazing build for all of you water mains who need a counter to strong earth setups. In particular, this build is amazing for younger servers where pute earth dominates the rankings. If you cannot go lightning Khan or join the earth horde - then kill them with this instead!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-105-1024x472.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/image-106-1024x472.png)

## Conclusion

As you embark on your journey through the realms of Infinity Kingdom, don't shy away from exploring the uncharted territories of strategy. The waters hold secrets and surprises, and this peculiar water build stands as a shining example of the unconventional paths that can lead to unexpected triumphs. Join me as we dive into the depths of this extraordinary strategy, unlocking its potential and reveling in the excitement it brings. Prepare to be amazed, intrigued, and thoroughly entertained by one of the most unique and captivating builds ever witnessed in the 845 days of Infinity Kingdom gameplay.

## Introduction

Infinity Kingdom’s creator events have quietly become some of the most enjoyable community-driven content the game offers, and this latest **[Creator Frame Design](https://discord.gg/JDfx7Tpvr8)** theme is a strong example of why.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-118-1024x572.png)

What started as a niche creative challenge has now grown into something much larger. The first frame event already produced a surprising number of high-quality entries, but this second iteration has clearly reached a wider audience. The difference is immediately noticeable: more participants, more experimentation, and a much higher overall level of polish.

Even if you have no intention of submitting a design yourself, this is one of those events worth paying attention to purely for the creativity on display.

---

## What Is the Creator Frame Design Event?

The **Creator Frame Design** event is a community art competition where players design a custom in-game frame that represents Infinity Kingdom creators.

### Core Concept

Participants are asked to design a frame that combines two key elements:

- **Infinity Kingdom identity** (immortals, dragons, elements, or overall game aesthetic)
- **Creator identity** (community contribution, creativity, influence, or expression)

The goal is not just to decorate a frame, but to create something that feels like a natural extension of the game’s visual style while also representing creators within the community.

### Design Rules

- The design must be **original**
- Any tools are allowed, including **Photoshop, AI-assisted tools, or other media software**
- The final result should function as a **frame usable in-game**, meaning readability and structure matter as much as artistic detail

---

## How to Join and Submit

### Participation Process

1. Create your frame design following the event requirements
2. Submit your work in the designated **Discord channel**
3. Follow the submission format outlined in the event post

***[Link to the channel here](https://discord.gg/JDfx7Tpvr8)***

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-119-703x1024.png)

### Important Notes

- Submissions are handled **entirely through Discord**
- Visibility within the channel can influence feedback and iteration
- The event runs **until April 6**, so timing your submission can matter

---

## Rewards and Incentives

The event offers both **competitive rewards** and **participation-based incentives**, which is an important distinction.

### Main Reward

- The **winning design** will be selected by the official team
- That design becomes the **official Creator Frame**
- The creator receives the frame directly as recognition

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-120.png)

### Participation Rewards

- **All participants** receive in-game item rewards
- Players who take part in **3 creator theme contests** earn the Creator Frame as a **long-term honor reward**

This structure makes the event accessible even if you are not aiming to win outright.

---

## Why This Event Is Worth Your Time

There are two very different reasons to engage with this event, and both are valid.

### 1. If You Want to Compete

This is one of the few opportunities to have your design permanently represented in-game.

From past events, the strongest entries tend to:

- Focus on **clear, readable shapes** rather than excessive detail
- Use IK elements in a way that feels **intentional, not decorative**
- Maintain visual clarity at **small UI scale**

### 2. If You Just Want to Explore the Community

Even without submitting anything, simply browsing the Discord channel is worth it.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-121.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-123.png)

You will find:

- **Surprisingly creative interpretations** of the theme
- Some entries that are genuinely **high-end, professional-quality work**
- Others that lean more into humor, which adds a lot of personality to the event

It’s a rare mix—serious design work alongside lighthearted experimentation—and that balance is part of what makes the event stand out.

---

## Player Perspective

From experience with previous creator events, the real value here goes beyond rewards. These competitions tend to reveal how players actually interpret Infinity Kingdom’s identity.

For instance, in the last frame event, some of the most memorable designs weren’t the most complex—they were the ones that immediately communicated a clear idea when scaled down. That same principle will likely apply again here.

If you’re participating, it’s worth thinking less about making something impressive at full resolution and more about how it reads in-game. If you’re just observing, this is one of the best windows into the creative side of the IK community.

---

## Conclusion Summary

The **「Creator Frame Design」** event is both a competition and a showcase. It offers meaningful rewards, but more importantly, it highlights the creativity of the player base at a level you don’t often see in regular gameplay.

Whether you plan to submit a design or simply browse the entries, it’s well worth engaging with. At minimum, you’ll come away with a better sense of how players interpret the game—and at best, you might find inspiration to join in yourself.

Every Infinity Kingdom player has experienced this moment. You might be farming resources, doing your daily grind, or preparing to log off when the alliance notification appears: **“ASSEMBLE NOW.”**

title: Crimson Moonlight on sale
summary: Alright, let's dive into the world of Infinity Kingdom and particularly focus on the Deep Sea Merchant and the Crimson Moonlight. Imagine this like a casual chat between friends who are both passionate about the game.
markdown:
Alright, let's dive into the world of Infinity Kingdom and particularly focus on the Deep Sea Merchant and the Crimson Moonlight. Imagine this like a casual chat between friends who are both passionate about the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-85.png)

### Introduction

So, the Deep Sea Eye Merchant in Infinity Kingdom is this cool feature that rolls around every weekend. It's like a special event where you can get your hands on exclusive items like Crimson Moonlight, Stardust, and more. The catch? It's only there from Saturday to Monday each weekend, and the prices for items go up with each purchase.

### What is Crimson Moonlight and Why is it Important?

Crimson Moonlight is this super important item for leveling up the portraits of Chaos immortals. Think of it as a key to boosting your immortals' powers and making them more formidable. It's one of the main attractions at the Deep Sea Merchant, and players often aim to snag it whenever they can.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-86.png)

### Cost of Crimson Moonlight at the Deep Sea Merchant

Here's where it gets interesting. The merchant sells Crimson Moonlight in sets of four. The starting price is 1,600 gems per set, but this increases exponentially, reaching up to 6,000 gems for the last set. **If you're planning to buy all ten sets available each weekend, it'll cost you a total of 32,400 gems** **for a total 40x Crimson Moonlights**. That's a hefty price, but considering it's one of the few ways to get Crimson Moonlight in-game without resorting to the Pinball event, it might be worth it for serious players. Just remember, the cost almost triples from the fifth to the tenth set, so plan your purchases carefully.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-87.png)

### Conclusion

Crimson Moonlight and Stardust are like the crown jewels at the Deep Sea Merchant. They're crucial for leveling up your immortals but come at a premium. The trick is to balance what you need versus what you can afford. And since the merchant visits every weekend, there's always another chance to stock up, so no need to blow all your gems in one go. Remember, patience can be a strategy too!

And that's pretty much the lowdown on the Deep Sea Merchant and the coveted Crimson Moonlight in Infinity Kingdom. Keep an eye on your gem count and happy gaming!

title: Cyrus Fire as your second/third march
summary: This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE…
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

This article is on fire as a third march. Why did I choose fire for my very first guide on building a third team you might ask? Because fire is a strong element viable as mains and very powerful as seconds and third!

**Fire has the bonuses of being:**
(1) **Free to play** (even at endgame!)
(2) **Dragon breath has very high damage**, meaning you will ALWAYS make a big dent in your opponent - even if your march itself is rubbish
(3) Fire dragon boost fire **Immortal damage based on buffs**, which means all of those blessings and boons we are not using in our main and even in our seconds synergize perfectly with the fire dragon.

This build perform well versus shadow as long as your Wu dosen't get hit my the shadow dragons attacks. However, it looses big time to holy! It also has a hard time nuking through proper earth setups, but is otherwise a very good and solid build.

Can be altered to include Khan-fire (see guide) if you are having issues with earths and holys.

## Setup

In a second/third march, you don't have very many juicy passives left to choose from. Moreover, not everyones main builds are going to be the same, so small deviations may occur. What we can say for sure is that you will never have BiS passives such as Weakness, Malice, Death Breath, Assist, etc. left for a third march.

In this guide I will show you a very well crafted build by a player relying on earth as his main march (Zeno-Cleo-Charles-Alex) and Lightning as his second (Khan-Bath-Peter-Richard). This means he has spent most all of the best physical passives, auras as well as anihilation and chase in his main team.

But by relying on the power of fire-buffs and because he wisely choose to run a physical backline for lightning (freeing up magic passives for Wu), we can run the following:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Skaermbillede-2022-05-10-212606.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Skaermbillede-2022-05-10-212558.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Skaermbillede-2022-05-10-212549.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Skaermbillede-2022-05-10-212535.png)

### You want to run this passive loadout:

**Empress Wu**: Fire Nova + Toxic Nova + Concentration

**Cyrus**: Blessing of Defense + Blessing of War + Sacrifice

**William**: Fighting Will + Paralysis + Garrote

**Hippolyta**: Fighting Master + Combo + Flame Protection

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-16-1024x362.png)

What if I don't have all of these free? If you are e.g. running Fighting will in your main or second, or relying on a nova for chase procs on your main. You might not have these available. Try and aim at something similar, but you can always swap in these as strong alternatives for this setup:

- Speed Blessing
- Blessing of rage
- Resist
- Oaken Guard
- Root
- Silence

title: Darius Lightning Build (2.6.3)
summary: Prepare to electrify the battlefield with a lightning-themed build in Infinity Kingdom. This guide will walk you through the intricacies of creating a potent lineup that revolves around Immortals Genghis Khan…
markdown:
### Unleashing the Thunder: Lightning Build Guide in Infinity Kingdom

Prepare to electrify the battlefield with a lightning-themed build in Infinity Kingdom. This guide will walk you through the intricacies of creating a potent lineup that revolves around Immortals Genghis Khan, Hammurabi, Darius, and Tokugawa/Bjorn.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-91.png)

With a focus on delivering quick wounds from Khan and enhancing the damage output of Darius and Hammurabi, this build is a versatile powerhouse that excels against Earth and hybrid builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-89.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-79.png)

It also holds its ground against Holy builds and serves as a strong all-around option for both mid-game and end-game content.

## Build Composition

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-87-1024x559.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-86-1024x581.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-92-1024x569.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-84.png)

1. **Hammurabi (Damage Dealer):** Equip Hammurabi with skills that amplify his damage potential. Consider using Spell Disintegration, Concentration, and Annihilation. This setup ensures he unleashes devastating area-of-effect damage.
2. **Genghis Khan (Wound Inflictor and Burst Damage):** Khan's role is to inflict wounds swiftly on the enemy while delivering a significant first-attack burst before his troop count decreases. Utilize skills like Fighting Master, Adrenaline Rush for fast wound infliction. You can also opt for the Assist skill if you have Guard for frontline support. Or you can boost his damage with Anger.
3. **Tokugawa/Bjorn (Support and Utility):** Tokugawa or Bjorn serves as a versatile utility Immortal, adapting to your specific enemy composition. As a baseline, skills like Weakness, Defense Blessing, Oaken Guard, and Resist are potent choices. However, you can also incorporate newer defensive skills like Energy Shield, Weakening Curse, or Siren's Gaze based on the meta in your server. The key is to mitigate the damage type dealt by your primary adversaries. If you have Guard, pairing it with Void Realm provides optimal protection for Darius, especially if Khan is running Assist.
4. **Darius (Damage Dealer):** Focus on maximizing Darius's damage output. Select skills such as Anger, Desire of Life, and Toxin Barrier. This combination empowers him to deliver substantial area-of-effect damage. If the need arises for more defense, consider replacing Desire of Life or Toxin Barrier with skills like Physical Shield, adjusting your build to counter the specific enemy you face.

**Results and Strategies:**
The results of this lightning-themed build are nothing short of remarkable. Darius shines as a damage dealer, while the combination of Fighting Master and Adrenaline Rush on Khan ensures immunity to control effects and rapid energy regeneration. This synergy leads to swift wound infliction on your enemies.

With a substantial troop count, both Hammurabi and Darius emerge as top-tier damage dealers in the game. However, it's vital to address their vulnerability, as they can be relatively squishy and susceptible to enemy damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-90.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-88.png)

To enhance the longevity of Hammurabi and Darius on the battlefield, consider further support from Tokugawa or Bjorn, with an emphasis on defense and crowd control skills to deter enemy threats. This lightning build's adaptability to counter the most prominent threats in your server's meta, such as Earth and hybrid builds, ensures its effectiveness in various scenarios.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-93.png)

In summary, the lightning-themed build featuring Genghis Khan, Hammurabi, Darius, and Tokugawa/Bjorn is a powerhouse that combines rapid wound infliction, massive area-of-effect damage, and adaptability to counter diverse enemy compositions. Mastering this build will undoubtedly make you a formidable force in the Infinity Kingdom battlefield. Electrify your foes and emerge victorious!

title: Dark Fortress
summary: Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.

In this article we shall look to one of the coolest and most sought after skins of**Infinity Kingdom: Dark Fortress**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-13.png)

## What does Dark Fortress Sovereign do?

Every castle skin has unique beneficial effects, from building speed to rss gathering and troop HP. The Dark Fortress castle skin provides a **5% boost to Dragon Upgrade Speed** and **5% Gold Production Speed**of Dwellings. This is an amazing castle skin effect and one that makes this skin the third best skin effect of all skins in my opinion. As you are growing and developing your marches your dragon is one of the few things in Infinity Kingdom that truely takes an extreem amounts of time. Getting three dragons to level 50 requires an incredible amount of speed ups and as such a 5% speed buff makes a huge difference!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-14.png)

Moreover, as you grow your dragon you will quickly run out of gold. Dragon upgrades require vast amounts of gold and as such boosting your dwellings production rate (primary gold income unless you comfortably farm infernals) is a big big buff.

In fact, I know I just said this is the third best skin. If your goal is simply growth and you are not near the level 50 cap at the moment, then this castle skin is the absolute best skin. It drops off later on however, as you will finish your dragon levels well before you ever complete your technology. As such I rank the tech-skin Night Phantoms above this one. Also, this is not a combat buff and we have to rank the combat buff actually making your armies stronger than otherwise possible as the number one, hence The Great Celebration skin is unrivaled rank one.

This being said, as you grow you want to have this skin! The best growth buffs you can get are technology, dragon and buildings (in that order).

## Troop cosmetic effect

This castle skin is one of only three skins that provide cosmetic skin effects for your troops as they march across the fields of Norheim and Frostborne.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-15.png)

## How to get it?

There is only one way to obtain this skin**: VIP level 15**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-16-1024x563.png)

There is only one way of obtaining this skin and that is getting to rank 15 VIP. You are going to have a rough time obtaining the required 1million VIP points to get here as a F2P. Spenders are going to get there eventually at which point you want to prioritize purchasing this box. The skin is simply very good value and something that I recommend you spend on if you are a spender. As a F2P you should not even try to get here. Spending 1 million gems on this is A LOT and you will still need to spend real money purchasing the Exalted Chest.

But if you do decide that you want to grind out the gems for free and get to VIP 15, consider this being your only purchase - money well spent.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-17-1024x403.png)

If you do make it to rank 15 the Dark Fortress Castle skin is available along with the shadow dragon egg in the very last VIP unique bundle to be purchased at a price of 99$.

## Golden Path

This skin is NOT available in the golden path rotation. **[Check out my article here to read more about the Castle skins offered via Golden Path as well as the full rotation](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/market/golden-path/)**.

title: Dead Castle Farming
summary: As we know, Alts help us to get honor, but more importantly it helps us get extra resources for our mains. In the past, many players tell me it is recommended to send marches out to farm for resources at nodes so that…
markdown:
As we know, Alts help us to get honor, but more importantly it helps us get extra resources for our mains. In the past, many players tell me it is recommended to send marches out to farm for resources at nodes so that those extra rss that are not protected could be stolen with our main Castle. Issue with this is that we got to wait for them to be red and it takes time since alts may use those RSS for buildings. Surely there is a better way!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-76.png)

And there is! What we should do is to use our AP to add to the amount of resources our alts are farming to be used to level up the rss production buildings (Farm, Quarry etc). Then those produced by the production building can be taken by the main.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-77.png)

## What is a "dead castle"?

A Dead Castle is the Castle of a player who is no longer playing the game. As such, the Castle is "dead" because there is no player activity anymore. What remain are the resource buildings (quarries, farms, lumbers and smelters) which continues to produce resource even though there is no one to collect them (no one logs in).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-82.png)

You can often spot dead castles by the fact that their Alliance tag has been removed (they have been kicked for inactivity). Moreover, any healthy server will have a list of active alliances which you can use to distinguish between a "dead" castle and a "live" castle.

## Base routine for farming maximum resources is

### 1. Spend all of your AP attacking dead castles around the map

**2. March send collect nodes** and log off while you wait for warehouse to be red (can't protect)

**3. Collect Alliance Resources** (this is not "protected rss" and can be farmed)

### 4. Focus on maxing out rss production building

Another cool/obvious thing is to stay at Castle level 39 first to receive boost for faster building speed and make all the production building to level 39.

## Most of the efficiency is from dead castle farming

There are always a ton of castles around the map of Norheim from players who has left the game long ago. Even in dense populated servers, you have dead castles to farm. When you are farming with your alts**, you should not spend a lot of time to** find the highest of the high level castles for efficient max reward attacks.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-78.png)

Instead, you want to run as many alts as you can at the same time in multiple instances (Gtarcade Desktop or Bluestacks). Scan the map and send our whenever you see someone at a half-decent level. Getting smaller hits in on dead castles is totally fine, since you don't need to be super efficient about your AP-spending, it is just important that you convert all your AP into resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-53-1024x574.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/alts-1024x608.png)

Naturally, the bigger dead castles you can find the better. But it is not worth the time to spend minutes on finding the perfect castle. Just send out marches enmass and make a new alt with the time it would have taken you to find the perfect farm target ;)

**Many small attacks make for a nice big pile of resources either way!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-79.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-81.png)

## Credit

*Special thank you and credit to player: Thunderhood for sharing his ideas which inspired this guide.*

### Death Breath: A Comprehensive Player Guide

In the expansive realm of the Tower of Knowledge, few skills shine as brightly as Death Breath. This skill is not just freely accessible to all players but stands as a titan among its peers for its enduring efficacy. From the onset of your journey to the zenith of late-game mastery, Death Breath remains a formidable force, thanks to its versatility and potent damage output.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-16-1024x599.png)

**Skill Mechanics:** *"Death Breath has a 100% chance to every 6 seconds, causes Physical Damage (75%) to all enemy units and Magical Damage (75%) once"*. Death Breath distinguishes itself by delivering numerous smaller hits, which collectively amount to substantial damage over time. This method of damage application makes it uniquely effective and a cornerstone for various skill combinations.

**Why Death Breath?** The brilliance of Death Breath lies in its multiplicity of strengths:

- **High Damage Output:** As expected of a damage-oriented skill, it excels in delivering significant DPS. This trait is fundamental in any combat scenario, making Death Breath a must-have in your arsenal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-17-1024x590.png)

- **Synergistic Potential:** Its capacity to unleash many smaller hits makes it the perfect candidate for synergy with other Tower of Knowledge skills. For example, in a fire-themed setup, Death Breath can activate proc-based skills like Energy Burst and Chase with exceptional efficiency, elevating your overall combat strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-18-1024x556.png)

- **Unmatched Versatility:** Death Breath is unparalleled in its ability to complement both physical and magical damage dealers. This dual compatibility ensures that it remains relevant and effective across various game stages and team compositions.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-19.png)

**Strategic Applications:** Death Breath's utility extends to diverse combat strategies, enhancing both physical and magical builds:

- **Physical Damage Synergy:** When paired with characters like Hippo or Khubilai Khan, Death Breath can amplify energy regeneration through the Energy Burst skill, given that a weakness aura is also integrated into the build. This combination ensures rapid energy gain and a barrage of critical hits, maximizing physical damage output.
- **Magical Damage Enhancement:** Utilizing Death Breath with Empress Wu can significantly boost burst damage by activating the Chase skill through consistent critical hits. This synergy not only escalates magical damage but also increases the frequency of Chase activations, making for a devastating impact in battle.

**Acquisition:** Remarkably, Death Breath is available to all players without cost, embodying the game's commitment to providing powerful tools that are accessible to everyone. Located within the Tower of Knowledge, it stands as a testament to the game's balanced approach to player progression and skill diversity.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-20-1024x603.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-18-1024x556.png)

**Conclusion:** Death Breath's enduring prominence within the game is a testament to its exceptional design, offering a blend of high damage, strategic synergy, and unparalleled versatility. Its status as a freely available skill further underscores its value, ensuring that all players have access to this powerful asset from the early stages to the pinnacle of their gaming experience. Whether you're orchestrating a physical onslaught or a magical barrage, incorporating Death Breath into your strategy can significantly enhance your combat effectiveness, making it a cornerstone skill for any player aiming for dominance in the Tower of Knowledge.
