title: Dragon Talent builds
summary: Must-Have Dragon Upgrade Talent Setup: Speed, Gold, and Long-Term Efficiency
markdown:
## Introduction

***Must-Have Dragon Upgrade Talent Setup: Speed, Gold, and Long-Term Efficiency***

Dragon progression is one of the slowest and most expensive systems in Infinity Kingdom. Unlike immortals, where EXP gains can be accelerated aggressively, dragons are constrained by **very long upgrade timers**, **massive gold costs**, and **fragment-heavy domestication requirements**.

At higher levels, a single dragon upgrade can take **weeks** and cost **50–60 million gold**. At that scale, even modest-looking percentage bonuses translate into enormous real value. For that reason, every serious account should reserve **one of their three talent pages** for dragon-related efficiency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-163-1024x150.png)

These talents do not need to exist in isolation. In practice, dragon talents fit very cleanly into:

- Resource collection + gnome boss farming pages (what I personally use)
- Daily gnome camp and EXP farming routines

**[Read more here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/leveling-and-daily-routine-talent-builds/)**

The key is not *which* page you merge them into, but that you **always activate the correct talents before interacting with dragon systems**.

---

## Core Principle: Dragons Punish Inefficiency

Dragon upgrades punish two mistakes more than almost any other system:

1. Starting upgrades without cost or speed talents active
2. Farming dragon fragments without AP efficiency and beginning dragon crystal chest unlocks without speed optimization

Because upgrades are something you want to be running 24/7 with no downtime at all, correcting these mistakes early and getting all the speed and cost advantages you can as early in your playthrough as possible will make a big difference! Efficiency is not felt immediately, but you will feel it eventually when you outperform your peers!

---

### Dragon Trainer – Upgrade Speed

Dragon upgrades can approach a month in duration. Any reduction to that timer compounds dramatically across multiple levels and across multiple dragons.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-164.png)

Always activate Dragon Trainer before starting:

- Dragon level upgrades
- Long upgrade chains where you queue progress back-to-back

This is one of those talents that does not feel impactful immediately—but months later, optimized accounts are simply further ahead.

---

## Mandatory Talents for Dragon Upgrading

### Dragon’s Treasure – Gold Cost Reduction

Dragon upgrades at higher levels routinely cost 50–60 million gold. A **5% reduction** at that point is not a convenience—it is several million gold saved *per upgrade*.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-165.png)

This talent should **always** be active before:

- Starting a new dragon level
- Pushing multiple levels in succession

Over the lifetime of a dragon, this single talent saves an enormous amount of **[gold](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/gold-talents/)**that can instead be funneled into technology, troops, or equipment.

---

## Farming Dragon Soul Fragments: Domestication Efficiency

Upgrading dragon domestication abilities requires a steady inflow of **[Dragon Soul Fragments](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-soul-fragments-crystals/obtain-dragon-soul-crystals/)**, which primarily come from gnome bosses and dragon chests. This makes AP efficiency and chest timing critical.

---

### Effortless – Free Gnome Boss Attacks

Gnome boss farming is extremely AP-intensive, especially at higher levels where fragment rewards scale meaningfully.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-166-1024x423.png)

Effortless removes AP cost entirely for boss attacks. This is one of the strongest dragon-related talents in the game because it converts:

- AP → fragments
- Limited daily stamina → free progression

If you actively farm gnome bosses, this talent is mandatory.

---

### Seize the Day – Chest Opening Efficiency

Dragon chests are another quiet bottleneck. Seize the Day reduces chest opening time, which becomes especially powerful if you actively manage your chests instead of passively waiting.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-167.png)

Seize the Day is simply a good talent for any active player who opens chests regularly rather than letting timers idle. For max efficiency, run this! That being said, this is only value if you are active enough to consistently begin a new cook every time your current one is done.

---

## How to Structure Your Dragon Talent Page

Dragon talents do not require a full page on their own. In fact, they integrate very naturally into existing efficiency builds.

Two common approaches work well:

### Option 1: Merge With Resource Collection + Gnome Boss Farming

- Ideal if you farm bosses regularly
- Keeps Effortless and Seize the Day active during fragment sessions
- Natural place for Dragon’s Treasure and Dragon Trainer

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-168.png)

This is the setup I personally use, as it minimizes swaps and keeps dragon progression constantly optimized.

---

### Option 2: Merge With Daily Gnome Camp / EXP Routine

- Useful if you batch dragon interactions during daily resets
- Allows you to stack EXP farming, boss farming, and dragon prep together
- Requires more intentional timing but works just as well

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-169.png)

Both approaches are valid—the important thing is consistency.

The most important thing here, is that you make sure to have each of the best talents in your 1 and 2 talent page. One of them should be technology boost talents and the other one dragon boost talents. Then fit in the remaining talents so you get two different sets. In either tech or dragon run EXP talents (if you need EXP), run Divine Walker in one and run Safe and Sound in the other, run Economics Expert in one and Gift of Piety in the other, etc.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-172.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-171.png)

---

## Player Perspective: Why Dragon Talents Matter More Than They Look

Dragon progression is deceptive. Because upgrades are so long, players often forget which talents were active when they started them. Weeks later, the inefficiency is already locked in.

From long-term experience, dragon optimization is one of the biggest hidden gaps between accounts that *feel* similar in power but progress at very different rates over time.

If you ever look at another player and wonder why their dragons seem inexplicably ahead, the answer is usually not spending—it is habit.

---

## Conclusion Summary

- Dragon upgrades are slow, expensive, and unforgiving.
- **Every account should reserve one talent page for dragon efficiency.**
- Always activate:  - **Dragon’s Treasure** before spending gold
- **Dragon Trainer** before starting upgrades
- For domestication farming:  - **Effortless** is mandatory for AP efficiency
- **Seize the Day** maximizes chest value
- Dragon talents should be **merged into an existing efficiency page**, not isolated.

Handled correctly, dragon talents do not just save time and gold—they determine how far ahead your account will be six months from now.

---

title: Dragon Talents: Major and Minor Nodes
summary: In this guide we are going to look deeper into the Dragon Talents trees. Players tend to focus on the Unique Skill Upgrades that are in these trees, but there are hidden gems which are actually more powerful than the…
markdown:
In this guide we are going to look deeper into the Dragon Talents trees. Players tend to focus on the Unique Skill Upgrades that are in these trees, but there are hidden gems which are actually more powerful than the unique flashy skill nodes!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-66.png)

## Unique nodes

You have Prime nodes which are determined by your specialization. For instance, I have chosen Fissure for my earth dragon in these images. As such, my Dragon's talent tree is populated by Sandstorm Breath and Earth Roar Prime nodes.

These nodes are on the outskirts of your talent tree. **There are 10 ranks to each of the new Prime Specialization Abilities**. See images below.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-69.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-160507.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-71.png)

These are unlocked my spending **Dragon Elemental Crystals** (like we are used to). [These can be obtained from gnome bosses (**read more**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-soul-fragments-crystals/obtain-dragon-soul-crystals/)).

Furthermore, you need to spend**Dragon Essences** to unlock each new rank of your specialization ability. [These can be obtained in various ways (**read more**).](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/dragon-essences-how-to-get-them/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-72.png)

## Major nodes

There are **four types of major nodes** on the talent tree. These are located opposite your Prime nodes, meaning you have to fill out your talent tree to reach both Prime nodes and Major nodes.

These nodes are:

1. **Claws**: Increases damage dealth by 1%
2. **Robust**:Increases Resilience rate by 1%
3. **Armor**: Reduces damage taken by 1%
4. **Gaze**: Increases accuracy rate by 1%

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-70.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161218.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161208.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161202.png)

## Minor nodes

There are 6 types of minor nodes around the Dragon Talent Tree. These minor nodes have stat increases to your Immortals physical, magical damage and defense as well as resiliance and accuracy bonuses.

They each have **3 levels**which are unlocked with normal Dragon Crystals of the corresponding element type (from gnome bosses).

1. **Physical Attack**: Increases physical attack by 30/60/90.
2. **Physical Defense**: Increases physical defense by 30/60/90.
3. **Magical Attack**:Increases magical attack by 30/60/90.
4. **Magical Defense**: Increases magical defense by 30/60/90.
5. **Resiliance**: Increases resiliance by 30/60/90.
6. **Accuracy**: Increases accuracy by 30/60/90.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161641.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161611.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161554.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161539.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161532.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-161526.png)

### Dragon Portrait Levels vs. Dragon Talent Tree: A Strategic Guide

One of the common dilemmas players face in the game is whether to prioritize upgrading Dragon Portrait levels or Dragon Talent Tree. The decision is not always straightforward, and it often depends on your current progress in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Red-Blue-Illustrative-Game-Versus-Youtube-Thumbnail-1024x576.png)

In this guide, we'll explore the factors that influence this choice and provide recommendations on when to transition between these two essential aspects of your dragon's development.

## It Depends on Your Progress

The choice between upgrading Dragon Portrait levels and Dragon Talent Tree is highly dependent on your current status in the game. Let's break down the key considerations:

### 1. Portrait Level Costs

Dragon Portrait levels come with an array of attribute bonuses, which can significantly enhance your dragon's power. However, it's important to note that as you progress through portrait levels, the costs increase rapidly. At some point, you'll find yourself spending thousands of crystals for relatively small stat upgrades.

| 2 | 32 | 40 |
| 3 | 47 | 60 |

| 5 | 92 | 110 |

### 2. Talent Tree Progress

On the other hand, your Dragon Talent Tree offers unique nodes and abilities that can be game-changing. If you've already invested heavily in your talents and have acquired most of the essential nodes, then the marginal benefits from further talent investments may be diminishing. In such cases, focusing on portrait levels becomes more attractive.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-50-1024x459.png)

### 3. Top Talent Nodes

Certain nodes in the Dragon Talent Tree are particularly valuable and should be prioritized. These include:

- **Armor**: Providing damage reduction.
- **Claw**: Enhancing your dragon's damage output.
- **Damage Reduction**: Reducing incoming damage.
- **Unique Nodes**: Any unique abilities your dragon possesses in the talent tree.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-53.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-52.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-51.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-54.png)

These nodes have a substantial impact on your dragon's performance, making them essential for your strategy.

### 4. Portrait Bonuses vs. Talent Nodes

Comparatively, Dragon Portrait levels offer incremental attribute bonuses with each upgrade. However, the cost of these levels increases quickly. For example, a minor node for physical attack in your Dragon Portrait may provide 30 - 60 - 90 attribute bonuses, with costs of 150 - 300 - 450 dragon crystals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-55.png)

### 5. A Balanced Approach

To make an informed decision, consider adopting a balanced approach. Start by upgrading the initial and relatively inexpensive levels of your Dragon Portrait to bolster your dragon's overall stats. Then, focus on completing your Dragon Talent Tree by acquiring essential nodes, including the top talent nodes mentioned earlier.

### 6. The Ideal Transition Point

Determining the ideal transition point between Dragon Portrait and Talent Tree upgrades is crucial. An efficient strategy is to invest in your Dragon Portrait levels until you reach around level 15-20. At this stage, you should have a strong foundation of attribute bonuses.

Once you have acquired all the critical nodes in your Dragon Talent Tree, you can return to upgrading your Dragon Portrait levels. This approach ensures that you strike a balance between incremental stat boosts and acquiring game-changing abilities.

In conclusion, the decision to upgrade Dragon Portrait levels or Dragon Talent Tree depends on your current progress and priorities. The most efficient strategy is often to begin with Dragon Portrait levels, transition to the Talent Tree after acquiring essential abilities, and return to Portrait upgrades once you've reached a particular level. By understanding the balance between these two aspects, you can maximize your dragon's potential and achieve success in the game.

title: Dragons count as 1.5 element when fixing alignments with Chaos Builds
summary: Elemental alignment in Infinity Kingdom is one of those systems that looks simple on the surface but has a lot of practical depth once you start mixing compositions. Most players understand the basic idea—stack elements…
markdown:
## Introduction

Elemental alignment in *Infinity Kingdom* is one of those systems that looks simple on the surface but has a lot of practical depth once you start mixing compositions. Most players understand the basic idea—stack elements for bonuses, counter enemy elements—but Chaos Immortals introduce a layer of flexibility that can be easy to misunderstand.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-111.png)

This guide breaks down how elemental values work, how buffs and advantages apply, and then focuses on how Chaos Immortals interact with your formation. The goal is to give you a reliable mental model you can apply when building teams, especially in mixed or experimental setups.

---

## How Elemental Values Work

Each Immortal contributes **1 elemental value** of their type. Dragons, however, count as **1.5 elemental value** toward their element.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-112.png)

This matters for two systems:

1. **Elemental Buffs (team bonuses)**
2. **Chaos Immortal alignment**

The game essentially tallies up the total “weight” of each element in your formation.

### Example:

- 2 Earth Immortals → 2 Earth value
- 1 Wind Immortal → 1 Wind value
- Earth Dragon → 1.5 Earth value

Total:

- Earth = 3.5
- Wind = 1

Earth is clearly dominant.

---

## Elemental Buffs (Brief Overview)

Elemental buffs activate when you stack multiple Immortals of the same element. The exact thresholds depend on the current balance patch, but the general idea is:

- **3 Immortals** → Immortal Physical Defense +20% and Immortal Magical Defense +20%
- **4 Immortals** → Immortal Physical Attack +20% and Immortal Magical Attack +20%
- **5 Immortals** → Troop HP +10%

The important takeaway: **Consistency in element stacking increases overall efficiency**, especially in PvP where stat scaling matters more than raw skill effects. That being said, 3 and 4 stacking are much much more important than getting the 5th bonus.

---

## Elemental Advantage (Brief Overview)

Each element has strengths and weaknesses against others. While exact matchups vary slightly depending on interpretation, the system follows a standard counter-cycle.

Elemental advantage provides:

- Increased damage dealt
- Reduced damage taken

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-113.png)

In practice, this becomes more relevant in:

- Arena matchups
- GvG targeting
- Counter-building specific enemy marches

**[Read much more here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/all-effects-ability-passive/misc-combat-guides/elemental-advantage-explained/)**

---

## How Chaos Immortals Work

Chaos Immortals do not have a fixed element. Instead, they **automatically shift to match the dominant element in your formation**.

The key rule:

> Chaos aligns with the element that has the **highest total value**, counting Immortals as 1 and Dragons as 1.5.

This is not based on count alone—it’s based on **weighted total**.

---

## Why Dragons Matter More Than You Think

Because dragons count as 1.5, they often act as the **tie-breaker** in mixed-element teams.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-114-1024x537.png)

---

## Conclusion Summary

- Each Immortal = 1 elemental value; each Dragon = 1.5
- Elemental buffs reward stacking and scale with consistency
- Elemental advantage matters situationally but is secondary to buffs
- Chaos Immortals adopt the **highest weighted element**, not just the most units
- Dragons frequently determine Chaos alignment, especially in mixed teams
- With multiple Chaos Immortals, your dragon effectively defines your composition

If you remember one thing:
**Chaos doesn’t add randomness—it reflects your build. And most of the time, your dragon is the deciding voice in that reflection.**

---

There are five different types of dragons in Infinity Kingdom and each one is tied to an element - Water, Water, Earth, Wind, and Lightning. Each of these dragons has 5 maturity stages - Egg, Infancy, Adolescence, Adulthood, and Elder.

### Dragon Upgrades

You will need dragon soul crystals in order to hatch a dragon egg when you reach Level 5 and unlock the Dragon Cave. Dragon soul crystals can be acquired as rewards from world bosses, quests and events. You will be able to train a dragon when you see a dragon icon bubble above the Dragon Cave. When your dragon reaches level 5, 15, and 25 you will unlock skills for them. This skill and their effects can be upgraded by spending Dragon Soul Crystals.

title: Drastic Action (legendary)
summary: Drastic Action is one of the more impactful legendary Tower of Knowledge skills for physical-focused builds. At a glance, it reads like a standard high-damage triggered skill, but in practice it behaves more like an…
markdown:
### Introduction

*Drastic Action* is one of the more impactful **legendary Tower of Knowledge skills** for physical-focused builds. At a glance, it reads like a standard high-damage triggered skill, but in practice it behaves more like an **execute tool**—designed to quickly remove weakened targets and shift the momentum of a fight.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-10-1024x658.png)

Its strength doesn’t come from raw damage alone, but from how that damage is applied: targeted, conditional, and repeatable within a short cycle. Because of this, it often overperforms compared to other single-target skills, especially in coordinated damage setups.

---

### Skill Mechanics and Breakdown

### Core Properties:

- **Type**: Triggered skill
- **Restriction**: Archers + Attack Immortals
- **Trigger Cycle**: Every 6 seconds
- **Trigger Chance**: 60%

### Effects:

- Deals **600% physical damage** to the enemy with the **highest HP lost**
- If the target is **below 70% HP**, the skill triggers an **additional damage instance**
- Reduces healing received by **all enemies**by **70% for 6 seconds**

---

### Why Drastic Action Functions as an Execute Skill

The key to understanding Drastic Action is target selection and conditional scaling.

- It prioritizes **the most damaged enemy**
- It gains **extra damage once that target drops below 70% HP**
- It cycles every 6 seconds with a **high trigger rate**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-8.png)

This creates a natural execution pattern:

1. Your team spreads initial damage
2. One target becomes the “most damaged”
3. Drastic Action repeatedly hits that same unit
4. Once below 70%, damage spikes due to the second hit

The result is **accelerated target elimination**, often before healing or defensive rotations can stabilize the unit.

---

### Synergy with Single-Target Damage Dealers

Drastic Action performs best in builds that already apply **focused pressure**.

It pairs naturally with immortals like:

- Alexander
- Ares

These units specialize in **single-target damage**, which helps quickly establish a priority target. Once that target is identified (highest HP lost), Drastic Action reinforces that pressure.

Important distinction:

- The skill **does not need to be equipped on these immortals**
- It simply benefits from being in a lineup that creates **focused damage patterns**

For example:

- Running Drastic Action on a **backline archer**
- While Alexander/Ares apply frontline pressure

This separation often results in more consistent uptime and safer positioning, while still benefiting from the execute effect.

---

### Anti-Heal Component (Often Overlooked)

While most players focus on the damage, the **70% healing reduction** is just as impactful.

In practical terms:

- It prevents recovery on the target you are trying to eliminate
- It amplifies effective team damage during its duration
- It weakens sustain-heavy compositions

In longer fights, this effect can be the difference between:

- A target stabilizing and recovering
- Or being permanently pushed into execution range

This is one reason Drastic Action performs well even outside pure burst setups.

---

### Interaction with Multi-Hit and Proc-Based Builds

Because Drastic Action can:

- Hit twice under conditions
- Apply repeated damage cycles

It contributes additional **damage instances**, which has synergy with:

- Executioner-type effects
- Other proc-based scaling mechanics

In testing, builds that rely on chaining effects tend to gain more value than expected from this skill—not because of its base numbers, but because of how often it contributes to the damage pipeline.

---

### Acquisition and Upgrade Cost

Drastic Action is a **legendary (Chaos) Tower of Knowledge skill**, which comes with significant investment requirements.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-9-1024x588.png)

### How to Obtain:

- Only available through the **Wisdom Well event**

### Upgrade Costs (Skill Stones):

- Unlock: 60
- Level 2: 5
- Level 3: 10
- Level 4: 15
- Level 5: 20
- Level 6: 30
- Level 7: 40
- Level 8: 60

### Total Cost: 240 Skill Stones

### Expected Investment:

- ~$400 to unlock
- ~$1500 to fully max (depending on RNG and pacing)

This places Drastic Action firmly in the category of **long-term or high-investment skills**, and it should be evaluated accordingly before committing resources.

---

### Player Perspective

From a practical standpoint, Drastic Action is one of those skills that performs better in real fights than it appears on paper.

When I first tested it, the expectation was a standard single-target damage proc. What stood out instead was how reliably it **locked onto one unit and finished it**. Once a target dipped below 70%, the double-hit effect created a noticeable spike in pressure.

In coordinated setups—especially alongside units like Alexander—the skill consistently shortened fights by removing one enemy earlier than expected. That alone often decides engagements.

The anti-heal component becomes more noticeable in higher-level fights. Against sustain-heavy teams, you can see healing numbers drop off during its window, making it much harder for opponents to recover.

Where players sometimes misjudge the skill is placement. It doesn’t need to sit on your main damage dealer. In many cases, running it on a safer backline unit results in **more consistent triggers and better overall value**.

---

### Conclusion Summary

- Drastic Action is a **high-impact legendary triggered skill** focused on single-target pressure
- Deals **600% damage**, with a **second hit below 70% HP**
- Functions as an **execute tool**, rapidly eliminating weakened enemies
- Synergizes with **single-target damage dealers** like Alexander and Ares
- Provides strong **anti-heal (70%)**, increasing effective damage
- Does **not require frontline placement** to be effective
- High investment cost makes it a **long-term strategic choice**

In practical terms, Drastic Action is less about raw numbers and more about **control over fight pacing**. It rewards builds that can focus damage and turns that pressure into reliable eliminations.

---

### Alexander with Battle Stance: a late game setup

In this guide, we explore an unconventional yet surprisingly effective setup featuring **Alexander the Great** using **Battle Stance** in an **Earth sustain march**. While Battle Stance is typically not recommended for Alex, this guide highlights how specific synergies can unlock insane potential, allowing Alex to deliver some of the highest damage figures seen in current Infinity Kingdom metas.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-97.png)

---

## 💡 March Overview

The march includes the following Immortals:

- **Alexander the Great** (Main DPS)
- **Charles/Athena** (Frontline sustain/support)
- **Theodora/Fou Fei** (Healer)
- **Zenobia** (Healer)

The setup focuses on **high sustain**, using **double healers** to keep Alex alive and allow him to ramp up damage over time. Athena provides Guard support, shielding Alex, while Zenobia not only heals but boosts **attack speed** through her exclusive artifact effect.

---

## ⚔️ Battle Stance on Alex: Why It Works Here

Normally, Battle Stance isn't optimal for Alex due to the 70% damage reduction for the first 20 seconds and energy regen that he doesn’t benefit from (as his ultimate is passive). However, in this **high-sustain march**, the drawbacks are compensated for:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-92.png)

- **Alex survives longer** due to double healers and Athena’s protection.
- Once Battle Stance activates (after 20s), Alex **deals 100% increased damage**.
- He benefits massively from **attack speed boosts** via Zenobia's artifact.

This synergy enables Alex to perform exceptionally well in **extended fights**, especially against setups that don’t have countermeasures against sustained damage.

---

## 📊 Performance Highlights

### Massive DPS Output

The damage amplification from **Battle Stance**, combined with **continuous damage effects** like Blade Vortex, is key. Executioner also shines here because Theodora (a typical counter via healing suppression) is **not present** in the lineup, allowing continuous damage to persist.

These reports consistently show **Alex outperforming expectations**, often topping 70-90 million damage with proper support in late-game conquest combat.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-96-1024x219.png)

### Key Skills Used on Alex

- **Battle Stance** – Delayed burst potential with 100% damage increase
- **Blade Vortex** – Reliable continuous damage
- **Executioner** – Amplifies total output due to persistent DoT effects

Alternative setups use **Demonic Contract** instead of Battle Stance, also yielding great results, though not as dramatic.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-93-1024x596.png)

---

## 🧪 Skill Comparison: Battle Stance vs. Demonic Contract

### Battle Stance Pros:

- 100% damage increase after 20s
- Extreme synergy with high sustain and long fights
- Turns Alex into a **late-game carry**

### Battle Stance Cons:

- Weak first 20 seconds
- No benefit from energy regen

### Demonic Contract Pros:

- Earlier power spike
- More consistent performance throughout the fight

### Demonic Contract Cons:

- Lower peak burst damage

---

## 🆚 Zenobia vs. Theodora

### Why Zenobia?

- Grants **25% attack speed** to Alex
- Supports the sustain strategy with **Embrace's Favor** healing

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-94.png)

### When Theodora Might Be Better:

- Against **continuous damage** builds (e.g., Blade Vortex)
- If you need **healing immunity cleanse**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-95.png)

Both options are viable, but Zenobia is superior when maximizing Alex's **damage output** through attack speed and heal burst.

---

## 🧪 Additional Variations

Other reported setups include:

- Swapping Zenobia for Theodora
- Pairing Demonic Contract with Executioner for earlier damage ramp

---

## ✅ Final Thoughts

This build showcases how creative setups and smart synergies can unlock surprising results in Infinity Kingdom. While Battle Stance isn’t traditionally used on Alex, in a **high-sustain, healer-heavy earth march**, it becomes a powerful enabler.

If you're looking to test new builds or optimize Alex for long, drawn-out Conquest battles, **this setup is worth exploring**. Consider your opponents, adapt your support immortals accordingly, and you might just unlock a new powerhouse in your lineup.

> High sustain + delayed burst = Battle Stance Alex supremacy!

### Player Guide: Innovative Earth Build with Dual Tanks and Elizabeth Bathory

In the ever-evolving meta of Infinity Kingdom, experimenting with different immortal combinations can yield surprisingly powerful results. One such innovative setup replaces the typical powerhouse Alexander with a dual tank frontline, spotlighting Charles and Yi Sun-Shin, and positions Elizabeth Bathory as a key damage dealer. This guide will explore the nuances of this build, suitable for various levels of spending.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-23-1024x375.png)

#### Core Strategy

The essence of this build lies in its robust defense coupled with devastating damage potential from the backline. Charles and Yi Sun-Shin serve as the immovable objects up front, mitigating incoming damage and controlling the pace of the battle, while Elizabeth Bathory, equipped with Blade Vortex and Executioner, unleashes significant damage.

## Immortal Roles and Skill Sets

**Charles (Tank)**:

- **Skills**: Energy Shield, Guard, Fighting Master  - Energy Shield and Guard enhance his tanking capabilities by boosting defense and mitigating damage.
- Fighting Master provides control immunity, ensuring his protective abilities remain uninterrupted.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-29-1024x640.png)

**Yi Sun-Shin (Tank)**:

- **Skills**: Weakening Curse, Berserk Aura, and either Assist or Purify  - Weakening Curse debuffs enemies, reducing their effectiveness in combat.
- Berserk Aura enhances the attack potential of allies.
- Choose Assist to redirect damage from key allies to Yi Sun-Shin, or Purify to cleanse detrimental effects, tailored to your battlefield needs.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-28-1024x614.png)

**Elizabeth Bathory (Key Damage Dealer)**:

- **Skills**: Blade Vortex, Executioner, Battle Stance

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-27-1024x607.png)

- This skill combination maximizes her damage output, particularly effective with her damage-over-time ultimate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-26-1024x548.png)

**Zenobia (Healer and Control - Default Low Spender Option)**:

- **Skills**: No Escape, Spring of Life, Vitality Touch  - Provides healing, crowd control, and enhances survivability, making her invaluable for sustained fights.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

#### Variations for Different Spending Levels

- **Mid Spender Variation**: Replace Zenobia with Himiko to add powerful magical damage and superior control with skills like Armageddon and Annihilation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-25-1024x368.png)

- **High Spender Variation**: Swap in Loki alongside Bathory for even greater control and damage, leveraging Loki’s Confuse ability.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-24-1024x560.png)

#### Tactical Considerations

- **Frontline Flexibility**: Adjust Yi Sun-Shin’s skills based on the specific threats you face. Assist enhances the durability of your backline immortals, while Purify can be crucial against teams with heavy debuff strategies.
- **Backline Adjustments**: Depending on your choice between Zenobia, Himiko, or Loki, tweak the frontline to balance defense and offense. For instance, if using Himiko or Loki, swap Guard to Yi Sun-Shin and No Escape to Charles to maintain high troop counts on Charles and thus high shield values. If you are using Blade Stance on a Loki or Himiko for the added control and damage, you can swap in Demonic Contract on Bathory.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-30-1024x644.png)

#### Strategic Outcomes

This build excels against various prevalent setups, including earth-based Loki teams, most holy configurations, and even some chaos builds. The dual tank configuration allows for sustained frontline presence, which in combination with the high output from Bathory can dismantle opponents effectively.

#### Conclusion

While no build guarantees invincibility, this earth-based strategy provides a robust framework that can lead to success in diverse combat scenarios. Whether you're a small, mid, or high spender, this guide offers a scalable approach to crafting a formidable earth team. Experiment with the recommended setups and tailor your strategy to overcome specific opponents, pushing the limits of what your earth team can achieve in Infinity Kingdom.

### Player Guide: Mastering the "Duel Master" Skill in Infinity Kingdom

"Duel Master" is a skill in Infinity Kingdom that, while sometimes overlooked, holds considerable potential to elevate the effectiveness of physical damage dealers under the right conditions. Its dual functionality—boosting physical attack attributes and providing immunity to wound effects—makes it a versatile addition to any player's arsenal, especially in strategies centered around sustained damage and healing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-150-1024x385.png)

## Understanding "Duel Master"

### Key Features

- **Physical Attack Increase**: "Duel Master" boosts the physical attack attributes of the immortal by 50%. This increase, while not directly enhancing damage dealt, significantly strengthens the output of any physical damage dealer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-151-1024x447.png)

- **Immunity to Wound Effects**: Perhaps the most distinguishing feature of "Duel Master" is its provision of immunity to wounds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-158.png)

Wounds, a debuff applied by formidable immortals like Genghis Khan and Emperor Qin, prevent affected units from receiving healing (excluding shield effects). "Duel Master" counters this by making the equipped immortal immune to such effects, ensuring that healing abilities remain effective.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-159-1024x390.png)

## Strategic Applications

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-154-1024x602.png)

### Optimizing Physical Damage Dealers

Given its attribute boost, "Duel Master" is naturally suited for immortals with a high physical damage output. The skill significantly enhances their combat effectiveness, making it a worthy consideration for any physical damage-focused strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-153-1024x605.png)

### Countering Wound Effects

The immunity to wound effects provided by "Duel Master" is its standout feature, offering a critical counterplay to some of the game's most potent debuffs. This aspect of the skill is invaluable in matchups where healing plays a pivotal role in maintaining frontline durability and overall team sustainability.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-155-1024x417.png)

### Ideal Immortal Pairings

- **Alexander in Earth or Hybrid Setups**: Alexander benefits immensely from "Duel Master," as his high attack speed and reliance on continuous healing make him a formidable force when paired with healers like Zenobia.
- **Other Physical Damage Dealers**: While particularly impactful with Alexander, "Duel Master" can also enhance the effectiveness of other immortals such as Manco, Khubilai, or Gilgamesh, especially within holy setups, though its impact may vary.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-156-1024x432.png)

## Acquiring "Duel Master"

"Duel Master" distinguishes itself by being accessible and free to play, requiring only a low level for acquisition. This ease of access ensures that players at various stages of the game can leverage the skill's benefits, from early exploration to late-game conquest strategies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-157-1024x327.png)

## Conclusion

"Duel Master" offers a compelling mix of offensive enhancement and defensive resilience, making it a skill worthy of consideration for any player looking to optimize their physical damage dealers. Its ability to counteract one of the most debilitating debuffs in the game, coupled with a significant increase in physical attack attributes, provides a strategic edge in both PvP and PvE content. Whether you're crafting a lineup around sustained healing and damage or looking for ways to enhance your existing physical attackers, "Duel Master" presents a robust solution that can adapt to various combat scenarios, solidifying its place in the end-game meta.

title: Dwellings
summary: Dwellings are one of your main sources of gold income. The dwellings are your tax-farms and they provide a passive income yield just like farms produce food and lumbers wood.
markdown:
Dwellings are one of your main sources of gold income. The dwellings are your tax-farms and they provide a passive income yield just like farms produce food and lumbers wood.

You want to prioritise dwellings as you build up and progress through the building levels. Gold is a high demand and low supply ressource which you will need a metrix ton of to **[upgrade your dragon](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/dragons/upgrade-train-your-dragon/)** and **[boost your immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/immortal-boost-level-up/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-67.png)

### lvl 54 = 522.5 gold per minute

My Dwellings produce 3,730 gold per 2 min (harvest timing) at level 54, times 6 that is a **solid 671,400 gold per hour**or **16,113,600 million gold per day** (with talent and 10/10 Gold Piles tech and gold production buff active plus in-game shop gold boost).

Dwellings are the easiest way to obtain gold and they are a constant stream of gold production for your Castle Kingdom. Upgrading your Dwellings to level 55 should be a priority for anyone struggling to keep up with the mounting gold costs. The production boost increases are quite significant. Personally, I prioritize upgrading all my dwellings every time I unlock a new Castle level.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-65.png)

Furthermore, you should remember to buff your gold production. Using the in-game buff items you can maintain a constant 50% boost to gold production, which makes Dwelling income go through the roof. This is arguably the single best use of gems (500 gems per 24 hour boost). I personally always maintain the buff as it is the most growth-value per gem spent until Immortals and Dragons are maxed (and even at this point, I will continue because we know we will need more for levels 60 once that is released).

Moreover, you can get an additional 10% production on top with the 14 days 5$ gold bundle in the Kingdom Supplies store. With both of these buffs active as well as the talents and more, you earn MASSIVE amounts of gold by simply harvesting your Dwellings.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-68-1024x626.png)

## Technology

Because dwellings are so very important to your total gold wealth, you want to prioritise upgrading not only these buildings, but also the technology related to dwellings and gold production.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-19-1024x376.png)

## Talent - Plentiful Gold

This talent is steightforward and insanely strong. Your dwellings produce a ton of gold for you as your citizens are taxed minute by minute.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-17.png)

**[Read more about gold talents.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/gold-talents/)**This talent is a plain 10% boost to the production of your dwellings. **You should always have this talent on.**
