## Skyriver Palace Castle Skin: Early Overview & Analysis

## Introduction

Infinity Kingdom has just pushed out a brand new and absolutely game-changing castle skin: **Skyriver Palace**. Introduced in the latest update (post-maintenance, June 6), this new skin now appears in the Castle Skin menu and has already made waves due to its **unprecedented power scaling**. As of now, the method to obtain this skin has not been confirmed, but it has been **teased as part of the upcoming Children's Day event**, running from **June 11 to June 21**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-22.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-23.png)

In this guide, we will break down what we know so far about the Skyriver Palace skin, its game-altering buffs, potential acquisition methods, and some forward-looking speculation on how this might impact the meta and future castle skin releases.

---

## Skyriver Palace Stats & Buffs

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-23-1024x501.png)

### Level 1 Buffs:

- +5% Physical Attack (Immortals)
- +5% Magical Attack (Immortals)
- -3% Death Rate

### Max Level Buffs:

- +15% Physical Attack (Immortals)
- +15% Magical Attack (Immortals)
- -6% Death Rate

> **This is the most powerful castle skin ever released in Infinity Kingdom.** Previous combat skins primarily gave 2% HP or 2% Honor gain at most. In contrast, Skyriver Palace provides a full-on 15% offensive boost AND survivability via reduced death rate. No other skin even comes close.

---

## Check the Sneak Peak Video here to see for yourself!

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Castle-skin-star-upgrade-1.mkv)

## How Do You Get It? (Speculation)

We currently **do not know how to obtain the Skyriver Palace**. However, based on the fact that it was teased in conjunction with the Children's Day event, it's safe to assume that:

1. **It will be tied to the event launching June 11.**
2. **It will likely require heavy spending to unlock.**
3. **We may unlock the base skin now and upgrade it in future events.**

This follows a trend similar to how other seasonal event bundles are structured. The event may also include multiple milestone rewards or a tiered progression system (similar to recent cosmetic or VIP pack models).

---

## What Makes This Skin So Special?

- **Double Damage Buffs:** 15% to both physical and magical damage means this skin benefits *every single march* regardless of element or role. This is completely unique.
- **Death Rate Reduction:** A -6% death rate is incredibly impactful for long PvP engagements, protecting troop count and reducing healing burdens.
- **Flexibility:** Unlike HP% skins that favor tanks or support, this is universally valuable across all team roles.

> No other castle skin has offered anything close to this level of universal, combat-focused performance enhancement.

---

## Strategic Implications

- **Must-Have for Competitive Players:** For players engaged in Throne battles, Squad Tournaments, or competitive server conquest, this skin is likely to become mandatory.
- **Massive Power Spike:** This skin will significantly widen the gap between spenders and F2P players.
- **Game Meta Shifts:** Expect a ripple effect through the meta. Teams may shift toward maximizing burst potential to take full advantage of the offensive bonus.

---

## Future Castle Skin Predictions (Speculation)

Given how Skyriver Palace is structured, we can reasonably speculate on future seasonal skins:

- Same +15% physical/magical damage base
- Third buff variable:  - Death Rate (current)
- Honor Gain (possible next?)
- HP% (final and most powerful?)

These would follow a pattern of rotating seasonal skins that can either be collected or upgraded over time, providing increasing bonuses.

---

## What Should You Do?

For now, keep an eye on the event launch June 11. If you're a spender:

- **Prepare your budget.**
- **Plan for milestone-based or progressive unlock mechanics.**
- **Evaluate your other spending (e.g., bundles, chaos fragments, etc.).**

> Personally, I plan to unlock this skin if at all possible. As soon as we know more about pricing, progression, and event structure, I will release a **full guide on obtaining, upgrading, and valuing the Skyriver Palace skin**.

---

## Final Thoughts

The Skyriver Palace is unlike anything we've seen in Infinity Kingdom. While its release method is still under wraps, its mere presence signals a potential shift in how powerful cosmetics can be. If you're competitive, stay alert, stay updated, and be ready to make a decision when the event drops. This is likely the most impactful castle cosmetic Infinity Kingdom has ever seen.

Stay tuned for a follow-up guide covering **exact costs, progression paths, and upgrade strategies** once the Children’s Day event goes live.

title: Earn Gold in Mysterium
summary: Gold is a very sparse ressource in Infinity Kingdom. Players have limited ways of obtaining gold, and a huge demand for it in order to upgrade Immortals Boost levels and Upgrade Dragon levels. The Mysterium is the…
markdown:
Gold is a very sparse ressource in Infinity Kingdom. Players have limited ways of obtaining gold, and a huge demand for it in order to upgrade Immortals Boost levels and Upgrade Dragon levels. The Mysterium is the biggest gold per week earning out there - so make sure you maximize your gold earnings every two days!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-75-1024x344.png)

## Mysterium - Gold versus Speedups

Running the Mysterium you must decide between gold and speedups. Camps provide a very high yield means to gain gold if you do gold runs.

The lootboxes found in Mysterium on the other hand is a great way to get **[speedups](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/mysterium/earn-speedups/)**- especially as a free to play, where speeds are much more rare.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/Skaermbillede-2022-02-20-180847.png)

## Gold runs

Running Mysterium on my main and my alts it is clear that the loot scales somehow - it does not seem to be only Castle level, but a combination of soldier tier, castle level and overall power.

Running with t7, C53 at around 3.6mil power my gold earned across the last runs avg. **5,644,000.00 Gold per clear**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-72-1024x481.png)

In addition I loot on average 12 hours of **[speedups](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/mysterium/earn-speedups/)**just from loot boxes where I had no option to fight.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-73.png)

#### How much do you get? Share your rewards so we can figure out the scaling function: discord.gg/sBVxxcc8bA

### Hardmode

You must complete the Mysterium on the highest difficulty while being able to kill all enemy marches in your way. If you begin skipping battles to preserve your strength, you loose out on a lot of gold.

If you are able to comfortably clear Hardmode (it is ok to skip hard counter and shadow marches) then go for it! **Floor 3 yield the majority of the total gold earned per run** on hardmode. You want to skip as little as possible here.

Furthermore, there is a massive new reward at the end of it all! Finishing the third and final floor on Hardmode will reward you with unique artifact fragments unlocking unique artifacts for Alexander, Saladin, Attila, The Cid and Ramssess.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-74.png)

title: Earn Justice Points & Enchant stones
summary: Every titantula spider event you have a total of 10 free attacks over the course of the entire day. Moreover, you are able to purchase an additional 10 attacks costing you 500 gems.
markdown:
Every titantula spider event you have a total of 10 free attacks over the course of the entire day. Moreover, you are able to purchase an additional 10 attacks costing you 500 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-8.png)

The spider will spawn 6 times during the day of the event. Starting at in-game reset time and then every 4 hours onwards.

This means that you have a l**imited amount of attack available** to reap maximum rewards. Therefore you must think carefully before you engage a spider. If you use a bunch of attacks and the spider doesn't die, you will not get any damage ranking bonus from this spider! **Only killed spiders reward the participating players with a bonus**.

When you fight the spider earn both **Justice Points** and **Enchant stone**. Justice points are the primary objective of this event and is what is used to **[compete for event ranking (and awesome rewards)](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pve/spider-boss/event-ranking-rewards-2x-week/)** as well as to earn the **[event participation rewards](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pve/spider-boss/titantula-participation-rewards/)**.

In addition to justice points, you also earn a lot of Enchant stones by participating in the spider event. These are used to upgrade [equipment](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/gear-equipment/) for your Immortals.

## Earn Justice Points and Enchant stones

You get a lot out of a single attack on the spider. Moreover, you should always use your attacks to reach a top 10 ranking on the spider. I usually do 3 or 4 spider a day and simply make sure I am within the top 10 on the kill, then try and snipe with a late attack.

You should always try and get the last hit. Beware, that you must remain top 10 for the kill, but once that is secured, you should try and hit the killing blow. Be slow with it, it is better to miss your hit because someone else got the kill than to use an attack on a spider where you would have ranked top 10 anyway. The attack is refunded if you hit after the spider is dead.

Only exception to this, is if you are in close competition with someone and can see you will likely end on the same number of ranking points (event ranking). Then you want to hit quickly and get the point cap you both will reach - **you want to do this, because if two players are tied in points, the player who got the points first wins.**

Rewards from attacks on spider are as follow.

| Attack | Justice Points | Enchant Stones |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single attack | 1,250 (cap) | 24,100 |  |
| Killing Blow | 9,000 | 134,400 |  |
| Top 10 damage placement (on any of the spiders of the day) | 7,000 | 102,400 |  |

title: Earth - Alex single target nuke
summary: This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.

**This build is made for:**Beginning of Pre-league

This article is on earth with a focus on Alex single-targeting. This means we are using the fast attackspeed and high phys dmg of Alexander the Great to proc as many instances of combo as possible as well as boosting its damage to the max. As Prime League has very limited passive ranks in the initial stages, this is a a solid build to begin a league with. You will have good survivability from an un-controlable Charles with adrenaline rush, strong healing from Zeno on Alex (your main dps you want toped). Lastly, Cleopatra is always a good choice, as she deals decent damage and gives that strong magic dmg debuff to keep us safe from heavy nuking fire teams or from Baldwin proc chains.

## Setup

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-31.png)

**Zeno**: Blessing of speed + Oaken Guard + Energy Suppression

**Cleo**: Wisdom + Nova + Annihilation

**Charles**: Fighting Master + Weakness + Adrenaline Rush

**Alexander**: Combo + Onslaught + Anger

## Strengths and weaknesses

This setup is built around Alex and his single target. Surviving long enough for him to make it a 4v3 battle secures the victory.

Problem is if you are fighting an enemy that simply does not die. If you end up with your Alex facing a Frederick I with spearmen counter and fully loaded with tanking passives, you might not be able to chew through in time.

On the other hand, most people will likely be running Charles if they want survivability, simply because his shields are amazingly strong. If you position your Alex to fight him directly, he will eat him up quickly!

You do no rely on Zeno heals too much, meaning Khan lightnings and Qin Wind teams are not a direct hardcounter to this setup (not running shelter, grace and adrenaline on Zeno). But these two teams are still the most dangeous.

All in all, earth has a very strong baseline. It might lack the additional stats given to the wind immortals and dragon, but what it lacks in stats is makes up for in very strong abilities. We enjoy CC immunity on two Immortals, the best survive in the game (Charles) and quite high damage output. **In conclusion, a strong solid march to start out any league.**

title: Earth Bathory is back! Patch 2.6.8
summary: The Earth Bathory build has made a strong comeback with the availability of \"Blade Vortex\" and \"Executioner\" skills, which are now accessible through the Legion of Frostborne rewards. This guide will detail how to…
markdown:
### Player Guide: Reviving the Earth Bathory Build in Infinity Kingdom

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-33-1024x499.png)

The Earth Bathory build has made a strong comeback with the availability of "Blade Vortex" and "Executioner" skills, which are now accessible through the Legion of Frostborne rewards. This guide will detail how to effectively utilize Bathory in a renewed Earth build that leverages these powerful skills for maximum impact in battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-39-1024x576.png)

## Core Immortal Setup

## Bathory - The Damage Powerhouse

- **Skills**: Blade Vortex, Executioner, Fighting Master/Battle Stance
- **Role**: Main damage dealer
- **Strategy**: Bathory's ultimate, which is a damage over time effect, synergizes exceptionally well with Executioner, amplifying its damage output capabilities. Blade Vortex ensures consistent application of damage across multiple enemy units, making Bathory a devastating force on the battlefield.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-34-1024x590.png)

### Blade Vortex

**Blade Vortex** is recognized for its exceptional damage-per-second (DPS) capabilities. It triggers every 12 seconds after battle starts, causing physical damage to three random enemy units. Additionally, it applies the "Tear" effect, which deals physical damage every 3 seconds for 12 seconds. The continuous damage from Blade Vortex makes it a high-ranking skill for DPS, with a 100% uptime on 3 out of 4 enemy units, making it ideal for sustained damage output.

### Executioner

**Executioner** is designed to capitalize on continuous damage effects. After inflicting continuous damage 8 times, it deals significant additional physical damage to all enemy units and increases damage dealt to targets with less than 30% troops by 50% for 6 seconds. This skill excels when combined with other skills that apply continuous damage, enhancing its potential to deliver devastating blows during combat.

### Synergy Between Blade Vortex and Executioner

The synergy between these two skills is notably powerful:

- **Blade Vortex** sets up continuous damage across multiple enemy units, which primes the battlefield for **Executioner** to trigger its effect.
- Once **Executioner** activates, it leverages the continuous damage applied by Blade Vortex to deal massive area damage and significantly boost damage against weakened foes.
- This combination is particularly deadly because Blade Vortex ensures that Executioner’s conditions are met frequently and efficiently, maximizing the area and impact damage potential.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-38-1024x397.png)

## Charles - The Stalwart Defender

- **Skills**: No-Escape, Purify, Life-Link/Weakening Curse/Aura
- **Role**: Frontline tank
- **Strategy**: Charles provides robust defenses with his shielding capabilities and utility effects. His skill set can be adjusted based on the opponent’s setup to either enhance his defensive attributes or disrupt enemy strategies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-35-1024x608.png)

### Alexander - The Frontline Destroyer

- **Skills**: Duel-Master, Combo, Wind Rage
- **Role**: Secondary damage dealer
- **Strategy**: Positioned to confront key frontline enemies directly, Alexander's high single-target damage quickly diminishes the enemy's front line, complementing Bathory’s area damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-36-1024x635.png)

### Zenobia/Theodora - The Sustaining Force

- **Skills**: Spring of Life, Energy Shield, Purification/Oaken Guard/Adrenaline Rush
- **Role**: Backline healer
- **Strategy**: Whether you choose Zenobia or Theodora, the focus should be on maintaining high troop health and utilizing their skills for additional battlefield control or sustain, ensuring your immortals can withstand prolonged engagements.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-37-1024x617.png)

## Tactical Considerations

- **Control Immunity**: Given the high stakes of control effects in PvP, Bathory’s third skill slot can alternate between Fighting Master for control immunity and Battle Stance for energy regeneration, depending on the opponent's setup.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

- **Skill Synergy**: The combination of Blade Vortex and Executioner on Bathory creates a synergy that is geared towards maximizing damage output from continuous damage effects, making her incredibly lethal against weakened foes.
- **Adaptability**: Always be ready to tweak Charles and Zenobia/Theodora's skills based on the specific challenges posed by your enemies. Their flexibility can be pivotal in countering diverse enemy strategies.

## Conclusion

The resurgence of the Earth Bathory build, powered by the synergistic combination of Blade Vortex and Executioner, provides a robust framework for players looking to dominate in PvP battles. This build not only revives a classic strategy but also adapts it to the current meta, making it a formidable choice for any player aiming to leverage Earth immortals' strengths effectively.

title: Earth Cleo-Bathony (updated for patch 2.3 meta)
summary: This guide is part of my article series on earth builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the earth build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE…
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on earth builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the earth build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

This is one of my all time favorite builds, but it is not for everyone. This build does not perform as well in P V E as for instance Zeno pure earth, as you do not have added healing to raid gnomes with. And if you are looking to have two or three top tier end-game marches, then you want to look towards wind-earth hybrid instead. Because of the passive synergies between setups. However, if you are an earth player and you do not spend enough to have an immensely powerful second and third march, but instead want to have ONE max power build for PVP, then this is the build for you.

There are not many other builds that can beat this setup in a one-on-one fight. The only real threats are holy. That makes this an absolute top-tier build and one any earth-main player should be familiar with.

**To run this build, you want to max a Genghis Khan for your secondary or third march and swap him in when you attack a holy-main whale**

This setup is for spenders. You will need charles and alex maxed and preferably unique artifact on alex. You also need Elizabeth Bathory maxed and a khan in the back pocket.

**If you are a mid spender, this is the build for you!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-24-1024x616.png)

## How does it work?

The key Immortal to this setup is Elizabeth Bathory. We are running Bathory in this team, simply because she deals insane damage – especially after the big buff to counter-damage back in May 2022.

You are most likely wondering why the heck I have Cleopatra in here as a support and not Zenobia? And you would be right to question that decision. There are a couple of different reasons:

First, this build is made to fight all types of enemy setups. That means being against a lot of magic damage from Dido-Merlin setups, Wu-Baldwin Fires and from Hammurabi Lightning teams. Cleopatra offer us a very strong defensive magic debuff for just this occasion.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-23.png)

In addition to reducing incoming magic damage, she does a decent amount of damage and cannot be hard countered by “wounds” from Emperor Qin and Genghis Khan! Cleo will always deal solid off-dps even with assist active, providing us the offense we want for this setup. We want to quickly burst down the enemy troop count and get ahead.

If we ran Zeno instead, we would in some fights get around the same amount of healing as Cleo deals damage, but in other fights, we would get 0 output from her, because she was being hard-countered by Qins or Khans. Cleo does not have that weakness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-17-1024x577.png)

We can rely on Cleo to always have an impact and put pressure on our enemies. Therefore, she is better in this fast-paced offensive earth setup. Because we do not rely on Zeno, this build performs much better than other earth builds when fighting lightning. Despite the elemental disadvantage, we have a chance to win because Khan’s wounds effect has no Zeno to counter.

Besides Cleopatra and Bathory in the back, we have a great frontline! Get it? Great…

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-19.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-18.png)

We run Alexander and Charles in the front like most all Earth setups. We enjoy the same advantages as usual from this duo. Charles provides the strongest sustain of all Immortals in Infinity Kingdom, keeping us safe from AOE damage. At the same time, Alex uses his absolutely ridiculous single target damage to nuke one of your enemy front-liners into the ground in the first 10-20 seconds of the fight.

## Setup

This setup is very different to anything else earth-related. The concept here is simple tho: Keep Elizabeth Bathony maxed on troops and unhindered for as long as possible. She will wreck anything in her way as long as she remain on high troop count.

So, how do we want to configure the passives setup for this build?

We want to strike a balance between defense and offense with this build. This build is all about maxing the effect of troop count on Bathory. By keeping her on high troop count the entire fight, we ensure she will kill the entire enemy team almost by herself.

Moreover, we add a lot of control synergizing well with both Earth Dragon’s stun and Bathory’s stun effect. Having many small control effects is extremely strong because you interrupt enemy skill casts entirely with a bit of luck. Many small control effects are much much stronger than a few with longer duration.

## Build Summary

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-26.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-27.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-25.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-24.png)

### You want to run this passive loadout:

**Bathony**: Anger + Fighting Master + Death Breath

**Cleopatra**: Annihilation + Coercion + Assist

**Alex**: Fighting Will + Weakness + Cleave

**Charles**: Oaken Guard + Malice + Adrenaline Rush

## Build Details and Strategy

For **Bathory**you want to equip: Anger and Death Breath for pure raw damage power. Moreover, you want to have Fighting Master on her, because we cannot afford for her to be interrupted by a lucky stun or freeze. Also, the damage reduction effect works nicely towards maintaining troop count.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-26.png)

For **Cleopatra**, we are running Annihilation for solid off-damage. Besides Annihilation, we run her as support with Coercion to bolster the damage of Bathory and Alexander as well as ensure consistency on Charles’s adrenaline rush attacks. Lastly, you want “assist” on Cleo to defend that all-important troop count of Bathory.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-27.png)

On the Great-Duo, we want Fighting Will for control and damage, Weakness to boost our ability to nuke with critical hits, and Cleave on **Alex**to further improve the team’s AOE capacity.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-25.png)

Furthermore, you want to have Oaken Guard on **Charles**to boost Physical Defences of our team, and Malice to ensure we incur as few critical hits as possible. Protecting from Chase builds and providing a smoother stream of incoming damage works nicely in our favour since we rely on shield-sustain.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-24.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-28.png)

The last spot on **Charles**is really the only thing that you want to change around depending on personal preference and the meta of your battlegroup. You have two options here:

(1) You can run an offense version with Life-Link. This turns **Charles**into a secondary damage dealer and works very well against enemy single-target nukers, such as other Alexanders.

(2) You can also choose a more defensive version of this build, where you protect your backline better from AOE damage by running Adrenaline Rush.

I personally favour the latter with Adrenaline Rush, but ultimately the choice depends on the meta builds in your battlegroup.

That was all for this Earth-Bathory Build. I hope you enjoyed this guide. Please let me know in the comments what kind of content you want to have next!

title: Earth Dragon Dimitr Guide: Skills, Builds, and Strategy
summary: In this guide, we’ll be exploring the Earth Dragon Dimitr, one of the most powerful and popular elemental dragons in Infinity Kingdom today—especially in Conquest Season. We'll walk through his skill tree options, break…
markdown:
In this guide, we’ll be exploring the **Earth Dragon Dimitr**, one of the most powerful and popular elemental dragons in *Infinity Kingdom* today—especially in **Conquest Season**. We'll walk through his skill tree options, break down how each path performs in different marches, and offer thoughts on when and how to use each.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-68-1024x486.png)

Whether you're building a **double tank setup**, a **hybrid composition**, or looking to boost your **team's survivability and control**, Dimitr offers a flexible and powerful toolkit.

---

## Why Earth Dragon Dimitr is So Good

Before dragon skill trees were introduced, Earth Dragon wasn’t seen as one of the top-tier dragons. But with the arrival of **customizable dragon talent trees**, Dimitr has risen to become a **top choice** among elemental dragons, rivaled only by Holy and Shadow in terms of versatility.

He brings:

- High **damage mitigation**
- Supportive **buffs and control**
- Synergy with both **tank-heavy** and **hybrid high-speed** marches

## Basics

- Earth Dragon Dimitr has **skyrocketed in popularity** since the release of dragon skill trees
- His skills are **highly adaptable** to various team compositions
- **Collapse** is the go-to pick for defense
- **Aftershock** supports hybrid and speed comps
- **Fissure** is best reserved for aggressive burst lineups

Upgrade him early, tailor his tree to your team, and you’ll see results in both PvP and Conquest performance.

Happy fighting, and may your Earth Dragon bring victory to your march!

### Guide to the Earth Dragon "Demeter" in Infinity Kingdom

Demeter, the Earth Dragon, is a pivotal character in Infinity Kingdom, offering distinct advantages and strategies with its abilities and talent specializations. This free dragon, unlocked during the tutorial, provides a robust foundation for your march, particularly against physical threats.

### Demeter's Stats at Level 55:

- **Physical Attack**: +114
- **Physical Defense**: +152
- **Magical Attack**: +126.6
- **Magical Defense**: +114
- **Analysis**: These stats make your march resistant to physical damage but more vulnerable to magical attacks. While the lower Physical Attack can be a concern for Earth carry immortals like Alexander, it's less impactful compared to Defense due to diminishing returns.

### Passive Skill - Earthshake:

- **Effect**: Provides +30% crit and dodge value.
- **Unique Feature**: Earth immortals get +4% damage increase for every 10% troops power loss, stackable up to 5 times.
- **Strategy**: This encourages the use of a Healer with your earth team to maximize the passive while keeping your immortals healthy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-69-1024x465.png)

---

## Skill Tree 1: Collapse

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-70-1024x438.png)

Collapse is arguably the **best skill tree** for Earth Dragon in current meta, especially for **double tank** teams.

- **Earthquake (Collapse)**: Deals true damage (starts at 30,000 and increases with levels).
- **Sandstorm Breath (Collapse)**: Reduces damage taken by **3 random allies**, with:  - Up to **98% chance** to trigger
- **35% damage reduction**
- Lasts for **16.8 seconds** at level 8

### Why Use Collapse?

- Best choice for **tanky team compositions**
- Incredibly high **damage mitigation uptime**
- Ideal if you're running frontline Immortals like **Charles, Alex, or Bjorn**

> "Collapse is the tree I use on my main team. It's one of the best defensive tools in the game right now."

---

## Skill Tree 2: Aftershock

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-71-1024x435.png)

Aftershock is a **flexible skill tree** with utility for **hybrid** or **attack-speed based** teams.

- **Earthquake (Aftershock)**: Extends stun duration by 1 second; adds 3 seconds to Earthquake duration
- **Sandstorm Breath (Aftershock)**:  - **90% chance** to trigger
- Reduces damage taken by 35%
- Increases **attack speed by 3%** for 12 seconds

### Why Use Aftershock?

- Excellent for **high attack speed teams** (e.g. **Alex + Hannibal with Rapid Artifact**)
- Good synergy with Immortals focused on **DPS burst**
- Can fit **double tank + hybrid mix** if built properly

> "Aftershock is a solid pick for high-speed marches or for frontlines that need both mitigation and aggression."

---

## Skill Tree 3: Fissure

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-72-1024x440.png)

Fissure is the most **offensive-focused** of Dimitr’s skill trees.

- **Earth Roar (Fissure)**: Increases enemy damage taken by 5%
- **Sandstorm Breath (Fissure)**:  - 90% chance to reduce damage taken by 25%
- Grants lifesteal (heals on normal attacks)
- Deals bonus true damage

### Why Use Fissure?

- Good for **burst-heavy DPS teams** with **Alex + Himiko** or other raw damage setups
- Amplifies damage output
- Adds **healing through attacks**, giving sustain for DPS units

However, Fissure is **less optimal** for **tank-focused teams**.

> "Fissure has potential in heavy-hitting teams, but it falls short in defensive comps. Use it when you're going full damage."

---

## Final Thoughts and Recommendations

### Current Meta Pick: Collapse

- Collapse is currently the most **popular and reliable** skill tree, especially for competitive play
- Offers **high uptime on damage reduction**, essential for tough Conquest fights

### When to Use Each Tree:

| Skill Tree | Best For |
| --- | --- |
| Collapse | Double tank, defensive setups |
| Aftershock | Hybrid and high attack speed teams |
| Fissure | Burst damage, DPS-heavy teams |

### Upgrade Recommendation

If you're deciding which dragon to focus on next, **Earth Dragon Dimitr should be your top priority**:

- **Balanced**: Offers both **sustain and utility**
- **Versatile**: Works in many different team compositions
- **Popular**: Commonly used in top-ranking Conquest teams

> "If I were to recommend one dragon tree to upgrade first, it would be Earth Dragon’s Collapse. It offers the best balance of survivability and team-wide support."

---

Demeter is a versatile and robust dragon in Infinity Kingdom, offering various strategic potentials through its talent trees. Each talent set caters to different playstyles and situations, making Demeter a competitive choice for various scenarios. Given its ease of build, notably with Metallic Fortress being one of the more straightforward gnome bosses, Demeter stands as a solid choice for players looking to bolster their march with a durable and strategically flexible dragon.

title: Earth Himiko Build for season 2 - a Top Meta Build (short of chaos)
summary: The meta in Season 2 starts to look a lot more like Conquest than what you may be used to from Season 1. With Sparks of Galaxy, Theodora, Himiko, and Bjorn become much more doable for a fraction of the cost of Theias in…
markdown:
The meta in Season 2 starts to look a lot more like Conquest than what you may be used to from Season 1. With **Sparks of Galaxy**, **Theodora**, **Himiko**, and **Bjorn** become much more doable for a fraction of the cost of Theias in S1 (roughly $400–$500; [**see the Sparks guide for details**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/sparks-of-galaxy/sparks-of-galaxy-updated-written-2-8-7/)). So this is a **spender build** in S2, but you can still **build toward it** even if you need to keep **Zenobia instead of Theodora** and **Charles instead of Bjorn** for a while. *(Tip: in Conquest the price drops further, and multiple seasons of Battle Pass reduce the price tags considerably.)*

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-145-1024x392.png)

This isn’t a guide on obtaining these immortals. See the separate event guides for that. The point is: in Season 2 this should be thought of as a **spender build** that can compete at the top of the ladders **without using any Chaos Immortals**.

### Core Concept

The core concept relies on **massive sustain and mitigation**, while **Himiko** takes advantage of her **high mage crit chance** and **massive AoE damage and control**. (Himiko can reach that consistent crit feel because she can run **mage-crit-chance artifacts**, not just flat %damage pieces.)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-144-1024x613.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-151-1024x615.png)

Later versions of this build will build into **Fu Fei**, but for now we are assuming you do not have access to max upgraded Chaos Immortals.

---

## Lineup & Flex

Regardless of where you’re at, the setup and skill plan are the same (Theo or Zeno, Bjorn or Charles).

**Spending levels are different for everyone**, so here’s how to think about it:

- **Best non-Chaos setup right now:** **Theodora / Bjorn / YSS / Himiko**. This is the top version for S2 if you can afford it.
- **Growing into it:** You can use **the exact same skill setup** on **Zenobia / YSS / Charles / Himiko** while you build resources. It plays the same way — just slightly less cleanse/mitigation ceiling until you upgrade to Theo and Bjorn.
- **Big spender path (already have Fu Fei in S2):** You can still run the **same overall structure**, but **put Fighting Master on Fu Fei** instead of Himiko. The idea is the same — protect your primary controller/nuker from getting shut down by enemy control.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-152.png)

---

## The Setup

### Healer — Zenobia / Theodora

**Zenobia / Theodora** is your healer, offering strong sustain. **Theodora** adds the huge advantage of **removing Damage over Time (DoT)** effects like **Blade Vortex**, which is very powerful in Season 2.

- Run **Assist** to protect **Himiko’s** troop count.
- Add **Vitality Touch** for extra healing and mitigation.
- Third slot options:  - **Purification** (small heal + dispel),
- **Resist** vs heavy mage enemies, or
- **Malice** (my preferred pick in S2) because consistent crit damage can still be dampened here. *(Late in Conquest, crit scales too high for Malice to keep up, but in S2 it still does work.)*

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-146-1024x572.png)

### Carry — Himiko

**Himiko** is the core immortal. She hits very hard and brings a strong **control effect** that most S2 teams aren’t hard-countering yet (only a few whales will be running **Fu Fei** this early). Even against those, her raw damage is high, especially with elemental advantage versus anything that isn’t **Shadow** or **Holy**.

- Use **Annihilation** and **Spell Disintegration** for damage.
- **Fighting Master** is **mandatory** in S2 to avoid getting shut down by enemy control (including mirror Himikos). This is very important.

*(If you’re a big spender running **Fu Fei** this season, shift **Fighting Master** from Himiko to **Fu Fei** instead, keeping the rest of the plan the same.)*

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-148-1024x625.png)

### Tank/Aura — Bjorn / Charles

This slot gives you **survivability and mitigation** so Himiko can safely do her job. **Bjorn** is the premium pick; **Charles** is fine while you’re building.

- **Energy Shield** for steady shielding and better sustain into spikes.
- **Weakness (Aura)** because in S2 you still want a bit more help reaching that **consistent crit rate** for Himiko. Later you won’t need to burn an aura slot for it, but in S2 you usually do.
- **Weakening Curse** (ideal) to hard-counter enemy physical damage dealers, especially front-loaded lines with **Alex** and similar. If you don’t have **Weakening Curse**, slot **Oaken Guard**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-149-1024x618.png)

### Tank/Buffer — Yi Sun-sin (YSS)

**YSS** is basically mandatory because his ultimate provides **30% less damage taken** and **30% more healing received** (with his unique setup), which perfectly matches a sustain/control plan.

- **Spring of Life** for more sustain in long fights.
- **Energy Suppression**, which is great in S2 since hyper-regen skills like **Corrosive** and **Energy Master** aren’t around yet.  - If you did not slot in **Resist**on your support, you can sometimes get greater value from Resist over Energy Suppression when faced with mage-carry enemies.
- **Jade Barrier** for extra shielding and **magical mitigation**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-150-1024x620.png)

---

### Side notes - If You Lack Expensive Skills

If you don’t have the top-end pieces yet, **grace effects** can hold the line:

- **Blessing of Defense + Oaken Guard** works fine if you aren’t running **Weakening Curse**.
- **Rage Blessing** is also useful if you have an empty slot and no Wisdom Well options yet.

---

## Dragon

Run **Earth Dragon** with the **Collapse specialization** talents for extra mitigation and longer mitigation windows. As you upgrade, **prioritize Sandstorm Breath** — j**[ust stick to the basic, proven dragon upgrade principles you normally follow](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/best-path-to-upgrading-dragon-talents-universal-dragon/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-143-1024x440.png)

---

## Conclusion

For Season 2, **Earth Himiko** is a **spender-friendly, non-Chaos top option** that wins by **outlasting** and **controlling** while **Himiko crit-bombs teams**. The best version right now is **Theodora / Bjorn / YSS / Himiko**, but you can **mirror the skills** on **Zenobia / YSS / Charles / Himiko** while you grow. And if you’re already splashing on **Fu Fei** in S2, run the same idea but **move Fighting Master to Fu Fei** instead of Himiko.
**Bottom line:** build the sustain shell, protect Himiko’s troop count, keep control immunity where it matters, and let her high **mage-crit** setup do the cleanup.

---
