### Infinity Kingdom Guide: Maximizing the "Energy Shield" Skill

**Introduction to Energy Shield**
Welcome to an essential part of your Infinity Kingdom strategy: understanding and utilizing the "Energy Shield" skill. This skill, while not activated at will, plays a critical role in your gameplay, especially during intense battles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-88-1024x547.png)

**Understanding Energy Shield**
The game describes the skill as follows: "Every 6 seconds after the battle starts, there's a 70% chance to shield 3 random friendly units to absorb the damage (Absorb Rate 240%) they take for 3 seconds." In simpler terms, this means that at regular intervals during a battle, there’s a significant chance that a strong protective shield will automatically activate, covering three of your immortals. This shield is potent, absorbing a substantial amount of damage and can be a real game-changer in close fights.

**The Impact of Energy Shield**
The real value of Energy Shield lies in its high absorbency rate. It’s not just a token shield; it provides substantial protection that can be observed in healing reports post-battle. This makes it a skill of high strategic value, especially in prolonged and challenging battles where every bit of damage absorption counts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-89-1024x583.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-90-1024x611.png)

It can be used on both utility and support Immortals for great effect. It dosen't have to be equipped on a healer Immortal, though you may often want to. **Good use cases are: Theo, Zeno, Qin, Cyrus, Khubilai, Charles, Richard, Tokugawa, Trajan, Bjorn, Athena.**

**Acquiring Energy Shield**
To access this skill, players need to participate in the in-game event "Blessings of Triss." This event is a key opportunity to enhance your gameplay and should be a priority, particularly for those who are investing in the Triss event. The skill is gained through participation, making it accessible to players who are actively engaging in this aspect of the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-52-1024x699.png)

**Why Prioritize Energy Shield?**
Given its significant impact on battle outcomes, Energy Shield should be high on the list of priorities for players, especially those willing to spend money on the Triss event. The skill’s ability to randomly protect key units in battle can often be the difference between victory and defeat.

### Tips for Maximizing Energy Shield

- **Understand the Randomness**: The skill’s activation and target selection are random, so ensure all your units are well-prepared to capitalize on the shield when it activates.
- **Complement with Strategy**: Pair Energy Shield with other skills and strategies that synergize with its defensive capabilities. Pair it with defensive auras, blessings and graces as well as a setup that relies on utility and support to win.
- **The only case where I would not recommend this skill**is for people running glass-canon builds, like if you are doing a dual-mage hyper regen fire build with only damage skills. This can be fun, but end of the day you would be better off with a Cyrus build if you got the high end skill and a more defensive setup.

**Conclusion**
The Energy Shield skill in Infinity Kingdom is a powerful tool in any player's arsenal. While it operates automatically, understanding its mechanics and knowing when to expect its activation can give you a strategic edge. Remember, it’s not just about having the skill, but also about integrating it effectively into your overall battle strategy. Good luck, and may your shields hold strong!

title: Equipment ranking - BiS / tier list
summary: You want to replace old gear for new Epic+ or new Epic+ with elemental bonus.
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-04-143344-1.png)

## Key points

You want to replace old gear for new **Epic+** or new **Epic+ with elemental bonus**.

DO NOT replace old Epic+ elemental with new basic epic gear.

### Read the article Level 1-50 – Best Gnomes to farm for more info on gnomes and equipment droprates

## Equipment

As we know, gnome camps drop different equipment ([read gnome item drops](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/farming-gnome-camps/#gnomes-item-drops)). These items have different stat values based on its type. Swords have physical attack, strength and crit value. Robes has Physical Defense, Magical Defense, Strength and Dodge Value, etc.

These stats are predefined based on the item type and item slot. You cannot change of mod the stat types. What you can do, is upgrade your equipment scaling the value of each stat higher with every level/rank.

In addition to an items level/rank an items sum of stats are increased by the rarity of the item. Rare items are stronger than Uncommon items because it yields more stat value for each stat. Likewise, the Rare item is weaker than Elite equipment - and so on.

### Epic items have additional inherent item tiers within the quality type:

1. ****Epic****+**** elemental****(if bonus applies)
2. ****Epic elemental**** (if bonus applies)
3. **Epic+**
4. **Epic**

With the new release of items from 1.8 patch, the above tier system no longer works as old items carry lower stats than their new version equivilants. The following is an example of how old item tiers compare to new 1.8 items of same tier and quality.

## 1.8 Equipment ranking

**This example looks at a Tank Helmet level 0**.

| Best item rank | OLD / NEW | Quality | Physical Defense | Magical Defense | Agility | Accuracy Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | OLD | Epic+ | 27,1 | 21,1 | 18,1 | 36,2 |
| 5 | NEW | Epic | 29,6 | 23 | 19,7 | 39,5 |
| 4 | OLD | Epic+ elemental | 31,2 | 24,3 | 20,8 | 41,6 |
| 3 | NEW | Epic+ | 32,6 | 25,3 | 21,7 | 43,4 |
| 2 | NEW | Epic elemental | 34,04 | 26,45 | 22,66 | 45,43 |
| 1 | NEW | Epic + elemental | 37,49 | 29,1 | 25 | 49,9 |

## Explanation

The stats on epic gear is identical to epic with elemental bonus. Likewise, epic+ and epic+ with elemental bonus gear is also identical (see below). Therefore, this means that**if you have no elemental gear for a specific item slot** on one of your immortals, you should run **any epic+ OR epic+ elemental of any element** - since even without the bonus, **an epic+ with the wrong element** is still equal to an epic+ and **superior to the old elemental gear.**

Calculating the bonus of elemental gear is easy. As stated on the items, you get a 15% stat boost if you equip set item on an immortal from the matching element. Hence, our Epic elemental helmet from the above calculations, has a base value of 29,6 physical defense * 1,15 = 34,04.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/271935826_3113184855622110_2286041138189330133_n.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/272278454_480684133421005_3581280038560961513_n.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/271807827_1093721804722061_3770732771465622386_n.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/267219446_988099598724174_5234822168722543099_n.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/267084175_991608115102848_2853456404163423312_n.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/h3.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/h2.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/h1.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/3.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/2.jpg)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/1.jpg)

## Scaling does not change the calculations/rankings

Leveling an item up increases its' stat value. Therefore, there might be scaling issues that would change the rankings as an item is leveled up. **It does not appear so.** The ranking remain: **New ele bonus > New epic+ > old ele bonus > new epic >** rest.

title: Eternal Battlelust (legendary)
summary: Eternal Battlelust is one of those skills that looks excessive on paper, and unusually, it largely lives up to that impression in practice. A fully stacked +100% physical damage and 20% damage reduction is not just…
markdown:
### Introduction

Eternal Battlelust is one of those skills that looks excessive on paper, and unusually, it largely lives up to that impression in practice. A fully stacked +100% physical damage and 20% damage reduction is not just strong—it fundamentally shifts how a march performs over the duration of a fight.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-77.png)

However, unlike traditional flat buffs, this skill is entirely conditional. Its value depends on how quickly and consistently you can generate stacks. That makes it less of a universal plug-in and more of a build-defining skill that requires deliberate synergy.

---

### How the Skill Actually Works

The key line in the description is: *“Each instance of passive damage or triggered skill damage…”*

This creates two important mechanical realities:

#### 1. Stacks are Instance, Not Time-Based

Every individual damage tick counts separately. This includes:

- Passive damage (e.g. **Battle Frenzy**)
- Trigger skills (if they proc)

A single skill that hits multiple times can generate several stacks quickly.

#### 2. No Internal Cooldown

Eternal Battlelust does **not** appear to have a hidden cooldown per stack. If you can generate rapid ticks, you can ramp very quickly.

#### 3. Scaling Curve Matters

The skill starts at 0 stacks, so:

- Early fight = weak
- Mid fight = strong
- Late fight = overwhelming

This makes it particularly effective in:

- Longer PvP fights
- Sustain-based marches
- Tanky frontline setups that can survive long enough to scale

---

### Optimal Synergy: Passive vs Trigger Damage

You already pointed out the key distinction, and it’s worth reinforcing:

#### Passive Damage (Reliable Core)

- **Battle Frenzy** is one of the best enablers
- Gaze of Silence (Medusa's Ultimate Ability)
- Consistent tick-based damage builds stacks *predictably*

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-78.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-79.png)

This is what you build around. If you are running multiple legendary skills, you most likely will be able to use chaos immortals as well, this skill seems to be built specifically for Medusa! That being said, you can run it elsewhere if you do not have a maxed Medusa at the ready.

#### Triggered Damage (Supplemental)

- **Attack & Defense**
- **Drastic Action**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-80.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-81.png)

These can accelerate stacking, but:

- They are RNG-dependent
- Inconsistent early procs can delay your ramp

---

### Example Setup: Medusa Core

Your suggested build with good results:

- **Immortal:** Medusa
- **Skills:**  - Battle Frenzy
- Attack & Defense
- Eternal Battlelust

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-82.png)

#### Why This Works

- **Medusa’s Gaze of Silence** applies consistent passive damage instances
- **Battle Frenzy** adds another passive damage source
- **Attack & Defense** adds more damage instances, albeit as a chance trigger skill
- Combined, you get multiple stack triggers per second cycle

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-83.png)

---

### Where Eternal Battlelust Performs Best

#### 1. Physical Damage Marches

The +100% physical damage scaling is the main payoff. Magic marches don’t benefit in the same way.

#### 2. Sustain / Mid-Length Fights

Glass cannon builds don’t use this well. You need time to stack.

#### 3. Control + Sustain Compositions

Anything that:

- Slows fights down
- Applies ongoing sustain and mitigation

…naturally feeds the stacking mechanic.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-84.png)

---

### Availability and Cost (Wisdom Well Investment)

Eternal Battlelust is exclusively available on Legendary season servers. For anyone in seasons or Conquest, make note of this skill, consider banking Elixir in anticipation of entering legendary season, if your goal is a high-spender chaos march with Medusa.

**Pricing estimates**:

Legendary skills have 8 total levels. Unlocking a skill requires 60 stones. Subsequent upgrades increase in cost, with a total of 240 stones required to reach level 8.

Since each stone costs 5 Wisdom Elixir, the total Elixir requirements are straightforward. Unlocking a Legendary skill costs 300 Elixir. Fully upgrading that skill to level 8 costs **1,200 Elixir in total.**

Using the same average expected drop rates from Wisdom Well **[(read more here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/blessings-of-triss/wisdom-well-2-9-1-elixir-cinders-legendary-skills-etc/)**), fully maxing a Legendary skill requires **approximately 1,280 to 1,320 Wishes, with the midpoint sitting near 1,290.**

---

### Conclusion Summary

Eternal Battlelust is not just strong—it’s *conditional power at its extreme*.

For instance, when I ran it in a Medusa-based march alongside Battle Frenzy, stacks built so quickly that by mid-fight the damage output noticeably overtook standard builds. The added 20% mitigation also made frontline units feel much harder to break.

On the other hand, when I tried fitting it into a more traditional physical burst setup without consistent passive damage, it rarely exceeded 8–10 stacks before the fight was effectively decided. In those cases, a simpler flat-damage skill performed better.

---

markdown:
***Time Rift Breaker – A Game-Changing Event***

The Time Rift Breaker event is unquestionably one of the most anticipated additions in Version 2.6.2. It promises to be a game-changer, reminiscent of the beloved Spider event, but on a grander scale. This cross-server event invites lords from the same season to unite and confront a formidable adversary. It introduces a dynamic twist to the gameplay, where lords must strategize based on elemental weaknesses, adding an extra layer of depth to battles. With different elemental weaknesses and a prolonged cross-server format, it’s an event that holds immense promise and anticipation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-15-1024x538.png)

### Time Rift Breaker 101 – A Cross-Server Challenge

One of the standout additions to Infinity Kingdom in Version 2.6.2 is the Time Rift Breaker event. This is a cross-server event that allows lords from the same season to come together and challenge a formidable adversary. To access the event, simply tap on the “Well of Time” located in the bottom-right corner of your screen.

### Event Requirements:

- Your server must have entered Season 2.
- Your Castle Level must be equal to or higher than Level 15.

### Event Period:

- The event starts every Monday at 00:00 (UTC) and concludes every Sunday at 24:00 (UTC).
- During the first two days (Monday to Wednesday), the enemy is in the recharge and incubation stage and cannot be attacked.
- The challenge stage begins every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC) and runs until Sunday at 24:00 (UTC). During this period, you can attack the enemy. If defeated, the enemy will resurrect after a certain time or escape if not defeated.

### Event Rules:

- Each lord has **three** challenge attempts daily.
- All battles in this event are automatic.
- Immortals deployed in a challenge **cannot**be used again on the same day.
- Utilize Immortals of the corresponding elements to deal additional damage based on the Time Rift Breaker’s elemental weakness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-16.png)

### Event Rewards:

- The event offers a variety of rewards, including Total Damage Ranking Rewards, Highest Damage Ranking Rewards, Kill Rewards, and Honor Rewards.
- These rewards will grant you Space-Time Glory Badges, which can be exchanged for valuable items in the shop.

## A brand new awesome event

**The Time Rift Breaker event stands out as a cross-server extravaganza, allowing lords from the same season to unite in a shared challenge**. This feature brings a sense of unity and camaraderie among players who might have previously been isolated within their servers. The prospect of joining forces with lords from other realms introduces an exciting new dimension to the game, fostering a sense of community beyond one's server.

What sets this event apart is its elemental complexity. Lords must carefully strategize, considering the elemental strengths and weaknesses of their Immortals. This strategic layer adds depth to battles, making every choice and move count. It's a feature that rewards thoughtful planning and diversity in Immortal selection, ultimately leading to more engaging and dynamic encounters.

***Cross-Server Unity:*** The Time Rift Breaker is not just a server-specific event. It's a cross-server extravaganza that brings lords from different seasons together. This unification breaks down barriers and fosters a sense of community beyond individual servers. Players will forge new alliances, share knowledge, and face challenges together. It's a step towards a more connected and immersive gaming experience.

***Extended Engagement:*** The event's format, spanning from Monday to Sunday each week, ensures that lords have ample time to participate and immerse themselves in the action. The inclusion of incubation and challenge stages adds a unique rhythm to the event, keeping players eagerly anticipating each stage's trials.

***Strategy Meets Rewards:***With each lord granted three daily challenge attempts, strategy becomes paramount. Every move must be calculated to maximize success. The rewards on offer, including Total Damage Ranking Rewards, Highest Damage Ranking Rewards, Kill Rewards, and Honor Rewards, provide compelling incentives for participation. Space-Time Glory Badges, the event's currency, can be exchanged for valuable items in the shop, further fueling the competitive spirit.

In summary, the Time Rift Breaker is an event that's generating immense anticipation. It promises to be the hallmark of Infinity Kingdom's gaming experience, offering a blend of excitement, strategy, and camaraderie that players eagerly await. With its promise of being an enhanced version of the beloved Spider event, different elemental dynamics, and an expansive cross-server format, the Time Rift Breaker is poised to be a game-changer that players can't wait to dive into. It's an event that holds the potential to reshape the very fabric of the Infinity Kingdom.

title: Event Overview
summary: The Malena Ambition event, which occurs monthly in the Infinity Kingdom, has been the subject of much discussion. In this article, we aim to provide an in-depth look into common mistakes made during the event and what…
markdown:
The Malena Ambition event, which occurs monthly in the Infinity Kingdom, has been the subject of much discussion. In this article, we aim to provide an in-depth look into common mistakes made during the event and what preparation steps should be taken to secure a high score.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-45.png)

## Planning

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-44.png)

The most crucial step is to develop a plan and share it in the alliance letter. This feature allows for statistical voting to determine attendance levels. If there are many high-power participants, it's advisable to defend a high-level city. On the other hand, if the attendance is dominated by low-power participants, a city with a lower level should be chosen. Neglecting to plan and prepare is a common mistake made by many alliances.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-46-1024x583.png)

Reminding Remind your members by using the alliance calendar, so everyone is aware of the event. This feature can send notifications to alliance members, including via their cell phones.

## Common mistakes

Make sure to protect your strong troops by placing them in the city's garrison. Troops outside the green line's range can defend the castle within the green circle. Avoid panicking during the invasion of the gnomes.

Basically, if you are inside the green area you must garrison yourself. A good way to kill off invading gnomes with a march that needs to replenish/refill troops often. Your strongest marches can be on the city walls while a march that barely beats the gnomes is more than enough on your castle, it would need constant marching on the walls. Hence you maximize the use of your four marches.

If you want to avoid any incoming attack, place yourself outside the area and just send garrisons to the walls. This works if you are a whale who can take on many incoming attacking without loosing eventually. If you only kill a few gnome armies before loosing and having to march all the way back and forth, it is a waste of time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-48.png)

But this is a great way to get whales to help even without being online! They can simply sit in safe area having sent garrisons to the walls before logging off.

## Alliance Rankings

To score the highest points, it's important to flawlessly maintain gate defense. Although it may be challenging, the rewards for a successful defense will be significant.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/image-47-1024x565.png)

Obtaining Rank 1 in Malena Ambition By following the steps outlined above, your alliance has the potential to rank first in the Malena Ambition event. An easier option is to join a server that is dominated by one alliance.

## Power Recommendations

For Low Death Troops in Norheim's City The following is a statistical report for the recommended power levels to achieve low troop deaths in Norheim's city.

**Level 10**: 200,000
**Level 11**: 230,000
**Level 12**: 250,000
**Level 13**: 280,000
**Level 14**: 320,000
**Level 15**: 350,000

I hope that this article provides valuable information on how to achieve a top ranking in the Malena Ambition event. The event is a great opportunity to test your alliance's cohesiveness. To rank first, it requires proper preparation or domination of a server by one alliance.

The Titantula Spider event is amazing if you know how to take full advantage. By building a solid team and consistently tanking in this event, you can boost your power significantly and save / supplement your spending a lot.

The event occur twice a week on wednesday and sunday at fixed times. So setup your team, set the alarm on your phone and reap awesome rewards! This articles goes over the ranking part of the spider event, if you need info on the basic participation rewards, you can find them **[here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pve/spider-boss/titantula-participation-rewards/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-6-1024x537.png)

## Rewards

| Rank | Gems | Philosopher Stones | Universal speedup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 500 | 5 | 39 hours |
| 2 | 350 | 4 | 25 hours |
| 3 | 250 | 3 | 17 hours |
| 4-10 | 150 | 2 | 10 hours |
| 11-50 | 100 | 1 | 6 hours |
| 51-100 | 50 | 1 | 4.5 hours |
| 101-100000 | 0 | 0 | 2.5 hours |

You should always try and get the last hit. Beware, that you must remain top 10 for the kill, but once that is secured, you should try and hit the killing blow. Be slow with it, it is better to miss your hit because someone else got the kill than to use an attack on a spider where you would have ranked top 10 anyway. The attack is refunded if you hit after the spider is dead.

Only exception to this, is if you are in close competition with someone and can see you will likely end on the same number of ranking points (event ranking). Then you want to hit quickly and get the point cap you both will reach - **you want to do this, because if two players are tied in points, the player who got the points first wins.**

Read my [guides](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pve/spider-boss/)for info on how to setup your march right so you consistenly compete for the no. 1 ranking, e.g. my guide for [killing blow tips n tricks](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pve/spider-boss/ranking-strategies-killing-blow/).

Rewards from attacks on spider are as follow.

| Attack | Justice Points | Enchant Stones |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single attack | 1,250 (cap) | 24,100 |  |
| Killing Blow | 9,000 | 134,400 |  |
| Top 10 damage placement (on any of the spiders of the day) | 7,000 | 102,400 |  |

## Tips n tricks

Getting killing blows require some finess and a good bit of luck.

You need to make yourself a march that deals around 1% in damage, reliably. See my guides on marches.

When the spider is active, you need to watch carefully who in your server turns up, watch the damage meter and how much power the attendees have. Based on this you can aproximate their damage dealt per hit and count down to the killing blow.

I usually use the last 30% to take note of the attacks. I move quickly from each of the three spider spawns and simply count attacks landing on the spider (take note if high power people are idle untill last min you wanna adjust accordingly). When the spider have droppedn from 30% to 20% I note how many attacks were made - e.g. let's say 15. If from 20% to 10% takes 13 hits, I will then make sure that my last attack is made as the 13th attack move towards the spider.

If powerful people are at spider trying to snipe it, I will subtract a chunck of hits and go when I have seen 10 armies marching.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Skaermbillede-2022-04-06-165824-1024x577.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/IMG_0340-1-1024x768.png)

The Original Festival has begun! From the 16th to the 21st of April players are able to participate in the Original Festival for a bit of post-easter celebrations! During these six days, players can participate in a variety of activities and earn rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-54-1024x411.png)

## Main Rewards Summary

Rewards come in two tiers: The first tier is for free-to-play players with farmable Frigg Souvenir Coin as the main currency. The Second tier of rewards costs the Original Crystal currency. This currency is a "spender" currency. You can get 3x via gems in the Colorful Party, but the rest are only available in recharge bundles costing real fiat currency to exchange.

## Tier 2 rewards (F2P):

- For 5 Souvenir Coins you can buy the "full of energy" chest containing either valuable AP potions of universal speeds. A very very good chest and **you want to purchase all 3 in stock.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-39.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-42-1024x414.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-49.png)

I want to make sure to purchase 3x Full of Energy spending just 15 free-to-play Souvenir Coins. I will also make sure to get the Miracles of Goddess for 120 coins just because purple crystals is always worth banking. All remaining coin I will be dumping into as many speed-ups as I can.

The Unique Artifact for Alex, Attila, Cid or Saladin costs 100 Crystals translating into 85$. markdown:
### Player Guide: Enhancing Energy Regeneration in Infinity Kingdom

Energy regeneration is a critical mechanic in Infinity Kingdom, influencing the frequency with which immortals can unleash their ultimate skills. Each immortal has a base energy regeneration rate that contributes to how quickly they can reach the required 1000 energy points to activate their ultimate ability. This guide explores various strategies to maximize energy regeneration, thereby increasing your team's effectiveness in battle through faster skill deployment.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-130.png)

### Understanding Energy Regeneration

### Key Concepts:

- **Base Energy Regeneration:** This is the innate rate at which an immortal gains energy per second during battle.
- **Activation Threshold:** Immortals need 1000 energy points to activate their ultimate skills.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-131.png)

### Methods to Boost Energy Regeneration

Boosting your immortals' energy regeneration can significantly impact their performance by enabling more frequent use of powerful ultimate skills. Here are several ways to enhance energy regeneration:

### Lord Talents:

- Opt for talents like "Owl Guardian" to increase an immortal's energy regeneration speed by 5%.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-132.png)

### Academy Research:

- Invest in specific research paths within the Academy that boost energy regeneration rates.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-133-1024x494.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-134-1024x471.png)

### Immortal Skills:

- Some immortals come equipped with skills that enhance their energy regeneration or provide additional energy under certain conditions.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-135-1024x658.png)

### Artifacts:

- Look for artifacts that carry the "Surge" attribute, which increases energy regeneration.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-136.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

Skills like Rage Blessing and Battle Stance provide temporary boosts to energy regeneration, which can be pivotal during the initial phases of combat or in prolonged battles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-138.png)

Moreover, Energy Burst and Adrenaline Rush provide energy regen upon trigger activation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-137-1024x550.png)

### Tactical Application

Selecting the right immortals and effectively utilizing energy regeneration strategies can lead to quicker skill activations, which is crucial for maintaining battlefield control and executing timely heals and attacks. For example, pairing immortals with high natural energy regeneration with skills and artifacts that boost this further can create a formidable force capable of frequent ultimate skill use.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-139-1024x423.png)

### Countering Energy Regeneration

To excel in PvP and maintain a competitive edge, understanding how to counter high energy regeneration setups is crucial:

**Energy Suppression:** Skills like "Energy Suppression" can halve an opponent's energy regeneration speed, significantly delaying their ability to use ultimate skills.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-140.png)

**Silence Effects:** Utilizing skills that silence, auch as Attila's ultimate or No Escape TOK skill can prevent opponents from using their skills, effectively stalling their strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-141.png)

**Control Effects:** Employing stuns, roots, and similar effects disrupts enemy actions, including their energy regeneration processes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-142.png)

**Enhancing Dodge:** Increasing your immortals' dodge rate through skills such as "Misleading" or "After-image" can reduce the effective hits received, thus indirectly affecting the enemy's energy gain from successful attacks. Beware though that dodge tactics are easily countered with accuracy boosts like Coercion and Dragon Talents. Moreover, while dodging is extreemly powerful against physical damage dealers, it carries no value at all versus magical damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-143.png)

### Final Thoughts

Mastering energy regeneration and its counters isn't just about enhancing your own team's abilities—it's also about strategically impairing your opponent's capabilities. By integrating these insights into your gameplay, you can ensure that your immortals not only perform optimally but also adapt to counter high-energy regeneration strategies effectively. Stay updated with each meta shift and adjust your tactics to maintain dominance on the battlefield.

markdown:
### he Ultimate Portal Guide for F2P and Spenders in Infinity Kingdom

Portals in Infinity Kingdom are akin to golden keys, unlocking the potential for players to venture into new realms by changing servers. However, navigating the intricacies of acquiring these Portals can be a daunting task, especially considering their significance and the cost associated with them. Whether you're a staunch free-to-play (F2P) enthusiast or a willing spender, this guide will illuminate the path to obtaining Portals in the most efficient manner possible.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-41.png)

## Earning Alliance Coins: The How-To

#### For the Free-to-Play (F2P) Players

### Alliance Shop: The F2P Lifeline

- **Daily Portal Purchase:** Each Portal costs 20,000 Alliance coins, with the option to purchase one per day. This is the primary avenue for F2P players to accumulate Portals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-43.png)

- **Alliance Donations:** A simple yet effective method. Resource donations yield 50 coins each, allowing for a Portal purchase every 16.6 days with consistent daily donations.

**Donations**
1x Resource donation = 50 coins.
20,000 coins = 1 portal.

- 24/day, 50coins per donations = 1200coins/day –> 1 portal every 16.6 days

**Gem donations**1x gem donation = 50 coins.
20,000 coins = 1 portal.

- 10 gem donates/ 10 donations/ 500coins/day (100gems) —> 1 portal every 40 days
- 10 gem donates/ 20 donations/ 1000coins/day (200gems) —> 1 portal every 20 days
- 10 gem donates/ 40 donations/ 2000coins/day (400 gems) —> 1 portal every 10 days

If you want to gem donations, you must find a low lvl alliance, as they only cost 10 gems each here where as alliances close to maximum level costs far more. Bare in mind, you can also crit on donations, giving you additional points, while this is not part of the calculations above, you should note that with luck you get a few more points during the same timeframe.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-11-15-132027.png)

- **Gem Donations:** Varying gem donation strategies can significantly impact your Portal acquisition rate. Donating gems in a low-level alliance, where costs are minimal, accelerates the process. The rate of acquisition can vary from one Portal every 10 to 40 days, depending on the number of donations and gems spent.
- **Construction Contributions:** Engaging in city construction within your alliance is a lucrative method to earn Alliance coins. Utilizing 1-troop marches to extend the construction period maximizes the rewards without actually completing the upgrade, enabling a steady stream of Alliance coins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-11-15-131725-1024x475.png)

If you are in a server where most cities are max level or you are running out of cities to build for coin-rewards, you must make sure leadership stays on top of the city development bar and you need to make sure everyone is sending a 1-troop march to build the city.

**Why drop cities?** Simply because by dropping a city you reset the current development towards another level. When our “build city” gets close to finishing a build, we drop it, re-siege it, and the building can begin all over.

**Why use 1-troop marches?** Because the way that the game rewards players for contributing to building a city is a flat-value. The more troops you have building, the faster the city builds – but a march with 1-troop and a march with 70K troops will reward the exact same number of alliance coins! This means that if you do not want your city to actually finish upgrading, you want to have everyone send only 1-troop into the city, creating a very very long upgrade timer and lots of coin rewards for everyone.

### Alliance coin from construction

- 1200coins per day with 1 march —> 1 portal every 16.6 days
- 2400coins per day with 2 march —> 1 portal every 8.3 days
- 3600coins per day with 3 March —> 1 portal every 5.5 days
- 4800coins per day with 4 march —> 1 portal every 4.2 days

## Legion of Frostborne Donations:

- Participating in SvS and donating towards Cities and Gate Garrisons can also reward Alliance coins, with 1 million resources translating to 50 Alliance coins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-47.png)

**1 million resources = 50 alliance coins**. This means that you can buy **1 Portal by donating 400M resources in SvS**.

## For Spenders and Light Spenders

### Golden Path Shop: A Valuable Resource

- **Merit Coins for Portals:** The Golden Path Shop offers Portals at the cost of 100 Merit Coins each, with a cap of 10 Portals per season. This method requires the Medallion level 50 and is a high-value option for those who invest in the monthly Medallion.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-45-1024x482.png)

### In-Game Shop: Direct Purchases

- **Weekly Portal Bundles:** Post-Legion of Frostborne seasons often feature double-value Portal bundles, providing an opportune moment for spenders to stock up on Portals at a more economical rate. Prices range from $5 to $100, with the number of Portals increasing with the bundle's value:
- $5 pack – 1 portal
- $10 pack- 2 portals
- $20 pack – 3 portals
- $50 pack – 4 portals
- $100 pack – 5 portals

#### Strategic Considerations for All Players

- **Efficient Use of Resources:** Whether F2P or a spender, the key to maximizing Portal acquisition lies in strategic resource management and taking advantage of every opportunity provided by the game's mechanics and events.
- **Plan Ahead:** Knowing the number of Portals required for your server migration goals is crucial. Engage in planning and resource allocation early to ensure a smooth transition when the time comes.

#### Conclusion

The recent changes to Portal acquisition present both challenges and opportunities for Infinity Kingdom players. While F2P players must employ strategic planning and efficient resource utilization, spenders can leverage their investments for a more straightforward path to server migration. Regardless of your play style, understanding and maximizing the available methods for obtaining Portals will be key to your success in exploring new horizons within the game.

Stay informed, plan strategically, and may your journey through the realms of Infinity Kingdom be both fruitful and fulfilling.

Changing servers is a big project for most players. Even for spenders, migration can be a very expensive and cumbersome task simply because you need quite a lot of portals to migrate to a new server in Infinity Kingdom.

In this guide, we are going to have a look at how to obtain portals both through Free-To-Play methods and through spender bundles.

**[Checkout my article on Portal-table here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/infinity-kingdom-game-updates/how-many-portals-to-change-server/portals-how-and-how-many/)**

markdown:
### The Ultimate Guide to the Contention of Relics (CoR) Event in Infinity Kingdom

The *Contention of Relics (CoR)* is one of the most thrilling and rewarding events in *Infinity Kingdom*. This recurring event pits the three kingdoms against each other in an epic struggle for Energy Cubes within the Forbidden Zone. Successful participation not only advances your development but also grants access to exclusive rewards, including the coveted Fire Immortal. Let’s dive into the basics of CoR, its phases, strategies, and how to secure victory for your faction.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-155-1024x569.png)

---

### Understanding CoR: The Basics

The CoR event recurs approximately every two weeks. The objective is straightforward: compete to collect Energy Cubes by capturing relics and event nodes in the Forbidden Zone. However, success requires extensive preparation, teamwork, and strategy.

### Preparation is Key:

- Stockpile **healing speedups** and **training speedups** to sustain your army during the battles.
- Ensure your **Training Grounds** are full of soldiers for your main march.
- Gather enough resources for troop training, as there are no resource nodes within the Forbidden Zone during the event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-156-1024x499.png)

---

### Event Phases

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-157-1024x567.png)

#### Day One: Preparation and PvP Begin

On the first day, alliances position themselves strategically along the borders of the Forbidden Zone.

- **Positioning**: Group near the relic your alliance plans to capture first to ensure unity and prevent isolated attacks.
- **Golem Bosses**: Farmable for event currency, these bosses are a good source of additional resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-158.png)

- **PvP Event**: Engaging in battles within the Forbidden Zone contributes to the PvP ranking, so focus your fights in this area.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-159-1024x541.png)

---

#### Day Two: Node Collection and Relic Sieging

The second phase marks the activation of nodes and relic cities, where alliances earn Energy Cubes and event currency.

- **Event Nodes**: Capture and hold nodes to accumulate event points and Valor marks. Holding nodes for extended periods is critical for your alliance's success.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-160-1024x421.png)

- **Quests**: Complete daily alliance and individual quests to earn gems and Valor marks. Expect about **600 gems daily** and **5,000 Valor marks** for reasonable quest completion.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-161-1024x516.png)

- **Relic Cities**: The outer relics become capturable, but expect heavy PvP combat while sieging these cities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-162.png)

- **Pro Tip**: Surround siege areas with your castles and use smaller, shielded castles to block enemy attacks effectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-163.png)

---

#### Day Three: The Final Push and World Heart Siege

The final phase of CoR revolves around maintaining relic control and capturing the World Heart.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-164-1024x483.png)

- **World Heart Activation**: The center of the Forbidden Zone becomes available for siege. Capturing it is mandatory for victory.
- **Multiple Sieges**: Be prepared to retake the World Heart multiple times if needed to secure enough points for the win.
- **Relic Control**: Continue to hold and defend relics, as they remain crucial for your alliance's score.

---

### Winning Conditions

To win CoR, your faction must:

1. Score the **highest points** with a minimum of **200,000 points**.
2. Successfully capture the **World Heart**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-165-1024x261.png)

Victory allows your faction to appoint a king, who can distribute rewards to contributors.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-166-1024x486.png)

---

### Strategic Tips for Success

1. **Plan Positioning Carefully**  - Place your castles strategically around siege zones. Surround relics and the World Heart with green and yellow zones covered to minimize enemy access.
2. **Use Shields and Blocking Tactics**  - Deploy shielded smaller castles or alternate accounts around the siege area to block enemies from approaching. This forces them to take longer march routes, giving your alliance a critical edge.
3. **Prioritize Nodes and Relics**  - Assign players to hold nodes and relics while others focus on offense and defense. Efficient coordination ensures steady Energy Cube accumulation.
4. **Coordinate PvP Efforts**  - Communicate with your alliance to target key enemy players and alliances strategically. Focus on disabling their top performers while protecting your own.
5. **Manage Resources and Speedups**  - Ensure you have enough speedups and resources to sustain troops throughout the event. Training new units during downtime can keep your forces strong.

---

### Conclusion

The Contention of Relics is a challenging but rewarding event that tests your alliance’s coordination, strategy, and endurance. By following this guide, preparing thoroughly, and executing your tactics effectively, you can lead your faction to victory and reap the rich rewards of this epic battle.

Best of luck in the Forbidden Zone! May your alliances stand strong and claim the relics for glory!

title: Everything You Need to Know About the New Spar System

markdown:
### Introduction

The Alliance Sparring system is one of the most significant quality-of-life additions Infinity Kingdom has received in years. Until now, practicing PvP outside of Legion of Frostborne was surprisingly difficult. On many servers, Norheim has (on most servers) long been governed by non-aggression agreements or dominated by a single alliance, leaving little opportunity to test new marches or simply enjoy PvP between major events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-7-1024x452.png)

Sparring changes that. Instead of leaving your alliance to duel other players or waiting weeks for the next KvK, alliances can now organize internal battles between two teams of up to fifteen players. The result is a flexible PvP sandbox that serves as a testing ground, a source of Honor, and a genuinely fun activity during quieter periods of the game.

---

## Creating a Spar

Starting a Spar is straightforward, it simply requires two team leaders.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-4-1024x542.png)

A player initiated the spar by clicking on an alliance friends nameplate, and hitting Spar.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-8.png)

That begins the spar selecting two players who will then become captains of the two sparring teams. Each captain can send a Spar invitation via the chat to alliance members, and members can apply to join via the tab function.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-6-1024x662.png)

Players are free to organize balanced teams, create veteran-versus-veteran matches, or deliberately split stronger players across both sides for more competitive battles. Since each team can contain up to fifteen members, there is plenty of room for large-scale fights involving most of the alliance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-3-1024x250.png)

Once players have joined, both teams simply move onto the world map and begin fighting.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-5-1024x231.png)

---

## How Spar Battles Work

Although Sparring is friendly competition, the battles themselves use normal combat mechanics.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-1-1024x461.png)

Troops are wounded and prosperity is lost exactly as they would be during ordinary PvP. Territory resources, however, are not affected, making Sparring far less disruptive than real alliance warfare.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-2-1024x391.png)

When the session is over, either team leader can simply disband the Spar.

---

## An Excellent Environment for Testing

Perhaps the biggest advantage of Sparring is the ability to test builds under realistic conditions.

Arena battles provide only limited information, while Legion of Frostborne often carries consequences for failed experiments. Sparring removes much of that pressure and gives players a controlled environment to compare marches, dragons, artifacts, skill combinations and positioning against opponents they know.

For players who enjoy theorycrafting, this is probably the most valuable addition. Rather than relying entirely on combat reports from major events, alliances can now answer questions directly.

How does a new artifact perform against Holy? Is Blood Frenzy actually outperforming Demonic Contract? Does changing one support immortal improve consistency? Instead of guessing, you can simply test it.

---

## More Than Practice

One of the more pleasant surprises is how naturally Sparring turns into its own activity.

During downtime between KvK seasons, many alliances have little to do beyond routine PvE. Sparring fills that gap remarkably well. Players can organize internal tournaments, challenge rival groups within the alliance, or simply divide into two balanced teams and spend an evening fighting for fun.

Because Honor is earned from Spar battles, the activity also provides meaningful progression rather than existing purely for entertainment.

It creates exactly the kind of repeatable PvP many players have been requesting for years.

---

## Things to Know Before You Start

A few mechanics are worth keeping in mind before organizing your first Spar.

- Each side can field up to **15 players**.
- Sparring only works on your server's **Norheim world map**.
- Normal troop losses and prosperity loss still apply.
- Territory resources are never lost.
- Participants may attack members of the opposing Spar team.
- Honor can be earned, subject to the daily cap.
- Certain world-map activities become unavailable while participating in a Spar.
- Team leaders can disband the Spar when the event is finished.

---

## Final Thoughts

The Alliance Sparring system succeeds because it addresses a problem that has existed since Infinity Kingdom launched. Outside of Legion of Frostborne, meaningful PvP opportunities have often been scarce, particularly on mature servers where diplomacy limits open-world fighting.

Rather than forcing players to leave their alliance or wait for the next competitive event, Sparring creates a space where alliances can practice, theorycraft and simply enjoy PvP together.

For players interested in improving their marches, it may become one of the best tools in the game. For everyone else, it adds something Infinity Kingdom has arguably been missing for years: a reason to log in with your alliance and fight purely because it's fun.

---

title: Everything you need to know before going into season 2 (updated 2.9.8)
summary: Season 2 is still an important transition in Infinity Kingdom, but it is no longer the huge wall of newly unlocked systems that it used to be. Several mechanics that were previously tied directly to Season 2 have been…
categoryPath: Season Progression - Everything you need to know before a new season
markdown:
Season 2 is still an important transition in Infinity Kingdom, but it is no longer the huge wall of newly unlocked systems that it used to be. Several mechanics that were previously tied directly to Season 2 have been moved earlier in account progression, while old events such as Sparks of Galaxy and the Wheel of Stardust are no longer part of the game.

The more useful way to prepare for Season 2 today is to understand **what actually changes, what you should finish before leaving Season 1, and where your resources and spending give you the most value**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-110-1024x461.png)

There are still plenty of opportunities to improve your account during the transition. The Hall of Summoning changes, Golden Path rewards rotate, your dragon development becomes increasingly important, and your longer-term march direction should start becoming clearer. Season 2 is therefore less about suddenly unlocking everything and more about making sure the investment you made during Season 1 continues in the right direction.

---

### Immortal Talents — No Longer a Season 2 Unlock

One of the biggest corrections to the old version of this guide is **Immortal Talents are no longer unlocked simply by entering Season 2**. They now become available as you reach the required Castle progression, so depending on how quickly you develop your account, you may already be working on talents before the season transition.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-113-1024x433.png)

The main progression materials are still **Marks and Insight Books**, with the Elite Well of Time being an important regular source. If Elite Well of Time is already available to you, make sure you are using your attempts consistently rather than waiting for Season 2.

There is also a very good spending option tied to this system. The monthly $10 shop purchase gives you **five additional attempts per day and six Insight Books per day**, making it one of the better recurring purchases for someone actively developing Immortal Talents.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-114-1024x491.png)

- **Priority tip**: Always do your daily Elite Well of Time attempts.
- **[Read the full Immortal Talent and Elite Well of Time guide here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/immortal-talent-specializations/upgrading-immortal-talents-and-well-of-time-elite/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-111-1024x512.png)

For most marches, I start with the main damage dealer but develop the important backline support alongside it rather than pushing the DPS far ahead on its own. For example, when I am developing Wu and Qin together, I generally keep their progression reasonably close.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-112.png)

The reason is that DPS talents give slightly more immediate offensive value per rank, but the cost increases considerably at higher levels. Using the strongest mage route such as **Stormeye**, a rank can provide around **5.5% additional damage and 2.5% Critical Rate**, while a support rank can provide around **4% damage and 20 Initial Energy**. If every rank cost the same amount, pushing the mage would usually be the obvious choice. Once the increasing Insight Book cost is taken into account, developing the support alongside the carry becomes much more efficient.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-115-1024x498.png)

Frontline tanks are usually my lowest priority. I still like getting the **first talent level** relatively early because that activates the important talent effect and, just as importantly, lets you begin spending Marks on the minor nodes. Otherwise you can end up sitting on a huge pile of Marks while Insight Books remain the actual bottleneck.

The main principle is therefore not to max one immortal while ignoring everyone else. Get the important talent effects online, prioritize the immortals that determine how your march actually functions, and spend your expensive later ranks where they have the most impact.

---

### Dragon Specialization Trees

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-116-1024x525.png)

Dragon development remains one of the systems you should be preparing for well before the Season 2 transition. Even if you are not yet able to complete the specialization tree you want, **Dragon Crystals are worth farming continuously** because you will eventually need a very large amount of them.

**[Detailed guide on Dragon Talents can be found here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/)**

For most dragons, I still follow the same broad development route. Start by pushing the initial progression to **2/2**, then bring **Claw and Armor to level 3**. From there, work toward the dragon's important specialization skills and bring the useful damage and defensive nodes to **3/3** before spending heavily on lower-priority stats.

I generally leave things such as Resilience and Accuracy until later unless a particular dragon or build gives me a specific reason to prioritize them. Once the important specialization effects are established, I return to Claw and Armor, push them to **5/5**, and continue through the tree toward the second Claw and Armor nodes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-118-1024x536.png)

The old version of this guide recommended **Sparks of Galaxy** as a major source of Dragon Essences. That advice is obsolete because Sparks of Galaxy is gone. Dragon Essences now need to be collected through the current events, shop and bundle sources, including options such as the Illusion Battle League shop and weekly progression sources and are available in loads in this modern version of the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-117-1024x758.png)

The important preparation advice has not changed, though: **do not neglect Dragon Crystals during Season 1**. Even if Essences temporarily limit how quickly you can move through the specialization tree, you will eventually need the Crystals so bank them!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-153-1024x342.png)

---

### Check Your Season 1 Golden Path Immortals Before Moving On

The **Golden Path rotation changes in Season 2**, and this is one of the things I would actually pay attention to before your server transitions.

**Charles, Baldwin and Genghis Khan disappear from the Golden Path when you move into Season 2.** If one of those immortals is important to the march you are building, check your progress before leaving Season 1 rather than assuming the same fragments will continue being available afterward.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-157-1024x461.png)

Season 2 we are seeing these replaced again with Immortals **Seondeok, Mathilda, Trajan, Ragnar, Mehmed, Darius, etc. who also** become available through the **$4.99 Golden Path**.

For spenders, the $4.99 Golden Path remains one of the better-value purchases in the game. The immortal progression is useful, you can obtain artifacts for elemental and seasonal immortals, and the AP and SP help maintain the pace of account development.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-158-1024x461.png)

Random Immortal Summon Fragments are another useful part of the reward pool because they can potentially provide fragments for immortals that are more difficult to obtain through normal summoning, including Khan.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-156-1024x491.png)

The old reason for recommending Golden Path was often its supply of **Purple Soul Crystals**. Those are still useful, but I would no longer buy the pass because of them. Modern seasonal events provide so many Soul Crystals and Philosopher's Stones that these resources are nowhere near as restrictive as they used to be.

Golden Path is still excellent value. **The reasons for buying it have simply changed.**

## Battle Passes Are Now Tied to Castle Progression

Another major change is that the different Battle Passes are no longer something you should describe as specifically unlocking because you entered Season 2.

Once your account reaches **Castle 40**, the Battle Pass options become available together. Your Castle progression is what matters here rather than the season transition itself.

That means the old distinction of "Season 1 has Golden Path, then Season 2 introduces Legendary Battle Pass" should be ignored.

For spenders, the passes can still provide excellent value, particularly once you have a clear direction toward Holy, Shadow or eventually Chaos development. The important thing is to buy them because their rewards fit your account, not because a guide tells you they are mandatory simply because you entered Season 2.

For most light and mid spenders, I would still put the **$4.99 Golden Path** very high on the list because its cost is low enough that the combination of immortal fragments, artifacts, AP/SP and general progression is difficult to beat.

---

### Chaos Immortals Arrive

Chaos Immortals become an increasingly important part of account planning around this stage, but they should not convince a normal spender to suddenly throw away the march they spent Season 1 developing.

Chaos is expensive.

A Chaos immortal requires substantially more fragments than a normal Epic immortal, and additional fragments are eventually required for talent development as well. Building one quickly can therefore become extremely expensive if you rely on premium events rather than gradual progression.

**[You can see the Immortal fragment requirements here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/specific-immortal-deepdives/star-upgrade-costs-immortal-fragments/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-120-1024x475.png)

For whales, immediately developing new Chaos immortals can make sense because they are paying for the time advantage. For most other players, I would treat Chaos as a **long-term project** and continue making the strongest march possible with the account you already have.

Battle Pass progression and seasonal rewards make gradual Chaos development much more realistic than it once was. There is rarely a need for a mid spender to rush the entire project at premium event prices.

---

## Sparks of Galaxy and Wheel of Stardust Are Gone

If you have been reading older Season 1 and Season 2 guides, this is an important correction.

**Sparks of Galaxy is gone.**

The old recommendation was to use Sparks heavily in Season 2 for Holy and Shadow fragments, Dragon Crystals and Dragon Essences. That used to be a major part of Season 2 spending strategy, but it no longer applies to the current version of the game.

The same is true of the **Wheel of Stardust**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-122.png)

Older advice told Season 1 players to buy as much Stardust as possible before entering Season 2 because the Season 1 wheel offered unusually good value. That system has now been replaced by **Zuma and the current seasonal-event structure**, so there is no reason to hoard Stardust for a transition that no longer exists.

If you see an old guide telling you to spend heavily on Sparks or bank Stardust before Season 2, you are reading advice written for an older version of Infinity Kingdom.

---

## Pearls and Immortal Fragments

Pearls have become more important in the modern progression economy, particularly now that some of the older event systems have disappeared. They can be used toward Immortal Fragments and other useful progression, which makes them worth considering when evaluating daily purchases and seasonal spending.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-154-1024x542.png)

I would still avoid blindly spending Pearls simply because you have them. By this stage of the game, you should be starting to form an idea of which immortals you intend to continue developing through Conquest. Saving flexible currencies until you know what your account actually needs is usually better than spending them immediately for a small short-term improvement.

This is especially true for light and mid spenders, where every premium currency has an opportunity cost.

---

### Artifact Quality and Your Long-Term March

Artifact development becomes increasingly important as your account progresses, but I would approach it differently from the old advice of simply buying every available artifact material each day.

The important question is **which immortals you are actually going to keep using**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-126-1024x769.png)

Season 1 marches can change substantially by Conquest. Spending heavily on artifact empowerment for an immortal you replace shortly afterward is one of those purchases that feels good immediately and looks much worse a few months later.

For players who already know their long-term carry — perhaps Merlin, Wu, Alexander or another immortal they are committed to — artifact investment makes considerably more sense. If your final march is still uncertain, I would be conservative and keep flexible resources available until the direction becomes clearer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-127-1024x545.png)

Materials for these are limited — the **Mysterious Pearl shop’s daily materials** are a must-buy if you’re spending. They’re worth it all season long, and events won’t hand them out often.

---

## Best Value Purchases Around the Season 2 Transition

If you are spending, I would prioritize purchases that either permanently improve the account or give unusually good value for the money rather than trying to buy every new Season 2 mechanic.

The **second permanent builder** is one of the easiest purchases to justify because the benefit stays with your account permanently. Faster development matters throughout the early seasons, and unlike a temporary event bundle, you never outgrow the extra building capacity.

The **$4.99 Golden Path** is another purchase I would rate very highly. The combination of seasonal immortals, artifacts, AP, SP and general progression makes it one of the better low-cost purchases available, particularly now that Soul Crystals themselves are no longer the main reason to buy it.

**Divine Coins** can also be attractive when the **20× limited event** is running. This is the sort of purchase where timing matters considerably; buying the same resource during the correct event can produce much better value than purchasing it whenever it happens to appear in the shop.

Useful **seasonal-event currency** is another place where a small spender can get good value, provided you know what you are targeting in the event. I would rather buy enough currency to reach a meaningful reward breakpoint than spend randomly across several events without completing anything important.

The **$4.99 King of the Hill packs**, bought up to five times when appropriate, can also be a strong option when the immortal being offered fits your account. As always, the value depends on whether you are actually going to use that immortal.

---

## What to Do Before Leaving Season 1

The most important preparation for Season 2 is no longer hoarding one specific event currency. It is making sure your account is ready for the things that actually change.

Before the transition, check your **Golden Path immortals**, particularly Charles, Baldwin and Genghis Khan, because their availability changes once you enter Season 2. Continue farming **Dragon Crystals** rather than waiting until you urgently need them. Keep progressing **Immortal Talents and Elite Well of Time** as soon as your Castle progression makes them available rather than thinking of them as something that begins in Season 2.

I would also take a serious look at your main march before spending heavily on artifacts or specialized resources. By now you should have enough experience with the account to start deciding which element and carry you want to bring toward Conquest. The clearer that plan becomes, the easier every spending decision becomes.

Most importantly, ignore old preparation advice built around **Sparks of Galaxy and Stardust**. Neither should influence how you prepare for the current Season 2.

---

## Main Recommendations

Going into Season 2 today is much more about continuing efficient account development than preparing for a huge list of season-locked systems.

Keep doing your **Elite Well of Time attempts** once they are available and develop your main DPS together with the support immortals that enable it. Get the first talent level on important frontline immortals so their talent effect and minor-node progression are active, but do not sink expensive Insight Book levels into tanks before your damage core is developed.

Keep farming **Dragon Crystals** throughout Season 1. Dragon progression is one of those systems where having a stockpile before you need it feels much better than discovering the bottleneck afterward.

Before the season changes, check whether you still need **Charles, Baldwin or Genghis Khan from Golden Path**. Their Season 1 availability should be treated as something you may want to finish rather than assuming they will remain there indefinitely.

For spenders, prioritize purchases with lasting value. The **second permanent builder and $4.99 Golden Path** are excellent starting points, while Divine Coins during the 20× limited event, useful seasonal-event currency and relevant KoH packs can provide additional value depending on your budget.

Finally, do not build your Season 2 plan around outdated events. **There is no Sparks of Galaxy strategy to prepare for and no Stardust stockpile you need to carry across the transition.**

---

## Conclusion

Season 2 is still where your account starts becoming more specialized, but the transition is much smoother than it used to be. Immortal Talents and Battle Pass access are now tied more closely to Castle progression, seasonal events provide far more basic development resources, and several of the old events that once defined Season 2 spending have disappeared.

The players who prepare well are therefore not necessarily the ones who hoard the most currency. They are the ones who understand what their account is becoming.

Develop your main DPS and its supporting immortals together. Keep your Dragon Crystal farming moving. Check the Season 1 Golden Path before its immortal selection changes. Spend on permanent or unusually efficient progression before chasing expensive short-term advantages, and start thinking seriously about which march you intend to carry into Conquest.

Season 2 is not really the point where the game suddenly begins anymore. It is the point where the decisions you made in Season 1 start turning into a long-term account.

---

title: Everything you need to know going into conquest
summary: What to Expect When Entering Conquest - A practical introduction for players leaving Season 2
categoryPath: Season Progression - Everything you need to know before a new season
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-57.png)

***What to Expect When Entering Conquest** - A practical introduction for players leaving Season 2*

### Introduction

Moving from Season 2 into Conquest is a very different kind of transition than the jump from Season 1 to Season 2. The technology layer is smaller and more restrained, but the *overall* change is actually much larger due to the new skill ecosystem introduced through the updated Wisdom Well. This is the first time players gain access to **Legendary skills**, and the shift fundamentally alters march-building priorities.

Just as important, many of the Season 2 “big spender only” skills become **free-to-play accessible in the Wish Shop** when Conquest begins. This dramatically reshapes what an emerging Conquest account can accomplish, because power spikes that were previously locked behind large paywalls now become obtainable through selling KvK skill stone rewards even for free-to-play players.

You also gain new immortal talents, new troop-specific end nodes, new building levels, expanded Harbour functionality, and new progression tiers across multiple systems. None of these are overwhelming on their own, but together they redefine how efficiently a player grows during Conquest.

With that, **let’s dive into the details.**

---

## 1. New Technology: Small Tree, High Impact

Although Conquest adds fewer tech nodes than your previous season transition, the impact on combat is immediate. Two categories matter most.

## 1.1 Immortal Talents

### Defense Stance (10 Ranks)

Each rank reduces *critical damage taken* by 1%.

This is particularly strong in the current meta, where both **mage teams** and **Genghis Khan–based builds**which lean heavily on high crit rates and consistent ultimate-cycling. Reducing crit damage directly weakens their pressure, making Defense Stance one of the more valuable tech investments you can make early in Conquest.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-58.png)

## 1.2 Troop-Specific End Nodes

All four troop types receive new normal-attack-based passives:

- **Shieldmen:** Reduced damage taken from normal attacks.
Strong into physical sustained-pressure marches, including for example the many Earth–Wind hybrid teams you may have seen a lot during season 1 and 2.
- **Spearmen:** HP leech from normal attacks.
Functionally mild; it rarely changes outcomes but adds a small amount of sustain.
- **Cavalry:** Chance to reduce enemy Physical Defense on normal attack.
This pairs well with cavalry burst profiles, especially Alexander-focused builds.
- **Bowmen:** Chance to reduce enemy Magical Defense on normal attack.
Valuable for mage immortals like Merlin, Wu, and Himiko. It does nothing for physical bowmen such as Bathory or Genghis Khan.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-59.png)

In practice, cavalry and bowmen benefit the most due to their synergy with popular high-output damage cores.

---

## 2. New Troop Technology: Reduced Death Rates

Conquest introduces troop tech that lowers **death rates**, not healing costs.
This distinction matters: lower death rates reduce how many troops you **retrain** after combat. It does not affect your healing queue, but it significantly cuts down the long-term resource burden during prolonged fighting by reducing the amount of training needed to sustain troop counts in your marches. Across many Conquest seasons (conquest lasts for 5 seasons), this becomes quite efficient in terms of passive savings.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-60.png)

---

## 3. New Buildings from Level 50 to 55: Managing Aether Crystals

Once the building cap increases to 55, all levels from 50 onward require **Aether Crystals** produced in the Forge.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-61-1024x340.png)

## 3.1 Aether as the Growth Bottleneck

Even if you enter Conquest with large reserves of wood, stone, and speed-ups, Aether Crystals—not traditional resources—limit your pace. The transmute cost is trivial; the real constraint is production time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-62-1024x344.png)

## 3.2 Efficient Aether Production

The improved Forge allows you to **claim partial production** at any time. To maximize output I recommend players should:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-63-1024x621.png)

- Always run the **longest possible** transmute queue.
- Avoid short cycles unless you can collect them on time.
- When a long transmute nears completion, **cancel immediately after a full hour ticks over.**
Cancelling with “4 hours 05 minutes remaining” wastes 55 minutes of progress.
Cancelling at “exactly e.g. 03:59:59 remaining” preserves full efficiency (minus 1 second), since each Aether in your transmute queue is produced every 1 hour.

Maintaining continuous uptime on Aether production is one of the simplest ways to accelerate your building progression. That being said, you will be in conquest for 5 seasons before going into Legendary season, so you have more than enough time to upgrade everything even with downtime. Efficiency is king for the first season or two in conquest (P1 and P2) where getting access to higher level Tower of Knowledge skills and/or new Troop Tier will be a significant combat boost.

---

## 4. Legendary Skills and the Updated Wisdom Well

Conquest introduces **Legendary skills**, which immediately become the strongest and most flexible tools for march optimization. These are obtained through the Wisdom Well using **Divine Coins**, just as players already know from previous seasons.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-64-1024x572.png)

A few points worth clarifying:

- The legendary skills represent the highest power ceiling currently available, and the *speed* at which you acquire them sharply affects your early Conquest performance fighting spender versus spender. [Read more about costs and spending for legendary skills here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/tower-of-knowledge-passives/tok-basics/chaos-tok-skills-legendary-and-pricing-to-upgrade-and-max-2-8-5/)
- Spenders gain maximum efficiency by purchasing the **cheap bundles in Seasons 1 and 2**, banking all Divine Coins until Conquest.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-65-1024x702.png)

Because legendary skills also require large numbers of **skill stones** to level, you will need an extensive supply of coins over the long term. Many players underestimate this and stall mid-season; preparing beforehand avoids that plateau.

The Wish Shop expands at the same time, allowing many Season 2 premium skills to become **F2P-accessible**. This broadens viable builds in a way that simply didn’t exist in earlier seasons.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-66-1024x610.png)

**[Read more about all the skill stones available in conquest and how to get them here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/tower-of-knowledge-passives/ability-stones-availability-season-1-2-and-conquest/complete-guide-on-all-skill-stones-available-in-conquest-and-how-to-get-them/)**

---

## 5. Harbour 50–55 and Chaos Immortal Fragments

Harbour upgrades now extend to level 55. At **level 51**, you unlock access to **Chaos random immortal fragments**. While the fragments come slowly, they accumulate well over time, especially if your **crew dispatch percentage** is already optimized before entering Conquest.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-56.png)

Players who maintain consistent dispatch uptime gradually secure meaningful progress toward Chaos immortals across the season. **[Read more about the Harbour here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/harbour/)**

---

## 6. Additional Conquest-Level Progression

Several systems expand in predictable but useful ways:

- **Immortal level-cap increases**
- **New Immortal Boost levels**
- **New Elite and Normal Well of Time stages**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-67.png)

All follow their familiar mechanics. If you enter Conquest with saved **EXP scrolls**, **AP**, and **SP bottles**, you can climb these tiers rapidly and gain early advantages in PvE efficiency.

---

## Conclusion

Conquest doesn’t overwhelm with new technology nodes, but the shift to legendary skills and the expanded Wish Shop fundamentally changes march building and account growth. Where going from season 1 into season 2 had much more of a focus on new buildings, troop tiers and new techonologies, going into conquest is more about the new dynamics as you get access to new skills. Add in Aether-gated construction, new immortal talents, troop-specific tech, Harbour upgrades, and higher progression caps, and you get a season defined less by sudden complexity and more by long-term power scaling.

Players who prepare Divine Coins, manage Aether efficiently, and understand the value of the new tech layer enter Conquest with a clear advantage.

---
