markdown:
### A Free-to-Play Player's Guide to Earning Gems in Infinity Kingdom

Gems are one of the most valuable resources in Infinity Kingdom, but if you’re a free-to-play (F2P) player, they can feel frustratingly scarce. Unlike whales who might have gems to spare, you’ll need to be strategic about both collecting and spending them. Don’t worry, though—there are plenty of ways to rack up gems without spending a dime! This guide will walk you through all the best methods.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-66.png)

---

### Daily Gem Collection: Consistent Effort Pays Off

Let’s start with the daily grind. There are several small but consistent ways to earn gems every day, and these can quickly add up over time.

#### 1. Arena Battles

- Complete at least your five free Arena challenges every day. Winning at least one guarantees performance rewards via in-game mail, averaging around 30 gems even for a smaller castle.
- At the end of each Arena season, you’ll also earn additional gems based on your rank.
- Completing your daily Arena challenges also counts toward your Daily Task chest rewards, which include 25 gems (second chest) and 75 gems (final chest).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-57-1024x535.png)

#### 2. Alliance Missions and Gifts

- Help your alliance complete Alliance Missions daily. Each chest rewards individual prizes and Alliance Funds.
- The daily Alliance Gift chest, unlocked through these missions, sometimes contains gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-56-1024x559.png)

#### 3. Nobility Rewards

- Access these rewards via your Lord Info screen. Starting at Knight level, you’ll earn 10 gems daily, scaling up as your nobility increases. For instance, Viscount Level 1 grants 90 gems daily, while Marquis Level 3 gives 150 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-55-1024x444.png)

#### 4. Throne of the Supreme (ToS)

- During the "Points Race" phase, earn 30 gems for each battle you win. Winning all 10 of your daily attempts can net 300 gems per day for two weeks.
- Focus on winnable battles rather than ranking to maximize gem gains.
- For young servers, you have to wait until the Game Mode is activated.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-59-1024x543.png)

#### 5. Gtarcade App

- Make sure to install the Gtarcade App found [**here**](https://clientweb.gtarcade.com/download/download.html)or via your favorite App Store. Here you will have two daily free point shop bundles each yielding 30 gems, i.e. 60 gems per day.
- In the App go to "Point Store" and redeem the two free bundles. Note that this can only be done once per day per Gtarcade account, so choose your castle wisely.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-54-1024x673.png)

#### Daily Gems Summary:

- **Arena rewards:** ~30-60 gems/day + end-of-season rewards.
- **Daily Task chests:** 100 gems/day.
- **Nobility rewards:** 10-150 gems/day based on rank.
- **Throne of the Supreme:** 300 gems/day during the Points Race phase.
- **Gtarcade App:**60 gems/day

---

### Weekly Gem Collection: Maximize Your Returns

Beyond daily efforts, there are additional weekly activities that can boost your gem reserves.

#### 1. Wisdom Palace Quizzes

- Complete daily quizzes to earn tickets for the Saturday Retrial quiz. Each correct answer on Saturday earns gems, typically 400-600 for full participation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-60.png)

#### 2. Sign-In Rewards

- Mid-week Sign-In Rewards include 200 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-61-1024x545.png)

#### 3. Gift Codes

- Keep an eye out for the weekly gift codes, which often provide 100-200 gems in total.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-62-1024x453.png)

#### 4. Ruins Exploration

- Ruins exploration rewards are random and something you can keep doing even after completing all areas. You can expect to find around 50 gems weekly on average.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-63.png)

#### Weekly Gems Summary:

- **Weekend Retrial quiz:** 400-600 gems.
- **Gift codes:** 100-200 gems.
- **Mid-week Sign-In Reward:** 200 gems.
- **Ruins exploration:** ~50 gems.
- **Daily gem total (from previous section):** ~1400 weekly.

Combined, these activities can easily net you **2,150+ gems per week**, even with minimal effort.

---

### Gems from Periodic Events: Participation Matters

Periodic events are another excellent source of gems. While it’s tough for F2P players to place in the top tiers, even casual participation often yields smaller gem rewards.

- **City Expansion, Immortal Glory, and other events:** Just participating can earn you 100-200 gems, plus other rewards.
- **Save speedups and resources:** Use them strategically during key events to boost your performance and increase gem rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-64-1024x530.png)

#### Periodic Events Summary:

- Minimal effort yields 100-200 gems per event.
- Strategic participation and saved resources can boost these rewards significantly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-65-1024x508.png)

---

### Tips for Smart Gem Management

Earning gems is only half the battle; spending them wisely is just as important:

- **Avoid impulse spending:** Save gems for high-impact uses like speeding up important upgrades or buying rare items.
- **Invest in long-term value:** Focus on items or upgrades that will provide sustained benefits, such as immortals or troop enhancements.
- **Plan for future events:** Keep a reserve of gems for critical moments, especially during big events where gem spending can yield better rewards.

**Generally speaking, I would advice you to only spend gems on two things: (1) upgrading VIP level once you get within range of achieving level 10 and (2) summon Immortals via 10x advanced summons to both unlock the immortals you need as well as farming purple crystals for your Tower of Knowledge skills.**

---

### Final Thoughts

Gems may be hard to come by for free-to-play players, but with consistent effort and smart strategies, you can build up a healthy stockpile over time. By focusing on daily tasks, weekly activities, and periodic events, you’ll set yourself up for success. Remember: every gem counts, and persistence is key.

#### Key Takeaways:

- **Daily gems:** Prioritize Arena, Alliance Missions, Nobility Rewards, Throne of the Supreme and remember Gtarcade App bundles.
- **Weekly gems:** Maximize Wisdom Palace quizzes, gift codes, and Sign-In Rewards.
- **Event gems:** Participate strategically and save resources for key events.
- **Spend wisely:** Focus on long-term value and save for major opportunities.

Happy gem hunting, and good luck conquering the Infinity Kingdom!

title: Free gems P2 - Planning ahead, understanding one-time gem boosts

markdown:
### Part 2 Guide: One-Time Gem Rewards in Infinity Kingdom

Welcome to Part 2 of our guide on free gems in *Infinity Kingdom*! In this installment, we’ll focus on the **one-time gem rewards** available to players. These rewards can make a huge difference, especially for new players, by providing a large influx of gems to fuel your early progress. Knowing where to find these rewards and planning how to spend them is crucial to maximizing their value.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-75.png)

---

### Why Focus on One-Time Rewards?

As a new player, you might feel like gems are flowing in constantly—but don’t let that deceive you! Many gem rewards in *Infinity Kingdom* are one-time only. Understanding this helps you:

1. **Plan ahead** for major gem expenditures, like VIP upgrades or immortal summoning.
2. Avoid the misconception of having a perpetual stream of gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-76.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-77.png)

Let’s explore the key sources of one-time gem rewards and how to make the most of them.

---

### The Best One-Time Gem Sources

#### 1. Unlocking Immortals

Unlocking immortals is one of the easiest ways to earn gems early on:

- **Rare Immortal:** 50 gems
- **Epic Immortal:** 100 gems
- **Legendary Immortal:** 300 gems (equivalent to one philosopher’s stone)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-79.png)

To maximize this, focus on summoning and upgrading immortals to unlock their gem rewards quickly.

---

#### 2. Ruins Exploration

Exploring ruins rewards you with both random and guaranteed gem payouts:

- **Random gems:** Found while exploring ruins.
- **Area completion:** 30 gems for completing all nodes in a region.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-80.png)

- **Puzzle completion:** 50 gems for solving the area’s puzzle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-81.png)

Ruins are not just great for gems—they also help you unlock valuable resources and boost your kingdom's growth.

---

#### 3. Well of Time (Campaign Mode)

Clearing the **Well of Time** provides steady gem rewards:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-82.png)

- **First clear of strongholds:** 50 gems each.
- **Chapter completion:** 3x 50 gems per chapter.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-83.png)

This adds up quickly as you progress through the chapters. Make sure to complete all available strongholds and chapters as efficiently as possible.

---

#### 4. Chronicle Rewards

The **Chronicle** is the single largest source of one-time gem rewards:

- **Early Chronicles:** 200–300 gems each.
- **Later Chronicles:** 1,200+ gems each.
- **Total rewards:** Upwards of **12,000 gems** without bonuses and close to **15,000 gems** with bonuses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-84.png)

This makes the Chronicle an essential focus for new players. Prioritize completing Chronicles as you progress through the game to collect these significant rewards.

---

#### 5. Legion of Frostborne (Advanced Chronicle)

Once your server completes the **Royal Ambition Chronicle** and the first **Contention of Relics**, the **Legion of Frostborne** unlocks.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-85-1024x212.png)

- **Seasonal Chronicle:** Resets every season and offers substantial gem rewards. This is a vital resource for mid-to-late-game players, so plan your gem spending with this in mind.

---

#### 6. Contention of Relics

While not as lucrative as other sources, the **Contention of Relics** offers additional gems during and after battles. Focus on participating in these events to supplement your gem earnings.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-86-1024x551.png)

---

### Tips for Spending Gems as a New Player

With all these one-time gem rewards, it’s important to spend them wisely. Here are the two best ways for new players to use gems:

1. **VIP Level 10:** Reaching VIP 10 unlocks a daily philosopher’s stone reward, providing long-term value.
2. **Immortal Summoning:** Invest in summoning powerful immortals to strengthen your team early.

Avoid spending gems on speed-ups or other consumables unless absolutely necessary. Focus on investments that will provide lasting benefits to your account.

---

### Key Takeaways for New Players

- Hunt down all one-time gem sources early to maximize your gem reserves.
- Plan your spending carefully, focusing on VIP upgrades and immortal summoning.
- Don’t expect a continuous flow of gems after claiming one-time rewards—adjust your strategy accordingly.

By following this guide, you’ll have a strong foundation to make the most of your gems in *Infinity Kingdom*. Good luck, and may your treasury always overflow!

**Tip**: I am not 100% sure that this is still working, but it used to be (couple months ago) that players could add the Discord account "ikvip" and get a monthly gift worth over 1000 gems (many stones). I have tried to get this confirmed as something that still works, however I have not been able to get final confirmation. But what you should do is give it a whirl and send a kind hello to the IK VIP discord account.

Let me know if you'd like additional tips or guides for specific aspects of the game!

title: Free-To-Play Fire with Gilgamesh! (Patch 2.3)
summary: This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE…
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

This article is on free to play fire with Gilgamesh. We take advantage of fire's inate ability to burst out insane damage to create a pumped-march that can deal a ton of damage - beware tho! Some luck is required when fighting against stronger foes.

It is the beauty and curse of fire to be reliant on RNG. We are building to deal crazy damage through critical hits and chase procs. If you are unlucky on your critical hits, it will feel very underwhelming. But on the other hand, a few solid crits makes you feel like a god amongst men!

******This is a free-to-play setup. All Immortals, artifacts and Tower of Knowledge skills used for this build is 100% free to obtain and max!******

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-44-1024x545.png)

Fire is a team that can be run in many different ways. One thing is for certain though. If you want to run fire well, you have to embrace the fact that fire is a glass-canon setup made to deal tons of damage in short time or die horrible trying.

It can work very well, and is especially strong against teams that rely on backline damage dealers and on slow ramp-ups.

Personally, I use Fire to nuke wind and shadow setups.

**However, you need to be aware before committing to fire**, that because we are building to deal crazy damage through critical hits, this build is subject to a lot of **RNG**. If you are unlucky on your critical hits, it will feel very underwhelming. But on the other hand, a few solid crits makes you feel like a god amongst men!

## How does it work?

This setup is pretty standard and revolves around pumping big burst damage from Wu and Gilgamesh.

1. **William**adds a solid 20% crit rate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Skaermbillede-2022-07-12-112413.png)

Because we are scaling critial hit rate and critical hit damage, this setup **scales extreemly well with combat buffs** adding a solid 5% boost to your critical hit rate. Furthermore, you want to get to **VIP level 13** as quickly as possible to get the **9% Base Critical Value**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-32-300x245.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-31.png)

## Embrace the chaos of RNG Fire!

Running fire you will always be subject to some RNG. Trying to mitigate it through defenses, running Charles, shelter, Cyrus control builds, etc. is admirable yet ultimately futile. **Fire is and has to be a glass canon of a build**. It is what makes fire awesome and what makes it frustrating. If you are not getting the crits you need, you will loose. No matter the build, not matter the power. If you do get the crits, you will absolutely melt the face off of most any enemy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-42-1024x622.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-41.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-40.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-39.png)

## ToK passive setup (main)

For the passive setup, we want to maximize the amount of damage we can output as possible. This means, barely any defensive passives! For Defense, the only two things you want are Malice and Oaken Guard. We want just these two, as they are extreemly high value passives giving us major defense and thus protecting troop count. There are no other defensives strong enough to make the cut. Against full magic damage, swap Oaken Guard into Resist. Otherwise, we are full on damage!

Fighting Master ensures our Gilgamesh never is Interrupted and thus that his continuous AOE pressure is reliably upheld. Furthermore, the mitigation protects his troop count nicely.

We want to get ahead in the fight as quickly as possible. Hence William runs Energy Suppression, which in combination with Hippolyta's energy redcution keeps a nice damper on the enemy energy bars allowing our fire to be the first to cast spells and hence get ahead in troop count right off the bat.

**You likely heard the saying "the best defense is a good offense?" Well this is it. By being the first to cast spells and pumping massive damage in the first seconds of a fight, we are reducing enemy troop count and thus boosting our damage comparativly!**

Fighting Will is the last skill I will spend significant time on. You should run this because you will take a lot of damage and therefore quickly reach the % triggers. Having a few seconds of control can get you back in the game if you fall behind early.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/asd122.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/1212121da.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/1212jka.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/211asddsa.png)

This lands us with the following setup. **You want to run this passive loadout:**

**Empress Wu**: Chase, Annihilation, Toxic Nova

**Gilgamesh**: Death Breath, Anger, Fighting Master

**William**: Fighting Will, Energy suppression, Malice

**Hippolyta**: Weakness, Oaken Guard, Blessing of War

title: Frozen Dragon Hive

markdown:
Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on. Untill now, we have also only had a single dragon skin with an awesome cosmetic effect - the shadow dragon skin.

NO LONGER! **Introducing the Water Dragon Glyndwr Castle skin!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-26.png)

## What does "Frozen Dragon Hive?" do?

Every castle skin has unique beneficial effects, from building speed to rss gathering and troop HP. The Frozen Dragon Hive increases troop **healing speed at the Hospital by 5%** AND**increase production speed of all resources by 5%**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-25-1024x557.png)

What does that mean precisely? It means that (1) your hospital is a flat 5% faster at healing the same amount of troops as before.

Furthermore, (2) your farms, lumber mills, quarries and smelteries inside your castle produce resources 5% faster. **Does not apply to gold production.**

## How to get it?

You have to purchase bundles (any bundles) which yield a total of 50K gems. It dosen't matter what bundles you purchase, as long as there is a gem reward it counts towards your castle skin.

This means, that if you have not yet purchased gems with a bonus, this could be a good time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-24-1024x577.png)

## Bundles with gems

Most all bundles have gem rewards, but how to they scale?

Usually, a 5$ bundle yield 520 gems, a 10$ bundle yields 1,100 gems, a 20$ bundle yields 2,300 gems, a 50$ bundle yields 6,000 gems and a 99$ bundle yields 12,500 gems. These are the standard rewards and can be slightly different on special bundles.

### Read more about shop bundles

| USD | 4.99 | 9.99 | 19.99 | 49.99 | 99.99 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gems | 520 | 1100 | 2300 | 6000 | 12500 |
| 1 USD = in Gems | 104.21 | 110.11 | 115.06 | 120.02 | 125.01 |

As you can see, the more expensive bundles are finally worth buying! They offer a higher gem/USD spent reward.

Do however take note, that the contents of expensive bundle tiers is MUCH worse than the cheaper ones. Overall, it would still be FAR MORE value to purchase many small bundles despite the lower gem reward.

### Player Guide: Adapting to Fu Fei's Balance Change in Infinity Kingdom

Fu Fei, a renowned chaos immortal in Infinity Kingdom, known for her potent healing abilities and control immunity, has recently become even more formidable following a balance update to her ultimate ability. This change significantly enhances her strategic value, particularly in countering control-based strategies that have previously served as viable methods to challenge chaos immortal setups, notably those involving Himiko.

## Understanding Fu Fei's Enhanced Ultimate Ability

### Before the Update

Fu Fei has been absolute top ranked for healing done since her release but that is not all there is to her!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-171-1024x461.png)

Previously, while Fu Fei provided a broad spectrum of control immunity, her protections did not extend to the unique control effects of Himiko’s ultimate ability. This allowed for strategic counterplay against chaos immortal setups, leveraging Himiko's control capabilities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-172-1024x553.png)

### After the Balance Change

The recent update has augmented Fu Fei's ultimate ability, enabling it to grant immunity even against Himiko’s controls. This development closes a critical loophole, significantly reducing the effectiveness of previously viable counter-chaos strategies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-173.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-174.png)

## Strategic Implications

The enhancement of Fu Fei's ultimate ability has considerable implications for players across the board, particularly affecting the strategic landscape in PvP battles:

- **Strengthened Chaos Setups**: Fu Fei's enhanced ability solidifies the dominance of chaos immortals by providing a comprehensive defense against one of the few weaknesses chaos setups had.
- **Reduced Counterplay Options**: The update narrows the strategic options available to players aiming to counter top-tier, Pay to Play chaos immortal lineups, challenging the community to innovate new strategies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-175-1024x441.png)

## Looking Forward: Strategies Against Enhanced Chaos Immortals

With direct control counterplay options dwindling, players must explore alternative strategies to compete against the enhanced capabilities of chaos immortals like Fu Fei:

- **Focus on Damage Mitigation and Sustain**: Since direct control counterplay has been diminished, building lineups that prioritize damage mitigation and sustain can help withstand the onslaught from chaos immortals.
- **Leverage Speed and Debuffs**: Speed manipulation and debuff strategies (outside of control effects) may offer a new avenue to challenge chaos setups, focusing on outpacing and weakening opponents before they can leverage their full potential.
- **Innovative Immortal Synergies**: Exploring less conventional immortal combinations and synergies that can exploit subtle vulnerabilities in chaos setups might emerge as a viable strategy.

## Community's Role in Evolving Strategies

The balance change to Fu Fei's ultimate ability presents a new challenge for the Infinity Kingdom community. It encourages players to engage in deeper strategic thinking and theorycrafting to devise methods to compete against the strengthened chaos immortal lineups. This evolving dynamic underscores the game's complexity and the continuous interplay between different strategies, urging players to adapt and innovate.

## Conclusion

Fu Fei's recent enhancement marks a significant shift in the strategic balance of Infinity Kingdom, particularly affecting the dynamics of PvP combat. While this change bolsters the power of chaos immortals, it also serves as a catalyst for strategic innovation among players. As the community navigates this new landscape, the effectiveness of emerging counter-strategies will undoubtedly shape the future of competition in Infinity Kingdom, highlighting the ever-evolving nature of its strategic depth.

### Unleash Destruction: The "Full Coverage" Skill Bundle Guide in Infinity Kingdom

Introduction: A brand new opportunity has just hit Infinity Kingdom, offering players the chance to acquire the coveted "Full Coverage" skill at an incredibly low cost. ![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-94-1024x636.png)

The event spans five days, and each day costs $5, allowing you to purchase one skill stone. After buying the skill stone for all five days, you receive a bonus of 5 stones for free, totaling 10 stones. This means you can unlock the skill with just $25 during the event. As the event returns, you can continue building your stockpile. After six events, with a total cost of $150, you'll unlock the skill.

This skill is a game-changer, and players are already incorporating it into their top-tier builds. The cost of $150 for such a skill is a fraction of what players are accustomed to spending on similar skills in Infinity Kingdom.

**The Power of Full Coverage** The "Full Coverage" skill is exceptionally powerful, especially when combined with high energy regeneration builds. Immortals with inherent high energy regeneration benefit the most from this skill. However, immortals that already synergize with high energy regeneration builds become exceptionally potent when paired with "Full Coverage."

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-97-1024x551.png)

The damage dealt by "Full Coverage" is scaled from troop count at the time of casting. Therefore, for the skill to shine, you need to ensure the survival of your frontliners. This may involve strategies like facing enemy tanks or adopting a void-guard support lineup to maximize the skill's potential.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-102-1024x615.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-101-1024x599.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-100-1024x605.png)

In conclusion, the "Full Coverage" skill bundle in Infinity Kingdom is an unbeatable opportunity to acquire a top-tier skill at a fraction of the cost players usually expect to spend. The skill's synergy with high energy regeneration builds and select immortals makes it a game-changing addition to your arsenal. If you have the means, don't miss out on this chance to unlock the power of "Full Coverage" for just $150. Unleash destruction and leave your mark on the battlefield!

markdown:
### Mastering the Power of "Full Coverage" in Infinity Kingdom

"Full Coverage" emerges as a formidable Tower of Knowledge skill in Infinity Kingdom, boasting the potential to significantly influence the tide of battles within the right strategic framework. Its power lies not just in its standalone capabilities but in the synergistic potential it holds when combined with other skills and immortals. This article delves into the mechanics of "Full Coverage," its optimal usage strategies, and how players can obtain this skill to maximize their combat effectiveness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-21-1024x542.png)

## What "Full Coverage" Does

"Full Coverage" is uniquely designed to amplify the damage output across the battlefield with its broad-reaching effect: **“After each release of an energy skill, there is a 70% chance to deal physical damage to the entire enemy team at a damage rate of 90%.”** This skill activates on the use of an ultimate ability, targeting all enemy units with a substantial damage wave, making it a critical asset in widespread damage strategies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-22-1024x587.png)

## How to Use "Full Coverage"

The key to unleashing "Full Coverage's" potential lies in pairing it with immortals and skills that facilitate frequent energy skill releases:

- **High Energy Regeneration Builds**: Immortals equipped with "Full Coverage" should ideally be part of a setup that emphasizes rapid energy regeneration. This ensures consistent activation of the skill, translating to persistent pressure on the entire enemy team.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-23-1024x566.png)

- **Synergistic Skill Pairings**: Combining "Full Coverage" with skills like "Energy Burst" and "Adrenaline Rush" can dramatically increase its damage output. For instance, using "Full Coverage" on Hippolyta alongside "Energy Burst" can result in high-frequency damage waves, exploiting her naturally high energy regeneration rates.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-24-1024x588.png)

- **Ideal Immortal Examples**: While a generic immortal like Gilgamesh might see moderate benefits, specific combinations like Hippolyta with "Energy Burst" or Genghis Khan with "Adrenaline Rush" can unlock "Full Coverage's" full damage potential.

## Obtaining "Full Coverage"

"Full Coverage" is accessible through multiple avenues, making it a viable addition for a broad spectrum of players:

- **Legion of Frostborne Rewards**: Players can earn "Full Coverage" by participating in the Legion of Frostborne event, utilizing Cold Coins and Gems for loot boxes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-25-1024x506.png)

- **5-Day Bundles**: Periodically, "Full Coverage" skill stones are featured in 5-day bundles, offering another pathway to acquisition.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-26.png)

## Strategic Placement

Given its accessibility, "Full Coverage" is an excellent skill choice across the player spectrum:

- **Free to Play (F2P) and Low to Mid Spenders**: For those focusing on fire or lightning mains, "Full Coverage" offers a cost-effective way to enhance their offensive capabilities.

- **Big Spenders**: In second or third formations, particularly for players with chaos and/or holy mains, "Full Coverage" adds depth and versatility, making it a must-have for comprehensive battle preparedness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-27.png)

## Conclusion

"Full Coverage" stands out as a skill of immense potential within Infinity Kingdom, especially when strategically paired with high-energy regeneration immortals and synergistic skills. Its ability to deal widespread damage following energy skill releases makes it a game-changer in the right hands. By leveraging the various avenues available for obtaining "Full Coverage," players can significantly bolster their arsenal, paving the way for dominance in both offensive and defensive engagements across Norheim. Whether you're a seasoned spender or a dedicated F2P player, integrating "Full Coverage" into your lineup can unlock new levels of strategic gameplay.

title: Fully Prepared - The perfect Alexander / Ares skill
summary: Legendary passive skills in Infinity Kingdom usually force a choice between damage and survival. Fully Prepared breaks that pattern. It offers a unified design built around momentum: keep attacking, grow stronger, take…
markdown:
### Fully Prepared: The Rise of Momentum-Based Defense in Infinity Kingdom

## Introduction – Momentum as a Front-Line Philosophy

Legendary passive skills in *Infinity Kingdom* usually force a choice between damage and survival. **Fully Prepared** breaks that pattern. It offers a unified design built around momentum: keep attacking, grow stronger, take less damage. No HP thresholds. No emergency triggers. Just steady pressure rewarded over time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-100.png)

In a meta where we have in the past often seen conditional passives like **Last Stand** or **Iron Curtain**, Fully Prepared represents a philosophical shift. Instead of reacting to danger, it assumes control from the first strike. The skill asks one thing of the player and the immortal alike—maintain rhythm. As long as normal attacks continue, both offense and defense scale upward in tandem.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-102.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-101.png)

This is not something that requires you to maintain high troop counts to even work, nor does it assume you loose 30% of your troops before it even takes effect. Instead it is a commitment to tempo and to getting ahead fast and then staying ahead. And that pays off!

---

## Skill Overview – How Fully Prepared Functions

**Fully Prepared** is a Legendary Passive Skill restricted to **front-line positions**.

Each **normal attack** grants two stacking effects:

- **Damage dealt increased** by a fixed percentage per hit
- **Damage taken reduced** by a fixed percentage per hit

These effects stack up to **10 times**. At higher skill levels, the scaling becomes substantial.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-100.png)

At **level 8**, each stack provides:

- **+6% damage dealt**
- **−5% damage taken**

At full stacks, this results in:

- **+60% total damage**
- **−50% total damage taken**

The moment normal attacks stop, the momentum ends. Stacks do not persist through inactivity or control effects.

*Fully Prepared cannot be equipped alongside **Last Stand** or **Iron Curtain**, as all three occupy the same defensive design space. Where those skills rely on conditional triggers, Fully Prepared replaces them with cumulative scaling tied directly to combat flow.*

---

## Damage Scaling – Power Earned Through Persistence

The offensive value of Fully Prepared is easy to underestimate at first glance. In practice, it competes directly with - and often outperforms - traditional damage passives.

At maximum level, Fully Prepared reaches **+60% damage**, matching Last Stand’s peak bonus. The difference lies in **uptime**.

Last Stand only activates once HP drops below a specific threshold. Fully Prepared begins scaling **from the opening exchange**. On fast-attacking front liners, full stacks are typically reached within the first 8-10 seconds of combat.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Infinity-Kingdom-2025-12-12-16-19-02.mp4)

This creates a form of **compounding pressure**:

- Early stacks accelerate mid-fight damage
- Mid-fight damage shortens engagements
- Shorter engagements reduce incoming risk

Rather than gambling on survival to unlock damage, Fully Prepared front-loads value and maintains it as long as attacks continue. In extended fights, that consistency translates into cleaner victories and fewer collapses.

---

## Durability and Mitigation – Proactive, Not Reactive

The defensive side of Fully Prepared is where its design truly stands apart.

At full stacks, **50% damage reduction** exceeds Iron Curtain’s maximum mitigation and does so without waiting for a trigger window or conditional triggers from e.g. troop counts. Protection builds quickly (especially on high speed normal attackers) as combat progresses.

This reframes the role of front-line immortals. Instead of functioning purely as damage sponges, they become **damage regulators**—reducing incoming pressure while actively accelerating the enemy’s defeat.

The tradeoff is clear and deliberate: momentum can be broken.

- Stuns, knockbacks, or forced downtime interrupt stacking
- Lost stacks mean lost mitigation
- Recovery requires re-establishing attack rhythm

Because of this, Fully Prepared strongly favors builds that minimize interruption through control resistance, immunity, or sheer attack speed. When uninterrupted, the skill delivers some of the most stable frontline durability available.

---

## Ideal Users and Synergies – Where Fully Prepared Excels

Fully Prepared shines on immortals who **stay in contact** and attack frequently. It is strongest on aggressive front lines designed for prolonged engagement rather than burst windows.

### Recommended Immortals

- **Alexander** – One of the most natural fits. His rapid attack chains allow stacks to build almost immediately, and his control immunity protects momentum. Perfect fit.
- **Ares** – Blends aggression with his Frigthen utility, quick normal attacks, making full-stack uptime reliable in drawn-out fights (as of the coming patch 2.9.0 Ares will also have a baked in Control Immunity perfect for maintaining momentum and uptime).
- **Hannibal Barca** – Slower to ramp but benefits heavily from long exchanges where stacks remain stable. Requires Fighting Master as to attain Control Immunity, since this takes up a skill slot he is significantly worse off than Ares (once patch 2.9.0 is live) and Alex where you are able to run both Wind Rage and Knife Through Butter, more on that below.

### Skill Synergies

- **Wind Rage** – The single most important pairing. This skill provides a huge increase to the number of normal attacks you land per second. Hence it significantly reduces stack buildup time.
- **Knife Through Butter** – Complements the scaling damage by maintaining pressure throughout the fight and by also scaling off of normal attack, making it a perfect synergy with Wind Rage which we want to run with Fully Prepared.
- **Assembly Charge** – Works well in aggressive dual-front setups that commit to sustained combat. Also scales off of normal attacks, hence works in synergy with the Wind Rage core. In my opinion, Assembly Charge is the skill to get if you do not have a Knife Through Butter level 6-8 available.

The perfect setup is in my opinion doing Wind Rage with Fully Prepared and Knife Through Butter - as shown below.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-103-1024x599.png)

---

## Obtaining Fully Prepared

Fully Prepared is a Legendary skill, meaning it is available only through the Wisdom Well event in Conquest and Legendary seasons. Being a legendary skill, you need additional skill stones to upgrade Fully Prepared - contrary to Epic skills which we are used to upgrading using Soul Crystals.

The cost to unlock is 60 skill stones, upgrading each level gets more and more expensive for a total of 240 stones required to reach level 8. Note that because level 7 to 8 costs a whopping 60 skill stones in itself, many players opt to stay at level 6 or 7 for a while and being upgrading other skills - then returning once you complete your legendary skill loadout. This is my recommendation as you progress into legendary skill setups as well.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-104-1024x531.png)

**Upgrade costs to Chaos/Legendary Skills:**
**Unlock: 60**level 2: 5
level 3: 10
level 4: 15
level 5: 20
level 6: 30
level 7: 40
level 8: 60**Total 240**

---

## Conclusion – The Backbone of Sustained Combat

Fully Prepared does not rescue failing positions. It amplifies strong ones.

When used correctly, it turns steady aggression into both offense and defense, scaling power through discipline rather than desperation. For players who value tempo, uptime, and sustained control, it stands as one of the most coherent and rewarding passive designs in the game.

---

Greetings, fellow commanders! As the first week of the Time Rift Breaker event in Infinity Kingdom comes to a close, it’s time to delve into the intricacies of this exciting weekly event. Join us as we explore the event’s rules, optimal team compositions, coveted rewards, and strategies for success.

Crafting the ideal team composition is crucial for achieving victory in the Time Rift Breaker event. We’ll assume access to all free Immortals and King of the Hill Immortals for our examples. However, if you lack specific Immortals, don’t fret – experimentation can lead to effective substitutes. Additionally, perusing the damage rankings and observing other players’ choices can offer valuable insights.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-63-1024x381.png)

***Checkout my video for build compositions as well as the boss-build section here on the wiki.***

    https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dg5MawPug2E

Notably, rare single-target skills may outperform epic skills in certain scenarios. For instance, consider using skills like Root and Poison Thorn for Hammurabi, as they prove more effective than Annihilation and Death Breath. While Immortals can only be used once per battle, skill changes can be made as frequently as desired. To streamline the process, it’s advisable to have multiple formation presets, sparing diligent players from constant skill adjustments.

There are three distinct types of Rift Breakers to contend with: Venom, Vampirism, and Amplify. Each presents unique challenges and demands tailored team compositions: **This week is Venom Rift Breaker.**

- **Venom Rift Breaker: Inflicts magical continuous damage and is weak against Holy, Lightning, and Fire elements. An example team might feature Hippolyta, William, Empress Wu, and Hammurabi, focusing on single-target damage and exploiting the Rift Breaker’s elemental vulnerabilities.**
- Vampirism Rift Breaker**:** Deals magical damage while healing itself and is susceptible to Shadow, Wind, and Lightning. An effective lineup could consist of Hannibal Barca, Alexander, Hammurabi, and Qin, capitalizing on synergies despite Alexander’s elemental mismatch.
- Amplify Rift Breaker: Unleashes buffed physical damage and is vulnerable to Water, Earth, and Fire elements. A well-rounded team may include Hippolyta, Alexander, Yoshitsune, and Empress Wu, benefiting from elemental strengths and prioritizing single-target damage.

title: Gamescon Bundles 2026

categoryPath: Gtarcade Shop - via Mobile app or Desktop
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom is participating in Gamescom 2026 alongside AppGallery, with the event running in Cologne, Germany, from **August 26–30**. The AppGallery/GameCenter booth is located in **Hall 7, Booth B.031**, where Infinity Kingdom is one of the featured games.

## Infinity Kingdom Gamescom 2026 Special Packs: Value Analysis and Buying Guide

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-139-1024x712.png)

Alongside the Gamescom appearance, several limited **Gamescom Special Packs** have appeared through the external shop. At first glance, the advertised discounts are substantial: 95%, 90%, 85%, 66%, and 48% off.

Those percentages are not particularly useful when deciding what to buy, though. What matters is how difficult the included resources normally are to obtain and whether a cheaper route already exists.

There are five main Gamescom packs:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-140-1024x231.png)

The three standard $0.99, $1.99, and $2.99 vouchers visible alongside them are regular voucher purchases rather than the main Gamescom bundles. GTarcade currently lists these vouchers separately with daily purchase limits.

## Gamescom Special Pack 1 – Artifact Schematic Fragments

**Price:** $4.99
**Purchase limit:** 5
**Reward:** 60 Artifact Schematic Fragment Selecting Chests
**Advertised discount:** 95%

The first pack is one of the better offers, although its value depends heavily on where your account is in artifact progression.

The selection chests contain fragments for specific exclusive artifacts. Before buying anything, check the chests already sitting in your inventory and confirm that the artifact you actually need is included.

At the full five-purchase limit, you are looking at: **$24.95 → 300 schematic fragments**

That is a meaningful amount of targeted artifact progression.

Compared with buying similar progression through events such as Stellar Compass, the Gamescom offer is attractive. However, artifact fragments are only valuable when they move an artifact toward a meaningful breakpoint.

For example, if you are actively finishing an artifact for an Immortal such as **Khan or Alex**, 60 targeted fragments for $4.99 can remove a substantial amount of waiting. Buying all five packs can provide roughly a third of the fragments required to fully develop an artifact.

If you have no immediate artifact target, there is much less reason to stockpile the chests simply because the shop says "95% off."

### Player Perspective

I would classify this as a **conditional buy rather than a universal buy**.

For an account already committed to finishing a specific premium artifact, the value is quite good. For an account still deciding which march or Immortal deserves the investment, keeping the money available for a more targeted event is perfectly reasonable.

The resource itself is valuable. The question is whether you need it now.

---

## Gamescom Special Pack 2 – Theia's Roulette Tickets

**Price:** $9.99
**Purchase limit:** 5
**Reward:** 32 Theia's Roulette Raffle Tickets
**Advertised discount:** 90%

This is the standout Gamescom pack.

A normal comparable $10 purchase provides approximately **20 roulette tickets**. The Gamescom version provides **32**, meaning you receive 12 additional tickets at essentially the same spending level.

That works out to: **60% more tickets for the same approximate price.**

Buying all five gives: **$49.95 → 160 Roulette Tickets**

For players actively progressing the **Holy Dragon**, this is easily the strongest purchase among the Gamescom offers.

It can also make sense for Shadow Dragon progression, although between the two I would generally prioritize Holy Dragon development unless the account has a specific reason to invest into Shadow.

The important distinction from Pack 1 is that the value proposition does not require nearly as much justification. If Theia's Roulette is already part of your planned dragon progression, you are essentially buying a resource you intended to acquire anyway at a substantially improved rate.

### Player Perspective

If I were spending selectively during this promotion, **Pack 2 would be my first purchase**.

Pack 1 solves an artifact progression problem. Pack 2 simply gives significantly more of an already desirable premium resource for the money.

That makes it the cleanest value proposition of the five.

---

## Gamescom Special Pack 3 – Master's Insights

**Price:** $19.99
**Purchase limit:** 5
**Reward:** 80 Master's Insights
**Advertised discount:** 85%

This one looks considerably better on the shop page than it does after comparing alternative sources.

You receive: **$19.99 → 80 Master's Insights**

The problem is not that Master's Insights are unimportant. The problem is that Infinity Kingdom already provides much more efficient long-term ways to obtain them.

The **30-Day Elite Campaign Supplies** in Kingdom Supplies costs around $10. Between the additional Elite World attempts and the daily Master's Insights provided through the supply rewards, an active player completing the relevant daily content can obtain roughly **930 Master's Insights across the month**.

The Gamescom comparison therefore becomes difficult to justify:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-141-1024x111.png)

The Gamescom pack buys immediacy. It does not buy efficiency.

### Player Perspective

This is a **hard pass for most accounts**.

There are circumstances where somebody might desperately need Master's Insights immediately, but you are paying an enormous premium to avoid waiting.

For normal progression, I would rather buy the monthly supply and let the resource accumulate naturally.

---

## Gamescom Special Pack 4 – City of Glory

**Price:** $49.99
**Purchase limit:** 1
**Main rewards:** City of Glory Castle Skin + 30 Eternal Dragon Soul Chests
**Advertised discount:** 66%

This pack requires separating cosmetic value from progression value.

The **City of Glory** castle skin provides useful bonuses, including:

- **Troop HP +2%**
- **5% Honor when attacking enemies**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-142-1024x619.png)

Neither effect is useless. Troop HP is broadly applicable, while additional Honor has obvious value for players who participate heavily in PvP. The problem is opportunity cost.

The castle itself has previously appeared around this spending tier, including during anniversary content. More importantly, a roughly $50 **Monthly Festival Pass** can provide a castle skin alongside additional rewards such as Immortal Costume materials, Gems, and event currencies. That gives you considerably more progression surrounding the cosmetic purchase.

The Gamescom pack attempts to compensate with **30 Eternal Dragon Soul Chests**, representing **300 Holy or Shadow Dragon Crystals** depending on selection.

If your real objective is dragon development, the discounted Theia's Roulette tickets provide a much cleaner way to spend toward that goal.

There is another long-term consideration: **City of Glory currently lacks the upgrade potential available to some other castle skins**. A fixed 2% Troop HP bonus is useful, but the abundance of more powerful upgradeable skins can eventually outscale it. ***Check the comparison for Combat Buffs from Castles here.***

### Player Perspective

I would buy Pack 4 primarily because I specifically wanted **City of Glory**, not because I wanted efficient account progression.

That distinction matters.

For collectors, the castle may justify the $49.99 price on its own. For a player evaluating every dollar according to combat progression, Pack 2 is considerably more compelling.

**Verdict: skip unless the castle skin itself is the objective.**

---

## Gamescom Special Pack 5 – Tokugawa and Hammurabi

**Price:** $99.99
**Purchase limit:** 1 per day
**Main rewards:**

- 60 Tokugawa fragments
- 60 Hammurabi fragments
- 60 random Enlightening Immortal fragments
- 60 Dust

**Advertised discount:** 48%

This is where the Gamescom promotion falls apart.

Tokugawa and Hammurabi have some scarcity because they are not standard Hall of Immortals acquisitions. Scarcity alone, however, does not make a $100 bundle efficient.

The useful comparison is **Elemental Bond**. Through Elemental Bond, comparable quantities of these Immortal fragments can be acquired around the **$30 spending level**, with additional Dragon Crystals attached to the purchases.

That leaves a very uncomfortable question for Pack 5: What exactly accounts for the remaining ~$70?

Primarily the extra Enlightening fragments and **60 Dust**.

While dust is in high demand, sixty Dust does not bridge that value gap. There is also a particularly strange design choice here. Unlike Packs 1–4, which have event-wide purchase limits, **the $99.99 pack refreshes daily**.

So the most expensive and least efficient Gamescom offer is also the one players are allowed to repeatedly purchase.

### Player Perspective

I would avoid this pack.

It is possible to construct an account-specific scenario where someone urgently wants both featured Immortals and values every additional fragment. Even in that situation, I would compare the cost against Elemental Bond before purchasing.

Calling something "48% off" does not matter when the underlying resources can be obtained much more efficiently elsewhere.

This is easily the **weakest Gamescom pack**.

---

## Gamescom 2026 Pack Priority

For spenders trying to maximize progression rather than simply collect everything, my order would be:

**1. Gamescom Special Pack 2 – Theia's Roulette Tickets**
Best overall value. Particularly strong for Holy Dragon progression.

**2. Gamescom Special Pack 1 – Artifact Schematic Fragments**
Very good when you are actively finishing a specific exclusive artifact.

**3. Gamescom Special Pack 4 – City of Glory**
Reasonable for collectors, but difficult to recommend purely for progression.

**4. Gamescom Special Pack 3 – Master's Insights**
Useful resource sold through an inefficient acquisition route.

**5. Gamescom Special Pack 5 – Tokugawa/Hammurabi**
Poor value compared with alternative ways of acquiring the featured Immortal fragments.

## A Note on GTarcade Purchases

There is one extra factor worth checking before purchasing any Gamescom pack: **external-shop recharge rewards**.

GTarcade has historically attached additional rewards and recharge milestones to purchases made through its official shop, and its current voucher listings show cumulative top-up rewards at several monthly spending thresholds. That means the effective value of a Gamescom purchase can be slightly higher if it simultaneously pushes your account across a recharge milestone.

That does not suddenly make Pack 5 efficient, but it is worth checking before deciding where to make a purchase.

GTarcade Infinity Kingdom Shop

---

## Conclusion

The **Gamescom 2026 Special Packs are a mixed promotion rather than a blanket discount event**.

The clear winner is **Gamescom Special Pack 2**. Thirty-two Theia's Roulette tickets for $9.99 is substantially better than the usual ticket ratio and gives players pursuing Holy or Shadow Dragon development a straightforward reason to buy.

**Pack 1** is also worthwhile when those 60 selectable Artifact Schematic Fragments directly advance an artifact you are already building. I would not buy them merely to sit in inventory, but targeted artifact progression at this price is respectable.

After those two, the value drops quickly.

The **Master's Insights pack** loses badly to long-term Campaign Supplies. **City of Glory** is more defensible as a cosmetic purchase than a progression purchase, particularly because other $50 festival offerings provide broader rewards. Finally, the **$99.99 Tokugawa/Hammurabi pack** is difficult to justify when Elemental Bond offers a much cheaper route toward comparable Immortal progression.

The advertised discounts range from **48% to 95%**, but Infinity Kingdom veterans should know better than to judge a pack by the percentage printed above it. Compare the contents against the cheapest repeatable source of the same progression.

For Gamescom 2026, that comparison produces a fairly simple answer:

**Buy the Roulette Tickets if you need dragon progression. Consider the Artifact Schematics if you have a specific artifact target. Treat everything else as optional or inefficient.**

---

title: Garrisons
summary: Garrisons are an important mechanic to know and understand for player versus player (PvP) combat in Infinity Kingdom. We use garrisons for defending our friends when they are being attacked by enemies at equal or…
markdown:
Garrisons are an important mechanic to know and understand for player versus player (PvP) combat in Infinity Kingdom. **We use garrisons for defending our friends when they are being attacked by enemies at equal or greater power. Garrisons are an awesome tool, because they are away of pooling strength with our allies. By pooling power we can overcome a stronger foe.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-3.png)

**You CAN garrison while you have shields on. Garrisons will not trigger Bloody Rage debuffs, leaving you safe to defend your allies from a shield.**

## How to garrison

You want to setup with your fellow alliance players, let's say you found a whale you need to kill as a team since he is much more powerful than any one of you. What can you do?**[You can setup a shield-hive](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/all-effects-ability-passive/strategies-for-managing-blood-rage-debuff/shield-hives-in-pvp-norheim-svs-combat/).**

The strongest player amongst you should lead rallies, however this leaves your friend open to being attacked since he **cannot shield** himself (Bloody Rage). This person cannot shield, as he/she will get Bloody Rage debuff when sending a rally. This is why the hive it needed - strength in numbers!

**You want to place other team mates around the rallier like on the below image.**

Everyone around the rallier must **send garrisons to defend your friend from the big player**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-5.png)

*Garrison to defend against the bigger player*

## Send a garrison

My Territory is the one leading the rallies and my fellow BKU castles are assisting me in my **rallies** and **garrisoning**me to defend against the whales counter attacks.

All my alliance friends are **garrisoning me by simply clicking my castle and hitting "Assist" and then assisting by sending my strongest march possible to garrison.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-13.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-14.png)

## Whales hurt

This is the best way to kill and defend against whales. By pooling your marches, **you are able to kill a much stronger opponent**. However, you also need to be aware of the **mechanics**at play here. Your rallies and garrisons are fighting the enemy player 1 at a time right after each other. The power of a rally comes from the buffs (alliance tech) and from the fact that the whales army defending at his gates, does not get to refresh troop count from training grounds in between attacks. **This means that you slowly grind him down untill one of your marches (you can have 5 in each rally) is able to beat the stronger player.**

This also means, that the first maybe 2-4 marches you send in your rally will likely be absolutely murdered and you will incur heavy losses. Likewise, the target will gain a ton of honor since he is killing a lot of troops before you finally defeat him.

**This makes it a double edged sword. It is still very powerful to fight in rally-clusters, and you are able to zero very big whales in this way. But it is by no means easy or cheap and you should expect big losses when you go whale-hunting!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/image-15.png)

markdown:
### Unleashing the Power of Garrote and Chaotic Blade: The Free, Underrated Gems of Infinity Kingdom

In the rich tapestry of Infinity Kingdom strategies, certain skills shine for their sheer potency and accessibility. Garrote and Chaotic Blade are two such Tower of Knowledge skills that have flown under the radar, despite offering incredible value and damage potential to every player, right from the early stages of the game. This guide aims to shed light on these underrated abilities, explaining why and how they can be pivotal in crafting a winning strategy, especially for players who leverage lightning builds and synergies with immortals like Loki.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-35.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-32.png)

## Why Garrote and Chaotic Blade Deserve Your Attention

Both Garrote and Chaotic Blade are obtained for free at low levels, making them accessible to all players. Here's why they stand out:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-34.png)

***Huge thanks and credit to PandaMorati from EDEN s56 who brought these damage calculations to my attention. Very good stuff!***

- **High Damage Output:** Despite common misconceptions, both skills boast damage stats that can rival even the most coveted pay-to-win skills. They have a 40% chance to activate, dealing 150% physical damage to three enemies, coupled with an additional 75% damage over 6 seconds to the same targets. This equates to an impressive total of 900% physical damage upon each activation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-38-1024x618.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-39-1024x621.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-40-1024x616.png)

- **Frequent Activation:** With a 40% chance to trigger every 6 seconds, these skills average a 60% physical damage per second (DPS) rate. This is on par with the DPS of Spear Impale, a highly sought-after skill known for its 55% activation chance and 325% physical damage to two enemy Immortals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-41.png)

- **Strategic Versatility:** While Spear Impale targets two immortals and includes a debuff, making it a preferred choice for focused damage, the distribution of damage across three enemies by Garrote and Chaotic Blade has its strategic advantages. This wider damage spread can be crucial in battles where damaging multiple targets simultaneously can disrupt enemy formations and strategies.

## Maximizing the Potential of Garrote and Chaotic Blade

To leverage these skills to their fullest, consider the following strategic approaches:

- **Ideal for Lightning Builds:** Garrote and Chaotic Blade are exceptionally synergistic with lightning builds. Their activation not only deals substantial damage but also triggers dragon buffs for your lightning immortals, enhancing their effectiveness on the battlefield.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-36-1024x455.png)

- **Synergy with Loki:** For players lacking access to Blade Vortex but seeking to inflict Bleed/Tear effects, pairing Garrote and Chaotic Blade with Loki can be a game-changer. This combination allows you to apply consistent pressure on the enemy, capitalizing on Loki's unique strengths while maximizing the damage output of these underrated skills.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-37-1024x503.png)

#### Conclusion

Garrote and Chaotic Blade represent a significant opportunity for Infinity Kingdom players to enhance their arsenal with high-damage, readily accessible skills. Their ability to deal substantial physical damage to multiple targets, combined with their activation frequency, places them in direct competition with top-tier pay-to-win skills. When utilized effectively, especially in conjunction with lightning builds or immortals like Loki, these skills can turn the tide of battle, proving that strategic insight and skill selection often trump sheer spending power. Embrace the potential of Garrote and Chaotic Blade, and watch as they carve a path to victory in your Infinity Kingdom adventures.

## Infinity Kingdom Guide: How to Scout Enemy Marches Without Attacking

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-69.png)

## Introduction

Ever wondered what your enemy is running—without having to risk a march or start a war? Good news: **you can gather valuable information on enemy lineups without engaging in battle**. This trick is especially useful during tense periods like Kill Events, server wars, or Contention of Relics, where a single attack can have major consequences.

In this guide, we’ll walk through **how to passively scout marches**, what kind of information you can infer, and how to use that intel to gain a tactical edge.

---

## The Trick: Reading March Info Without Fighting

### Step-by-Step

1. **Observe March Animations:** When an enemy player sends out a march—whether to gather, reinforce, or move between castles—you can click on their march.
2. **Tap on the Marching Icon or Avatar:** This allows you to see **troop types** being used in that formation.
3. **Pay Attention to Unit Icons and Arrangement:** You won't see exact immortals or skills, but you *can* see which types of troops are being used—**infantry, cavalry, bowmen, or spearmen**.

---

## What Can You Learn?

Even this small window gives you a **surprisingly large amount of intel**. Here's what to look for and what it can tell you:

### 1. Troop Composition

You’ll see which unit types are present. For example:

- **Two cavalry** might suggest **Alex + Yi Sun-Shin** in an Earth setup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-66.png)

- **Spearmen + Shieldmen** suggests a shadow Tutankhamun + Bjorn setup (or Wukong + YSS if whale battling)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-68.png)

- **Cavalry + Shieldmen** often point to hybrid setups like the popular Alex + Hannibal but can also be a dual tank earth YSS + Charles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-67.png)

- **Two Shieldmen** is most likely a fire team coming at you (Trajan, Hippo)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-69.png)

### 2. Formation Purpose

You can often tell **if it's a gathering march, garrison, or PvP team** based on the type of troops and how well-balanced the comp is. If you see a full cavalry march with no defense—it's probably meant for quick strikes, not sustain.

---

## Practical Use Cases

### During Kill Events, Legion of Frostborne or Relic Fights:

- Know what you're walking into before you engage.
- Identify weak marches to intercept for easy points.
- Pick your battles: avoid counters and target vulnerable teams.

### Planning a Rally or Defense:

- Help your alliance prepare the right buffs or formations.
- Predict if the enemy will rely on silence, burn, leech, or burst.
- Know when to bring out your hard counters or support tools.

***BONUS TIP: Spotting a fake march. Some players are not clever enough to use four different immortals when they are sending a fake march. So when you see something marching towards you in Illusion Battlegrounds that isnt a complete setup you know to disregard it!***

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-70.png)

---

## Why This Matters

Information is power in Infinity Kingdom. By learning to **gather intel without initiating combat**, you gain a **free strategic advantage**—and that’s especially important if you’re fighting against stronger opponents or playing a support role.

Many players don’t even realize this feature exists, so using it gives you a **tactical edge with zero cost**.

---

## Final Thoughts

Scouting doesn’t always have to involve risk or aggression. With a little attention to detail, you can **out-think your enemies before you out-fight them**. This method of passive scouting is perfect for players who value strategy and precision over brute force.

So next time you're watching enemy marches move around Norheim, **click in, check the setup, and start planning.** The smartest commander wins—often before the first hit even lands.

---
