title: Gem Droprate
summary: With the introduction of patch 2.6.6 in Infinity Kingdom, a new gem feature has been unveiled, revolutionizing how players can enhance their immortals' equipment. These gems, attainable through raiding gnome camps…
markdown:
### Detailed Guide: Gem Drop Rates from Raiding Gnomes in Infinity Kingdom

With the introduction of patch 2.6.6 in Infinity Kingdom, a new gem feature has been unveiled, revolutionizing how players can enhance their immortals' equipment. These gems, attainable through raiding gnome camps, allow for a customizable boost in equipment power, tailored to the strengths and strategic needs of your immortals. This guide dives into the drop rates of gems from gnome camps, providing a comprehensive analysis based on real-world data to help you strategize your raids effectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-51-1024x473.png)

## Gem Acquisition and Drop Rates

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-55-1024x473.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-53-1024x473.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-56-1024x560.png)

### Gathering Data

Over the course of raiding 1,413 gnome camps, including sessions during double drop rate events (where the gem count was halved to maintain accuracy), an average of 4.26 gems per camp was observed. Here's a breakdown of what this means for your resource allocation:

- **Action Point (AP) Cost**: Each gnome camp raid requires 70 AP, translating to an expenditure of 16.44 AP for every gem acquired. Thus, for every 1,000 AP spent, players can expect to receive approximately 60.9 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-57.png)

### Understanding the Gem Requirement

To level up a gem, three gems of the previous level are required. This requirement might seem modest at first glance, but the exponential growth across 8 gem levels means the numbers can quickly escalate:

- **To craft a single level 8 gem**, you need 2,187 gems.
- **For a full equipment set on your main march** (comprising 4 pieces of equipment per immortal, with 4 immortals), the total comes to a staggering 139,968 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-58-1024x572.png)

### AP Investment

Given the drop rates and the gem requirements for equipment enhancement, the AP needed for a fully upgraded main march is considerable:

- **Total AP needed**: 2,298,325 AP, or equivalently, 2,298 "1K AP bottles".
- **For upgrading a single piece of equipment** (e.g., the weapon of your main damage dealer), you're looking at 8,748 gems, requiring 143,746 AP.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-59-1024x659.png)

**[Read more about upgrading Gems here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/gear-equipment/gem-upgrade-costs/)**

## Strategies for Efficient Gem Farming

### Prioritizing Gnome Camp Raids

Given the high AP cost per gem, strategic allocation of your AP towards gnome camps, especially during double event periods, is crucial for maximizing your gem haul.

### Balancing AP Use

Diversify your AP expenditure to balance between essential daily tasks and gnome camp raids. Prioritizing gnome raids during double drop rate events can significantly enhance your efficiency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-60-1024x468.png)

### Planning for the Long Haul

The journey to fully upgrade your main march's equipment with level 8 gems is a marathon, not a sprint. Setting incremental goals, such as focusing on upgrading one piece of equipment at a time, can make the task seem less daunting.

### Utilize Events and Bonuses

Maximize participation in events that offer increased drop rates or additional AP rewards to boost your gem farming efficiency without exhausting your AP reserves too quickly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-61-1024x558.png)

## Conclusion

Farming gems through raiding gnome camps in Infinity Kingdom is a resource-intensive endeavor that demands strategic planning and patience. Understanding the drop rates and the sheer volume of gems needed for high-level upgrades can help you make informed decisions on how to allocate your AP effectively. By leveraging events and managing your resources wisely, you can gradually enhance your immortals' equipment, significantly boosting your prowess in the realm.

title: Gem Optimization Guide - using the correct gems
summary: If you’ve been checking battle reports lately, you’ve probably noticed some truly questionable gem setups—physical attack on tanks, accuracy on supports, and other combinations that make no mechanical sense. In most…
markdown:
If you’ve been checking battle reports lately, you’ve probably noticed some truly questionable gem setups—physical attack on tanks, accuracy on supports, and other combinations that make no mechanical sense. In most cases, this comes down to the auto-equip system.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-161-1024x558.png)

Auto-equip only looks at **gem level and a crude role heuristic**, not at how damage, dodge, or mitigation actually function in real combat. As a result, it frequently equips gems that *technically fit* but *practically weaken* the march.

Manual gem control is one of the easiest ways to gain real PvP power without spending more resources - if you understand where each stat actually applies. Manually managing your gem-setup is a 'must do' for players of Infinity Kingdom, especially because it costs knowledge and attention rather than additional spending. The goal of this guide is to explain *what* to equip, *where*, and—most importantly—*why*.

---

## Core Mechanics That Matter for Gem Choices

Several fundamental mechanics govern how gems perform in real combat:

- **Magic damage cannot be dodged**
Accuracy has no interaction with magic damage. Magic immortals do not need accuracy to function.
- **Physical damage can be dodged**
Normal attacks, ultimates, and physical Tower of Knowledge skills all check **accuracy**versus enemy dodge.
- **Support immortals are not damage dealers**
Offensive gems on supports provide negligible value compared to survivability.
- **Tanks exist to absorb damage, not deal it**
Any attack gem placed on a tank is effectively wasted power.
- **Resilience has universal defensive value**
Reducing incoming critical hits is relevant for every immortal, regardless of role, once other requirements are met.

Understanding these interactions is the foundation for every gem decision that follows.

---

## Weapon Gems: Match the Gem to the Immortal’s Function

Weapons are where auto-equip makes the most frequent and costly mistakes, namely from equipping offensive gems on tanks and support immortal's weapons. Let's go over the gems you want for each immortal type:

### Physical Damage Dealers - attack and ranged immortals

Examples: Alexander, Hippolyta, Tutankhamon, Genghis Khan, Gilgamesh, Seondeok

- **Physical attack gems**
- No defensive gems unless deliberately sacrificing damage (rarely optimal)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-162-1024x398.png)

Physical attackers scale directly with attack, and weapon slots are a large source of offensive power.

---

### Magic Damage Dealers

Examples: Himiko, Empress Wu, Merlin

- **Magic attack gems only**
- No defensive gems unless deliberately sacrificing damage (rarely optimal)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-163-1024x606.png)

Magic attackers scale off of their magical attack attributes and as such defensive weapon gems undermine their primary role. Their survivability is handled elsewhere in your build-setup.

---

### Tanks and Supports

Examples: Cao Cao, Theodora, Qin, Yi Sun-sin, Trajan, Ragnar

- **Defensive gems on weapons**
- Physical or magic defense depending on matchup

This is one of the least understood mechanics in the game: **you can equip defensive gems on weapons**, but only by manually opening the defensive gem tab. Auto-equip will never do this correctly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-164-1024x566.png)

For tanks and supports, defensive stats on weapons provide far more effective power than any offensive alternative.

#### Choosing Physical vs Magic Defense

This should be dictated by **current PvP meta**, not a static rule:

- Against physical-heavy builds (e.g. hyper-regen-Khan, Alex-KTB, earth/wind hybrids):
→ Physical defense is valuable even on backliners
- Against magic-centric builds (e.g. Himiko burst):
→ Magic defense becomes the priority

Because gem resources are limited, many players may be forces to compromise atleast until late-game. In practice, I often balance physical and magic defense. On frontliners I usually go 1-3 magical-physical defense while leaning toward magic defense on backliners - but this reflects my current battlegroup meta rather than a universal rule. I play against both physical and magical damage enemies. Magical damage is typically dealt in AoE hence a danger to backliners where I run more heavily on magical defense and frontliners tend to soak more physical damage, hence I tend to lean into physical defense. But I want to reinforce my main point from above here - in order to minmax your setup, you should change your balance between physical and magical defense gems based on your main 'rival' build setups in PvP encounters.

*Note: On a practical note, going 100% into one type of defensive gem will strain your ability to upgrade those gems into the later levels. As such, balancing between using some physical gems even against all out magical damage can be a good thing on frontliners who still soak normal attacks and other types of off-damage by physical damage dealers.*

---

## Armor Gems (Helmet & Chest): Meta-Driven Optimization

Armor pieces can only equip defensive gems, which simplifies the decision mechanically but not strategically.

**The true min-max approach is to swap armor gems based on what you are fighting.** There is no permanently optimal setup - only a setup that is optimal *for your current environment*.

- Physical-heavy meta → lean physical defense
- Magic-heavy meta → lean magic defense
- Mixed meta → balance accordingly or change constantly

### A Practical Example (Not a Rule)

In a mixed battlegroup environment with both physical and magic threats, I personally often run a **1–3 split**:

- **Frontliners**:
3× physical defense, 1× magic defense
- **Backliners**:
3× magic defense, 1× physical defense

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-165.png)

This reflects typical damage distribution:

- Frontliners absorb more physical damage generally speaking
- Backliners are more vulnerable to magic AoE burst

This is a *pragmatic compromise*, not a theoretical optimum. Players should always adjust based on the opponents they are actually going toe-to-toe with or losing to in PvP.

---

## Accessory Gems: Accuracy vs Resilience

Accessory slots are where real optimization happens if you run a physical damage setup yourself - and where most players misplay.

### Non-Physical Immortals

- **Always resilience**
- Accuracy provides zero value

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-166-1024x521.png)

Supports, tanks, and magic attackers all fall into this category.

---

### Physical Damage Dealers: Hit-Cap First

Physical attackers must be **hit-capped**.

That means:

- If *any* attack is dodged in battle reports → you need more accuracy
- If *no* attacks are dodged → additional accuracy is wasted

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-167.png)

Once hit-capped:

- Invest everything else into **resilience**

Resilience directly reduces incoming critical hits and improves survivability without sacrificing damage output once accuracy requirements are met.

#### How to Check Hit-Cap

- Review PvP battle reports against relevant opponents
- Look for “Dodged” entries
- **One dodge** already indicates insufficient accuracy

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-168-1024x390.png)

As you can see, I need to replace one of my Resilience Gems on Bathory with another Accuracy Gem and test again for hit-cap.

---

### Current Meta Reality

Dodge-centric builds have largely disappeared. In earlier eras, wind-dragon setups with Misleading and After-image were effective counters to physical damage. Today:

- Accuracy is abundant (immortal talents, dragon talents, gems)
- Dodge investment is inefficient
- True dodge-focused marches are rare

As a result, most physical attackers can run **minimal accuracy** and transition quickly into resilience. If you do encounter dodge-heavy setups, **Coercion aura** is also very good as a quick-fix temporary counter - after which you should reassess reports. That being said, it is better to fix your hit-cap using gems (if 4x accuracy gems is enough to reach hit-cap) than with a tower of knowledge skill slot, but in rare cases both can even be needed.

---

## Resource Priority: Focus Where It Matters

Finally, a practical reminder:

- Fully optimize gems on your **main march**
- Level 1-3 placeholder gems on subsequent marches are perfectly fine
- Heavy investment into marches you don’t actively fight with is wasted power

Infinity Kingdom consistently rewards **depth over breadth**. One properly gemmed march will outperform multiple partially optimized ones.

---

## Conclusion

Auto-equip optimizes for gem level, not combat effectiveness. Once you understand how damage, dodge, and mitigation actually function, manual gem control is a simple highest-impact way to improvement.

- Tanks and supports want defense**- also on weapons**
- Mages want pure magic attack, attackers and ranged want pure physical attack
- Physical attackers must be hit-capped, then pivot into resilience
- Meta awareness always beats static default configurations

Read your battle reports, adjust to the opponents you face most often, and your marches will perform much closer to their real potential.

---

title: Gem Upgrade Costs
summary: Upgrading gems in Infinity Kingdom is a crucial aspect of enhancing your immortals' power, offering tailored stat boosts to fit your strategic needs. This guide focuses on the cost, both in gems and Action Points (AP)…
markdown:
### Guide to Upgrading Equipment Gems in Infinity Kingdom

Upgrading gems in Infinity Kingdom is a crucial aspect of enhancing your immortals' power, offering tailored stat boosts to fit your strategic needs. This guide focuses on the cost, both in gems and Action Points (AP), associated with upgrading gems to their maximum potential. Understanding these costs is essential for effective resource management and planning your progression in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-62-1024x526.png)

## Gem Upgrading Mechanics

To upgrade a gem to the next level, you need three gems of the previous level. This exponential requirement means that as you aim for higher-level gems, the number of lower-level gems needed increases significantly.

### The Exponential Cost of Upgrading

The process of upgrading gems follows a simple rule: 3^n, where n is the number of upgrades needed to reach a desired gem level. Here's a breakdown of what this looks like in practice:

- Level 2 gem: 3 Level 1 gems
- Level 3 gem: 9 Level 1 gems (3 Level 2 gems)
- Level 4 gem: 27 Level 1 gems (9 Level 2 gems)
- … and so on, up to Level 8.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-58-1024x572.png)

## Total Gem Requirements

To achieve a single Level 8 gem, which represents the pinnacle of gem enhancement, you need a total of 2,187 Level 1 gems. Given that each piece of equipment can be enhanced with multiple gems, and each immortal in your main march requires a full set of upgraded equipment, the total number of gems needed for a complete upgrade is substantial.

### Full Equipment Upgrade Costs

- **For one piece of equipment**: 2,187 gems are needed for a single Level 8 gem. Since most equipment pieces can hold multiple gems, multiply this number by the number of gem slots available.
- **For a full set on one immortal**: Assuming 4 pieces of equipment, each requiring 4 Level 8 gems, you would need 8,748 gems.
- **For your main march**: With 4 immortals, each needing their equipment fully upgraded, the total comes to 139,968 Level 1 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-63.png)

## Action Point (AP) Investment

Given the drop rate of gems from gnome camps (averaging 4.26 gems per camp with a 70 AP cost per raid), we can calculate the AP investment required to gather enough gems for upgrading.

### AP Cost Breakdown

- **Per Gem**: On average, raiding gnome camps consumes 16.44 AP per gem.
- **For a single Level 8 gem upgrade**: You'll need approximately 35,934 AP.
- **For one piece of equipment**: Upgrading to include 4 Level 8 gems requires around 143,746 AP.
- **For a full main march upgrade**: The total AP investment skyrockets to approximately 2,298,325 AP.

Read more about **[Gem Droprates here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/gear-equipment/gem-droprate/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-56-1024x560.png)

## Strategic Considerations

### Efficient Farming

- **Leverage Events**: Participate in events that offer double drop rates or additional AP to maximize your gem farming efficiency.
- **Prioritize AP Usage**: Balance your AP between essential in-game activities and targeted gnome camp raids for gem farming.

### Long-Term Planning

- **Set Incremental Goals**: Focus on upgrading gems for one piece of equipment or one immortal at a time to manage the daunting numbers more effectively.
- **Resource Allocation**: Plan your AP and gem acquisition strategies around event schedules and your progression goals to ensure steady advancement.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-60-1024x468.png)

## Conclusion

Upgrading gems in Infinity Kingdom represents a significant investment in both resources and time. By understanding the costs involved and strategizing your approach to gem farming and AP management, you can efficiently enhance your immortals' equipment, thereby boosting your power and effectiveness in the game. Remember, patience and strategic planning are key to navigating the gem upgrade process successfully.

title: Genghis Khan (lightning) – Ultimate Skill
summary: Genghis Khan is one of the most direct and mechanically transparent burst carries in Infinity Kingdom. He does not rely on layered triggers or complicated scaling loops. His value is simple: high, reliable AoE physical…
markdown:
### Introduction

Genghis Khan is one of the most direct and mechanically transparent burst carries in *Infinity Kingdom*. He does not rely on layered triggers or complicated scaling loops. His value is simple: high, reliable AoE physical damage combined with one of the most strategically important debuffs in the game — **Serious Wound**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-95-1024x585.png)

In the current meta, he occupies an interesting space. On paper, his damage is among the highest of all burst carries and in practice, his effectiveness is supreeme when correctly setup. When properly built, he performs at a top-tier level.

This guide breaks down his Ultimate mechanics, optimal builds, team structures, damage comparison against meta carries, and his real position in competitive play.

---

### Ultimate Skill – Arrowstorm

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-96.png)

### Core Effect

- Full-field AoE physical damage
- 150% → 500% scaling at max level
- Applies **Serious Wound** for 10 seconds (healing blocked)

Arrowstorm hits every enemy on the battlefield. At max level, 500% scaling gives it genuine late-game burst potential, especially when amplified through critical scaling and Ultimate damage modifiers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-97.png)

The embedded Serious Wound is what elevates the skill from strong to decisive. It shuts down:

- Active healing ultimates
- Passive regeneration
- Sustain loops in Earth defensive teams

In sustained fights, this denial can determine the outcome more reliably than raw damage alone.

### Exclusive Artifact Effect

With his exclusive artifact equipped, Arrowstorm gains **+30% total damage**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-98.png)

The mechanic does not change, but the added damage takes him to absolute top tier when it comes to raining down pain in the form of massive AoE burst damage.

---

## Team Fit and Lineup Structures

Khan is flexible, but not universal. His performance depends on builds that protect his casting rhythm either through hyper regen or strong regen control. Khan needs to get ahead in the energy regen game (same principles as Himiko and other burst centered meta immortals). Since all of his damage comes from repeated ultimate ability casts.

### Earth Hybrid (Current Strongest Structure)

In the current meta, Khan performs most consistently as a backline carry inside Earth-heavy defensive shells.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-99-1024x614.png)

Example structure:

- Zenobia, Theodora or preferably Fu Fei support and sustain
- Either Alexander offensive builds (preferably) or dual tank Bjorn/Charles builds
- YSS mandatory frontline tank for mitigation
- Khan backline carry

### Pure Lightning Composition

In full Lightning:

- Khan becomes the central carry.
- Energy acceleration becomes mandatory, consider Matilda for backline support here.

Pure Lightning can work, but in general it seems to struggle to keep pace with optimized Earth builds.

---

## Optimal Support – Fu Fei

Fu Fei is Khan’s strongest support.

Her Ultimate:

- Heals all allies
- Removes control
- Grants control immunity (up to 6 seconds with artifact)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-100-1024x618.png)

Khan’s biggest weakness is interruption. If stunned before casting, his pressure collapses. Fu Fei solves this entirely. If Fu Fei is unavailable, **Fighting Master** becomes mandatory to prevent shutdown. That in itself is a huge part of why Fu Fei is so powerful, you free up a passive skill slot on your main carry - Khan - to equip yet another devastating damage skill.

#### Mandatory Support Specialisation – Battle Excitation

Running Khan you need a support not only to maintain HP and troop count, etc. But also for the incredibly powerful synergy with the support talent specialization "Battle Excitation". This talent skill restores up to 200 energy to a back-row ally at battle start and increases their damage dealt by 55%.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-101.png)

For Khan, this is not optional. It accelerates first Arrowstorm timing thus amplifying opening burst as well as providing the quickest possible application of Wounds in the game.

Without Battle Excitation, his first cast often arrives too late against aggressive teams.

---

## Skill Build Recommendations

Khan’s philosophy is simple: **Increase Ultimate frequency or increase Ultimate damage.**

### Free-to-Play / Low Investment

- Fighting Master (control immunity + survivability)
- Anger (physical damage)
- Upgrade to Time to Shine if possible

Time to Shine synergises strongly with his crit-based burst and pairs extremely well with Deadly Aim.

### High Investment

- Energy Mastery
- Corrosive Power

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-84.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-83.png)

These skills both increase the damage output of Arrow Storm as well as provide massive energy regen upon every cast. They are the core of what players call "hyper-regen-builds" and they absolutely shine on Khan. They significantly changes how Khan performs.

Did you catch the hint? anyway, for the last skill slot for players able to run Fu Fei support for Khan, you want to use Time to Shine for that massive damage and crit synergy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-102.png)

As such the final setup will look like this for high-end players: Corrosive + Energy Mastery + Time to Shine.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-103.png)

---

## Specialisation Choice

### Deadly Aim (Best Option)

- +30% Critical Rate
- +50% Physical Damage

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-104.png)

Perfect synergy with his burst profile. When combined with Time to Shine, Arrowstorm damage spikes become very noticeable. This is the only choice that makes sense regardless or your specific setup and build.

Deadly Aim is simply far better than the alternatives:
**Concentration Stance**: Provides Ultimate damage and accuracy. Accuracy adds little value; Khan already has minimal miss chance.
**Stellar Rain**: Triggers additional damage every 9 seconds. Poor scaling and poor synergy. Not recommended.

---

## Meta Damage Comparison – Where Khan Actually Stands

To properly evaluate Khan, we need to compare him to other meta burst carries.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-105-1024x127.png)

**Baldwin – Highest Average, RNG Dependent**. Baldwin leads at 198% DPS, but his damage relies on proc mechanics. This is a problem, since some fights he may overperform, but in many others he underperforms both in terms of just bad procs meaning lesser overall damage - but especially because he has the inherent risk of not dealing any damage at all against the enemies you really want dead! Baldwin can go multiple casts without hitting the enemy carry (not likely, but entirely possible) which makes him a very RNG pick - meaning if you want to be able to sometimes demolish enemies with good luck and hits he is awesome, but for consistency, not so much.

Khan by comparison has **zero randomness** in output. Every Arrowstorm delivers predictable value at an average not far off.

---

**Himiko – Conditional Parity**. Note that Himiko’s listed value includes a 25% Shadow elemental advantage. The advantage is confirmed to be in the 10-25% range for all the elemental advantages and based on experiance (especially from when shadow elemental affinity was buffed to fight back against the old holy dominated meta) she most likely sits at a full 25%. However, this is not officially confirmed so just have that in mind.

Given elemental advantage Himiko edges higher into the damage ranking than Khan, but she does NOT provide Wounds and moreover your Khan will not be hamstrung by a meta where most default builds are built to counter magical damage through Aegis and Resist. But again on the other side, Himiko forces Fighting Master upon enemies through fear of her control effect and she does have the added advantage of taking less damage. Why favor a Khan then?

---

## The Strategic Advantage – Built-In Serious Wound

Basically, for a solo carry in pure damage numbers some immortals like Baldwin and Himiko does outperform Khan on paper. But in a meta where solo-carry builds are losing out to builds that incorporate Alex's with Knife Through Butter as well as a meta where healing has become readily available in large numbers, a Khan with Wounds is in my opinion a stronger pick right now. No other carry in the game can provide healing denial.

This matters because where many meta builds needs a Qin to secure wounds, a Khan build that is transitioning into its last form with Fu Fei besides him, does not lose out on the precious wounds debuff like other meta builds. Instead, Khan solves this entirely himself.

Sometimes denying enemy healing is stronger than dealing a bit more damage!

---

## Conclusion Summary

Genghis Khan is one of the most consistent burst carries in Infinity Kingdom.

He does not top the damage charts on average damage on paper but he offers:

- Near-top-tier DPS
- Complete consistency
- Built-in Serious Wound

In the right structure, he remains a highly competitive anti-sustain carry. Without proper energy and control protection, he falls short of the very top. Khan rewards structured builds and proper support. Build around his Ultimate, protect him between first and second cast window, and his impact becomes massive.

---

title: Ghost Fiesta 2026 – Halloween Festival Event Guide, Rewards & Best Priorities
summary: Infinity Kingdom's Ghost Fiesta Halloween Festival has officially
markdown:
![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141341-iscxw4.png)

If you participated in August's Harvest Festival or September's Pirate Festival, most of the activities will feel familiar. Lucky Koi, the festival battle pass, Alchemical Secrets, Dazzling Wish, Pinnacle Trial, Glorious Challenge, and the Grail Shop all return.

However, there are some important changes worth knowing about. The biggest is **Witch Forest**, an entirely new board-based event replacing Fishing Contest, while Fu Fei and Louis IX receive new *Night of Terror* outfits.

Let's go through the event, where to collect your rewards, and what you should prioritize.

## TL;DR – What Should You Focus On?

* **Lucky Koi:** Claim the daily free rewards. For spenders, the five-purchase consolation is one of the best ways to obtain Eternal Grails.
* **Night of Terror Pass:** Complete daily objectives for Tokens of Light, Magic Wands, and other rewards. The $50 pass includes 60 Louis IX outfit fragments and 60 Temple of Edfu fragments.
* **Witch Forest:** The new replacement for Fishing Contest. Collect candy, complete daily milestones, and pursue Louis IX outfit fragments.
* **Alchemical Secrets:** The returning crystal-sorting puzzle. Complete stages for free Magic Wands.
* **Dazzling Wish:** The main source of Fu Fei outfit fragments, but extremely expensive to pursue through random drops.
* **Grail Shop:** Horus is the main Immortal reward, while the 250-Grail Chaos selection chest and 330-Grail artifact chest are particularly attractive.
* **Pinnacle Trial and Glorious Challenge:** Complete the available stages for free event currencies, Magic Wands, Tokens of Light, and additional rewards.

\---------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Lucky Koi – Don't Miss the Best Grail Deal

Lucky Koi returns with its familiar combination of daily free rewards and an optional paid lottery.

Everyone should log in daily and collect the free gift, which includes a Token of Light that can be used in the seasonal events.

For spenders, however, Lucky Koi is one of the most important parts of Ghost Fiesta.

The **$4.99 Koi Gift Pack** provides Tokens of Light and 1,500 Magic Wands, while also entering you into a lottery held every two days.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-140833-oh3jwm.png)

One lucky participant wins the grand prize of 4,250 Eternal Grails and a special reward. But winning the lottery isn't actually the main reason to participate.

Players who purchase all five rounds without winning receive a consolation reward containing **850 Eternal Grails**.

That guaranteed consolation alone makes Lucky Koi one of the most efficient Eternal Grail purchases available in Infinity Kingdom.

**Our recommendation:** For players already spending money on seasonal events, completing the five Lucky Koi purchases should be a priority. The consolation reward is excellent, and the included event resources improve the overall value further.

## Night of Terror – The Festival Battle Pass

The Halloween battle pass follows the familiar 30-level seasonal progression system.

Players complete daily objectives to earn EXP and unlock rewards across the free and premium tracks.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-140854-f9p1jh.png)

The premium $50 option is particularly interesting because it includes:

* 120 additional Tokens of Light
* 60 Louis IX *Night of Terror* outfit fragments
* 60 Temple of Edfu castle decoration fragments
* Additional Magic Wands and event resources

Louis IX requires 60 fragments to unlock his outfit, meaning the pass can provide an immediate outfit unlock once its rewards are collected.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-140925-jwriv1.png)

The Temple of Edfu decoration provides +5% Physical Attack and +5% Magical Attack for Immortals, alongside +5% Building Upgrade Speed.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-140902-nje61w.png)

It's a decent combat decoration, although we generally prefer Troop Attack bonuses over Immortal Attack bonuses because of how troop-based damage scales.

For players considering the pass, the most important rewards are arguably the Tokens of Light and Louis IX fragments. Both have substantial value elsewhere in the event.

## Witch Forest – The New Fishing Contest

The biggest gameplay change in Ghost Fiesta is **Witch Forest**, which replaces the traditional Fishing Contest with a Halloween-themed board game.

Main reward of the Witch Forest - much like the previous fishing event - is Outfit fragments. This time for Louis. 

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141144-fm1fn4.png)

Instead of casting fishing nets, players spend Magic Wands to move around a board containing different rewards.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141002-xhce19.png)

The board features three main types of spaces:

* **Candy Magic:** Awards random candy, contributing toward event progression.
* **Surprise Magic:** Triggers special effects, including reward multipliers or jackpot events, and grants an extra move.
* **Reward spaces:** Provide resource chests and other items directly.

Players can choose different spending multipliers, including ×100. Surprise Magic can increase this further; we've already observed a ×200 multiplier appearing during gameplay.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141014-3zkqus.png)

### Candy Collection and Progression

Normal candy comes in three different types:

The different candies contribute points toward daily progression rewards.

Players can participate alone or team up with another player from their server. Teammates share daily point progression, making cooperation an important part of reaching the higher milestone rewards.

Teams reset daily, so you'll need to team up again after each refresh.

### Louis IX Outfit Fragments

Witch Forest also introduces the **My Candy Jar** collection, which rewards players for collecting special Evil Pumpkins.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141158-j6ymn3.png)

These are separate from the ordinary candy points used for daily progression.

This gives players another way to obtain Louis IX *Night of Terror* fragments beyond the premium battle pass.

The event also offers daily team rankings and overall personal rankings, providing additional incentives for more competitive players.

**Our recommendation:** Collect the free Magic Wands available throughout the festival before purchasing additional ones. As with Fishing Contest, the most efficient strategy is generally to identify your next outfit milestone and spend toward that target rather than purchasing blindly.

We'll cover Witch Forest's probabilities, expected candy returns, and Magic Wand spending efficiency in a dedicated guide.

## Alchemical Secrets – The Puzzle Returns

Alchemical Secrets returns almost unchanged from the Pirate Festival.

This mini-game challenges players to sort differently colored Primal Stones into matching treasure chests.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141225-mxd4jb.png)

The early levels are straightforward, but later stages introduce frozen chests, hidden stones, and other mechanics that require more careful planning.

Completing the stages provides useful rewards, including Magic Wands for Witch Forest.

Previously completed stages can also be raided to obtain additional rewards without solving the puzzle again.

One important tip from our earlier testing is that **even difficult puzzles can be solved without purchasing additional assistance items**. The optional Unlock item can make levels easier, but careful planning is generally sufficient.

For a complete explanation of the puzzle mechanics and solutions, see our [Alchemical Secrets guide](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/pirate-festival-2026---alchemical-secrets-new-mini-game/).

## Dazzling Wish – Fu Fei's Halloween Outfit

Dazzling Wish returns as the primary event for Fu Fei's new *Night of Terror* outfit.

The wheel offers 20 Fu Fei outfit fragments as its rarest reward, alongside various amounts of Eternal Grails.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141238-ogwn6b.png)

However, the outfit fragment drop probability is just **0.2% per draw**.

That means players need an average of 500 draws for a single 20-fragment reward, before accounting for any separate guarantees or additional sources.

Fu Fei requires 80 fragments to unlock the outfit, so obtaining it through random wheel drops alone is extremely expensive.

In fact, 200 spins produce an expected return of just eight Fu Fei fragments.

For most players, we recommend treating Dazzling Wish as an optional activity rather than a primary spending target.

Players mainly interested in Eternal Grails should strongly consider Wish Grail instead, which generally provides considerably better returns per Token of Light.

## Grail Shop – Horus and the Best Rewards

The Grail Shop returns with several attractive purchases.

The main featured Immortal is **Horus**, available for 845 Eternal Grails per chest containing 80 fragments, alongside his exclusive *Eye of Horus* artifact schematic.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141249-nm3dqj.png)

However, some of the most appealing purchases are the relatively inexpensive selection chests.

The **Fate of Chaos Selection Chest VIII** is particularly attractive, offering a choice of Chaos Immortal fragments, including Medusa, Ares, Apollo, Wukong, Loki, Poseidon, and others.

At 250 Eternal Grails for 80 fragments, this is considerably more accessible than purchasing many of these Immortals through their original premium events.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141300-vfyktq.png)

Likewise, the 330-Grail artifact selection chest provides a relatively affordable source of specialized artifact progression.

For many players, these selection chests may offer better practical value than committing large amounts of currency toward Horus.

**The Challenge Shop** also offers Tokens of Light, Stardust, and additional resources in exchange for the candy currency earned from event activities.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141311-t84fzi.png)

**Our recommendation:** Prioritize the rewards your account actually needs, but give the Chaos fragment and artifact selection chests serious consideration before committing to the most expensive items.

## Pinnacle Trial and Glorious Challenge

Both combat activities return in their familiar formats.

**Pinnacle Trial** rewards players for clearing increasingly difficult stages, providing Magic Wands, random Immortal fragments, Tokens of Light, and event collection rewards.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141324-wkkdo5.png)

Additional stages unlock as the festival progresses, so check back regularly rather than expecting to finish everything immediately.

**Glorious Challenge** also returns with its familiar combat progression.

Completing stages provides candy currency for the Challenge Shop and Magic Wands for Witch Forest.

The higher difficulties unlock later during the event.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-141331-y293sm.png)

These activities are particularly important for free-to-play players because they provide event resources without requiring direct purchases.

Even if you don't intend to compete for ranking rewards, clearing as many accessible stages as possible should be part of your festival routine.

## Final Thoughts – Where Is the Best Value?

Ghost Fiesta is largely a traditional Infinity Kingdom seasonal festival, but Witch Forest and the new outfit rewards provide some welcome variety.

For free-to-play players, the priority should be collecting daily Lucky Koi gifts, completing the free battle pass, clearing Alchemical Secrets and combat challenges, and using the accumulated Magic Wands in Witch Forest.

For low and moderate spenders, **Lucky Koi remains one of the best purchases in the game**, while the premium festival pass offers an attractive combination of Tokens of Light and Louis IX outfit progression.

The Grail Shop also deserves attention, particularly the efficient Chaos Immortal and artifact selection chests.

Meanwhile, Dazzling Wish continues to be a particularly expensive way to pursue the newest seasonal outfit. Unless you're specifically targeting Fu Fei or its ranking rewards, there are generally more efficient places to spend your Tokens of Light.

Ultimately, the strategy remains familiar: **collect your free event resources first, identify which rewards matter to your account, and only spend additional money when it helps you reach a worthwhile milestone.**

Ghost Fiesta may be Halloween-themed, but getting the best value from it is still about careful planning rather than chasing every shiny reward.

title: Goddesses Celebration Festival 2026
summary: The 2026 Goddesses Festival continues the now-standard seasonal event framework that Infinity Kingdom has settled into over the past year. If you have played recent events, the structure will feel familiar: a battle…
markdown:
## Introduction

The 2026 **Goddesses Festival** continues the now-standard seasonal event framework that Infinity Kingdom has settled into over the past year. If you have played recent events, the structure will feel familiar: a battle pass, token-based gacha, alliance contribution system, PvE currency grind, and a grail-based progression layer.

What matters is not just understanding each tab, but how they connect. Tokens convert into grails, grails convert into fragments, and everything feeds into either chaos progression or resource efficiency depending on your account stage.

This guide breaks down every tab, explains the mechanics behind them, and provides practical recommendations based on actual in-game behavior.

---

## Judgment Realm (Battle Pass)

### Structure

- Free + Paid track
- 7 daily missions
- 100 EXP per mission
- ~70 total missions available
- No perfect attendance required for max level

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-48-1024x544.png)

### Common Tasks

- Troop training (multiple queues strongly recommended)
- Arena battles
- Well of Time
- Market purchases
- Pinnacle Trial
- Glorious Challenge
- Gnome bosses

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-49-1024x660.png)

### Rewards Overview

### Free Track

- 30 Tokens of Light

### Paid Track ($50)

- +170 Tokens of Light
- 7800 Gems
- 60 Castle Skin Fragments (Judgment Realm skin)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-50-1024x487.png)

**[See seperate guide here for more on the skin.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/skins/judgment-realm/)**

---

### Player Perspective

The value of the pass is heavily concentrated in the **tokens**, not the cosmetics.

- **200 total tokens (free + paid)**
→ ~865 Eternal Grails on average

That alone can fund:

- One top-tier chaos purchase (845 grails), or
- Mid-tier + leftover

In practice, this is one of the more efficient seasonal passes if your goal is chaos progression rather than visuals.

---

## Goddesses Celebration (Alliance Gifting)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-51-1024x582.png)

### Mechanics

- Send gifts to alliance members
- Earn:  - Celebration points (ranking)
- Eternal Grails
- Alliance members can claim rewards from your gifts

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-68-1024x527.png)

### Ranking Rewards

- Large gem payouts
- Eternal Grails for alliance
- **Top 3:**  - Temporary *Dark Night Sovereign* (top combat skin)
- *Supreme Ruler* teleport skin

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-52-1024x560.png)

### Player Perspective

This tab is **whale-dominated**. Rankings scale aggressively with spending.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-67.png)

However:

- Even light participation contributes to alliance grail income
- Gift generation from tokens (10% proc) feeds into this system passively

Treat this as:

- A **bonus system for low spenders**
- A **primary competitive track for high spenders**

---

## Lucky Koi

### Contents

- Daily login rewards
- Lucky Coin lottery
- **1 free Token of Light per day**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-53-1024x457.png)

### Koi Gift Pack ($4.99)

Includes:

- 5 Tokens of Light
- 520 Gems
- 500 VIP Points
- Grail lottery (up to 4250 every 2 days)
- Guaranteed 850 grails after 5 purchases without jackpot

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-54-1024x485.png)

### Player Perspective

This is one of the strongest low-cost packs currently available.

Baseline value:

- 5 tokens = **~21.6 grails**
- Plus gems, VIP, and lottery upside
- Plus 850 grails spending 25$

If you are spending at all, this is usually the first thing worth picking up.

---

## Dazzling Wish (Token Spins)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-55-1024x554.png)

### Drop Rates

- 0.45% → 300 grails
- 1.55% → 50 grails
- 3.5% → 25 grails
- 12% → 5 grails
- 72.5% → 1 grail
- 10% → 1 Celebration Gift

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-56.png)

### Expected Value

### 1 Token of Light = 4.325 Eternal Grails (average)

- 0.10 Celebration Gifts

### Practical Benchmarks

- 10 tokens → ~43.25 grails
- 100 tokens → ~432.5 grails
- 200 tokens → ~865 grails

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-57-1024x402.png)

### Player Perspective

Always evaluate tokens using **4.325 grails per token**. You need a lot to progress into e.g. chaos immortals with Grails, meaning the average rates are important here. While you can get lucky always assume average rewards.

Do not overvalue:

- High-roll jackpots (too rare)
- Gift value (too variable)

Treat gifts as bonus alliance value, not core progression.

---

## Grail Shop

### Festival Coin Shop

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-58-1024x537.png)

Earn coins via Glorious Challenge:

- 100 Stardust → 1000 coins
- Artifact Selection Chest → 2000 coins
- 5 Tokens → 2000 coins

---

### Eternal Grail Shop

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-59-1024x521.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-60-1024x305.png)

---

## Token → Fragment Efficiency Table

Using **4.325 grails per token**:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-61-1024x268.png)

---

## Glorious Challenge

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-62-1024x577.png)

### Mechanics

- Use tickets to fight gnomes
- Earn Festival Coins
- Progress unlocks higher difficulty (Hard mode on Day 4)

---

### Strategy Shift (Important)

Older advice: "*Save tickets until Hard Mode*"

That however, does not hold entirely true anymore. Since they changed the shop to hold daily stock instead of event-wide stock of items, you need to think more carefully and obtain currency early too.

Current reality (daily shop stock):

- Early spending is viable **if you spend coins immediately**
- Do NOT overcap coins
- Hard mode is still best for bulk farming

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-63.png)

### Recommended Approach

- Day 1–3:  - Spend tickets only if you need items immediately
- Day 4+:  - Push hard mode
- Bank coins for daily resets

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-64.png)

---

## Pinnacle Trial

### Overview

- PvE progression mode
- Increasing difficulty
- Includes:  - Chaos immortals
- High-tier skills

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-65-1024x545.png)

### Rewards

- Random immortal fragments
- Tokens of Light
- Lunar Grace Pavilion skin fragments

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-66.png)

---

### Player Perspective

Difficulty varies heavily by account:

- Early/mid game: can be a wall
- Late game: manageable with optimized setups

If stuck, head on over to the ik-wiki discord community for tips and tricks from other players on how to best defeat each level!

---

## Conclusion Summary

The Goddesses Festival follows a familiar structure, but the important layer is the math behind Tokens of Light:

- **1 Token = 4.325 grails (baseline)**
- Token volume directly determines your event outcome

Key takeaways:

- Battle pass value comes from tokens, not cosmetics
- Grail efficiency varies massively by immortal tier
- Daily-stock shops change how you approach Glorious Challenge
- Gift value is secondary—focus on guaranteed grail returns

If you approach the event with clear token-to-grail targets, it becomes much easier to decide where to spend, what to skip, and how to get the most out of the 10-day window.

---

title: Goddesses Festival 2023
summary: The Goddesses Festival is a great event for all types of players. If you want to spend there are excellent items available if you have a gem-abundance. This event however, does not require you to spend a single dollar…
markdown:
The Goddesses Festival is a great event for all types of players. If you want to spend there are excellent items available if you have a gem-abundance. This event however, does not require you to spend a single dollar to max out on rewards, making it arguably one of the best events for F2P players since we are only relying on Gems as currency for this event. While you do need quite a few gems to get the top rewards, the fact that any F2P player can bank gems and obtain the best of the best rewards is a huge improvement to other seasonal events where top rewards is pay-walled.

## Basics of this event

During the festival event you earn Goblets by farming nodes on the map, collecting resources from your farms (inside your castle), killing gnomes and killing bosses. Just like so many other events, we get boxes with item currency, this time Goblets.
These Goblets can be used to purchase Star Souvenir Coins, which are the currency for basic rewards. These are bought at a 1:1 ratio.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-110-1024x540.png)

**There are two types of rewards for this event and not all can be farmed with Goblets.** Goblets unlock the basic farmable rewards whereas the juicy and best rewards require another event currency: **Divine Crystals.**

## Divine Crystals

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-20.png)

These are not farmable, but are rewarded from completing the event quests/tasks and can be purchased for 200 gems each.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-111.png)

## Free Divine Crystals

While you can spend 200 gems to get a Divine Crystal all day, there is also a few Free Divine Crystals available in this event.

For free we get a total of 1x2 1x3 and 1x5 = **10 crystals.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-112-1024x494.png)

The way you unlock these is by completing the quest's found in the Secrets of Stars event tab. There are a total of xx Quests (outer circles) which you should make sure to complete during the event. As you complete these quests, you are rewarded both as you complete every quest as well as when you complete all the quests connected to one of the major chest nodes (see below)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-113.png)

### All in all these are the tasks you want to complete:

1. kill 50 gnomes (ANY level)
2. Purchase 50 times at the Market (buying Soul Crystal Immortal fragments can be melted for 1:1 return
3. Kill 15 Gnome bosses (ANY level)
4. Raid Well of Time 150 times (1500 SP required, make sure never to waste SP at cap)
5. Challenge 20 times in Arena (20 hits not wins!)
6. Sail 8 times (careful doing 12hour sails if you are behind)
7. Force teleport 10 lords (any dead castle will do, no lvl restriction)
8. Login for 4 days
9. Collect 600K resources (single node will do)
10. Train 80,000 troops (any type will do)
11. Summon 25 times using Philosopher Stones
12. Manufacture 200,000 Fortifications (any level and type)

## Rewards

I have **EXCLUDED**the free crystals, so you can just see it as a 2000 gem discount on your first purchase.

### 1. Star Souvenir Coin

| Star Coin | Stock | Reward |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 150 | 1 | Epic Artifact (standard) |
| 25 | 3 | Philosopher's Stones |
| 10 | 1 | Nameplate |
| 10 | 1 | Elite Immortal Fragments Chest (100-10,000 soul crystals) |
| 15 | 5 | 3h universal speedup |
| 10 | 5 | Medium Rss Chest |
| 6 | 15 | 30m Universal Speedup |
| 2 | 20 | Basic Rss Chest |

We want to make sure we grind enough Goblets / Star coins to get the **Random Epic Immortal**, the **Philosopher's Offer chest** and the **Elite Immortal Fragments Chest**. These are the most important rewards, because they yield decent purple crystal. If you have currency to spare, go for speedups.

### 2. Divine Crystal

| Divine Crystal | Stock | Reward | Price in gems 1x |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | 1 | Unique Artifact (Attila, Saladin, Alexander, Cid) | 40000 |
| 180 | 1 | Unique Artifact (Ramss, Leonidas, Hannibal, Richard) | 36000 |
| 50 | 1 | 1000x dragon crystals (earth, lightning, water, fire) | 10000 |
| 10 | 2 | Epic Merchants Chest (gold / marketorder / boost buff) | 2000 |
| 2 | 5 | Philosopher's Offer (chance at stones / gems / exp / speeds) | 400 |
| 1 | 5 | Full of Energy (AP recovery / Speeds) | 200 |
| 1 | 20 | Medium Rss Chest | 200 |
| 1 | 15 | 3h Universal Speedup | 200 |

There are many important rewards to take not of here:

1. **Unique Artifact**for Alex, Attila, Saladin or Cid is very powerful and 40,000 gems is pretty cheap! You usually should think a value of around 100-150$ for one of these.
2. **Dragon soul crystals** take a long time to grind out, making it a very nice reward if you are working on a second or a third dragon. If you are building multiple marches, you want to buy this one. If you are a low spender or a free to play, dont bother with your gems on this one.
3. **Philosopher Stones**are often **the best value item** of these events. this is no different. Each stone has a value **[avg. of 515 purple crystals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/passives/purple-crystal-maximum-efficiency-2/)** and getting them at a discount rate is awesome. These are simply insanely good, because you need a ton of purple crystal **[(read everything abount purple crystals here)](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/passives/purple-crystal-maximum-efficiency-2/)**.
Each stone costs 200 gems instead of the usual 300 gems, making it a nice discount you want to use up.
4. The **Full of Energy** Chest is very good! You can get a TON of AP this way and you want to make sure you buy all five of those regardless of who you are!

## Other rewards

In other rewards, we get some nice things on the side as we play through this event. Doing the quests from "Secrets of the Stars" will net you a **territorial teleport**, assorted **buffs**, rss **chests**, **speedups**and **exp**scrolls. All very nice loot for very little effort.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103921.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103914.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103907.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103853.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103847.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103840.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103833.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-103826.png)

*Examples of the loot, non-exhaustive.*

We also get a nice amount of **ressources**, **speedups**and if we are lucky, **Enchant** **Stones**and **Exp** Scrolls as we hand over our Goblets and purchase Divine Crystals with gems on the "Divine Blessings" tab.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-104200.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-101806-1.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-100648.png)

title: Goddesses Festival 2024
summary: The Goddesses Festival returns to Infinity Kingdom, continuing the tradition of celebrating with Goblets, Souvenir Coins, and Divine Crystals. This event offers players, both free-to-play (F2P) and spenders, a variety…
markdown:
### Goddesses Festival Event Guide: Maximizing Rewards in Infinity Kingdom

The Goddesses Festival returns to Infinity Kingdom, continuing the tradition of celebrating with Goblets, Souvenir Coins, and Divine Crystals. This event offers players, both free-to-play (F2P) and spenders, a variety of rewards through active participation and strategic resource management. Here's how to navigate this event efficiently, ensuring you maximize the benefits from both tiers of rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-141.png)

## Free Tier Rewards: Goblets to Souvenir Coins Conversion

### Collecting Goblets

Participants will collect Goblets throughout the event period, which serve as the primary currency for F2P rewards. These Goblets can be converted into Souvenir Coins, the currency used to redeem rewards in the free tier.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-142-1024x486.png)

### Noteworthy Free Tier Rewards

While the free tier rewards may not seem as lucrative compared to previous events, there are still valuable items to be obtained for diligent players:

- **100 Stardust for 150 Souvenir Coins**: Essential for upgrading portrait levels, stardust remains a valuable resource.
- **Epic Immortal Selection Chest for 150 Souvenir Coins**: For players looking to complete or enhance their epic immortal rosters, this selection chest offers a direct path to do so.
- **Minor Speedups**: While not the highlight of the event, speedups are always useful for progressing faster in various game aspects.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-143-1024x443.png)

## Spender Tier Rewards: Leveraging Divine Crystals

### Earning Divine Crystals

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-139-1024x439.png)

Divine Crystals are obtained through event-specific quests and spending gems, with the conversion rate being 1 Divine Crystal for every 200 gems spent. These crystals unlock the path to more premium rewards within the event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-140.png)

### Premium Rewards and Their Costs

The spender tier offers significant rewards that can impact your strategic positioning in the game:

- **Holy or Shadow Immortal for 120 Divine Crystals (24,000 gems)**: Acquiring a Holy or Shadow immortal at this price is an opportunity worth considering for players focusing on these elements, particularly for those looking to max out immortals like Himiko or Tomyris.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-144-1024x411.png)

- **Unique Artifacts for 60 Divine Crystals (12,000 gems)**: Given the essential role of artifacts in boosting immortal performance, securing them at this price offers great value. Players should prioritize acquiring artifacts integral to their main lineup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-145-1024x453.png)

## Strategic Considerations

### Assessing Value and Priorities

- **For F2P Players**: Focus on collecting Goblets daily to maximize your Souvenir Coins. Prioritize rewards that directly contribute to your current objectives, such as stardust for portrait levels or specific epic immortals to round out your lineup.
- **For Spenders**: Evaluate your spending plans in the context of the event. If you were already planning to invest in gems, timing your purchases to coincide with the Goddesses Festival can yield additional value in the form of Divine Crystals. Prioritize holy or shadow immortals and unique artifacts that align with your strategic needs.

### Conclusion

- **Daily Engagement**: Ensure you're completing the event-specific quests daily to gather as many Goblets and Divine Crystals as possible.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-146.png)

The Goddesses Festival in Infinity Kingdom presents a blend of opportunities for both free-to-play participants and spenders. While the free tier offers modest rewards, diligent collection and conversion of Goblets to Souvenir Coins can still yield useful resources. For spenders, the event underscores the strategic use of gems to obtain significant boosts through Holy or Shadow immortals and unique artifacts. By carefully navigating the event's mechanics and optimizing resource allocation, players can enhance their Kingdom's prowess and prepare for the challenges ahead in Norheim.

markdown:
The Goddesses Festival is a great event for all types of players. If you want to spend there are excellent items available if you have a gem-abundance. This event however, does not require you to spend a single dollar to max out on rewards, making it arguably one of the best events for F2P players.

## Basics of this event

During the festival event you earn Goblets by farming nodes on the map, collecting resources from your farms (inside your castle), killing gnomes and killing bosses. Just like so many other events, we get boxes with item currency, this time Goblets.
These Goblets can be used to purchase Star Souvenir Coins, which are the currency for basic rewards. These are bought at a 1:1 ratio.

**There are two types of rewards, and not all can be farmed with Goblets.**

The higher quality rewards requires Divine Crystals

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-20.png)

These are not farmable, but are rewarded from completing the event quests/tasks and can be purchased for 200 gems each.

**Free Divine Crystals**
For free we get a total of 1x2 1x3 and 1x5 = 10 crystals. We want to spend these on philosopher stones!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Skaermbillede-2022-03-13-100614-1024x546.png)

If you plan on spending gems during this event, see below how much each item will cost you.

## Rewards

I have **EXCLUDED**the free crystals, so you can just see it as a 2000 gem discount on your first purchase.

### 1. Star Souvenir Coin

| 2 | 40 | Basic Rss Chest |  |

We want to make sure we grind enough Goblets / Star coins to get the **Random Epic Immortal**, the **Philosopher's Offer chest** and the **Elite Immortal Fragments Chest**. These are the most important rewards, because they yield decent purple crystal. If you have currency to spare, go for speedups.

### 2. Divine Crystal

| Divine Crystal | Stock | Reward | Price in gems 1x |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 120 | 1 | Core Immortal Selection ( Charles, Khan, Baldwin ) | 24000 |
| 150 | 1 | Permanent Skin | 30000 |

| 10 | 1 | Avartar Frame | 2000 |
| 5 | 1 | Chatbox | 1000 |

There are many important rewards to take not of here:

1. **Free to play players have a rare opportunity to unlock one of the best Immortals in the game - Charles, Genghis Khan or Baldwin.** These are usually only availble through a 99$ bundle, making this a VERY good event and a priority for players who are not spending that much on an Immortal unlock.
2. **Dragon soul crystals** take a long time to grind out, making it a very nice reward if you are working on a second or a third dragon. If you are building multiple marches, you want to buy this one. If you are a low spender or a free to play, dont bother with your gems on this one.
3. **Philosopher Stones**are often **the best value item** of these events. this is no different. Each stone has a value **[avg. of 515 purple crystals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/passives/purple-crystal-maximum-efficiency-2/)** and getting them at a discount rate is awesome. These are simply insanely good, because you need a ton of purple crystal **[(read everything abount purple crystals here)](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/passives/purple-crystal-maximum-efficiency-2/)**.
Each stone costs 200 gems instead of the usual 300 gems, making it a nice discount you want to use up.

### Mastering Hippolyta's Unique Artifact in Infinity Kingdom

Hippolyta, a fire Immortal renowned for her formidable presence on both the battlefield and against bosses, becomes an even more critical asset to any lineup with the acquisition of her Unique Artifact. This guide delves into the strategic enhancements brought by this artifact, how to obtain it, and its pivotal role in maximizing Hippolyta's potential in Infinity Kingdom.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-93-1024x635.png)

## The Power of Hippolyta's Unique Artifact

Hippolyta's Ultimate Ability, already a game-changer due to its capacity to control enemy energy regeneration and attack speed, receives a significant boost with her Unique Artifact. The artifact upgrades her ultimate from delivering 5 strikes to a devastating 7 strikes. Each strike not only inflicts 120% physical damage but also reduces the enemy's energy by 100 and their attack speed by 10%. This enhancement not only amplifies the damage dealt but also escalates the control aspect of her ability, making Hippolyta an indispensable Immortal for fire and hybrid setups alike.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-94-1024x428.png)

### Strategic Implications

- **Enhanced Control**: The additional strikes further cripple the enemy's ability to regenerate energy and reduce their attack speed, significantly hampering their combat effectiveness.
- **Increased Damage Output**: With 2 extra hits at 120% physical damage each, Hippolyta's overall damage capability skyrockets, making her even more lethal in PvP and against bosses.

## Obtaining Hippolyta's Unique Artifact

Fortunately for players, acquiring Hippolyta's Unique Artifact is relatively straightforward, making this power boost accessible to a wide player base.

### Throne of the Supreme Shop

The artifact is a permanent fixture in the Throne of the Supreme shop, allowing players to target their resources specifically to acquire this item.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-92.png)

### Special Bundles and Stellar Compass Event

In addition to the shop, the artifact can also be found in special bundles and as part of the rewards in the Stellar Compass event. These avenues provide flexibility in obtaining the artifact, ensuring that players can leverage different aspects of the game to secure this valuable item.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-91-1024x582.png)

## Maximizing Hippolyta's Potential

With the Unique Artifact in hand, players should consider the following strategies to fully leverage Hippolyta's enhanced capabilities:

### Skill Composition

You want to incorporate a high energy regen build on your Hippolyta. She provides value through her ultimate ability and having high energy regen means a lot more hits - especially when you have the unique artifact! Because she hits so many times with each cast, you can run Energy Burst for high effect.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-95.png)

### Artifact Synergy

Focus on enhancing other aspects of Hippolyta's gear and abilities that synergize with the control and damage aspects of her enhanced ultimate. Prioritizing physical damage and speed reduction effects can further magnify her battlefield control.

### Tactical Deployment

Deploy Hippolyta strategically in PvP battles and against bosses where her enhanced ultimate can disrupt enemy formations or significantly reduce boss effectiveness. Identifying key enemy targets or boss mechanics susceptible to energy and attack speed reduction can dictate the timing and focus of her ultimate ability.

## Conclusion

Hippolyta's Unique Artifact transforms her into an even more powerful Immortal, with significant implications for control and damage in PvP and PvE content alike. Its relatively easy acquisition makes it a must-have for players looking to enhance their lineup's effectiveness. By obtaining this artifact and employing strategic deployment and synergy, players can unlock the full potential of Hippolyta, making her a cornerstone of their Immortal roster in Infinity Kingdom.

title: Golden Path Shopping List for F2P or Spender
summary: Common Player Question throughout the many years of Golden Path: What should I prioritize? What should I buy?... lets answer that once in for all!
markdown:
## Infinity Kingdom Guide: Best Shopping List for Golden Path (Patch 2.8.5 Edition)

*By Myrahk – July 2025*

Common Player Question throughout the many years of Golden Path: What should I prioritize? What should I buy?... lets answer that once in for all!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-72.png)

The **Golden Path** is, hands down, the best value feature in Infinity Kingdom. It gives access to meta immortals, unique artifacts, portals, purple crystals, and other high-value items at a better rate than any other system in the game. But with limited **Golden Path Coins** each season, **what should you actually buy?**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-73-1024x434.png)

This guide breaks it down for **Free-to-Play**, **Light Spenders**, and **Whales**, helping you make the **best shopping choices** based on your playstyle and goals.

---

## How to Complete a Golden Path Season

**Levels and Runtime**: To fully utilize the entire shop during the Golden Path Season, players need to reach level 50. The event spans a duration of 30 days, giving you ample time to immerse yourself in its challenges and reap the rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-76-1024x491.png)

**Daily Quests**: By completing the 18 daily quests you can earn a total of 216 EXP.

**Total Gain Calculation**: We have around 30 days to complete a season. 30 x 216 EXP = 6480 EXP = 64 levels. That means you get the 100 from clearing battle pass plus 15x 50 return reward = 450 coins for a **total of 550 coins per season entirely free to play.**

Buying the Battle Pass for 20$ you get 20 levels, meaning an additional 600 coins as you repeat the 50 level 20 more times plus 200 coins from the paid tier rewards as you level. Total of 550 + 600 + 200 = 1350 coins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-75-1024x466.png)

---

## Step 1: Understand Your Coin Budget

Here’s how many coins you can expect:

- **Free-to-Play:** ~500–600 coins (depending on activity and pass completion)
- **Light Spender (Premium Pass):** ~1300-1400 coins (**200 from the instant 20 levels** + **~750 from progression**)
- **Whale:** No real limit — you’ll max the pass every season, just gem it...

Knowing your coin budget helps prioritize properly.

---

## Best Buys in the Golden Path Shop

Before we make lists, here are the **top-value items** every player should consider:

- **Action Point Flasks (x10)** – 1,000 AP each for just 10 coins — insane value for farming gnomes/events.
- **Unique Artifacts (NEW)** – Now available for those immortals, **600 coins each** (one per immortal per season).
- **Meta Immortal Fragments** – **Yi Sun-Shin, Matilda, Artemisia, Tokugawa, Trajan** are game-changing.
- **Random Immortal Fragments (x5 per element)** – **1500 total per season** for **150,000 purple crystals** (Best source for ToK growth).
- **Portals (x10)** – Cheap migration tokens at 50 coins each.

---

## Myrahk’s Best Shopping Lists

Let’s optimize based on player type:

---

### Free-to-Play (500-600 coins)

If you’re F2P, your focus should be **long-term progression**. ***Goal**:* Get the core immortals that you are unable to obtain elsewhere due to pay-walls.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-77-1024x408.png)

### Priority Order:

1. **Immortal Fragments** – Pick **one meta immortal** you’re building. Keep buying until core main march immortal is max.
2. **Action Point Flasks (x10)** – 10,000 AP — **100 coins total**.
3. **Elemental Selection Unique Artifacts - 480 coins**. Use them to upgrade your core damage dealer in your main setup max.
4. **Random Immortal Fragments**60x fragments for 60 coins, buy as many as you can and turn them into Purple Crystals to upgrade your ToK skills.
5. If you are considering migration, **Portal** (50 coins) or stockpile toward next season.

---

### Light Spenders (1300-1400 coins with Premium Pass)

This is the sweet spot for efficiency. You get enough coins to make **serious progress** without spending hundreds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-79-1024x353.png)

### Priority Order:

1. **Action Point Flasks (x10)** – **100 coins** for 10,000 AP for event farming efficiency.
2. **Elemental Selection Unique Artifacts - 480 coins**. Very good value, make sure you buy both (2x) in stock and upgrade your core damage dealer in your main setup max.
3. **Unique Artifact** – **600 coins**. This is huge value if you need it. But you should only buy if you are using these immortals in your main or secondary march.
4. **Random Immortal Fragments (all 5 elements)** – You gain 100 Purple Crystals worth of fragments for each coin spent here. Max 1500 coins for 150K Crystals.
5. **Portals** – if you are doing migration prep.

*Goal:* Make *one*immortal **artifact-ready**, continue boosting your Tower of Knowledge, and stock up on migration flexibility.

---

### Whales (No Budget Limit)

If you’re maxing, your shopping list is **everything**. But there’s still a smart order of operations:

### Priority Order:

1. **All Unique Artifacts** – 600 coins each — **must-have** for meta immortals.
2. **All Meta Immortal Fragments (5x each)** – You’ll max their talents much faster.
3. **Random Immortal Fragments (all 5 elements)** – Even whales need purple crystals for maxing ToK.
4. **Portals (x10)** – Flexibility for cross-server migration.
5. **Action Point Flasks (x10)** – Farm nonstop.
6. **Cosmetics (castle skins, frames)** – If you care about aesthetics.

*Goal:* Max out your main team’s immortals and artifacts, prep for Conquest meta builds, and maintain server movement flexibility.

---

## Why This Shopping Order Works

- **Purple Crystals** are the hardest long-term bottleneck — get them every season.
- **Artifacts** are now the biggest game-changer for meta immortals.
- **Meta Immortals** like Yi Sun-Shin, Matilda, Trajan, and Tokugawa remain top Conquest picks.
- **Portals & AP** future-proof your account for server politics and event farming.

---

## TL;DR – Myrahk’s Golden Path Shopping Rules

- **F2P:** Paywalled immortals for free here → Action Points → Random fragments for purples.
- **Light Spender:** Action Points → Artifact for main → Paywalled immortals for free here → Random frags → Portals.
- **Whales:** Buy **everything** in this order: AP → Artifacts → Immortal Frags → Random Frags → Portals → Cosmetics.

---

### Final Thoughts

Even after the 2.8.5 adjustments (fragment limit reduction), the **Golden Path is still the single best value purchase in Infinity Kingdom.**

For **Free-to-Play**, it’s your primary path to Tower of Knowledge growth.
For **Light Spenders**, it’s the perfect mix of efficiency and power progression.
For **Whales**, it’s the fastest way to **stay meta** with artifacts and immortals.

If you take anything from this guide, it’s this: **Never miss a season of Golden Path.**
