✨ **Golden Week is here in Infinity Kingdom!** ✨
Make sure you log in through the Gtarcade App and collect your **free rewards** before November 7th. Don’t miss out on **free gems, Philosopher’s Stones, speedups**, and the cozy **Moonlit Hearth castle skin** for just 100 points — basically free!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-1.png)

Golden Week is here in Norheim, and Gtarcade is giving us some small but sweet rewards through the App (desktop or mobile). Until **November 7th**, players can grab both a free bundle and a super cheap skin reward. Neither is game-breaking, but for free-to-play players and collectors, this is an easy win.

---

### Free Golden Week Giftpack

The free pack is the one nobody should skip. This is a daily reward, so make sure you login to the Gtarcade app every day atleast for the Golden Week!

It gives you:

- **300 Gems**
- **9 Philosopher’s Stones**
- **3 Hours of Universal Speedups**
- A small stack of resources

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-3-1024x518.png)

The real gem here (no pun intended) is the **Philosopher’s Stones**, since you can convert them into **Soul Crystals** or use them for **Immortal summons**. Every player benefits from these — F2P especially, but even late-game players can’t say no to free pulls.

So yeah, this is basically just free efficiency. Claim it the moment you log in on the Gtarcade app.

---

### Moonlit Hearth Castle Skin (100 Gtarcade Points)

Now, onto the second Golden Week gift: the **Moonlit Hearth** castle skin. This one is **not a paid cash bundle** — it costs just **100 Gtarcade Points**, which makes it dirt cheap.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-4-1024x527.png)

To put it in perspective:

- Just doing your **daily login** and spinning the **Gtarcade Point Wheel once** basically gets you there.
- Even if you don’t have points saved up, you’ll almost certainly collect enough during the Golden Week period to buy it without effort.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-5.png)

That’s why I’d actually call this **practically free-to-play**, even though technically you’re spending points.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-6.png)

The skin itself is a cozy purple design with an Asian aesthetic. Not flashy, not over the top — just a chill vibe. It comes with:

- **+3% Resource Gathering Speed** buff

And let’s be honest: that buff isn’t great. Gathering speed doesn’t impact combat, and compared to skins with training, healing, or construction boosts, this one sits low on the usefulness scale.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-7-1024x502.png)

But here’s the thing: at **100 points**, the opportunity cost is tiny. Sure, you could spend those points on:

- Two daily **Beginner Gtarcade bundles** (15-min speedups + 1 small SP bottle each), or
- Roughly a third of the **100-gem bundle**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-8-1024x489.png)

But for most players, that tradeoff is worth it just to snag a limited-time cosmetic. If you like the cozy look, it’s a no-brainer.

You should expect to earn over 100 point for free just by doing the daily Gtarcade routine in the App, making the cost very very minor. **[Read more about the ways to obtain Points for free here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/accounts/gtarcade/gtarcade-wheel-free-gtarcade-points-daily/)**

---

### Player Perspective, i.e. what I will do:

- Grab the **free bundle immediately** (Philosopher’s Stones are always high value).
- Spend the 100 points on the **Moonlit Hearth skin** — not because the buff is good, but because it’s so cheap and it adds to my collection of skins. Its cute and passing it up seems a wasted opportunity given the incredibly low cost.

---

### What if my Account is not bound to a Gtarcade account?

First of all, I recommend that you fix that immediately. Simply the risk of account deletion, forgetting the password, loosing your phone, etc. is more than enough risk to make Gtarcade Account Binding an important step for you. **[If this is relevant for you, read more here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/accounts/gtarcade/linking-your-account/).**

Using the Desktop app you find the giftpacks under "Point Shop" as you open the Gtarcade app as you would normally when starting the game. If you do not have the app, **[download available here.](https://clientweb.gtarcade.com/download/download.html)**

On Mobile, you can download the App via your preferred App Store or access directly using the in-game shop which has a link at the top. See more below.

### Introduction

Grace is one of the newest additions to the game and one that is extreemly interesting given the current crit-based meta. As such it is perhaps not surprisingly a prominent skill in most top tier builds once you hit the later legendary seasons and it is made available. Like most of the Tower of Knowledge aura skills Grace is quite simple, yet hugely effective! It reduces incoming critical damage, which directly targets one of the strongest and most common strategies for build-setups in the current meta.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-22.png)

A lot of popular builds rely heavily on crit-based burst—Khan, Loki, and similar setups—so a skill that weakens crit damage changes how those fights play out. It’s not flashy, but it affects your defensive capabilities in a massive way.

---

### How the Skill Works

Grace is an **epic aura skill**, which means its effect is always active from the moment the battle starts. There’s no trigger condition, no cooldown, and no RNG involved. As soon as the fight begins, all allies benefit from reduced critical damage taken.

The effect itself is simple: it reduces critical damage received by up to 50%.

It’s important to understand that this **does not prevent crits from happening**. Enemies will still land critical hits, **but the damage multiplier** on those hits is significantly reduced.

In practice, this turns large burst hits into something much more manageable. A hit that would normally chunk a unit heavily instead becomes something that can be healed through or absorbed by shielding effects much better. Overall that means enemies are not going to be able to rely on huge burst hits to settle the fight, instead Grace ensures a much longer fight as incomming damage is smoothed.

Because it’s an aura skill, it also comes with a limitation: each immortal can only equip one aura. So running Grace means you’re giving up another aura option, which is an important trade-off to consider when building your setup. That being said, this is an absolute S-tier skill and should be a priority.

---

### Availability and Upgrading

Unlike legendary Chaos skills, Grace is relatively accessible. You unlock it through the **Contract Shop during Legendary Season**, I believe starting at Round 3. This means it is available to a much wider range of players than many other top tier skills (namely legendaries), and is available also to free-to-play.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-23-1024x435.png)

After unlocking it with skill stones, upgrades are done using **Soul Crystals**, which is a more standard and manageable resource compared to Chaos skill upgrades. Because of this and how powerful the effect is, you can expect Grace to become very common across all levels of play once players reach that stage of progression.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-24-1024x512.png)

That accessibility is a big part of why this skill is so interesting —it’s not just strong, it’s widely usable.

---

### What It Changes in Combat

The most immediate effect of Grace is that it reduces the impact of burst damage. In the current meta burst crits can be massive when players build out strong artifacts, etc. and that means fights tend to go quite short. For example below, you see one Corona Godstrike eliminating (almost) an entire team on a single critical hit.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-25-1024x498.png)

Critical hits are still there, but they no longer decide fights on their own. Where you would normally see a unit lose a huge chunk of HP from a single crit, you now see a more controlled drop in health.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-26-1024x377.png)

Naturally the above is me finding extreemes to prove a point, but in general critical hits are huge in Infinity Kingdom and reducing their damage by a whopping 50% is absolutely massive!

This has a ripple effect on the entire fight. Battles last longer because units aren’t being deleted as quickly. Healing becomes more effective because it has time to work between hits. Instead of fights being decided in short burst windows, they stretch out into longer exchanges where sustain and consistency matter more.

Over time, this leads to more fights approaching the time limit. In PvP especially, that changes how wins are secured. Instead of overwhelming your opponent quickly, you often win by simply surviving longer.

---

### Impact on Team Building and Meta

Grace naturally shifts the game toward more defensive and sustain-oriented setups. Tanks, shields and healers gain value because they benefit directly from reduced burst damage. Double tank compositions, which can struggle against high burst, start to feel more stable again.

At the same time, crit-reliant builds lose some of their edge. They still deal good damage, but they no longer have the same ability to quickly eliminate targets. This forces those builds to rely more on sustained damage rather than single big hits.

Another important point is that Grace is often stronger in defense than offense. When you’re attacking, you usually need to secure damage to either win or atleast make a huge impact in a rally. When you’re defending, simply surviving long enough can be enough—especially if the fight times out. Grace supports that defensive playstyle very well.

---

### Player Perspective

From experience, Grace doesn’t feel like a power spike in the traditional sense. It doesn’t increase your numbers or make your damage look better. Instead, it limits how much your opponent can do to you.

The difference becomes obvious in close fights. Situations where a couple of crits would normally decide the outcome instead turn into longer trades. Units that would have died survive just long enough to be healed, and that often changes the entire flow of the fight.

It also changes how you approach matchups. Against strong burst players, Grace gives you a layer of consistency that makes fights feel less volatile. You’re less dependent on avoiding bad RNG from enemy crits, and more able to play around sustained pressure.

---

### Conclusion Summary

Grace is an epic aura skill that reduces critical damage taken by up to 50%, and while the effect is simple, its impact is significant. It slows fights down, weakens burst-heavy strategies, and makes sustain-based gameplay more viable.

Because it’s always active and relatively easy to obtain, it’s likely to become a standard part of many builds. It won’t help you win faster, but it will make it much harder for your opponent to win quickly—and in the current meta, that alone makes it a very valuable tool.

---

title: Growl
summary: Growl is a legendary season KvK-limited Tower of Knowledge skill built around a simple tradeoff: early tempo in exchange for raw damage scaling. On paper, a 50% increase to physical damage suggests a top-tier offensive…
markdown:
### Introduction

Growl is a legendary season KvK-limited Tower of Knowledge skill built around a simple tradeoff: early tempo in exchange for raw damage scaling. On paper, a 50% increase to physical damage suggests a top-tier offensive option. In practice, its value depends heavily on how your build generates damage and how combat unfolds over time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-32-1024x604.png)

Unlike skills that enable more frequent attacks or trigger chains, Growl operates as a *pure amplifier*. It strengthens what your build already does, but does not help it do it more often. That distinction defines where the skill performs well—and where it falls short.

---

### Skill Description

> **Growl:** Lowers your initial Energy by 100, and increases your Physical Damage by 50%

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-33.png)

---

### Mechanics and Tradeoffs

Growl combines a very large offensive modifier with a meaningful tempo penalty. Understanding how these two parts interact is key to evaluating the skill.

The **50% physical damage increase** applies broadly across a physical damage build. It enhances normal attacks, physical skill damage, and any effects that scale from physical output.

The **energy penalty** introduces a more subtle limitation. Starting with 100 less energy delays the first ultimate cast, which can have a real impact in faster fights—especially in PvP, where early ultimates often decide momentum. In slower encounters, this drawback becomes less important, as the fight length allows the damage bonus to compensate over time.

Usually you want trigger-skills that scale off of the high number of normal-attack instances of e.g. Alexander and Hannibal. Now, Growl does not affect attack frequency or proc rates.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-34-1024x630.png)

It does not generate additional hits, nor does it improve the likelihood of triggering effects like Wind-rage or Assembly Charge, its value is tied entirely to amplifying all physical damage dealt. Pure and simple. Why it fits nicely here is down to the energy penalty, which is completely removed on Alexander and Hannibal since their unique artifact removes energy entirely from them making their skill a passive.

---

### Performance by Game Mode

#### PvE Performance (Elemental Domain, Bosses, Spiders)

Growl performs most consistently in PvE environments, where fights tend to be longer and less dependent on early burst timing. In these scenarios, the delayed ultimate has relatively little impact, while the 50% damage increase applies across the entire duration of the fight.

From testing, the improvement is steady rather than explosive. For example, Hippolyta’s damage in Elemental Domain increased by roughly 5–10 million per run after switching to Growl, pushing totals from around 95 million to over 100 million. The rotation itself did not change—what changed was the value of every damage instance within that rotation.

This is where Growl finds its niche. PvE encounters reward sustained output and consistency, and Growl enhances both without requiring specific timing or conditions. It is particularly effective on Immortals with multi-hit abilities, where each individual hit benefits from the scaling.

---

#### PvP Performance (Arena, KvK Combat)

In PvP, Growl becomes more situational. The same damage increase is present, but the context is different. Fights are often decided quickly, and early ultimate timing plays a much larger role in determining the outcome.

The energy penalty can delay key abilities just enough to lose early pressure, especially in optimized teams built around fast activation and chaining effects. At the same time, Growl does not contribute to increasing attack frequency or trigger consistency, which are often the main drivers of damage in competitive builds.

Testing reflects this tradeoff. On Alexander, for instance, Growl produced similar or slightly higher damage numbers in some cases, but not by a meaningful margin. Replacing core synergy skills like Assembly Charge typically resulted in minimal gains or even slight losses, because the build depends more on generating additional triggers than amplifying individual hits.

That said, Growl is not unusable in PvP. It fits reasonably well into second or third marches, where optimization is less strict and sustained damage can still provide value. It can also perform adequately in slower matchups where fights extend beyond the initial burst window.

---

### Conclusion Summary

Growl is a **situational scaling skill** with clear strengths and limitations:

- Provides a **50% physical damage increase across all sources**
- Trades early tempo for long-term output via an energy penalty
- Excels in **PvE and sustained damage scenarios**
- Struggles in **fast-paced PvP builds dependent on triggers and timing**

### Best used:

- In second or third teams
- In PvE content like Elemental Domain and boss fights
- On Immortals with multi-hit or scaling abilities

**Final takeaway:**
Growl is not a core engine skill—it is a **multiplier**. If your build already produces consistent damage, Growl will elevate it. If your build depends on speed, chaining, or early pressure, the skill will feel out of place.

---

title: GTA Store 20% Limited-Time Sale Is Now Live (september 2026)
markdown:
## 💠How Does the 20% Sale Work?

The sale does not necessarily reduce the price shown for each bundle. Instead, you receive a larger quantity of the included items for the original price.

For example, the price that would ordinarily buy **8 coins now buys 10**. This effectively reduces the price per item by 20%, even though the total bundle price remains unchanged.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20260930-135845-27noj9.png)

The promotion covers several different resources, so compare the increased contents with what each bundle ordinarily provides before purchasing.

## 💠Is the Sale Worth Using?

The GTArcade Store generally offers better bundle value than purchasing directly through the game, and receiving another 20% discount on top makes this a good time to bring forward purchases you were already planning to make.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20260930-135710-zan379.png)

Players investing in Chaos Immortals, Holy and Shadow progression, Dragon development or other long-term upgrades may find some excellent value here. However, there are no exclusive rewards tied directly to the sale itself, so there is little reason to purchase resources you do not actually need.

The sensible approach is simple: if you were likely to buy one of these bundles later, buying it during the promotion gives you more for the same money.

## 💠Monthly Cumulative Top-Up Rewards

Purchases from the GTA Store also count towards the **monthly cumulative recharge rewards**. Your eligible spending accumulates throughout the month, with additional rewards unlocking whenever you reach one of the listed thresholds.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20260930-135735-php3gg.png)

For example, the reward levels shown in the store include:

* **$4.99 cumulative recharge:** 14 Random Immortal Fragments, 14 Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chests, 2 Precious Dragon Crystal Selection Chests and 520 Gems.
* **$19.99 cumulative recharge:** 20 Random Immortal Fragments, 20 Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chests, 4 Precious Dragon Crystal Selection Chests and 2,300 Gems.
* **$999.99 cumulative recharge:** 120 Random Shadow Immortal Fragments, 120 Shadow and Light Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chests, 200 Eternal Dragon Soul Chests, 100,000 Gems and the **Official Supporter – Leader Insignia**.

There are additional milestones between these examples, and each reward level can be claimed once per month. This means that purchases made during the 20% sale can provide value in two places: extra items from the discounted bundle itself and progress towards the monthly cumulative rewards.

## 💠New Player First-Purchase Gift

If you have never purchased anything through the GTArcade Store before, your first purchase of **any priced package** also unlocks the one-time Platform First Purchase Gift.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20260930-135745-y7jzgc.png)

The gift contains:

* King Arthur ×1
* Philosopher’s Stone ×9
* Medium SP Recovery ×3
* Medium AP Recovery ×3
* Gems ×100
* **Official Supporter – Common Insignia ×1**

Since any priced package qualifies, even one of the cheapest available purchases can unlock the full gift. The insignia is particularly valuable because insignias provide permanent account bonuses as your collection develops.

This first-purchase gift is separate from both the limited-time sale and the monthly cumulative recharge rewards, allowing an eligible new store customer to benefit from all three simultaneously.

## 💠Promotion Period

**Start:** September 28, 2026
**End:** September 30, 2026

You can find the participating bundles through the official [Infinity Kingdom GTA Store](https://shop.gtarcade.com/en/game?game_id=408).

The sale lasts for only three days, so anyone already planning a GTA Store purchase should inspect the available bundles and monthly reward thresholds before the promotion ends.

1. [Download and Install](#install)
2. [Why install Gtarcade app?](#why)
2.1 [Point Shop rewards](#points)
2.2. [Community Forum](#forum)

You can find the Gtarcade application on Gtarcades website: [**https://www.gtarcade.com/en/micro/download**](https://www.gtarcade.com/en/micro/download)

From there you simply download and run the installer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-39-1024x530.png)

You have direct access to the Gtarcade community forums via the app. It work really well with a built in browser functionality.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-40-1024x1019.png)

In the last tab of the app you can read more info about the Emulator and how it works. The FAQ has info on mapping keyboards, setting up Macros, various error codes, etc.

title: Gtarcade PC Launch event

markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-56-1024x400.png)

## Infinity Kingdom PC Launch Event Guide

**Attention, Infinity Kingdom players!** A brand-new event has hit the scene, and it's called the "PC Launch." But what's it all about, and why should you be excited? In this guide, we'll break down the PC Launch event, what it entails, and how you can make the most of it to enhance your gaming experience.

## The PC Launch Event

Despite the name, the PC Launch event isn't just for newcomers. If you've been playing Infinity Kingdom on your PC for a while, you're not left out in the cold either. The PC Launch event is all about celebrating the game's availability on PC and giving players fantastic opportunities to earn valuable rewards.

## Migrate Seamlessly to PC

If you've been a dedicated Infinity Kingdom player on your mobile device, now is the perfect time to migrate to the PC version. And even if you're already enjoying the PC version, there are still exciting rewards waiting for you.

## Daily Rewards

One of the highlights of the PC Launch event is the daily rewards. Log in each day to claim awesome goodies that will boost your in-game progress. These rewards can include valuable items like speed-ups, action points (AP), spell points (SP), shields, troop calls, teleports, resource boosts, and more.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-57-1024x317.png)

## Create Your Unique Invitation Code

Participating in the PC Launch event allows you to create your very own invitation code. This code is your ticket to invite other players to join the PC version of Infinity Kingdom via the Gtarcade app.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-59-1024x582.png)

## Earn Additional Gifts

But here's the real kicker: when you invite other players using your unique code, you receive even more gifts! It's a win-win situation. Your friends get to enjoy Infinity Kingdom on PC, and you receive fantastic rewards for spreading the word.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-62.png)

## 700+ VIP Points

Among the rewards you can receive, there's one that stands out - 200 VIP points. Yes, you read that right. By participating in the PC Launch event and bringing new players into the Infinity Kingdom world, you can earn a substantial VIP point boost. This is an excellent way to enhance your VIP level and enjoy its benefits, such as daily bonuses and increased efficiency.

In addition to the single 200 VIP free gift, you get daily rewards with 100 VIP points (5 of the days) plus more VIP points for every players using your unique invite code.

## Exclusive Daily Benefit

As if the daily rewards and VIP points weren't enough, there's an Exclusive Daily Benefit waiting for you. This feature offers additional VIP points, further enhancing your VIP experience.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-58-1024x523.png)

## How to Make the Most of the PC Launch Event

To maximize the PC Launch event, follow these simple steps:

- **Log in daily:** Make sure you don't miss a single day to claim your daily rewards.
- **Create your invitation code:** Generate your unique invitation code and share it with friends and fellow gamers.
- **Invite new players:** Encourage friends to migrate to the PC version of Infinity Kingdom using your code.
- **Enjoy the rewards:** As new players join, you'll receive additional gifts, including the coveted 200 VIP points.

So, whether you're an Infinity Kingdom veteran or a newcomer, the PC Launch event has something for everyone. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy the game on PC, bring friends into the Infinity Kingdom community, and reap the rewards that come with it. Dive into the action and make the most of this exciting event!

Playing Infinity Kingdom via the Gtarcade PC app not only offers the convenience of the big screen but also comes with the bonus of earning Gtarcade points. These points are valuable and can be redeemed for fantastic in-game rewards. Here's how you can make the most of this feature:

## Continuous Play for Gtarcade Points

When you play Infinity Kingdom using the Gtarcade PC app, you earn Gtarcade points by the hour. For your first hour of play, you'll receive a generous 40 Gtarcade points. But here's the kicker: if you continue to play for another hour, you'll earn an additional 40 points.

These points are not only an additional incentive for PC players, but they can also provide a significant edge in your Infinity Kingdom journey.

title: Gtarcade Point Packs - new additions as of march 2026

categoryPath: Gtarcade Shop - via Mobile app or Desktop
markdown:
### Introduction

The latest update to the GTarcade point shop adds a mix of free rewards, low-cost bundles, and a few higher-tier options that are actually worth a closer look. On the surface, it’s a standard refresh—but when you break it down in terms of in-game value and resource scarcity, a few of these stand out more than they first appear.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-109-1024x572.png)

I’ll go through them the same way I evaluate any bundle: looking at long-term usefulness, opportunity cost, and how they fit into actual progression.

---

## Free Bundles – Quietly High Value

The addition of new free daily, weekly, and monthly bundles is easily the most impactful part of this update.

### Daily Free Bundle

- Gems ×40
- Heart of Norheim ×1
- Small SP Recovery ×1
- Small AP Recovery ×1

Individually small, but over time this adds up. The Heart of Norheim is the key item here—those are always useful, especially for players still stabilizing immortal progression.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-110.png)

### Weekly Free Bundle

- Gems ×100
- 30m Speedup ×4
- March Speedup ×1
- Troop Recall ×1

The **Troop Recall** is the standout. These are hard to stockpile and incredibly valuable in both PvP and event play. Having a consistent weekly source, even at low volume, is a meaningful upgrade.

### Monthly Free Bundle

- Gems ×500
- 4h Protection Barrier ×1

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-111.png)

Simple but effective. The barrier alone justifies the claim, especially during active kingdom conflict periods.

---

## Low-Cost Point Packs

### IK Mini Pack (1000 points) - the gem bundle!

- Gems ×400
- Superior EXP Rolls ×6
- Market Orders ×6

#### Point-per-Gem Efficiency Overview

Looking strictly at **points per gem**, the IK Mini Pack stands out as the only bundle with strong raw efficiency at **2.5 points per gem**, while all other paid bundles sit at a much weaker **10 points per gem baseline**. This creates a clear divide: the Mini Pack is efficient if you only care about gems, whereas the 5k and 10k bundles are effectively charging a premium where the **real value must come from the extra items**, not the gems themselves. In practice, this means you should never justify the higher-tier packs based on gem value alone—they only make sense if you actively need things like Kingdom Contracts, Alchemy Stones, or Stardust. Otherwise, you’re overspending points for what is, at its core, a worse gem conversion rate.

#### Point-per-Gem Table

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-112.png)

Obviously the free bundles are best value... but the mini pack for just 1000 points giving 400 gems with a daily stock of 1 is a very good way to efficiently earn Gems every day!

### Lite Pack (5000 points) - skipable

- Gems ×500
- 3h Speedups ×5
- 8h Enhanced Gathering ×5
- Superior EXP Rolls ×5

These look fine on paper, but the issue is efficiency. You can get similar or better gem conversion rates from other point bundles that include more impactful items.

From experience, these are the kinds of packs you end up buying early and later regret once you realize how tight points become over time.

---

## Mid-Tier Packs

### Basic Pack (10,000 points)

- Gems ×1000
- Alchemy Stone ×5
- Territorial Teleport ×5
- Kingdom Contract ×1

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-113.png)

This one is genuinely useful.

- **Kingdom Contract** alone replaces a 3000 gem cost
- **Alchemy Stones** without using Cinders is significant for many players
- Teleports are always relevant in active kingdoms

If you’re planning a kingdom transfer or actively progressing alchemy, this is one of the better uses of points.

---

### Plus Pack (10,000 points)

- Gems ×1000
- Ultimate EXP Rolls ×10
- Stardust ×10

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-114.png)

This one is more situational.

The **Stardust** is the key factor—it’s one of the few consistent ways to obtain it outside limited events. That said, 10 Stardust for 10k points is not particularly efficient unless you’re specifically bottlenecked there.

In most cases, I would only take this if Stardust is actively slowing your progress.

---

## High-Tier Pack – Long-Term Investment

### Shadow & Holy Dragon Crystal Bundles (High-Tier Situational)

These bundles follow a very different value logic compared to the rest of the shop:

- Dragon Essence ×15
- Shadow *or* Holy Dragon Crystals ×500
- Epic Immortal Spirit Chest ×3
- Market Orders ×100

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-117.png)

On paper, these have **poor general efficiency**, especially since there are **no gems included at all**. If you evaluate them the same way as standard bundles, they fall behind immediately.

However, the moment you are actively progressing a **Holy or Shadow Dragon**, the equation changes completely.

Dragon Crystals—especially for these two elements—are one of the more restrictive progression materials. You don’t get them in meaningful quantities from regular play, and farming them passively is slow. Getting **500 crystals in a single purchase** is a substantial acceleration.

From experience, once you reach the stage where your dragon development starts gating your march performance, these kinds of bundles become one of the few ways to push forward at a reasonable pace.

If you are **not** building a Holy or Shadow Dragon, this bundle has almost no practical value and should be skipped without hesitation.

---

### IK 10 Pack (50,000 points)

- Equipment Forging Stone Random Chest ×20

This is where things become more context-dependent.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-115.png)

In early and mid game, this won’t feel impactful. But once you reach **Legendary Seasons**, forging materials become a real bottleneck.

I’ve run into this myself—gear progression slows down not because of design, but because you simply can’t generate enough forging materials consistently.

This bundle helps offset that.

---

## Cosmetic Bundles – Purely Optional

A range of new profile frames has been added. These are expensive and offer no gameplay advantage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-116-1024x542.png)

If cosmetics matter to you, they’re there. Otherwise, they’re easy to ignore without missing anything meaningful.

---

## Player Perspective

From a long-term standpoint, the real winners here are:

- The **free bundles** (especially weekly troop recall)
- The **Basic 10k pack** (practical and flexible value)
- The **50k forging chest pack** (late-game relevance)

The lower-cost packs are tempting, but they don’t hold up when you compare them against how limited GTarcade points actually are over time.

For instance, when I started prioritizing long-term progression—alchemy, gear, and mobility—I found myself consistently skipping the smaller packs. The immediate gain just didn’t justify the opportunity cost later.

---

## Conclusion Summary

This update is stronger than it first appears, mainly because of the added free rewards and a few well-placed mid/high-tier bundles.

- **Always claim the free bundles** – they add up significantly
- **Prioritize the 10k Basic Pack** for practical utility
- **Consider the 50k forging pack** if you’re entering Legendary Seasons
- **Skip most low-cost packs** unless you have excess points

In short, the update rewards patience. The best value comes from saving points and spending them where progression bottlenecks actually exist.

---

title: Gtarcade Wheel - free Gtarcade Points Daily
summary: For many Infinity Kingdom players, the GTarcade App remains an underutilized resource. Tucked into both the desktop client and the mobile app is a small but powerful feature: the GTarcade Wheel. While it might look like…
markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom Guide: Why You Should Spin the GTarcade Wheel Every Day

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-12-1024x641.png)

---

## Introduction: The Hidden Daily Gem

For many Infinity Kingdom players, the GTarcade App remains an underutilized resource. Tucked into both the desktop client and the mobile app is a small but powerful feature: the **GTarcade Wheel**. While it might look like a gimmicky bonus system at first glance, those who use it daily know better. Over time, this free wheel can build up real value and provide exclusive rewards that bolster your game—especially for free-to-play and low-spend players.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-13.png)

In this guide, we’ll break down how the wheel works, what you can get from it, how much value it brings, and why you should absolutely make it a habit.

---

## How the GTarcade Wheel Works

The GTarcade Wheel is available once per day through the GTarcade desktop or mobile app. Each player gets **three free spins per day**. These spins reward you with **GTarcade Points**, which accumulate in your account and can be spent in the GTarcade Rewards Store.

- Each spin gives between 1 and 1,000 points.
- **Jackpot** spin is 1,000 points – rare but possible (more on this below).
- The system is entirely free and resets daily.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-14-461x1024.png)

---

## What You Can Get With Points

The GTarcade Points you earn can be spent in the **GTarcade Rewards Store**, which offers:

- **Mysterium Hearts** (for event entries)
- **Gems** (always useful, especially for daily bundle refreshes or speeding up builds)
- **Shields** (important for defense in PvP or when offline)
- **Artifact Fragments** (an extremely rare and valuable reward)
- **Shadow/Holy Dragon Crystals** (for upgrading dragons in late-game)
- **Market Refreshes** (can help significantly with optimizing purchases)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-15-1024x767.png)

If you manage to save up 30,000 points, you unlock access to **premium tier rewards** that include even more impactful items.

---

## What Kind of Return to Expect

Let’s get real: **you won't hit the jackpot every day**. But that doesn’t mean the GTarcade Wheel isn’t worth your time. Here’s what my own data shows after spinning every day for the past 60 days:

- **Total jackpot wins:** 2
- **Average points per day:** 132
- **Total points earned in 60 days:** ~7,920

This daily trickle might seem small, but it adds up. Two jackpots over two months is very good odds for a free system. Most days you’ll get under 100 points, but the occasional 1,000-point jackpot keeps things exciting and balances the average.

Spending money via Gtarcade you earn 80 points per dollar (roughtly). This means that daily you are getting value of spending one to two dollars per day for free. Nothing huge, but it all adds up - especially if you are free to play player!

If you're consistent, you're looking at around **4,000–8,000 points every 2 months**, which is enough to make meaningful purchases in the Rewards Store.

---

## Why It Matters for You

This wheel is especially important for players who:

- Don’t spend much money or are fully free-to-play
- Are looking for extra Mysterium Hearts for extra daily/weekly progress
- Want to grab occasional rare rewards like Artifact Fragments or Dragon Crystals
- Are saving up for big refresh items like shields or advanced gems

It takes **less than a minute** to spin all three wheels, and the long-term reward is more than worth the time. You could ignore it and save yourself 60 seconds, or you could be collecting thousands of GTarcade points toward real in-game value every few weeks.

---

## Final Thoughts

The GTarcade Wheel may not feel like a game-changer day to day, but it’s one of those **cumulative advantage systems** that quietly help you outpace your peers. It’s free, it rewards loyalty and consistency, and the value scales over time.

Make it part of your daily habit: log in, spin the wheel, rack up points, and cash in later. Whether it’s that clutch shield, extra gems, or a Mysterium Heart you needed, the GTarcade Wheel is your free gateway to more efficient Infinity Kingdom gameplay.

Start spinning. Start winning.

title: Journey Guide from level 0 to level 5
summary: Follow the tuturial. It is pretty well done, and will get you a short intro to everything. The tutorial in Infinity Kingdom is pretty self-explanatory and well done. You will have a decent idea of what this game is…
markdown:
Follow the tuturial. It is pretty well done, and will get you a short intro to everything. The tutorial in Infinity Kingdom is pretty self-explanatory and well done. You will have a decent idea of what this game is about once you complete it.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-03-111840-1024x578.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-03-111905-1024x569.png)

As you progress through the tutorial you are introduced to building your castle, fighting gnomes, summoning Immortals. These are the key elements to Infinity Kingdom, as well as the PvP that will be introduced later on.

**Below you find a comprehensive list of all things you need to know from level 0-5 in Infinity Kingdom.**I have made the list and sub-pages in chronological order based on when you can/should learn something. As such, it follows the tutorial as closely as possible.

## Main take-away's from level 0-5

1. Right off the bat you are being exposed to the **in-game shop** which promotes "recommended Immortals" to purchase amongst many other things which will be extreemly confusing to a brand new player - what to buy and should I even buy? Moreover, there are a few key free-to-play rewards from the shop function that you want to take advantage of right as you being playing.
Read the article: **[Beginner Bundles & Free swag](https://ik-wiki.com/?post_type=docs&p=8857)**
2. The Tuturial gets right down to brass tax - what this game is all about: City building. You want to build and keep building at alle times. Read the article: **[Beginner Building with builders](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-building-with-builders/)**
3. You are quickly faced with gnomes inside your castle territory, these must be booted out, and to do so the tutorial helps you summon a powerful Immortal (or two).
Read the article: **[Beginner Summoning and Philosopher Stones](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-summoning-and-philosopher-stones/)**
4. One of the last things you learn going into level 5 is attacking gnomes on the map.
Read the article: **[Beginner Gnome Raider](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-gnome-raider/)**
 and the article: **[Beginner Power up Immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-power-up-immortals/)**
5. At castle level 5 where we end this guide, you unlock the Dragon Lair. Here you hatch and develop your dragons, which are a key part of your armies. Read the article:**[Beginner Dragon Trainer](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-dragon-trainer/)**
6. Finally, at level 5 you unlock your very first Lord Talent Point. Talents are very important for your growth and later provides strong boosts for combat encounters (PvE and PvP).
Read the article: **[Beginning Talented Talenting](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-talented-talenting/)**

---

## A bit more you should know ...

While this is not a comprehensive list of what you are doing during the tutorial, it is what I feel are the most important things to take-away and make sure you have understood. If you are aware and understand these four things, you are off to a decent beginning.

**In addition to the more in-depth explanations offered in the sub-articles referenced above, I have some general tips and tricks for you to consider while you do the tuturial.**

## Tips and tricks

- **Always keep your builders busy** and always buy the temporary builder with gems or alliance coins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-13-1024x552.png)

- **Always produce troops.** You want to always keep your barracks training new troops. If you reach the cap (you shouldn't) delete troops and keep cooking. This is because there are key quests later in the game based on how many troops you have trained, these quests yield EXP which you need to set talents (level 5+). **In the beginning you want to spend all of your training speed ups on training fast for these quests.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-03-154122.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-20.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-19.png)

- **Always keep your AP nice and low.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-15.png)

- **Scout ruins without scout downtime**. Nice rewards for no effort once you read my coords guide.
**[Find all coords for every ruin in the game here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/ruins/ruins/all-ruin-coordinates/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-17-1024x575.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-18.png)

- **Spend your speedups.** Untill level 10-15+ you do not want a single speedup resting in your inventory. Spend them as fast as you can, just remember to get alliance help before completing buildings. Speed builds, troops and tech (later) as hard as you can.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-24-1024x510.png)

- **Spend your EXP scrolls and upgrade Immortal equipment**. You should always spend EXP scrolls and improve equipment when you have materials. No reason to hold on to any of it, since you can reborn an Immortal and get back 100% EXP in new scrolls + all materials and gold spent upgrading and boosting. This is available later in the Alchemy Lab, **don't worry about it for now and just upgrade everything you can.**

## Conclusion

**Basically, you should try to have as low downtime on everything as possible to progress fast through the lower levels. Spend every ressource, speedup, EXP scroll, boost-material, buff, enchant stone, etc.** **DO NOT STOCKPILE untill you reach atleast Castle level 30.**

There are much to learn about Infinity Kingdom, but if I were to sum up how to grow fast and grow right I would say: It is actually pretty simple, just remove downtime as much as you can. Send builders on long builds while you are not playing, build small quick buildings while you are online. Always zero your AP, SP, etc. Keep armies farming ressource nodes once you are offline (you will learn later).

title: Halloween 2023
summary: Infinity Kingdom has once again adorned itself in spooky splendor as Halloween approaches. The 2023 Halloween event has surfaced with its familiar yet exciting elements.
markdown:
### Unveiling the Secrets of Infinity Kingdom's Halloween Event 2023

Infinity Kingdom has once again adorned itself in spooky splendor as Halloween approaches. The 2023 Halloween event has surfaced with its familiar yet exciting elements.

In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through the event's intricacies, helping you secure every enticing reward. Let's dive into the festivities:

**1. Shadowy Spectres Event**
Begin your Halloween journey with the classic 5-day daily quests offered by the Shadowy Spectres. These quests not only grant you valuable sub-rewards but also unlock access to a treasure trove of Loki fragments and stardust.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-26-1024x341.png)

By completing these quests, you'll accumulate 40 Loki fragments, 20 stardust, 10 Milk Candy, and 500 gems, setting the stage for a fruitful event.

**2. Scary Pumpkins**
Engage in the age-old tradition of pumpkin hunting by defeating gnomes and harvesting resources. These actions allow you to acquire event-specific chests using the free-to-play currency, setting you on the path to creating delectable sweets. After all, it wouldn't be Halloween without some treats!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-27-1024x360.png)

**3. Trick or Treat Mini Event**
The Trick or Treat mini event is where the magic of candy production unfolds. Here, you'll craft candies that play a pivotal role in the Halloween festivities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-28-1024x314.png)

**4. Gift Party**
The Gift Party is the heart of the Halloween event, where your hard-earned Candy and Milk Candy find purpose. For free-to-play players, prioritize obtaining 30x Stardust for 5 Candy each, along with 200 gems. Additionally, secure the precious speed-ups. While the other offerings are present, they may not be as worthwhile due to the relatively high gem cost for older legacy artifact technology.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-29-1024x469.png)

For the spender Candy, known as "Milk Candy," you can unlock even more Stardust. By redeeming a total of 10 sets of 9 Stardust, you'll receive a substantial boost of 90 Stardust. Each set of 9 costs 10 Milk Candy, totaling 100 Milk Candy to acquire them all. This is a valuable investment, especially if you wish to maintain Portrait Levels.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-30-1024x509.png)

Furthermore, for a bargain price of 120 Milk Candy, you can obtain 60x fragments for your preferred Shadow or Holy immortal. This deal is hard to pass up.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-31-1024x545.png)

Lastly, consider acquiring as many Crimson Moonlights as possible, especially if you are a dedicated Chaos Spender. These Moonlights are relatively costly in the pinball event, making them a wise purchase. Aim to obtain the full 30 Moonlights for 300 Milk Candy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-32-1024x296.png)

**5. Night Phantoms**
Night Phantoms provide an opportunity to acquire Halloween-themed cosmetics, including frames, nameframes, and castle skins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-34.png)

However, it's advisable to focus on these items only if you urgently require additional Candy or are particularly fond of the cosmetics. They are less cost-effective compared to the regular bundles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-33-1024x437.png)

**6. Candy Feast**
In the Candy Feast section, you have the chance to purchase Candy. The $5, $10, $20, and $50 bundles are available once during the event, and the $100 bundle can be purchased up to five times. This entails a total cost of $585 for 620 Milk Candy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-35-1024x568.png)

The bundle you opt for depends on your event goals. For mid-spenders aiming for Stardust and a Holy or Shadow immortal requiring 220 Milk Candy, you can choose to skip the $5 bundle and purchase the other ones, including one $100 bundle. This results in a budget-friendly cost of just $80 for a Holy or Shadow immortal.

In conclusion, the 2023 Halloween event in Infinity Kingdom promises a bountiful harvest of rewards, including affordable Holy and Shadow immortals and ample Stardust. So, dive into the festivities, gather your Candy, and enjoy the spooktacular delights that await you!

In this article we shall go through the unique seasonal event for Halloween 2022! For this one, we are going to focus on spender-content. **Since we are doing the Halloween event where spenders can reap big rewards.**

Halloween have some F2P rewards too in the form of gifts, but I honestly don’t think anyone here wants to here me tell you to go send gifts to your friends – we all know that!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-10-30-115927-1024x573.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/IMG_0241-1024x472.png)

## Free Gift Codes for Halloween!

Here are the three new codes! **They expire in 6 days from today,** so get on it and make sure you have used all three. There are major rewards including a total of 9 philosopher stones to get this year!

3x **CODES:**halloweenfb + halloweendc + halloweenvk

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-4-1024x569.png)

## Spender rewards

We have quite a few high value items available for this event, including castle skin, unique artifacts and a chance to unlock one of the great Epic Immortals of Infinity Kingdom.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-10-30-115927-1024x573.png)

We will take a look at the rewards first, then the bundles on offer as well as the pricings of his years event rewards.

| Bundle Price | 5$ | 10$ | 20$ | 50$ | 100$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Candy | 10 | 15 | 35 | 60 | 100 |
| Candy per usd | 2 | 1.5 | 1.75 | 1.2 | 1 |

## Buddy up!

This years event is much like the previous. We have a lot of rewards, but we can’t redeem them ourselves but instead have to gift them to one another. We gotta go trick or treating! So you should find a buddy on your server that needs some of the same items that you do and trade gifts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-10-30-115718.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-5-1.png)

Night Phantoms is an awesome skin and one of the skins I personally have gained the most value from since I got it last year. **Having 3% boost to technology is a gift that keeps on giving.** I know only one player that has actually completed technology at this stage, meaning pretty much everyone even in castle level 50 are struggling to keep up with the vast tech-tree of Infinity Kingdom.

## Unlock Charles or Genghis Khan or Baldwin

You can also get a full 60 fragment chest for either Genghis Khan, Charles or Baldwin. These are absolute top tier Immortals and especially Charles and Khan are invaluable in many end-game meta setups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image.png)

There are not many events where players are able to obtain a Genghis Khan or a Charles. If you are a 100% free to play player, you cannot trade with someone else. That would require money investments. Instead, what you can do is trade your services in return for a rewards chest!

For instance, some players in your server may value honor or resources highly. If you have an army of free to play alts ready. You can trade a couple million honor for a spender reward. Or you can make a deal for x-amount of million resources for a reward. **This is an opportunity for all you free to plays to offer your services for sale!**

## Unique Artifact - high value item

Third on the list of amazing rewards, is a full unique artifact piece for Alex, Attila, Cid or Saladin. **These cost around 200-300 USD to get through Triss**events and as such you can get a very nice discount if you are running one of these Immortals and need more artifacts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/IMG_0239-832x1024.jpg)

## Pricing on rewards

Let’s have a look at the pricings and how we can get the rewards we want for as cheap as possible.

These are all the candy-currency bundles of this years event. As usual the cheaper the bundle the more value.

| Bundle Price | 5$ | 10$ | 20$ | 50$ | 100$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Candy | 10 | 15 | 35 | 60 | 100 |
| Candy per usd | 2 | 1.5 | 1.75 | 1.2 | 1 |

Because this event both has rewards you can buy directly and rewards you can gift to each other. There are some of the rewards you can get in multiple ways.

The **castle skin**, should be traded. You can get is as cheap as **70$** if you gift-trade with another player.

Whereas if you get it from the bundles you purchase you have to spend the total 115$ and you will **not be able to get a unique artifact**! That would be terrible!

The **Immortal unlock of Khan or Charles will set you back 85$ i**f done as cheap as possible.

The Unique Artifact can **ONLY**be gained through the big event 99$ bundles, and as such you need all of them totalling a cost of 115$ for the artifact. A bit less than half of what they usually cost to get through Triss!

The cosmetics can be bought for 15$ but are included in the 115$ if u buy unique artifact.

## What does it cost to get EVERYTHING?

Well if you want everything you have to combine purchasing exclusive bundles and currency-bundles.

To get the **unique artifact**you have to buy all three exclusive bundles, getting you back **115$**. As I said, a very very good price.

This also takes care of getting the **cosmetic**stuff, and leaves you with 30 spare candy currency.

To get the **Castle skin** you need to trade with a buddy and spend **80 candy**. Moreover, we want **Charles or Khan,** so we need an additional **120 candy**. With the 30 we have spare we are looking to buy 170 candy at a cost of **155$**.

Some of you will now think. Boy, that’s a lot of money. And yes, it is. But I have to say, at a **grand total of 270$ for ALL the high profile rewards**, it is very very **cheap** compared to buying the same value outside of this event.

You get the**castle skin, a unique artifact, a khan or Charles, the cosmetics and a bunch of VIP points**and other minor stuff. Comparatively, you should be expecting to pay this for a single artifact on a bad day of Triss!

All in all very good value for spenders this Halloween.

## Free-to-play gift rewards

As a free-to-play we have very very nice rewards. We are always on the hunt for more **Purple Soul Crystals**, and this event has quite a few! In addition we can get much needed **AP potions** and a bunch of **speedups**and the **cosmetic**name plate.
