title: How to Best Progress Immortal Affinity for Maximum Insignia Power
summary: The Insignia system is one of the best sources of permanent account progression in Infinity Kingdom, but it's also one of the easiest systems to waste resources on.
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-30-1024x498.png)

The Insignia system is one of the best sources of permanent account progression in **Infinity Kingdom**, but it's also one of the easiest systems to waste resources on.

When Affinity was first introduced, I assumed the goal was simple: take my main immortals as high as possible and collect their Insignias along the way. After spending more time with the system, it became clear that this isn't the most efficient approach. The Affinity cost rises sharply at higher levels, while the stat increase from later Insignias is often surprisingly small.

The real objective isn't maximizing one immortal—it's maximizing your **entire collection**.

If you approach Affinity as a collection system instead of an individual hero progression system, you'll unlock permanent account-wide stats much faster and hit the important Collection milestones far sooner.

This guide explains why.

---

## Understanding What You're Actually Progressing

Every immortal has a series of Insignias that unlock at specific Affinity levels.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-19-1024x510.png)

Each Insignia gives you two things:

- A permanent account-wide attribute bonus.
- One Collection Star.

That second reward is incredibly important because Collection Stars unlock additional global bonuses that affect every immortal you own.

The game summarizes the system quite well:

- Activated Insignias permanently increase your account's attributes.
- Collecting more Insignias unlocks stronger global attribute bonuses through Total Collection milestones.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-20.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-21.png)

In other words, every new Insignia makes your account stronger twice:

- once through its own attribute,
- and again by moving you closer to the next Collection milestone.

---

## Why Collection Stars Matter So Much

Many players focus only on the attribute printed on an individual Insignia.

That's only half the picture.

Every Insignia also contributes one star toward your Total Collection, which unlocks powerful global bonuses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-22-1024x198.png)

These bonuses apply to **every immortal on your account**, regardless of team composition. That means every Collection Star has value beyond the Insignia itself. Reaching these milestones sooner is one of the biggest long-term power increases available.

---

## The Hidden Trap of Higher Affinity Levels

This is where many players unintentionally slow their progression. Let's look at a real example.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-26.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-25.png)

### Alexander the Great

At **Affinity Level 15**, Alexander unlocks his Bronze Insignia.

Reward:

- **+8 Physical Attack**
- **1 Collection Star**

At **Affinity Level 30**, he unlocks his Silver Insignia.

Reward:

- **+10 Physical Attack**
- **1 Collection Star**

At first glance, progressing from Bronze to Silver seems like the obvious choice. But look closer. You're investing a huge amount of additional Affinity for just **2 more Physical Attack**.

The resource cost increases dramatically, while the stat increase barely changes. This is where efficiency starts to matter.

**A Better Investment**: Instead of taking Alexander from Level 15 to Level 30 immediately, imagine spending those resources on another physical immortal.

For example, **Mehmed II**. Taking Mehmed from Level 0 to Level 15 gives you:

- **+8 Physical Attack**
- **1 Collection Star**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-28.png)

The difference is only **2 Physical Attack**, but the second option costs dramatically less Affinity. You also broaden your collection instead of concentrating resources into one immortal. Repeat this process across your roster, and the gains become significant. Rather than unlocking one expensive Insignia, you're collecting multiple efficient ones while racing toward the next Collection milestone.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-29.png)

---

## Prioritize the Right Immortals

Not every immortal grants the same attribute.

Some provide:

- Physical Attack
- Magical Attack
- Physical Defense
- Magical Defense
- Accuracy
- Dodge
- Resilience
- Percentage bonuses

This means you shouldn't simply level your favourite immortals. You should level the immortals that provide the permanent stats your account actually needs. For a physical account, prioritize immortals that reward Physical Attack or offensive physical bonuses. For mage accounts, focus on immortals that grant Magical Attack or offensive magic bonuses. Once your offensive stats are well established, you can begin collecting defensive bonuses.

Planning your Affinity this way gives every investment a clear purpose.

---

## Use the Correct Affinity Gifts

Another small optimization that adds up over time is using the correct gifts.

Elemental gifts provide bonus Affinity when used on immortals of the matching element.

For example:

- Fire gifts → Fire immortals
- Water gifts → Water immortals
- Earth gifts → Earth immortals
- Wind gifts → Wind immortals

For Chaos immortals, use **Spirit Font Nectar**, which is designed specifically for them.

Matching gifts properly gives you the most progress for every resource you spend.

---

## When Should You Push Beyond Level 15?

Stopping at Level 15 isn't a permanent rule. It's simply the most efficient way to grow early.

Once you've built a healthy collection and reached important milestones, the value of deeper Affinity investments increases. At that point, you've already secured many of the powerful account-wide bonuses, so improving individual immortals becomes a much better investment.

Until then, breadth consistently beats depth. I think the optimal is going for the 100 bonus threshold and then upgrading into finished 30 affinity levels for the attributes you need the most.

---

## Player Perspective

After comparing the rewards, I completely changed how I spend Affinity.

Originally, I was feeding resources into the immortals I used most often. On paper, that seemed logical, but once I compared the actual rewards, the numbers told a different story. Spending a large amount of Affinity to increase Alexander's reward from **+8 Physical Attack** to **+10 Physical Attack** simply wasn't as valuable as unlocking another immortal that also granted **+8 Physical Attack** while adding another Collection Star.

That change in mindset made the system much easier to optimize. Rather than trying to finish one immortal before moving on, I started treating every first Insignia as another step toward strengthening my entire account. The permanent stats accumulated much faster, and the Collection milestones came noticeably sooner.

---

## Final Thoughts

The biggest mistake players make with Affinity is thinking vertically instead of horizontally. Affinity isn't about creating one perfect immortal. It's about building a powerful collection.

Unlocking first Insignias across multiple immortals gives you:

- More permanent attributes.
- More Collection Stars.
- Faster access to powerful global milestone bonuses.
- Better value for every Affinity resource you spend.

Once you've established that foundation, you can always return later and push your favourite immortals to higher Affinity levels.

In the long run, you'll end up with both a stronger collection **and** stronger individual immortals—but you'll get there much more efficiently.

---

title: How to Combine Dragon Keys
summary: In Infinity Kingdom, dragon crystals are one of the most valuable upgrade materials in the game—fueling your elemental dragons, boosting their combat stats, and ultimately powering your main march to compete at higher…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-40.png)

## Why This Update Is a Big Deal for Dragon Key Management

In Infinity Kingdom, dragon crystals are one of the most valuable upgrade materials in the game—fueling your elemental dragons, boosting their combat stats, and ultimately powering your main march to compete at higher levels. But for many players, **opening Dragon Crystal Chests has always been gated by one thing**: the right kind of key.

You earn Dragon Chests from boss fights across Norheim, the Mysterium, and Spider events. But to open them, you need specific keys: green (3-hour), blue (6-hour), purple (12-hour), or legendary (24-hour). The longer the duration, the better the chest quality. Until now, most players were sitting on mountains of 3-hour and 12-hour keys while *never* seeing the rarer blue or legendary ones—unless they spent real money.

That all changed with the latest patch.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-41.png)

**As of the June update, Infinity Kingdom now allows you to combine Dragon Keys directly from your inventory.** No crafting timers, no hidden building requirements, no alchemy needed. You can now convert two 12-hour keys into one 24-hour key *for free*. This small but crucial quality-of-life change gives players—especially Free-to-Play and low spenders—much better access to premium dragon rewards.

This guide breaks down what changed, how it works, and why smart Dragon Key management just became an essential part of your daily routine.

Let’s dive in.

## 🗝️ Why Dragon Keys Matter

Dragon Chest Keys are crucial for unlocking Dragon Crystal Chests earned from boss fights (Norheim, Mysterium, Spider Boss). These chests contain:

- Elemental dragon crystals (Fire, Water, Earth, Lightning)
- Gems, speed-ups, and rare resources

Before the patch, **3-hour (green)** and **12-hour (purple)** keys were common, but **6-hour (blue)** and **24-hour (legendary)** keys were rare and typically **only obtainable via paid bundles**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-42.png)

---

## 🔥 What Changed in the Latest Patch

With the update released yesterday, a long-requested feature arrived: **dragon key combining**! Now you can:

- Combine **two 12-hour keys** → **one 24-hour key**
- Later on, hopefully combine 6-hour keys into 12-hour ones

**No cost** in resources or time—it's purely a UI convenience applied instantly.

---

## 🛠️ How to Combine Keys: Step-by-Step

A lot of players asked how to do this—there is **no Alchemy Lab recipe** or special button in the Dragon Chest building. It’s simple:

1. Go to your **inventory** → **Others** tab
2. Select a key (e.g. a purple 12-hour key)
3. Hit **Combine**
4. TWO keys merge into the next-tier key
5. No spend, no timer—just instant upgrade

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-39-1024x525.png)

This works on **all servers** and **all players**, not limited by castle level or server type.

---

## 🎯 Why This Is a Game-Changer

- **Maximize your rare 24-hour keys**: Instead of spending money, you can simply combine paid-earned 12-hour keys.
- **Free players benefit too**: Use surplus 12-hour keys to create a powerful 24-hour key—no spending required.
- **Efficiency in chest opening**: Longer-duration keys are better value per use and easier to align with your play schedule.
- **Streamlined inventory**: Fewer key types to track and fewer UI elements to manage.

---

## ⚙️ Strategic Use of Keys

- **Stay stocked**: Save green & purple keys until you've built enough 24-hour keys for when you'll be at your strongest dragon assortment.
- **Best use timing**: Combine keys when you have at least two of the same tier to avoid wasting dormant keys.
- **Gauge chest value**: 24-hour chests hold the most crystals—so prioritizing these provides better long-term value.

---

## ✅ Summary

| Feature | Benefit |
| --- | --- |
| Dragon key combining | Converts e.g. two 12-hour keys into 1 24-hour key — instantly |
| Zero cost/time | No crafting fees or wait times—pure convenience |
| Full availability | Works for all players, on all servers |
| Improves value play | Better chest rewards and smart key management |

---

## Final Thoughts

Dragon Key composing is a **quiet but massive improvement** for any player collecting dragon crystals. It not only saves resources but also makes managing chest rewards way easier.

If you've got a surplus of 12-hour keys, this patch allows you to **upgrade your stash for free**—use it wisely, and power up your dragon game without spending a dime.

---

title: How to Complete a Golden Path Season
summary: The Golden Path is one of the most rewarding systems in Infinity Kingdom, giving you access to meta immortals, unique artifacts, Tower of Knowledge fragments, portals, and more — all at the best value in the game.
markdown:
## Infinity Kingdom Guide: How to Complete a Golden Path Season (and Maximize Your Rewards)

*By Myrahk – July 2025*

The **Golden Path** is one of the most rewarding systems in Infinity Kingdom, giving you access to **meta immortals**, **unique artifacts**, **Tower of Knowledge fragments**, **portals**, and more — all at the best value in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-76-1024x491.png)

But to make the most of it, you need to **complete the season efficiently**. Whether you’re Free-to-Play or spending for the premium track, this guide will show you **how to reach the max level**, **maximize your coins**, and get everything you want from the Golden Path shop.

---

## Understanding the Golden Path Season

**Length:** **30 days** per season.

**Max Level:** **Endless**. Level rewards until 50, then repeat level 50 for more coins.Fully completing the path unlocks all rewards and ensures you gain the maximum amount of Golden Path Coins.

**Purpose:** Completing the Golden Path each season gives you **enough coins to buy high-value shop items** like **meta immortal fragments**, **Tower of Knowledge fragments**, and now **unique artifacts** (added in the 2.8.5 update).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-75-1024x466.png)

---

## How Much EXP Do You Need?

To fully complete the Golden Path (reach level 50), you need:

- **7,000 EXP**

---

## How Do You Earn EXP?

You earn EXP through **daily quests**:

- **18 daily quests** worth a combined **216 EXP** per day.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-76-1024x491.png)

Multiply that by the full 30-day season:

- **216 EXP x 30 days = 6,480 EXP**

That means even as a **Free-to-Play player**, completing all dailies every day will land you **at least level 64**, which overshoots the requirement for level 50.

From there, you can buy levels for 450 gems each (30 coins).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/image-68-1024x520.png)

**In short:**
Even without spending, you can comfortably hit max level — **if you do your dailies consistently**.

---

## Coin Earnings: Free-to-Play vs. Spender

The real reason to finish the Golden Path? **Coins.** **[Checkout my guides on what to buy here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/market/golden-path-shopping-list-for-f2p-or-spender/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/image-69.png)

Here’s how the math breaks down:

### Free-to-Play

- **Base Pass:** 50 levels = **550 coins** total.

Breakdown:

- **100 coins** from reaching level 50 (flat reward).
- **15 x 50-coin return rewards** (750 EXP increments after 50 levels) = **450 coins**.

**Total:** **550 coins** per season.

---

### Premium Pass ($20)

Buying the Premium Pass instantly gives you **20 levels** and additional coin rewards.

- **20 instant levels** = **600 extra coins** (you repeat the 50-coin return reward cycle 20 times).
- **200 bonus coins** from premium-tier rewards as you level.

**Total with Pass:** **1,350 coins per season**

---

### Why It Matters

These coin amounts directly determine **what you can afford in the shop** each season. Whether you want to prioritize **Tower of Knowledge purple crystals**, **meta immortal fragments**, or **unique artifacts**, hitting these targets means **you can actually buy them**.

---

## Step-by-Step: How to Complete the Golden Path

1. **Log in every day.**  - Consistency is everything. Missing too many days can drop you below level 50.
2. **Do all 18 daily quests.**  - This gives you **216 EXP daily**, which is more than enough to max the pass.
3. **Track your progress.**  - Don’t wait until the last week to panic — check your level regularly.
4. **Buy the Premium Pass if you can.**  - For $20, you get **+20 levels**, **600 more coins**, and **better loot** on the premium track.
- **Value-wise, this is the best single purchase in Infinity Kingdom.**
5. **Plan your shop purchases early.**  - Coins earned from the Golden Path don’t roll over between seasons. Know what you want before you spend.

---

## What Should You Buy With Your Coins?

This depends on your player type:

- **Free-to-Play:** Get the core immortals and artifacts that you are unable to obtain elsewhere due to pay-walls
- **Light Spenders:** Elemental Selection Unique Artifacts, UA's, core paywall immortals and Purple Crystals.
- **Whales:** Immortal frags, random frags for purples, Unique artifacts, AP... get it all!

(See my [**Golden Path Shopping Guide**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/market/golden-path-shopping-list-for-f2p-or-spender/)for a full breakdown).

---

## TL;DR – Myrahk’s Completion Tips

- **Do all dailies** (18 quests, 216 EXP/day) — you’ll easily exceed level 50.
- **F2P gets 550 coins** each season.
- **Spend $20 for Premium Pass** to jump to **1,350 coins** total — the best purchase in the game.
- **Plan your shopping list early** so you don’t waste coins on low-value items.

---

## Final Thoughts

The Golden Path remains **the single most valuable system in Infinity Kingdom**, especially after the **2.8.5 update** added **unique artifacts**.

Even if you’re Free-to-Play, completing the Golden Path each season will give you **enough coins for meaningful upgrades**. And for light spenders, the **Premium Pass** is the best bang for your buck in the entire game.

**Bottom line:**
**Do your dailies. Finish the pass. Spend smart. Repeat every season.**

That’s how you stay competitive — no matter your spending level.

title: How to Farm Personal Legion’s Marks in Legion of Frostborne
markdown:
Personal Legion’s Marks measure your individual activity during Legion of Frostborne, commonly called KvK. They determine your personal settlement reward, making them one of the most important resources to farm before the season ends.

The main target is **10,000,000 Personal Legion’s Marks**. Reaching it awards:

* **3,000 Gems**
* **25,000 Cold Silver**
* **20× 3-hour Speedup Chests**

That Cold Silver represents more than half the 48,000 required to unlock a complete KvK Ability Stone skill, so reaching 10 million Marks should be a priority whenever possible.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261008-202529-ntj0fo.png)

## 💠Where to Check Your Personal Marks

Open the **Legion Handbook** and select the Personal Legion’s Mark reward page.

Do not use the internal alliance ranking to check your total. That leaderboard resets weekly and can display a much higher accumulated figure. The Legion Handbook shows the seasonal total that determines your final reward.

## 💠The Best Method: Repeated Wall Attacks

For most players, repeatedly attacking the walls of an available city or checkpoint is the fastest and most accessible way to farm Personal Legion’s Marks.

When an objective is available:

1. Declare war and begin the 15-minute attack window.
2. Position your castle as close to the objective as possible.
3. Continuously attack with all four marches.
4. Stop before the objective is completely captured.
5. Wait through the 30-minute Protection Barrier.
6. Declare war again and repeat the process.

The objective must remain uncaptured. Capturing it removes the opportunity to continue farming repeated attack cycles.

A recorded example increased the player’s total from **4,951,812 to 5,176,283 Marks**, a gain of **224,471 Marks** from roughly 20 attacks. This should not be treated as a fixed rate: the amount earned depends partly on the damage dealt by each march.

Because four marches can complete far more than 20 attacks during a full siege window, a well-positioned player can generate a very large number of Marks from each cycle. You then wait just 30 minutes before being able to run at the very same gate again!

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261008-202543-obv9zw.png)

## 💠Cities Versus Gates

Cities are generally faster to farm because nearby castle positions can provide extremely short marching distances. However, gates are more commonly left available for repeated farming and remain an excellent option.

The ideal position allows a march to reach the objective and return within a few seconds. Shorter marching time means more attacks during the 15-minute window and therefore more Personal Legion’s Marks.

Do not occupy the best position after you finish. If you are going offline, relocate away from the objective so another federation member can use it. One practical option is to begin your relocation shortly before farming; your city will move automatically once the relocation timer finishes.

## 💠Preparing Your Marches

Use four marches equipped with Immortals and Dragons. They do not need to be complete competitive PvP formations, as even secondary marches can deal meaningful wall damage.

For efficient farming:

* Use the **Military Lord Talent** tree.
* Select **Riding Fast** to reduce marching time.
* Select **Survival Methods** to reduce troop losses.
* Position your castle immediately beside the objective.
* Avoid consuming valuable attack and defence boosts unless necessary.
* Monitor your seriously wounded and dead troops between cycles.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261008-202738-7akr4j.png)

Wall farming normally produces relatively limited casualties compared with sustained PvP or Honor trading. This makes it particularly suitable for free-to-play players and developing accounts that cannot afford to empty their troop bank.

## 💠Other Ways to Earn Personal Legion’s Marks

### Fighting for Honor

Honor earned against players outside your federation also contributes to Personal Legion’s Marks. Active PvP can therefore generate Marks naturally while helping your federation contest territory.

Some players arrange Honor trades with members of opposing federations. When properly organised, a player using **Rank Advancement** can earn large amounts of Honor from attacking a relocation containing four defending marches.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261008-202754-3tkwpg.png)

This can be very fast, but it is expensive in troops and hospital capacity. It is best used when your troop bank is healthy and no major battle is approaching.

### Donating Resources

Resources can be donated to restore the defenders of a city or checkpoint owned by your federation. These donations provide Personal Legion’s Marks as well as Alliance Points.

This is a safe method with no troop losses, but developing accounts should be careful. Buildings, technology, troop tiers and Dragon upgrades should normally take priority over donating hundreds of millions of resources.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261008-202841-gg365g.png)

Donation farming makes the most sense when:

* Your important building upgrades are complete.
* You have a large surplus of resources.
* You also need Alliance Points for Portals.
* Your federation genuinely needs the objective restored.

### Gnomes and Gnome Bosses

Defeating Gnomes and Gnome Bosses also contributes to Personal Legion’s Marks. This provides a steady source while farming experience, equipment and upgrade materials.

However, do not destroy your troop bank merely to gain more Marks. Farm levels that your marches can defeat efficiently, use your strongest sustainable formations and leave enough troops available for sieges and PvP. 

While gnomes farming has to be included here, as it is a source of Marks, this is not your main strategy and AP should be prioritized for PvP and other activities if your supply is at all strained.



### Cities, Checkpoints and Thermal Towers

Normal participation in Legion of Frostborne also generates Marks through activities such as:

* Defeating city and checkpoint defenders.
* Damaging city and checkpoint walls.
* Constructing Thermal Towers.
* Completely demolishing enemy Thermal Towers.
* Damaging enemy territories and forcing relocations.
* Participating in PvP battles.

These activities are especially valuable because they produce personal progress while directly helping your alliance and federation control the battlefield.

## 💠Personal Marks and Federation Reputation

Repeated wall attacks are valuable on several levels.

The player earns **Personal Legion’s Marks**, the alliance earns **Alliance Reputation**, and that reputation contributes to the federation’s overall score. A coordinated gate-farming programme can therefore work toward:

* The player’s 10 million Personal Marks reward.
* The alliance’s 12 million Reputation reward.
* The federation’s overall ranking.
* Individual and alliance seasonal rankings.

This is why gate farming remains useful even when your federation is not likely to win the entire KvK. Players can still secure personal Cold Silver while helping their alliance reach its own settlement threshold.

## 💠Marks and Legion Achievements Are Different

Personal Legion’s Marks should not be confused with **Legion Achievements**.

Personal Marks accumulate throughout the season and determine your personal settlement reward. Legion Achievements are individual objectives that award Expedition Battle Pass experience and, during Legendary Season, may also provide Contract Crystals.

Many activities contribute to both systems, but the rewards and progress counters are separate. Gathering resources may advance an achievement, for example, without being an efficient direct method of farming Personal Marks.

## 💠Recommended Farming Routine

For most players, the best routine is:

1. Earn Marks naturally through battles, objectives, towers and Gnome farming.
2. Preserve your troop bank during heavily contested phases.
3. Locate an available city or checkpoint during quieter periods.
4. Farm its walls with four marches for the full 15-minute window.
5. Leave the objective uncaptured.
6. Move away when finished so another player can take the best position.
7. Return after the 30-minute Protection Barrier expires.
8. Repeat until you reach 10 million Marks.

Alliance and federation leadership can make this considerably more efficient by assigning different gates, announcing attack windows and rotating nearby positions between players.

title: How to get MUCH cheaper higher tier soldiers
summary: In Infinity Kingdom, unlocking higher-tier troops is a critical milestone for boosting your army’s power. However, it comes at a steep cost, as training higher-tier troops requires significantly more resources and time.…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-15-1024x357.png)

In Infinity Kingdom, unlocking higher-tier troops is a critical milestone for boosting your army’s power. However, it comes at a steep cost, as training higher-tier troops requires significantly more resources and time. This guide will show you how to efficiently upgrade to new troop tiers while minimizing resource expenditure.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-6.png)

---

## Understanding Troop Tiers

### Why Troop Tiers Matter

Each new tier of troops comes with higher base stats, making them much stronger than their lower-tier counterparts. Unlocking new tiers can significantly enhance your performance in PvE and PvP battles. However, higher-tier troops are also much more expensive to train, both in terms of resources and time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-5-1024x518.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-4-1024x522.png)

---

## The Upgrade Trick

Here’s a key mechanic to save resources when transitioning to higher troop tiers:

### Automatic Troop Upgrade

When your barracks upgrades to unlock a new troop tier, all existing troops of the lower tier automatically upgrade to the new tier. This process is instantaneous and does not consume additional resources. For example:

- If you have 10,000 Tier 1 troops and upgrade your barracks to unlock Tier 2, those 10,000 troops are immediately converted to Tier 2.

This mechanic allows you to bypass the high resource cost of directly training higher-tier troops.

---

## Step-by-Step Strategy

### 1. Train Troops Before Upgrading

- Use all available troop training speedups and focus on producing as many lower-tier troops as possible before upgrading your barracks.
- Aim to completely fill your training grounds with lower-tier troops.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-2-1024x532.png)

### 2. Upgrade Your Barracks

- Once your training grounds are filled and your barracks is ready to upgrade, proceed with the upgrade to unlock the next troop tier.
- All lower-tier troops will instantly convert to the higher tier upon completion.

### 3. Redirect Resources

- The resources saved can now be used for other essential upgrades, such as your castle, technology research, or dragon enhancements.

---

## Example Calculation

Let's have a look at how much we are saving every time we hit that training button using this method of training Tier 1 troops before upgrading to Tier 2:

- **Resource Cost for Tier 1 Troops:** 2700 + 1080 + 540 + 900 = 5220 resources

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-1024x191.png)

- **Resource Cost for Training Tier 2 Troops Directly:** 15000 + 8000 + 4000 + 6000

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-1-1024x173.png)

1. **Tier 1 Troops:**  - **Cost:** Training 1,800 Tier 1 troops costs 5,220 resources (2.9 resources per soldier).
- **Time:** 1 hour and 25 minutes to train 1,800 troops.
2. **Tier 2 Troops (Requires Barracks Level 10):**  - **Cost:** Training 2,000 Tier 2 troops costs 33,000 resources (16.5 resources per soldier).
- **Time:** 2 hours and 7 minutes to train 2,000 troops.

These figures highlight the steep increase in both resource and time requirements as you move to higher troop tiers.

By pre-training Tier 1 troops, you savehuge amounts of resources while still benefiting from the strength of Tier 2 troops after the upgrade.

---

## Additional Tips for Resource Efficiency

1. **Use Training Speedups Wisely:** Focus on maximizing troop numbers before unlocking the next tier.
2. **Plan Your Upgrades:** Coordinate troop training and barracks upgrades to ensure no downtime.
3. **Monitor Resource Levels:** Ensure you have enough resources to complete the barracks upgrade itself, which can be costly.
4. **Save Boosts for Key Milestones:** Use resource and training boosts strategically for significant upgrades like troop tiers.

---

## Conclusion

Efficiently upgrading troop tiers is a game-changer in Infinity Kingdom. By leveraging the automatic troop upgrade mechanic, you can save vast amounts of resources and focus on other critical aspects of your development. Follow this guide to maximize your efficiency and dominate in Norheim!

title: How to get the highest chance of a bonus roll
summary: In Infinity Kingdom, artifacts play a crucial role in bolstering your immortals' capabilities, with bonus rolls on these artifacts often making a significant difference in battle performance. However, the likelihood of…
markdown:
### Player Guide: Crafting Artifacts with Bonus Rolls in Infinity Kingdom

In Infinity Kingdom, artifacts play a crucial role in bolstering your immortals' capabilities, with bonus rolls on these artifacts often making a significant difference in battle performance. However, the likelihood of crafting an artifact with a bonus is relatively low, with many players reporting success rates around one in four or five attempts. This guide explores a strategy to potentially increase your chances of obtaining artifacts with desired bonus rolls, focusing on efficiency and resource management.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-108-1024x425.png)

## Understanding Bonus Rolls

Bonus rolls on artifacts can grant additional stats such as bonus damage or energy regeneration, which can substantially enhance an immortal's effectiveness. The randomness associated with obtaining these bonuses makes crafting a game of patience and strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-109.png)

## Strategy for Increasing Bonus Roll Chances

While there's no guaranteed method to secure bonus rolls, certain practices seem to improve odds based on player experiences. Here’s a strategic approach to try:

### Step 1: Building a "No-Bonus Streak"

Begin by crafting lower-tier artifacts, such as green or blue ones, until you accumulate a streak of 4-5 crafts without receiving any bonus rolls. This step is based on the observation that a series of unsuccessful attempts might increase the likelihood of success in subsequent crafts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-110-1024x594.png)

### Step 2: Crafting Desired Artifacts

Once you've established a "no-bonus streak," proceed to craft the artifact(s) for your targeted immortal(s). This approach hypothesizes that the chances of obtaining a bonus roll are somewhat higher following a series of non-bonus crafts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-111-1024x619.png)

### Step 3: Bulk Crafting for Key Artifacts

To further optimize your chances, consider saving up resources to craft multiple instances of a desired artifact in one go. For example, if aiming for a bonus on an Alexander artifact, gather enough materials to craft four unique artifacts consecutively. This bulk crafting, combined with the preceding "no-bonus streak," may improve your odds of landing a bonus roll.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-113.png)

## Tips for Efficient Artifact Crafting

- **Resource Management**: Efficiently manage your crafting materials, focusing on accumulating enough resources to implement the bulk crafting strategy for artifacts you highly prioritize.
- **Patience and Persistence**: Recognize that crafting with the aim of obtaining bonus rolls requires patience. Be prepared for a process of trial and error, and don't get discouraged by initial failures.
- **Prioritize Key Immortals**: Focus your efforts on crafting artifacts with bonus rolls for immortals who will benefit most significantly from the additional stats, thereby maximizing the impact on your overall strategy.
- **Document Your Attempts**: Keeping track of your crafting attempts and outcomes can provide insights into the effectiveness of this strategy and help refine your approach over time.

## Conclusion

Crafting artifacts with bonus rolls in Infinity Kingdom is a challenge that combines luck with strategic planning. By employing a methodical approach, such as creating a "no-bonus streak" and engaging in bulk crafting for high-priority artifacts, you can potentially increase your chances of acquiring artifacts with beneficial bonus rolls. While this strategy does not guarantee success, it offers a structured way to pursue those game-changing artifact bonuses, making your immortals more formidable on the battlefield.

title: How to increase Physical and Magical attack - And how attributes impact damage
summary: One of the most common questions new players ask in Infinity Kingdom is: \"How do I raise my physical or magical attack from 3,000 to 5,000 or even 10,000+?\" It's a great question—and one that deserves a deep dive.
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-77-1024x287.png)

## Introduction: What Does "Attack" Really Mean?

One of the most common questions new players ask in *Infinity Kingdom* is: "How do I raise my physical or magical attack from 3,000 to 5,000 or even 10,000+?" It's a great question—and one that deserves a deep dive.

First, we need to clear up a common misconception: **high attack stats do not directly equal high damage output.** Think of attack as a foundation. The higher your base attack, the more *potential* damage you can do. But actual damage depends on many other factors like skills, debuffs, enemy defenses, criticals, and damage bonuses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-83.png)

---

## The Difference Between Attack and Damage

Let’s clarify with an example:

- A skill like **Anger** directly increases physical ***damage*** by 30%. This affects your actual damage output.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-79.png)

- A skill like **Onslaught** increases physical ***attack*** by 60%. This boosts your base attack stat but doesn’t guarantee more damage—it increases the *possibility* of doing higher damage.Basically, attributes are all part of the damage equation, whereas Anger and other damage modifiers apply as aplification after standard damage equation is calculated. Thus much stronger.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-78.png)

Anyway back to attributes... So if you have 5,000 physical attack and apply a 60% bonus:

- 5,000 x 1.6 = 8,000 physical attack
- This will not *guarantee* higher damage per hit, but it will increase the ceiling of what you can hit for.

---

## How to Increase Physical or Magical Attack

There are several core areas to focus on if you want to increase your attack stats:

### 1. Gears and Equipment

Max out your Immortal’s gear to max level and socket appropriate **attack gems** (physical or magical depending on the Immortal).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-80.png)

- Gem upgrades make a big difference, especially at higher levels.

### 2. Artifacts

Artifacts are massive contributors to both physical and magical attack.

- Example: A maxed-out artifact with physical attack bonuses of 42% or more can raise your total by thousands.
- Look for artifacts with both % attack boosts and flat attack values (+350 or more).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-81.png)

### 3. Specialization Tree

Your **Immortal Specialization Talents** provides major boosts to attack stats.

- Example: Each node may provide +250 magical or physical attack.
- Fully unlocked trees can give 1,750–2,000 attack.

### 4. Mayor Bonuses

If you have a city mayor position that boosts attack, make use of it.

- Not always active, but very helpful when you’re building a high stat profile.

### 5. Immortal Portrait Leveling

Portrait bonuses (especially at level 20) can give additional % damage or attack boosts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-82.png)

- These are especially powerful when combined with artifacts and gear.

---

## Real Example: High-End Stats

Let’s take a look at a player like Lord Mora who has:

- **18,776 physical attack** on a fully built Chaos Wukong

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-74-1024x570.png)

- This is thanks to:  - Maxed artifact: 49% + 16% suffix = 65% physical attack bonus
- Flat bonus of +1028 from gems
- Immortal Talent Tree maxed
- level 50 portrait

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-75.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-76.png)

*Note: Had he rolled a flat bonus on one of the remaining suffixes on the artifact he would have even hit well above 19,000+*

**Now compare that to a player with 12,000 attack?**

- The 18,000 Wukong will deal **higher average damage** over time, but not necessarily 50% more damage every hit since the physical attack attribute is.... yes you remember from earlier: it's part of the damage equation as one amongst multiple variables!
- Important side note: Damage also greatly depend on **critical hits, skill multipliers, and enemy resistances.**

---

## Why It Matters: Attack vs. Consistent Output

Attack boosts are important, but they serve as part of a larger equation.

- **Physical/Magical Attack** increases potential output
- **Physical/Magical Damage%** skills like Anger or Fire Blessing increase actual output

You want to build both.

- Don’t just chase numbers—pair your high attack with proper damage-enhancing skills.

---

## Final Tips for New Players

- **Start with gear and gems.** Easy to upgrade and impactful early.
- **Prioritize artifacts.** They scale hard with star level.
- **Invest in Dragon Specializations.** They add thousands of stats.
- **Balance attack with damage%.** One without the other limits your output.
- **Don’t neglect portraits.** They’re slow to build but give major long-term power.

---

## Conclusion

Raising your physical or magical attack takes time and planning. Gear, gems, artifacts, portraits, and specialization trees all work together to increase your attack stats. And remember—attack increases your **damage potential**, but it's your build and skills that turn that potential into consistent, high-performance output.

Keep building, and over time you’ll hit those crazy high attribute numbers and feel the difference every battle.

Happy upgrading!

title: How to obtain Crimson Moonlights

markdown:
### Player Guide: How to Obtain Crimson Moonlights in Infinity Kingdom

Crimson Moonlights are one of the essential resources in Infinity Kingdom, primarily used for purchasing exclusive artifacts and advancing in various game aspects. Understanding the best ways to acquire them can enhance your gameplay efficiency and strategy. This guide will explore the three main methods for obtaining Crimson Moonlights: Primal Pinball, Deep Sea Eye Merchant, and Golden Path.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-148-1024x503.png)

---

### 1. Primal Pinball

**Overview:** Primal Pinball is a dynamic weekly lottery event where players use pearls to aim for prizes on a pinball board. The event runs for three days, offering players a chance to win various rewards, including the coveted Crimson Moonlights.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-149.png)

### Strategy:

- **Purchase Strategy:** To maximize cost-efficiency, opt for the $5 bundle, which provides 18 pearls at approximately 28 cents each. Accumulate 100 pearls before participating to take full advantage of the bonus plays.
- **Bonus Plays:** After using 100 pearls, you receive an extra 20 pearls as a bonus from the event.
- **Chance of Winning:** Each pearl has a 5% chance to land on a reward slot containing Crimson Moonlights. Typically, every 120 pearls result in about 24 Crimson Moonlights based on probability.

**Practical Experience:** Through recording 600 pearl drops, the results yielded an average slightly higher than the expected number of Crimson Moonlights, making the event somewhat worthwhile, especially when considering additional rewards like speedups and Stardust.

---

### 2. Deep Sea Eye Merchant

**Overview:** The Deep Sea Eye Merchant event is an alternative method to acquire Crimson Moonlights directly for gems. This event offers straightforward transactions without the uncertainty of a game of chance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-150.png)

### Cost Analysis:

- **Pricing:** Starts at 1,600 gems for four Crimson Moonlights and increases exponentially up to 6,000 gems.
- **Total Cost:** For ten sets, the total cost is 32,400 gems for 40 Crimson Moonlights, averaging a steep price per set.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-151.png)

**Recommendation:** Ideal for high spenders, this method guarantees Crimson Moonlights but at a premium cost. Evaluate your spending ability and the necessity of these resources for your game progress before investing.

---

### 3. Golden Path

**Overview:** Golden Path is a monthly event that offers a more economical way to obtain Crimson Moonlights alongside other valuable rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-152-1024x522.png)

### Benefits:

- **Cost-Effective:** For just $5 a month, players receive 200 Merit Coins.
- **Purchases:** These coins can be exchanged for eight Crimson Moonlights, providing a steady, albeit small, supply of 8 each month.
- **Added Value:** The Golden Path also includes an exclusive artifact chest, immortal shards, speedups, and other resources, enhancing the overall value of the $5 expenditure.

**Comparison:** Compared to the Primal Pinball, the Golden Path offers a significantly better return on investment, making it an excellent choice for players seeking consistent value.

---

### Summary

Navigating the acquisition of Crimson Moonlights requires a balanced approach between direct purchases and participating in events. Primal Pinball remains a primary source for those who enjoy the challenge and potential for large rewards, while the Deep Sea Eye Merchant is best suited for players without budget constraints. For regular and cost-effective gains, the Golden Path provides an excellent monthly option. Understanding these methods and integrating them into your strategy will help you maximize your resource management and enhance your gameplay in Infinity Kingdom.

title: How to Obtain Dragon Soul Crystals in Infinity Kingdom
summary: Dragons are among the most important sources of account power in Infinity Kingdom. Dragon Crystals are used to improve their skills, develop their Talent Trees and raise their Portrait levels, so even established…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-32-1024x341.png)

Dragons are among the most important sources of account power in Infinity Kingdom. Dragon Crystals are used to improve their skills, develop their Talent Trees and raise their Portrait levels, so even established players continue needing enormous quantities of them.

The difficulty is that not every dragon is developed through the same sources. Water, Earth, Fire and Lightning Crystals can be farmed from Gnome Bosses, while Wind, Holy and Shadow Crystals depend much more heavily on specialised shops, seasonal currencies and limited events. Knowing where each type comes from helps you plan several seasons ahead and prevents scarce currencies from being spent on poor-value alternatives.

This guide covers the main ways to obtain Dragon Crystals, how Gnome Boss rewards scale and how your available boss levels improve as your server progresses through the seasons.

---

## Elemental Dragon Crystals and Gnome Bosses

Water, Earth, Fire and Lightning each have a corresponding Gnome Boss. Defeating one awards a Dragon Chest containing crystals for that boss’s element, making regular boss farming the main repeatable source of crystals for these four dragons.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-26-1024x163.png)

Wind is also an elemental dragon, but it does **not** have a corresponding Gnome Boss and must be developed through other sources.

Dragon Chests are divided into five qualities:

- **Common:** Grey
- **Uncommon:** Green
- **Rare:** Blue
- **Epic:** Purple
- **Legendary:** Gold

Both the boss level and the chest quality matter. A higher-level boss increases the guaranteed number of crystals contained within a chest of the same quality, while moving from a Common chest to a Rare, Epic or Legendary chest produces a much larger increase.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-29-1024x476.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-30-1024x472.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-31-1024x472.png)

## How Boss Levels Increase with Seasons

New servers do not immediately have access to all 20 Gnome Boss levels. The available level cap increases as the server advances through its seasonal progression.

The difference between individual levels remains fairly modest, however. Comparing Level 18 and Level 20 chests of the same rarity, Level 20 contains approximately **10–12% more Dragon Crystals**:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-27.png)

Defeating a boss places its Dragon Chest in the Trove, where it can be purified over time. Because the Trove has limited space, active boss farming also requires you to manage purification timers and Dragon Chest Keys.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-28-1024x269.png)

Keys allow a matching chest to be opened immediately. Lower-rarity keys can now be combined into higher-rarity keys, which makes unwanted Common and Uncommon keys more useful than they were under the original system. Even so, higher-quality keys remain valuable, and it is sensible to reserve them for moments when your Trove is full or when an Epic or Legendary chest would otherwise prevent you from continuing to farm.

---

## Wind Dragon Soul Crystals

Unlike Water, Earth, Fire and Lightning, the Wind Dragon has no dedicated Gnome Boss. Wind Dragon Crystals must instead be obtained through specialised shops and rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/image-29-1024x476.png)

The two most important recurring sources are:

- **Arena Insignia Shop**, using Arena Insignias
- **Legion’s Vender**, using Cold Silver earned from Legion of Frostborne

The addition of Wind Dragon Crystals to Legion’s Vender means that the Arena is no longer their exclusive source. However, both currencies have important competing uses. Arena Insignias are accumulated gradually, while Cold Silver is needed for exclusive KvK Ability Stones and can also be converted indirectly into Cinder Shop progress by buying and recycling unwanted stones.

For most developing accounts, important KvK and Cinder Shop skills should therefore be completed before Cold Silver is redirected into Wind Dragon Crystals. Once the necessary skills are covered, Legion’s Vender becomes one of the best opportunities to make meaningful Wind Dragon progress each season.

---

## Holy and Shadow Dragon Soul Crystals

Holy and Shadow Dragon Crystals remain considerably harder to obtain than the standard boss-farmed crystals. Their availability is spread across premium shops, rotating rewards and limited events rather than a permanent Gnome Boss.

Current sources include:

- VIP Shop
- Rune Factory Shop
- Selected GTarcade monthly rewards
- Limited-time events and promotional bundles
- Theia’s Roulette, following their addition in Update 2.9.8

Theia’s Roulette is now particularly important because it gives players another recurring opportunity to collect meaningful quantities of Holy and Shadow Crystals. Availability still depends on the active Roulette rewards, so players should inspect each event before committing Gems or paid spins.

The VIP and Rune Factory Shops also provide both crystal types, but neither purchase exists in isolation. VIP Points and Rune Factory currency can be used on other scarce progression items, including Immortal fragments and artifact-related materials. Buying Dragon Crystals is therefore worthwhile when you are actively developing that dragon, but much less attractive when the crystals will simply sit unused.

For most accounts, Holy and Shadow Dragons should be treated as long-term projects rather than something that can be completed through ordinary daily farming.ogression is intentionally slow and should be viewed as a long-term investment.

## Choosing Between Holy and Shadow

If your resources only allow you to develop one premium dragon, the decision should begin with the march you actually intend to use.

The Holy Dragon remains the more generally applicable option. It fits into a broad range of PvE and PvP formations and is normally the safer investment when you are uncertain about your long-term build.

The Shadow Dragon is more specialised, but its Decay mechanics and PvP utility can be extremely valuable in the right formation. Players building specifically around those interactions may gain more from Shadow than from a general-purpose Holy Dragon.

Neither dragon is automatically correct for every account. Because their crystals are so scarce, changing direction after investing heavily is expensive. Decide on the march first, then begin purchasing crystals.

---

## Spending Dragon Crystals Efficiently

Focusing on one dragon remains good advice, but the old fixed priority of Skills, then the entire Talent Tree, then Portraits is too simplistic.

Dragon Skills should be raised first, particularly until the requirements for the Talent Tree are met. Once Talents become available, both the Talent Tree and Dragon Portrait compete for the same elemental Dragon Crystals. Talents also require Dragon Essence.

Early Portrait levels are comparatively cheap and provide efficient raw attributes to the entire march. Talent nodes become especially valuable when they unlock percentage bonuses, important special nodes or the dragon specialisation you intend to use. The most efficient path therefore moves between Portrait and Talent investment rather than completing one entire system before touching the other.

A sensible general approach is:

1. Develop the dragon’s main skills and meet the Talent Tree requirements.
2. Take the inexpensive early Portrait levels.
3. Progress toward the important Talent nodes and chosen specialisations.
4. Compare the next Portrait level with the next useful Talent upgrade.
5. Continue alternating until the important Talent branches and efficient Portrait levels are completed.

The exact stopping points depend on your dragon, build and available Dragon Essence. What matters is avoiding large investments in expensive minor nodes while cheaper Portrait attributes remain available, or pushing Portraits indefinitely while ignoring powerful percentage-based Talent bonuses.

---

## Common Mistakes

The most common Dragon Crystal mistakes are:

Treating Portraits and Talents as a rigid one-before-the-other progression instead of comparing their current value.

- Assuming all five elemental dragons can be farmed from Gnome Bosses.
- Farming Level 20 bosses inefficiently when Level 18 can be cleared far more consistently.
- Farming lower bosses despite being able to defeat Level 20 comfortably.
- Allowing the Trove to remain full and losing opportunities to collect more chests.
- Using valuable high-rarity keys without considering purification time and future farming.
- Spending Arena Insignias on minor rewards while actively developing the Wind Dragon.
- Buying Wind Crystals with Cold Silver before obtaining important KvK and Cinder Shop skills.
- Buying Holy or Shadow Crystals without having a clear march planned for that dragon.
- Splitting crystals between several unfinished dragons.

---

## Conclusion

Dragon Crystal farming improves naturally as your server advances. Higher levels always improve the contents of an equivalent chest, but the increase between individual boss levels is modest enough that reliable clears still matter.

Water, Earth, Fire and Lightning can be developed steadily through boss farming, while Wind, Holy and Shadow require much more deliberate currency planning. Wind players should combine Arena progression with Legion’s Vender purchases once their essential skills are secured, while Holy and Shadow players should take advantage of suitable Theia’s Roulette rotations and carefully selected shop purchases.

Above all, develop dragons with a purpose. Choose the march first, concentrate your crystals and compare the value of Skills, Talents and Portraits at each stage instead of spreading resources across every dragon at once.

---

markdown:
### Unveiling Stardust: A Guide to Infinity Kingdom's Latest Resource

Introduced a while back in Infinity Kingdom's version 2.6.3, we saw a new resource known as Stardust. This enigmatic substance is introduced as part of the Immortal Portrait system, also debuting in this exciting patch.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-40.png)

In this article, we will explore what Stardust is, its essential functions, how it is obtained, and its significance in enhancing your Immortal's power.

## What is Stardust and How Does It Work?

Stardust is a versatile resource with a primary role: to upgrade your Immortal Portraits. The Immortal Portraits serve as a mechanism for enhancing your Immortal's capabilities. Each Immortal Portrait level attained through Stardust upgrades bestows new buffs that significantly amplify your Immortal's combat power. These improvements manifest through increased attribute values, contributing to your Immortal's overall effectiveness in battles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-39.png)

For example, an Immortal like Alexander, renowned for his physical damage prowess, experiences noteworthy enhancements with each level. As his Portrait level increases, his physical attack, damage, defense, and accuracy attributes receive substantial boosts. This transformation empowers Immortals to become even more formidable, turning the tides of battle in your favor.

## The Costs of Stardust Upgrades

As Stardust is a freshly introduced resource, comprehensive cost information is not available at the moment. However, we will diligently monitor and update this article as more details emerge. It's important to keep an eye on future announcements and community discussions to stay informed about the requirements for Stardust upgrades.

For reference, here is the information we currently possess on the initial nine levels of Stardust upgrades, full information on the **[costs of upgrading Immortal Portrait levels can be found here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortal-portraits/cost-of-upgrading-immortal-portraits/)**

## Obtaining Stardust: Unveiling the Sources

Stardust can be acquired from a variety of sources, ensuring that players have multiple paths to collect this valuable resource. Here are the primary outlets to obtain Stardust:

**Arena Shop**: The Arena Shop offers a daily total of 60 Stardust, obtainable in exchange for 15,000 Insignias. Engaging in the arena battles and performing well can grant you access to this precious resource.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-41.png)

**Throne of the Supreme Shop**: In the Throne of the Supreme Shop, you will find a seasonal total of 250 Stardust. Acquiring these Stardust requires an investment of 25,000 Glory Coins. These coins are a sought-after currency earned through participation in various game events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-42.png)

Moreover, you can earn the 250x stardust twice in a single season, if you are in a server that is manipulating the odds and earning max odds rewards. See seperate guide. If you do that, you are earning enough coins to buyout the shop for Stardust before reaching the Regional Finals, where the shop resets.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-103-1024x461.png)

**Marketplace**: The Marketplace, a versatile hub for resources, also sells Stardust. Here, you can purchase 1 Stardust for either 120 Gems or 200 Soul Crystals, depending on your preference and resource availability. This flexibility ensures that players can acquire Stardust according to their specific in-game choices.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-43.png)

**Mysterious Pearl Shop**: The Mysterious Pearl Shop offers a daily total of 20 Stardust, available at the cost of 20 Pearls. This provides yet another opportunity to obtain Stardust and expand your Immortal's power.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-44.png)

**Seasonal Events**: The recurring seasonal events (around 1 every 2 months) also hold a large amount of stardust available for all for free during the seasonal event. Requires only basic activity. You are earning 600 Stardust every seasonal event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-104.png)

**Weekend Sea Merchant**: Each week, the Deep Sea Merchant offers commanders the chance to purchase Stardust bundles. These bundles consist of 10 packages, each containing 7 Stardust. While the rewards are bountiful, the gem cost escalates with each subsequent purchase. The key is to strategically invest your gems to maximize Stardust gains without draining your precious resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-105.png)

Let’s break down the costs and returns associated with each Stardust purchase available with the Sea Merchant:

1. **560 Gems:** The initial investment, offering a cost-effective way to kickstart your Stardust collection.
2. **630 Gems:** A slight increase in cost, maintaining a reasonable balance between investment and return.
3. **700 Gems:** Continuing the trend, the cost rises gradually, ensuring you can progress without excessive expenditures.
4. **840 Gems:** As the costs increase, evaluate your gem reserves and consider whether the benefits outweigh the expense.
5. **980 Gems:** A step further in cost, reinforcing the need for careful consideration in your purchasing strategy.
6. **1120 Gems:** Approaching the higher tiers, weigh the value of the investment against your gem budget.
7. **1260 Gems:** A notable increase in cost, prompting commanders to assess their gem priorities.
8. **1400 Gems:** A substantial investment, requiring a strategic approach to maintain gem sustainability.
9. **1750 Gems:** Nearing the upper limit, evaluate your gem reserves and balance Stardust gains with other priorities.
10. **2100 Gems:** The highest tier, offering a significant return but demanding a careful assessment of your gem allocation.

**Total Stardust Return:** 70 Stardust

**In conclusion**, Stardust, the new resource introduced in the 2.6.3 patch, is set to play a vital role in enhancing your Immortals' capabilities through the Immortal Portrait system. While its costs are yet to be fully revealed, its acquisition from various in-game sources ensures that players have the means to access this resource. As you embark on your journey to upgrade Immortal Portraits and boost combat power, Stardust will undoubtedly be a resource of great significance in Infinity Kingdom's ever-evolving landscape.

title: How to Protect Troops and Resources from Defeats
summary: Getting zeroed in Infinity Kingdom can be brutal—you lose troops, resources, honor, and momentum. But what if we told you there are smart ways to minimize those losses, or even prevent them entirely? This guide builds…
markdown:
Getting zeroed in *Infinity Kingdom* can be brutal—you lose troops, resources, honor, and momentum. But what if we told you there are smart ways to *minimize* those losses, or even prevent them entirely? This guide builds upon our understanding of how defeats and zeroing work to offer you practical workarounds for protecting both your troops and resources when facing an incoming attack.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-118.png)

---

## Protecting Troops from Death During Defeat

### The Key Strategy: Marches as Safe Havens

If you know an attack is coming and you're unlikely to win, the best thing you can do is get your troops ***out***of your Training Grounds (TG). Why? Because TG troops are the most vulnerable and are killed in large numbers during defeats.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-119.png)

### Here’s what you do:

- **Fill all four of your marches** before you are attacked.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-120-1024x444.png)

When you are attacked, *only the garrisoned march and what remains in TG/hospital will be vulnerable*. With four marches filled but not fighting, and an empty TG, you'll take almost no troop losses.

Once the defeat is over and you're ready to fight back:

- Slowly adjust troop numbers from your other three marches.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-121-1024x484.png)

- Reallocate excess troops from those to reinforce your main march.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-123-1024x429.png)

- This trick lets you keep a strong team ready while the rest of your troops remain safely distributed.

### The "Training & Healing Limbo" Trick

Another excellent tactic is to **leave completed training or healing cycles unclaimed**:

- When troops finish in **Barracks** or **Hospitals**, do *not* hit "Claim".
- Troops remain safely out of the Training Grounds.
- Since they're not technically in your base army yet, they can’t be killed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-124-1024x511.png)

**Note:** You won’t be able to train or heal additional troops until you claim the old batch. So use this only if you're saving a few key marches for an important moment.

---

## Protecting Resources from Being Raided

Losing resources after a defeat can be devastating—especially those you've spent days farming or claiming. But there's a powerful trick to protect them.

### Forge Banking: Turning the Forge into a Resource Vault

The **Forge Transmutation** mechanic lets you convert large amounts of resources for refining. But here’s the trick:

- Initiate a **massive transmutation** in the Forge using all your excess unprotected resources.
- **Do NOT complete the transmutation.**
- Those resources are now safely banked.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-125-1024x381.png)

**TIP**: Use the Red Flask "Dragon's Breath Potion" to bank. This one uses more stone than other resources, which likely fits you well as you most likely want to preserve stone. If you are maxed and need food more, use the dust "Ancient Dragon Spine Powder" instead, as this is the most food intensive transmutation.

### If you're defeated:

- Attackers **cannot**steal what's in the Forge queue.
- Once the danger has passed, **cancel**the transmutation.
- You will lose 20% of what you banked but recover **80%**—*far better than losing everything*.

---

## Conclusion

You can't always avoid getting attacked in *Infinity Kingdom*, but you can **control how much you lose**. By learning how to protect troops and stash resources, you turn defeats into mere setbacks—not disasters.

A little preparation goes a long way. Master these techniques, and you’ll spend less time rebuilding and more time fighting back. If you have more tips or questions about this topic, drop them in the Discord or comment section!
