### Military Talent Loadouts: How to Choose the Right Combat Talents

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-173-1024x614.png)

## Introduction

Military talents are the most **situational** of all talent trees in Infinity Kingdom. Unlike development or dragon talents - where efficiency math largely dictates optimal choices - combat talents must adapt to:

- Your army composition
- The enemy’s damage profile
- Whether you are attacking or defending
- The specific PvP or PvE context

There is no single “best” military loadout. Instead, there is a **decision framework** that helps you determine which talents are correct *for you* in each situation.

This article walks through the Military talent tree step by step, explaining:

- Which talents are default picks
- Which depend on your build
- Which are niche but powerful when used correctly

---

## 1. Crit vs Dodge

You almost always want **Crit** now. Used to be Dodge was a real thing to counter physical damage dealers - especially Alexander's - but that is not really the case anymore given how abundant accuracy attributes are now. Given how Crit is always very powerful, it is the default pick here outside of niche builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-174-1024x389.png)

There are three reasons for this:

1. Most army compositions naturally reach higher Crit than Dodge, meaning Crit talents simply give more effective stats.
2. You want battles to end decisively. Dodge-oriented setups prolong fights and increase the risk of timeout losses.
3. High-VIP players (VIP 14–15) are often running **Chase**, which explicitly requires crits to function.

Dodge looks defensive on paper, but in practice it is rarely optimal.

### Default pick: Crit

---

## 2. Physical vs Magic Attack

This is your first true build-dependent choice.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-175-1024x392.png)

- If your primary damage comes from **physical attackers** (for example, lightning-based marches), you want **Knife Through Butter**.
- If your damage comes from **magic carries** (Merlin-centric water, double mage fire setups like Baldwin + Wu), you want **Rage**.

The rule is simple:
**Always amplify your primary damage source.**

---

## 3. AP Conservation vs March Speed

You want **March Speed**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-176.png)

Even when farming gnomes, the small AP savings are rarely worth the extra time spent marching. In PvP, march speed determines:

- Whether you catch targets
- Whether you reinforce in time
- Whether you reposition effectively

Life is too short to save 4 AP and miss fights. **Default pick: March Speed**

---

## 4. Attack vs Defense (Early Tree)

You almost always want **First Strike**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-177.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-178.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-179.png)

The only scenario where **Body of Steel** makes sense is if you cannot reach **Might of Longbows** later in the tree. Otherwise, offensive tempo matters more than early defense. Ruin is a PvE talent and as such not something we are interested in here. But for sieging, that will help you a bit!

### Default pick: First Strike

---

## 5. Relocation Speed vs Reduced Troop Losses

By default, you want **Survival Methods**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-180.png)

Reducing troop losses is universally valuable in:

- PvP
- Gnome farming
- Extended fighting sessions

The only exception is **Illusion Battle (IB)** scenarios, where relocation speed can be strategically important.

### Default pick: Survival Methods

---

## 6. Berserking vs Healing vs Honor

This is one of the most important decision points.

### 6.1 Last Stand – Pure Damage

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-181-1024x357.png)

Last Stand adds a **flat 8% damage increase**, which is enormous. It allows you to:

- Win fights at a power disadvantage
- Break stalemates
- Perform effectively while ratting

This is my go-to talent for **heavy PvP** (SvS, Norheim).

### 6.2 Aid – Healing Efficiency

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-182.png)

Aid is situationally strong if:

- You are the target of repeated rallies
- You are absorbing large volumes of attacks
- You lack healing speedups

I rarely run it by default, but it can be extremely helpful under pressure.

### 6.3 Rank Advancement – Honor Farming

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-183.png)

If you **overpower your opponent**, Rank Advancement is exceptional.

It is mandatory when:

- Farming honor
- Using alts
- Pushing Nobility rank

This talent has no place in even fights—but dominates in one-sided engagements.

---

## 7. Weaken Enemies vs Boost Defense

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-184-1024x411.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-185.png)

Weakening the enemy’s offense speeds up kills and reduces incoming damage. Way I see it, if you are building for offense you go Domination, if you are building for defense you go Frighten. Given how Frighten only reduces enemy Immortal skill damage, it will be more impactful versus enemies doing e.g. Energy Master + Corrosive builds, but it will be quite lackluster against a mage with Infinite Firepower since it does nothing to Tower of Knowledge skills. Likewise, Alexander / Hannibal builds relying on normal attack damage is not impacted by Frighten.

While there may be defense builds that work well with Frighten, it lacks coverage and I greatly favor Domination which ensure effectiveness across the board. **Default pick for current meta: Domination**

---

## 8. Sneak Attack vs Might of Longbows

Sneak Attack is powerful on offense, dealing **7.5% max HP damage before battle starts**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-189-1024x369.png)

However, **Might of Longbows** is the strongest defensive talent in the entire tree and should be your default.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-188.png)

The logic:

- You already run many offensive talents
- You need defense when enemies attack *you*

### Default pick: Might of Longbows

---

## 9. Energy Regen vs Attack Speed

You almost always want **Owl Guardian (Energy Regen)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-190.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-191.png)

- Every immortal benefits from energy regen
- Only very specific normal-attack builds value attack speed more

Attack speed is niche. Energy regen is universal.

---

## 10. Excitation vs Energy Burst

This depends on **whether you are attacking or defending**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-192.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-193.png)

- **Excitation** → Better when attacking
- **Energy Burst** → Better when defending, especially if the attacker uses tactics

Both are viable. Choose based on your role in the fight. I do not like Meditation much, but I will mention if here. If you are doing e.g. a frontloaded Tutankhamon build or a damage Hippo build or something niche, then you may gain value from Meditation to rival the other two. But this is super niche!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-194-1024x339.png)

---

## 11. Accuracy vs Resilience

You usually want **Resilience**.

However, this is a talent that is determined 100% on the questions: Are you running physical damage? if yes, do you ever miss an attack? (dodge in reports). If yes and yes, then Accuracy is your saviour!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-195-1024x424.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-196.png)

For anyone else (the vast majority) Resilience reducing incoming crits is super strong and the default go-to talent pick here.

Reasons to pick **Target Locked (Accuracy):**

- Prevents misses → consistent damage
- Extremely strong for physical carries if you are having problems reaching hit-cap

---

## 12. Hospital / Wall / Defense Energy Talents

Frankly, this row is weak.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-197.png)

All three options are underwhelming. I default to **Skillful** (defense energy regen) because it has *some* PvP relevance. Far as I am concerned, this is a row where you pick something to move on..

---

From here on, we are getting into Conquest season talents. The following will be available upon entering Conquest.

## 13. Irresistible Force vs Fate’s Favor

For me, this is a clear choice: **Irresistible Force**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-198-1024x404.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-199.png)

Reducing enemy energy regen directly improves your combat performance. Fate’s Favor only has value in extremely niche “intentional defeat” strategies, which I do not play.

### What is intentional defeat strategies? +

*To me this is a total no brainer, I always want to push my combat power and performance as much as possible. Hence Irresistible Force is the nobrain pick for me. That being said, I can see in super rare cases where you are doing maybe a low-troop count fire-dragon attack spam on an enemy whale (where you send just enough troops to enable your dragon breath to land and kill enemy troops before you are defeated, thus taking minimal defeat losses while slowly grinding down the enemy) then I guess Fate's Favor is good. I never play to be defeated so never using this talent.*

If your goal is to win fights, take **Irresistible Force**.

---

## 14. Countering Enemy Damage Types

This final choice is extremely powerful and should **never** be set-and-forget.

You should usually choose between:

### Adaptive Armor

- +25% physical defense if enemy front row is attack-type
Excellent against Alexander-based compositions.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-200-1024x469.png)

### Rune of Petricite

- +25% magical defense if enemy back row is magic-type
Essential against Himiko and mage-heavy metas.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-201-1024x514.png)

Do not rely on **Total Victory**. The wounded conversion effect is too small to matter meaningfully.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-202.png)

**Best practice:**
Have **two military talent pages**, one for physical-heavy metas and one for magic-heavy metas, and swap based on the matchup.

---

## Conclusion Summary

Military talents are not about copying a fixed build—they are about **correct decision-making**.

Key takeaways:

- Default to offense to avoid timeouts
- Amplify your primary damage type
- Adjust talents based on whether you are attacking or defending
- Counter the enemy’s carry, not their support
- Maintain multiple military pages if you are PvP-active

Players who actively think about their Military talents will consistently outperform players with higher raw power who do not.

That is the real advantage of mastering this tree.

---

title: How to snipe the jackpot in Children's Festival 2025
summary: Seasonal events in Infinity Kingdom, like the ongoing Children’s Day Celebration, offer unique ways to earn powerful rewards. Among these, the most sought-after is the Jackpot Reward from the Treasure Hunter feature.…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Skaermbillede-2025-06-17-102154-1024x586.png)

Seasonal events in Infinity Kingdom, like the ongoing **Children’s Day Celebration**, offer unique ways to earn powerful rewards. Among these, the most sought-after is the **Jackpot Reward** from the **Treasure Hunter** feature. This system appears regularly in seasonal events, and while it’s often overlooked or misunderstood, with the right strategy you can **snipe the jackpot**—even as a free or light spender.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-55.png)

On **Season 1 servers**, the jackpot consists of **60x Shadow/Holy Selection Chests**, while **Chaos-enabled servers** receive **80x Chaos Selection Chests**—a truly massive prize that can accelerate your immortal progress drastically.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-50-1024x511.png)

This guide will explain in detail how the system works, the odds involved, and a proven strategy to snipe these jackpot rewards using patience, timing, and in-game observation.

### TL;DR

- Jackpot = 60x Holy/Shadow chests (S1) or 80x Chaos chests (Conquest servers)
- Only 3 jackpots per 3,000 items
- It’s all about timing, not money

---

## Understanding the Treasure Hunter System

Each round of the Treasure Hunter has a **fixed pool of 3,000 items** shared across your server group. This pool is made up of three item tiers:

### Bottom Tier (Common Items)

These items are extremely common and make up the bulk of the pool:

- Random elemental immortal fragments (540 total)
- Small Dragon Crystal chests (168 total)

### Middle Tier (Uncommon Rewards)

Less common, but still decently likely to pull:

- Unique Artifact Schematics (30 total)
- Cao Cao Fragments
- Large Dragon Crystal Selection Chests
- Immortal Selection Chests (e.g. Alexander)

### Top Tier (Rare Jackpot Items)

These are the true high-value rewards:

- 60x Shadow/Holy Selection Chests (S1 servers) or 80x Chaos Selection Chests (Conquest servers) — only 3 total
- 5 Unique Artifact Fragments (Holy/Shadow or Chaos)
- 4 Random Immortal Fragments (Holy/Shadow or Chaos)

With just **3 jackpot items in a 3,000-item pool**, your base odds are 0.1%. However, these odds **improve over time** as other players pull and drain lower-tier items.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Skaermbillede-2025-06-17-102128-1024x505.png)

### TL;DR

- Pool: 3,000 total items per round
- Jackpot odds start at 0.1%, increase as pool is drained
- Common items dominate early draws

---

## The Strategy: How to Snipe the Jackpot

The key to success is **timing your pulls** to when the jackpot odds are most favorable.

### Step 1: Monitor the Jackpot Count

Check how many jackpot items are left in the current pool. If all 3 are gone, the pool resets. If only 1 remains, stay alert.

### Step 2: Track the Pool Count

You can see how many items remain in the pool. As this number gets lower, your chances improve dramatically.

- At 3,000 items: ~0.1% odds
- At 1,000 items: ~0.15% odds

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Skaermbillede-2025-06-17-102050-1024x516.png)

### Step 3: Wait for Ideal Conditions

If 1 jackpot is left and fewer than 80 items remain, prepare to start pulling and make sure you have a bank of wishes so you can finish the pool if "unlucky".

### Step 4: Draw Quickly

Start drawing when the pool hits 60–50 remaining items. DO NOT draw manually (use multi-draw!) you may be reading other guides telling you to avoid wasting pulls after the jackpot drops, but for this sniping we need speed a lot more than we need to not waste a draw or two. As it pool gets to very low number of items, you speed through draws to snipe the jackpot.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-72.png)

### Step 5: Monitor & Repeat

If someone else snipes the jackpot before you, the pool resets and you start tracking again.

### TL;DR

- Start pulling at 50–60 remaining items with 1 jackpot left
- Always use fast multi-draws during sniping window
- Jackpot pulls cause instant reset

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Skaermbillede-2025-06-17-102154-1-1024x586.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Skaermbillede-2025-06-17-102209-1024x359.png)

---

## Real Example: Children’s Festival Jackpot Sniping

During the ongoing Children’s Day event, players received **Resonance Crystals** from:

- Battle Pass
- Free Celebration Shop rewards

One player used only these free and pass-earned crystals to participate. By tracking pool drops and watching for low-count jackpot opportunities, they were able to **pull 3 jackpots in only 50 draws total.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Skaermbillede-2025-06-17-102241-1024x441.png)

This demonstrates that success doesn’t require heavy spending—**only dedication and smart timing.**

### TL;DR

- **3 jackpots pulled with 50 draws**
- No additional purchases beyond Battle Pass
- Patience and timing = success

---

## Additional Tips for Jackpot Hunters

- **Have time ready**: You may need to monitor the event for long stretches
- **Be patient**: RNG is random—some rounds will reset early, others give chances late
- **Avoid overcommitting**: Never burn all crystals in one go without watching the pool

### TL;DR

- Time > money
- Track manually
- Be ready to adapt quickly

---

## Why Jackpot Sniping Knowledge Is Essential for Every Seasonal Event in Infinity Kingdom

If you’ve just learned how to snipe the jackpot in the **Children’s Day Celebration** event, congratulations—you’ve unlocked one of the most powerful techniques in all of *Infinity Kingdom*. But here’s the real kicker: this isn’t just useful for one event.

In fact, once you understand how **Treasure Hunter jackpot sniping** works, you can apply that same knowledge to **every seasonal event** moving forward.

## Same Mechanics, Different Skin

Whether it’s the **Spring Festival**, **Halloween Spree**, **Anniversary Carnival**, or any other seasonal celebration, Infinity Kingdom reuses the **same exact Treasure Hunter system**. The interface might change, the event currency may have a new name, and the rewards might be themed differently—but the mechanics remain identical:

- 3,000 items per round
- 3 jackpot prizes
- Fixed item counts for all rewards
- Shared cross-server pool
- Jackpot causes an instant reset

This consistency means once you’ve mastered the art of timing your pulls, monitoring the remaining item count, and jumping in when odds are optimal, you can rinse and repeat your way to **massive long-term gains**.

## The Jackpot Is Always Worth It

Depending on your server stage, the top-tier prize will vary:

- **Season 1 servers**: 60x Shadow/Holy Selection Chests
- **Conquest servers**: 80x Chaos Selection Chests (far more valuable)

These jackpots are game-defining. Getting even one or two over the course of an event can power up a full new immortal, supercharge an element build, or complete an artifact breakthrough. When you learn to snipe successfully, you’re not relying on luck—you’re stacking the odds in your favor and **bypassing the spending curve** entirely.

## Knowledge That Pays Off Repeatedly

Each seasonal event typically lasts 10–14 days and has **multiple jackpot rounds**. Multiply that across all major events throughout the year, and you get several dozen sniping opportunities annually. Now imagine walking away with 5, 10, or even 15 jackpots over time.

This knowledge literally **compounds in value** the longer you play.

## The True Power: Non-Whales Keeping Up

For low- or mid-spenders, jackpot sniping is one of the few tools that can let you fight above your weight. Whales will always have more resources, but they often spend fast and early, not strategically. If you're patient and observant, you can end up walking away with the jackpot that they missed by being too hasty.

## What to Expect in Future Events

So far, the Treasure Hunter system has remained unchanged across every seasonal event that used it. That means in future events, you should expect:

- Different event currency (e.g., Lanterns, Candy, Fireworks, etc.)
- Updated pool visuals and themes
- New artifact or fragment jackpot rewards (sometimes exclusive)
- The exact same jackpot logic and pool behavior

## Final Words

Learning to snipe jackpots in Treasure Hunter isn’t just a fun trick—it’s a **core player skill**. Master it once, and you’ll be harvesting jackpot rewards **every few months** as seasonal events roll through.

Track the pool. Wait for the low counts. Draw fast. Get rewarded.

**Next time a seasonal event hits Norheim, you’ll already be ahead of the game.**

title: How to test: Critical hits, e.g. Weakness, Chase, Energy burst
summary: In the ever-evolving world of Infinity Kingdom, mastering the intricacies of critical hit-based Tower of Knowledge skills is essential for any player seeking to maximize their combat effectiveness. With skills like…
markdown:
### Unlocking the Secrets of Critical Hit-Based Tower of Knowledge Skills in Infinity Kingdom

In the ever-evolving world of Infinity Kingdom, mastering the intricacies of critical hit-based Tower of Knowledge skills is essential for any player seeking to maximize their combat effectiveness. With skills like Energy Burst and Chase, the potential for high energy regeneration and damage output on critical hits becomes a game-changer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-55-1024x574.png)

Understanding the nuances of these skills, along with factors like critical hit chance boosts and resilience reduction, can significantly impact your battle outcomes.

## 1. Critical Hit Basics

Before delving into specific skills, it's crucial to grasp the fundamentals of critical hits. When an attack lands as a critical hit, all damage instances are multiplied by 2-3 times, resulting in a substantial increase in overall damage. Consistent critical hits are, therefore, a key goal for any player seeking to optimize their strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-56-1024x612.png)

## 2. Boosting Critical Hit Chance

To enhance your chances of landing critical hits, consider utilizing Immortal William and the dragon, both of which boost critical hit chance. Additionally, Tower of Knowledge skills like "Weakness" can be instrumental in securing more critical hits by reducing the enemy's resilience rate. Strategically incorporating these boosts into your lineup can tip the scales in your favor.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-57.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-58.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-59.png)

*Note: Fire dragon says Crit Damage, but that is incorrect. Seems to be Critical hit chance boost.*

## 3. Customizing Strategies

The challenge arises in determining when to deploy critical hit-based skills like Chase or Weakness. There's no one-size-fits-all answer; it depends on various factors such as your technology, skill levels, boost levels, and the specific enemy you are facing.

## 4. Reading Battle Reports

To fine-tune your strategy, regularly review battle reports. In one scenario, Himiko achieved a high critical hit rating, indicating that her critical hit chance surpassed the enemy's resilience.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-60-1024x612.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-61-1024x612.png)

In such cases, running Weakness becomes a viable option, ensuring more critical hits. Additionally, considering skills like Chase can further capitalize on the high chance of critical hits.

Conversely, if your opponent boasts high resilience, perhaps from a full dragon talent tree or skills like Malice, obtaining critical hits might be challenging. In such situations, countering with skills like Malice can neutralize the impact of critical hits.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-62.png)

## 5. Testing and Optimization

Experimentation is key. As you test your build in combat, observe the outcomes and adjust accordingly. If critical hits are consistently high, integrating skills like Chase may yield substantial damage. However, in late conquest, where space in your mage's skill set is limited, considerations like spell disintegration may take precedence over skills like Chase.

## 6. Considerations for Chase

While Chase can deliver impressive damage, late-game scenarios might necessitate prioritizing other magical damage skills over it. Even with a high critical hit rate, the damage contribution of Chase may be overshadowed by alternatives like Concentration, which guarantees a flat damage boost.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-61-1024x612.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-63.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-64.png)

In conclusion, mastering critical hit-based Tower of Knowledge skills involves a delicate balance of understanding your strengths, weaknesses, and adapting your strategy based on the ever-changing landscape of Infinity Kingdom. Regularly assess and refine your approach to stay one step ahead in the dynamic world of battles and conquests.

title: How to test: Dodge rate, e.g. Misleading
summary: In the dynamic realm of Infinity Kingdom, achieving victory hinges on a thorough understanding of battle mechanics. One pivotal aspect is the adept utilization of dodge skills, particularly Misleading and After-Image.…
markdown:
### Mastering Dodge Skills in Infinity Kingdom: A Comprehensive Guide

In the dynamic realm of Infinity Kingdom, achieving victory hinges on a thorough understanding of battle mechanics. One pivotal aspect is the adept utilization of dodge skills, particularly Misleading and After-Image. This comprehensive guide aims to unravel the intricacies of these skills, empowering players to make informed decisions for effective skill setups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-42-1024x564.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-44-1024x547.png)

If you are new to reading battle reports, you may want to begin by reading the 101 guides found here: **[Battle Report Guides](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/all-effects-ability-passive/battle-reports/)**

### Understanding the Dodge Mechanism:

Dodge serves as a potent defense against physical damage, providing a crucial layer of survivability to your Immortals. It's essential to recognize that dodge exclusively works against physical attacks, including normal attacks and abilities denoted as "physical damage rate." However, the effectiveness of dodge can be diminished by an enemy's accuracy, which reduces the dodge chances of your Immortals.

### Delving into Dodge Skills - Misleading and After-Image:

1. **Misleading:**

- Purpose: Increases dodge chance, offering a valuable defense against physical attacks.
- Strategy: Effective when facing enemies relying on physical damage.
- Considerations: Assess its value by observing if enemy attacks are successfully dodged by your Immortals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-45.png)

2. **After-Image:**

- Purpose: Similar to Misleading, enhances dodge chances to improve overall survivability.
- Strategy: Complements Misleading for an added layer of dodge effectiveness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-46.png)

### Understanding Dodge Mechanics in Infinity Kingdom: A Tactical Analysis

In the intricate landscape of Infinity Kingdom, the mastery of dodge skills is a game-changer, with Misleading and After-Image taking center stage. To navigate this aspect effectively, commanders must delve into the subtleties of physical damage recognition, energy regeneration dynamics, and the art of deciphering battle reports for crucial dodge metrics.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-47.png)

### Identifying Physical Damage: Unraveling the Challenge

*Challenge:* The initial hurdle lies in recognizing skills and attacks categorized as "physical damage rate." You must learn which Immortal's deal physical damage. If you are faced with an enemy that deals mainly magical damage, misleading may not be very valueable. On the other hand, against enemies with a lot of physical damage, misleading can be a huge boost.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-49-1024x543.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-51-1024x560.png)

*Insight:* Building familiarity with these distinctions is paramount, providing a crucial foundation for understanding when dodge skills, such as Misleading and After-Image, are most beneficial.

### Dodge Counters Energy Regen: A Tactical Insight

*Insight:* Dodging attacks serves as a formidable countermeasure, preventing the triggering of skills like Energy Burst and Adrenaline Rush. If the triggering attack is dodges, the enemy will gain no energy from their efforts!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-52.png)

*Consideration:* A successful dodge translates to no hits, consequently inhibiting the activation of energy regeneration skills. This critical insight influences strategic decisions during skill setup.

### Reading Battle Reports for Dodge Metrics: A Strategic Approach

*Technique:* Commanders can initiate their analysis by clicking on a specific Immortal in the battle report.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-53-1024x612.png)

*Exploration:* Navigate to the type of damage dealt to unveil intricate details such as dodge rate, critical hits, and instances of dodged attacks. This exploration is instrumental in gauging the effectiveness of dodge-centric strategies.

For this the important metric is dodge. Clicking on an immortal in the battle report. Then clicking on one of the types of damage being dealt by this immortal on the right hand side gives players information about the damage dealt, critical hits and dodged attacks.

### Evaluating Misleading's Effectiveness

*Methodology:* Analyzing battle reports becomes a strategic exercise to ascertain if enemy attacks are successfully being dodged.

The goal is for players to be able to test for themselves and evaluate if Misleading is good for them or not. For instance, if a player uses misleading he can check the enemy side of the battle report, go to a physical damage dealer and check the attack information to see if any of the enemy’s attacks are being dodges by his Immortals. If they are, misleading gives high value. If they are not, it means that the enemy has too much accuracy for the player to gain value from misleading.

In the above report you can see that I should be using Coercion for the Alexander to try and reduce the dodged attacks. Likewise, it shows that the enemy's reliance on Misleading is a good choice, because my Alexander had 43% of it's attacks dodged entirely!

In the below, you will see the reverse, here I am still not using Coercion, but the enemy is also using Misleading. However, not a single Alexander attack is being dodged! What does that mean? That means that my Alexander has enough accuracy to make up the increased dodge chance of my enemy. As such, the enemy should replace misleading with something else.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-54-1024x567.png)

*Strategic Insight:* Misleading proves its worth if dodges occur, signifying its value in enhancing the survivability of Immortals. However, commanders should maintain a continuous reevaluation process, especially if no dodges are observed.

In the ever-evolving battlefield of Infinity Kingdom, understanding the nuances of dodge mechanics becomes a strategic art. Through astute recognition of physical damage, leveraging the counteractive nature of dodge against energy regen, and dissecting battle reports for insightful metrics, commanders can elevate their tactical prowess. May your Immortals dodge swiftly, and victories be plentiful on the horizon!
