title: How to understand and use the Energy Regen attribute
summary: Energy is the heartbeat of every immortal. It’s what fuels their ultimate abilities - the big, flashy, game-defining moves that usually decide who wins the fight. Without energy, your immortals are basically swinging…
markdown:
### Introduction – Why Energy Matters So Much

Energy is the heartbeat of every immortal. It’s what fuels their ultimate abilities - the big, flashy, game-defining moves that usually decide who wins the fight. Without energy, your immortals are basically swinging wet noodles - *with a few exceptions*.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-12.png)

Each immortal automatically gains energy over time, plus extra from certain buffs or abilities. Once they hit **1000 energy**, they cast their ultimate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-11-1024x380.png)

A lot of players underestimate how much energy regen speed defines an immortal’s *tempo*. Whether your team cycles ultimates fast and keeps pressure up, or fires off slow, heavy-hitting bursts depends almost entirely on this stat.

---

## How Energy Regeneration Works

All immortals regenerate energy passively every second. You can see their specific regen speed in their info window:
**Open your immortal → tap Power Info → look to the bottom → for "Energy Regen".**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-13-1024x754.png)

That number shows how much energy per second your immortal naturally gains.

For example:

- **Hippolyta:** 142 energy per second → ~7 seconds to reach 1000 energy.
- **Genghis Khan:** 83.1 energy per second → ~12 seconds to reach 1000 energy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-15-1024x696.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-14.png)

So Hippo can cast almost twice as often as Khan without any buffs. But that doesn’t mean Hippo is *stronger* — just that she plays faster. Khan hits harder but slower, meaning any regen buff has a bigger *relative* effect on him.

---

## Why Regen Speed Changes Everything

The faster an immortal regens energy, the more ultimates they can cast in a fight. But the important nuance is *how* that interacts with other effects:

- **Flat energy gain** (like Adrenaline Rush or Energy Burst) adds fixed energy each trigger.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-19.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-20.png)

- **Percentage-based buffs** (like Blessing of Rage or Matilda’s ultimate) multiply your *base* regen rate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-16.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-18.png)

So, if you’ve got a low-regen immortal like Khan, flat energy skills are more impactful. If you’re running someone with naturally high regen, percent buffs scale harder. Note that there are also other factors to consider, with Adrenaline Rush you need attack speed whereas Energy Burst needs many damage instances and high critical hit rates. However the principle remain.

Here’s an example:

- Hippolyta gains 142 per second.
Add Blessing of Rage (20% bonus): +28 energy per second.
- Khan gains 83.1 per second.
Same Blessing: +16.6 per second.

Both benefit, but Hippo gains nearly double the extra energy — that’s why Matilda and Blessing of Rage feel insane on immortals who already regen quickly. That being said, this does not mean you should never run e.g. Blessing of Rage in lightning Khan builds, the gain is still hugely valueable, but you need to understand what it actually does and how it impacts your immortals.

---

## Examples & Synergy in Action

Here’s where this gets fun. Energy regen isn’t just about speed — it’s about *timing synergy*.

Take **Theodora + Yi Sun-sin (YSS)** as an example:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-21-1024x723.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-22-1024x736.png)

- Theodora regen: 93.7/s
- YSS regen: 97.6/s
That means both hit their first ultimates around the same time — YSS at about 10.24 seconds, Theo at 10.67 seconds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-23.png)

When timed right, YSS’s artifact buff (which increases healing by 30%) is active when Theo’s heal goes off. That’s free extra sustain purely from energy syncing.

---

## Exceptions & Special Cases

A few immortals ignore or bend the energy system:

- **Alexander** and **Hannibal**: Once you unlock their unique artifacts, their ultimates become passive — energy doesn’t matter.
- **Manco Capac:** Only needs 1000 energy once; his ultimate stays active after that.
- **Control effects** (like stuns, silences, and water dragon strikes) can interrupt ultimates or remove energy regen for a time (silences). If you’re unlucky, your immortal might lose energy mid-cast and never fire off.

So even with perfect regen, battlefield chaos can still ruin your timing. Always account for those disruptions in real fights.

---

## What Affects Energy Regen

Several things modify your regen stat directly:

- **Technology:**  - *Energy Surge* → +5% energy regen speed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-24.png)

- **Talent Trees:**  - *Owl Guardian* (in the Military talent tree) → +5% energy regen speed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-25.png)

- **Immortal Boost Levels:**  - Total +14% at Boost 30. (5% at level 9, 5% at 19, 2% at 24, 2% at 29), **[read more here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/specific-immortal-deepdives/immortal-boost-levels-0-30/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-26-1024x574.png)

- **Artifacts (Surge Bonus Roll):**  - Available for *Attack* and *Support* types.
- +5% base bonus, increasing with star level and quality.
- Max caps by season:  - **S1 Bronze:** 15% cap (5★)
- **S2 Silver:** 20% cap (5★)
- **Conquest & Legendary (Gold):** 25% cap (5★)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-28.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-30.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-29.png)

Stacking all these together can make a huge difference — especially for immortals who rely on frequent ultimates like Hippo, Merlin, or Himiko.

---

## Conclusion – The Bottom Line

Energy regen isn’t just another stat — it’s the tempo of your march. It defines how often your immortals cast, how their combos line up, and how much value you get from skills and other boons.

Knowing how Energy Regen works will help you understand how to setup immortal synergies, skills and to understand combat performance as well as how to optimize your choice of setups and builds.

---

title: How to upgrade Immortal Portraits efficiently
summary: The latest update in Infinity Kingdom, patch 2.6.3, introduced an exciting new feature known as Immortal Portraits.
markdown:
### Title: Maximizing Power: Efficient Immortal Portrait Upgrades in Infinity Kingdom

The latest update in Infinity Kingdom, patch 2.6.3, introduced an exciting new feature known as Immortal Portraits.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-6.png)

These captivating portraits play a pivotal role in enhancing your Immortal's capabilities and boosting their combat prowess. Stardust, a versatile resource, serves as the key to unlocking the full potential of Immortal Portraits, and this guide will reveal how to make the most efficient use of it.

### Unveiling Immortal Portraits: The Power of Stardust

With each Immortal Portrait level, which is achieved through Stardust upgrades, your Immortals receive potent buffs that significantly enhance their attributes and contribute to their overall effectiveness in battles. These upgrades are essential for taking your Immortals to the next level, and they are categorized into different types based on the Immortal's role, such as attack, tank, ranged, mage, and support. While the specific attributes may vary, they all share a common tier structure for upgrades.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-4-1024x541.png)

The upgrades begin with basic stat values for the initial levels, gradually building up to the significant tier rewards. The first major milestone is reached at level 10, where Immortals unlock a 5% boost in a specific attribute. However, the most impressive gains come with the final and highest tier upgrades that kick in at level 20.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-5-1024x555.png)

These provide pure, substantial increases in output. For example, physical damage-dealing Immortals gain an extra 5% in physical damage, making it a game-changing boost.

### The Value of Stardust: A Precious Resource

Efficiently utilizing your Stardust is crucial in your journey to enhance your Immortals. As the upgrade costs increase with each level, it's essential to make wise choices. While level 18 might offer only minor attribute boosts at a relatively high Stardust cost, level 19 to 20 can be a game-changer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-7.png)

For instance, the upgrade to 18 provides you 73.3 magical defense which relative to the roughly 4200 magical defense attribute value on my Alexander can only be called a minor boost at best.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-8-1024x570.png)

Therefore, players should carefully strategize how they invest their Stardust to maximize their Immortals' power.

### The Ultimate Upgrade Path: Prioritization and Thresholds

To get the most out of your Immortal Portraits, it's crucial to prioritize certain Immortals. Focus on your key Immortals first, those that are essential to your strategy, such as Alexander and Hannibal for hybrid builds or Merlin for water-themed teams (unless you're running Himiko). These Immortals should be your top candidates for Immortal Portrait upgrades.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-3-1024x574.png)

However, there's an essential strategy to bear in mind. It's highly recommended to prioritize upgrading a single Immortal to level 20 as quickly as possible before spreading your Stardust across multiple Immortals. The reason behind this approach is the critical threshold that unlocks at level 20, where you receive a significant 5% boost in a particular attribute, such as damage. This boost far outweighs the earlier, minor upgrades in terms of power and efficiency.

In practice, this means that players should first prioritize their primary Immortal, taking them to level 20 to unlock this substantial power boost. Then, gradually work on upgrading other Immortals. While you can opt to gain a few of the lower levels on other crucial Immortals, the focus should always be on reaching level 20 as swiftly as possible.

### Conclusion: Master the Art of Immortal Portrait Upgrades

Efficiently upgrading Immortal Portraits with Stardust is a pivotal aspect of maximizing your Immortals' combat potential in Infinity Kingdom. Prioritizing key Immortals and reaching level 20 as soon as possible is the most efficient way to boost your team's strength. With this strategic approach, you'll have a formidable edge in battles and unleash the full potential of your Immortals. So, embark on your journey, harness the power of Stardust, and dominate the battlefield like never before!

title: How to Upgrade Portaits and When to STOP upgrading
summary: Infinity Kingdom Guide: When to Stop Upgrading Portraits?
markdown:
**Infinity Kingdom Guide: When to Stop Upgrading Portraits?**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-8-1024x520.png)

---

## Introduction

Portraits are one of the most powerful late-game progression tools in Infinity Kingdom. Unlocking significant stat boosts as you level them up with Stardust, portraits can push your Immortals from "strong" to "formidable." However, Stardust is incredibly limited, and wasting it can set back your entire account progression. Knowing **when to stop upgrading a portrait** is key to optimizing your power and efficiency.

In this guide, we will explain what portraits are, why they matter, what each level tier does, and when you should stop upgrading them depending on your goals and spending level.

---

## What Are Portraits?

Portraits are special upgrades you can apply to Immortals once you have unlocked them. You access them from the Immortal interface, and they become relevant starting in the mid-game and especially in Season 1 and beyond.

To upgrade them, you need **Stardust**, a rare resource that is mainly obtained from the Lucky Spin event or from bundles. Upgrading a portrait grants direct attribute bonuses depending on the Immortal's type (DPS, Tank, or Support).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-9-1024x529.png)

**[Read more about all upgrade costs and attribute boosts here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/immortal-portraits/portrait-level-table/)**

---

## Why Stardust Must Be Spent Wisely

Stardust is a major bottleneck. Unless you are a high spender who can whale every Lucky Spin, you will need to be very selective about which Immortals you invest in and how far.

Every 10 levels takes significantly more Stardust. For example:

- Level 1 to 10 is relatively cheap.
- Level 40 to 50 can cost as much as the entire 0-30 path combined.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-10-1024x486.png)

This makes poor Stardust spending **one of the most punishing long-term mistakes** in the game.

**[All upgrade costs here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/immortal-portraits/portait-upgrade-costs-level-1-50/)**

---

## Key Milestones in Portrait Leveling

Each 10-level breakpoint offers specific bonuses:

- **Level 10:** A small but meaningful bump to base stats. For DPS, it is worth doing even early.
- **Level 20:** This is a **huge breakpoint** for tanks and supports, as they gain **+5% Damage Taken Reduction**. This is an essential early target.
- **Level 40:** Another **+5% Damage Taken Reduction** for tanks and supports. While not as vital as the 20 breakpoint, it is a powerful bonus.
- **Level 50:** Grants **flat attributes and max scaling power** to your Immortal. Essential for DPS, but diminishing returns for supports and tanks unless you are pushing every ounce of power.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-11-1024x384.png)

---

## Recommended Upgrade Strategy

Here is a smart and efficient upgrade path tailored for low- to mid-spenders:

### Early Progression (Preparation to Season 1):

- **DPS Immortal(s):** Upgrade to **Level 20** as soon as possible. You need every stat you can get.
- **Support/Tank Immortals:** Level **10** is enough. Focus Stardust on your DPS.

### Mid Progression (Season 1 to Season 2):

- **DPS Immortal(s):** Push to **Level 40** to unlock more attribute scaling.
- **Support/Tank Immortals:** Push to **Level 20** for that +5% Damage Taken Reduction.

### Late Progression (Season 2 and Conquest):

- **DPS Immortal(s):** Push to **Level 50** to max out your main source of damage.
- **Support/Tank Immortals:** Keep at **Level 20**, or **40** if you want to power up your main march before moving to your second.

Unless you're a whale, going **40-50 on supports and tanks is not recommended**, as it gives only marginal benefit for an extreme cost. That Stardust is better spent upgrading your next march.

---

## Power Pooling vs. Roster Building

If your goal is to **max power into one main team**, you might go further on supports and tanks. Getting them to 40 means a larger power boost and more stats for Conquest-style dominance.

However, if your goal is to **build up a competitive second march**, **stop at 20** and move on. Those thousands of Stardust can level 2-3 more portraits to 20 instead of going from 40 to 50 on a tank.

---

## Conclusion

Understanding when to stop upgrading portraits is critical for efficient account growth. For most players:

- **DPS to 50**, supports and tanks to **20** is optimal.
- Go to **40** on supports/tanks only if you're pooling everything into one team.
- Only push **50 on non-DPS** if you're a heavy spender chasing top leaderboard spots.

Remember: Stardust is scarce. Spend it with intention, and your roster will thank you.

---

title: How to upgrade your Dragon Talent Tree?
summary: In this guide we are going to answer the question I have been getting so many times: How does dragon talents work?
markdown:
In this guide we are going to answer the question I have been getting so many times: How does dragon talents work?

## Moving around the talent tree

You have a large tree, and not all of the buffs and stats are relevant for you. For instance, my earth-wind hybrid main does not benefit from magic damage at all, so why would I want to spend crystals on that? Well I need to move around the talent tree and to do that I need to level up the minor nodes on the tree.

**Once you level up a minor node you can access the node behind it.** As you can see below, the arrows show how I unlock new minor nodes once I level up the first nodes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-67.png)

The highest node is the **Major node** here (in gray with arrows towards it). I need to unlock ALL other minor nodes in this section of the tree (blue) to unlock my **Major**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-73.png)

**UPDATE: HOTFIX changes to dragon talents since it's early release means that you no longer have to upgrade minor nodes to level 3 in order to progress on to the next node. This is very good, because it means you can now upgrade just level 1 minor nodes along your path to Claw, uniques, etc. See seperate guide for the best way to progress your dragon's talents (universal guide).**

## Unique nodes

The unique nodes are more difficult. Because these depend on the setup, element and build that you are using. For instance, running Earth-Wind Hybrid you want attack speed as quickly as possible. As such the progression path in Aftershock is:

**1. Claw and Armor Major nodes (Green)
2. Sandstorm Breath (Blue)
3. Earth Roar (Purple)
4. Gaze and Robust Major nodes (Grey)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-68.png)

title: How to upgrade your dragon talents in conquest
summary: Once you enter Conquest, dragon talent progression opens up again — and this is where crystal management starts to matter even more.
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-68-1024x529.png)

## Dragon Talent Progression (Conquest Extension Guide)

Once you enter Conquest, dragon talent progression opens up again — and this is where crystal management starts to matter even more.

At **Dragon Level 52 and 54**, you unlock:

- **Unique Nodes Level 7 and 8 (on both sides)**
- **+2 levels to both dragon abilities**
- **1 new Claw major node**
- **1 new Armor major node**
- Additional minor nodes along the path

This effectively reopens the tree with the same structure, but higher stakes. The logic from Season 2 still applies — but the order you invest in now determines how quickly your march scales into late-game viability.

If you where looking for how to upgrade dragon talents in a pre-conquest environment, [read a previous article here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/milestones-and-costs-upgrading-dragon-talents-a-season-2-guide/).

---

## Understanding the Conquest Extension

The key difference in Conquest is pacing.

In Season 2, most players progress linearly. In Conquest, crystal income varies heavily between players, so your approach depends on whether you’ve been saving or not.

You’re essentially rebuilding priority in this order:

1. Unlock access (Unique Nodes 7 → 8)
2. Secure high-value majors (new Claw + Armor)
3. Reinforce baseline stats (minor nodes)
4. Finish scaling (max majors + abilities)

---

## 🥇 Path 1: If You Have Banked Crystals

If you’ve been saving crystals properly, you can accelerate your power spike significantly.

### Step 1: Push to Unique Node Level 7

You need this to unlock the next layer of major nodes.

- Follow the shortest path
- Only upgrade required minor nodes to **level 1**
- Avoid unnecessary stat investment early

---

### Step 2: Unlock New Claw and Armor

Once Unique Node 7 is unlocked:

- Immediately unlock both **new Claw and Armor nodes**
- These are your highest value upgrades per crystal at this stage

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-69-1024x560.png)

---

### Step 3: Upgrade Claw & Armor to Level 3

Same logic as pre-Conquest applies:

- Fast scaling
- Efficient cost-to-power ratio

You’re again hitting that early breakpoint where:

- Damage dealt increases meaningfully
- Damage taken drops noticeably

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-70.png)

---

### Step 4: Push to Unique Node Level 8

Now that your baseline combat stats are stabilized:

- Complete **Unique Node 8 on both sides**
- This upgrades your dragon abilities to their final levels

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-71-1024x539.png)

At this stage, your dragon’s core identity is fully online.

---

### Step 5: Upgrade Relevant Minor Nodes to Level 3

Now you shift into stat optimization.

### Priority order:

1. Physical or Magical Damage (based on your march)
2. Physical and Magical Defense (both matter in Conquest)
3. Resilience

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-72.png)

**Ignore Accuracy** in almost all cases.
Unless you’re running a very specific niche setup, it has negligible impact compared to raw damage or survivability.

---

## 🥈 Path 2: If You’re Behind on Crystals

So if you are NOT in a position where you have banked a lot of Crystals going into Conquest - or if you are building new dragons for your second and third march during conquest - this is how to best progress from scratch in a conquest environment.

---

## Step 1: Reset Your Dragon Talents

If you’ve already invested into the new Conquest nodes inefficiently, resetting is often the correct decision.

A reset allows you to:

- Remove low-value upgrades (like early minor node overinvestment)
- Reallocate crystals into major nodes faster
- Follow a clean, efficient path through the tree

---

## Step 2: Rush to Unique Node Level 7 (First Side)

Your first goal is to unlock **Unique Node Level 7**, which gates access to the new layer of major nodes.

### How to approach this:

- Take the **shortest path possible**
- Upgrade required minor nodes to **Level 1 only**
- Skip optional nodes unless they are directly on your path

At this stage, every crystal saved matters more than minor stat gains.

---

## Step 3: Unlock and Upgrade Claw + Armor (First Pair)

Once Unique Node 7 is unlocked, you gain access to a new **Claw** and **Armor** node.

These should be your **immediate priority**.

### Upgrade strategy:

- Unlock **first armor and claw** nodes
- Push each to **Level 3**

This is one of the most efficient power spikes available:

- Claw increases **total damage dealt (%)**
- Armor reduces **total damage taken (%)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-74-1024x482.png)

**Level 3 is the efficiency sweet-spot. Massive buff but crystal cost scaling is not too heavy on progress.**

---

## Step 4: Move to the Opposite Side (Second Unique 7)

After stabilizing your first set of majors, shift focus to the other side of the tree.

Repeat the same process:

- Rush to **Unique Node Level 7**
- Keep minor nodes at **Level 1**
- Avoid unnecessary upgrades

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-77-1024x713.png)

The goal is consistency — you’re building a balanced foundation, not a lopsided tree.

---

## Step 5: Unlock and Upgrade Second Claw + Armor Pair

Once the second Unique 7 is unlocked:

- Unlock the second **Claw and Armor**
- Upgrade both to **Level 3**

At this point, you now have:

- **Two Claw nodes (Level 3)**
- **Two Armor nodes (Level 3)**

This is a major breakpoint.

Your dragon now has:

- Strong damage scaling
- Reliable damage mitigation
- A stable baseline for all content (PvP and PvE)

---

## Step 6: Unlock Unique Node Level 8 (Both Sides)

With all four major nodes active, you can now safely invest into ability progression.

- Push both sides to **Unique Node Level 8**
- This upgrades your dragon’s abilities to their final levels

Because your Claw and Armor are already established, these ability upgrades now scale properly and feel impactful.

If you rush this step earlier, the effect is much weaker.

---

## Step 7: Maximize Claw and Armor (Level 5)

Now you transition from stabilization into scaling.

Upgrade all four major nodes:

- Both **Claw nodes → Level 5**
- Both **Armor nodes → Level 5**

This is expensive, but it provides the strongest long-term return.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-78-1024x530.png)

At this stage, your dragon becomes fully competitive in Conquest environments.

---

## Step 8: Upgrade Minor Nodes (Final Optimization)

Only after your major nodes and abilities are secured should you invest heavily into minor nodes.

### Priority order:

1. **Damage type (Physical or Magical)**  - Match your march (e.g. Mage build → Magical Attack)
2. **Physical Defense and Magical Defense**  - Both are valuable in Conquest due to mixed matchups
3. **Resilience**  - Solid survivability stat, especially in longer fights

### What to skip:

- **Accuracy**

In most real scenarios, accuracy provides very little value compared to raw damage or mitigation. It only becomes relevant in niche setups, which most players won’t benefit from.

---

## Player Perspective

In practice, Conquest dragon progression is less about unlocking everything and more about **timing your power spikes**.

For instance, when I pushed my Fire Dragon into Conquest, I initially tried to rush straight to Unique 8. The result was underwhelming — my abilities improved, but my march still folded quickly because I hadn’t reinforced Armor yet.

After resetting and prioritizing Claw and Armor first, the difference was immediate. Even at level 3, the combined damage and mitigation made a bigger impact than rushing ability levels alone.

The pattern holds across builds:

- **Majors (Claw/Armor) define your baseline combat strength**
- **Unique nodes enhance it**
- **Minor nodes refine it**

If you invert that order, you’ll feel weaker despite spending the same crystals.

---

## Conclusion Summary

Conquest doesn’t change the fundamentals — it reinforces them.

- If you have crystals saved:
→ Rush **Claw + Armor → Level 3 → Unique 8 → Minor optimization**
- If you’re behind:
→ **Reset → Rebuild efficiently → Secure all Claw/Armor → Then scale**

Across both paths, the priority remains consistent:

> **Secure major node value first, unlock abilities second, optimize stats last.**

That approach keeps your dragon competitive at every stage instead of peaking too late.

---

title: How to Use the Buff & Debuff Overview in Battle Report Replays
summary: Infinity Kingdom battles are driven by a complex interaction of skills, talents, artifacts, and dragon effects. During combat, these systems constantly apply buffs, debuffs, control effects, shields, and healing. For a…
markdown:
### Player Guide: Mastering the Buff Overview Feature in Infinity Kingdom

## Introduction

Infinity Kingdom battles are driven by a complex interaction of **skills, talents, artifacts, and dragon effects**. During combat, these systems constantly apply buffs, debuffs, control effects, shields, and healing. For a long time, many of these interactions happened too quickly to fully understand.

Patch **2.6.8** introduced a practical solution: the **Buff and Debuff Overview** in the Battle Report replay. This feature allows players to pause a fight and inspect exactly which effects are active on every immortal at any moment in time.

For players who want to understand **why a battle was won or lost**, this tool is one of the most valuable additions the game has made.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-121-1024x562.png)

---

## Where to Find the Buff & Debuff Overview

### Step 1: Open a Battle Report Replay

Battle reports are generated from multiple PvP and PvE activities, including:

- Arena battles
- Open world PvP
- Throne of the Supreme fights
- Illusion Battles

Open the report and tap **Replay** to watch the fight again.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-191-1024x355.png)

---

### Step 2: Locate the Buff Overview Button

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-122.png)

During the replay, look at the **bottom-left corner of the battle screen**. You will see a **small helmet icon**. This is the **Buff & Debuff Overview button**.

Tap this icon at any time during the replay to open the detailed overview window.

**Important:** You can open the overview while the battle is running or while it is paused.

---

### Recommendations for Effective Use

- **Speed Adjustment**: Since the default 2x speed may be too fast to track buffs and debuffs accurately, it's advisable to set the replay speed to normal. This slower pace allows for a detailed observation of the combat dynamics.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-123.png)

---

## Understanding the Buff & Debuff Overview Window

### Enhanced Game Understanding

- **Real-Time Strategy Adjustment**: By observing which buffs and debuffs are affecting your immortals during battle, you can make informed decisions on the fly, adjusting your tactics based on the strengths and weaknesses revealed through the feature.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-124.png)

- **Post-Battle Analysis**: Use the feature to analyze battles post-completion, identifying key moments where certain buffs or debuffs played a pivotal role. This analysis can guide future troop compositions and strategy adjustments.

### Increased Transparency

- **Clearer Combat Dynamics**: The Buff Overview clarifies the often-complex interplay of various skills and effects in battle, helping players understand exactly why certain outcomes occur.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-192.png)

- **Educational Tool**: For newer players, this feature serves as an educational tool, helping them learn the effects of different immortals' skills and how they interact in the heat of battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-125-1024x506.png)

Consider the Fire march example using **Trajan's Rain of Fire**.

This ultimate skill:

- Grants **+30% critical damage** to allied fire units
- Each fire ultimate cast increases **critical chance by 10% for 6 seconds**
- The effect can **stack up to five times**

With the buff overview active, you can pause the battle and confirm:

- When the crit buff is applied
- How many stacks are active
- Which immortals currently benefit from the effect

This makes it much easier to verify whether your **team synergy is actually triggering correctly**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-126.png)

---

## Future Enhancements and Expectations

While the current implementation of the Buff Overview is highly beneficial, there is room for further enhancement:

- **Cause and Effect Details**: A future update could include information on the cause of each buff or debuff when selected. This addition would provide even deeper insights into the mechanics at play, particularly how specific skills affect the battlefield.

## Conclusion

The **Buff & Debuff Overview** is one of the most useful analysis tools in Infinity Kingdom.

By opening the overview during battle replays, players can:

- Identify **active buffs and debuffs in real time**
- Understand **skill timing and interactions**
- Diagnose **why battles were won or lost**
- Improve march composition and skill selection

For players who want to refine their strategy, regularly reviewing battle reports with this tool provides insights that are almost impossible to notice during live combat.

In many cases, the difference between a good march and a great one becomes clear only after carefully examining these buff interactions.

---

title: How “Trigger Probability Increase” Actually Works in Infinity Kingdom
summary: Trigger-based skills sit at the center of many Tower of Knowledge builds, particularly in magic-heavy or hybrid compositions where value is generated over time through repeated procs. On paper, increasing trigger…
markdown:
### Introduction

Trigger-based skills sit at the center of many Tower of Knowledge builds, particularly in magic-heavy or hybrid compositions where value is generated over time through repeated procs. On paper, increasing trigger probability seems like one of the most straightforward ways to improve consistency—more activations should naturally translate into more damage, more healing, or more control.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-1.png)

In practice, however, the system is not as intuitive as it appears. The way trigger probability scales, and how different sources interact with each other, introduces some hidden limitations that can significantly affect build efficiency. Many players, myself included early on, assumed these bonuses worked additively and stacked freely. That assumption leads to overinvestment in trigger scaling and, ultimately, weaker overall builds.

This guide breaks down how trigger probability increases are actually calculated, what sources affect them, and how to approach them from a practical, tested perspective.

---

### Understanding Triggered Skills vs Passive Activations

Before getting into scaling mechanics, it’s important to clearly separate two types of effects that often get grouped together by newer players.

- **Triggered Skills**: These explicitly carry the *“Triggered”* tag in their description and list a percentage chance to activate. These are the only skills affected by trigger probability increases.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-2.png)

- **Passive Chance-Based Effects**: Some skills, such as *Chase*, also display a percentage chance to activate, but they are classified as passive effects rather than triggered skills.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-3.png)

This distinction is not just semantic—it directly determines whether a skill benefits from trigger probability bonuses at all.

For example:

- *Annihilation*: Triggered skill → affected by trigger probability boosts
- *Chase*: Passive effect → not affected

In actual gameplay, this matters more than it seems at first glance. A build that looks like it has multiple “proc-based” elements may only partially benefit from trigger scaling. If you’re not checking the skill classification carefully, it’s easy to overestimate how much value you’re getting from effects like Nine Tails or Abundant Spirit.

---

### How Trigger Probability Is Actually Calculated

#### Not Additive — It’s Relative to Base Chance

One of the most common misunderstandings is assuming trigger probability increases are additive. The logic is simple and intuitive. Let's use Annihilation as an example again, Annihilation has a 45% chance to trigger its effect (damage).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-4.png)

> 45% (base) + 10% (buff) = 55%

**But this is not how the system works.**

Instead, the increase is calculated as a percentage of the **base trigger rate**, not added as a flat value. The game effectively scales the original chance rather than stacking directly on top of it.

### Formula:

> Final Chance = Base Chance × (1 + Increase %)

### Example (Annihilation):

- Base: 45%
- Increase: 10%

> 45% × 1.10 = **49.5%**

So instead of gaining a flat +10 percentage points, you gain **+4.5 percentage points**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-6-1024x347.png)

This has a few important implications:

- Higher base trigger skills **benefit more**in absolute terms
- Lower base trigger skills see relatively **small gains**

In longer fights, this difference becomes very noticeable. A skill you expected to trigger “more than half the time” still behaves closer to its original rate, which can affect both damage expectations and timing-based strategies.

---

### Sources of Trigger Probability Increase

There are currently two primary and widely used sources of trigger probability increases in the game. Both provide the same nominal value, but their interaction is where things become important.

#### 1. Nine Tails (Chaos Support Backline)

- **Passive**effect from ultimate
- Grants **+10% trigger probability** to all allied triggered skills

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-5.png)

Nine Tails is often included in builds not just for utility, but specifically for this passive scaling. Because it applies team-wide, it’s especially valuable in compositions running multiple triggered skills.

#### 2. Abundant Spirit (Tower of Knowledge Skill)

- Grants **+10% trigger probability**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image.png)

Abundant Spirit is typically considered when players want to reinforce proc consistency without dedicating a backline slot to Nine Tails. On paper, it looks like a flexible alternative—or even a stacking option.

At this stage, many players assume running both will result in a combined +20% effect. That leads directly into the next, and arguably most important, mechanic.

---

### Trigger Probability Buffs Do NOT Stack

Despite coming from completely separate systems—one being an immortal passive and the other a Tower of Knowledge skill—**trigger probability increases do not stack**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-7-1024x656.png)

The game only applies **one instance** of the effect, even if multiple sources are active.

So if you run:

- Nine Tails (+10%)
- Abundant Spirit (+10%)

You do **not** get +20%. The system will still only apply a single **+10% (relative)** increase.

This behavior is not clearly stated in-game, which is why it’s often misunderstood. It also means that combining these two sources provides no additional benefit, even though it appears like it should.

---

### Player Perspective

From a practical standpoint, this mechanic has a direct impact on build efficiency and decision-making.

When I first tested this interaction, the expectation was straightforward: stacking both sources should push high-frequency triggered skills closer to consistency thresholds where they feel reliable every rotation. In actual testing, the results didn’t match that expectation. Proc rates plateaued in a way that didn’t align with a supposed +20% increase.

After comparing results across multiple setups and confirming with other experienced players, it became clear that only one modifier was being applied. Once you understand that, the optimal approach becomes much simpler.

In real builds:

- Running **Nine Tails already covers your trigger scaling needs**
- Adding **Abundant Spirit provides no additional value**

For example, in a magic AoE setup using Annihilation:

- With Nine Tails alone: ~49.5% proc rate
- Adding Abundant Spirit: remains ~49.5%

At that point, Abundant Spirit is effectively consuming a slot without contributing anything meaningful. In most cases, that slot is better used on:

- Raw damage amplification
- Energy regeneration for faster skill cycles
- Defensive or sustain tools for longer fights

This becomes especially important in competitive environments or extended engagements, where efficiency across all skill slots determines overall performance.

---

### Conclusion Summary

- Trigger probability increases scale **off the base rate**, not as flat additions
- A 10% increase means **+10% of the base value**, not +10 percentage points
- Multiple trigger probability buffs **do not stack**
- Only one source (e.g., Nine Tails *or* Abundant Spirit) is applied
- Running both leads to inefficient use of skill slots

In practical terms, once you include a source like Nine Tails in your lineup, trigger probability is already optimized within the limits of the system. From there, your focus should shift toward effects that provide clear, additive gains rather than trying to push proc rates beyond what the mechanics actually allow.

---

title: Best Default IBL Wind Formation: Arthur, Saladin, Qin and Baldwin
markdown:
![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-145843-3ta4to.png)

## Recommended Formation

## Saladin: The Main Damage Dealer

Saladin is the primary carry. **Blade Vortex** and **Lightning Strike** give him strong immediate damage, while **Unyielding** improves his Critical Rate and provides valuable sustain.

This is also why Saladin is generally preferred over Hannibal Barca in this formation. IBL battles are often decided too quickly for Hannibal’s normal-attack scaling to reach its full potential. Saladin begins applying meaningful pressure much earlier.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-145851-3wb0f7.png)

Lightning Strike works particularly well here because Qin applies **Wound**, giving Saladin the condition he needs to produce additional damage.

## Arthur: Protecting the Carry

Arthur’s main responsibility is keeping Saladin alive long enough to do his job.

**Guard** allows Arthur to protect his more offensive frontline partner, while **Toxin Barrier** provides additional protection against the physical damage that dominates many IBL formations. **Fighting Will** adds another source of control and disruption.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-145858-py0yhp.png)

This defensive package is what allows Saladin to run such an aggressive build without immediately collapsing under frontline pressure.

## Qin Emperor: Anti-Healing and Control

Qin is one of the defining Immortals in the formation. His Ultimate applies **Wound**, preventing enemy healing while also supporting the conditions required by Lightning Strike.

His additional skills reinforce that support role:

* **Energy Suppression** slows the enemy’s access to Ultimate Skills.
* **No Escape** adds another form of control.
* **Weakness** provides a persistent aura effect throughout the battle.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-145907-00gvxc.png)

Qin is especially valuable against healing and sustain formations. Removing him changes how the entire formation functions, not merely one part of its damage.

## Baldwin IV: Defensive Support

Baldwin is not intended to be the primary carry. He contributes Magical Damage, but his more important job is supporting the formation defensively.

**Energy Shield** and **Oaken Shield** help the team survive incoming pressure, while **Misleading** interferes with enemy Accuracy and makes Dodge considerably more valuable. Accuracy and Dodge effects are particularly noticeable in IBL, where attributes are more restricted than on fully developed live accounts.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-145917-acntfr.png)

Together with Arthur’s defensive skills, Baldwin makes this formation exceptionally comfortable against physical teams.



## Situational Changes

### Against Healing Formations

Dont change a thing. You got **Qin and Lightning Strike**. Wound is essential for stopping enemy recovery and activating the intended Saladin combination.

### Against Teams With Little or No Healing

Qin can be replaced by **Matilda** for additional offensive pressure and Energy support. However, you should also replace Lightning Strike because Matilda does not provide Qin’s reliable Wound application.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-145957-ioxqje.png)

Use a direct damage skill that does not depend on the enemy carrying a specific debuff.

### Against Physical-Damage Teams

The default formation is already heavily prepared for this matchup. Keep Arthur, Baldwin, Toxin Barrier, Oaken Shield and the rest of the defensive package intact.

### Against Magic-Heavy Teams

Consider using the **Wind Dragon** and replacing Baldwin with **Cleopatra**. Baldwin’s support skills can be transferred to Cleopatra, creating a variation designed to reduce Magical Damage rather than physical pressure.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-150043-ni192g.png)

The purpose of this change is survival, not increasing the formation’s damage.

### Against High-Dodge Teams

Accuracy becomes much more important. If repeated misses are costing you battles, introduce **Coercion** or another anti-Dodge option rather than blindly adding more damage.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-150056-mhihko.png)

## Fire Dragon or Wind Dragon?

Both dragons work extremely well, and the difference is closer than it may initially appear.

The **Fire Dragon** is the more aggressive choice. Its early burst complements Saladin and can decide shorter battles before the opponent establishes healing, control or defensive momentum. Despite breaking the full Wind theme, the additional opening damage can easily justify its inclusion.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-150112-zu9n4g.png)

The **Wind Dragon** offers a more balanced approach. Its Accuracy reduction, True Damage and additional sustain improve consistency, while all four Immortals still benefit from being Wind. The healing portion can lose value against Qin and other anti-healing effects, but the remaining benefits remain powerful.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261003-150136-x006fz.png)

As a general rule:

* Choose **Fire** when you want maximum early pressure.
* Choose **Wind** when you value consistency, True Damage and Accuracy disruption.

## What Counters This Formation?

This setup is especially strong against physical opponents, but magic-heavy formations and teams capable of surviving its initial pressure can create problems. No formation is universally best, and relying on only one march will eventually leave you exposed.

The strongest IBL preparation therefore resembles **rock-paper-scissors**: maintain three functional setups, understand which matchup each one is intended to fight and switch according to your opponent. This Wind formation is an excellent default—but it should be the foundation of your options, not your only option.

title: Hunting Feast Token Cost Efficiency (2026 mini event)
summary: The Hunting Feast is arguably the most economically important system inside the May 2026 Hunting Festival. While the event contains large amounts of Soul Crystal Chests, Philosopher’s Offer Chests, speedups, and…
markdown:
## Introduction

The Hunting Feast is arguably the most economically important system inside the May 2026 Hunting Festival. While the event contains large amounts of Soul Crystal Chests, Philosopher’s Offer Chests, speedups, and insignia rewards, the real question for most experienced players is much simpler:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-84.png)

> Is buying Meat for Hunting Feast more cost efficient than directly purchasing Tokens of Light?

This guide focuses specifically on that comparison.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-85.png)

Rather than looking at the event emotionally or from a completionist perspective, we will break the system down mathematically by comparing:

- Meat cost per Feast level
- Token rewards per level
- Dollar cost per Token
- Direct Token purchase efficiency through Gtarcade bundles

An important detail is that Hunting Feast is fundamentally a 2-player cooperative event. If both players contribute equally, both players receive the full rewards while effectively sharing the progression burden. That cooperative structure is one of the reasons the event can become surprisingly efficient.

The goal of this guide is therefore not simply to say whether Hunting Feast is “good” or “bad,” but instead to determine exactly where the event outperforms direct Token purchases and where the value begins falling off.

---

## Meat Pricing and Hunting Feast Level Costs

To evaluate Hunting Feast properly, we first need a consistent Meat-per-dollar benchmark.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-87.png)

Using the efficient recurring Gtarcade bundles available during the event, the daily Meat shop looks like this:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-88.png)

This establishes the core benchmark used throughout the guide: **24 Meat per Dollar**

Or:

- 1 Meat ≈ $0.0417
- 10 Meat ≈ $0.42
- 100 Meat ≈ $4.17

The Hunting Feast itself scales upward every few levels. Levels become increasingly expensive as progression continues, while Token rewards rise much more slowly.

The event follows this structure:

- Completing levels 1, 2, 3, and 4 costs 2000 points total, meaning 500 points or 5 Meat per level.
- Completing levels 5, 6, and 7 costs 1000 points each, or 10 Meat per level.
- Completing levels 8, 9, and 10 costs 2000 points each, or 20 Meat per level.
- Completing levels 11, 12, and 13 costs 3000 points each, or 30 Meat per level.
- Completing levels 14, 15, and 16 costs 4000 points each, or 40 Meat per level.
- This pattern continues upward, increasing by 1000 points, or 10 Meat, every three completed levels.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-86-1024x461.png)

This distinction matters because the reward bands and cost bands do not always line up neatly. Token rewards increase every 10 levels, while Meat costs increase every 3 levels.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-89.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-90.png)

The early levels are extremely efficient, then the value settles into a repeating pattern where the first few levels after each Token increase are stronger, and the last levels before the next Token increase are weaker.

This is why levels such as 11, 21, 31, 51, 61, 71, 81, and 91 look better than the levels immediately before them. The Token reward has just increased, while the Meat cost has not yet fully caught up.

---

## Direct Token Purchase Pricing

To compare Hunting Feast fairly, we also need to establish the efficiency of buying Tokens directly.

To avoid distortions from inefficient whale bundles, we only use the most efficient lower-tier Gtarcade Token packs:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-91.png)

This gives us the baseline direct-purchase value:

## Direct Token Purchase Efficiency

- 1.46 Tokens per Dollar
- **$0.685 per Token**

This number becomes the benchmark Hunting Feast must beat.

If Hunting Feast provides Tokens below $0.685 each, then the event is mathematically more efficient than buying Tokens directly.

---

## Comparing Hunting Feast Versus Direct Token Buying

Now, at this stage it will be obvious for everyone that if you do indeed have a friend who contributes to the event, Hunting Feast surpasses direct token purchasing by MILES! And as we shall see just below, we are actually getting superior value even doing this even solo (while also boosting someone else!). Amazing!

Once we compare the numbers directly, the early and middle Hunting Feast levels clearly outperform standard Token purchases - and that is even not counting any of the other rewards like the thousands of philosopher stones and million or two in Soul Crystals you will be getting in addition.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-92.png)

The most important conclusion is that Hunting Feast remains more efficient than direct Token buying for a surprisingly large portion of the event.

Even many of the later levels remain mathematically competitive despite the rising Meat costs.

For developing accounts, the Soul Crystal Chests and Philosopher’s Offer Chests massively increase the overall value.

For long-term whales, however, many of those resources are already heavily stockpiled after several abundance-style events. In that situation, the event becomes much more of a pure Token-per-dollar calculation.

Another major factor is free Meat generation. Players also earn Meat through:

- Ingredient Hunt
- Glorious Challenge
- Pinnacle Trial
- Daily event participation

That free Meat significantly improves the effective efficiency of Hunting Feast in practice since you are doing this event together with someone else. Even doing this event as a spender looking to complete all 100 levels with a free-to-play player, your real dollars spent per level across the 100 levels will be lower than above, since you will be getting some "free" meat from your friend. That it NOT included in the above meaning that as the event already favors token purchasing via Meat over Directly, the participation of a friend in the event will make it much much more efficient.

---

## Additional Rewards and Final Verdict

While this guide primarily focuses on Token efficiency, Hunting Feast also generates enormous secondary value through:

- Philosopher’s Offer Chests
- Soul Crystal Chests
- Speedups
- Festival Insignias

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-93-1024x461.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-94-1024x461.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-95-1024x461.png)

For mid-game accounts especially, these rewards dramatically increase the event’s real progression value beyond what the Token calculations alone suggest.

This is why many active players consider Hunting Feast one of the strongest seasonal spending systems Infinity Kingdom has introduced recently.

The early and middle levels are particularly efficient because they combine:

- Excellent Token-per-dollar value
- Valuable secondary rewards
- Cooperative progression advantages
- Large amounts of free supplemental Meat

The event only begins losing efficiency near the extreme late levels where Meat scaling starts outpacing Token growth.

Even then, the event may still remain worth pushing for players who:

- Need abundance resources
- Want the insignia
- Care about collection completion
- Have a strong cooperative partner
- Generate large amounts of free Meat

## Final Takeaway

Compared purely as a Token conversion system, Hunting Feast is significantly more efficient than direct Token purchases throughout most of the event.

The strongest value sits in the early and middle progression tiers, where Token costs are substantially lower than standard shop pricing.

For coordinated 2-player teams, especially active mid-game accounts, Hunting Feast is arguably one of the best spending opportunities available during the entire Hunting Festival.

The Hunting Feast is one of the most strategically interesting seasonal systems Infinity Kingdom has introduced recently because its value depends heavily on coordination and account progression.

For developing accounts, the event is extraordinarily strong due to the combined value of:

- Tokens of Light
- Soul Crystals
- Philosopher’s Stones
- Speedups
- Free Meat generation

And if your alliance coordinates properly, the efficiency improves dramatically beyond what the raw numbers initially suggest.

---

title: Hunting Festival 2022
summary: You want to sharped your arrows and polish your scopes this time around because the hunting festival has INSANE rewards in 2022!
markdown:
## Why should I care?

You want to sharped your arrows and polish your scopes this time around because the hunting festival has INSANE rewards in 2022!

We got all the same rewards as last year, decent castle skin (and the best looking skin imo). Loads of philosopher stones, utility items, rss', frame, textbox and much more. But what we have never seen before is the availability of **unique** **artifact schematics for uniques which are otherwise reserved as Triss Pay to Play schematics!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-25-1024x403.png)

Uniques include:

1. Celestial's Blade, Unique artifact for **Attila the Hun**.
2. Homer's Epic, Unique artifact for **Alexander the Great**.
3. The Song of the Cid, Unique artifact for **El Cid**.
4. Wings of War, Unique artifact for **Saladin**.

This is huge and you want to make sure you spend the gems required to max the **Legendary Hunter**challenge by day 5 end.

## How does it work?

The Hunting Festival 2022 will begin on **May 13th and last until May 18th** (available for servers that have been open for more than 7 days; the event will last for the first 5 days, and the sixth day is the settlement day in which you can continue to claim rewards). Let's check out the event details together!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-19-1024x511.png)

*There are a few major tabs u need to beware of:*

1. **Call of the Wild:** obtain rewards by logging into the game each day.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-20-1024x536.png)

2. **Hunting Festival Adventure**: you have a chance to obtain Chests when you defeat Gnome armies or Bosses during the event. Each Chest contains materials for making arrows (**Unyielding Wood or Falcon Feathers**)!

These are important because you need a lot of arrows to complete the **Legendary Hunter challenge of the festival.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-21-1024x660.png)

3. **Tribal Warrior:** complete daily tasks to obtain Mithril Arrow materials (Unyielding Wood and Falcon Feathers) and points. Once your task completion progress reaches certain points, you can get a progress chest that contains Lustrium Arrows.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-22-1024x595.png)

4. **Forging Master**: obtain Unyielding Wood and Falcon Feathers to craft Mithril Arrows, or use Gems to craft Lustrium Arrows. Arrows can be used to win fantastic rewards in Legendary Hunter!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-23-1024x575.png)

5. **Legendary Hunter**: during the Hunting Festival, use arrows to knock down wooden cards. Each time you knock down a beast card, you'll unlock the corresponding reward. Arrows can be crafted in the Forging Master event. There are three reward tiers in total. Rewards include exclusive Hunting Festival decorations and more!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-24-1024x588.png)

2. **Hunting Festival Adventure**: you have a chance to obtain Chests when you defeat Gnome armies or Bosses during the event. Each Chest contains materials for making arrows (**Unyielding Wood or Falcon Feathers**)!

These are important because you need a lot of arrows to complete the **Legendary Hunter challenge of the festival.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-21-1024x660.png)

3. **Forging Master**: obtain Unyielding Wood and Falcon Feathers to craft Mithril Arrows, or use Gems to craft Lustrium Arrows. Arrows can be used to win fantastic rewards in Legendary Hunter!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-23-1024x575.png)

4. **Legendary Hunter**: during the Hunting Festival, use arrows to knock down wooden cards. Each time you knock down a beast card, you'll unlock the corresponding reward. Arrows can be crafted in the Forging Master event. There are three reward tiers in total. Rewards include exclusive Hunting Festival decorations and more!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image-24-1024x588.png)

For detailed information on maxing Legendary hunter, please see my article: **[Legendary Hunter costs](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/spring-fiesta/hunting-festival/cost-of-maxing-legendary-hunter-with-gems/)**

markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom: Hunting Festival 2024 Player Guide

The Hunting Festival 2024 is in full swing, bringing the usual seasonal event tabs with a mix of old and new rewards. In this guide, we’ll take a deep dive into each of the event tabs, compare the rewards to last year’s event, and provide insights on how to navigate the event efficiently.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-85-1024x538.png)

## Event Overview

### Tab 1: Tribal Warrior

The Tribal Warrior tab features the familiar daily quests. Each day, three new quest chains unlock, rewarding you with event currency, gems, and other side rewards. Completing these daily quests earns you Event Points that count towards the five main event chests. Each chest contains Gem-Arrows and Stardust.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-86-1024x521.png)

Unfortunately, unlike last year, there are no chaos fragments available this year. In 2023, players received Loki fragments for completing these quests. This year, the focus is solely on Stardust and arrows.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-92.png)

### Tab 2: Hunting Festival Adventure

The Hunting Festival Adventure tab encourages players to engage in regular gameplay activities such as farming resources and raiding gnomes. Completing these tasks earns you the materials needed to craft free-to-play arrows, which are essential for progressing in the Legendary Hunter tab.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-87-1024x422.png)

### Tab 3: Legendary Hunter

In the Legendary Hunter tab, you use your arrows to hunt and progress through 40 levels on the event bar. The rewards in the free tier are minimal unless you reach level 40, where you can obtain a Unique Artifact. For spenders, there are valuable rewards including Epic Immortal Fragments, Stardust, and a few Crimson Moonlight items. The final reward at level 40 for spenders is 60 fragments for a holy or shadow immortal of your choice, which is quite appealing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-89-1024x354.png)

However, this year’s event has a significant change compared to last year. The development team removed the HP cap on levels. Last year, the animals’ HP capped at 550 from level 17 to level 40, making the event challenging but doable with gem-arrows. This year, the HP increases continuously without capping. For instance, at level 27, the HP is 1050, and it increases by 50 HP with each subsequent level. **This results in a need for an exorbitant amount of gems to complete the event, making it less rewarding and less feasible to progress without heavy spending.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-88-1024x508.png)

Overall, I cannot recommend spending the gems to progress through this event for anyone. You can get far more value out of your gems in almost every other activity and event in the game.

## Strategy and Recommendations

### Tribal Warrior Quests

- **Complete Daily Quests**: Make sure to complete the daily quests to earn Event Points and progress towards the main event chests.
- **Focus on Gem-Arrows and Stardust**: These are the primary rewards this year, so aim to maximize your gains from these chests.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-90.png)

### Hunting Festival Adventure

- **Engage in Regular Activities**: Continue farming resources and raiding gnomes to collect the materials needed for crafting arrows.
- **Efficient Farming**: If you are going to be raiding gnomes for equipment and gems anyway, it is a good time to do so now, as you gain the arrow materials you will need for the hunting festival's Legendary Hunter event tab. Get whatever you can from the free arrows and disregard the rest of the Legendary Hunter. It is not worth the gems this year.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-91-1024x542.png)

### Legendary Hunter

- **Maximize Free-to-Play Rewards**: Given the high gem cost for progressing, focus on achieving as much as possible with the free-to-play resources.
- **Avoid Heavy Spending**: Due to the removal of the HP cap, progressing through the event is significantly more costly. It is advisable to avoid spending large amounts of gems unless you are prepared for the high expenditure.
- **Assess Value**: If you are considering spending, weigh the value of the rewards against the cost. The final spender rewards are attractive but ensure they align with your goals and resources.

**[Read more about completing the Legendary Hunter event here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/spring-fiesta/hunting-festival/cost-of-maxing-2024/)**

## Conclusion

The Hunting Festival 2024 offers a mix of rewards, but changes in the event mechanics, particularly the removal of the HP cap, have made it more challenging for players to progress without heavy spending. Focus on maximizing the free-to-play rewards and carefully consider any expenditure in the Legendary Hunter tab. While the event may not be as rewarding as last year’s, strategic play can still yield valuable rewards.

We hope this guide helps you navigate the Hunting Festival 2024 efficiently. Happy hunting, and may your arrows fly true!

***Early sneak peak at the coming event!***

The upcoming **Hunting Festival 2025** is set to introduce a brand-new seasonal event format to *Infinity Kingdom*, reworking the way players engage with limited-time content. While the event isn’t live yet, early access and test server footage have given us a detailed preview of what to expect. Here’s a comprehensive guide to help you prepare.

    https://youtu.be/gLvLTzCGE-o

**Check out the video and see for yourself! In the below you will find my comments and take on this new event format. Note that this is not a released event and as such everything is subject to possible changes before it launches.**

## 🌿 Event Dates

### May 14 to May 23, 2025

## 🌟 Overview: What is the Hunting Festival?

The Hunting Festival revamps the seasonal event format by introducing:

- A **Battle Pass**-style progression system
- A new hunting mechanic tied to **Resonance Crystals**
- Chaos and Holy/Shadow rewards depending on your server season
- **Point-based milestone rewards**
- **Ranking-based competitive rewards**

This event structure is similar in overall flow to previous seasonal formats like the Original Festival and Radiant Festival, but introduces higher-stakes rewards and more engagement opportunities.

---

## 🔹 Battle Pass System

The Battle Pass contains **30 levels** of rewards split into:

- **Free tier**: 1 Resonance Crystal per level
- **Paid tier**: 5 Resonance Crystals per level

Unlocking the paid tier also grants more valuable rewards, including additional draw opportunities and milestone rewards.

### Key Paid Tier Rewards:

- **Resonance Crystals** (5 per level)
- **Ability Stone Selection Chests**
- **Chaos Artifact Selection Chests** (for Chaos servers)
- **Holy/Shadow Artifact Selection Chests** (for early servers)
- **Cao Cao Fragments & Unique Artifact**

---

## 🛡️ The Hunt Mechanic

Using Resonance Crystals, players can **"hunt"** to obtain rewards:

- **Chaos Servers**:  - Chaos Unique Artifact Selection Chest
- Random Chaos Immortal Fragments
- Jackpot: 80 Chaos Immortal Selection Fragments
- **Non-Chaos Servers (Season 1)**:  - Holy/Shadow Artifact Selection Chests
- Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments

Crystals can be bought in the in-game shop and also via the event shop - also reward from Pinnacle Trials, daily login and battle pass system.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-35-1024x526.png)

Each hunt also earns **Hunting Points**, which contribute to milestone rewards and leaderboard ranking.

## 🔹 Pinnacle Trials as usual

The Pinnacle Trials continues with this new version of seasonal events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-34.png)

---

## 🎉 Milestone Rewards

As you accumulate **Hunting Points**, you unlock reward thresholds that contain:

- Chaos (or Holy/Shadow) Immortal Fragments
- Selection Chests
- Random Fragments
- Stardust

You don't need to reach the final level to earn good rewards—even moderate participation yields excellent value. However, the best rewards (including Chaos Selection Fragments) will likely require completing the Battle Pass and purchasing extra Resonance Crystals.

---

## 🥇 Server Rankings & Competitive Rewards

This Hunting Festival introduces a **server-wide ranking system** based on player performance.

### Ranking Rewards Include:

- **Stardust**
- **Random Immortal Fragments**
- **Ability Stone Selection Chests** (contains top-tier skills like Corrosive Power, No Escape, Ambush, and possibly more)

High-ranking players will walk away with **significant**reward bonuses, making this event very appealing to mid- to high-level spenders.

---

## 📊 Strategy Tips

- **Prioritize unlocking the paid Battle Pass** for 5x hunting power per level
- **Hoard Gems** now if you plan to purchase extra Resonance Crystals
- If on a **Chaos server**, focus on drawing Chaos Selection Fragments and Unique Artifacts
- If on a **Season 1 server**, take advantage of Holy/Shadow gear and fragments to prepare for Conquest
- **Top up hunting milestones** to reach valuable rewards like Ability Stone Selection Chests
- **Watch the rankings** and time your spending to secure a leaderboard spot

---

## 🔎 Final Thoughts

The **Hunting Festival 2025** is shaping up to be one of the **most rewarding events to date**, with high-value items like Chaos Artifacts, Ability Stones, and massive quantities of Stardust and Immortal Fragments up for grabs. Whether you're a spender looking for top-tier PvP power or a strategic free-to-play player aiming to optimize progression, this event has something for everyone.

Stay tuned for the live launch on **May 14**, and make sure to plan your spending and daily logins to maximize your rewards!

title: Hunting Festival 2025 (live) Complete overview and strategy for reward maximization
summary: The long-anticipated Hunting Festival 2025 has officially launched in Infinity Kingdom, introducing a brand-new event structure. Following our earlier sneak peek guide, we now have full access to all features of the…
markdown:
### Hunting Festival 2025: Full Event Guide

The long-anticipated **Hunting Festival 2025** has officially launched in *Infinity Kingdom*, introducing a brand-new event structure. Following our earlier **sneak peek guide**, we now have full access to all features of the event, and there is plenty to unpack. With an innovative hunting mechanic, new currency systems, ranking competitions, and a unique cosmetic reward system, the event is an ambitious upgrade from previous formats—but not without its controversies.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-46-1024x576.png)

---

### Sign-In Rewards

This time, the daily login rewards consist exclusively of the new event currency: **Resonance Crystals**. Players receive **2 crystals per day**, amounting to a total of **20 free crystals** over 10 days. These are used in the core hunting mechanic described below.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-47-1024x403.png)

---

### Hunting Season Battle Pass

The battle pass features **30 levels** and is split into a **free** and a **paid** track:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-48-1024x483.png)

- **Free Track:** Awards only Resonance Crystals, with a total of **60 free crystals**.
- **Premium Track:** Priced at **$50**, it includes:  - One **random full Holy/Shadow Immortal**
- **145 Resonance Crystals**
- A large amount of **Gems**
- The all-new **territory skin: Corridor of Ghost Flame**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-49-1024x427.png)

The skin provides a **2% Troop HP buff** and a **cosmetic sprite transformation**, comparable to the Fourth Anniversary skin. Players need **160 EXP per level** to reach the top, with a daily cap of **700 EXP**, totaling **7000 EXP** over the event. This means a degree of flexibility: you can skip a few days and still finish the pass.

---

### Glorious Challenge

This PvE component has players fight gnome formations in two difficulty tiers:

- **Normal Mode** is available from day one.
- **Hard Mode** unlocks on **day three**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-50-1024x546.png)

You get **five challenge tickets per day**, and clearing each stage for the first time gives **Souvenir Coins** and **Gems**. Once cleared, you can raid levels for extra coins.

> **Tip:** Always push your highest possible stage! Failing a stage does **not** consume tickets.

### ⚠️ Glorious Challenge Tickets – Spend Smart!

During the Hunting Festival event, players can **purchase Glorious Challenge tickets** in the Celebration Shop using **gems**. However, it's crucial to be strategic with these purchases!

These tickets are **not permanent**—they **expire the same day** you buy them. If you purchase and use them before **Hard Mode** is unlocked (on **May 17**), you’ll be forced to spend them on **Normal Mode**, which yields **significantly fewer rewards**.

To maximize your returns:

- **Wait until May 17** when Hard Mode becomes available.
- **Then** purchase and use all your gem-bought tickets on Hard Mode stages for the **best value** in **Souvenir Coins** and **event progression**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-53.png)

Patience here pays off—don’t waste your gems early!

---

### Pinnacle Trial

This is a more advanced version of Glorious Challenge, featuring PvE battles against Immortals with challenging passive skill combinations. You receive **one ticket per day** and can earn up to **30 Resonance Crystals** through first clears. Rewards also include random Immortal Fragments and more Souvenir Coins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-51-1024x531.png)

---

### Celebration Shop

This event-exclusive shop lets you trade **Souvenir Coins** for a wide range of items:

- **New avatar and chat frames**
- **Glorious Challenge tickets** (limited; wait for Hard Mode)
- **Up to 90 Resonance Crystals** (for 18,000 coins)

While it's tempting to spend early, we advise waiting until Hard Mode opens for better coin efficiency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-52-1024x544.png)

### 🎯 Best Items to Prioritize in the Celebration Shop

For players looking to make the most of their **Souvenir Coins**, I highly recommend **securing both of the full Unique Artifact Selection Chests** as well as the **500 Stardust**. These offer the best long-term value and progression impact.

Once you’ve claimed those key rewards, your best bet is to spend any leftover currency on:

- **Resonance Crystals** (for more chances in the Hunt)
- The **4x 1-Hour Speedup Chests**, which provide solid efficiency for daily development

Stick to these priorities to get the most value from the event!

---

### The Hunt Mechanic

The central feature of the Hunting Festival is the **Treasure Hunt**. Using **Resonance Crystals**, you can perform hunts for a chance at top-tier rewards:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-54-1024x558.png)

- On **Conquest Servers**, these include:  - **Chaos Immortal selection chests**
- **Random Chaos Immortal Fragments**
- **Grand Prize: 80 Chaos Selection Fragments**
- On **Non-Chaos Servers**, rewards are instead:  - **Holy/Shadow Immortal selections**

The **prize pool is shared across all servers**, meaning competition for Grand Prizes is intense and refreshes every **two hours** or when all Grand Prizes are claimed.

---

### Rankings and Milestone Rewards

Each Crystal spent = **1 point**. There are **two ranking systems**:

- **Daily Rankings:**  - Top prize: **Ability Stone Selection Chest** (skills like *Corrosive Power*, *Ambush*, *No Escape and Guard, Purification* and more in season servers where later skills are yet to be unlocked *)
- Runners-up: **Unique Artifact Selection Chests**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-55-1024x539.png)

- **Total Event Rankings:**  - Top rewards: **Exclusive Event Frame**, **Gold Dust**, **Random Fragments**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-56-1024x554.png)

Additionally, there are **Milestone Rewards** based on accumulated points, granting Random Chaos (or Holy/Shadow) Fragments.

> **Note for F2P:** You can aim to enter the top 1000 daily or bank your Crystals for a late-event push at the daily leaderboard.

**Strategic Hunting:** Do not hunt whenever you obtain Crystals. Instead make sure you bank enough to obtain a ranking in the daily rankings that you are satisfied with and try to snipe a ranking by noticing days where rankings are lesser than others. E.g. I expect daily rankings on the 17th where hard mode is unlocked and thus event shop coins explode to be much higher than others.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-57-1024x518.png)

---

### In-Game Shop Bundles

Bundles range from **$3 to $100**, offering different value:

- **$3 and $5 bundles**: Best return with **~3 Crystals per $1**.
- **$50 Bundle**: Includes **Crystals**, **Philosopher Stones**, and an **exclusive Avatar Frame**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-58-1024x559.png)

Total spenders can collect hundreds of Crystals and dominate the event’s Hunt and Rankings.

---

### Summary & Final Thoughts

The **Hunting Festival 2025** is a reimagined event format with a fresh approach to PvE challenges, cosmetic rewards, and battle pass progression. However, the **shared prize pool** system and **emphasis on spending** make it difficult for free-to-play or light spenders to compete for top-tier prizes.

Still, everyone can earn decent rewards through milestone progression, PvE stages, and by planning Crystal spending wisely. The new **Corridor of Ghost Flame** skin and **Battle Pass structure** represent a meaningful evolution of seasonal content in Infinity Kingdom.

Our recommendation:

- **F2P/Low Spenders:** Focus on completing PvE stages and accumulating Crystals to make a focused push on the **daily leaderboard**.
- **Moderate Spenders:** The **$50 Battle Pass** provides solid return with Crystals, cosmetic skins, and value rewards.
- **Whales:** Compete in rankings for Ability Stones and the Grand Prize jackpot in the Hunt.

Happy hunting, Lords! May your Crystals bring you glory—and Chaos.
