2. **[Alliance challenges and methods for AP efficient alliance ranking](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/infernal-assault/alliance-challenge/)**

title: Infernal Event Gold Farming
summary: The calendar event Infernal Assault can for some players be the single best method of obtaining gold. It is not as easy or cheap to come by as in the Mysterium and with simple Dwelling production, but it can yield…
markdown:
The calendar event Infernal Assault can for some players be the single best method of obtaining gold. It is not as easy or cheap to come by as in the Mysterium and with simple Dwelling production, but it can yield insane amounts of gold for players who have the time, AP and troops to farm it for the three-day period the event lasts. The event is a recurring event that comes around every month or so.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-69.png)

During a single event I was able to farm 1 billion gold recently, a quite massive pile of much needed gold for my development and growth. There are a few different ways of farming gold in the Infernal event. Here is what I do.

### Farming lower levels with minimal losses

It is important to understand how to keep low troop losses when fighting Infernal Gnome camps. The camps work by having multiple gnome armies occupied in each camp, which you will need to defeat in order to earn the gold reward. Please make note that the gnome armies all have an airship. This is critically important, because when you are farming at a much lower level than your own strength, it is the continued airship damage that cause the most troop losses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Skaermbillede-2023-09-07-204946-1024x593.png)

However, you can avoid taking ANY losses from the airships by killing the entire gnome army before the airship begin to drop bombs on you. This is around 15-16 seconds into the fight. What this means is that you want to setup a march that deals a ton of frontloaded damage, meaning high DPS from the first second of the fight.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Skaermbillede-2023-09-07-204629-1024x614.png)

Having slow ramp-up damage dealers like Manco means that the enemy gets to live past second 15. That is not good.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Skaermbillede-2023-09-07-204946-1-1024x593.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Skaermbillede-2023-09-07-205005-1-1024x585.png)

Instead, you can wield a powerful damage speced Earth-Wind Hybrid and/or Fire team which ensures high DPS right out of the gates. When I farm with my marches, I have found that levels 34-36 are the sweet spot for me. Here I can maintain very loss losses because I can kill the gnomes quickly with both my Hybrid and my Fire team. I tried using my holy (which in PvP is stronger than my Fire team) but it resulted in crazy high losses, again because of the ramp-up mechanics of Holy.

So what you want to do using this method is to make sure your team is set up for high damage from the very first second of the fight. However, there are pros and cons to everything in Infinity Kingdom. While the pros here is that you are not going to run out of troops easily, the drawbacks are that you will therefore also need a lot of time and a lot of AP in order to farm for hours and hours on end.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Skaermbillede-2023-09-07-204605-1024x568.png)

When you are using this method, you need to find your sweetspot. I for instance, have much higher losses on a level 32 than on a 36, simply because of the gnome army compositions that I am up against. Test out where your sweet spot is but do not fret if you take a massive loss around the 30-33 level stage. Most players are not able to kill these as easily as the higher levels 34-36.

Personal note: Before I was powerful enough to farm 34-36’s I was farming level 28 for a long time. Seemed to be my natural sweet spot. My journey has been farming 28s for a loong time and then farming 34 and 36s. Never anything in between for my setups.

### Level progression

Level progression earns you a ton of gold because we are rewarded a big additional gold reward the first time we clear a new level of gnome camp. As such, players are encouraged to climb to the highest levels possible. However, this is extremely troop intensive, as you will easily take 4-6K troop losses on a single camp when you fight to increase your level. Furthermore, the Core in the middle of the Infernal spawn is a lot tougher than the outer camps and once you climb up there (for me around 40+) they begin to drain both troops and AP having to send many attacks to kill a single core.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-8.png)

The downside of this method is obvious. You need a lot of troops to sustain, however you do not need a lot of AP as you will run out of troops way before you ever get AP drained. The gold rewards can be quite good so it is not something you should discard, but I personally do not recommend trying to climb alone.

### Getting boost from stronger players

The last part leads nicely into the last method of obtaining gold via the Infernal event: Getting boosted.

Like in all most other games, there are big differences to the combat prowess of different players. Some are a lot stronger than others which gives them the ability to help out their fellow players. This very important to the growth of you or your alliance. For big players helping out smaller players complete their camps and progress can be very cheap on troops and easy to do. It will get them decent gold rewards because they are in essence farming, but it also massively rewards the player getting boosted who can now progress to new levels without having to take on massive losses. This is because of a mechanic that few people realize.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-9-1024x431.png)

Basically, the Infernal event allows for parties of varying sizes depending on the level. Let’s just say that we have a big 500k whale and a bunch of smaller 350-400k players in the same alliance. They all need gold, but they cannot all do the same levels of Infernals easily. You simply have the smaller players either help as much as they can or just sending a single attack at one of the Infernal camps, after which the big player clears all camps with low losses earning EVERYONE who have participated in the combat (meaning anyone who has attacked a gnome camp) the gold rewards for camp kills.

**[Check out the video on my YouTube channel if you want to see this in action.](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvLOQ4Wc5EaIvGLQMgbJEsA)**

Lastly, yes. This can be done with 0 losses for small players. Many bigger players often farm Infernals alone of in small groups, this should not happen however. It is inefficient and a wasted growth potential for your alliance. Instead, what you want to do is have small players join the group and send a 1-troop march at a camp. This combat will be lost with no losses, but it still counts as participation. Hence, when the whale then clears all the camps, the small player who didn’t kill anything but just sent a 1-troop march at some random camp also gets the full clear rewards from the camps killed by the bigger player.

**In essence, this is free gold for your friends and something that ALL alliances should make use of to ensure the full growth reward for the collective alliance.**

title: Infinite Firepower and synergy options (written in 2.9.2)
summary: Among legendary magic skills in Infinity Kingdom, Infinite Firepower (IF) sits at the very top when it comes to raw, repeatable magical damage. I’ve tested it across multiple seasons, in both structured KvK wars and…
markdown:
## Introduction: Infinite Firepower – Complete Skill Guide

Among legendary magic skills in *Infinity Kingdom*, **Infinite Firepower** (IF) sits at the very top when it comes to raw, repeatable magical damage. I’ve tested it across multiple seasons, in both structured KvK wars and standard PvP ladder, and it consistently performs at a level that rivals full ultimate rotations.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-106-1024x573.png)

What makes the skill exceptional is not just the damage number. It combines:

- High AoE damage
- High trigger frequency
- Built-in Energy regeneration

That combination opens up two distinct build paths:

1. A **cost-efficient chase build** for mid-level spenders (beware IF itself it NOT cheap)
2. A **high-investment hyper-regen ultimate build** for players leaning into maximum magical burst.

Below is a structured breakdown of why the skill works and how to build around it properly.

---

## Skill Overview

**Skill Details**: After the battle starts, there's a 60% chance to deal magical damage to all enemies every 3s (damage rate 350%) and increases own Energy Regen Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-107.png)

### What This Means in Practice

- **350% damage rate AoE**
- **60% trigger chance**
- **Triggers every 3 seconds**
- **+20% Energy Regen Speed for 3 seconds**

In real combat, you’re effectively rolling a 60% chance for a 350% AoE hit every 3 seconds. Over a full fight, that adds up extremely quickly.

In many of my test logs, Infinite Firepower alone has matched or exceeded the total output of some weaker ultimate skills. That’s before you even start building synergy around it.

---

## Why Infinite Firepower Is So Strong

### 1. Damage Frequency

The key factor is frequency.

A 350% AoE hit is already strong. But attaching that to a 3-second cycle with a 60% trigger rate creates consistent pressure. It’s not a one-time spike. It’s sustained magical bombardment.

This frequency also makes it ideal as a **Chase trigger platform**, which we’ll cover below.

### 2. Built-In Energy Regen

The +20% Energy Regen Speed for 3 seconds often gets overlooked.

But because the trigger interval is also 3 seconds, you frequently refresh the regen window. In longer fights, this results in noticeably faster ultimate cycling — especially in energy-optimized setups.

When I tested it on a fully optimized mage lineup, ultimate uptime became dramatically smoother compared to builds without regen stacking.

---

## Build Path 1: Budget Chase Fire Build

This is the efficient route for mid-level spenders who can afford one legendary but not multiple.

### Core Synergy

- Infinite Firepower
- Abundant Spirit / Fighting Master
- Chase

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-110.png)

### Why This Works:

### Chase

Because Infinite Firepower hits all enemies at high frequency, it becomes an excellent Chase enabler. Every crit becomes another opportunity for extra follow-up damage.

In fire-based mage setups, this interaction scales very well with crit-focused immortal builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-114.png)

What I’ve noticed in real fights is that once crit scaling reaches a comfortable threshold, the damage curve becomes very unstable for the enemy. You get burst chains that can wipe backlines before ultimate rotations even fully stabilize.

### Abundant Spirit

- Increases skill trigger chance
- Boosts crit-based synergy

With Abundant Spirit, Infinite Firepower’s trigger chance rises from **60% to 70%**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-111.png)

That 10% increase matters more than it looks on paper because of the 3-second cycle. Over a full battle, the expected number of procs increases significantly.

Additionally:

- Crit chance improves.
- Chase trigger chance on crit increases (30% → 40%).

This creates layered probability stacking. However, you need to **beware that this is only possible if you have Fu Fei as support. If not, you need to use this slot for Fighting Master**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-115.png)

However, if you are able to build out Fu Fei, you can ramp up the heat with Abundant!

### Why This Is the “Cheap” Version

- Abundant Spirit can be earned through KvK progression.
- Chase is a very accessible early skill.
- Only one legendary investment required.

For players committing to one premium magic skill, this is the most efficient synergy route.

---

## Build Path 2: Hyper-Regeneration Ultimate Build (High Investment)

This is the expensive version and I will simply assume you have Fu Fei if this is relevant to you.

### Core Synergy

- Infinite Firepower
- Energy Mastery
- Corrosive Power

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-109.png)

All legendary. All high cost.

### Why This Works

Instead of leaning into crit/chase, this build leans into:

- Stacked Energy regeneration
- Faster ultimate cycles
- Amplified ultimate damage

### Energy Mastery

Energy Mastery increases Energy Regen Speed significantly.

When stacked with Infinite Firepower’s built-in 20% regen boost, the result is extremely fast ultimate cycling. In some of my later-season tests, ultimates were coming online noticeably earlier than standard mage builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-112.png)

This shifts the damage profile from sustained AoE pressure to heavy rotational burst.

### Corrosive Power

Corrosive Power further enhances magical damage output tied to ultimates.

When ultimates trigger faster and hit harder, the synergy becomes multiplicative rather than additive.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-113.png)

You’re no longer just benefiting from Infinite Firepower’s damage — you’re using it as a catalyst to supercharge your entire ultimate loop.

---

## Why This Build Is Expensive

All components are legendary priced, meaning super expensive! Read more about the pricing of legendary skills (and Corrosive) **[here](https://ik-wiki.com/?post_type=docs&p=16878)**.

---

## Conclusion Summary

**Infinite Firepower is the premier magical DPS legendary skill.**

- 350% AoE every 3 seconds at 60% trigger rate
- Built-in 20% Energy Regen boost
- Synergizes with both crit/chase and ultimate-regen builds

**Budget Route:**
Pair with Abundant Spirit + Chase for high-value crit builds.

**Premium Route:**
Pair with Energy Mastery + Corrosive Power for hyper-regen ultimate cycling.

The only real drawback is cost and specialization commitment. Legendary skills are expensive, and Infinite Firepower firmly anchors you into a magical damage focus.

If you’re building a dedicated mage core and want consistent, scaling AoE pressure, this is one of the strongest investments you can make.

---

title: Infinity Kingdom 5th Anniversary Event Guide
summary: Every anniversary in Infinity Kingdom tends to follow a familiar structure: a mix of progression events, ranking challenges, shop rotations, and an experimental mini-game layered on top of the usual economy loop. The…
markdown:
Every anniversary in *Infinity Kingdom* tends to follow a familiar structure: a mix of progression events, ranking challenges, shop rotations, and an experimental mini-game layered on top of the usual economy loop. The 5th Anniversary event appears to follow that model, but with a few notable additions that change how players should plan their resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-41-1024x562.png)

From early information, this celebration revolves around three central currencies:

- **Fish Tokens**
- **5th Anniversary Coins**
- Plus returning currencies: **Tokens of Light** and **Eternal Grails**

This guide breaks down each activity, explains how the systems interact, and offers practical advice based on how similar anniversary events have worked in previous years.

---

## Lucky Coil & Daily Sign-In

### Overview

The event will include:

- **Lucky Koi Lottery**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-42-1024x513.png)

- **Daily Sign-In Rewards**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-43-1024x490.png)

- Both awarding ****Dazzling**Wish Tokens**

---

## Hall of Divine Might (Anniversary Battle Pass)

### Overview

The anniversary introduces a new **Hall of Divine Might Battle Pass** with:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-44-1024x510.png)

- Free track: Tokens of Light
- Premium track: Larger amounts of Tokens of Light + Exclusive Castle Skin
- No additional skins beyond the featured anniversary skin

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-46-1024x555.png)

---

## Fruit Frenzy (2048 Mini-Game)

### Overview

A new 2048-style puzzle mode:

- Merge identical fruits by sliding the board.
- Each move consumes **Fish Tokens**.
- Rewards based on progress.
- Ranking rewards available.
- Extra Fish Token pricing not yet confirmed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-47-1024x605.png)

### Strategic Approach

From similar limited-move event games in the past:

1. Avoid random swipes.
2. Establish a corner stacking strategy early.
3. Preserve open lanes to avoid dead boards.

If ranking rewards are meaningful (Tokens of Light, Coins, or rare shards), expect competition from heavy spenders buying additional Fish Tokens.

Press Officer Hades has a really good video about this, I recommend checking out this **[video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rivIwZ0wKiI)**to get the most out of the new Fish Tokens Fruit Crazed Event. All credit to Hades for the awesome video! Thanks mate.

### Important Unknowns

- Cost of extra Fish Tokens, if you are inefficient in the event you may need to purchase more Fish Tokens.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-48-1024x507.png)

If ranking rewards are top-heavy, F2P players should focus on progression milestones rather than leaderboard chasing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-49-1024x531.png)

---

## Celebration Cake (Collaborative Mini-Game)

### Overview

- Invite one collaborator per cake.
- Craft up to **two cakes**.
- Each cake has **30 levels**.
- Both partners receive rewards at every level.
- Upgrade cakes using **Delicious Cream**.
- Cream obtained from anniversary events or Recharge Shop.

### This is essentially a cooperative progression ladder .

Choose collaborators carefully. Ideally: Similar activity level, similar spending tier, reliable activity.

Cream is partially locked behind Recharge:

- F2P players may cap below level 30.
- Moderate spenders may reach full clear on both cakes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-50-1024x513.png)

---

## Lore’s Challenge

### Overview

- Returns in **Normal** and later **Hard** modes.
- Rewards:  - Gems
- 5th Anniversary Coins

Anniversary Coins feed directly into the **Challenge Shop**. That means Lore’s Challenge is not optional if you want cosmetic or premium items from the event store.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-52-1024x537.png)

Hard mode:

- Unlocks at day 2
- Requires optimized march builds, but doable by most

During the first days you want to buy a few extra attacks to raid even though you are unable to raid hardmode yet. This is contrary to the older events, because they changed the way the shop stock works a few seasonals ago. Now you have 1 daily stock for the main items: Tokens of Light, Stardust and Unique Artifact Chests. Personally, I make sure to collect the daily Token of Lights and the Stardust.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-51-1024x484.png)

---

## Pinnacle Trial (Anniversary Edition)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-55-1024x570.png)

### Overview

- Strong preset marches to defeat. Later levels can be quite challenging, try to push as far as you can.
- Ranking battles.
- Rewards include:  - Random Immortal Shards
- Tokens of Light
- 30 Sun Chariot Castle Skin Fragments

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-54.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-56-1024x488.png)

---

## Dazzling Wish

### Overview

- Rewards are not exclusively Eternal Grails, no other secondary rewards.

This is a stable, known mechanic. No major structural change.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-57-1024x595.png)

I will be making a seperate guide to evaluate the efficiency of the Grails given the costs of the Token of Lights and the Grail Chances for each reward tier. **[Please read more here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/anniversary/infinity-kingdom-5th-anniversary-event-guide/cost-efficiency-guide-eternal-grail-vs-chaos-roulette/)**if you are interested in Grails as a means to unlock Chaos Immortal Fragments relative to Chaos Roulette.

---

## Grail Shop & Challenge Shop

### Structure

Two tabs:

## Challenge Shop

Spend **5th Anniversary Coins** on:

- New Avatar Frames
- New Chart Frames
- Tokens of Light
- Stardust
- Unique Artifact Chests
- Philosopher Stones

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-58-1024x546.png)

## Grail Shop

Spend **Eternal Grails** on:

- Chaos Immortal Fragments
- Chaos Artifact Selection Chests
- Chaos Immortal **Great Tango** (so far only available here)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-59-1024x524.png)

---

## Event Packs

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-60-1024x549.png)

- Early packs often high value.
- Later tiers less efficient.
- First Bundle is inefficient token wise but awards the unique frame
- Bundles include Cream, Fish Tokens, or Tokens of Light.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-61-1024x531.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-62-1024x529.png)

Wait for gem-equivalency breakdown before purchasing heavily.

---

## Conclusion Summary

The 5th Anniversary event blends familiar anniversary structure with two new interactive systems: **Fruit Frenzy** and **Celebration Cake**.

The most strategically important elements appear to be:

- Tokens of Light from Battle Pass and Pinnacle Trial
- 5th Anniversary Coins from PvE Challenge
- Grail Shop access for high-tier account scaling
- Cooperative Cake progression efficiency

---

title: Infinity Kingdom Creator Association – A New Way to Earn Vouchers
summary: Infinity Kingdom can be quite an expensive game to play. While it is
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-33-1024x575.png)

## Introduction

Infinity Kingdom can be quite an expensive game to play. While it is absolutely possible to play entirely free-to-play, most players quickly run into paywalls or strong incentives to spend. The biggest spenders — the so-called chaos whales — operate on an entirely different level, but even for normal players there are many smaller purchases that significantly improve account growth.

Monthly battle passes are a good example. Most players eventually decide they are worth buying because the rewards across the tiers are simply too efficient to ignore. The same applies when chasing a specific immortal in **Elemental Bonds**, trying to secure a legendary skill in the **Wisdom Well**, or participating fully in certain limited-time events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-1024x691.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-3-1024x567.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-85.png)

Because of this structure, it is genuinely big news — especially for free-to-play players or those on a limited budget — that the Infinity Kingdom team has introduced a new initiative called the **Creator Association**. The idea is simple: players can earn **vouchers for in-game purchases** by creating content for the community.

---

## What the Creator Association Is

The Creator Association is somewhat similar in spirit to the **Press Officer program**, which has existed since the early days of Infinity Kingdom. However, the focus here is different.

Press Officers typically contribute long written guides, strategy explanations, and detailed mechanics breakdowns. The Creator Association instead focuses on **creative community content** and social media presence.

Players who are accepted into the program will:

- Join a private official Discord creator channel
- Participate in regular creative activities or themes
- Produce content related to Infinity Kingdom and the world of Norheim

The program is framed as a way for players to **document the events happening across Norheim** through creative work.

For anyone with a creative streak who is already sharing content around the game, this could realistically help make the game a bit cheaper to play.

---

## Official Announcement Overview

The developers describe the initiative as a way to preserve the stories and history of Norheim through player creativity.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-31-1024x359.png)

Creators who are accepted can expect several benefits:

### Voucher Rewards

Vouchers will be distributed regularly based on how many submissions you create for each theme.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-81-1024x633.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-84-1024x414.png)

These vouchers can be used toward **in-game purchases**, which is the part that will interest most players.

### Official Social Media Features

Outstanding content may be featured on Infinity Kingdom’s official social channels, giving creators visibility within the community.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-32-1024x508.png)

### Dedicated Creator Community

Accepted players will gain access to a dedicated Discord creator channel where activities and creative themes are organized.

Applications are open long-term through the official recruitment form.

---

## How It Probably Works in Practice (My Perspective)

Now, I should mention something important here.

I am **not** part of the Creator Association myself — I’m a Press Officer — so this section is based on how similar programs usually operate and how the announcement reads.

So if you’re accepted, this is how I imagine the system works in practice.

First, once accepted you’ll likely gain access to the **private Discord creator channel**. That’s where the Infinity Kingdom team probably posts regular themes or creative prompts.

For example, they might ask creators to produce content around:

- A new immortal release
- A specific event happening in the game
- Highlights from the battlefield
- Creative storytelling from Norheim

You then submit your content for that theme — whether that’s artwork, a short video, social media content, or some other creative format.

Based on the number of submissions you produce, **voucher rewards are distributed**.

From experience with community programs, the important detail is consistency. Players who participate regularly in these themes will probably earn the most value from the program.

---

## Player Perspective

From a practical gameplay perspective, vouchers matter because **small purchases in Infinity Kingdom add up quickly**.

Even modest spending tends to focus on things like:

- Monthly battle passes
- Event participation packs
- Skill pulls in the Wisdom Well
- Extra attempts during limited events

Individually these purchases are small, but over time they make a noticeable difference in progression.

If the Creator Association allows players to earn vouchers regularly, it essentially converts **community activity into in-game value**. That’s a pretty interesting trade-off, especially for players who already enjoy creating content around the game.

---

## How to Apply

If you’re interested, you can apply through the official recruitment form:

    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScO_ULRLxLxYu_X_Ct_Ka5h60dVeX8lRLPMbfUnhxgZn_9new/viewform

Recruitment is currently **open long-term**, so there is no strict deadline to apply.

---

## Conclusion

Infinity Kingdom has always rewarded spending, even though the game remains technically playable as free-to-play. The Creator Association introduces a different path — one where creativity and community involvement can translate into voucher rewards.

For players with a creative side, the program offers a practical way to offset some of the costs associated with events, battle passes, and progression systems.

If you already enjoy making content around the game, applying for the Creator Association is certainly worth considering.

---

title: Infinity Kingdom Gift Codes: How to Find Active Codes and Never Miss New Ones
summary: Gift codes in Infinity Kingdom are one of the most consistent sources of free resources, speedups, and occasionally premium items. Over time, the system has become more structured, but also slightly confusing for newer…
markdown:
### Introduction

Gift codes in *Infinity Kingdom* are one of the most consistent sources of free resources, speedups, and occasionally premium items. Over time, the system has become more structured, but also slightly confusing for newer players due to how codes are distributed and updated. Today we will look at a little something a surprising amount of players don't know exists: The Discord**!codes**command.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-18-1024x584.png)

The key point most players miss is this: there is no single perfectly up-to-date list of all active codes at any given moment. Instead, you need to combine a few reliable sources to stay current. This guide explains how the system actually works and how experienced players keep track of valid codes efficiently.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-17-1024x453.png)

---

### How to Quickly Check Active Gift Codes

The most straightforward method is through the official Discord server.

- Join the **[official Infinity Kingdom Discord](https://discord.gg/R756PXH8r5)**
- Use the command:
**```
!codes
```**
- The **Bot Helper** will return a list of currently tracked active codes

This list is useful because:

- It filters out expired codes
- It gives you a clean, usable set of working entries
- It’s maintained centrally rather than relying on scattered posts

However, there’s an important limitation most players don’t realize.

---

### Limitations of the !codes Command

The

```
!codes
```

 list is not updated in real time.

In practice, it tends to lag behind newer releases. For example:

- Running  ```
!codes
```  on **May 2nd** may still return codes last updated around **January 14th**
- That means **weekly, monthly, and event-specific codes** are often missing

These “missing” codes are usually:

- Time-limited (sometimes only a few days)
- Released through announcements, events, or promotions
- Not always added to the bot immediately

So while

```
!codes
```

 is reliable for baseline active codes, it should not be your only source.

---

### Where Temporary Codes Actually Come From

Most temporary codes follow predictable patterns:

- Join the challen for **[Weekly codes](https://discord.gg/GdY7xTUeT7)**
- **Monthly batches** and **event**tied releases
- **Special promotions or celebrations**
- **Miscellaneous one-off drops**

For example, in **May 2026**, several codes circulated that would not necessarily appear in the bot list:

- MAYGIFT
- LOVEMAY
- MAYPACK
- MAYBOOST
- CHEERMAY
- Seraphic

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-21-1024x484.png)

These are exactly the type of codes players miss if they rely only on

```
!codes
```

.

---

### How to Never Miss a Code (Practical Setup)

To stay fully up to date, you need a layered approach:

#### 1. Subscribe to the Official Discord Channels

- Look for a[**weekly-codes**](https://discord.gg/GdY7xTUeT7)or announcements channel
- Enable notifications or check regularly

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-19-1024x511.png)

#### 2. Use Alliance Discord Sharing

Most active alliances maintain:

- A **gift-code channel**
- Members posting codes as soon as they appear

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-20-1024x623.png)

This is often faster than official updates.

#### 3. Join Community Hubs (e.g., IK Wiki Discord)

- These communities aggregate codes from multiple regions
- Codes often appear there before being widely circulated

---

### Conclusion Summary

- The **```
!codes
```  command** on the official Discord is the easiest way to check stable, active codes
- It is **not always up to date**, especially for recent or temporary codes
- **Weekly, monthly, and event codes** often appear outside that list
- To stay current, you should:  - Follow the official Discord channels
- Stay active in an alliance Discord
- Join community hubs that track codes

In practice, the system works best when you treat

```
!codes
```

 as your baseline—and Discord activity as your real-time source.
