Repeated testing resolves that question: Twin Crowns separately selects the highest Physical Attack ally and the highest Magical Attack ally. In our tests, every cast applied the Attack Speed and damage buffs to both recipients. The recording below shows the buffs active on two allies at the same time. Watch Alexander and Loki’s status rows: both display the timed Attack Speed and damage buffs together. ### Video: Twin Crowns Targeting Test
This confirms the targeting behaviour observed in the repeated tests. The battle result itself is not a benchmark for a finished Jadwiga formation. ### Why This Matters for Team Building Jadwiga can support two damage dealers simultaneously, which makes physical-and-magical combinations especially interesting. Alexander can receive the Physical Attack selection while a mage receives the Magical Attack selection, allowing both to benefit from the same cast. However, dealing a particular damage type does not automatically mean an Immortal has the highest corresponding attack stat. Check the actual values in your formation, especially when using unusual builds or Immortals whose damage mechanics involve stat conversion. If your highest Magical Attack belongs to a support with limited damage output, the second selection still occurs, but the formation may gain less from it than a team with a dedicated magical damage dealer. ## Energy Regeneration and Exclusive Artifact Jadwiga’s displayed **83.0 Energy Regen** is solid for a support whose contribution depends on repeatedly casting her ultimate. ![](/uploads/screenshot-20261017-232728-wpydvn.png) Her Exclusive Artifact extends Twin Crowns by three seconds, taking its duration from **six to nine seconds**. That is a **50% increase in duration per application**, giving both selected allies more time to deal damage with the buffs active. It makes the artifact an important part of assessing a developed Jadwiga. Longer duration does not automatically establish permanent coverage. Actual uptime still depends on her casting intervals, survival, control effects and energy disruption. Her Energy Regen stat is encouraging, but replays are needed to judge uptime in competitive battles. ## Potential Team Combinations With the targeting confirmed, the most interesting starting points are formations that give both selections a valuable damage dealer to support. These remain team concepts for testing rather than established best builds. ![]() ![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261018-193713-w4xf7x.png) ### Alexander + Himiko or Loki Combining Alexander with a magical carry such as Himiko or Loki is a natural direction to explore. Alexander can receive the Physical Attack selection, while the magical carry receives the Magical Attack selection. A formation combining **Alexander, Himiko or Loki, Jadwiga and Zenobia** would retain healing while adding offensive amplification for both attackers, provided they hold the relevant highest attack stats. This gives us a reason to revisit Alexander hybrids. Whether Jadwiga adds enough pressure to improve their competitive position still needs testing against comparable opponents. ### Alexander + Louis IX Alexander + Louis is also worth exploring because Twin Crowns can support both of them, provided Alexander has the highest Physical Attack and you somehow are able to get Louis to have the highest Magical Attack. I am not sure if this it possible, but IF it is this could be a new hybrid build in the making! That last condition matters. **Louis dealing magical damage does not automatically establish that his Magical Attack exceeds the supports in the formation.** Check his actual stats, try to boost his magical attack through gems, etc. and confirm the recipients in replays. If the selections line up, this could allow two frontline attackers to benefit from Jadwiga while leaving the remaining backline slot available for another support. Neither version is proven. The first tests whether healing can sustain the attackers through their buff windows; the second tests whether greater offensive pressure justifies giving up Zenobia’s healing. ### Louis + YSS Louis + YSS with Jadwiga and Qin remains another formation to investigate. Louis can be the intended magical recipient, with the physical recipient determined by the actual attack stats of the team. The relevant question for this team is how much value each recipient gains, and whether the formation performs better with Jadwiga than with an alternative support. ![](/uploads/screenshot-20261017-232953-9vogmb.png) ## Does Jadwiga Replace Zenobia or Qin? **TBD.** We still lack enough comparative testing with a fully developed Jadwiga to establish a reliable verdict. Keeping Zenobia preserves healing, while keeping Qin explores a different balance of offensive support. Jadwiga needs to contribute enough additional damage through Twin Crowns to justify what the replaced Immortal brings to the formation. The targeting tests answer how her skill works. They do not yet establish which support pairing wins more battles. That requires comparisons across several fights against comparable opponents, looking at damage, survival and buff uptime. ## Tower of Knowledge Skills Choose Jadwiga’s support skills around the needs of your overall build. She does not need a specific Tower of Knowledge combination to make Twin Crowns function. Healing, protection, energy support and other utility can be distributed according to the formation and the skills already assigned to its other Immortals. The priority is making the whole march work together. ## How to Obtain Jadwiga Jadwiga is obtained through **Elemental Bond**. Select her as your target and collect fragments through the card-matching event using Soulglass Crests. She requires **60 fragments to summon**, with further fragments needed for development. ![](/uploads/screenshot-20261017-232749-ao1roc.png) For the event mechanics and spending approach, see our dedicated [Elemental Bond guide](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/should-you-spend-on-the-elemental-bond-event/). Unlocking her and developing a competitive replacement are separate investment decisions. Her skill progression and Exclusive Artifact both matter when assessing the version you intend to use. ## Final Thoughts Repeated testing confirms the important mechanic: **Twin Crowns selects the ally with the highest Physical Attack and the ally with the highest Magical Attack, giving both recipients both the Attack Speed and damage buffs.** That makes Alexander with Himiko or Loki, and potentially Alexander with Louis, interesting combinations to explore. Solid energy regeneration and an artifact that extends the buff to nine seconds add to her appeal. Her place in the meta remains TBD. The next step is establishing whether that offensive contribution outperforms the healing or utility of the support she replaces in a fully developed formation.

title: Journey Guide from level 5 to level 10
summary: Follow the tuturial. It is pretty well done, and will get you a short intro to everything. The tutorial in Infinity Kingdom is pretty self-explanatory and well done. You will have a decent idea of what this game is…
markdown:
Follow the tuturial. It is pretty well done, and will get you a short intro to everything. The tutorial in Infinity Kingdom is pretty self-explanatory and well done. You will have a decent idea of what this game is about once you complete it.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/tech-1-1024x522.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-213009-1-1024x604.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-214625.png)

As you progress through the tutorial you are introduced to building your castle, fighting gnomes, summoning Immortals. These are the key elements to Infinity Kingdom, as well as the PvP that will be introduced later on.

**Below you find a comprehensive list of all things you need to know from Castle level 5-10 in Infinity Kingdom.**I have made the list and sub-pages in chronological order based on when you can/should learn something. As such, it follows the tutorial as closely as possible.

## Main take-away’s from Castle level 5-10

**1. Alliances**are unlocked and you are now able to take full advantage of the community aspects of Infinity Kingdom. Do spend time on finding a solid and ACTIVE community. For now, the power, skill and even levels of kindness of your fellow alliance friends is completly irrelevant. You need activity before all else, since you want to take full advantage of: (1) **[Alliance "Help" function](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-alliance-help-function/)**, and (2) **[Alliance donations and shop](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-alliance-donations-shop/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-211655-1024x560.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-211708-1024x552.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-211645-1024x560.png)

**2. You will now also unlock your harbour**. From here, you can send out a ship on a voyage to bring back some goodies. Basically, you trade gold ressource for speedups, immortal fragments and purple crystals. It is 100% worth and you should have 0 downtime on sailing untill you are done using purple crystals on your third march (long after you are Castle level 50). Read the article [**Beginner Sailing**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-sailing/)for more info.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-22-214625-1.png)

**3. The Tutorial takes you through your Nobility Ranking** somewhere around this progress level. This is where the currency **Honor**is introduced to you. The tutorial explains how honor is earned by fighting other players (**PvP**) in the game. However, why you should care and what you should do about it is not made very clear. More information available in my article: **[Beginner Honor amongst the Nobel](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-honor-amongst-the-nobel/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-75.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-24-225451.png)

**4. As you try attacking another Lord you will be struck with a debuff called "Bloody Rage"**read more about Bloody Rage debuff and strategies for minimizing it's impact on your game in my article: **[Beginner Blood Rage](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-blood-rage-strategy/)**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-84.png)

**5.**Returning to your Castle, you will soon be **Castle level 8** and build the **Academy**for the first time. In the academy you have a ton of research into new technology. This is extreemly important to do, as there are huge **growth**buffs and crucial **combat**buffs to be gained here. Furthermore, you want to be efficient about it, since you are going to be doing **Technology Research the entire game**. I heard of a few of the biggest whales in the game have completed technology. Most whales will never finish technology. Read more in my article: **[Beginner Technology Research](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/the-beginning/beginner-technology-research/)**

---

## A bit more you should know ...

While this is not a comprehensive list of what you are doing during the tutorial, it is what I feel are the most important things to take-away and make sure you have understood. If you are aware and understand these four things, you are off to a decent beginning.

**In addition to the more in-depth explanations offered in the sub-articles referenced above, I have some general tips and tricks for you to consider while you do the tuturial.**

## Tips and tricks

- **Always buy the temporary builder with gems or alliance coins**
- **Keep your ship sailing at all times**
- **Always keep your academy and builders busy!**
- **Do not underestimate the value of honor**
- **Raid them gnomes hard..**

title: Judgment Realm
summary: The Judgment Realm Castle Skin is the featured cosmetic tied to the 2026 Goddesses Festival battle pass. On paper, it looks like a standard seasonal addition: moderate combat stats, some economic value, and long-term…
markdown:
## Introduction

The **Judgment Realm Castle Skin** is the featured cosmetic tied to the 2026 Goddesses Festival battle pass. On paper, it looks like a standard seasonal addition: moderate combat stats, some economic value, and long-term scaling through fragments.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-69-1024x496.png)

In practice, though, this is one of those skins where you need to separate how it *looks* from how it actually performs. If you’ve been around a few of these seasonal cycles, you’ll recognize the pattern immediately—this is not a power spike skin, it’s a filler skin attached to a strong event package.

---

## What the Skin Actually Gives You

At base level, the buffs are simple:

- 5% Immortal Physical Defense
- 5% Immortal Magical Defense
- 5% Resource Production Speed

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-70.png)

At full upgrade (which requires 660 fragments total), those become:

- 15% Physical Defense
- 15% Magical Defense
- 10% Resource Production Speed

Now, on paper, 15% anything sounds decent. The issue is not the number—it’s *what stat it’s applied to*.

Physical defense is one of those stats that sounds stronger than it actually plays out in real fights.

---

## Why Physical Defense Underperforms

It’s important to clarify that the **Judgment Realm skin increases both physical and magical defense**, which on paper makes it look like a well-rounded survivability boost. The issue is not the coverage—it’s where that stat is applied, and how stats scale in Infinity Kingdom.

In actual combat, most of your power does not sit on the immortals themselves, but on the **troops they lead**. Each immortal is effectively amplifying a large army, and the majority of meaningful stats—damage output, survivability, and scaling—come from troop-based attributes. Because of this, **modifiers that affect troops scale far more effectively** than those applied directly to immortals.

When you increase immortal defense, you are only improving the defensive layer of the immortal unit. Even at 10–15%, this is a relatively small portion of your total combat power. In contrast, a troop-based modifier—such as the +5–15% troop attack from something like Abyssal Temple—affects every unit in the march. That translates directly into higher total damage output and often shorter fights, which in turn reduces incoming damage indirectly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-70.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-71.png)

From practical testing, the difference is noticeable. Troop-based buffs tend to change outcomes: fights end faster, trades become more favorable, and efficiency improves across PvP, gnomes, and bosses. Immortal defense, even when covering both physical and magical damage, tends to have a softer effect. It smooths incoming damage slightly, but rarely shifts the result of a fight in a meaningful way.

The core issue is scaling. Defense is not inherently bad, but when applied at the immortal level, it simply doesn’t interact strongly enough with the larger system of troop-based combat. If the same percentages were applied to troop HP or attack, the impact would be significantly higher.

In short, even though the Judgment Realm skin offers dual defense, it struggles because it enhances the smallest layer of your army rather than the one that actually determines performance.

---

## The Secondary Stat – Resource Production

The second half of the skin is resource production speed, and this is where things fall off completely from a competitive standpoint.

Production speed is not useless—but it’s not something you ever prioritize:

- Active players get most resources from events, farming, and rewards
- Alliance and tech bonuses already cover a lot of this
- The marginal gain from +5–10% production is very small

In other words, this stat doesn’t meaningfully impact your progression if you’re playing regularly.

---

## Where It Stands Compared to Other Skins

If you’ve picked up a few of the better skins over the past year, the difference becomes pretty obvious.

Take something like **Mt. Paradise**. The troop HP gives you survivability across all content, and the march speed adds real tactical value in both PvP and PvE. You feel that difference immediately when rotating targets or contesting nodes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-72-1024x378.png)

Or **Goddess of Victory**, which reduces troop death rate. That effect directly saves resources and extends your ability to stay active in long fights or events like IB. It’s one of the few skins where the benefit is both visible and measurable over time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-73.png)

Even something like **City of Glory**, which leans into honor gain, still ties into long-term progression in a way that matters if you’re active in PvP.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-75-1024x443.png)

When you put Judgment Realm next to those, it doesn’t really compete in any category:

- Not the best survivability
- No utility
- No progression scaling

It just sits in the middle without a clear role.

---

## So When Would You Actually Use It?

In real gameplay, there are only a few situations where this skin makes sense:

- You don’t have any of the stronger skins
- You’re early or mid-game and options are limited
- You like the visual and don’t mind the tradeoff
- You bought the battle pass anyway and it’s your best available option

Outside of that, it’s almost always outperformed.

---

## The Real Reason You Get This Skin

This is the part that matters most.

You are not buying the battle pass for this skin.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-76-1024x465.png)

You are buying it for:

- The **Tokens of Light**
- The **Grail conversion value**
- The overall event efficiency

The skin is just bundled in. If anything, it’s a small bonus rather than a selling point.

In fact, this is pretty consistent with recent seasonal design. The real value is always tied to progression systems, not cosmetics.

---

## Key Takeaways

- Immortal defense is a weak combat stat compared to troop attribute modifiers or tactical march speed bonuses
- Resource production has minimal impact for active players
- The skin is heavily outclassed by existing combat skins
- The battle pass is still worth considering—but because of tokens, not the skin

---

## Conclusion Summary

The **Judgment Realm Castle Skin** is best viewed as a secondary reward rather than a meaningful upgrade.

It doesn’t offer the kind of stats that change outcomes in PvP or improve efficiency in PvE, and it falls behind even older skins that provide HP or troop-saving effects.

If you end up using it, it’s because it’s what you have—not because it’s what you chose.

And that, more than anything, tells you where it stands.

---

title: Khan-Based Lightning in Conquest
summary: Lightning has always been a flashy element in Infinity Kingdom, but in recent years it lost its crown as stronger Chaos and Earth–Himiko builds took over Conquest. That’s why this build is so exciting — it showcases a…
markdown:
### The Return of Crit Khan – Late Game Lightning Build

Lightning has always been a flashy element in *Infinity Kingdom*, but in recent years it lost its crown as stronger Chaos and Earth–Himiko builds took over Conquest. That’s why this build is so exciting — it showcases a way to make Lightning shine again in late game Conquest, with none other than **Genghis Khan** back in the spotlight as the carry.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-98.png)

This build goes **against the current meta**, yet it’s crushing maxed Himiko teams and even taking out whales. Let’s dive into what makes it work.

---

## 🐉 Dragon Choice: Thunder Dragon

The first surprise in this setup is the use of **Thunder Dragon**, not Lightning. Why?

- **Lightning Cage**: Reduces damage dealt by enemy mages — perfect against the Himiko-dominated meta.
- **Lightning Shriek**: Adds more true damage scaling.
- **Ultimate Amplifier (24%)**: Boosts damage from ultimates after the first one. By the time Khan ults a second and third time, he’s dishing out devastating nukes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-93-1024x524.png)

Even though this team doesn’t match the dragon’s element, the defensive and ultimate-boosting effects are what matter. This helps Khan survive the burst meta and lets his damage snowball.

---

## Core Carry: Genghis Khan (Crit Build)

The star of the march is **Crit Khan**. For years, Khan’s crit multiplier was feared, but his inconsistency pushed him out of the meta. This build fixes that:

- **Energy Mastery** (Level 8): Still one of the strongest skills in the game, giving Khan ridiculous damage scaling.
- **Corrosive Power**: Adds even more ramp damage.
- **Fighting Master (Level 8)**: Keeps Khan CC immune nice and safe and buys Khan time and consistency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-94-1024x572.png)

---

## Frontline: YSS + Bjorn

The frontline here is deceptively standard but synergizes beautifully with the build:

- **YSS (Yi Sun-sin):** Easy to obtain, reliable shields, and 30% boosted defense and 30% more healing from our Theo/Fu Fei support. A tank that stalls while Khan ramps.
- Skills: No Escape, Master's Aegis, Resist (resist can be changed based on your specific enemy).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-95-1024x581.png)

- **Bjorn:** His ultimate boosts damage output by another 20%. This stacks with the dragon and Khan’s skills, multiplying the burst potential even further.
- Skills: Energy Suppression, Fear of Domination and Rage Blessing. Getting ahead in the energy game is vital here and once we land that first dragon breath we activate fear aura for more damage stacking for our Khan, just in time for him to come online and repeately spam massive AOEs from his hyper-regen setup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-96-1024x580.png)

Together they keep the frontline stable and enable Khan’s late-game damage spikes.

## Core Support: Fu Fei or Theodora

For the key support role we are using Theodora as default because she is a lot easier to max. We NEED a level 8 talent support to buff our Khan, therefore many will want to do Theodora over Fu Fei (it is quite expensive to max a chaos immortals talents) however, if you can do it.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-101-1024x419.png)

Fu Fei is a big upgrade! Either immortal runs the same setup and works by providing massive sustain and defense, DoT clearing or control immunity.

- **Life Protection**: Offering big healing buffs and a big defensive for our Khan.
- **Fountain of Life**: We need this skill and it should be a priority (even at level 1). Simply because we **MUST**obtain imnmunity to no escape to make this regen build work.
- **Spring of Life**: Good heal boost aura. Adding even more sustain.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-97-1024x542.png)

All in all, we are stacking MASSIVE amounts of damage mitigations, energy regen control effects and healing in this setup. Everything is about defending until Khan comes online and ramps repeated ultimates at high troop count relying on our healer and tanks ability to keep him topped up and on his combination of Corrosive + Energy Master to enable spam-ultimate casting.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-100-1024x605.png)

Very cool! **And the strongest lightning build I have ever seen.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-99-1024x442.png)

---

## 💡 Why This Build Works

1. **Meta Counterplay:**  - Most players are running **Resist** + **Master’s Aegis** to protect against Himiko’s magic burst.
- That means very few are running **Oaken Guard** or other anti-physical defenses.
- Result: Khan has free reign to shred them.
2. **Dragon Synergy:**  - Thunder Dragon cuts mage damage early, neutralizing Himiko bursts.
- It also stacks bonus damage for ultimates — Khan’s bread and butter.
3. **Crit Khan Factor:**  - With high crit multipliers and stacked bonuses, a lucky crit can instantly delete enemy carries.
- Even without crits, consistent boosted ults let Khan dominate over time.
4. **No Wound in Meta:**  - Many teams lack wound in the current mage-heavy meta.
- That means healing (Theodora, Life Protection) is more effective, helping Khan survive long enough to nuke.

---

## 📊 Proof in Reports

Hades shares reports where:

- This build wipes out **maxed Himiko teams** that normally crush everything.
- Even when heavily outnumbered, as long as Khan has troops left, he can swing fights back with one or two ultimates.
- Against strong rally setups, Khan crits once and completely shifts the momentum.

---

## 🏆 Final Thoughts

This **Late Game Lightning Build** is one of the freshest and most exciting Conquest setups we’ve seen in a long time.

- It **revives Genghis Khan** as a top-tier carry, something many veterans will love to see.
- It uses **Thunder Dragon** in a unique defensive/offensive hybrid way.
- It punishes the **mage-heavy Himiko meta**, taking advantage of players stacking magic resistance but leaving themselves vulnerable to physical nukes.

⚡ Verdict: **Crit Khan is back.** With the right support and dragon synergy, he’s once again capable of deleting entire teams — and this build proves Lightning still has a place at the top of Conquest.

title: Khan-Shadow: Fight holy with shadow! (2.2 patch)
summary: This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the shadow build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE…
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the shadow build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

**This article is on a standard shadow main build in the 2.2 meta. This build is made to combat zeno-alex teams and holy. Since these two teams are able to heal so quickly that most nothing can really compete with it, we need to have access to wounds. Hence, we replace our Bathony (who is insanely strong in any of our sub-marches) with Genghis Khan! This gives us slightly lower sustain damage, but higher burst and the most valuable debuff in the game - wounds!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Screenshot_20220722-225019-1024x474.jpg)

**This build is a big spender build! We are using shadow here, meaing you have to spend quite a lot to ever run this.**

This build performs well against anything. It performs particularly well versus healer setups, including holy! You want to run this in this situation. If you are not fighting holy or Zeno-Alex you want to do the default shadow build. See guide on the shadow page!

## How does it work?

This setup is pretty standard and revolves around pumping big burst damage from all both Khan and Himiko whilst your dragon and Himiko controls the battlefield. Moreover, your Siegfried dishes out amazing sustained damage, and keeps chipping away while your bursters recharge.

However, the important thing to understand here is wounds. Wounds = 100% reduces healing recieved. This means you can completly nullify Theodora and Zeno. Beware, new setups are emerging that are able to deal with wounds and heal through niche holy killers like this. However, I have not seen any big holy whale using these setups yet, making this a VERY strong build to have in your arsenal.

## ToK passive setup (main)

This build can both function as a main and as a secondary march. Please see my guide on running this as a secondary march here.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Screenshot_20220722-222649-1024x474.png)

**Himiko**: Death Breath + Annihilation + Chase

**Khan**: Adrenaline Rush + Anger + Fighting Will

**Siegfried**: Malice + Cleave + Rage Blessing

**Bjorn**: Oaken Guard + Energy Suppression + Weakness

title: Khubilai Khan - Code of Yuan
summary: In the heart of the immersive realms of Infinity Kingdom, a new artifact has emerged to captivate the attention of commanders and strategists alike: the Code of Yuan. This distinctive artifact, exclusively crafted for…
markdown:
### The Enigmatic Power of the Code of Yuan in Infinity Kingdom

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-37-1024x555.png)

In the heart of the immersive realms of Infinity Kingdom, a new artifact has emerged to captivate the attention of commanders and strategists alike: the Code of Yuan. This distinctive artifact, exclusively crafted for the revered holy immortal Khubilai Khan, has sparked fervent discussions and ignited curiosity within the kingdom's ever-evolving landscape. This article delves into the intricacies of the Code of Yuan, dissecting its unique attributes and potential impact on the battlefield.

## Unveiling the Artifact: Skill Mechanics

At the core of the Code of Yuan lies a skill mechanic that promises to redefine Khubilai Khan's prowess in combat. Distinctive to this artifact and unique to Khubilai Khan himself, the skill activates each time his ultimate ability, Total Conquest, inflicts damage. With a remarkable 75% chance, the Code of Yuan empowers the target to endure additional damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-39.png)

This mechanic introduces a new layer of strategic possibilities, allowing Khubilai Khan to inflict multiple instances of damage on a single target. The genius of the Code of Yuan lies in its enhancement of Khubilai Khan's Total Conquest ability. This ultimate ability, already a formidable force, now carries the potential to unleash an even more devastating blow. The additional damage mechanic, triggered by the skill's activation, amplifies the precision and impact of Khubilai Khan's attacks, providing him with a newfound advantage in battles. Because the ultimate ability Total Conquest as a default deals damage a total of 5 times, the damage increase is an almost sure proc.

***Probability of UA trigger occuring = 1 - (1 - 0.75)5 = 0.9990234375 = 99.9%***

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-38.png)

## Theoretical Potential and the Quest for Precision

On the theoretical front, the Code of Yuan hints at a significant boost to Khubilai Khan's damage output. This enhancement, in theory, makes a compelling case for a more potent presence on the battlefield. However, the quantifiable extent of this augmentation remains a subject of exploration, necessitating empirical tests to truly ascertain its tangible effects.

### Putting Theory to the Test

In the pursuit of understanding the Code of Yuan's practical implications, rigorous testing has been undertaken. The tests were designed to unravel the artifact's impact within a controlled environment, minimizing extraneous variables that could skew results.

Boss battles emerged as the litmus test for the Code of Yuan's potency. As such I engaged in a series of level 18 boss encounters.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-40-1024x549.png)

### (1) Using a Normal Epic artifact with strong physical attack roll and Surge bonus

This artifact is a very powerful one, having rolled near perfect attributes and the Surge bonus. Both of these stat values are amongst the absolute best and most critical for the damage output of Khubilai Khan.

### (2) Using a "Code of Yuan" unique artifact with TERRIBLE rolls, no physical attributes and no bonus

This unique artifact contrary to the above, has terrible rolls with no damage impact at all besides the unique effect itself. As such the test we are going to be conducting here will determine if the unique artifact effect all by itself can carry it's own and make up for the massive damage attribute loss.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-41-1024x589.png)

Firtly, our Khubilai Khan will be equiped with our powerful normal artifact gaining huge attack and damage-boosting attributes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-43.png)

Subsequent trials saw Khubilai Khan wielding the Code of Yuan—a unique artifact devoid of attack-boosting attributes and bonuses. The anticipation was a drop in damage output due to the stark disparity in attributes.

## Results: Surprising Outcomes and Future Prospects

Counter to expectations, the test results unveiled a fascinating trend. Despite the massive reduction in attributes like physical attack and energy regeneration with the Code of Yuan, the damage output and overall DPS of Khubilai Khan surprisingly increased during boss encounters. **Despite having 25% lower physical attack and 17% less energy regen, our UA-Khubilai Khan wielding Code of Yuan was able to deal 11% more damage!** Very surprising and a huge find to me.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-44.png)

Counter to expectations, the test results have revealed a compelling narrative that sheds light on the formidable prowess of the Code of Yuan. Our UA-Khubilai Khan, brandishing the Code of Yuan, demonstrated an astonishing 11% increase in damage output during boss encounters. **This discovery stands as a resounding testament to the potency of this unique artifact, compellingly underscoring its ability to amplify Khubilai Khan's impact on the battlefield.**This revelation ignites anticipation, kindling eagerness to craft more Codes of Yuan and to envision the potential of a physical main role and a surge bonus on a Unique Artifact. The Code of Yuan's transformative effect on damage output signifies a significant stride forward in strategic evolution, setting the stage for an exciting era of calculated experimentation and optimized combat mastery.

***I look forward to many more Codes of Yuan - best of luck to you on your crafting rolls!***

title: 🗡️ Knife Through Butter: The Energy-Shredder That Could Make the Next Version of Hybrid-builds
summary: Infinity Kingdom’s next patch introduces one of the most disruptive Tower of Knowledge skills we’ve seen in years: Knife Through Butter. At first glance, its raw damage looks unremarkable — but its energy drain mechanic…
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom’s next patch introduces one of the most disruptive Tower of Knowledge skills we’ve seen in years: **Knife Through Butter**. At first glance, its raw damage looks unremarkable — but its **energy drain mechanic** makes it potentially *meta-breaking*.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-91.png)

This skill doesn’t just punish the current **hyper-regen meta** — it may also bring back the long-forgotten **Earth–Wind hybrid archetype**, putting physical carries like **Alexander the Great** back in the spotlight.

---

## 🔎 What Knife Through Butter Does

### Skill Details:

- **Type:** Physical, Attack-triggered
- **Effect:** Normal attacks have a 60% chance to remove **300 Energy** from **all enemy Immortals**
- **Proc Chance:** 60% per 6 normal attack, thus scaling with attack speed.
- **Target:** All enemies simultaneously

---

## 🚩 Why It’s a Big Deal

### 1. Hard Counter to Hyper-Regen Meta

Right now, many Conquest battles revolve around **regen-based comps** — teams that chain ultimates endlessly through energy boosts. These teams thrive on casting before you can react.

Knife Through Butter flips that on its head:

- Every proc robs the *entire enemy team* of 300 energy.
- With high attack speed, enemies may never reach ultimate thresholds.
- Result: Heals, shields, and CC chains collapse.

---

### 2. Revival and evolution of Hybrid Teams

For several seasons, hybrids (earth wind) have struggled in the regen backline-centered meta. With Knife Through Butter, hybrids finally have a disruptive tool that rewards their natural strengths:

- **High attack speed carries** like Alexander, Hannibal when boosted by Zeno and Qin for attack speed can proc this constantly.
- By draining energy, they prevent enemy from cycling their devastating ultimates.
- The freed-up space lets hybrids’ sustained DPS shine again.

***The next evolution of Hybrid will be Alex-Ares frontline!***?

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-92-1024x542.png)

In short: **Hybrids get relevance back** — not by brute force, but by shutting down the opponent’s key win condition. Perhaps even as a new version with Ares? I personally think so.

---

## 📊 Numbers That Matter

Let's put the impact of **Knife Through Butter** into context, using a common hybrid setup:

- **Attack Speed Setup**: With standard hybrid builds (e.g., Alexander running **Wind Rage** and **Berserker**), achieving 3-4 attacks per second is common in prolonged battles.
- **Proc Mechanics**: With a 60% chance per 6 attacks attack, at 3 attacks per second, you average 1.8 procs per second (60% × 3 = .9 procs).
- **Energy Drain Impact**: At each proc, you drain **300 Energy from each enemy Immortal**. Averaging .9 procs per second gives us approximately 270 Energy drained per second from each enemy Immortal—an absolutely staggering number.

### The idea is simple yet effective:

- DPS #1 shuts down enemy ultimates by continuous energy drain.
- DPS #2 quickly bursts down priority targets who become vulnerable due to interrupted heals, controls and shields.

---

## 🎯 How It Fits Into Conquest Meta

### Hybrid Resurgence

- Earth–Wind hybrids with Alexander and Hannibal suddenly look dangerous again.
- With Knife Through Butter, they can suppress backline enery regen based builds that otherwise ramping up damage.

### More Attack-Speed Builds

- Expect **Wind Rage**, **Berserker**, and other speed-enhancers to become mandatory.

### Whale Must-Have

- For spenders, this skill will likely be **required** for top Conquest matches.
- Any team without energy control will risk being steamrolled by Knife Through Butter comps.

### Implications

- Skills like **Energy Suppression** may see renewed relevance as synergies to constant energy drain.
- Teams that rely less on ultimate cycles (like raw crit Khan comps) will adapt faster.

---

## 🏆 Final Thoughts

Knife Through Butter isn’t just another skill — it’s a **meta-shifter**. By introducing large-scale **energy disruption**, it dismantles regen-based setups and opens the door for hybrid physical builds to thrive again.

- **For Whales:** It’s almost mandatory. If you want to compete at the very top, you’ll need it.
- **For Mid-Spenders:** It’s a ticket to punch above your weight, especially in Conquest battlegroups dominated by regen comps.
- **For the Meta:** Expect hybrid marches (Alex-Hannibal earth wind) to climb back to the top.

⚡ Verdict: This is a very interesting skill and one that in the right build may be t**he most broken energy skill so far? Right now it looks strong but not broken, but I think that once whales figure out how to setup Alexander-Ares hybrids, we are going to see some new top builds and a new hybrid era... time will tell!**

### Skill News: Introducing the new Chaos skill the "Last Stand" Skill in Infinity Kingdom

"Last Stand" is the latest addition to the arsenal of Tower of Knowledge skills in Infinity Kingdom, specifically within the chaos category. This guide will delve into the mechanics of this formidable skill, its implications in the game's meta, particularly for high-level play, and what makes it a significant investment for the biggest spenders in the game.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Skill Overview

### Availability and Cost

"Last Stand" is a chaos-tier skill, which is the highest rarity for skills in Infinity Kingdom. It requires a substantial investment to unlock and maximize:

- **Skill Stones Needed**: To fully upgrade "Last Stand," players need 290 skill stones.
- **Acquisition**: Available exclusively through wishes during the Triss event.
- **Expected Cost**: With an average drop chance of 4%, acquiring enough skill stones for "Last Stand" could necessitate around 7,000 wishes, making it one of the most expensive items in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image.png)

### Skill Mechanics

- **Activation Condition**: "Last Stand" activates when your troops are below 70% of their total count.
- **Effects**:  - **Damage Reduction**: Reduces damage taken by 60%.
- **Damage Increase**: Boosts damage dealt by 60%.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-1.png)

## Strategic Implications

### Comparisons to Existing Skills

"Last Stand" offers the combined benefits of multiple top-tier defensive and offensive skills, but in a single slot: Comparatively, Physical shield and Anger has been used for three years now as some of the strongest skills to respectively reducing incoming damage and increase your damage dealt.

These are a great comparison for this skill as using two skill slots on physical and magical shield gives you a solid 30% damage taken reduction - half of what this skill does! Albeit you gain the effect only under 70% troop count, but still incredble! Combine that with 2x anger (anger = 30% damage buff) and this single skill has the inherent value of 2x physical shield, 2x magical shield and 2x anger/concentration. But it takes up one slot!

- **Physical and Magical Shield**: Normally, occupying two skill slots to achieve a 30% damage reduction, "Last Stand" provides double that reduction under its activation condition.
- **Anger/Concentration**: Similarly, while each of these skills provides a 30% damage boost, "Last Stand" doubles this effect as well.

Looking at a chaos setup with Last Stand available it is going to be very difficult to deal real impactful damage to their key damage dealer, and at the same time you will take massive amounts of incoming damage if you are able to even break the 70% barrier and reach activation! Scary skill for sure!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-2-1024x602.png)

### Meta Impact

The introduction of "Last Stand" is poised to significantly influence the strategic choices at the highest levels of play, particularly among players who can afford the heavy investment (whales):

- **Breakthrough Capability**: In a meta dominated by dual healer backlines, "Last Stand" offers a potential counter by significantly enhancing both the survivability and damage output of chaos immortals.
- **Shift from Defense to Offense**: Its powerful effects may encourage top players to rethink strategies that heavily favor sustain and defense, potentially reducing the prevalence of immortals like Theodora in favor of more offensive or balanced setups.

## Considerations for Use

### Build Synergy

- **Critical Thresholds**: Players will need to manage their troop health strategically to ensure "Last Stand" activates when most needed.
- **Complementary Skills**: Pairing "Last Stand" with skills that enhance energy recovery, critical hits, or further damage mitigation can amplify its effectiveness.

### Whale Territory

- Given its cost and the rarity of required resources, "Last Stand" is realistically only accessible to the game's biggest spenders. This exclusivity ensures that its impact, while potentially meta-defining, will be confined to the upper echelons of player rankings.

## Conclusion

"Last Stand" embodies a significant evolution in the strategic dynamics of Infinity Kingdom. Its potent combination of defensive and offensive enhancements in a single skill slot sets it apart as a potential game-changer for those who can afford to integrate it into their builds. As more top-tier players begin to unlock and deploy this skill, its true effect on the game's competitive meta will become clearer. For now, it remains a symbol of high-stake investments yielding potentially unmatched battlefield supremacy.
