![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Skaermbillede-2022-06-15-103811.png)

Louis IX

**Ultimate skill: Howling Thunder**
Replaces magical attacks with your own physical attacks and have a 55% chance to trigger lightning with each attack, dealing magical damage to the target and 1-2 nearby units (damage rate 60%) and increasing the magical damage they recieve by 6% for 3s.

**Scaling**:
Damage rate - 60% / 80% / 100% / 120% / 140% / 160% / 180% / 200%

**Recieved damage reduction**:
Damage rate - 6% / 8% / 10% / 12% / 14% / 16% / 18% / 20%

title: Lightning in Season 2: Genghis Khan or Hammurabi??
summary: Lightning has always been a fan-favorite element in Infinity Kingdom — fast, aggressive, and able to tear through opponents with brutal crits and high burst damage. In Season 1, most players leaned on combinations like…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-60-1024x578.png)

Lightning has always been a fan-favorite element in *Infinity Kingdom* — fast, aggressive, and able to tear through opponents with brutal crits and high burst damage. In **Season 1**, most players leaned on combinations like **YSG–Khan** or the generally stronger **Hammurabi–Khan** setup to maximize raw output.

But with the release of **Immortal Talents in Season 2**, the rules have changed. Suddenly, running two damage dealers in the backline is no longer the optimal path. Instead, every serious Lightning march will want to slot in a **support immortal** to unlock that devastating **support talent tree**.

So the question many Lightning mains are asking: **Who should stay as your primary damage dealer — Hammurabi or Genghis Khan?**

---

## 🎯 Why You Need a Support in Season 2

- **Immortal Talents** make supports mandatory. The support talent tree is one of the strongest in the game, offering utility, healing, and damage amplification that can swing entire fights.
- Without a support in your Lightning backline, you’ll simply be missing out on huge power spikes that Season 2 offers.
- This means: instead of running **Hammurabi + Khan**, you’ll now run something like **Support + One DPS**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-58-1024x362.png)

Typical options include **Theodora** or **Matilda**, with **Cao Cao** also entering the conversation later when he becomes easier to obtain.

---

## 🔥 Genghis Khan – The Reliable Monster

Khan has always been a staple of Lightning, and for good reason:

- **High Crit Multiplier** – His critical hits scale insanely well, especially when built as a “Crit-Khan.”
- **Wound Effect** – Khan brings wounds to the table, shutting down healing-based teams. That’s utility on top of raw damage.
- **Flexibility** – Unlike Hammurabi, Khan isn’t tied to pure Lightning setups. He works in hybrid marches (Earth/Lightning, Double Tank setups, etc.) and still performs.
- **Reliability** – His damage isn’t as easily interrupted by control effects compared to mages.

The downside? His ceiling isn’t as explosively high as Hammurabi’s when everything lines up. But for most players, especially those without fully-optimized mage skills, **Khan is the consistent and safer pick**.

---

## 🪄 Hammurabi – The High-Risk, High-Reward Mage

Hammurabi has risen in popularity thanks to Season 2 talents and the Lightning Dragon’s scaling:

- **Synergy with Debuffs** – His kit thrives when stacked with debuffs like *Corrosive Power* or *Psionic Tide*. With the right conditions, he can massively out-damage Khan.
- **Dragon Compatibility** – The Lightning Dragon ultimate increases damage taken from ultimate skills. Combined with mage burst skills like *Energy Mastery* or *Infinite Firepower*, Hammurabi scales extremely well.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-59-1024x379.png)

- **Insane Damage Potential** – With correct setup and if the enemy isn’t debuff-capped, Hammurabi can outperform Khan.

The catch?

- **Fragile & Interruptible** – Being a mage, Hammurabi is much easier to shut down through control effects.
- **Requires Premium Skills** – To unlock his full potential, you’ll need access to high-end mage skills. Free-to-play and light spenders often won’t have the luxury.
- **Inconsistent** – His performance can fluctuate wildly depending on matchup and enemy buffs.

In short: Hammurabi can be the **superior choice**, but he’s harder to use well and much less forgiving than Khan.

---

## ⚔️ Which One Should You Choose?

Here’s the practical breakdown:

- **For Reliability → Genghis Khan.** He’s easier to build, harder to shut down, and always brings value through wounds and crit damage.
- **For Maximum Damage Potential → Hammurabi.** If you have the mage skills and can manage debuff stacking without hitting the cap, Hammurabi will outscale Khan in high-end setups.
- **For Light Spenders → Qin + Hammurabi** can be very effective, but you’ll need patience and the right skill investments.
- **For Consistency at All Levels → Theodora/Matilda + Khan** backline is probably the strongest “plug-and-play” Lightning option in Season 2.

## 🛡️ Support Choices for Lightning

- **Theodora:** A fantastic backbone support. Reliable healing, anti-control, and scales very well with talents.
- **Matilda:** Another strong option, leaning more into raw sustain. Great for light spenders.
- **Cao Cao (Xiaoxiao):** Not widely available yet, but will be one of the most meta-defining supports once accessible.
- **Himiko (situational):** Sometimes used, but Lightning already struggles into Earth-Himiko, so not optimal.

👉 **Recommendation:** Run Theodora or Matilda. If you’re a spender and can unlock Cao Cao later, he becomes the premium pick.

---

## 🪄 Damage Dealer Showdown – Khan vs. Hammurabi

### Genghis Khan – The Reliable Beast

- Huge crit multiplier → “Crit-Khan” builds can hit insane numbers.
- Scales with end-game expensive skills like *Corrosive Power*, *Time to Shine, Lightning Strike, Unyielding*, *Energy Mastery*
- Wound effect denies healing.
- Less fragile, harder to counter by enemies.
- Fits into hybrid marches beyond Lightning.
- Easier to build with mid-tier skills.

### Hammurabi – The Mage Nuker

- Scales with end-game expensive skills like *Corrosive Power*, *Psionic Tide*, *Infinite Firepower*, *Energy Mastery*.
- Pairs perfectly with Lightning Dragon’s debuff centered passive.
- Insane burst potential if enemy isn’t debuff-capped.
- Fragile and control-prone → requires strong frontline + support.

👉 **Verdict:**

- **Most players → Khan is better.**
- **High spenders with full mage skills → Hammurabi can outperform Khan, but is riskier.**

---

## ⚔️ Recommended March Setups

### Free-to-Play / Light Spender Build

- **Frontline:** Tokugawa + El Cid / Richard
- **Backline:** Theodora (Support) + Genghis Khan (DPS)

Why: Stable, consistent, strong sustain, and Khan is less skill-dependent than Hammurabi.

---

### Whale / High Spender Build

- **Frontline:** Bjorn + Tokugawa (or El Cid for anti-hybrid)
- **Backline:** Cao Cao (Support) + Hammurabi (DPS)

Why: Hammurabi can hit absurd numbers with premium mage skills. Cao Cao adds incredible sustain if you are powerful enough to survive early game in the new hyper regen meta.

---

## 📜 Skills for Lightning

### Basic For Khan (DPS)

- **Fighting Master / Anger** – Control immunity is a big deal, especially vs Himikos. Anger baseline great damage amp.
- **Energy Burst** – Synergizes with his high instance rate skills like DB.
- **Death Breath** – Consistent damage amplification.

### Spender For Khan (DPS)

- **Time to Shine**/**Lightning Strike/Unyielding**/**Fighting Master** – Big amp or control immunity.
- **Energy Mastery** – Huge regen and damage amp.
- **Corrosive** – Constant Casting.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-55-1024x645.png)

### Basic For Hammurabi (Mage DPS)

- **Concentration** – Amp.
- **Spell Disintegration** – Amplifies through debuff and dragon passive and scales off of Ultimate. Triple yield.
- **Annihilation** – Top-tier mage burst skills.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-56-1024x697.png)

### Spender For Hammurabi (Mage DPS)

- **Corrosive Power** – Debuff-based scaling.
- **Psionic Tide** – Amplifies burst.
- **Energy Mastery / Infinite Firepower** – Top-tier mage burst skills.

***OBS**: Note that fighting into shadows you want to always use Fighting Master on your main damage dealer to avoid CC effects.*

---

## 💰 Spending Tips

- **F2P / Light Spenders:** Build Khan. He’s easier to make effective with lower investment.
- **Medium Spenders:** Run Khan early, then consider Hammurabi if you secure key mage skills.
- **Whales:** Hammurabi + Cao Cao is the true Lightning endgame.

---

## 🏆 Final Thoughts

- **Khan is the safe, flexible, and consistent DPS.** You can always rely on him to perform, and he’s easier to build around.
- **Hammurabi is the specialist.** When built correctly, he can outperform Khan — but he’s squishier, riskier, and far more reliant on premium skills and the right matchups.

Personally? I recommend **Matilda/Theodora + Khan** for most players, because it’s consistent and very hard to counter. But if you’re aiming for the absolute top-tier and have the skills to back it up, **Hammurabi can still be a terrifying weapon** in your Lightning arsenal.

title: Lightning Strike
summary: In this guide, we take a deep dive into one of the newer legendary skills in Infinity Kingdom: Lightning Strike. Whether you're testing it out on your mid-tier marches or considering it for one of your top squads, this…
markdown:
### Lightning Strike Skill Guide – Tower of Knowledge Passive

In this guide, we take a deep dive into one of the newer legendary skills in Infinity Kingdom: **Lightning Strike**. Whether you're testing it out on your mid-tier marches or considering it for one of your top squads, this skill introduces a unique dynamic to physical damage teams—especially those built around **seriously wound synergies**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-125.png)

We’ll walk through what the skill does, how it works, best Immortal pairings, purchasing info, and some practical insights from player testing.

---

## Lightning Strike – What It Does

You’ll find **Lightning Strike** in the **Tower of Knowledge**, right near **Soul Synergy**. As of now, it's a **legendary skill** with position restrictions and a damage + debuff mechanic.

### Skill Description:

- **Trigger:** Every 12 seconds (70% chance)
- **Effect:** Deals **physical damage (Damage Rate: 90% + 30%/level) to all enemies** and **increases their damage taken by (3% + 1%/level) for 6 seconds**
- **Bonus:** If the target is **seriously wounded**, the damage is **increased by 50%**

## Damage benchmark

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-123-1024x220.png)

Overall the damage from Lightning Strike averages out at 70% physical damage per second placing it above older skills such as Chaotic Blade etc., and generally quite high compared to other physical damage skills. What is more interesting however, is looking at the damage while condition is met. With an activation from Wounds (which you can have constant uptime on quite easily) you are getting 105% damage per second, which places is very high on the list of skills behind only skills like Blade Vortex and Drastic Action. In essence, this is a must have for Wounds-based setups and not the best in others.

💡 **Quick Tip:** The skill is reportedly being **buffed in a future patch**, reducing the cooldown from 12s → **9s**, which will increase uptime and DPS significantly.

Brining it down to just 9s cooldown will further increase its usefulness taking the damage average to 93.33% DPS and a whopping 140% while wounds is active. **Very impressive**!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-124-1024x105.png)

---

## How to Get Lightning Strike

Lightning Strike is a **pay-to-acquire skill** (currently exclusive):

- **Cost:** $140 total through the **Recharge event**
- You’ll receive **the required skill stones** across the tiers in the event

At the time of writing, **free-to-play access is not available**, so this skill is only for players who are willing to spend.

---

## Ideal Immortals for Lightning Strike

Due to its **physical damage type** and **position restrictions**, Lightning Strike works best on **high-attack melee Immortals**, especially those in **physical-heavy or lightning-focused teams**.

### Top Picks:

#### 🗡️ Alexander the Great

- High physical attack (~10k+ with gear)
- Excellent synergy in **frontline burst setups**
- Compatible with **Time to Shine**, **Fighting Master**, and **Chase**

#### 🗡️ Genghis Khan

- Works great in **backline physical builds**
- If running **dual seriously wound Immortals** (like Khan + Qin), Lightning Strike gets its **50% bonus damage consistently**

#### 🛡️ Hannibal Barca

- Another powerful physical option
- Less commonly used in current meta but still viable in tanky, retaliate-style teams

💡 **Note:** Lightning Strike is **not available to Chaos Immortals** or Magic/Support units, and is best left to **main damage dealers in the front or backline**.

---

## Theorycrafting: Seriously Wounded Synergy

The real power of Lightning Strike comes from the **bonus 50% damage** if the target is **seriously wounded**. This makes it ideal in setups where:

- You run **two wound-inflicting Immortals**
- You have **high uptime on wound effects** from fast energy regeneration

One test setup:

- **Frontline:** Alexander + Khan
- **Backline:** Qin + Tokugawa
- **Result:** Lightning Strike dealt **7M damage in a 38s battle**, thanks to high uptime on wounds

While performance varies by matchup and timing, the synergy potential is very real when **wound uptime is consistent**.

---

## Practical Testing & Performance

- In tests, Lightning Strike performed reliably with **1.5x damage multipliers**
- Performance depends heavily on:  - **Wound uptime**
- **Immortal attack stat (Khan with low attack didn't benefit as much)**
- **Fight duration** (short fights = fewer triggers)
- Optimal when paired with **fast energy regen** units and **frontline sustain**

It won’t always shine in short skirmishes but **scales well in drawn-out battles** or **PvE boss fights** where uptime is king.

---

## Should You Buy It? Final Thoughts

### 🔥 Pros:

- Unique AoE + debuff combination
- Strong synergy with meta wound-based builds
- Getting buffed soon (cooldown from 12s to 9s)
- Great on staple Immortals like **Alex and Khan**

### 🧊 Cons:

- Paywalled behind $140 recharge event.
- Limited to physical attackers with positioning constraints
- Dependent on synergy to hit full potential

### ✅ Recommendation:

If you’re a **spender building physical DPS teams**, **Lightning Strike is a worthy addition**—especially once the cooldown buff goes live. It’s not a must-have, but it’s a **high-ceiling skill** when used with the right team setup.

---

## Summary – Lightning Strike at a Glance

| Aspect | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Role | Physical AoE + Damage Amplifier |
| Best Immortals | Alexander, Khan, Hannibal |
| Optimal Synergy | Dual Master, Seriously Wound, Anger. |
| PvP/PvE Use | Both – great for boss fights and long PvP |
| Patch 2.8.1 Insight | Cooldown buff from 12s ➝ 9s coming soon |

title: Lightning - Tanky Charlie
summary: This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.

**This build is made for:**Round 2 of Pre-league

This article is on lightning with Charles. We know lightning to be a hefty damage dealer, with great kill potential and access to wounds debuff. Moreover, in Prime league it is one of only very few marche setups to have wounds. What is lacks is sustain power - well well well, not any more!

## Setup

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/image.png)

**Genghis Khan**: Adrenaline Rush + Fighting Master + Anger

**YSG**: Coercion + Chaotic Blade + Garrote

**Charles**: Weakness + Assist + Oaken Guard

**Peter**: Malice + Death Breath + Cleave

## Strengths and weaknesses

This setup is a solid earth killer. With the high damage and wounds it eats through sustain setups quickly. Moreover, since we are running Charles ourselves, we are not weak to the wounds debuff from other Qin / Khan.

Wind setups are not a big problem for this team, with the added survivability from Charles, we can fight wind reasonably (we got wounds!). Big nuke fire setups are a problem...

**In conclusion, a balanced march easy to use and strong against most things you will meet.**

markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds for the **Playoff section of IB Prime League**.

If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.

**This guide was made before the first battles in the playoffs have commenced. I have been busy in training grounds for the past week, crafting what I think will be the five strongest marches for the Playoffs of Illusion Battle Prime League.**

[**You can find my five playoffs builds here:**
1. Fire w. Charles & Khan
2. Earth-Wind Hybrid
3. Lightning w. Charles
4. Water w. Charles & Khan
5. Water w. Charles & Ignatius](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/prime-league-illusion-battle/playoffs-my-top-5-builds-going-into-first-round/)

**As we have not yet had a playoff battle, I have no real IB data to go by. Therefore, I hope to see many of you trying out this build or one of my other playoffs-builds to report back with feedback and battlereports!**

## The build overview

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/l1.png)

This article is on lightning with Charles. We know lightning to be a hefty damage dealer, with great kill potential and access to wounds debuff. Moreover, in Prime league it is one of only very few marche setups to have wounds. What is lacks is sustain power - well well well, not any more!

Peter is the only Immortal in the game to counter Charles' shielding. We can confortably run Peter in this Setup since we have Charles ourselves to tank.

With the addition of Hammurabi to lightning, we are now also able to run the VERY strong magic ToK passives, like Spell Disintegrator and Stormeye.

Moreover, we rely on Charles strong shields and boosting the base damage of Immortal Ultimate abilities through William and a few auras. Mostly tho, with all the "new" ToK passives available, the game has shifted from a focus on Immortal native abilities towards more of a balance where ToK skills perform incredibly well and outperform the value of e.g. blessings and the minor Ultimate-ToK-booster passive types.

Lastly, this build uses Khan to make sure we keep wounds up on our enemies. We thus make sure that no one can play a healer-reliant sustain march to out-sustain the high nuke potential of our fire march. Moreover, Khan deals very solid damage and one of only two Immortals to enable Desire ToK passive to perform well.

## Setup

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/l2.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Skaermbillede-2022-07-09-113637.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/l5.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/l4.png)

**Hammurabi**: Annihilation + Stormeye + Spell Disintegration

**Khan**: Sniper + Desire + Anger

**Charles**: Energy Suppression + Assist + Malice

**Peter**: Weakness + Fighting Will + Death Breath

## Strengths and weaknesses

This setup is a solid earth killer. With the high damage and wounds it eats through sustain setups quickly. Moreover, since we are running Charles ourselves, we are not weak to the wounds debuff from other Qin / Khan.

Wind setups are not a big problem for this team, with the added survivability from Charles, we can fight wind reasonably (we got wounds!). Big nuke fire setups are a problem... however, if you face the meta-fire build with Khan and Charles. This lightning team will do very well. In training grounds, atleast these two are toe-to-toe fighting each other.

**In conclusion, a strong march that will kill most everything. Amazing for single attacks since it is so damn strong itself, also can break multiple garrisons if you lead when rallying!**

title: Lightning - Wounds specialists
summary: This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on Prime League Illusion Builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the main Prime League page.

**This build is made for:**Beginning of Pre-league

This article is on lightning team with a speciality in stopping healing, aka. killing earth marches. You have most likely tried fighting an earth march and having it be literally unkillable? Yeah.. having Charles shields, Zeno heals. If that was not enough, in IB Prime League's early pre-league games cheap healing passives such as Grace and Support are both very strong and shelter works quite okay even at base level. **How will you ever kill that?** You must be able to debuff the enemy with "[wounds](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/all-effects-ability-passive/effect-types-mechanics-debuffs-and-buffs/)". Hence, Genghis Khan is the center of this march. We need him to quickly and reliably cast Arrow Storm to debuff the enemy team with wounds. His native energy regen is not enough to cast consistenty and maintain 100% uptime on wounds, thus we run adrenaline rush maxed to both get wounds on quickly as well as consistently. For the rest of the march, we build balancing damage and survivability. Luckily, lightning dragon scales damage buff off of debuffs on the enemy, which pairs nicely with garrote, chaotic and suppression which are all VERY strong passives at base level. Moreover, we run only physical so we MUST have coercion to minimize misses.

## Setup

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Skaermbillede-2022-04-22-203813.png)

**Yi Seong-gye**: Assist + Weakness + Rage blessing

**Genghis Khan**: Adrenaline Rush + Anger + Garrote/Chaotic Blade

**Peter**: Onslaught + Energy suppression + Garrote/Chaotic Blade

**Richard**: Coercion + Resist + Oaken Guard

## Strengths and weaknesses

This build is a niche build. You want some of your roster to be earth killers so you are not getting stuck against an enemy stacking 5x defensive earth garrisons (which will NEVER die without lightning's 25% damage buff vs earth and wounds from Khan). **It is a specialist spiner build and you will be hunting all earth teams you can find during the IB.**

Lightning is not the strongest of elements and the Immortals' abilities are mediocre compared to other elements (besides wounds). This means, you should expoect not to win 1:1 battles versus wind, fire, etc. You must be a teamplayer to run this, as you will most likely be dedicated as the first march to spearhead and lead rallies against your enemies on the battlefield. **In conclusion, a strong specialist march to counter healing and earth.**

**IMPORTANT PROTECTION FOR YOUR ACCOUNT**
Recently, we have had news from the IK team, informing us of potential problems with Android system upgrades and IK guest accounts. The information reads, that due to an Android system upgrade and new policies from Google, guest accounts are at risk of being permanently lost in the 2.2 game update (july 23. 2022).
You should therefore hurry to bind your account to protect it from accidental deletion! You can bind in many ways, using Social Media, Google or Apple game-centers or via the Official Gtarcade app. I have personally bound mine through Gtarcade because playing from a Gtarcade account also offer bonuses for spenders that are larger than any other purchase / recharge platform. If you are a free-to-play, this is not as important, and in that case the message is simply: BIND YOUR ACCOUNT NOW!

## How to bind an account to Gtarcade

If you are having trouble logging into Gtarcade Desktop and finding the same character as playing on mobile, please following these instructions to connect Gtarcade account:

You can connect Gtarcade Account in-game by following these steps:

1.Open Settings from your portrait

title: Loadout 2 - Dragon and Gold development + Honor
summary: This article series is made for those who has leveled up lord level enough to take advantage of strong hybrid talent builds. I have done a wide range of talent builds for lower level Lords in the section \"Basic talent…
markdown:
This article series is made for those who has leveled up lord level enough to take advantage of strong hybrid talent builds. I have done a wide range of talent builds for lower level Lords in the section "[Basic talent builds](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/important-talents-and-talent-builds/)".

In this series we go over how to setup and take advantage of the 3 available predefined talent loadouts and switch between them. The three articles shall go over:

1. **Default loadout for 90% of playtime.** Research boost, rss gathering, EXP grinding and honor farming.
2. **Dragon & Minting loadout.** Used only when beginning a dragon/mint.
3. **IB/SVS loadout (PvP)**.

[Read more about these three here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/best-46-talent-builds/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-49-1024x101.png)

For the purpose of this article, we shall go over the second utility loadout I run. **This talent setup is balanced between development tech boost and military with a focus on dragon and mint development, making it the perfect utility talent setup.**

I have this setup on only when my dragon finishes upgrading and my mint is done cooking gold. Because you need the dragon talent and the mint talent for these tasts - and because the dragon leveling requires a ton of gold - **you should ALWAYS time your Mint cooks to match up with your dragon finishing an upgrade.**Remember to take into account if you are going to speed up your dragon upgrade timer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Skaermbillede-2022-04-29-125909.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/Skaermbillede-2022-04-29-125859.png)

## The talents

**1. Untill we are done with all our buildings to level 50, we run building speed.**When we are finished we move over to rss yield.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-37.png)

**2. Untill we are done leveling our second and third march, we run double exp.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-38.png)

**3. Always run gold production.** We need a ton to level all dragons to 50 and immortals to boost level 25.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-39.png)

**4. Divine walker. 3x free gnome hits or long range speeded castle hits per day is awesome.**If you are unable to do spider reliably, you can opt for double gnome greens.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-40.png)

**5. Dragon trainer. You should boost dragon speed in this loadout - since that is the entire point!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-50.png)

**6. Safe and Sound untill you have maxed second and third march Immortal levels.** 6x no troop losses on level 50 gnomes a day is awesome.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-42.png)

### 7. Training speed

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-43.png)

**8. Economics Expert.**You are timing out your dragon and mint cooks, meaning you will be beginning a new cook and a new dragon upgrade now. Economics Expert is an invaluable talent to your gold production.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-51.png)

**That is it for Development. Now we move into the Military tree to secure our honor talent, which we need to keep up in honor and nobility ranking.**

**1. Crit versus dodge**. You almost always want to run crit. (A) Because almost all army compositions have a combined critvalue beyond its dodge. Meaning you simply get more stat. (B) Because you will be using your talents to attack enemies and have no interest in battles going into overtime (time-out losses). (C) Because anyone VIP 14-15 always want to be running the passive “Chase” which needs crits.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-102.png)

**2. Physical versus Magic attack**. Next up you need to pick based on your army composition. Since I am usually using my talent when I hit enemies with my lightning team which is mainly physical damage, I run Knife Through Butter (phys). If you are relying on e.g. Merlin to deal the damage in your water or wield double mage fire (Baldwin + Wu) you want to use Rage (magic).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-103.png)

**3. AP conservation versus March speed**. You always want march speed. Even raiding gnomes, life it too short to save 4 AP when you hit a gnome.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-104.png)

**4. Attack** **versus defend**. You want to run defensive **Body of Steel**as you are unable to reach Might of Longbows further down the talent tree.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-47.png)

**5. Relocation speed versus reduced troop losses**. Per default you want to be running **Survival Methods**for the reduction in troop losses. Only in an [IB scenario](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/ib-talents-illusion-battle/) is relocation speed important.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-108.png)

### 6. Berserking versus healing versus honor

(6.1.) This is an important one that requires some foresight on your part. If you are fightning in a closely matched battle, **Last Stand**is a VERY powerful talent adding streight up 8% more damage to your army. This means you can beat opponent even at a significant power disadvantage! However, it comes at a properity cost you must be wary of. It is my go to talent in heavy PvP situations (SvS or Norheim). **Last Stand** is also a must have, if you are [ratting](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pvp/lord-combat-strategies/rat-pack-playstyle/).

(6.2.) **Aid**is a decent defensive talent if you are taking a lot of hits as the target of rallies or just the center of enemy frenzy. If you are low on healing speedups, this talent can save you a lot of trouble. I never run this per default, but see its value.

(6.3.) **Rank Advancement** is an amazing talent! If you overpower your opponent you want to run this talent to maximize your honor gain and climb that Nobility Ranking. It is a must-have when you [farm honor, e.g. using alts](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/nobility-honor/using-alts-to-farm-honor/).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-48.png)

**That is it for the dragon and minting loadout. Because it looks so much like the default loadout, you are able to stay in this talent setup for a while after swapping into it. You just need to get back to your default by the time you begin a new tech research.**

title: Loadout 3 - IB & SvS (PvP)
summary: This article series is made for those who has leveled up lord level enough to take advantage of strong hybrid talent builds. I have done a wide range of talent builds for lower level Lords in the section “Basic talent…
markdown:
This article series is made for those who has leveled up lord level enough to take advantage of strong hybrid talent builds. I have done a wide range of talent builds for lower level Lords in the section “[Basic talent builds](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/important-talents-and-talent-builds/)“.

In this series we go over how to setup and take advantage of the 3 available predefined talent loadouts and switch between them. The three articles shall go over:

1. **Default loadout for 90% of playtime.** Research boost, rss gathering, EXP grinding and honor farming.
2. **Dragon & Minting loadout.** Used only when beginning a dragon/mint.
3. **IB/SVS loadout (PvP)**.

[Read more about these three here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/best-46-talent-builds/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-53-1024x104.png)

For the purpose of this article, we shall go over the third loadout I run. **This talent setup is not a hybrid spec like the 1 and 2. This is an almost full Military talent loadout giving you the best possible advantages in battle.**

**I have this setup on only when playing IB or when a big battle is about to go down in Legion of Frostborne (SvS).**

**There are three types of talents.**Some talents makes the most sense to run in any combat scenario, some depend on your army composition and then there are some you only want in very specific situations.

### 1. Crit versus dodge

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-102.png)

You almost always want to run crit. (A) Because almost all army compositions have a combined critvalue beyond its dodge. Meaning you simply get more stat. (B) Because you will be using your talents to attack enemies and have no interest in battles going into overtime (time-out losses). (C) Because anyone VIP 14-15 always want to be running the passive “Chase” which needs crits.

### 2. Physical versus Magic attack

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-103.png)

Next up you need to pick based on your army composition. Since I am usually using my talent when I hit enemies with my lightning team which is mainly physical damage, I run Knife Through Butter (phys). If you are relying on e.g. Merlin to deal the damage in your water or wield double mage fire (Baldwin + Wu) you want to use Rage (magic).

### 3. AP conservation versus March speed

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-104.png)

You always want march speed. Even raiding gnomes, life it too short to save 4 AP when you hit a gnome.

**4. Attack** **versus defend**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-107.png)

You want to run **First Strike** here almost always. You shold only consider using the defensive **Body of Steel**if you are unable to reach Might of Longbows further down the talent tree.

**5. Relocation speed versus reduced troop losses** -**OBS! SvS or IB?**

Per default you want to be running **Survival Methods**for the reduction in troop losses. But if you are playing in an [IB scenario](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/talents/ib-talents-illusion-battle/), relocation speed important!

**5.1. SvS and other PvP activities. Here you want Survival methods.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-108.png)

**5.2. Illusion Battle. Here you must have relo speed to quickly get to key structures before your enemy.**If you run this talent and your enemy does not, then you are able to kill their relo on the very first relocation to a tower!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-52.png)

### 6. Berserking versus healing versus honor

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-110.png)

(6.1.) This is an important one that requires some foresight on your part. If you are fightning in a closely matched battle, **Last Stand**is a VERY powerful talent adding streight up 8% more damage to your army. This means you can beat opponent even at a significant power disadvantage! However, it comes at a properity cost you must be wary of. It is my go to talent in heavy PvP situations (SvS or Norheim). **Last Stand** is also a must have, if you are [ratting](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pvp/lord-combat-strategies/rat-pack-playstyle/).

(6.2.) **Aid**is a decent defensive talent if you are taking a lot of hits as the target of rallies or just the center of enemy frenzy. If you are low on healing speedups, this talent can save you a lot of trouble. I never run this per default, but see its value.

(6.3.) **Rank Advancement** is an amazing talent! If you overpower your opponent you want to run this talent to maximize your honor gain and climb that Nobility Ranking. It is a must-have when you [farm honor, e.g. using alts](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/nobility-honor/using-alts-to-farm-honor/).

### 7. Weaken enemies versus boosting defense

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-111.png)

You want to default to running **Domination** and weaken your enemies. The only reason to do anything else is if you have built an army and talent setup around prolong-victories. A niche build with very little usefulness. Just take Domination 😀

### 8. Another attack versus defend

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-112.png)

While **Sneak attack** is a very strong attack talent (dealing 7.5% of max HP in damage to an enemy immortal before battle begins. Attacking into a weakened opponent is very powerful!), you want to go **defensive**and choose**Might of Longbows**here by default.

The logic is, that you already have a lot of very powerful attack talents to use, and want to have some defense for when enemies are attacking into you with their offensive talent builds! Might of Longbows is simply the strongest defensive talent in the tree, and a must have in most all situations.

### 9. Energy regen versus attack speed

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-113.png)

You want to run **Owl Guardian** for its energy regen. All Immortals benefit greatly from increased energy regen, where as only very few and highly specific builds values attack speed over regen.

### 10. Another attack versus defend choice

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-115.png)

This one is tricky. The first talent it weakest, so exclude that one. Making it a decision on when you want the power of increased energy regen. If you are attacking more than defending you want **Excitation**(marked above), if you are on the defense **Energy Burst**can be activated with the same buff (plus a debuff if your attacker runs a tactic in the attack).

### 11. Resilience versus Accuracy

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-116.png)

You want to run accuracy most of the time. Like with many of the talents above, we want to deal damage when we play PvP to avoid time-out losses. Therefore, we run **Target Locked** and boost our accuracy. Moreover, accuracy is one of the absolute best stats for your physical damage Immortals and extreemly important to consistent wins.

In very specific cases you want to run **Strong Will** if your team is solely reliant on magic damage (e.g. running double mage fire with Hippo and William as supports) OR if you are playing a niche defense-prolong team.

**12. Hospital queues versus scaling walls versus defense energy reg.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-117.png)

This is an odd choice, mainly because I think all three talents are terrible. I default to the third option, **Skillful**because it is the only one I find slightly useful in PvP (energy regen in defense battles).

Honestly, I usually spend my talent point in **development** instead – this way when maxed Lord levels, we can maintain 5/5 **Plentiful Gold** even while waging war or in SvS.

title: Loki the best thing to happen to F2P players?
summary: Ah, Loki, the name that stirs up a whirlpool of emotions in the hearts of Infinity Kingdom players. Dubbed as a \"whale Immortal\" by many due to his seemingly insurmountable acquisition and upgrade costs, Loki has been a…
markdown:
### Loki: A Free to Play (F2P) Game Changer in Infinity Kingdom

Ah, Loki, the name that stirs up a whirlpool of emotions in the hearts of Infinity Kingdom players. Dubbed as a "whale Immortal" by many due to his seemingly insurmountable acquisition and upgrade costs, Loki has been a subject of much debate. But, let's flip the script today and discuss why Loki might just be the unsung hero for F2P players in the realm of Norheim.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-102-1024x598.png)

#### Loki's Arrival: A Blessing in Disguise

Since his grand debut in November 2022, Loki has indeed been tagged with the "expensive" label, but let's look beyond that. The introduction of Loki brought along a flurry of seasonal events that generously doled out Loki fragments and Chaos Selection Chests - yes, free of charge!

From Spring Festival and Winter's Christmas Celebrations to Halloween and Summer Party, most of the seasonal events in Infinity Kingdom have had free Loki fragments in quite high numbers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-103.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-104.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-105.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-106.png)

It also seems that they will continue to offer Loki and Selection Chests in the seasonal events, with a massive amount available in the Anniversary event currently live.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-109-1024x475.png)

#### The Power of a 5-Star Loki

For F2P players or those who prefer not to splurge, acquiring a 5-star Loki has become a feasible goal. Some might question the effectiveness of not fully upgrading him. However, this is where the true beauty of Loki's design shines through.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-110-1024x411.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-112-1024x611.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-113-1024x402.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-114-1024x615.png)

Loki's essence isn't just in dealing damage; it's his control abilities that truly make him stand out. His skill effects and percentages are so potent that even at 5 stars, he can significantly disrupt enemy formations and strategies. This aspect is vastly underestimated by many.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-115.png)

#### Leveraging Loki's Unique Skillset

Loki's unique skillset allows him to fit seamlessly into any elemental setup, be it fire, water, or earth. His control abilities can turn the tide of battles, making him a versatile addition to any team.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-117.png)

I, too, have embraced the Loki revolution. Swapping out a maxed Gilgamesh (with his top-tier Unique artifact) for a 6-star Loki (which, for skill slot purposes, is quite comparable to a 5-star) has yielded incredible results. This shift has not only enhanced my overall strategy but has also proven to be a game-changer in my battle outcomes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-116-1024x381.png)

#### Why Loki Deserves a Second Look from F2P Players

- **Accessibility:** The consistent distribution of Loki fragments through events has made him more accessible to F2P players than initially anticipated.
- **Impactfulness at 5 Stars:** Unlike other Immortals who might need to be fully maxed to unveil their full potential, Loki's control capabilities ensure he remains a formidable force even at 5 stars.
- **Strategic Advantage:** Incorporating Loki into your lineup opens up new strategic avenues, allowing for more flexibility in tackling various challenges and opponents.

#### Conclusion: Embracing Loki's Potential

It's time to shed the old perceptions and embrace Loki for the strategic asset he is, especially for F2P and light spender communities. Loki's introduction to Infinity Kingdom is not just a tale of exclusivity for those who can afford to whale out. It's a narrative of opportunity, strategic depth, and the democratization of power through smart play and event participation.

So, before you join the chorus of those lamenting over Loki's "whale" status, consider the potential lying dormant in your 5-star Loki. With the right strategy, he might just be the key to unlocking new heights for your kingdom, proving once and for all that in the world of Infinity Kingdom, strategy can indeed triumph over spending.

title: Lore Series Chapter 7: Secrets of the Floating Spire
markdown: ## 💠Secrets of the Floating Spire Chapter 7 opens with a dying man delivering a warning: > “Go to the West. Tell them the Council is forging a false god.” This immediately establishes that the Floating Spire is part of something much larger than an isolated alchemical experiment. The Council is not simply studying forbidden magic. It appears to be attempting to create some form of artificial divinity. The episode then returns to Brynhild and the Hangover Knight inside the Spire’s laboratory. The glowing figures held inside its enormous cylinders are finally identified as the souls of fallen warriors. Brynhild is horrified. These warriors should have travelled to Valhalla after death, but instead their souls have been captured and imprisoned inside the machinery. The Hangover Knight explains the truth very simply: > “They’re used as fuel.” ![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261004-201356-pns4rn.png) ## 💠The Council Is Harvesting Warrior Souls This is the most important revelation of the chapter. The Floating Spire appears to be powered by the souls of the dead, including warriors who were supposed to pass into Valhalla. It also explains why so many people have disappeared around the Spire and why the Council has worked so hard to conceal what happens inside it. The missing scouts and stolen alchemical components uncovered in earlier chapters were only pieces of a much larger operation. The Hangover Knight’s first reaction is to destroy the soul containers, but Brynhild stops him. Smashing the machinery directly could kill them both and potentially endanger the souls trapped inside. When guards arrive, Brynhild instead strikes the central mechanism. The machinery begins to overload, giving them an opportunity to escape and perhaps disrupting the process that was holding the warrior souls. ## 💠The Philosopher’s Stone Appears Before they leave, the Hangover Knight retrieves a glowing red crystal from the machinery. This appears to be the **Philosopher’s Stone** mentioned in the official description. Interestingly, the English subtitles refer to it as the **Sorcerer’s Stone**, but this seems to be a translation difference rather than a separate object. ![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261004-201448-8ahuo2.png) The pair now possess the stone, but they still do not understand exactly what it is, how it was created or what role it plays in the Council’s attempt to forge a false god. Obtaining the stone therefore does not end the mystery. It gives Brynhild and the Hangover Knight the first physical piece of evidence connecting the Council, the Floating Spire and the imprisoned souls. ## 💠The Journey Continues West After escaping through the Spire’s ventilation system, Brynhild asks what their next move should be. Their destination is a place in the West where humanity once made a covenant with the Goddess. They believe it may contain answers about the Philosopher’s Stone and perhaps the power the Council is trying to recreate. When they emerge, however, they find a distant city already burning. Whatever is happening is no longer contained inside the Floating Spire. The destruction ahead suggests that the Council’s plans are advancing quickly, and Brynhild and the Hangover Knight may already be running out of time. ## 💠Why Chapter 7 Matters Chapter 7 gives the Floating Spire a much darker purpose. It is not merely a laboratory or storage facility. It is a machine powered by stolen souls. For Brynhild, this is also deeply personal. The warriors inside were denied their rightful passage to Valhalla and reduced to fuel for the Council’s experiments. Her anger makes the discovery feel like more than another clue in the investigation. The warning about a “false god” is even more important. It suggests that the Council may be using the Philosopher’s Stone and the power of countless warrior souls to create, summon or imitate something divine. ![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261004-201421-p0jdim.png) ## 💠My Take This is one of the strongest lore chapters so far because it finally begins connecting the different mysteries introduced throughout the series. The missing people, the alchemical components, the Floating Spire and the Philosopher’s Stone now appear to be parts of the same project. We still do not know what the Council’s false god will be, why the covenant with the Goddess matters or whether the souls inside the Spire were truly freed. However, the story has clearly moved beyond a simple hunt for a magical object. Brynhild and the Hangover Knight now have the Philosopher’s Stone, but their next destination is already burning. Chapter 8 should take us west and, hopefully, closer to understanding what the Council is actually trying to create. ## 💠Follow the Journey **Resonance of the Sacred Emblem** continues to expand the world of Norheim by giving familiar characters, locations and items a proper place within the game’s story. Stay tuned for the next chapter as Brynhild and the Hangover Knight travel towards the site of humanity’s covenant with the Goddess.

title: Low-Spender Gilgamesh Earth - Executing the current meta builds
summary: Every now and then, the meta shifts in a way that quietly reopens something old and powerful.
markdown:
### The Return of Executioner - A Low-Spender Gilgamesh Build That Punishes the Current Meta

## Introduction – Why This Is Relevant Right Now

Every now and then, the meta shifts in a way that quietly reopens something old and powerful.

In the current Conquest environment, most mid to high spenders have transitioned away from **Theodora purification setups** and into **Fu Fei-based Himiko builds**. On paper, that makes perfect sense. Fu Fei adds scaling sustain, damage amplification, and fits neatly into the modern tempo-driven Fey structures.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-130-1024x619.png)

But that shift has created a hole.

Because when players dropped Theodora, they also dropped consistent cleansing. And when Purification disappeared from skill slots, something very important quietly became viable again: **Executioner.**

During my recent KvK, seeing Blurry from VT revive the old Executioner combo was honestly refreshing. I used to run that synergy a lot back when Executioner first released, and it absolutely dominated when properly supported by DoT stacking. Watching it perform again — into modern Fu Fei Himiko builds — was genuinely cool.

Props to Blurry. This is a very clean, very intelligent meta read. And if you are a low spender or fully free-to-play player struggling to punch above your weight into mid/high spenders, this build is one of the few that can actually do it.

---

## Why Executioner Fell Off — And Why It’s Back

When Executioner first released, it was a top-tier Tower of Knowledge skill.

It paired beautifully with:

- Blade Vortex
- Garrote
- Chaotic
- DoT ultimates like Bathory
- And especially Gilgamesh

The damage scaled aggressively because it triggers off continuous damage ticks. The more ticks, the more bursts.

But then the meta adapted.

Players shifted heavily into:

- Theodora
- Purification
- Cleanse-heavy builds

And that was the hard counter. If continuous damage never sticks, Executioner never scales. Simple as that. Now? That environment isn’t nearly as common. Most spenders prefer Fu Fei over Theodora. Very few are dedicating a slot to Purification anymore.

That means DoTs stay on the field. And when DoTs stay active, Executioner becomes dangerous again. See the matchup below for example:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-131-1024x594.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-133-1024x594.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-134-1024x597.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-135-1024x590.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-136-1024x589.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-137-1024x604.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-138-1024x609.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-139-1024x583.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-128.png)

This was a attack by the Himiko player, resulting in a timed-out defeat, where the enemy himiko was nuked by Gilga's Executioner crits, but with the strong healing legendaries the rest stayed alive. But the Gilgamesh build was victorious in its defense even against a top tier meta march with all the correct legendary skills!

---

## The Core Idea of the Build

At its heart, this build can take many forms. But the centerpiece is always:

## Gilgamesh + Blade Vortex + Executioner

You *can* run something similar on Bathory.
It works.
But it does not scale quite as cleanly as Gilgamesh, because Gilga simply produces more reliable DoT ticks per cycle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-140.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-141.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-142.png)

This is important. Executioner requires continuous damage instances to trigger its burst. Gilgamesh’s ultimate already applies ticking damage to all enemies. Blade Vortex adds additional ticking damage. When combined, you create a constant trigger engine.

You are not building burst. You are building a scaling damage machine.

---

## Elemental Advantage – The Overlooked Strength

This is one of the rare cases where a free-to-play core immortal actually holds elemental advantage over the meta. Gilgamesh is Holy.

Most meta Himiko builds are Earth-based and often include Shadow immortals. That means:

- Gilgamesh deals increased damage into Shadow.
- Gilgamesh takes reduced damage from Shadow.

Usually, Himiko builds enjoy elemental advantage. In this matchup, the tables turn.

And that matters more than people think — especially when Executioner crits.

---

## The Full Setup – Built for Mitigation and Scaling

We are not trying to one-shot anyone.
We are building something that survives long enough for Executioner to stack and detonate.

## Dragon: Earth Dragon

Earth Dragon provides mitigation and damage reduction — exactly what this composition needs. The longer the fight goes, the stronger your scaling becomes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-143.png)

---

## Immortal Breakdown

## Qin Shi Huang – The Engine

Qin is critical.

Not because of raw damage. But because of Wounds that allow tempo and pressure to mount fast.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-144-1024x623.png)

### Skills:

- **Assist** – Mandatory to protect Gilgamesh troop count.
- **Blessing of Defense** – Helps survive early burst.
- **No Escape** – Only if enemy is NOT running Fountain of Life.  - If Fountain is present → swap to an Aura (Aegis, Malice, etc.).

Qin applies **Wounds**, which is extremely important into Fu Fei healing structures. Negating sustain ensures your Executioner damage sticks.

### Talent:

- **Battle Excitation**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-145.png)

Battle Excitation:

- Gives Gilgamesh 200 energy at battle start.
- Increases his damage by 40%.

This early acceleration is huge. Getting Gilgamesh’s first cast earlier means Executioner begins scaling earlier. In tempo-based fights, that often decides everything.

Running double DPS instead of a support is a mistake here. You must exploit this specialization.

---

## Gilgamesh – The Core

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-146-1024x540.png)

### Skills:

- Executioner
- Blade Vortex
- Fighting Master

Fighting Master is extremely important into Himiko because control immunity protects your damage cycle. If Gilgamesh is stunned at the wrong time, your scaling collapses.

### Talent:

- **Deadly Aim**

We are building into crit scaling.

Executioner crits — especially with elemental advantage — are devastating.

### Artifact:

- Physical Damage main stat
- Annihilation effect
- Crit % secondary

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-147.png)

When Executioner crits under these conditions, even high spender backlines feel it.

I’ve seen Executioner crit chains absolutely demolish modern Himiko-Fu Fei setups.

---

## Yi Sun-Shin – The Wall

YSS is here to face-tank.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-148-1024x593.png)

### Default Skills:

- Energy Suppression
- Physical Shield
- Weakness

Physical Shield + Fearless Stance allows YSS to survive Alexander Knife Through Butter builds.

Weakness synergizes with:

- Deadly Aim
- Artifact crit scaling
- Executioner burst

### Talent:

- **Fearless Stance** (default)

If your meta lacks Alexanders, you can shift into Sturdy Barrier. But in most battlegroups right now, Alexander is common again.

---

## Charles – Shield Sustain

Charles provides layered shielding.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-149-1024x614.png)

### Default:

- Weakening Curse
- Energy Shield

If facing dual tank + magic carry:

- Swap Weakening Curse → Resist or Rage Blessing.

### Talent:

- **Sturdy Barrier**

Charles can apply multiple shield layers. Just make sure he is NOT positioned against enemy Alexander, since shield scaling depends on troop count.

---

## What This Build Counters

### 1. Fu Fei + Himiko Sustain

Without Theodora or Purification, your DoTs remain active.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/image-150.png)

Executioner scales.
Wounds reduce healing.
Elemental advantage increases pressure.

This is exactly the kind of structural hole this build exploits.

---

### 2. Knife Through Butter Earth Hybrids

Many of these builds rely on Zenobia + Qin for attack speed and sustain. Without Theodora, they are not cleansing debuffs.

Make sure:

- YSS faces Alexander
- Physical Shield + Fearless Stance are active

Executioner will do the rest.

---

## What You Must Avoid

If you see:

Theodora
Purification

Do not take that fight.

That is the Achilles heel.

If DoTs are removed, your scaling engine breaks.

---

## Accessibility – Why This Is Special

This is not theorycrafting for whales.

- Gilgamesh is cheap and farmable.
- Qin is easy to build.
- YSS and Charles are obtainable through Earth fragments and events.
- Core skills (Executioner, Blade Vortex, Energy Shield, No Escape) are available in the Cinder Shop.

You can:

- Sell old skill stones.
- Reinvest Cinders.
- Build this almost entirely free.

The cost difference between this march and the spender builds it can defeat is enormous.

And yet — it can win.

That is rare.

---

## Final Thoughts

This build does not overpower the meta.

It reads the meta.

Executioner was not weak.
It was suppressed.

Now that purification is less common, continuous damage builds have room again — and Gilgamesh is the cleanest F2P platform for it.

If you are a low spender struggling to punch upward into mid/high spenders, this is one of the few builds in the current environment that:

- Holds elemental advantage
- Scales properly
- Is almost fully F2P accessible
- Punishes common Fu Fei Himiko structures

It is not universal.
It is not safe into Theodora.

But in the right matchups, it absolutely punches above its budget.

---

title: Lucky Spin (2.6.9)
summary: The Lucky Spin event in Infinity Kingdom is a fantastic opportunity for players to bolster their immortal roster. Whether you're a free-to-play player or a spender, this event provides a chance to obtain key immortals…
markdown:
### Player Guide: Lucky Spin Event in Infinity Kingdom

The Lucky Spin event in Infinity Kingdom is a fantastic opportunity for players to bolster their immortal roster. Whether you're a free-to-play player or a spender, this event provides a chance to obtain key immortals and valuable rewards. This guide will walk you through the mechanics of the event, the rewards, and some strategic tips to make the most out of it.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-112-1024x532.png)

## Event Overview

The Lucky Spin event allows players to use gems to purchase spins on the roulette wheel. Each spin has a chance to reward various prizes, with a 2.5% chance to win the grand prize of 60 epic immortal fragments. Spinning 40 times guarantees the grand prize, ensuring that players will eventually obtain the top reward.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-113.png)

### Key Details:

- **Maximum Spins per Day:** 50
- **Free Spins per Day:** 1
- **Spins to Clear the Wheel:** 40
- **Max Daily Purple Crystal Gain:** 2x 7000 = 14,000
- **Daily Gem Spend:** 14,700 (for max purple crystal gain)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-114.png)

## How to Participate

1. **Collect Gems:** Gems can be earned through gameplay, events, or by spending real money. Ensure you have enough gems to participate effectively.
2. **Select Your Reward:** Choose the immortal you want as the main reward from the available list. This includes high-tier immortals like Ragnar, Mehmet, Seondeok, Darius, Atalanta, and many others.
3. **Spin the Wheel:** Use your gems to spin the wheel. Each spin has a chance to win various rewards, with a 2.5% chance for the grand prize.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-115.png)

## Available Immortals

The Lucky Spin event offers a variety of top-tier immortals, many of which are otherwise paywalled. These include:

- Ragnar
- Mehmet
- Seondeok
- Darius
- Atalanta
- Margaret
- Yi Sun-Shin
- Trajan
- Louis
- Mathilda
- Artemisia
- Pakal
- Empress Wu
- Tokugawa
- Toyotomi
- Dido
- Arash
- Cyrus
- Hammurabi
- Emperor Qin

This selection covers a wide range of classic elements, making it possible for all players to build competitive teams.

## Rewards

In addition to immortal fragments, the wheel offers:

| What you get from a wheel clear? | Shards/reward |
| --- | --- |
| Jackpot Epic Immortal | 60 |
| Dragon Crystals Selection Chest | 100 |
| Rare Dragon Chest Key | 1 |
| Speedups | 2x3h |
| Market Refreshes | 20 |
| Experiance Scrolls | 1x 10K |
| Experiance Scrolls | 5x 1K |
| Gold | 1x20K |
| Grain | 2x100K |
| Stone | 2x100K |
| Wood | 2x100K |
| Iron | 2x100K |

These rewards can significantly boost your progress in the game, especially for building out your original element teams.

## Strategy and Tips

### Maximizing Value

1. **Daily Free Spin:** Always use your daily free spin to maximize your chances without spending gems.
2. **Save Gems:** Accumulate gems in preparation for the event. This allows you to make the most of the guaranteed grand prize after 40 spins.
3. **Focus on Key Immortals:** Select an immortal that fits your current team needs or one that will complete your setup.

### Calculating Costs

- **Average Gem Cost per Immortal Fragment:** Assuming you need to spin 40 times to get the grand prize, you will spend 12,000 gems per 60 fragments, which equals 200 gems per fragment.
- **Total Cost to Max an Immortal:** To max out an immortal (1020 fragments), you will need approximately 204,000 gems. This is a feasible target if you save up over time and complement your fragments from other sources.

### Purple Crystal Grinding

While some guides suggest using the Lucky Spin for grinding purple crystals, it's not the most efficient method. You can convert gems to purple crystals at a roughly 1:1 ratio, but there are better ways to earn crystals. [**Check out dedicated guides for more efficient crystal farming methods.**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/tower-of-knowledge-passives/purple-crystal-maximum-efficiency-2/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-116.png)

## Conclusion

The Lucky Spin event is a valuable opportunity to obtain powerful immortals and other rewards in Infinity Kingdom. By understanding the mechanics, planning your gem usage, and selecting the right immortals, you can make significant progress in your game. Happy spinning, and may the odds be in your favor!

title: Magic Artifact Bonus: Crit vs %dmg (Annihilation vs Deadly Bonus)
summary: In this guide we are going to have a look at the Magic Artifacts of Infinity Kingdom. For this one, we are going to do a dive deep into the world of Magic Artifact Bonuses. The choice of either Annihilation or Deadly…
markdown:
In this guide we are going to have a look at the Magic Artifacts of Infinity Kingdom. For this one, we are going to do a dive deep into the world of Magic Artifact Bonuses. The choice of either Annihilation or Deadly Bonus on artifacts is a complex choice.

Let's figure it out togeather!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-17.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-18.png)

## Annihilation versus Deadly

So how can it be that we have not given a streight answer as to which one is better? Annihilation or Deadly? Surely one must be better than the other? Truth is, the answer to that question is more complex than a simple binary answer.

Well then we are building our mages without chase and **we need to figure out if Annihilation crit bonus is still better than the Deadly damage buff**. Lucky for you, I have made the tests for you so you don't have to!

## Testing

I have been testing out a ton. My tests have been made by setting up a lonely **Empress Wu to fight a**lonely **Charles**. I **repeated**this fight a total of **40 times** and recorded all avg. values for Imperial Fire Ultimates. Please see the data in the bottom of this article.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-10-28-152531-1024x573.png)

What I found was, that the value of adding either 10% Magical damage or adding 20% Crit Damage depends entirely on your crit chance. Makes sense right? The more we crit, the more value we get from added critial damage.

We always gain a boost to our damage from plain magic damage boost. Contrary, when we do not land a critical hit we gain no value at all from crit damage. But because the damage added by Crit Damage boost is double that of Magical Damage boost, we have a specific **crit chance threshold** we have to reach before adding 20% Critical Damage becomes more powerful than adding flat 10% Magical Damage.

## Critical Chance Threshold

Based on the avg. value of our test data (read above and below) I calculated what the damage would be on avg. given 100 hits of Imperial Fire with each artifact bonus and for multiple different critical hit chance percentages.

**Example of the equation: 10% critical hit chance**
With 10% crit chance we get 90 normal hits and 10 critical hits, as such the equation become

**Deadly**: Damage = **(** ( avg. normal hit dmg * 90 ) + ( avg. crit hit dmg * 10) **)** * 1,1
**Annihilation**: Damage = ( avg. normal hit dmg * 90 ) + ( **(** avg. crit hit dmg * 10**)** * 1,2)

## Results

| 100 hits | Imperial Fire Empress Wu |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crit chance | Deadly 10% spell dmg | Annihilation 20% crit damage |
| 5% | 14.802.883 | 13.674.379 |
| 10% | 15.281.335 | 14.326.550 |
| 15% | 15.759.788 | 14.978.720 |
| 20% | 16.238.240 | 15.630.891 |
| 30% | 17.195.146 | 16.935.232 |
| 35% | 17.673.598 | 17.587.402 |
| 37% | 17.864.979 | 17.848.270 |
| 38% | 17.960.670 | 17.978.704 |
| 40% | 18.152.051 | 18.239.572 |
| 45% | 18.630.504 | 18.891.743 |
| 50% | 19.108.956 | 19.543.913 |
| 60% | 20.065.862 | 20.848.254 |

## Conclusion

You need to test the critical hit chance of your magic Immortals yourself. Check your reports and see if you are getting value from Annihilation or be better of with Deadly.

**If you have a critical hit chance of 38% or higher = then you want to run Annihilation Bonus Artifact on your Mage.**

**If you have a critical hit chance of 37% or lower = then you want to run Deadly Bonus Artifact on your Mage.**

In my opinion, the best way to test what your critical hit chance is against both enemies with Malice and without Malice, is to go to the Arena. Find a buddy to test on. Run your setup and give your mage Death Breath and attack your buddy many times both with him running Malice and without him running Malice. This will give you a good idea of your critical hit chance on your mage because Death Breath has an absurd high count of damage instances per fight.

For example, by repeating this fight against by buddy a couple times I quickly get a couple hundres data points.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-19.png)

That's it for this guide on Magical Artifact Bonuses! Best of luck in your own testing!

title: Magic Lightning With Hammurabi & Khan (patch 2.3)
summary: This guide is part of my article series on lightning builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB…
markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on lightning builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

This article is on magic lightning. As you know, there are many water and earth mains, which makes lightning a strong team to master. Moreover, Lightning is surprisingly strong as a F2P or low-spender! If you are patient and smart about it, you can **unlock Genghis Khan for free** via events like Spring Fiesta + you can unlock **Hammurabi through the KoH**(needs to be maxed via Pearl shop tho). **This makes our BiS lightning team one of the cheapest top tier marches.**

This is a very strong build that works as an allround lightning build for the player who needs lightning to do everything. Beware, that you may struggle a bit on bosses. As such, you should check out my lightning boss build.

This build loses to shadow, like most others, but perform at a mid-tier level vs shadow. It however, perform VERY WELL versus holy, murders any earth and is an **invaluable tool to have when you and a bunch of low-spenders are rallying down big whales.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/image-29-1024x552.png)

## Setup

This setup is pretty standard and revolves around pumping big magic burst damage while maintaining "**wounds**" from Khan as well as control via Richard stun and fighting will on Peter.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215920-1024x624.png)

Moreover, Peter and Khan adds a very nice assistance on the DPS. This setup is NOT built as a counter to holy, you can do more to counter holy marches (see Lightning holy-counter guide).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215855-1024x622.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215425-1024x617.png)

This setup performs well versus all marches and especially kills earth teams (if your tech is too low for energy regen. You might need to setup your Khan with adrenaline so you get wounds off before water dragon heals).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215455.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215505.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215447.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215439.png)

### You want to run this passive loadout:

**Hammurabi**: Annihilation + Nova + Chase/concentration (*based on your crit tech*).

**Genghis Khan**: Death Breath + Anger + Energy Burst

**Peter**: Fighting Will + Weakness + Cleave

**Richard**: Oaken Guard + Malice + Energy Suppression / life link *(Defense vs. offense)*

title: Magic-Merlin Madness

markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-162-1024x574.png)

Infinity Kingdom recently added a new mini-game, Battle Chess, which offers a refreshing chess-like format that features familiar Immortals and spells. Since the game mode is still in its early stages, the meta is yet to settle. However, we have found an extremely strong and fun build that has been delivering excellent results.

## The build

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-161-1024x366.png)

### IMMORTALS

In this build, we have selected five Immortals, each with unique abilities to offer. **The first is Merlin**, whose magical proc-damage ability can deal massive damage to opponents. Every time we spend 2 arcane cards, we can proc his skill and deal 50 x 5 damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-163.png)

The second Immortal is **Lancelot**, who is a cost-effective meat-shield that can soak up damage and win 1:1 against weaker solo Immortals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-164.png)

The third Immortal is **Amanitore**, whose ability is to reduce the cost of arcane cards by 1 on every cast. This makes it possible for us to spam all our spells instantly and infinitely once we get a couple of her on the field.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-165.png)

The fourth Immortal, **Moctezuma**I, is an essential part of this build. He provides extra Energy Marks, but at the cost of his own HP. Nevertheless, we can heal him, keeping him alive for a long time and getting a ton of free Energy Marks.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-166.png)

The fifth and final Immortal is **Zenobia**, who has excellent healing abilities. We can spawn a couple of her to keep our Monte's at higher levels at the cost of her own HP. This mechanic helps us level out the health loss across multiple Immortals, making it easier to keep everyone alive using a healing spell card.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-167.png)

### ARCANE SPELL CARDS

Our arcane spell cards consist of four options that serve different purposes. **Blizzard**is an excellent skill that deals 180 damage in a large area of effect, making it suitable for clearing out weaker immortals and dealing with summoners like Edward and Cleo.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-168.png)

**Tsunami**is another spell that deals 100 damage but only costs two Energy Marks, making it a suitable spell for getting initial Merlin procs and add-clear ability. It also kills YSG Immortals and the pets of Cleo and Edward, which many players are currently using.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-169.png)

**Healing Wave** is a crucial spell that can heal every Immortal in a large area of effect, costing only 3 Energy Marks. This means we can place Healing Wave on top of our army of Monte's and Zeno's, keeping all of them alive.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-170.png)

The final spell in our build is **Blast**, which deals 100 damage in a small area of effect and applies a damage over time effect (DoT Burn) that causes an additional 50 damage per second for three seconds, making it a total of 250 damage. Although Blast is an expensive spell, that's not a problem for us because we have an army of Monte's and Amanitore's, enabling us to spam Blast at no cost.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-171.png)

## Gameplay

The core gameplay strategy behind this build is to get an exponential growth in Energy Mark income, which, in turn, is used to spam spells, proccing Merlin's ability to deal massive damage. The weakness of this build is that if you're up against someone with a lot of clear spells, you may have to spread out further to avoid losing your army of Monte's and Amanitore's.

Looking ahead, we plan to swap out Zenobia with Dido to further boost the damage output of Merlin's ability. This will mean we will need to stay more on top of healing our Monte's ourselves, but we believe that with the right timing, this build could become even more potent. In conclusion, Battle Chess is an exciting and refreshing addition to Infinity Kingdom, and with the right build, it can be a fun and rewarding experience.
