### Player Guide: Navigating the "Original Festival" Event in Infinity Kingdom

The "Original Festival" is the latest seasonal event in Infinity Kingdom, featuring a familiar format with exciting opportunities to earn unique rewards through daily quests and event-specific activities. This guide will walk you through the event tabs, strategies for maximizing your rewards, and recommendations to get the most out of this event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-113-1024x576.png)

## Event Structure and Key Activities

### 1. Wonderous Celebration: Daily Quests

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-103-1024x561.png)

This tab is your go-to throughout the seven-day event. Completing the daily quests not only yields valuable rewards like 40 stardust and 30 Original Crystals but also provides Paint Brushes needed for the Colorful Party tab.

**Strategies**:

- Ensure completion of daily quests to accumulate Paint Brushes.
- Focus on maximizing your daily rewards to build towards larger event goals.

### 2. Surprise Original Festival: Farmable Currency

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-104-1024x555.png)

While not a separate event tab, this aspect encourages players to engage in regular activities such as defeating gnomes and gathering resources to earn Floral Coins, whimsically referred to as Bunny Coins due to their appearance.

**Tips**:

- Regular participation in standard game activities is crucial to maximize your earnings of Floral Coins.

### 3. Colorful Party: Progress Through Painting

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-105-1024x563.png)

Use the Paint Brushes from daily quests to unlock rewards across 20 levels in three tiers: Free, 3.5K Gem Tier, and $20 Tier. Rewards include speedups, philosopher stones, resources, and notably, Original Crystals.

**Rewards Breakdown**:

- **Free Tier**: 3 Original Crystals
- **Gem Tier**: 12 Original Crystals
- **$20 Tier**: 45 Original Crystals

**Recommendation**:

- Invest in the $20 tier if feasible, as it significantly increases your total haul of Original Crystals, vital for purchasing top-tier rewards.

### 4. Redeem Event Tab: Exchanging Event Currency

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-106-1024x553.png)

This tab is where you spend Original Crystals for high-value items like Unique Artifacts and Chaos Immortal fragments.

In total completing the Wonderous Celebration daily quests and the free, gem and 20$ tier of the Colorful Party will net you a total of 90 Original Crystals. This is important to know for the fourth event tab, because this is the Redeem Event tab where we spend currency in exchange for the main event rewards.

First of all you want to make sure you farm enough **free currency** to get the 100 stardust and the 10x Philosopher’s chests. If you need epic immortals, you should go ahead and get the 60 fragments too. The rest of your free currency should be used to get as many speed ups as possible.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-108-1024x360.png)

For the **Original Crystal** rewards, you can buy 80 chaos immortal fragments for 130 crystals and you can get four unique artifacts (they are in selection chests as normal) for 38 crystals per unique artifact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-107-1024x343.png)

If you are after one of the unique artifacts, you can get your 38 crystals by simply competing the daily quests and spending 3.5K gems on the coloring event. That’s a full **Unique Artifact**for just 3500 gems, very cheap and very good value!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-109-1024x489.png)

If you are after the **Chaos Immortal Fragments** you are in need of additional crystals. You got a total of 90 crystals by completing the event and buying the 20$ reward tier in the coloring tab. You need 40 more which you have to obtain through the event bundles in the shop.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-111.png)

The bundles are **DAILY bundles** which is very good because it means you can get higher value out of them by buying the more efficient bundles every day. For 10$ you get 5 crystals, for 20$ you get 10 crystals, for 50$ you get 15 crystals. As you can see, the first two bundles are better value at 2$ per crystal whereas the 50$ bundle is only for those who need to buy everything (no one... don’t do it!) as it costs you 3.33$ per crystal here.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-112-1024x522.png)

Getting your last 40 crystals needed for the chaos immortal fragments you want to spend the required 80$ on these bundles in addition to the 20$ on the coloring event for a total of 100$ for 80 chaos immortal fragments. You can do this in three days by buying the 10$ and the 20$ on first two days and the last 20$ needed on the third day of the event. This is a very good price, in line with previous seasonal events and a huge recommendation for anyone with any chaos ambition. This is much better value than the normal chaos event roulette, so you wanna do this if you are building up a chaos immortal.

**Recommendations**: If you are thinking of going two artifacts unlocked you need 76 Crystals which is less than the 90 you get from the event so just buy the coloring 20$ tier and you get two full unique artifacts for just 20$! Very nice. If you need a third, you should think again. You are going to need 24 more crystals which you gotta spend 50$ on, I would not do that to be honest, the value here is not very good. So if you are after artifacts stick to the cheap 2 artifacts.

**Optimal Usage**:

- **Stardust and Philosopher’s Chests**: Prioritize these if you need to enhance your immortals' capabilities.
- **Chaos Immortal Fragments**: Requires 130 Original Crystals for 80 fragments. Consider purchasing the $20 coloring event tier and additional bundles to meet the crystal requirement.
- **Unique Artifacts**: Obtainable for 38 Original Crystals each. If targeting two artifacts, simply completing the event and buying the $20 tier suffices.

## In summation

The event introduces daily bundles that offer Original Crystals, providing an efficient way to reach your desired crystal count for top rewards:

- **$10 Bundle**: 5 crystals
- **$20 Bundle**: 10 crystals
- **$50 Bundle**: 15 crystals

**Budgeting for Chaos Immortal Fragments**:

- To acquire the necessary 40 additional crystals for the Chaos Immortal fragments, spending $80 on bundles over three days is recommended, supplemented by the $20 spent on the Colorful Party.

**Artifact Acquisition**:

- For two artifacts, the expenditure of $20 for the Colorful Party suffices.
- Pursuing a third artifact requires an additional 24 crystals, which may not offer the best value at $50.

## Conclusion

The "Original Festival" provides a structured pathway to significant rewards through engaging daily activities and strategic spending. By focusing on the efficient completion of daily quests and smart allocation of resources towards the Colorful Party and bundles, players can optimize their gains and significantly enhance their gameplay experience in Infinity Kingdom.

title: Original Festival 2026
summary: This event follows the same structural backbone as the Infinity Kingdom seasonal cycle, but introduces one of the most impactful side systems we’ve seen in a long time: Candy Defenders.
markdown:
## Introduction

This event follows the same structural backbone as the Infinity Kingdom seasonal cycle, but introduces one of the most impactful side systems we’ve seen in a long time: **Candy Defenders**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-40-1024x573.png)

At a glance, it looks like a standard token → grail → shop loop. In practice, the event splits into two parallel economies:

- **Traditional progression** → Tokens → Grails → Chaos / Artifacts
- **Resource acceleration** → Candy → Massive speedups piles / philosopher stones / soul crystals

Understanding how these two layers interact is what determines whether you treat this as a normal event—or extract far more value than usual.

---

## Judgment Realm (Battle Pass)

### Structure & Rewards

- Free track: **30 Tokens of Light**
- Paid track:  - +120 Tokens of Light
- 6000 Gems
- **Hall of Divine Might** skin (or upgrade)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-41-1024x533.png)

### Skin Value: Hall of Divine Might

This is where the pass becomes unusually strong.

- **Troop Attack %** (top-tier combat stat)
- **Troop Load %** (minor, but harmless)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-42-1024x514.png)

### Why Troop Attack Matters

As accounts scale, troop count increases exponentially. At that point:

- **Troop stats scale better than immortal stats**
- Attack % directly improves all formations, not just skill output

If upgraded, this skin starts competing with top-tier combat skins, especially in late game where you have scaled into very high troop counts.

---

## Dazzling Wish (Token Conversion)

### Updated Drop Rates

- 0.45% → 300 grails
- 1.55% → 50 grails
- 3.5% → 25 grails
- 12% → 5 grails
- 82.5% → 1 grail

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-43-1024x569.png)

### Expected yield

You can still treat: **1 Token ≈ ~4.2–4.3 Grails**

---

## Candy Defenders (New Core System)

### Mechanics

- Earn **Candy** from:  - Glorious Challenge
- Pinnacle Trial
- Grail Shop (via gnome farming)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-46.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-45-1024x350.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-44.png)

- Spend candy to attack a boss:  - Chance to deal damage
- Chance to receive rewards

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-47-1024x543.png)

### Reward Types

- Speedups (all types)
- Philosopher’s Stones
- Soul Crystals
- Resource boxes

**[Read standalone analysis of the expected rewards as well as how much candy it takes to kill a boss, incl. cost analysis in this guide.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/spring-fiesta/original-festival/candy-boss-madness-2026-original-festival-edition/)**

---

### Player Perspective

This is easily the highest raw resource value I’ve seen from a seasonal event.

What stands out is the **consistency of returns**:

- You are not chasing jackpots
- You are accumulating **bulk progression materials**

From experience, this directly impacts:

- **Tower of Knowledge progression** (stones)
- **Immortal development** (crystals & fragments)
- **Account tempo** (speedups)

Even on late-game accounts, speedups alone justify participation. On developing accounts, this system accelerates progression in multiple bottlenecks simultaneously.

---

## Lucky Koi

### Structure

- Daily free token
- $5 bundle:  - 5 Tokens
- Gems + VIP
- Grail lottery (up to 4250)
- Guaranteed **850 grails after 5 purchases**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-48-1024x553.png)

A highly recommended purchase for anyone building into chaos immortals as this is the best chaos-immortal efficiency in the game from a cost-effectiveness perspective.

---

## Fertile Harvest (Gnome Farming)

### Function

- Kill gnomes → earn **Original Crystals**
- Convert into **Candy** via shop

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-49-1024x547.png)

This is a secondary farming system, the drop rate is not impressive so this will not be your main collection method for Candy. But it is a nice little off thing for free.

---

## Grail Shop & Chaos Economy

### Grail Costs

- Tengu: **750 grails**
- Fu Fei: **450 grails**
- Athena / Wukong / Loki / Poseidon: **250 grails (daily stock)**
- Artifacts:  - 1050 (Tengu)
- 1000 (others)
- 600 (Fu Fei)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-50-1024x561.png)

Because there is no new immortal pressure, this event is pretty much all about steady chaos immortal progression for most players.

- Daily 250-grail purchases or the 450 Fu Fei purchase are often the best long-term value for mid-spenders, etc.
- Saving for 750-tier depends on your current roster gaps but diving into this tier means expensive immortals where you should expect to also spend significantly during other events (e.g. Rune Factory).

The decision becomes account-specific rather than event-driven.

---

## Glorious Challenge

### Key Mechanics

- Same structure as before
- Day 4 → Hard Mode
- Currency: **Flowers (Original Festival Coins)**
- Also generates **Candy**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-51-1024x564.png)

### Strategy Update

Daily shop stock still applies, so:

### Early Days (1–3):

- Spend enough to avoid capping
- Secure daily purchases

### Day 4+:

- Push hard mode
- Optimize farming efficiency

---

## Pinnacle Trial

### Rewards

- Immortal fragments
- Tokens of Light
- **Large amounts of Candy (from Day 3+)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-52-1024x556.png)

### Player Perspective

This seasonal event Pinnacle Trial is a lot more important as it is a **major Candy source** and as such a key contributor to overall event value. Even partial progression here has meaningful returns.

---

## Conclusion Summary

This event looks standard—but plays very differently.

### Key Takeaways

- **Token value remains stable (~4.3 grails)**
- **Battle pass is stronger than usual** due to Divine Might skin
- **No new chaos immortal** shifts focus to efficiency, not urgency
- **Candy Defenders is the real centerpiece**

---

title: Overview: Dragon Talent Specializations and Nodes
summary: With patch 2.3 we have an entirely new feature available. Talent trees for Dragons! Each Dragon has a unique talent tree consisting of:
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-67.png)

## Talent trees for Dragons!

With patch 2.3 we have an entirely new feature available. Talent trees for Dragons! Each Dragon has a unique talent tree consisting of:

- Dragon Specialization
- Prime nodes that alter how the dragons 3 unique abilities work.
- Small nodes offering different stat-bonuses.
- Major nodes offering bonus damage / reduced damage taken.

Upgrading your dragon has become more complex than ever.

 **Let's get into training your dragons!**

## Dragon Specialization

**Each dragon offer three different specializations**. For instance, the earth dragon offer the following three specializations:Collapse, Aftershock and Fissure and the fire dragon has: Wildfire, Calamity and Prairie Fire.

**All dragons and their specializations, which specialization you need to choose for which march setup and much more is available in my articles on each of the elemental dragon specializations**. See all elemental guides here: [**Dragon Talent Guides**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-64.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-65.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-66.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-163006-1024x433.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-163000-1024x464.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-162954-1024x448.png)

Each specialization has **two unique effects** on the dragon's original abilities. For instance, Wildfire changed the burn on dragon's breath and removes the critical damage buff from roar and instead provides physical and defense buffs once immortals crit. These are abilities you want to study closely and you MUST think of what your specific march setup is built to do.

**There is no "best specialization" there is only best synergy with the Immortal and ToK build you are running.**

## Prime Unique nodes

You have Prime nodes which are determined by your specialization. For instance, I have chosen Fissure for my earth dragon in these images. As such, my Dragon's talent tree is populated by Sandstorm Breath and Earth Roar Prime nodes.

These nodes are on the outskirts of your talent tree. **There are 10 ranks to each of the new Prime Specialization Abilities**. See images below.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-69.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Skaermbillede-2022-08-18-160507.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-71.png)

These are unlocked my spending **Dragon Elemental Crystals** (like we are used to). [These can be obtained from gnome bosses (**read more**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-soul-fragments-crystals/obtain-dragon-soul-crystals/)).

Furthermore, you need to spend**Dragon Essences** to unlock each new rank of your specialization ability. [These can be obtained in various ways (**read more**).](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/dragon/dragon-talents-patch-2-3/dragon-essences-how-to-get-them/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-72.png)

## Moving around the talent tree

You have a large tree, and not all of the buffs and stats are relevant for you. For instance, my earth-wind hybrid main does not benefit from magic damage at all, so why would I want to spend crystals on that? Well I need to move around the talent tree and to do that I need to level up the minor nodes on the tree.

**Once you level up a minor node to level 3 you can access the node behind it.** As you can see below, the arrows show how I unlock new minor nodes once I level up the first nodes to level 3. After that, it is important to note that you need BOTH sides connecting into a higher node to unlock it. As such, the nodes marked in blue below are required to unlock the node above. The highest node is the Major node here (in gray with arrows towards it). I need to unlock ALL other minor nodes in this section of the tree (blue) to unlock my Major.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/image-73.png)

title: Panda Festival in 2025
summary: Seasonal Event • Theme: Panda / Martial Arts • Duration: 10 Days
markdown:
## 🐼 Kung Fu Festival Event (2025)

*Seasonal Event • Theme: Panda / Martial Arts • Duration: 10 Days*

Infinity Kingdom’s latest seasonal event brings a fresh spin to the usual lineup — a full **Kung Fu Panda-inspired** theme featuring bamboo-decorated menus, martial arts motifs, and even a castle skin with a literal panda!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-88-1024x576.png)

Gameplay-wise, it follows the same familiar structure as other seasonal events like the **Harvest Festival** or **Midsummer Celebration**: you’ve got your **Glory Challenge**, **Pinnacle Trial**, **Dashing Wish**, and the **Seasonal Shop**. The big difference this time is the addition of the **Lucky Koi Lottery** — a $5 entry system with a jackpot prize of **4,000 Insignias**.

---

## Event Structure & Main Rewards

### 1. Glory Challenge

Classic event structure. Normal mode runs first, then **Hard Mode unlocks around Day 4**.
Waiting to spend credentials until Hard Mode is available is the smart move — each raid there gives roughly **250+ points**, letting you nearly clear the shop by the end of the event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-89-1024x565.png)

### 2. Pinnacle Trial

Completing all Pinnicle Trials missions grants **30 Skyriver Palace fragments**, and another **30 fragments** come from the Battle Pass. That’s **60 total fragments**, enough to unlock or upgrade one of the best all-purpose castle skins in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-90-1024x509.png)

Skyriver Palace is still one of the top PvP skins, mainly because of its strong offensive combat buffs, making this a great time to upgrade it. In my opinion, Abyssal Palace currently holds the crown — its Troop Attack buff is the most powerful overall. Right behind it, I’d put Sun Chariot, not just for its defensive stats but for the **marching speed boost** that lets you outmaneuver opponents so easily. That extra mobility can completely change how fights play out. Because of that, I’d rank Skyriver’s in third place overall for me personally and how I play, but in terms of pure combat buffs it sits comfortably in second place. Also, don’t forget Skyriver’s utility bonus: **-3% death rate**, which helps conserve troops over long battles — a small but valuable perk.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-91-1024x472.png)

### 3. Battle Pass (Kung Fu Master Edition)

This one’s visually stunning — dojo rooftops, lantern glow, swirling mist, and a meditating panda on the balcony.

The Kung Fu Master castle skin does technically have combat buffs, but it’s nowhere near competitive compared to the top-tier options. Its **+3% Troop HP** at max level gives only a small survivability boost, and while the **+15% March Speed** is nice for repositioning or farming, it doesn’t really help in serious PvP fights.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-92-1024x531.png)

In practice, this skin just doesn’t move the needle like **Abyssal Palace’s attack buff**, **Sun Chariot’s defensive + mobility combo**, or even **Skyriver Palace’s offensive setup**. It’s mainly a **collector’s or style skin** — great visuals, fun theme, but not something you’d equip when power matters. Think of it as more of a “flex” piece than a performance skin.

But when it comes to stats, it’s more for collectors than for combat:

| Level | Troop HP Buff | March Speed Buff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | +2 % | +5 % |
| 10 | +3 % | +15 % |

That +3% HP at max level is among the weakest buffs for any combat skin. The +15% march speed is handy for farming or repositioning, but not impactful in PvP.

If you’re going for efficiency, **buy the pass for the Skyriver Palace fragments**, not for the Kung Fu Master stats.

---

## 🎟️ New Feature — Lucky Koi Lottery

As with previous seasonal events, we have a daily login and get a reward. The Daily Sign-in is bundles in with the new Lucky Koi feature. Here we get 10x Token of Light to be spent in the Dazzling Wish.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-95-1024x548.png)

This is the big new feature of the event.

- Entry costs **$5 USD per ticket**.
- Each ticket gives some **gems as a baseline reward** and a chance to win **4,000 Insignias**.
- Every player gets **one free ticket daily** via login rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-93-1024x559.png)

At the time of writing, there were roughly **3,317 participants per bracket** and **only one jackpot winner per bracket**, so the odds are around 1 in 3,000. Not amazing, but not real-world lottery bad either.

If you hit the jackpot, 4,000 Insignias equals:

- ~400 Chaos Immortal fragments, or
- 3 full Chaos Artifacts (with currency left over).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-94-1024x393.png)

Realistically, the gem value already makes the $5 ticket not a total waste, but it’s definitely more of a **fun gamble** than a smart investment.

### Speculation

While not confirmed, it looks like Lucky Koi might **become a recurring feature**. It’s integrated directly into the **daily login tab**, which to me signals a new-permanent addition rather than a one-off. Usually I find they make a standalone mini-event for none-recurrent elements. But no way to know! Here’s hoping it sticks around — it adds a fun little surprise each day if you are inclined to participate in the lottery!

---

## Event Shop Highlights

- **Panda Chat Box:** Bamboo-styled frame with an ink-brush aesthetic. Very clean look.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-96.png)

- **Panda Frame:** Simple, thematic, and looks great with most avatars.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-97.png)

- Make sure to get: **Artifact Fragment Chests / Stardust / Speedups:** In that priority order.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-98-1024x289.png)

- **Cosmetics + Resources:** Grab these last if you’ve got spare currency.

**Tip:** Save your credentials until Hard Mode opens — this gives better efficiency and makes it possible to nearly clear the entire shop by event end.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-99-1024x289.png)

---

## 💫 Dazzling Wish

The **Dazzling Wish** tab is the event’s gacha-style feature, where you spend **Tokens of Light** to draw for a wide range of rewards. It’s flashy, fun, and filled with tempting jackpots — but like all luck-based draws in IK, the odds are rough.

#### 🎁 Reward Pool & Drop Rates

Here’s the official breakdown of rewards and their drop chances:

- 🎯 **0.05%** – 60x *Kung Fu Master Castle Skin Fragments* (headline jackpot, but not that valuable since the Battle Pass already gives a full unlock)
- ⚡ **0.45%** – 80x *Chaos Immortal Selection Chests* ← *the real jackpot*
- 🗡️ **0.6%** – 60x *Unique Artifact Chaos Selection Chests* ← *also top-tier reward*
- 💥 **2.5%** – 5x *Chaos Immortal Selection Chests*
- ⚙️ **3%** – 5x *Unique Artifact Chaos Selection Chests*
- 🔮 **6%** – 1x *Random Chaos Immortal Fragment*
- 🌑 **7.4%** – 1x *Random Holy or Shadow Immortal Fragment*
- 💧 **10%** – *Water Artifact Selection Chest*
- 🌍 **10%** – *Random Earth Immortal Fragment*
- 🐉 **10%** – *Eternal Dragon Soul Chest* (10x Holy or Shadow Crystals)
- 🌪️ **10%** – *Random Wind Immortal Fragment*
- 💎 **10%** – *Precious Dragon Crystal Selection Chest* (30x regular elements or 20x wind)
- 📜 **10%** – *Artifact Schematic Fragment Selection Chest*
- 🔥 **10%** – *Random Fire Immortal Fragment*
- ⚡ **10%** – *Random Lightning Immortal Fragment*

#### 💎 Real Jackpot Value

While the castle skin fragments headline the list, the **real jackpots** here are definitely the **Chaos Immortal** and **Unique Artifact Chaos** fragment bundles. Pulling either of those gives serious account value — but they’re both extremely rare. With only **0.45% and 0.6%** odds, you’ll need a whole lot of luck to hit one.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-103-1024x595.png)

At a **$1–$2 cost per Token of Light**, here’s the math:

- Expected cost per 80 Chaos Immortal fragments = ~$222 total spins on average.
- That’s roughly **$2.78 per fragment** if you’re buying the cheaper token packs, or **$5.56 per fragment** with the expensive ones.

So yeah — **not efficient at all** unless RNG smiles on you.

#### 💰 Token of Light Purchase Options

Tokens of Light can be bought from multiple bundles during the event:

- **Profile Picture Bundle:** 25 tokens for $50 (once per event)
- **Daily Bundles:**  - 4 stock × 3 tokens for $3 each
- 6 stock × 5 tokens for $5 each
- 8 stock × 8 tokens for $10 each
- 10 stock × 12 tokens for $20 each
- 12 stock × 30 tokens for $50 each
- 20 stock × 60 tokens for $100 each

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-101.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-102-1024x538.png)

Bundles on the **GTarcade App** are identical — so no discount this time. However, buying on both platforms effectively doubles your daily purchase cap, which is great if you’re trying to whale hard for leaderboard rewards.

#### 🏆 Ranking System

Just like other seasonal wish events, **Dazzling Wish includes a ranking board** that resets daily. The top spenders each day earn **extra Skyriver Castle Fragments**, which can be huge if you’re already investing heavily. It’s a nice bonus for whales but requires you to outspend your bracket to secure the rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-100-1024x626.png)

---

## Player Perspective

Visually, this might be the coolest seasonal event IK’s done in a while. The Kung Fu Master castle skin is incredible and visually I must have it.

What I will do:

- I will **get the Battle Pass** for Skyriver Palace fragments and the cool Panda skin for my collection.
- I will **buy one or two Lucky Koi ticket** just for the thrill (the gem value softens the loss).
- I will make sure to empty the **shop for artifacts and stardust.**
- I will **not**be buying Token of Lights, the pricing to rank is far out of my budget.

---

title: Passive Resource farming part 1
summary: Farming resources for your main is crucially important for any player in Infinity Kingdom. However, not everyone has the time to spend a few hours every day sending army after army to kill dead castles with all our many…
markdown:
Farming resources for your main is crucially important for any player in Infinity Kingdom. However, not everyone has the time to spend a few hours every day sending army after army to kill dead castles with all our many alts. Instead, what you can choose to set up passive-alts.

If you do not have the time to spend AP on alts attacking castles all over Norheim, then you may want to simply create a farmvile group of alts where you only do the bare minimum and still achieve quite solid resource income (almost) without moving a finger.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-84.png)

## Method 1

You create as many alts as you can handle. You need to grow your alts to increase the level of your resource farms (quarry, lumber, smelter and farm). What you want to do is simple. Login once a day and:

1. Keep buildings upgrading, no rushing castles or tiers. Just upgrade from the "bottom" with farms first then rest and just make sure you don't have downtime when upgrading a castle level is required.
2. Spend your wishes for free resources (almost always stone or wood)
3. Collect Alliance Resources
4. attack your alt 1-2 times with your main account to clear out the passively generated resources from the castle's farms.

**DO NOT collect resources from the alt's farms.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-85-1024x439.png)

## Growing alts

Make sure you have all your alts in the same alt-alliance and in a high level alt alliance with full roster of resource producing cities in Norheim. The resources generated through wishing and alliance city taxes is enough combined with quest rewards to keep you upgrading pretty consistently. If you want to grow faster, you can "invest" resources by not farming the alts until they reach a decent size.

It is also very important that you are running multiple instances to grow alts fast. Let's say you have 5 instances open at a time. Each account with 3 alts in your server and in the same alliance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-53-1024x574.png)

What you do is simple. You begin buildings on the first 5 + click help. If building finished instantly, begin a new and click help. Once you have buildings high enough level that they do not instant finish. Move on to the next 5 alts in the same instances and do the same.

Having 15-helps just from yourself means that you can cap the alliance help-boost very fast and build the first many levels of buildings instantly without any speedups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-86-1024x132.png)

After you reach a higher level, you simply do the method 1 rotation.

This method centeres around leveling up your alts farms to the point where you consistently get 12-15 million resources per day from each farm (around castle level 40-45). However, it does take a while to grow your alts and as such it is a big time investment. It pays off very well and I personally feel it is very much worth the time invested given the many billions of resources I have farmed from my alts at this point.

However, there is also an alternative method which requires almost no activity but still a decent resource income - albeit at higher AP expense for your main castle. In part to of this guide you can learn how to setup a massive farm that requires no building upgrades.[**Read more about this Method 2 here.**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/resources/passive-resource-farming/method-2-farming-low-level-alts-easily-and-efficiently/)

title: Passive Skill Combos / strategies
summary: ToK Skills are the Tower of Knowledge skills you can buy for Soul Crystals in the game to enhance your marches' DPS, Control or Sustain, as well as to grant some special effects.
markdown:
ToK Skills are the Tower of Knowledge skills you can buy for Soul Crystals in the game to enhance your marches' DPS, Control or Sustain, as well as to grant some special effects.

Asking for what is the best blessing or aura on a specific immortal wouldn't be the correct quesiton. Instead, you should ask what are your team's **strengths**and **vulnerabilities**so you know what auras and blessings best fit your team as a whole.

As an example, Fire has a very **strong**DPS while being very **vulnerable** to physical damage. That way, you can push this strength by adding Weakness(increases crit), while adding Oaken(reduces physical damage taken) and Misleading(increases your dodge) to protect you against Physical damage.

In addition, you have to think about how the elemental **dragon**interacts with ToK skills. For example, the fire dragon scales damage from buff = blessings gain increased value for fire teams. Same with debuffs for Lightning.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/image-8-1024x538.png)

You can think about your teams vulnerabilities but some of the best combos are:

## For blessings

- **Oaken + Resist**: Strong protection for 18s, so it's the safest option when it comes to blessings.
- **Rage Bless + Energy Suppression**: Useful at getting first hits on enemies, meaning they don't get to do as much damage back to you. Take into account this combo doesn't work properly for fire*.
- **Oaken + Energy Suppression**: Uses the best sides of each of the skills above. Useful for delaying Khan from casting his skill before your Water dragon heals.
- **War Bless + Defense Blesss**: More useful for second or third marches, but still a good combo.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/50.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/20.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/25.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/26.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/27.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/28.png)

## For Auras, you can choose 2 to 4 of the following:

- **Malice** is such a powerful defensive skill for it's reduction in crit rates by 20% for the enemy, which basically means you take around 20% less damage. Almost a must have skill for a main team.
- **Weakness**: Like Malice but offensive. You buff your crit rate by 20%, so very usefull for any team and a must have for fire or teams that want to use Energy Burst or Chase.
- **Misleading**: Increasing your Dodge by 20% means a big reduction in enemy DPS, but also soft-counters Crowd Control(CC) effects like Attila's silence, as you can dodge 20% of his ultimates.
- **Coercion**: Can be used in any team but it is a must have skill on teams that have no mages, such as Lightning and Holy. Not using this skill would make you very vulnerable against Misleading users.
- **Shelter**: Very strong healing in a single aura. It is best used in sustain marches like Earth, as the value there only increases as the fight prolongues.
- **Sacrifice**: This is a mini version of Weakness. Buffing the DPS of 2 immortals by 15% is still solid and worthy using on second marches.
- **Berserk**: Not the best aura but this skill brings some healing and attack speed, so it's best used in Earth or Wind, since both benefit a lot from increased attack speed.

## The most noteworthy combinations you need to know about

The skills availble in the Tower of Knowledge, have a very high variety in terms of effect. While most skills revolve around damage and protection many are more utalitarian and can be used to create powerful combinations. We have tanky skills like Absolute Defense, some give tanks offense ability such as Life Link. Others provide control immunities, i.e. Fighting Master and we have Duel Master, that bring protecting against anti-heal effects.

1. **Adrenaline Rush(AR)** is great on frontline immortals who have very strong Ultimate Skills and low innate Energy Regen(ER). So it goes great on Charles, William, Saladin, Peter and Attila.

2. **Energy Burst(EB)** is equivalent to AR but made for backline immortals or immortals with high crit rate. Since Damage over Time(DoT) skills can actually crit, this skill is very well used on Gilgamesh and Elizabeth. But also does very well on the immortals with highest crit in the game: mages(not so good on Wu tho, her natural energy regen is too high already).

Just make sure you are using Death Breath or other high hit rate skills such as Cleave, Nova or Chaotic Blade for the number of crits to be even higher. Other honorable mentions of immortals that go well with EB would be Hippolyta and William, since fire has such high crit rate.

3. **Demon Body** is an underrated skill. I would call it a mini-Khan, as it bring an anti-heal effect around 1/3 as good as Khan's.

4. **Silence**is another underrated skill. It is a mini-Attila! And very good investment early on, as it is a blue skill, only falling behind other stronger skills at the late game.

5. **Root**is the last of the extreemly underated skills I will mention. It often rivals fire nova / toxic nova in damage and provides more control than Richard!

6. **Duel Master** is a weaker version of Anger, but brings you immunity to anti-heal, so you could use it on heal based teams.

7. **Absolute Defense(AD)** is the best defensive skill for backline immortals, as it allows our squishy backlines to negative huge amounts of damage. This skill is very RNG based and needs to be at a high level to be consistent enough

8. **Life Link(LL)** is a hybrid skill, since it reduces incoming damage while dealing damage back to the enemy. It can be used on any frontline immortal and is best used on Sustain based teams, since healing means you can take and reflect more damage.

9. **Fighting Will(FW)** does some damage but it's main use is to root the enemy, disabling them from doing normal attacks and casting ToK skills. A very strong skill in any team, but, again, best used in teams that posses healing, since you can recharge it's uses.

10. **Fighting Master(FM)** is great on Crowd Control immortals or mages. The idea is FM is used to protect skills of big value from getting stunned or silenced. So it can be used on Attila, Hippo, Charles or any Mages... to protect their Ultimate skills, and preferably let it protect other big value skills like Annihilation, Fighting Will and Assist.

11. **Speaking of Assist**, this is one of the best skills in the game. Instead of having multiple immortals carrying Damage skills, this skill allows you to condese all DPS skills on one or two immortals, while the rest of the team focuses on keeping them alive!

There are two main ways of using assist:

- You can use it on a frontline immortal, by running Assist+FW/LL/FM.
- Or, you can have it on your Range/Support immortal, by running Assist+AD/FW/LL/FM.

All of these 2 skill combos meantioned are viable. It is recommended to leave the 3rd skill slot for an aura.

**Special thank you to Mr. Harddus for providing most of the information above!** <3

title: Passive Skills
summary: Passive Tower of Knowledge skills are skills which provide their effects permanently when equipped. They only work on the single Immortal they are equipped but they need no trigger, have no duration timer, cannot be…
categoryPath: Different skill mechanics (Triggered, Passives, Graces, Blessings, Aura)
markdown:
Passive Tower of Knowledge skills are skills which provide their effects permanently when equipped. **They only work on the single Immortal they are equipped but they need no trigger, have no duration timer, cannot be despelled.** They simply provide their boon and that’s it!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135745.png)

There are a few different types of Passive Skills. **They have three purposes**:

1. Offensive
2. Defensive
3. Utility

### 1. Offensive Passives

For offensive passives you have skills such as Concentration, Anger, Duel Master, Rage. These provide a flat bonus to your Immortal which increase the damage dealt by your Immortal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135638.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135706.png)

For instance, Concentration boosts a mage's magical damage dealt by 30% (MASSIVE) and likewise ít's counterpart Anger provides 30% more physical damage dealt (also MASSIVE).

### 2. Defensive Passives

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135723.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135734.png)

Defensive Passives such as Physical Shield and Magical Shield, provides a flat boost to your defenses. As their names suggest, Physical Shield gives you enhanced protection against physical damage and makes your single Immortal take 30% less physical damage. Likewise, Magical Shield provides 30% less magical damage taken.

### 3. Utility Passives

These are some of the most interesting skills in all of Infinity Kingdom. They are extreemly powerful to use as hard counters against certain enemy setups. They provide highly specific and niche buffs / Immunities to your Immortals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135745.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Skaermbillede-2022-12-13-135713.png)

For example, Duel Master can be used for extreem value against an enemy wounds-setup. If you have a healer, then you will die hard to wounds. But with Duel Master, you can ensure that one of your core damage dealing Immortals keeps being healed.

Same concept for another skill like Fighting Master. This one provides immunity to Control Effects (does not work on Himiko). This is likewise extreemly powerful against certain setups. For instance if you fight against an earth team, being Immune to dragon stun provides a huge advantage!

title: Patch 2.3 equipment S1 & S2 + new equipment coming soon
summary: As we know, gnome camps drop different equipment (read gnome item drops). These items have different stat values based on its type. Swords have physical attack, strength and crit value. Robes has Physical Defense…
markdown:
As we know, gnome camps drop different equipment ([read gnome item drops](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/farming-gnome-camps/#gnomes-item-drops)). These items have different stat values based on its type. Swords have physical attack, strength and crit value. Robes has Physical Defense, Magical Defense, Strength and Dodge Value, etc.

These stats are predefined based on the item type and item slot. You cannot change of mod the stat types. What you can do, is upgrade your equipment scaling the value of each stat higher with every level/rank.

In addition to an items level/rank an items sum of stats are increased by the rarity of the item. Rare items are stronger than Uncommon items because it yields more stat value for each stat. Likewise, the Rare item is weaker than Elite equipment - and so on.

### Epic items have additional inherent item tiers within the quality type:

1. ****Epic****+**** elemental****(if bonus applies)
2. ****Epic elemental**** (if bonus applies)
3. **Epic+**
4. **Epic**

**In patch 2.3 they we have a name change to existing equipment adding "S2" to the new equipment from patch 1.8.**
Moreover, the game has introduced new stronger equipment (however it is unobtainable as of patch 2.3 current).

markdown:
### Patch 2.6.0.6 Update for Infinity Kingdom: A New Era of Gameplay and Aesthetic Delights

The virtual realms of Infinity Kingdom have been infused with a fresh wave of enhancements and additions, ushering in the highly anticipated Patch 2.6.6. With a slew of UI and gameplay upgrades, not to mention an array of enticing new items, this update promises to elevate the immersive experience for both new adventurers and seasoned veterans alike.

## Streamlined User Interface: Navigating the Kingdom with Finesse

One of the hallmark improvements of Patch 2.6.6 is the revamped user interface (UI) that will leave players spellbound. The UI overhaul is designed to provide a more intuitive and user-friendly navigation system, ensuring that players can effortlessly explore the intricate world of Infinity Kingdom. the UI has been meticulously redesigned to make your journey through the kingdom more enjoyable than ever before with a new and greatly enhanced march overview UI feature. Here you can see the status, movement timers, and much more giving greater insights more rapidly for players.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-27.png)

## Auto Garrison Feature: Efficiency at Your Fingertips

The advent of the Auto Garrison feature is set to revolutionize how players defend their realms. With a simple command, you can now assign troops to automatically garrison your Castle, thereby fortifying your defenses without the hassle of manual intervention.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-28.png)

This strategic addition allows players to focus on grander schemes while ensuring their territories remain impervious to external threats.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-29.png)

## VIP Store: Exclusive Treasures Await

Patch 2.6.6 introduces the illustrious VIP Store, an emporium brimming with exclusive treasures and rewards for the most dedicated adventurers. As players ascend through the VIP ranks, they'll unlock access to this veritable trove of sought-after items, granting a distinct advantage on the battlefield. The VIP Store is a testament to Infinity Kingdom's commitment to honoring the loyalty of its valiant players.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-30-1024x561.png)

## Artifact Upgrade Materials and New Immortals: Power Unveiled

For those who yearn to ascend to new heights of power, the patch delivers with an array of Artifact upgrade materials available for purchase. Elevating the strength and potency of your Artifacts has never been easier, offering an avenue to customize your gameplay strategy in unprecedented ways.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-31-1024x565.png)

Additionally, the Pearl shop has welcomed a host of new immortals, each wielding unique abilities and traits that are poised to reshape the dynamics of battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-32-1024x545.png)

## New UI for Marches: Tactical Finesse Redefined

Patch 2.6.6 introduces a new and improved UI for managing your marches. Now, players can strategize with greater precision, ensuring that their armies move in tandem with their calculated plans. The enhanced UI empowers players to orchestrate complex maneuvers with ease, further reinforcing Infinity Kingdom's commitment to fostering tactical brilliance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-33.png)

## Honor Ranking Castle Cosmetics Skins: Exude Grandeur

The allure of regal aesthetics takes center stage with the introduction of Honor Ranking Castle Cosmetic Skins. Distinguished players who ascend through the ranks will have the opportunity to adorn their castles with opulent and majestic designs, showcasing their hard-earned achievements in the most splendid fashion. These cosmetic skins epitomize the grandeur of Infinity Kingdom's virtual realm.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-34.png)

## The Mysterium continues!

New Mysterium levels to progres through. The Mysterium rewards are huge now, with artifact fragments for unique artifacts for Atilla, Alex, Cid, Saladin and Ramssess as well as a ton more gold and speed ups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-35-1024x521.png)

## Conclusion

In conclusion, Patch 2.6.6 is an epochal chapter in the saga of Infinity Kingdom, propelling the game into new dimensions of immersion and strategy. With its enriched UI, automated features, exclusive VIP Store, artifact enhancements, and captivating new immortals, this update encapsulates the developers' unwavering dedication to crafting an unforgettable gaming experience. Brace yourselves for an adventure like no other, as Infinity Kingdom continues to evolve and captivate the hearts of adventurers worldwide.

title: Patch 2.6.2: New Immortal, New Event, Solid Improvements
summary: Infinity Kingdom, a beloved strategy game, is gearing up to introduce thrilling new features and gameplay enhancements in its upcoming Version 2.6.2 update. The developers are all set to elevate the gaming experience…
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom, a beloved strategy game, is gearing up to introduce thrilling new features and gameplay enhancements in its upcoming Version 2.6.2 update. The developers are all set to elevate the gaming experience for lords venturing across the vast realms of the Infinity Kingdom. Here's a comprehensive analysis of the exciting changes awaiting players:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-14-1024x576.png)

## Time Rift Breaker - A Game-Changing Event

The Time Rift Breaker event is unquestionably one of the most anticipated additions in Version 2.6.2. It promises to be a game-changer, reminiscent of the beloved Spider event, but on a grander scale. This cross-server event invites lords from the same season to unite and confront a formidable adversary. It introduces a dynamic twist to the gameplay, where lords must strategize based on elemental weaknesses, adding an extra layer of depth to battles. With different elemental weaknesses and a prolonged cross-server format, it's an event that holds immense promise and anticipation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-15-1024x538.png)

### Time Rift Breaker 101 - A Cross-Server Challenge

One of the standout additions to Infinity Kingdom in Version 2.6.2 is the Time Rift Breaker event. This is a cross-server event that allows lords from the same season to come together and challenge a formidable adversary. To access the event, simply tap on the "Well of Time" located in the bottom-right corner of your screen.

### Event Requirements:

- Your server must have entered Season 2.
- Your Castle Level must be equal to or higher than Level 15.

### Event Period:

- The event starts every Monday at 00:00 (UTC) and concludes every Sunday at 24:00 (UTC).
- During the first two days (Monday to Wednesday), the enemy is in the recharge and incubation stage and cannot be attacked.
- The challenge stage begins every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC) and runs until Sunday at 24:00 (UTC). During this period, you can attack the enemy. If defeated, the enemy will resurrect after a certain time or escape if not defeated.

### Event Rules:

- Each lord has three challenge attempts daily.
- All battles in this event are automatic.
- Immortals deployed in a challenge cannot be used again on the same day.
- Utilize Immortals of the corresponding elements to deal additional damage based on the Time Rift Breaker's elemental weakness.

### Event Rewards:

- The event offers a variety of rewards, including Total Damage Ranking Rewards, Highest Damage Ranking Rewards, Kill Rewards, and Honor Rewards.
- These rewards will grant you Space-Time Glory Badges, which can be exchanged for valuable items in the shop.

## Darius - Lightning's Mighty Champion

The arrival of Darius I, a formidable new Immortal, is cause for celebration. Belonging to the Lightning element, Darius I brings a unique set of skills to the battlefield. His specialty lies in spear attacks, making him a valuable asset against the physical meta. His skill, which inflicts Physical Damage to all enemies and has a chance to decrease their Physical Damage dealt, positions him as a potent counter to physical damage dealers. This is particularly significant in a meta dominated by physical threats, and Darius I's inclusion will undoubtedly shake up the competitive landscape.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-13-1024x1024.png)

***Darius I's Skill:***

- Skill: Inflicts Physical Damage (Damage Rate 108%) to all enemies and has a 9% chance of decreasing their Physical Damage dealt by 30% (with an additional 30% decrease when first casting the skill), lasting for 6 seconds.
- Upgrade Preview: Darius I's skills will evolve, increasing his Damage Rate and the trigger chance of Physical Damage decrease, making him an even more formidable force on the battlefield.  - Damage Rate: 108%/144%/180%/216%/252%/288%/324%/360%
- Trigger Chance of Physical Damage Decrease: 9%/12%/15%/18%/21%/24%/27%/30%

## Optimizations for a Seamless Gaming Experience

Version 2.6.2 isn't just about introducing new content; it's also about enhancing the overall gaming experience. The optimizations included in this update are aimed at providing players with smoother and more enjoyable gameplay. Some notable improvements include:

- **Arena Battle Report Sharing:** Enhancing communication between lords, this feature allows the sharing of Arena Battle Reports via the Chat Channel, fostering a stronger sense of community among players.
- **Mysterium Difficulty Adjustment:** The Mysterium difficulty has been fine-tuned to ensure a more balanced and enjoyable gaming experience, catering to players of all levels.
- **King of the Hill Ranking Rewards Adjustment:** Entrance requirements for stage and overall rankings in the King of the Hill event have been refined, ensuring fair competition and encouraging player engagement.
- **Battle Damage Numbers Optimization:** To make battles more transparent and informative, various types of damage, such as Normal Attack Damage, Skill Damage, and Crit Damage, are now displayed in distinct colors, enhancing the overall clarity of battles.
- **Gnome Boss Search Rules Optimization:** Gnome Bosses can now be directly searched for, simplifying the process and aligning it with the spawning rules of regular monsters.
- **Alliance & Academy Technology Bonus Effective in Checkpoints:** Technology bonuses from both the Academy and Alliance Technology are now applicable in Legion of Frostborne Checkpoints, empowering players to overcome challenges more effectively.

As the Version 2.6.2 update unfolds, the Infinity Kingdom development team actively seeks player feedback through official media channels like Facebook, Discord, VK, and more. The Time Rift Breaker event awaits, and with Darius I by your side, you'll be well-equipped to face epic battles and conquer the ever-expanding Infinity Kingdom.

title: Patch 2.6.3 - New Portrait feature, SvS annoyance and quality of life
summary: In the ever-evolving battle for Norheim, the Gnomes with impaired souls persist in their quest to construct formidable steam machines to combat the human forces. The previous version introduced the Time Rift Breakers…
markdown:
**2.6.3 Version Patch** *10/09/2023*

In the ever-evolving battle for Norheim, the Gnomes with impaired souls persist in their quest to construct formidable steam machines to combat the human forces. The previous version introduced the Time Rift Breakers, created by Malena, the Goddess of War, and ignited fresh animosity among humans against the Gnomes. Now, in this latest patch, version 2.6.3, a brand-new cultivation system known as Immortal Portrait is set to emerge. This system promises to bestow additional advantages upon your Immortals. Alongside this, the update features the convenience of One-click Equipment Dismantle, introduces new permissions for Alliance R5 members, and offers various optimizations to enhance the overall gameplay experience. Let's delve into the specifics of these changes and their potential impact on players. Full official patchnotes can be found here: https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7018594.html

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/image-31-1024x567.png)

### New Feature - Immortal Portrait

One of the most intriguing aspects of this update is the Immortal Portrait system. The Immortal Portrait interface will be integrated into the Galleries, allowing players to explore Immortals and Dragon Portraits of the corresponding element. These Immortal Portraits promise to provide a range of unique Attribute Bonuses.

- Notably, Legendary and Epic Immortals and Dragons have exclusive Portraits.
- Players can enhance these Portraits by using Crimson Moonlight or Astral Sand, thus increasing their Brilliance. As Portraits level up, Immortals gain access to more potent Attribute Bonuses.
- The essential materials for enhancing these Portraits, Crimson Moonlight, and Astral Sand, will be obtainable through various in-game events.

This exciting new feature introduces a layer of depth to character customization and strategy. It will be fascinating to see how accessible these Portraits are and how players will incorporate them into their gameplay. The potential for unique buffs adds an intriguing dynamic to the overall experience.

### One-click Equipment Dismantle

In the realm of quality-of-life improvements, the introduction of One-click Equipment Dismantle stands out. This feature will empower players to efficiently dismantle up to 200 pieces of equipment in one batch, providing a more streamlined approach to managing their inventory. The only exception is Elemental Equipment, which players must dismantle manually. This enhancement simplifies equipment management and offers a convenient way to declutter one's inventory, contributing to a more player-friendly experience.

### War Declaration

The introduction of the War Declaration procedure for attacking Cities and Checkpoints is a significant strategic shift in the game. Players must now formally declare war on a City or Checkpoint in Norheim or KVK before launching an invasion. Furthermore, there is a mandatory three-minute waiting period after the War Declaration.

- Importantly, only players of Alliance R6 and R5 ranks have the authority to declare war.
- In the Legion of Frostborne, players are confined to declaring war solely within the scope of their own Thermal Tower, eliminating the leverage of their allies' energy range.

This strategic change aims to prolong SvS seasons by making it more challenging for alliances to conquer the entire map quickly. It disrupts the use of alternate alliances to siege with towers. However, there are concerns that this might result in empty areas of the map rather than stimulating strategic battles.

### Optimizations

The update also introduces several other optimizations to enhance the gameplay experience:

**New Alliance R5 Permissions** - Leaders can assign Mayor Appointment and Alliance Tactics Usage authorities to R5 members to streamline alliance management.

**Daily Sign-in Rewards Update** - Daily Sign-in Rewards have been upgraded to offer more valuable items, including Immortal Fragments.

**10X Draws with Philosopher's Stone Shards** - A new quick-use function allows players to use 10 Philosopher's Stone Shards with a single tap, simplifying the process.

**Time Rift Breaker Battle Report Sharing** - Players can now share battle reports on Time Rift Breaker battles, promoting improved alliance coordination and communication.

**Limit and Cooldown of Friendly Alliances** - Within the Legion of Frostborne, each alliance can have a maximum of 9 allies. After ending friendly relations with a particular alliance, players must wait 24 hours before re-establishing relations. However, the extent of its impact remains uncertain, as it could merely serve as a minor obstacle for larger servers.

**Immortal & Dragon Info Display Optimization** - The information display for Immortals and Dragons on the Formation and Battle Report interfaces has been optimized, aiming to provide clearer information to players.

This update ushers in a range of changes and improvements, some with the potential to reshape gameplay strategies, while others contribute to overall quality-of-life enhancements. As players dive into the 2.6.3 Version Patch, the impact of these changes will become more apparent, and the game's landscape may evolve accordingly.

title: Patch 2.6.6 - New Gem Feature & Legendary skills

markdown:
The Infinity Kingdom 2.6.6 patch, is a major update with numerous features and optimizations. Highlights include the Equipment Gem Slotting feature, which allows players to enhance their gear with attack, defense, or support gems. This system provides a significant power boost and is accessible without a paywall, a major positive shift for the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-113-1024x483.png)

Let's delve deeper into the key aspects of the Infinity Kingdom's 2.6.6 patch, focusing on the Equipment Gem Slotting feature and Legendary Skills. In this guide I shall go over what I find to be interesting in the new patch, so we are going to skip a fair bit of it too! **[Read the full patch notes here.](https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7019371.html)**

## Equipment Gem Slotting Feature

This feature revolutionizes how players can augment their equipment. Here's a breakdown:

- **Gem Types:**  - **Attack Gems** boost Physical and Magical Attack, crucial for offensive strategies.
- **Defense Gems** enhance Physical and Magic Defense, pivotal for durability in battles.
- **Support Gems** improve Resilience and Accuracy, offering tactical advantages.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-115-1024x569.png)

- **Obtaining Gems:**  - Primarily acquired by defeating monsters, ensuring that all players have access to these enhancements without a paywall.
- Eight levels of gems exist, allowing for progression and strategic depth. Combining three lower-level gems of the same type creates a higher-level gem, adding an element of resource management.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-114-1024x513.png)

As you farm gems from gnomes you bank quite a few gems quickly. That's great, because we are going to need them! You need to combine gems to upgrade their levels. Max level and requirements are unknown as of now.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-116-1024x601.png)

## Legendary Skills in the Tower of Knowledge

- **Introduction of Legendary Skills:**  - These are separate from common skills and offer potentially game-changing abilities.
- Upgrading requires red passive skill stones, indicating a higher resource investment.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-117-1024x94.png)

- **Strategic Implications:**  - Likely to be powerful, these skills could redefine battle strategies.
- While potentially expensive, they offer a new echelon of gameplay for invested players.
- The introduction of these skills might make existing high-tier skills more accessible, balancing the playing field.

This patch represents a significant evolution in Infinity Kingdom's gameplay, offering both enhanced strategic depth and accessibility. Players should explore these features to fully leverage their potential in their quest for dominance. Whie these new Legendary Skills are most likely going to be heavily paywalled. But there may be some upside to that for us none whales - let's face it, chaos spenders are playing their own game at this point anyway requiring no skill or brains to beat anyone without chaos - but for the rest of us we may just get access to the expensive Triss skills more cheaply as new legendary skills become the spender primary target!

### Player Guide: Mastering the New Alliance and Kingdom Dynamics in Infinity Kingdom

The latest patch has revolutionized the way alliances and kingdoms interact in the world of Infinity Kingdom. Traditionally, alliances were confined within the borders of their own kingdoms. For example, only players within the Ruslan kingdom (red) could join alliances formed by fellow Ruslan players. This limitation is now a thing of the past! Players are now granted the freedom to join any alliance across the diverse kingdoms of Norheim.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-11-1024x505.png)

## Key Changes and Their Impact

### Cross-Kingdom Alliances

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-10.png)

The update allows players to align with any alliance, regardless of the kingdom. This newfound flexibility means players can now leverage kingdom-specific buffs that align with their strategic preferences and build choices.

- **Customizing Buffs:** If your strategy involves utilizing cavalry immortals as your main march, the 5% cavalry HP buff from Ruslan becomes crucial. Shieldmen specialists will benefit from the Vitas buff, while spearmen users should look towards Ydia for enhancements. This ensures that players in Vitas, for instance, are no longer at a disadvantage when deploying cavalry in their main force. Changing your allegiance to a new kingdom while retaining your preferred alliance is now effortlessly possible.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-7-1024x570.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-6-1024x560.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-5-1024x568.png)

**[Read more about changing alliances for Kingdom buffs here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/kingdom/leveraging-kingdom-changes-for-buffs-in-infinity-kingdom/)**

### Enhanced Utilization of Kingdom Honor Ranking Buffs

The introduction of cross-kingdom alliances opens up strategic avenues for maximizing the benefits of kingdom honor ranking buffs. These buffs, awarded through titles such as Prince, provide not only a significant troop boost but also considerable enhancements to your immortals.

- **Strategic Alliance Distribution:** High-power alliances, typically one to three per server, can now spread across different kingdoms, making full use of the available honor ranking buffs. This strategic distribution ensures that powerful buffs, which were previously unattainable for many due to the restrictive kingdom-alliance relationship, are now within reach. Players in servers with fewer dominant alliances no longer have to miss out on full kingdom honor ranking benefits.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-1-1024x348.png)

**[Read more about how to best use the Kingdoms Honor Rankings for max effect.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/lord-lady/nobility-honor/maximizing-honor-ranking-buffs-in-infinity-kingdom/)**

## Strategy Tips

- **Go Get Your Best Buff:** Embrace the change! Analyze which kingdom's buff aligns best with your gameplay style and make the switch without losing your alliance connections.
- **Maximize Your Fighting Power:** With the ability to access and utilize all kingdom honor rankings, players can significantly boost their combat effectiveness, especially when gearing up for closely matched server vs server (svs) battles.

This update is a game-changer for Infinity Kingdom players, offering unprecedented flexibility and strategic depth. Whether you're fine-tuning your main march or looking to maximize your fighting power through honor rankings, the new alliance and kingdom dynamics open up a world of possibilities. Dive in, explore, and conquer Norheim like never before!

## Infinity Kingdom Patch 2.6.7 Player Guide: Analysis and Impact

With the release of patch 2.6.7, Infinity Kingdom takes another exciting step forward, introducing a series of enhancements and new features poised to reshape the strategic landscape of Norheim. This guide delves into the official patch notes released by YooZoo, providing an in-depth analysis of the content and its implications for players.

## New Features and Their Strategic Impact

### 1. New Open Arena

#### Seasonal Elements and Restrictions

The introduction of seasonal elements to the Open Arena, including Immortal and skill restrictions, injects fresh strategic challenges. Players must adapt their strategies each season, encouraging diversity in team compositions and tactics. The banning of two Epic Immortals from each element and random Tower of Knowledge skills necessitates a deeper roster and versatility in skill setups.

#### Immortal Artifacts Availability

The equal access to Artifacts within the Open Arena levels the playing field, focusing competition on strategic prowess rather than inventory depth. This change encourages players to experiment with different Artifact combinations to maximize their team's effectiveness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-64-1024x511.png)

### 2. Ability Stone Selling

The option to convert Ability Stones into Cinder of Wish offers players a new avenue to utilize surplus materials, enhancing their ability to focus on desired upgrades and refinements.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-63-1024x397.png)

### 3. Equipment Stone Slotting

The addition of a [Compose All] feature streamlines the process of managing Equipment Stones, saving time and improving user experience. The interface and sorting optimizations further simplify equipment management, allowing for quicker adjustments and optimizations.

### 4. New Immortal: Pakal the Great

Pakal the Great adds depth to the Earth element lineup, providing players with new strategic options for their teams. His introduction is likely to inspire new team compositions and strategies, especially for players focusing on Earth-aligned teams.

## Optimizations and Their Benefits

### 1. Primal Pinball

The ability to tap and hold the golden toad for continuous pinball shooting enhances the game's playability, making this feature more enjoyable and less tedious.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-65-1024x652.png)

### 2. Main Menu Shop Access

Direct access to various shops from the main interface streamlines the shopping experience, reducing the time spent navigating menus and allowing players to focus more on gameplay.

### 3. Lord Nobility Interface

The visual polish and addition of a TIPS button improve user interaction with the Lord Nobility system, making it more engaging and informative.

### 4. Dragon Chest Opening

The quick access button for Dragon Chests simplifies inventory management and ensures players don't overlook the valuable resources these chests offer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-62-1024x410.png)

## Balance Adjustment and Gameplay Impact

### 1. [Holy] Defense Adjustment

The reduction in Holy's defense against Shadow alters the elemental balance, potentially shifting the meta and affecting team compositions in PvP. I am very keen to see some Himiko Builds possibly doing real dents into holy and maybe even Chaos holy.

### 2. Tower of Knowledge Skill: [Drastic Action]

The adjustments to [Drastic Action], including the change in healing reduction duration and trigger threshold, modify its utility in battle. These changes may influence skill selection and strategic planning, especially in prolonged engagements.

a. Lowers healing received by 50%. The effect now lasts for 6 seconds.

b. Now triggers when HP falls below 70% (was 50%).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-61-1024x504.png)

## Conclusion

Patch 2.6.7 brings a wealth of changes and improvements to Infinity Kingdom, significantly impacting gameplay strategy and player experience. The new Open Arena features, alongside optimizations and balance adjustments, promise to keep the game dynamic and engaging. Players are encouraged to explore the depths of these updates, adapting their strategies and enjoying the fresh challenges and opportunities they present. With these changes, Infinity Kingdom continues to evolve, offering a rich and complex world for players to conquer.

### Player Guide: Navigating the Fourth March in Infinity Kingdom PvP and PvE Events

The recent update to Infinity Kingdom introduced a game-changing feature: the addition of a fourth march in PvP combat events such as Arena and Throne, as well as in the PvE event, Rift Breaker Boss. This addition significantly impacts the dynamics of player strategies and power differentials between spenders and non-spenders.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-114-1024x334.png)

## Implications of the Fourth March

### Increased Power Differential

The introduction of a fourth march widens the gap between whales (big spenders) and non-whales. Players who have invested heavily in the game will likely have the resources to equip and sustain a powerful fourth march, whereas average players may struggle to muster a competitive fourth force.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-115-1024x526.png)

### Strategic Opportunities

Despite the challenges, the fourth march offers strategic opportunities that can be exploited even with limited resources. Here’s how to maximize the potential of a less powerful fourth march:

## Strategies for Maximizing Your Fourth March

### 1. Utilizing Elemental Dragons

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-116-1024x424.png)

- **Dragon Choice**: Employ dragons like the lightning or fire dragon, which guarantee true damage with their dragon breath. This ensures that your fourth march can still impact the battlefield by softening enemy troops, potentially tipping the scales in closely matched encounters.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-120-1024x452.png)

### 2. Deploying Chaos Immortals

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-117-1024x557.png)

- **Chaos at Low Levels**: Even unmaxed chaos immortals can be significantly impactful. Their innate abilities can make them useful even with minimal upgrades. For example, using a low-star Fu Fei can still disrupt enemy formations effectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-118-1024x561.png)

### 3. Tactical Placement

- **Follow-up Strategy**: Use your fourth march strategically after your main marches to clean up weakened enemies. This approach is particularly effective if your primary marches are designed to inflict heavy damage, allowing your fourth march to finish off the remaining forces.
- **Example Setup**: If you have a strong fire setup as your third march, position your fourth march to engage immediately after. Even a weaker fourth march can successfully defeat or severely damage an already weakened enemy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-119-1024x492.png)

## Considerations for Building Your Fourth March

### Troop Composition and Synergy

- **Focus on Synergy**: Even if your fourth march isn't as strong, maintaining synergy between the immortals' abilities can enhance its effectiveness. This includes aligning their elemental strengths and combining their skills to support each other.
- **Skill Allocation**: Prioritize deploying leftover but potent Tower of Knowledge skills that can amplify even a weaker group of immortals.

### Adapting to the New Meta

- **Experimentation**: With the introduction of the fourth march, the game's meta will inevitably shift. Stay adaptive and experiment with different combinations and strategies to find what works best for your lineup and playing style.
- **Feedback and Adjustments**: Pay close attention to the performance of all your marches in battle and be ready to make adjustments. The key to success will be continuous optimization based on battle outcomes and emerging player strategies.

## Conclusion

The addition of a fourth march in Infinity Kingdom presents both challenges and opportunities. For players without the resources to field four powerhouse marches, strategic creativity and clever utilization of available immortals and skills can still yield competitive advantages. Whether you are a whale or a more modest spender, the new dynamics call for experimentation and adaptation to harness the full potential of your armies in the evolving landscape of Infinity Kingdom.
