## Introduction

Thank you for your patience in waiting for this patch. We promise not to disappoint you. Patch 2.6 includes important new content and lots of optimizations! A new level limit is coming, and mysterious crystals known as Etherite have appeared in Norheim, guiding its Lords on a brand new adventure. In addition, due to popular demand, the developers have increased the shop availability of Wind Dragon Crystals, optimized Battle Chess and other features. All detailed changes are included in these patch notes. Enjoy!

### New Features

### 1. Increased Level Limit

Increased the maximum level of buildings in the Territory to Lv.55. To upgrade buildings, a special material is required: Etherite.

Etherite can be obtained by transmuting items at the Forge, or from the Wonderful Activities event.

### Troops

When the Barracks reach Lv.55, a new troop type will be unlocked: Elite Palace Troops. Stronger troops are the foundation of a stronger unit.

### Dragons

Increased the maximum level of dragons to Lv.55. With the support of more powerful dragons, your units will see a great increase in Power.

### Immortals

a. New level limit: Increased the maximum level of Immortals to Lv.55.

b. New class limit: Increased the maximum class of Immortals to Class 30.

c. New equipment: Added the Ether series of Legendary equipment. Wearing Legendary equipment will vastly increase your strength.

![](https://oss.gtarcade.com/ucms/ab24982c-1120-4712-ba8d-5c21382066b3_2023-06-28.jpg)

### Well of Time

Added new chapters to Well of Time: Chapter 16 - Holy Protection, Chapter 17 - A Brothers Pain, and Chapter 18 - Battle of Virtus.

![](https://oss.gtarcade.com/ucms/383cea5d-d85e-4418-b356-dff743c05367_2023-06-28.jpg)

### Academy Technology

Added new branches to the Fortifications, Immortal, and Military technology trees, allowing you to obtain all kinds of powerful attribute bonuses.

### Tower of Knowledge Skills

Added 12 new skills to the Tower of Knowledge.

| Skill Name | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unforeseen Attack | Triggered | Every 6s after battle starts, has a 50% chance of dealing Physical Damage (Damage Factor x%) to 1 random back-row enemy unit. |
| Weakening Curse | Debuff | After battle starts, inflicts Disarm on all enemy units, reducing the damage they deal by x% for 45s or until they use an active skill. |
| Lost Dimension | Passive | Upon receiving Physical Damage, has a y% chance of disorienting 1 random enemy unit, reducing their SP Recovery by 50% and their Accuracy Rate by 15% for 6s. |
| Executioner | Passive | Upon dealing 10 instances of Continuous Damage, also deals Physical Damage (Damage Factor x%) to all enemy units and gains the Execute status, increasing damage dealt to targets with less than 30% HP by y% for 6s. |
| Wine and Dine | Passive | When healing an allied unit, has a 50% chance of increasing that unit's damage by x% for 6s. |
| Heavy Lifter | Passive | When using a passive skill, has a 50% chance of also dealing Magical Damage (Damage Factor x%) to all enemy units, and reducing their Attack Speed by y% for 12s. |
| Phantom Agility | Passive | Upon successfully dodging an enemy's attack, increases the damage of the next active skill by x%. Stacks up to 3 times. Expires upon using an active skill. |
| Memory Defense | Triggered | Every 12s after battles starts, has a 65% chance of granting you and the allied unit with the highest losses a buff that increases Healing Effect by x% and Physical Defense and Magical Defense by y% for 12s. |
| Ambush | Triggered | Every 12s after battle starts, has a 50% chance of gaining Stealth status, becoming unable to act or be targeted for 3s. After Stealth status ends, appears and deals Physical Damage (Damage Factor x%) to all enemy units. |
| Poison Thorn | Triggered | Every 6s after battle starts, has a 60% chance of dealing Magical Damage (Damage Factor x%) to the enemy unit with the highest Physical Attack. Also inflicts Poison on the target, causing them to take Magical Damage (Damage Factor y%) every 3s for 6s, and reducing their Healing Effect by 50%. |
| No Escape | Triggered | At the start of battle, has a x% chance of inflicting Silence on all enemy units for 6s. Every 6s after Silence ends, has a y% chance of dealing Physical Damage (Damage Factor z%) to all enemy units, and Stunning 2 random targets for 3s. |
| Corrosive Power | Triggered | Upon dealing 3 instances of active skill damage, recovers x% SP and increases your active skill damage by y% for 2s. |

### Optimizations

### 1. Wind Dragon Crystal Sales

Due to popular demand, the Arena Shop now has much more Wind Dragon Crystals available for sale.

a. Players who reach Gold III or higher will have one chance per season to redeem Wind Dragon Crystals at an even lower price at the Insignia Shop.

b. Availability will gradually increase with each Arena season.

### 2. Battle Chess

### a. Adjusted the rules for leaving Alliance Invitationals rooms

When the Alliance Invitationals end, you and your opponent need to return to the invitational room again.

### b. Emojis

Added emojis to Battle Chess to improve its fun and social factors. You can use the Chat button to send unlocked emojis to your opponent.

### 3. Unit Expedition Display

When the number of troops in the current unit is below the minimum, the No. of Troops information will be displayed in red. This makes it easier to manage your units.

### 4. Immortal Display

Improved the display of Immortals. The new background on the Immortals screen improves the experience.

That's all the changes coming with Patch 2.6. Thanks for reading! If you have any questions, then please feel free to get in touch with us over Facebook, Discord, VK, or any other official channels. Compete with other Lords to race to the new level limit! A patch notes reading activity is also available on Facebook. Simply share your views on any part of the patch notes together with your ID for a chance to win fabulous rewards. Come to Facebook and share your thoughts with us now!

title: Patch 2.8.1 - Baldwin nerf - what should players do?
summary: With the arrival of Patch 2.8.1, one of the most significant changes is the nerf to Baldwin, the Magic Wind Immortal. Baldwin has always had an interesting place in the meta, often acting as a support mage rather than a…
markdown:
### Understanding Baldwin's Nerf in Patch 2.8.1

With the arrival of **Patch 2.8.1**, one of the most significant changes is the **nerf to Baldwin**, the **Magic Wind Immortal**. Baldwin has always had an interesting place in the meta, often acting as a **support mage** rather than a primary damage dealer. His ability to increase **magic damage taken** by enemies made him a strong **secondary pick**, particularly in hybrid magic teams. However, with this recent nerf, Baldwin's role has changed dramatically, leaving many players questioning how to proceed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-101.png)

This guide will break down the changes, analyze their impact on gameplay, and provide recommendations on what to do next if you've been using Baldwin in your setups.

---

## What Changed?

The patch **adjusted Baldwin’s Hurricane ability**, and the full patch note reads:

> The [Hurricane] has been adjusted to: Summons Tornado that deals Magical Damage (Damage Rate 306%+42%/level) to 1 random enemy troop. After hitting a target, Tornado has a chance of splitting into two which will continue to attack nearby enemy troops. A tornado can split up to 2 times (Chance of the first split is 75%, Chance of the second split is 50%).

**[*Official patch notes found here.*](https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7022307.html)**

At first glance, this might not seem like a huge shift. However, the **biggest change is the removal of Baldwin’s magic damage debuff**. Previously, **Hurricane also increased the target’s magic damage taken by 30%**, making Baldwin a valuable enabler for strong mage-focused teams.

Now, Baldwin is simply a **magic damage dealer**, and without his utility, his role becomes much more limited.

---

## Why Does This Matter?

Baldwin has never been the **hardest-hitting mage**. His **ultimate damage was always slightly behind other top-tier mages**, but his **debuff utility made him valuable**. Here’s why this change is significant:

1. **No More Magic Damage Amplification**  - Baldwin can no longer increase the damage output of other magic-heavy teams. Previously, he was an excellent **support mage** for strong casters like **Wu Zetian, Himiko, Merlin, and Loki**.
- Without the debuff, his value as a **team enabler** is gone, and he has to compete **purely as a damage dealer**.
2. **Weaker Passive Skill Synergy**  - Since Baldwin no longer buffs **magic damage taken**, his **own attacks (like Annihilation and other passives)** are weaker.
- He no longer benefits from his own ability, meaning his **overall output is lower**.
3. **Impact on Specific Team Compositions**  - The **Baldwin-Wu Zetian Fire Nuke Build** loses its synergy, making it **far less viable**.
- Wind-based teams may **no longer benefit from a magic-based setup**.
- Even in Wind compositions, **Atalanta and physical damage teams** are now more effective choices.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-102.png)

---

## How Does This Affect the Meta?

Previously, Baldwin carved out a niche as a **secondary magic enabler**, but now he is just a **damage dealer without extra utility**. This effectively removes him from most competitive setups.

- **Wind Magic Teams Are No Longer Ideal**  - Without Baldwin’s debuff, **pure Wind magic setups** are much weaker.
- **Atalanta now becomes a stronger pick** for Wind teams, focusing on **physical damage instead**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-103.png)

- **Fire Magic Teams Lose a Key Component**  - Baldwin **no longer makes sense in fire teams** like Wu-Baldwin-Cyrus.
- Instead, players should look to a **more traditional fire build** with **Cyrus and Wu Zetian**.
- **Baldwin's Overall Viability Drops**  - He can still deal **some damage**, but his value as a **supporting mage is gone**.
- Other mages like **Himiko, Merlin, and Wu Zetian** now **outclass him completely**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-104.png)

---

## What Should You Do if You Have Baldwin?

### 1. Transition to Atalanta in Wind Teams

If you were using Baldwin in **Wind setups**, now is the time to **switch to physical damage**.

- **Atalanta is a much stronger choice** in Wind compositions, focusing on **consistent physical damage**.
- Wind teams now lean towards **physical-based strategies** instead of magic damage.

### 2. Move to a Different Mage

If you were using Baldwin in a **magic team**, consider replacing him with **a stronger, more reliable mage**.

- **Himiko** – One of the **best alternatives**, offering **higher damage and crowd control**.
- **Merlin** – A **consistent magic damage dealer** with higher concistent damage.
- **Wu Zetian** – A mage with potential for high burst damage procs, and with the chance she is now the same as Baldwin just better as her chance for multiple hits is almost as high but without damage reduction.

### 3. Avoid Investing in Baldwin Further

Since Baldwin’s value has dropped significantly, **it is not recommended to continue investing resources in him**. Unless a future patch **buffs his damage** or **restores his magic debuff**, there are **better options** available.

### 4. Adjust Fire Team Compositions

If you were using Baldwin in **Fire Mage setups**, switch to **Cyrus-Wu Fire builds**, which remain highly effective without needing Baldwin’s old debuff.

### Checkout this Cyrus Fire team if you are in need of a new direction for your fire team

---

## Final Thoughts

While Baldwin wasn’t a **top-tier meta pick** before, he had a **valuable niche role** due to his magic damage debuff. Now that this has been removed, his **overall effectiveness is significantly lower**, and his place in **high-level team compositions is questionable**.

If you’re currently using Baldwin, **consider switching to Atalanta in Wind teams** or **investing in a stronger mage** like **Himiko or Merlin**. This nerf may seem small, but it effectively removes Baldwin from his **supportive enabler role**, making it hard to justify using him over other Immortals.

If you're looking to stay competitive, now is the time to **adjust your strategy** and **move forward with a stronger setup**.

title: Patch 2.8.1 (march 13th 2025)
summary: Overall, Patch 2.8.1 brings meaningful changes, particularly in meta-shifting skills, strategic Frostborne battles, and quality-of-life updates. Some changes favor aggressive playstyles (e.g., Blade Dodge, No Losses…
markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom Patch 2.8.1

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-73-1024x288.png)

---

## Patch 2.8.1 Breakdown & Analysis

### New Features

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-78.png)

#### 1. Tower of Knowledge Skills

- **Master's Aegis (Epic)** – Reduces magical damage taken by all allies.
**Opinion:** This is a solid defensive skill, especially useful against heavy magic-based teams. It could lead to a shift in the meta where magic-heavy compositions lose some dominance.
- **Blade Dodge (Epic)** – Reduces damage taken and dealt for the first 15 seconds. Afterward, using an Ultimate increases physical damage.
**Opinion:** A risky but rewarding skill. Players will need to build strategies around survival in the first 15 seconds, then unleash powerful Ultimate attacks. It might benefit tankier frontline Immortals the most.
- **Dominate (Elite)** – Increases physical attack.
**Opinion:** A straightforward buff that benefits aggressive lineups. Expect stronger physical DPS builds to emerge.
- **Ignite (Elite)** – Increases magical attack.
**Opinion:** A counterpart to Dominate, this will boost mages, making them even deadlier. Expect to see more burst-damage magic teams.

---

#### 2. Territory Decoration - Goddess of Victory

- Grants **+2% Troop HP** and **-3% Troop Death Rate** when deployed.
**Opinion:** This is a minor but useful buff for survivability, especially for players investing heavily in long battles. Since it’s locked behind an event, it might create a slight imbalance between those who obtain it and those who don’t.

---

## Optimizations & Their Impact

#### 1. Inner City Resource Collection ("Claim All")

- A **"Claim All"** button now allows players to collect all resources at once.
**Opinion:** A long-overdue quality-of-life change. It doesn’t impact balance but makes resource collection much smoother, especially for high-level players managing multiple resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-77.png)

---

#### 2. Legion of Frostborne Adjustments

- **Checkpoints:** No-Protection zone expanded by **50%**.
**Opinion:** This makes checkpoint battles more intense and tactical. Expect more strategic planning around when and where to engage since players can’t just hug the safety zone anymore.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-76.png)

- **Alliance Tactics - "Wonder Builder" Replaced with "No Losses"** (Thermal Tower builders won’t lose troops for 30 minutes).
**Opinion:** This strongly encourages more aggressive tower placement. Alliances that are quick to take advantage of this will have a massive edge in positioning during Frostborne battles.

---

#### 3. Artifact Rebirth

- **Players can now rebirth Level 0 artifacts directly from the Forge.**
**Opinion:** This makes managing artifacts much easier. Previously, players had to upgrade artifacts before rebirthing them, which wasted time and resources. Now, bad artifacts can be recycled immediately, allowing for faster optimization of gear.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-75-1024x568.png)

---

#### 4. Star of Popularity Event Changes

- **"Like" Function Removed** and replaced with **"Popularity Boost"**, where players can send gifts to increase another player’s popularity.
**Opinion:** This change makes popularity a more meaningful social feature rather than just a passive “like” counter. It also incentivizes spending, since giving gifts usually costs in-game currency or items.

---

## Balance Adjustments

### 1. Immortal Specialization Changes

- **Knight's Spirit (Legendary)** – Increased damage and attack speed.
**Opinion:** A clear buff that strengthens physical damage dealers and setups relying on sustained damage. It might make certain physical Immortals much more viable in prolonged fights.
- **Destroyer Stance (Legendary)** – Boosts **Critical Rate** and **Critical Damage**.
**Opinion:** A strong buff for critical-based teams. This might push crit-focused Immortals to the top of the DPS rankings.
- **Whirlwind Shock & Abyssal Inferno (Legendary)** – Higher activation rates and damage buffs.
**Opinion:** This strengthens Immortals who rely on periodic effects, increasing their burst potential. Expect to see these abilities used more in PvP.
- **Corrupting Wave & Concentration Stance (Legendary)** – Adjusted Ultimate Skill damage and added Resilience/Accuracy buffs.
**Opinion:** A well-rounded adjustment that improves consistency. It makes these skills more useful across different matchups, rather than just excelling in specific scenarios.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-74.png)

---

## Final Thoughts

Overall, **Patch 2.8.1** brings meaningful changes, particularly in **meta-shifting skills**, **strategic Frostborne battles**, and **quality-of-life updates**. Some changes favor aggressive playstyles (e.g., Blade Dodge, No Losses, Destroyer Stance buffs), while others make defensive and resource management strategies more efficient (Master’s Aegis, Claim All, Artifact Rebirth).

Expect **Frostborne warfare to become more dynamic**, with alliances fighting over expanded checkpoint zones and taking advantage of no-loss tower building. The new skills also mean **a potential shift in the PvP meta**, especially with buffs to crit-focused and magic-reducing abilities.

This patch leans **heavily into refining gameplay mechanics** while also introducing **new strategic layers**—a sign that **Infinity Kingdom** is continuing to evolve in a positive direction.

title: Patch 2.8.2 - Quality of Life and Balance Adjustments
summary: Infinity Kingdom's latest update, Patch 2.8.2, brings a host of enhancements and adjustments aimed at enriching the gameplay experience. This update just landed minutes ago—let's see what we got!
markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom Patch 2.8.2 – First Impressions & Overview

Infinity Kingdom's latest update, **Patch 2.8.2**, brings a host of enhancements and adjustments aimed at enriching the gameplay experience. This update just landed minutes ago—let's see what we got!

This patch introduces new features, optimizations, and balance changes that players will find both engaging and beneficial.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-35-1024x396.png)

---

## Alliance Forced Impeachment

A significant addition is the **Alliance Forced Impeachment** system. Members holding the **R3 rank or higher** can now initiate an impeachment process to potentially replace the current alliance leader. The outcome hinges on member votes and their **activity levels**. Notably, there's a **seven-day cooldown** between impeachment attempts, and during the voting phase, certain leader permissions are temporarily restricted.

This system empowers alliances to ensure active and effective leadership. It’s a very interesting take to add an activity vector to the voting system—something that, as far as I know, is completely new. This will likely be especially positive for impeachments in alt alliances where some players have large numbers of relatively inactive alts. This way, real players in the alliance will matter more in these voting cases. **Good stuff!**

---

## Individual Immortal and Dragon Sharing

To foster better communication and strategy sharing, the update introduces **Individual Immortal and Dragon Sharing**. Players can now share specific Immortals or Dragons directly in chat channels, making it easier to discuss builds and strategies with fellow alliance members.

This is a **great quality-of-life change**. While we’ve always been able to share things, making it easier to share only specific Immortals or Dragons—without going through formations—is very nice.

---

## Tower of Knowledge Enhancements

The **Tower of Knowledge** has received notable improvements:

- **New skill effects and status effect categories** have been added, providing more depth and variety in skill selection. This is interesting, although it's unclear what new categories are being implemented. We’ll have to wait until the update drops to investigate further. That said, expanding categories may lead to **indirect buffs to lightning compositions** and allow **debuffs that previously didn’t stack**—like Fire Nova Burn and Fire Dragon Burn—to be used together. That would be great for build creativity.
- The **main interface has been optimized** for a more user-friendly experience. Looks to be a simple yet more detailed layut

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-36-1024x560.png)

---

## Wishing Fountain Optimizations

The **Wishing Fountain** now features a **One-tap Claim** function, streamlining the reward collection process. Additionally, **new world buffs** have been introduced to enhance **resource production**, helping players progress faster.

Nothing game-breaking, but definitely a **nice QoL upgrade**.

---

## Selection and Random Chest Display Improvements

Tooltips and inventory displays for **selection and random chests** have been refined to provide clearer information.

**Simple and helpful.**

---

## Player-Created Chat Emotes

A fun addition! The inclusion of **player-created chat emotes** gives a personalized touch to in-game communication.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-37-1024x582.png)

Nothing meta-changing here, but I personally love this. It adds expression and personality to chat, and it's even better that these came from **player events** like the one recently hosted on the official Discord. (Check it out if you haven’t already!)

---

## Chronicle Place Interface Optimization

The **Chronicle Place** interface has been polished for **improved navigation and usability**—another clean quality-of-life improvement.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-38-1024x406.png)

---

## Training Camp Closure

The **Training Camp** will be temporarily closed starting **April 17**. Players with active subscriptions are advised to cancel promptly. Compensation will be delivered via in-game mail.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-39-1024x553.png)

It’s unclear what changes will be made, but I’ve always had high hopes for the Training Camp. The current format poorly reflects real combat scenarios. Ideally, the revamped version will **scale properly with your real power** (technology, honor, etc.) and allow full sandbox testing—even with units or artifacts you don’t yet own. Fingers crossed!

---

## Balance Adjustments

### Immortal Adjustments:

- **Athena**: Energy regeneration speed increased from **44/sec to 53/sec**. A decent buff—not huge, but makes her slightly more viable.
- **Loki**: “Realm of Lies” skill now deals more damage. The Confuse chance increases if enemies are Bleeding or Torn. His unique artifact now adds **30% bonus damage** to Realm of Lies instead of healing.

> This makes Loki much more attractive for endgame builds. Big fan of this change!

- **Manco Cápac**: His artifact effect now gives **30% more Sun Flare damage** (replacing dodge rate). Great change! This could give rise to new **Holy-based Manco setups**, especially when paired with Blade Dodge or Victory Pursuit.

### Wind Dragon Adjustment:

- **Stormy Breath** now activates when **any allied troops** land normal attacks (not just wind troops), with a **60% chance** to heal over 12 seconds.

This might be the **biggest change in the entire patch**. For years, hybrid setups had to use Earth Dragon due to Wind’s restrictions. With this update, **Earth-Wind hybrid teams can finally run Wind Dragon**, which has better stats. Expect a significant **buff to hybrid teams** across the board.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-40-1024x549.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Adjustments:

- **Weakening Curse**: Unlock level reduced from 51 → 50 (important with the upcoming level 50 cap in Season 1, let's hope it is also made available in the new season 1 format!)
- **Blade Vortex**: Unlock level reduced from 50 → 39
- **Spell Disintegrator**: Unlock level reduced from 47 → 38
- **Stormeye**: Unlock level reduced from 44 → 37

This helps **new players in 1 servers** get access faster to the powerful late-game skills which they are eventually going to use. Encouraging build diversity, faster progression and most importantly less temporary skills to upgrade as you progress towards the skills you actually want to spend purple crystals on! Very nice.

---

## Final Thoughts

Patch **2.8.2** delivers a satisfying mix of **quality-of-life improvements**, **balance updates**, and **forward-looking changes** that refresh several core systems. Key highlights include:

- **Stronger team-building potential** through Tower of Knowledge changes
- **More strategic flexibility** via Wind Dragon rework
- **Better alliance leadership controls** with impeachment voting
- Fun and expressive **emote support** and UI upgrades

With Season merges, new skill rebalancing, and more strategic options opening up, Infinity Kingdom continues to grow in a direction that supports both **veteran and new players** alike.

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you on the battlefield!

title: Patch 2.8.3 - New season structure

markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom v2.8.3 Update Guide

Patch 2.8.3 brings a wealth of improvements and exciting new features to *Infinity Kingdom*. From a comprehensive **season merger** to the introduction of a **brand-new Expedition Battle Pass**, this update is set to significantly enhance the *Legion of Frostborne* gameplay and progression experience. Here's everything you need to know.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-17-1024x358.png)

---

## 🌀 What's New in v2.8.3

### 🔁 1. Season Merger and Progression Overhaul

To streamline the player experience and reduce downtime between seasons, Infinity Kingdom is implementing a **new season structure** and **merging existing seasons**.

#### 📊 New Season Format:

- **Preparation Season** (Level Cap: 40)
- **Season 1** (Level Cap: 50)
- **Season 2** (Level Cap: 50)
- **Conquest Season** (Level Cap: 55)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-18-1024x866.png)

#### 🔄 Server Progression Flow:

- **Original Preparation and Season 1 servers** → will enter new Season 1.
- **Original Season 2 servers** → will merge and jump directly to Conquest Season.
- **Servers just entering Season 2** → will go directly to Conquest after finishing current season.
- **Season 3 servers** → will complete current Expedition and then enter Conquest.

#### 🛠 Balance and Display Adjustments:

- Season naming and color-coded server icons improved for clarity.
- Seasonal resource compensation and buffs (e.g., building/research speed) added for new servers.
- Matchmaking improvements for new Conquest Season entrants.
- Legion rewards and mission difficulties have been rebalanced across level caps.

---

### 🚀 2. Server Transfer Updates

With the restructured season format, **server transfer rules** have also been adjusted:

#### 📌 Key Transfer Rules:

- Only allowed **within the same season**.
- **Target server must be in the Preparation Zone.**
- **Item cost increases** with each transfer during a season.

## 🔁 Server Transfer Portal Cost Changes – What You Need to Know

One of the most impactful changes in Patch 2.8.3 is the **new scaling cost system** for **server transfer portal items**. Previously, transferring between servers required a fixed number of portals. However, starting with this update, the **cost of transferring servers will now increase based on how many times you’ve transferred within the current season**.

### 📈 How the New System Works:

- **First transfer** of the season: costs the standard number of portals.
- **Subsequent transfers**: each additional jump during the same season will require **more portal items** than the last.
- The increase is **progressive**, meaning the cost ramps up quickly if you attempt multiple transfers.

### 🔒 Why This Matters:

This update is designed to **discourage excessive server hopping**, especially from veteran players trying to **stay permanently in lower-tier seasons (e.g., Season 1)** with fully maxed-out marches and artifacts.

Previously, players could manipulate matchmaking and progression systems by constantly **resetting their server environment**, creating unfair advantages over newer or less developed players. With the new system:

- Jumping back and forth between S1 and early servers becomes **resource-prohibitive**.
- Strategic, **long-term server investment** is now more important than ever.
- Server environments will feel **more balanced**, especially in preparation and early seasons.

### 🔔 Key Takeaways:

- **Plan your server transfers carefully** — multiple moves in a season will be costly.
- **Stay informed about your current season status** (icon color and rules) to avoid surprises.
- This change brings more **stability** and **fairness** to the Legion of Frostborne experience for everyone.

If you’re managing multiple accounts or alt strategies, consider **committing to your main server** for the season to avoid burning precious portals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-19.png)

#### 🔴 Special Handling:

- Servers in S1/S2 at the time of the update will be marked **red**.
- **Red → Yellow** transfers allowed; **Yellow → Red** are blocked.
- Free transfers allowed between servers of the **same icon color**.

---

### 🎯 3. Expedition Battle Pass – New KVK Progression Feature

A **major addition** to the Conquest Season is the new **Expedition Battle Pass**, designed to reward activity in the *Legion of Frostborne* battlefield. **[See more read.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/legion-of-frostborne/kvk-battle-pass-2-8-3/)**

#### 🏅 Battle Pass Details:

- **Access via:** Legion Achievements tab.
- **Earn EXP:** Complete personal Legion tasks to level up.
- **Duration:** Lasts for the full war period; ends if war ends early.
- **Important:** Progress (including paid unlocks) resets if you transfer servers during an active war.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-20-1024x487.png)

#### 🎁 Reward Tiers:

- **Free Tier:** Basic resources and random immortal fragments.
- **Paid Tier:**  - Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments
- **FULL 60-stone unlock** of a powerful Tower of Knowledge skill

This makes the paid pass incredibly valuable for players looking to build top-tier marches and maximize their KVK rewards.

---

### ⚒️ Feature Tweaks & Optimizations

- **Dragon Talent unlocks moved to Season 2**.
- **Inner City UI**: Resource panels grouped by resource type for improved clarity.

---

## 📌 Final Thoughts

Patch 2.8.3 marks a pivotal step toward a more balanced and engaging KVK experience in *Infinity Kingdom*. The revamped season system reduces grind and downtime, while the Expedition Battle Pass encourages consistent engagement and offers premium rewards for effort.

Whether you're strategizing your next Conquest or preparing your march in Season 1, now is a great time to dive into Norheim and make your mark.

---

**Stay updated:** Follow Infinity Kingdom on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/InfinityKingdom), Discord, and other social channels for community updates and patch events.

title: Patch 2.8.4 - Ninetail buffs and more
summary: Infinity Kingdom's Patch v2.8.4, released on May 29, 2025, introduces a series of enhancements aimed at improving gameplay, alliance dynamics, and strategic depth. This update brings significant changes, particularly to…
markdown:
**Infinity Kingdom's Patch v2.8.4, released on May 29, 2025**, introduces a series of enhancements aimed at improving gameplay, alliance dynamics, and strategic depth. This update brings significant changes, particularly to the Immortal Nine Tails, and offers various quality-of-life improvement[s.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/patch-notes/patch-2-8-x/patch-2-8-3/)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-125-1024x320.png)

### https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7022701.html

---

## 🔥 Nine Tails Rework: A Game-Changer for Trigger-Based Builds

One of the most impactful changes in this patch is the overhaul of Nine Tails' skill, *Phantom Pact*. Previously an active skill that cleansed allies and boosted trigger-type skill activation chances, it has now been divided into a passive and an active component:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-126-1024x565.png)

- **Passive**: Upon entering battle, increases the trigger chance of all allied trigger-type skills by *(3% +1% per level)*.
- **Active**: Removes Bite, Serious Wound, and DoT effects from all allies. Additionally, after any allied Immortal casts an Ultimate Skill, it restores HP to the most damaged allied troop *(Recovery Rate: 69% +23% per level)* for 6 seconds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-128.png)

While getting her skills buff to trigger chance as a passive instead of an active buff, means a much more reliable and effective use of the the skills strenghts in combination with chance ultimates like Wu's or Loki's as well as big damage skills like Annihilation and Infinite Firepower.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-127-1024x569.png)

But while this is a clear buff, we also see her unique artifact being changed. From an additional 5% trigger chance to 30% healing done. While I think this is a slight nerf because you want Ninetails: One to hard-counter Poseidon, and two to provide trigger chance. The healing done is not huge from her, but hey - maybe 30% more will change that!

- Nine Tails' unique artifact now enhances the healing effect by 30%.

### Strategic Implications

This rework significantly elevates Nine Tails' utility in trigger-based team compositions. The passive increase in trigger chance synergizes exceptionally well with Immortals like Wu Zetian, Baldwin IV, and Loki, who rely heavily on triggered skills. The active component's cleansing and healing capabilities further bolster team survivability, making Nine Tails a versatile asset in various setups.

---

## 🛠️ Quality-of-Life Enhancements

### Skill Details Sharing

Players can now share details of Immortal active skills, Tower of Knowledge skills, and Dragon skills directly in chat channels. This facilitates better communication and strategy sharing within alliances and the broader community.

### Alliance Internal Rankings

New internal rankings have been introduced for alliances, covering:

- **Strongest Troop Power**
- **Total Troop Number**
- **Lord Honor**

These rankings provide a clearer picture of individual contributions and can aid in strategic planning and recognition within alliances.

### Interface Optimizations

- **Stellar Compass**: Drop rates for each item are now viewable, offering greater transparency.
- **Official Post Appointment**: Player avatars are now displayed, enhancing the visual appeal and clarity of appointments.
- **Tower of Knowledge**: The interface now shows equipped Immortals alongside their skills, making it easier to manage and strategize skill allocations.

### Alliance Leadership Adjustments

The rank required to initiate a forced impeachment within an alliance has been changed from R3 to R4. This adjustment ensures that only higher-ranking members can initiate such significant changes, promoting stability and thoughtful leadership transitions.

---

## 🎯 Conclusion

Patch v2.8.4 brings meaningful improvements to Infinity Kingdom, enhancing both strategic depth and user experience. The rework of Nine Tails opens up new possibilities for trigger-based team compositions, while the quality-of-life enhancements streamline gameplay and alliance management. Players are encouraged to explore these changes and adapt their strategies to maximize their effectiveness on the battlefield.

title: Patch 2.8.5 - Return of Control Builds, Golden Path Buffs and more!
summary: The latest Infinity Kingdom patch comes with some of the biggest changes to the Golden Path (GP) event since its inception—and adds a brand-new immortal, Ares, with a groundbreaking ultimate skill. This patch isn’t just…
markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom Patch Overview – Major Golden Path Overhaul and Ares Reveal

The latest Infinity Kingdom patch comes with some of the biggest changes to the Golden Path (GP) event since its inception—and adds a brand-new immortal, **Ares**, with a groundbreaking ultimate skill. This patch isn’t just tweaking numbers; it’s reshaping how low- and mid-spenders approach long-term progress, making high-tier power much more accessible while also offering a glimpse of a potential shift in PvP meta.

In this article, we break down the key changes, explain why they matter, and explore their future impact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-1024x423.png)

---

## Massive Buffs to Golden Path (GP)

Let’s start with the headline: **Golden Path has received a major buff.**

Until now, players participating in Golden Path could only exchange up to **2,000 Merit Coins** for 10x60 fragments of the highly sought after Immortals like YSS, Mathilda, Trajan and others. That will change. From now on, we are getting half. That’s **60 fragments per immortal, up to** **5 times**—enough to unlock or slowly progress a specific immortal, but obviously this will slow down the speed at which newer players will be able to max out YSS and the others. But while this is a minor nerf, there are MAJOR news!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-2-1024x431.png)

So far we have had no Unique Artifacts in GP and its been very hard to get UAs for the GP immortals.

That changes now.

### What’s New:

- You are still limited to **1,000 Merit Coins** worth of immortal fragments per Golden Path run (5x 60-fragment bundles).
- **Now you can also purchase the Unique Artifact shards** for those same immortals available in the Golden Path!

### Why This Is a Big Deal:

Unique Artifacts (UAs) are some of the most powerful tools in Infinity Kingdom. They define the effectiveness of high-end immortals. Until now, immortals like Mathilda, Trajan, and Mathilda—who feature in GP—have been easy to obtain but almost impossible to max out, because their Unique Artifacts were so rare or paywalled. That bottleneck is now open.

Now, **players who invest in Golden Path can realistically work toward not only maxing their immortal fragments, but also completing their artifacts.** This makes immortals like Mathilda (a fantastic support), YSS (best tank in the game), and others far more viable at high-end PvP.

### Minor Drawback:

The **fragment purchase cap** halfed will be rought for some... This is a disappointment for Season 1 players who have used Golden Path to stack fragments fast for crystal melting (to boost Tower of Knowledge skills). The five-bundle cap slows down early-game progression and lowers purple crystal farming efficiency.

However, even with this small downside, the overall Golden Path update is a **massive net positive**. It makes the event one of the best long-term investments for low- and mid-spenders.

---

## Ares – New Immortal, New Meta?

The patch also introduces **Ares**, a brand-new immortal whose active skill is already creating buzz.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-1-1024x1024.png)

### Ares’s Active Skill:

> "Inflicts Physical Damage (Damage Rate x%) on all enemies, with a y% chance of applying Frighten: Prevents the carrier from gaining Control Immunity effects and weakens their Barriers by 30% for 6 seconds."

This might be the **single most impactful skill text we’ve seen in a long time**, because it introduces something never before seen: a **counter to control immunity**.

### Why That Matters:

The meta in Infinity Kingdom has shifted heavily toward units and setups that center around:

- Deal insane burst damage
- Are immune to control (Fountain and Fu Fei)

This has made traditional **control setups** (stun, silence, fear) nearly obsolete—until now. Ares’s “Frighten” status bypasses the core of what made control irrelevant: control immunity. And with new control-supporting Tower of Knowledge skills like **Fountain of Life**, the door is open for a return to tactical, status-based marches.

This could bring back strong setups with:

- Loki **(Confuse)**
- Tony **(Confuse)**
- Other classic controllers like Richard, Attila, Bathory, Himiko, etc.

Ares in combination with ToK skills like Fountain and proper support, **we may be seeing the rebirth of control-based strategies** at the top levels.

### Big Spender Alert:

Let’s be honest: Ares and this new meta direction won’t be accessible to everyone right away. As of now, these new tools are extremely costly to acquire. But if you’re a huge spender or in a kingdom with players who are, expect new kinds of high-control marches to start appearing.

And if you’re a theorycrafter? This is your moment to shine.

---

## Final Thoughts

This patch is a major milestone. The Golden Path has gone from a modest progression tool to one of the **best-value events in the game**, offering both immortal fragments and Unique Artifact progress. Yes, the cap on fragment purchases slightly slows early-game fragment farming, but the tradeoff is more than worth it.

Add to that a bold new immortal with a control-immunity counter and we’re potentially seeing the **beginning of a meta shift** that reopens doors to old strategies and new creativity.

**Whether you’re a low-spender, mid-spender, or theorycrafting enthusiast, this patch gives you more tools than ever.**

Time to log in and start planning your next Golden Path run—and maybe your return to control domination.

title: Patch 2.8.6 - new skills, putting an end to endless whale-gemming and more
summary: Patch 2.8.6 is here, bringing substantial changes to Infinity Kingdom’s core mechanics and introducing exciting new features. As always, I'll unpack all the details, explain their impact, and share what this means for…
markdown:
## 📌 Main Points from Patch 2.8.6 (TL;DR)

- **New Hybrid Meta Skill:**
The introduction of **Knife Through Butter** will revitalize Hybrid setups. With its rapid energy drain, this skill is set to disrupt the current hyper-regen meta by preventing enemy immortals from casting ultimates as frequently. Expect high-speed Hybrid teams using **Wind Rage** and **Berserker** to become popular again.
- **No More Endless Gemming of Prosperity:**
The update introduces scaling gem costs for restoring Prosperity, making repeated gemming increasingly costly each day. This change encourages smarter and more strategic PvP play, emphasizing careful planning over limitless gem-spending.
- **Holy Team Buff – Manco Cápac vs. Confuse:**
**Manco Cápac** now grants Holy Immortals **Control Immunity**, specifically countering problematic Confuse skills used by immortals like **Tomyris** and **Loki**. This provides Holy teams a powerful defensive advantage against crowd control, enhancing their viability in the PvP meta.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-16-1024x480.png)

## Comprehensive Guide to Patch 2.8.6 – Infinity Kingdom's Latest Update Explained

Patch 2.8.6 is here, bringing substantial changes to Infinity Kingdom’s core mechanics and introducing exciting new features. As always, I'll unpack all the details, explain their impact, and share what this means for your game experience and strategy. Whether you're a casual player or a competitive strategist, this update brings something significant for everyone.

## 🔥 Key Highlights of Patch 2.8.6:

This update introduces several major additions and adjustments, each designed to balance gameplay, add strategic depth, and improve your overall gaming experience.

---

## ⚔️ 1. New Pinnacle Trial Ranking System

The Pinnacle Trial now features a competitive ranking system, called **Trial Ranking**. Here's how it works:

- **Points System:** Players clearing the Pinnacle Trial stages earn ranking points. Top 10 scorers appear on the leaderboard.
- **Challenges:** You can challenge players on the leaderboard. Winning earns you ranking points; losing has no penalty.
- **Limited Attempts:** Daily challenge attempts are limited, so make them count.
- **Ranking Rewards:** End-of-event rewards scale based on your final rank, providing extra incentive for competitive play.

**What it Means for You:**
This adds a welcome competitive edge to PvE gameplay, making Pinnacle Trials more rewarding and engaging. Players with strong PvE setups can now shine even brighter and earn well-deserved bragging rights and rewards.

---

## 📚 2. New Tower of Knowledge Skills

### 🗡️ Knife Through Butter (Legendary Skill)

- **Effect:** After every 6 normal attacks, deal AoE physical damage (60% + 20%/level) with a 60% chance to drain enemy energy by 90 + 30/level.
- **Acquisition:** Available via Wisdom Well during Conquest Season.

**Strategic Impact:**
A game-changer, especially for Hybrid setups. With high attack-speed Immortals, this skill dramatically disrupts enemy ultimates. It directly counters the current hyper-regen meta by consistently draining enemy energy.

### 🛡️ Iron Curtain (Epic Skill)

- **Effect:** Normal attacks have a chance (18% + 6%/level) to weaken enemy barriers by 30% for 3 seconds. Also grants a damage reduction buff (10.5% + 3.5%/level) when troop strength is above 70%.
- **Acquisition:** Available via Conquest Season Recharge Gifts Pack.

**Strategic Impact:**
Useful for tankier frontlines and teams facing barrier-heavy opponents. The added defensive buff further improves sustain, making it great for tanky setups and bruisers.

---

## ⚖️ 3. Optimizations & Adjustments

### 📌 Wisdom Well Event Shop Improvements

The following valuable skills are now more easily accessible:

- **S1 Skills:** Fire of Rage, Victorious Pursuit, Snipe, Stormeye, Curse of Pain, Blade Vortex, Toxin Barrier, Demonic Contract, Void Realm.
- **Conquest Season Skills:** Siren's Gaze, Weakness Protection, Berserker, Wind Rage.

**Player Impact:**
This broadens strategic diversity, allowing players easier access to skills previously challenging to obtain. Expect richer and more varied team compositions.

### 💎 Prosperity Gem Cost Changes

To curb endless gem-spending on Prosperity recovery (a common frustration in PvP):

- Gem cost for restoring Prosperity now scales upward with each daily use.
- Costs reset at UTC 0:00 daily.

**Strategic Impact:**
Players now need to think carefully before gemming prosperity repeatedly. It promotes smarter gameplay, requiring thoughtful engagement and strategic resource management.

### 🌎 Migration Power Cap Increased

- The King’s migration power cap is now raised significantly (from 2-3 million to 4-6 million power) based on completed Contention of Relics battles.

**Player Impact:**
This change enables stronger players to migrate between servers, fostering greater competitiveness and flexibility for seasoned players or alliances looking to merge or recruit high-power lords.

### 🛒 Golden Path Shop Display Update

- Now clearly displays item quantities, improving clarity and ease of shopping.

---

## 🎯 Balance Adjustments to Immortals

Several Immortals received significant balance tweaks, increasing their viability:

### 🔸 Manco Cápac

- Now grants **Control Immunity** to all Holy Immortals and increases **Dodge Rate** for 15 seconds.
- Becomes immune to Confuse after casting, periodically dealing Physical Damage afterward, but no longer gains energy post-cast.

**Impact:** Significantly improves Holy team defense against crowd-control, enhancing sustained battles.

### 🔸 Khubilai Khan

- Damage increased slightly (now 78% + 26%/level) on wolf attacks.
- Each wolf has a 60% chance to apply stacking debuffs, increasing the target's physical damage received (up to 3 stacks).

**Impact:** Strengthens Khan’s viability, especially in physical-damage-focused teams, making him a more attractive frontline DPS/support hybrid.

### 🔸 Nebuchadnezzar II

- Base Energy Regen Speed significantly increased (66 → 83 points/second).

**Impact:** Faster ultimate casts will improve his utility, potentially shifting builds around Nebuchadnezzar II and enhancing his usage in competitive teams.

---

## 📌 Strategic Analysis: What Does This Patch Mean for You?

Patch 2.8.6 clearly aims at game balance:

- **Hybrid setups** return strongly to the meta, challenging dominant pure magic and hyper-regen teams.
- The new Prosperity gem cost scaling forces strategic resource management, reducing "infinite shielding" and encouraging tactical decision-making.
- Improved skill availability in Wisdom Well greatly enhances player flexibility, letting you experiment with builds you might previously have overlooked.
- Improved migration flexibility offers strategic options for highly competitive players or alliances.

This patch makes strategic planning, thoughtful investment, and tactical flexibility more important than ever.

---

## 🔮 Predictions: What's Next in the Meta?

I predict significant shifts in the meta following Patch 2.8.6:

- **Hybrid setups** (physical/magical mixed teams) will see a strong resurgence.
- Skills promoting high attack speed (Wind Rage, Berserker) and energy disruption (Knife Through Butter) will dominate the new strategic landscape.
- Prosperity gem cost changes will promote smarter PvP engagement, rewarding more strategic and calculated players.

---

## 📖 Conclusion & TL;DR

Patch 2.8.6 offers a mix of new strategic depth, balancing adjustments, and quality-of-life improvements, emphasizing thoughtful gameplay:

- New Pinnacle Trial rankings add competitive PvE depth.
- **Knife Through Butter** and **Iron Curtain** skills provide crucial meta shifts, reviving hybrid strategies.
- Prosperity gem scaling encourages smarter PvP play.
- Easier skill access from Wisdom Well diversifies build options.
- Increased migration power cap enhances server competitiveness.

In short, Infinity Kingdom Patch 2.8.6 significantly changes how we approach team-building, PvP strategy, and PvE challenges. Adaptation and careful planning are now keys to victory.

title: Patch 2.8.7 - Arthur nerf, more artifacts to the people and battle pass changes and more
summary: Patch 2.8.7 dropped with a lot of hype around Wildfire Furnace and Alliance Supremacy. Those are cool new events and worth checking out in the official news posts, but the real long-term impact of this patch lies deeper…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-69.png)

Patch 2.8.7 dropped with a lot of hype around **Wildfire Furnace** and **Alliance Supremacy**. Those are cool new events and worth checking out in the official news posts, but the real long-term impact of this patch lies deeper in the notes. Some subtle changes here could shake up progression, the gem economy, and even the late-game meta. Let’s dig into the big ones.

---

## Battle Pass Expansion & Shop

The **Legendary & Peak Battle Pass** has been expanded up to **100 levels**, with levels now purchasable. On top of that, a **Battle Pass Shop** has been added where you can spend **Inferno Insignia** on Holy, Shadow, and Chaos immortal fragments plus their exclusive artifacts.

> ### 3. Legendary & Peak Battle Pass

>
>
>
> 1) Legendary & Peak Battle Pass levels increased to 100, with battle pass levels available for purchase.
>
>
>
> 2) Battle Pass shop opened, where Inferno Insignia can be used to purchase Holy, Shadow, and Chaos Immortal Fragments and their exclusive artifacts.
>
>
>
> 3) Inferno Insignia can be obtained through premium battle pass rewards, participating in Festival Events, purchasing festival packs, etc.

The way it works. Player Exe has been kind enough to share details with us:

- Each BP level now gives **10 medallions**.
- It costs **450 medallions** for **60 fragments** (holy/shadow).
- Buying a level costs **600 gems**.

Basically, you can think of the mechanics to how this work as the normal GP, we have 50 levels of rewards and then we repeat level 50. But instead of an unlimited repeat of level 50 (like in normal GP) we have a cap of 100 levels, i.e. 50 levels that are just currency rewards. Basically a GP but capped at level 100 instead of unlimited.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-82-1024x472.png)

### Buying immortals this way is thus:

- 27,000 gems = 60 frags of a Holy/Shadow immortal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-80-1024x472.png)

While gemming levels here for fragments is not particularly cheap, the path in itself with the 100 level version is incredibly good value. And even tho is is not cheap, and most players aren’t going to be spamming it, the upside is this adds **another gem → useful fragments conversion path**, which has been a theme in recent updates. Slow farming it with free pass levels is probably the most realistic play for most players, but whales now have a guaranteed gem sink for Shadow/Holy progress.

Completing the Battle Pass in the new version is super high value. For just **30$ you will get 2150 gems, 60 immortal fragment selection chests for holy/shadow, 1000 medallions (i.e. little over 120 frags) and 60 random holy/shadow fragments** by completing daily quests consistently and maxing out the pass event. Comparatively, the old version yielded just 90 selection chests and 30 random holy/shadow fragments as you completed the 50 levels there.

*Note, completing 100 levels should be doable without gemming since the quests have gotten an EXP buff. Player Exe who has been kind enough to share is past level 14 in 4 days without completing every quest.*

---

## Battle Pass Shop S2 Updates

The **Monthly BP Shop S2** now includes **Ragnar, Mehmed II, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Darius, and Cao Cao fragments**, along with their artifacts.

> ***The notes say "Monthly Battle Pass Shop S2 season adds Ragnar, Mehmed II, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Darius the Great, and Cao Cao fragments, along with exclusive artifacts."***

This is honestly a very welcome change. Ragnar and Cao Cao artifacts in particular have been high-demand pieces. A lot of players stalled out because you needed specific events to push those, so BP making them more accessible is a win.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-70-1024x445.png)

And it ties nicely with the **Sparks of Galaxy S2** update:

> ***3) Sparks of Galaxy event S2 season adds seasonal Immortal exclusive artifact selection box.***

The Seasonal Immortals tend to reference the ones available in e.g. Battle Pass as notes above, which is great. Now you can also grab **seasonal Immortal exclusive artifact selection boxes** in Galaxy! This is the same as the new seasonal addition in the Daily Pearl Shop, though that one is a bit expensive. Anyway, if you for example, is running a **YSS + Himiko build** (one of the strongest Season 2 metas), you can now farm **Himiko artifacts** within the same Galaxy event cycle. Much smoother progression for focused builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-84-1024x612.png)

---

## King Arthur Reflection Nerf

This one’s huge for late-game PvP.

Arthur’s reflection used to basically act like **true damage**. If you dropped him against an Apollo-heavy whale march, his reflect ignored their reduction stats — so Apollo just ate that damage raw. That made Arthur one of the few effective counters to big Apollo setups.

> ### King Arthur Damage Reflection Algorithm Fix

>
>
>
> After the fix, King Arthur's reflected damage will be affected by the target's damage reduction attributes.

Now:

- Reflection **does scale with the target’s damage reduction** (YSS, Tower of Knowledge nodes, artifact reductions, etc.).
- In practice, this means Arthur is going to bounce back *much* less damage to whales, since stacked defensive stats will blunt it.

I’ll be real — this probably kills his role as a “budget whale counter.” Without that cheese, he may slide back into obscurity unless something else keeps him relevant. Which is a shame, because he offered a very different tool compared to the standard bruisers. I hope the devs keep tweaking him instead of letting him rot.

If you’re mid-game and thinking of building him now, I’d wait to see how the meta reacts. He might still be okay for general marches, but his days of cracking Apollo are gone.

---

## Other Small but Notable Changes

- **Immortal Specialization Master All**: being able to preset and instantly unlock entire node chains is a nice QoL upgrade. Less clicking, more experimenting.
- **Daily Deals Shop**: Holy and Shadow artifacts after 75 days → great for newer servers catching up.
- **Training Grounds raid requirement lowered**: from 30% reserves to 10%. Means you can raid more aggressively without gimping your training, which is solid for active servers.
- **Gem auto removal**: if you’ve ever had to unsocket multiple gems from one piece, you’ll love this.

---

## Player Perspective

If I had to break it down:

- **Battle Pass changes** are the best part of this patch for long-term growth. Even if you don’t whale, just having the option to slowly gem → fragment farm is progress.
- **Galaxy S2 + BP Shop updates** smooth out a lot of the artifact bottlenecks. This is going to speed up how fast people can actually *finish* their intended builds.
- **Arthur fix** is the one sore spot. It makes sense for balance, but it also cuts away one of the only fun curveballs against top-tier Apollo whales.

If it were me, I’d be putting gems into the BP shop path as a long-term holy/shadow investment, while holding off on Arthur until we see if he survives in the new balance landscape.

---

## Bottom Line

Patch 2.8.7 is sneaky important. Everyone’s eyes are on Wildfire and Alliance Supremacy, but the **Battle Pass overhaul** and **Arthur nerf** will affect the actual day-to-day progression and PvP scene way more.

- More ways to farm Shadow/Holy = win.
- Easier access to artifacts = win.
- Arthur losing his cheese = probably a loss, unless you never built him in the first place.

So, my advice? Start planning how to use gems in the new BP shop, enjoy the smoother artifact paths, and keep an eye on how the PvP tier list shifts without Arthur as a counterpick.

title: Patch 2.8.8 - Legendary Season
summary: The Wildfire Furnace embers are burning hot and the team behind IK is ready to drop the new Legendary Season, introducing level 60 cap across buildings, Immortals, dragons, gnomes, tech—the works. With new ranks, levels…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-33-1024x576.png)

The Wildfire Furnace embers are burning hot and the team behind IK is ready to drop the new **Legendary Season**, introducing **level 60 cap** across buildings, Immortals, dragons, gnomes, tech—the works. With new ranks, levels and tiers comes new materials and systems:

- **Energy Core** gating for building upgrades (new currencies: **Azure** & **Stellar** Crystals).
- **Mythic equipment** reforges with **random attributes** (bound to the Immortal).
- **Elemental Domain** boss dungeons on a weekly elemental schedule.
- **Alliance-based KVK registration** and new **migration** rules centered on a server-wide **Command Power** metric.

This guide translates the patch notes into practical gameplay: what changes, why it matters, and how to prep so day one of Legendary Season feels like an acceleration, not a wall.

**[Full patch notes available here.](https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7023513.html)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-34-1024x419.png)

---

## Level 60 Expansion – What Actually Changes

### 1) Buildings → 60 via Energy Cores

**Energy Cores** control your path to Lv60. Each Core has **5 tiers**, every tier has **3 stages**. You **inject energy** with **Azure** or **Stellar Crystals**; once a Core hits **stage 3**, you can **upgrade to the next tier** by consuming normal resources.

- **Azure Crystals**: After entering Legendary Season and reaching **Forge Lv55**, you can convert **Food/Wood/Stone/Iron** into Azure in the Forge.
- **Stellar Crystals**: From **events** (details vary per cycle).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/E1F76965-5D8E-4C10-83E7-1A80A3A7391E-1024x198.png)

**Why this matters:** You can’t brute-force to 60 with only speedups and mats. The Core stages throttle pace. Start thinking of **resource → Azure** conversion as a long-term sink, and time your event play for Stellar injections.

### Prep tips

- Push **Forge to 55** before Oct 20 if you can, so Azure conversion is unlocked immediately once you’re in Legendary.
- Bank standard resources and speedups; you’ll redirect a chunk into **Azure** instead of raw building.

---

### 2) Equipment → Legendary+ & Mythic Reforges

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-37-1024x130.png)

**Gnomes Lv56+** can drop **Legendary+ gear** that levels to **60**. Once strengthened to 60, you can **reforge to Mythic** using:

- **[Class + Slot Forging Stone]** and **[Forging Hammer]** to perform the reforge.
- Reforged Mythic pieces are **bound to the Immortal**, **cannot be removed**, and gain **1–5 random attributes**.
- **Rerolls**: Use **Tempering Elixirs** + **Forging Hammers** to reroll random attributes.
- **Sources** for these mats: **Well of Time – Elemental Domain** (see below).

**Why this matters:** Mythic attributes are the real stat ceiling. Binding means fewer hand-me-downs; plan **who** gets Mythic first. The **random lines** introduce chase/variance like Artifacts—expect a min–max grind.

### Prep tips

- Farm and stash **Well of Time** currency; clear daily once Legendary starts.
- Decide priority Immortals per march; once you bind a Mythic, it’s committed.
- Keep a **reroll budget** (Elixirs/Hammers) to avoid getting stuck with dead stats.

---

### 3) Elemental Domain (Oct 20, 00:00 UTC)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-36-1024x130.png)

A new event featuring **eight elemental dungeons**: Water, Fire, Wind, Lightning, Earth, **Holy**, **Shadow**, **Chaos**.

### Weekly schedule

- **Mon**: Water
- **Tue**: Fire
- **Wed**: Wind
- **Thu**: Lightning
- **Fri**: Earth
- **Sat–Sun**: **All elements** (Water, Fire, Wind, Lightning, Earth, Holy, Shadow, Chaos)

### Rules

- **Element lock**: Only Immortals/dragons of that element can enter that day’s dungeon.
- **3 challenges/day**; attempts reset daily.
- **Rewards scale** with **boss remaining HP** after your run.

**Unknown details:** It’s still unclear whether this event is **personal, server-wide, or cross-server**. Stay tuned for confirmation when it goes live.

**Why this matters:** Progression mats for Mythic gear are time-gated by **element days**. If you don’t have depth in an element, your income is worse that day. Saturday/Sunday become catch-up windows.

### Prep tips

- **Bench-build**: Promote/star-up side-element Immortals so they can hold **3 skills** even if you don’t dust them yet. Example: if you don’t main Water, star up **Merlin** so he can carry good gold skills on Mondays.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-43-1024x528.png)

- For instance, a Seondeok is awesome in PvE content, so get her star ranks done and use her during fire tuesdays!

- **Don’t**blow **stardust**on off-march units yet; prioritize stars → skill slots.
- Keep flexible **gold skill pools** to re-slot between elements.

---

### 4) Other Cap Increases

- **Resource points / Gnomes / Mech bosses / Lord Lv** → all **to 60**.
- **Immortals**: Lv60; **Boost Level cap 35** (SP bottles matter again).
- **Dragons**: Lv60; **new talent nodes** (expect both skill trees to reach **Lv10** nodes).
- **Barracks**: Higher-tier troops unlock.
- **Tower of Knowledge**: **New skills** unlock with higher levels.
- **Academy**: New **Technologies**; focus PvP stats first.
- **Well of Time & Elite dungeons**: New chapters.
- **Fortification**: Higher wall tiers.

**Why this matters:** It’s a total-stat jump across every layer. Expect arena/KVK DPS and tank checks to rise quickly once a few whales hit 35 boosts and Lv10 dragon nodes.

### Prep tips

- Hoard **SP bottles** and **dragon crystals**; those two are immediate, visible power spikes.
- Save **unclaimed daily/quest EXP** on alts/mains if you were holding them—turn-in post-60 unlock to jump-start **Lord** levels.
- Prioritize **Academy** lines that directly give **Atk/Def/HP** for your main march types.

---

## Legendary Season – Structure & KVK Flow

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-38-1024x165.png)

### Opening & Off-Season

- **Opens Oct 20, 00:00 UTC** for servers that joined preview (S1–S232; M1–M12).
- **First off-season** before the first Legendary KVK is extended to **30 days**; later ones revert to **14 days**.

**Why this matters:** You get a one-time month to climb the new caps before the first Legendary KVK. Plan your alliance’s **upgrade sprint** around this window.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-39-1024x238.png)

### Alliance Registration (Legion of Frostborne)

- Registration/matchmaking/settlement are now **Alliance-based**.
- **Window**: **72 hours after off-season** opens.
- **Who registers**: **R6/R5** (manual). After deadline, the system can **auto-assign** alliances to factions based on active members and power.
- **Skip rule**: Alliances that participated in the **previous round** can **choose to skip** the current one (not for brand-new/no-history alliances).
- **Alliance lock** after the deadline: you’re bound to your alliance for that KVK. Leaving and coming back to the **same** alliance is okay; switching alliances or migrating blocks entry for that round. New joiners **after** the deadline cannot participate that round.

**Why this matters:** No more freewheeling alt alliance hopscotch mid-season. Leadership needs to coordinate **who’s in** before the deadline and avoid late swaps.

---

## Migration Overhaul – Command Power & Slots

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-40-1024x159.png)

### Command Power

Each server calculates **daily at 00:00 UTC** the average of top players’ **historical highest power**. That average is the server’s **Command Power** benchmark.

### Special Migration Slots

- If a player’s **historical highest lord power ≥ Command Power** of the target server, they must consume **1 Special Migration Slot** from that server to move in. Otherwise, no slot needed.
- **Slot quantities by season:**  - **Season 1**: **3** per server
- **Season 2**: **5** per server
- **Conquest**: **8** per server
- **Legendary**: **8** per server
- Slots **refresh when the server enters a new season**.

### King Settings

- **Allow Special Migration**: High-power players (≥ Command Power) can enter by consuming slots; others free.
- **Disallow Special Migration**: Blocks all players ≥ Command Power. Others free.
- If there’s **no King**, the **last saved** King setting persists.

### What this changes in practice

- **Kings become gatekeepers**. Recruitment of whales is a strategic resource decision.
- **Scarcity**: A tiny slot pool forces alliances to rank recruits and coordinate multi-player moves.
- **Season timing** matters: Some groups will wait for a season change to refresh slots.

### Server strategy notes

- **New S1/S2**: Protects early ecosystems; only a handful of over-cap players can enter.
- **Conquest/Legendary**: Still tight. Expect pre-arranged **slot reservations** and audits of candidate **historical highest**.

---

## New Tower Skill – Fully Prepared

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-41-1024x238.png)

- **Type**: Offensive Immortal only. **Mutually exclusive** with **Counterattack** (cannot equip both).
- **Effect**: Each normal attack **increases damage dealt** by **1.8% + 0.6%/level** and **reduces damage taken** by **1.5% + 0.5%/level**, stacking up to **10** times.
- **Acquisition**: **Wisdom Well** event.
- **Suggested users** (from notes): **Ares, Alexander, Hannibal, Wukong, Poseidon**, etc.

### How it plays

- It’s a **ramp** skill keyed to **basic attack cadence**. On fast-hitting or extended fights, the stack cap yields notable **DPS + survivability**. On burst/short fights, it may underperform immediate-value skills.
- Clashes with **Counterattack** builds—so choose between **sustained ramp** vs **reactive damage loops**.

**Meta note:** While this skill seems tuned to boost **Ares**, it could actually push **Alexander** back into meta relevance. With multiple attack speed-based skills now in circulation, Alex’s value in sustained DPS comps may surge again.

---

## Quality-of-Life & Economy Tweaks

- **Forge conversion**: Each converted item can be collected immediately; **Gold** requires at least **10,000** per collect. You can **manually input** conversion amounts now.
- **Alliance Help** now works on **Dragon upgrades** (huge time saver post-55).
- **Battle Pass (Golden Path)**: Daily purchasable levels cap **raised to 30** (applies next BP cycle after the update; missed days don’t roll over).
- **Daily Mission Lord EXP** for **Lv41–55** increased **from 200 → 500**.
- **Bug Fix**: **Iron Curtain** no longer weakens enemies’ barriers if they have **no barrier effects** active (fixes unintended interactions).

### Why this matters

- Faster **dragon** timelines during Legendary sprint.
- Early/mid accounts climb **Lord levels** faster, helping them reach 55/Legendary gating.
- BP buyers can compress progress per day, but not retroactively.

---

## Practical Day‑1 Plan (Oct 20 Legendary Unlock)

1. **Forge 55 check** → Start **Azure** conversion loop.
2. **Academy** → Queue first **PvP-stat techs** unlocked by 56–60 tiers, unless major dev. nodes are available. Look for Troop count and Crit Damage (unknown if added, what I will look for first once patch drops).
3. **Dragon** → Upgrade + spam **Alliance Help**; aim for new **Lv10 nodes** quickly.
4. **Immortal boosts** → Pump **SP** to your main carry line; aim **Tier 34–35** on DPS first.
5. **Elemental Domain** → Hit the **day’s element** with a pre-built bench; use weekend to make up weak elements.
6. **Gear** → Push **Legendary+ to 60** on your #1 DPS, then **Mythic reforge**; keep mats for **rerolls**.
7. **Alliance admin** → Handle **KVK registration** within the 72h window; lock rosters early; communicate migration stance with the King.

---

## Conclusion Summary

- **Legendary Season** is a systems gate: Energy Cores, Elemental Domain, and Mythic reforges will pace your progress more than raw speedups.
- **Mythic gear** + **Immortal Tier 35** + **Dragon Lv10 nodes** are the big three power spikes. Plan mats and rerolls around your **primary DPS**.
- **Alliance/KVK** becomes more administrative: registration windows, roster locks, and **migration slots** turn kingship into a strategic role.
- **Bottom line**: Prep your Forge, hoard SP/dragon mats, build minimal element benches, and align your alliance on migration/KVK logistics before Oct 20.

---

## Notes & Sources
