The result could be a major shift in both Conquest progression and the top Legendary meta, with Medusa becoming the leading physical carry earlier and Horus emerging as a genuine magical alternative at the highest level.

## Table of Contents

- Horus and Royal Sarcophagus
- Why the damage cap matters
- Psychic Vortex and the new hyper-regen mage
- Horus versus Medusa at the top of the meta
- The Wish Shop changes
- Thorn Armor and Counterattack teams
- Other additions and quality-of-life improvements
- Final assessment

---

## Horus and Royal Sarcophagus

Horus is a Chaos Immortal positioned in the back row. He deals magical damage, commands Bowmen, and will initially be obtainable through the Pirate Festival event. His ability, Royal Sarcophagus, combines a permanent defensive passive with an active area attack and team-wide damage amplification.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-13-1024x201.png)

His exclusive artifact increases the Punishment application chance to 100%, while the official recommendations for its primary attribute are Crit Rate or Magical Attack Bonus. With the artifact equipped, every successful ultimate should therefore place the full enemy march under a 15% damage-taken debuff for six seconds at maximum skill level.

There is already plenty to like in the active portion of the ability. A 400% magical attack against all four enemies is strong, and Punishment increases the damage those targets receive from the rest of Horus's march as well. He is not merely a protected damage dealer. He can also function as a team-wide amplifier, making every follow-up ultimate and triggered magical attack more threatening during the debuff window.

The passive portion, however, is what makes Horus genuinely unusual.

---

## Why the Damage Cap Matters

At maximum level, no individual instance of damage can remove more than 5% of Horus's maximum HP. In a simplified battle with no healing, shields or other HP effects, an enemy would need at least 20 separate damaging instances to defeat him from full health. One enormous critical hit cannot simply erase him.

That is a direct answer to burst-based marches. Much of the recent high-end meta has revolved around generating energy quickly, stacking damage multipliers and delivering an overwhelming ultimate before the opposing team's sustain can take control. Horus places a hard limit on the value of each individual hit against him. A skill that would normally remove half of a back-row Immortal's health is reduced to the same 5% ceiling as any other sufficiently large hit.

This does not make Horus immortal, and it is important not to read the ability as complete damage immunity. Rapid normal attacks, multi-hit skills, damage-over-time effects and frequent passive triggers may still create enough separate instances to bring him down. The passive also says nothing about control, energy reduction, silence or the death of the three Immortals around him. A Horus left alive after the rest of his march collapses has not necessarily won the battle.

What the cap does is buy time. Healing, shields and other forms of sustain are much more valuable when the carry cannot be deleted between two healing cycles. This is why Horus looks especially well suited to a hyper-regeneration mage team. Conventional burst may struggle to finish him, while every additional second gives Horus more opportunities to gain energy, cast Royal Sarcophagus and strengthen his subsequent magical damage.

There are several mechanical details that will need to be tested after release. We need to see exactly how the cap treats multi-hit abilities, damage-over-time ticks, reflected damage and other unusual damage sources. We also need to confirm whether Punishment is applied before or after Royal Sarcophagus deals its damage. The wording strongly establishes Horus as an anti-burst Immortal, but those interactions will determine which teams can counter him most efficiently.

---

## Psychic Vortex and the New Hyper-Regen Mage

Psychic Vortex is the new Tower of Knowledge skill arriving with Horus. It becomes available from the Wish Shop during Legendary Season and gains a stack whenever the equipped Immortal loses 10% HP or casts an Ultimate Skill.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-14-1024x137.png)

A maximum increase of 150% Magical Damage is enormous. Horus is particularly interesting as its carrier because his passive gives him time to build the stacks without being removed by a single burst sequence. His ultimate contributes a stack, incoming HP loss can contribute additional stacks, and the finished effect strengthens both Royal Sarcophagus and any magical damage produced by his equipped skills.

The most obvious high-end setup to test is:

- **Energy Mastery**, to accelerate Horus's Ultimate Skill cycle.
- **Infinite Firepower**, to add repeated area damage and a further energy-regeneration increase.
- **Psychic Vortex**, to scale Horus's total magical output as the battle develops.

Infinite Firepower is already one of the foundations of the premium hyper-regeneration mage build. It has a 60% chance to activate every three seconds, deals 350% magical damage to all enemies and temporarily raises Energy Regeneration Speed by 20%. Energy Mastery then pushes the ultimate cycle even harder. Psychic Vortex adds a different type of pressure because its modifier is not limited to Horus's ultimate. Once stacked, it should strengthen his active damage and the magical damage from Infinite Firepower, although the final calculation will depend on how its bonus combines with other modifiers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-121.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-122.png)

Existing hyper-regen builds commonly use Corrosive Power beside Infinite Firepower and Energy Mastery. On Horus, Psychic Vortex may be the stronger alternative because it scales his broader damage package and is designed around repeated ultimate casts and survivable HP loss. That comparison cannot be settled from the tooltip alone, but it is one of the first skill tests veteran players should run.

The synergy extends beyond Horus's personal numbers. Royal Sarcophagus places Punishment on the opposing march, increasing all damage received, while Psychic Vortex raises Horus's own Magical Damage. If the team can maintain its energy engine, Horus is simultaneously making himself stronger and making the enemy more vulnerable. That creates the outline of a mage carry who is extremely difficult to burst, yet becomes more dangerous the longer he remains in combat.

There is one important unknown in the Psychic Vortex wording. “When your HP decreases by 10%” could refer to cumulative 10% thresholds, or it could require a particular damage event or internal trigger. Horus's damage cap makes that distinction especially relevant. If cumulative HP loss reliably triggers the skill, he should build stacks naturally. If the game expects a single 10% loss, his passive could interact with the condition differently. Live testing is required before treating the stacking speed as settled.

---

## Horus Versus Medusa at the Top of the Meta

Medusa is currently the standard against which new Chaos carries need to be measured. Her passive damage, control and exceptional interaction with Eternal Battlelust have made her the leading physical option at the top end of the game. Apollo and Loki remain strong secondary carries, but neither currently offers the same complete package as a fully developed Medusa team.

Horus does not look like a straightforward replacement for Medusa. He opens a separate magical route with a very different defensive profile. Medusa uses frequent passive damage to build an enormous physical advantage through Eternal Battlelust. Horus attempts to survive the opening burst, amplify the damage taken by the whole enemy march and scale a repeated magical attack cycle through Psychic Vortex.

For Legendary players, it may be entirely valid to build both. A Medusa march and a Horus march use different damage types, attack the opponent through different mechanics and are likely to demand different answers. If Horus performs as strongly in live combat as his tooltip suggests, conventional burst teams may have to rely more heavily on sustained multi-hit damage, energy control or a comparable Horus setup rather than expecting one ultimate rotation to decide the fight.

It is still too early to declare which carry will sit at the absolute top. The most important variables are Horus's native Energy Regeneration, his final attributes and how the damage cap behaves against the strongest multi-hit and triggered skills. Psychic Vortex's stacking behavior will matter just as much. If Horus has strong attributes and reaches his ultimate quickly, the combination of survival, 400% area damage and a reliable 15% Punishment debuff could make the proposed Energy Mastery, Infinite Firepower and Psychic Vortex build exceptional. If his energy cycle is slow or his base attributes fall behind Medusa, Apollo and Loki, the defensive passive may not be enough to make him the best overall carry.

My expectation is therefore not that Medusa disappears. At the highest level, the more likely outcome is a split carry meta in which Medusa remains the premier physical choice while Horus establishes a top-tier magical march. The question is less likely to be “Which one is playable?” and more likely to be “Which one deserves the strongest supporting cast, and which enemy march are you trying to counter?”

---

## The Wish Shop Changes

The skill-release changes may appear smaller than a new Chaos Immortal, but they will alter account planning across several seasons.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-15-1024x241.png)

Eternal Battlelust is the most important change in this group. The skill gains a stack from passive or triggered damage, with each stack adding 5% Physical Damage and 1% damage reduction. At 20 stacks, that reaches 100% additional Physical Damage and 20% damage reduction. Medusa is an ideal user because her kit and common supporting skills can generate the repeated damage instances needed to build it rapidly.

Previously, this created a clear seasonal distinction. Medusa could be good during Conquest, but Eternal Battlelust was one of the pieces that made her frightening in Legendary. Apollo was therefore often the more immediately complete carry for a player entering Conquest. Moving Eternal Battlelust forward removes that waiting period. Players who can obtain and develop both Medusa and the skill should now be able to assemble her defining build during Conquest, which is likely to move her ahead of Apollo as the premium carry target for that stage of the game.

This is not just a balance change. It changes how players should save Wisdom Elixir, plan Wish Shop purchases and choose which Chaos Immortal to develop. Older progression advice that treats Legendary as the point at which Medusa overtakes Apollo will need to be reconsidered after v2.9.9.

Energy Mastery moving all the way to S2 is also significant. Newer mage accounts will gain access to one of the game's core energy tools far earlier than before. It will not give an S2 player a finished Legendary hyper-regen build, but it makes early magical teams smoother and reduces the number of seasons players must wait before experimenting with faster ultimate cycles.

---

## Thorn Armor and Counterattack Teams

Thorn Armor is the only Tower of Knowledge skill receiving a direct balance adjustment in this patch. Its general Physical Damage reduction remains at 6% plus 2% per additional level, but the reflected damage granted to targets with Counterattack effects rises from 6% plus 2% per level to 9% plus 3% per level.

At maximum level, the reflection therefore increases from 20% to 30% of the incoming damage. The reflected damage is calculated before reduction, which makes the improvement more meaningful than the percentage alone may suggest. Counterattack teams now have a stronger way to punish physical attackers, particularly Immortals that depend on frequent normal attacks.

This remains a specialized buff because the extra reflection only applies when the target already has a Counterattack effect. It will not transform Thorn Armor into a universal defensive skill, but established Counterattack marches should revisit it rather than relying on evaluations made before the patch.

---

## Other Additions and Quality-of-Life Improvements

Most of the remaining changes will not determine the top meta, but several will make the game noticeably easier to manage.

- **Alliance Charter:** New players who unlock Alliances receive a five-day quest with rare item rewards. This should give beginners more direction while encouraging early participation in alliance activities.
- **Immortal demonstration battles:** The Immortal interface can now show suggested lineups and skill setups in demonstration battles. This is useful as an introduction, although official recommendations should be treated as a starting point rather than a substitute for testing and adapting to the current meta.
- **Artifact source display:** Newly obtained artifacts will show where they came from. The feature only supports artifacts acquired after v2.9.9.
- **Immortal Affinity:** Multiple Affinity rewards can be claimed together, with clearer prompts and notifications for newly available stories.
- **Opening event rewards:** Stellar Compass receives broader Artifact Schematic rewards, while the S0 and S1 Ancient Gold Exchange adds Artifact Empowerment materials.
- **Automatic building upgrades:** Accounts with Castle Level 3 or higher can instantly raise eligible buildings by multiple levels when all requirements are met. It applies when at least two levels are available and the building is level 48 or below, making it primarily a catch-up feature.
- **Lord Talents:** Players can downgrade talents and reset a single Talent tree. This should make experimentation and switching between development and combat setups less wasteful.
- **Elemental Domain:** Existing formations can be copied quickly, reducing repetitive team setup.
- **Alliance Spar:** The Castle requirement changes to level 5 or higher.
- **Alchemy Lab:** Clicking selected equipment during decomposition now deselects it, removing a small but irritating interface problem.

---

## Final Assessment

Patch 2.9.9 may prove to be an important turning point in Infinity Kingdom's carry meta. Horus appears to be designed as an answer to the burst arms race, and Royal Sarcophagus gives him a form of protection that no ordinary defensive stat can replicate. A maximum 5% damage cap per instance does not make him untouchable, but it should prevent the huge single hits on which many top teams rely from deciding the battle immediately.

Psychic Vortex looks like the natural offensive partner for that design. Horus survives long enough to accumulate its stacks, repeated ultimates help activate it, and Punishment magnifies the pressure created by the entire team. Energy Mastery, Infinite Firepower and Psychic Vortex could produce a new version of the hyper-regeneration mage build, this time centered on a carry who cannot be removed by conventional burst before the engine begins to run.

Meanwhile, Eternal Battlelust arriving in Conquest accelerates Medusa's rise and weakens the old argument for prioritizing Apollo during that stage. Medusa should now be able to access the skill that completes her scaling build a full seasonal tier earlier. Rather than creating one obvious winner, v2.9.9 may leave high-end players choosing between the established physical dominance of Medusa and the anti-burst magical potential of Horus, or building both for different marches.

The exact ranking should wait for live tests of Horus's attributes, energy cycle, damage-cap interactions and Psychic Vortex triggers. On paper, though, this is much more than a routine content patch. It introduces a credible counter to burst damage, moves a top Medusa skill into Conquest and gives veteran mage players an entirely new endgame build to explore.

---

title: Patch 3.0.0 – Jadwiga, Gilded Club and Ghost Fiesta Arrive
markdown:
## Table of Contents

* New Immortal: Jadwiga
* Can Jadwiga Revive Alexander Builds?
* Ghost Fiesta and Night of Terror
* Gilded Club
* Witch Forest
* Artifact Protection
* Summary

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20260927-230734-krfek2.png)

## New Immortal: Jadwiga

Jadwiga is a new Epic Earth support Immortal using Bowmen. She will be obtained through Elemental Bond.

Her skill, **Twin Crowns**, targets the allied units with the highest Physical Attack and Magical Attack, increasing their Attack Speed and damage dealt for six seconds.

At maximum skill level, Twin Crowns provides:

* 25% additional Attack Speed
* 60% additional damage dealt
* Six-second duration

Her Exclusive Artifact extends Twin Crowns by another three seconds, potentially increasing the buff duration to nine seconds. The recommended primary attributes are Dodge Rate or Physical Attack Bonus.

Those are impressive numbers, but Jadwiga’s real value depends on how well she performs inside existing formations. Her skill looks particularly interesting because it is designed to support both a physical and magical carry at the same time.

## Can Jadwiga Revive Alexander Builds?

The important comparison is not simply whether Jadwiga is a strong Earth support. The real question is whether she can outperform one of the established support choices in the familiar **Alexander, Zenobia and Qin Shi Huang** structure.

The most obvious first experiment will be replacing Qin with Jadwiga while retaining Zenobia’s sustain. Jadwiga offers direct Attack Speed and damage amplification, allowing Alexander to apply greater physical pressure while the strongest magical attacker receives the same offensive support.

This becomes especially interesting in formations combining Alexander with **Himiko or Loki**. Alexander should normally hold the highest Physical Attack, while Himiko or Loki provides the highest Magical Attack. Twin Crowns is therefore naturally positioned to buff both primary carries rather than concentrating the entire formation around Alexander alone.

On paper, the combination is extremely aggressive:

* Alexander benefits from additional Attack Speed and damage.
* Himiko or Loki receives support for the magical side of the formation.
* Zenobia can remain in place to provide the sustain needed to keep both carries active.

A more extreme version could replace Zenobia instead, keeping Qin and Jadwiga together for maximum offensive pressure. That would sacrifice much of the formation’s durability, however, and may leave it too vulnerable in a meta dominated by powerful burst and control effects.

Alexander hybrid formations have been losing a lot of battles lately, so Jadwiga arrives at a useful time. Her dual-carry support could provide the extra pressure these teams have been missing, but her numbers alone do not guarantee a return to the top of the meta.

Several details will need live testing:

* How quickly Jadwiga casts Twin Crowns
* Whether it consistently selects Alexander and the intended magical carry
* How much uptime the Exclusive Artifact provides in practice
* Whether the added damage compensates for losing Qin’s utility
* Whether the formation remains durable enough against current top teams

Jadwiga may prove to be the missing piece for Alexander plus Himiko/Loki builds, or the Zenobia-Qin pairing may remain more consistent. Either way, she creates a genuinely interesting formation question rather than simply adding another interchangeable Earth support.

## Ghost Fiesta and Night of Terror

**Ghost Fiesta** will be the seasonal event arriving in October, bringing Infinity Kingdom’s Halloween theme back to Norheim.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20260927-230750-tjpv6n.png)

The event introduces the limited **Night of Terror** outfit series, beginning with new appearances for:

* Fu Fei
* Louis IX

Both outfits will be obtained through Ghost Fiesta. We can assume that these will either replace or be added in similarly to the Alexander and Athena skins. Most likely, we will have both Alexander and Louis from fishing and both Athena and Fu Fei from Dazzling Wish.

## The New Gilded Club Event

Gilded Club is a new event containing four connected activities:

* VIP Pass
* Max Bounty
* Fortune Wheel
* Private Treasure Gallery

Rather than being a single mini-game, Gilded Club appears to be a complete event structure with daily progression, repeatable quests, wheel rewards and its own exchange shop.

### VIP Pass

The Gilded Club Battle Pass is divided into **Silver Insignia** and **Gold Insignia** reward tracks. Players complete daily missions to earn EXP and raise the pass level.

### Max Bounty

Max Bounty becomes available at Castle level 15.

Players can select Bounty Quests of different difficulties, with harder quests providing better rewards. Quests refresh every hour, while completed quests award Bounty Points used to unlock Progress Chests.

### Fortune Wheel

The Fortune Wheel uses dedicated event items and includes both Auto Mode and adjustable spin multipliers.

As players spin, the wheel accumulates Energy. Reaching 100% triggers **Gold Rush**, reducing the cost of the next spin by 20%.

The wheel also has a daily leaderboard based on Wheel Points. Rankings settle every 24 hours, after which the daily points reset.

### Private Treasure Gallery

The Private Treasure Gallery is the Gilded Club exchange shop. Exclusive tokens earned during the event can be exchanged for Surprise Gifts.

The real value of Gilded Club will depend on the Battle Pass rewards, wheel probabilities and Gallery prices. We will examine those separately once the event is available.

## Witch Forest

Ghost Fiesta is also receiving a new board-style activity called **Witch Forest**.

Players consume Magic Wands to move around the board and activate different tiles:

* **Candy Magic**

   guarantees Candy.
* **Surprise Magic**

   triggers a random event and an immediate extra spin.
* **Reward tiles**

   provide the displayed resources directly.

Candies have different rarities and point values. Accumulating Candy Points unlocks Progress Chests.

Surprise Magic can also trigger two special bonuses:

* **Multiplier Event:**

   Multiplies the rewards earned.
* **Jackpot Event:**

   Awards every reward along the travelled path.

The main strategic question will be how easily Magic Wands can be collected and how many are required to complete the Progress Chests.

All in all, sounds like a new mini-game like the addition of the 2064 game. And I expect this to be something for minor rewards, a couple insignias and some fun!

## Artifact Upgrade Protection

Patch 3.0.0 also adds a useful safeguard when developing Artifacts.

When rare materials are about to be consumed during Artifact Upgrade or Development, the game will display a second confirmation prompt. This should make it harder to accidentally spend valuable materials on the wrong artifact.

## Summary

Patch 3.0.0 is led by Jadwiga, October’s Halloween-themed Ghost Fiesta and the completely new Gilded Club event.

For competitive players, Jadwiga is the most interesting addition. Her ability to support the strongest physical and magical attackers simultaneously makes her a natural candidate for Alexander plus Himiko/Loki formations. Whether she replaces Qin, replaces Zenobia or fails to break the established Zenobia-Qin pairing will depend on live testing.

title: Patch Notes Gift Event (deadline march 16th)
summary: Greetings! The latest patch to grace the world of Infinity Kingdom is patch 2.5. As part of the pre-roll out the team behind Infinity Kingdom have released the patchnotes as well as a unique event where players can…
markdown:
Greetings! The latest patch to grace the world of Infinity Kingdom is patch 2.5. As part of the pre-roll out the team behind Infinity Kingdom have released the patchnotes as well as a unique event where players can participate to earn gift rewards! Simply read the notes, comment in the post and win gifts! In this short article we are going to quickly get an overview of the patch and dive into the details for the gift event. For more details check out all the links in the article below!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-37-1024x491.png)

## Patch notes gift event

First things first, FREE GIFTS! We have a unique chance to participate in a gift event where players can earn rewards simply by commenting on the Infinity Kingdom Forum Post!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-38.png)

We as players are encouraged to read the patch notes and to leave a suggestion, opinions, questions or anything else we may have to say about the latest patch streight to the forum. In doing so you participate in a draw-event for gift rewards.

You can leave any suggestions, opinions, or questions in the comments section of this post [**https://forum.gtarcade.com/topic/145887**](https://forum.gtarcade.com/topic/145887)

**Participation format**: **Comment in the topic post and leave your Lord ID in your comment post to participate! 20 lords will be selected and rewarded with a gift.**

**Event deadline** (UTC): March 16th, midnight

## Patch notes

The patch notes were a bit different than usual. We are not seeing anything in regards to changes or balancing of the "standard" Infinity Kingdom game that we know so well. That being said, there are rumours that dragon skill levels 6-6 for dragon talents is being implemented. While this is true on the old conquest servers, it is still to be seen if this is something that will be rolled out and it is surprisingly not mentioned in the patch.

What is mentioned is Battle Chess! Battle chess is a brand new game mode where players fight on a chess-board style format. It will be a mini-game side event where you deploy Immortals, skill cards (magic abilities) in a fight to kill your enemies King. From the notes, it sounds like an Infinity Kingdom styled version of auto-chess meets Hearthstone! Very exciting, and certainly an opportunity for players who are running out of things to do between events.

The setting is the commonly known chess board. However, instead of the traditional chess pieces we are going to be playing with Immortals as pieces on the board. In addition, players are choosing a deck of spell-cards to be used in combat for various different effects, by the looks of the skills they are going to be in line with well known Immortal Ultimate Abilities from the original game.

The pieces we have to use have different mechanics and concepts. It seems we are using a piece-unique resource called Stamina for movement as well as Energy Marks to cast spells. By the sounds of the notes the player continuously earns Energy Marks throughout the fight.

**[You can read all we know so far about Battle Chess here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/patch-notes/patch-2-5-battle-chess/new-mini-game-battle-chess/).**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-39.png)

You can also go streight to the official patchnotes and read for yourself!

Read the official Patch 2.5 Notes at: [https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7016809.html](https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7016809.html)

title: Peak Battle Pass (Chaos immortals and artifacts)
summary: The Peak Battle Pass is the late‑game, Chaos‑focused pass in Infinity Kingdom. It unlocks at Castle level 50 (this is your Season 2 pass) and rotates roughly once a month for 28 days. The whole idea is simple: if you’re…
markdown:
The **Peak Battle Pass** is the late‑game, Chaos‑focused pass in Infinity Kingdom. It unlocks at **Castle level 50** (this is your **Season 2** pass) and rotates roughly once a month for **28 days**. The whole idea is simple: if you’re planning to build **Chaos immortals** and their **Exclusive Artifacts**, this is where the best recurring value lives.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-55-1024x565.png)

There’s also a **Legendary Battle Pass** running alongside it; both feeds the same currency, so you can plan out long‑term Chaos purchases without wasting tokens. **[Read more about the Legendary Battle Pass here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/battle-passes/legendary-battle-pass-holy-shadow/)**.

---

## How It Works

- **Availability:** Unlocks at **C50 (Season 2)**.
- **Duration:** Each run lasts **28 days**.
- **Tiers:** Two tracks per run.  - **Silver Medallion:** Free.
- **Golden Medallion:** Paid (**$49.99**).
- **Currency:** Both Peak and Legendary passes award **Inferno Insignias**. You can spend them in either shop, which is huge for planning.

### Daily Tasks & Leveling

- You’ll see **6 or 7 daily tasks** (depends on the day), each worth **150 Pass EXP**.
- Each Battle Pass level needs **250 EXP**.
- To hit **Level 100**, you need **24,750 EXP** in total.
- Over **28 days** you get **at least 168 tasks** (6 × 28), which equals **25,200 EXP**. That’s **more than enough** to cap the pass without buying levels.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-56-1024x485.png)

- You can also skip and buy levels at **750 Gems per level** if you’re short.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-57.png)

---

## Rewards Overview

### Silver Medallion (Free Track)

- **120** Random Immortal Fragments
- **30** Random **Holy/Shadow** Immortal Fragments
- **10 × 60‑min** universal speedups
- **5 × 60‑min** training speedups
- **5 × 60‑min** healing speedups
- **500,000** of each resource **(except gold)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-58.png)

### Golden Medallion (Paid, $49.99)

- **80** *Fate of Chaos Selection Chest II* (contains fragments for **all current Chaos immortals except Ares and Apollo**)
- **6,000 Gems**
- **1,674 Inferno Insignias**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-60.png)

Note: The exact behavior of *Fate of Chaos Selection Chest II* follows the “select from pool” logic and **does not include Ares and Apollo**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-59.png)

---

## Peak Battle Pass Shop

- The shop includes **all current Chaos Immortals** **except Ares and Apollo**, plus their **Exclusive Artifacts**.
- **Costs & Limits:**  - **Chaos Immortal Fragments:** 80‑fragment bundle costs **800 Inferno Insignias** (**limit 4** per immortal per run).
- **Chaos Exclusive Artifact:** costs **1,200 Inferno Insignias** (**limit 2** per run).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-61-1024x491.png)

***Important Season 2 Note:** In the current version, the shop **also lacks Fu Fei**. This is **not intended** and will be fixed in the **next rotation**. If Fu Fei is your planned first Chaos immortal, **bank your insignias** now and buy her **next season** when she appears.*

---

## Legendary Battle Pass (Context)

If you have Peak unlocked, you’ll also see a **Legendary Battle Pass**. It **also** contributes **Inferno Insignias** and focuses on Chaos immortals/artifacts. Because both passes award the **same currency**, you can push both to funnel insignias into **one** shop plan.

- **Cost Together:** Doing **both** (Legendary + Peak) runs you **about $80 total**.
- **Insignia Total:** If you cap **both** passes to **Level 100**, you’ll get **2,604 Inferno Insignias** in total.

> Planning tip: If you’re under **C50** and not close, you can stack insignias across seasons via the Legendary pass and **spend later** in the Peak shop once you hit C50.

---

## Value Check (Why this matters)

- With **2,604 insignias** (both passes maxed), you can target **Chaos fragments** or **Artifacts** directly in the Peak Shop.
- Example plan people like: Put insignias into **Chaos Immortal Fragments**. At **800 insignias for 80 fragments**, pure math says **240 fragments** should cost **2,400 insignias** (3 × 800). That’s a clean pickup and leaves a small buffer for next run.
- For comparison, **500 Eye of Chaos** typically gets **~200–250 fragments** and costs **more than $80**, so the passes are generally **better value** if your goal is **specific Chaos** progress.

---

## Strategy: What I’d Actually Do

If you’re aiming at Chaos, here’s the practical flow I recommend after testing this across a couple rotations:

1. **Bank Insignias if your target isn’t in shop.** With the Fu Fei situation (Season 2 missing in UI), don’t panic spend. Wait a rotation and buy **exactly** what you want.
2. **Secure your first chaos.** Getting your **first main Chaos immortal** to usable stars is the biggest spike. Usually that’s Apollo long‑term, but he is **not in this shop**, so plan a different main chaos like e.g., **Fu Fei** (when available) and build around it.
3. **If you’re below C50**, use Legendary pass to **stockpile insignias**. Don’t force Shadow/Holy unless they’re part of your end‑game plan. It’s totally fine to sit on currency and **power‑spike at C50**.
4. **Don’t overbuy in one run.** There are purchase limits (4 × 80‑frag bundles per immortal, 2 artifacts). If you can’t finish a purchase this season, carry insignias over - they do not disapear.

---

## Quick Summary

- Unlocks at **C50/Season 2**, runs **28 days**.
- **Silver (free)** gives mixed frags, speedups, and resources.
- **Gold ($49.99)** gives **80** *Fate of Chaos II* chests (excludes Ares/Apollo), **6,000 Gems**, **1,674 insignias**.
- **Shop:** **800 insignias → 80 Chaos frags** (limit 4 per immortal); **1,200 insignias → Artifact** (limit 2).
- Maxing both **Legendary + Peak** ≈ **$80 total** → **2,604 insignias**.
- Best baseline buy: **Fragments**. Once stars are done get one Artifact to unlock unique effect then continue to build talents with immortal fragments.
- If your target is missing (e.g., **Fu Fei** this Season 2), **bank insignias** and buy next rotation.

**Bottom line:** If Chaos is your endgame, the Peak + Legendary passes are the most controlled and cost‑efficient way to progress—just be patient and buy the **right** things at the **right** time. But you should expect to supplement the battle passes with Chaos Eyes and the Roulette event, since you need 1640 immortal fragments to star and unlock artifact slot plus 4750 in total to fully complete the talents. It is perfectly fine to not have chaos within your budget and thus spend the Insignias in the Legenday Pass to complete holy or shadow immortals. Only you can make that decision, just think long term and be realistic about your budget for Infinity Kingdom.

---

title: Physical Damage Dealer
summary: The best rolls for your specific Immortal depends entirely on the sub-type of Attack Immortal you are running and on the build you use it in. Therefore, I am reluctant to make a simplified list of the best rolls.…
markdown:
The best rolls for your specific Immortal depends entirely on the sub-type of Attack Immortal you are running and on the build you use it in. Therefore, I am reluctant to make a simplified list of the best rolls. Instead, we need to dive deep and understand each of the three archtypes of Attack Immortals and their individual **Best In Slot Artifact Attribute Rolls**.

Therefore I want to dive a bit deeper then merely presenting the options of rolls. In this article we are diving deep into the world of **Ultimate Ability Based Damage Dealers**.

## Immortals in this category

| Alexander | Frederick |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Manco | Saladin |  |
| Hannibal Barca | Siegfried |  |

## The best artifact rolls

|  | Ultimate Ability Based Utility & DPS |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Best | Primary | Secondary | Bonus |
| 1 | Physical Attack Rate (%) | Physical Attack Rate (%) | Iron Fist (dps) |
| 2 | Physical Attack Value | Physical Attack Value | Rapid (dps) |
| 3 |  | Accuracy Rate (%) |  |
| 4 |  | Accuracy Value |  |
| 5 |  | Physical Defense Rate (%) |  |
| 6 |  | Physical Defense Value |  |
| 7 |  | Crit Rate (%) |  |
| 8 |  | Crit Rate Value |  |
| 9 |  | Dodge Rate Rate (%) |  |
| 10 |  | Dodge Value |  |
| 11 |  | Magical Defense Rate (%) |  |
| 12 |  | Magical Defense Value |  |
| 13 |  | Resiliance Rate (%) |  |
| 14 |  | Resiliance Value |  |

**Alexander**, **Hannibal Barca** are iconic in this category as champions of full on physical damage dealer with great success. They furthermore are unique in the sense that their Unique Artifacts are able to roll a Bonus Roll called **Rapid**, increaseing their attack speed. Only these two are able to get this bonus. You cannot use Surge for anything on these two Immortals since their Unique Effects turn their Ultimates into Passive abilities. Hence they get a new Bonus Rapid in exchange for an otherwise useless Surge.

The result is that you still want Iron Fist Bonus on these Immortals almost always. **Only**if you are running both Alex and Hannibal in a hybrid setup with Berserk, Speed Blessing, Unique artifact on Zeno and Qin in the backline will you have high enough attack speed to make rapid worth while. Moreover, big whales with **Wind Rage** may take more value from Rapid. I have not been able to test that yet.

**For everyone else and as a default Iron Will is always extreemly strong.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-66.png)

**All**six of our **Physical Damage Dealer Attack Immortals** must have **Physical Attack Rate % or Value**as the Primary Artifact Roll. Anything else will be a big decrease in damage potential.

In addition, their performance largely comes down to their need for **accuracy**.

**Your physical damage dealers must have accuracy**: If you are using **Coercion**in your setup, then Accuracy drops below phys defense and crit rate in value. **If**you **DO NOT run Coercion**, **accuracy**is a close second and sometimes even stronger than phys %.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-67-1024x682.png)

**The hardest thing about Immortal Artifacts, is knowing your hit-rate**.

If you are running no **Coercion**but have completed the dragon talent tree, you could still be hit-capped against non-dodge (Manco / Afterimage / Missleading) builds. However, if you are not and you try to take on such a build, you are missing out on a ton of damage.

**It is highly underrated how much your dps goes down if you are not hit-capped.**

title: Pirate Festival 2025
summary: Pirate Festival 2025 – Full Guide & Skin Breakdown
markdown:
***Pirate Festival 2025 – Full Guide & Skin Breakdown***

The Pirate Festival is back, and if you’ve played Harvest Festival before, you’ll feel right at home. It’s basically the same structure, just with pirate flavor on top. The main difference this year is in the rewards: a new **Sun Chariot City Skin** and, more importantly, **Abyssal Throne fragments are now available in the event pass**. That’s in my opinion the real big reward for this event, since it means I can slowly build up Abyssal without having to whale on rankings. Very nice!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-49-1024x410.png)

So yeah, the event itself isn’t anything groundbreaking, but the rewards make it worth paying attention to. Anyways, lets get into the details.

---

## General Event Info

This is one of those seasonal grind events with multiple parts running at the same time: daily quests, challenges, PvE fights, spins, and a final shop. If you’re used to Harvest Festival, it’s the same thing in practice. The only thing that changes from year to year are the skins and which rewards get put into the pool.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-62-1024x1024.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-63-1024x1024.png)

---

## Event Content & Mechanics

### 1. Daily Sign-in

Log in every day, grab **Tokens of Light**, and toss them into **Dazzling Wish**. Free spins are always worth it, just don’t expect miracles. If you hit the Chaos Immortal jackpot or the skin fragments, congrats — that’s pure luck.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-52-1024x461.png)

---

### 2. Battle Pass

Same daily quest pass as always.

- You can skip one quest per day or even miss one full day and still complete it.
- The $50 premium tier unlocks the **Sun Chariot skin**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-51-1024x520.png)

#### Sun Chariot, any good?

The march speed here is surprisingly good. Normally defensive skins use troop death rate reduction, but march speed makes this skin more flexible.
I think that Move speed is the best secondary stat (meaning outside of attack or defense) because you are able to hit the enemy and recall before the enemy lands. That means you can fight with a huge advantage as you can recall your main before an enemy hits you).
Could be the best defensive option so far, but it really depends on your setup, for defensive late game setups, this may prove better than Abyssals Attack if upgraded.

---

#### More Abyssal Flame!

The fragments you collect while progressing the pass are actually **Abyssal Throne**, not Sun Chariot. That’s nice, because it means you’re building toward something long-term instead of adding yet another half-finished skin to your list.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-53-1024x633.png)

---

### 3. Glorious Challenge

Exactly the same as always. The only tip is: **save your extra gem-attempts until Hard Mode opens.** Every event, people burn them early and end up losing value. Once Hard is open, spend freely.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-54-1024x478.png)

---

### 4. Pinnacle Trials

This is the PvE section that ends with the new **Pinnacle Trial Ranking mode**.

- Top 10 players on your server show up on a ranking board.
- Other players can challenge them to gain points and push their own ranking.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-55-1024x475.png)

It’s more of a competitive race for high-end players, but casuals can still clear the PvE for some rewards. Think of it as a fun distraction if you’re not aiming for the leaderboard. Note that this also rewards Abyssal Throne fragments, thus another avenue to obtain these fragments if you are able to qualify as a top ranking player.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-56-1024x617.png)

---

### 5. Dazzling Wish

This one got worse compared to the old version. It’s no longer cross-server, so you can’t play smart or snipe. The value just isn’t there unless you’re spending heavily.

Odds look like this:

- Sun Chariot: 0.05%
- Chaos Immortal Chests (80x): 0.45%
- Chaos Artifact fragments (60x): 0.6%
- Chaos Immortal Chests (5x): 2.5%
- Chaos Artifact fragments (5x): 3%
- Random Chaos Immortal fragments (1x): 6%
- Holy/shadow Random Frags: 7.4%

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-57-1024x479.png)

Basically, for most players this is a lottery — not efficient, not worth serious money. If you’re a whale chasing Chaos or skins, you’ll still roll. Everyone else should just treat the free pulls as bonus value.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-58.png)

Personally I think there is a somewhat hidden gem to get the random fragments. Ofc you need a bit of luck with these, but at 6% and 7.4% the drop rate is quite frequent. If you want to rank in this event, you are going to see A LOT of random fragments and a real impact on unlock and maxing immortal progress speeds.

---

### 6. Celebration Shop

The priorities here haven’t changed:

1. **Artifacts (x3)**
2. **Stardust**
3. **Tokens of Light**
4. **Speedups or Philosopher Stones** depending on your situation

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-59-1024x480.png)

If you’re in **Season 2** (or early Season 1), Philosopher Stones are more valuable because the new specialization tree eats up immortal fragments like crazy. If you’re already stacked on immortals, speedups will usually do more for you.

---

## Final Thoughts

Pirate Festival 2025 isn’t a brand-new experience — it’s Harvest Festival with pirate cosmetics. The gameplay loop is the same, so don’t expect surprises. The interesting part is in the rewards:

- **Sun Chariot** adds a genuinely solid defensive skin option.
- **Abyssal Throne** is still my go-to combat skin, and now it’s more accessible through the pass.

Main advice:

- Be patient — don’t rush unlocks, you’ll lose Pirate Marks.
- Don’t over-invest in Dazzling Wish unless you know what you’re doing.
- Grab Abyssal fragments wherever you can.

The event’s nothing new, but the rewards are worth grinding out if you’re serious about skins.

title: Pirate Festival 2026 - Alchemical Secrets New Mini-game
summary: Alchemical Secrets is a new puzzle event introduced during the 2026 Pirate Festival. Unlike most seasonal activities in Infinity Kingdom, this is a genuine mini-game rather than another wheel or combat challenge.…
markdown:
### Alchemical Secrets Guide: How to Solve the Pirate Festival Mini-Game

**Alchemical Secrets** is a new puzzle event introduced during the 2026 Pirate Festival. Unlike most seasonal activities in Infinity Kingdom, this is a genuine mini-game rather than another wheel or combat challenge. Players must reorganize mixed Primal Stones until every Treasure Chest contains stones of a single colour.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-90-1024x535.png)

The opening stages are straightforward, but later puzzles introduce hidden stones, frozen chests, fixed chests and optional locked spaces. These mechanics make the event considerably more interesting and require players to plan several moves ahead.

More importantly, the harder stages can be completed **without spending an Unlock item on the optional locked chest**. Opening it gives you more working space and makes the puzzle easier, but it is a convenience rather than a requirement.

---

## Table of Contents

- Event Overview
- How the Puzzle Works
- Special Treasure Chests
- How to Unfreeze Chests
- Tools and Consumable Items
- Solving Harder Stages
- Magic Stones, Raids and Rewards
- Summary

---

## Alchemical Secrets Overview

Alchemical Secrets is available to players with **Castle Level 20 or higher**. New groups of stages unlock throughout the Pirate Festival, so the entire event cannot be completed immediately.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-91-1024x376.png)

Entering a stage costs **one Magic Stone**. Once inside, you can leave and return to your unfinished puzzle without paying another entry cost. However, resetting the board consumes another Magic Stone and does not refund the original entry cost.

Each completed stage awards Pirate Festival rewards, including **Magic Fishing Nets** that can be used in the Fishing Contest. Cleared stages can also be raided with additional Magic Stones, allowing players to collect rewards without solving the same puzzle again. These event mechanics are also confirmed by the [official GTarcade Pirate Festival overview](https://forum.gtarcade.com/topic/261119).

## How the Puzzle Works

Every Treasure Chest contains a vertical stack of coloured Primal Stones. Only the stone at the top of a stack can be moved.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/new-mini-event-2.mp4)

To make a move:

1. Select the Treasure Chest containing the stone you want to move.
2. Select a valid destination chest.
3. The top stone will move into the new chest.

A Primal Stone can normally be moved into:

- An empty Treasure Chest.
- A Treasure Chest with the same coloured stone on top.

The objective is to fill every available chest with Primal Stones of the same colour. Once every stone has been correctly classified, the stage is cleared.

There does not appear to be a time limit, so there is no reason to rush. The game records the number of steps used, but careful planning is considerably more important than completing the puzzle quickly.

## Special Treasure Chests

The later stages introduce several mechanics that change how you should approach the board.

### Blind Box Treasure Chests

Some Primal Stones are displayed with a question mark instead of their actual colour. The hidden colour is only revealed after the stone above it has been moved.

You should therefore avoid planning an entire colour stack around an unknown stone. Reveal Blind Box stones while you still have enough empty space to handle an inconvenient result.

### Frozen Treasure Chests

Frozen chests are covered in blue ice and cannot initially receive or release Primal Stones.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-94.png)

Every time you complete one full colour classification, **one Frozen Treasure Chest is randomly unlocked**. Its stones then become available and can be included in the rest of the puzzle.

This creates the main challenge of the harder levels. You must first complete colours using the limited active space, which gradually releases the frozen chests and gives you access to the remaining stones.

### Fixed Treasure Chests

Fixed chests are marked by glowing rings. Once a Primal Stone is placed inside one of these chests, it cannot be removed again.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-93.png)

Never use a fixed chest as temporary storage. Only place a stone inside when you are confident that it belongs to the colour you intend to complete there.

### Optional Locked Chest

Some stages include an additional empty Treasure Chest that can be opened with the **Unlock** consumable. This provides another temporary sorting space and can make a difficult board much easier.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-95.png)

However, even the harder stages can be solved without unlocking it. The puzzle simply requires more planning and a careful sequence of completed colours.

## How to Unfreeze the Board

Frozen chests are not unlocked by waiting. You release them by completing full single-colour chests elsewhere on the board.

This means that the order in which you complete colours matters. At the start of a difficult stage, look for the colour with the greatest number of exposed stones. That will usually be the easiest first classification and your first opportunity to unlock a frozen chest.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-96-1024x603.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-97-1024x526.png)

Because the frozen chest is selected randomly, you cannot know exactly which stones will become available next. Your opening moves should therefore leave enough flexibility to work with several possible outcomes.

A good general approach is:

1. Identify the easiest exposed colour to complete.
2. Preserve at least one empty chest as working space.
3. Complete that first colour to release a frozen chest.
4. Inspect the newly available stones before committing to the next colour.
5. Repeat the process until the entire board has been opened.

This is where Alchemical Secrets becomes more strategic than a normal sorting game. You are not only sorting the visible stones. You are creating a sequence that gradually unlocks the rest of the board.

## Tools and Consumable Items

Several assistance tools are displayed on the left side of the puzzle. These are available for purchase along with additional attempts in the in-game shop.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/new-mini-event-1.mp4)

Items include:

- **Undo:** Reverses a previous move.
- **Reset:** Restarts the stage, but consumes another Magic Stone.
- **Clear All:** Provides a shortcut for clearing part of the puzzle.
- **Unlock:** Opens the optional locked Treasure Chest and creates additional working space.

These tools are useful, but they should not be treated as part of the normal solution. Many stages, including the more complicated puzzles, can be cleared with **zero items used**.

Undo is reasonable when you make one accidental move. Unlock is useful if you are genuinely stuck and do not want to spend more time solving the board. Reset should be the final option because it costs another Magic Stone.

## Tips for Solving Harder Stages

### Preserve Your Empty Chests

Empty chests are your working space. Filling every available chest too early is the easiest way to trap yourself.

Before making a move, consider whether you will still have somewhere to place the next obstructing stone.

### Complete the Most Accessible Colour First

Look for colours that already have several matching stones exposed. Finishing one of these stacks quickly unlocks a frozen chest and expands your available options.

### Do Not Use Fixed Chests for Storage

A stone placed in a fixed chest cannot be removed. Treat every move into one as permanent.

If you are not certain which colour should occupy that chest, leave it empty.

### Plan Around Hidden Stones

A question-mark stone can reveal a colour that does not fit your current arrangement. Reveal these stones while you still have flexible empty chests rather than leaving every unknown until the end.

### Think Several Moves Ahead

Before moving a stone, ask three questions:

1. What stone will this move expose?
2. Where can that newly exposed stone go?
3. Will I still have enough space to continue?

A move can be legal and still be strategically disastrous. The important question is not whether you can make the move, but whether the board remains solvable afterward.

### Avoid Buying Space Too Quickly

The optional locked chest is deliberately tempting because additional space makes any sorting puzzle easier. Nevertheless, it is not necessary for completing the stage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-98-1024x541.png)

Try solving the puzzle normally before spending an Unlock item. If you enjoy this type of game and are willing to plan ahead, preserving the item is entirely possible.

## Magic Stones, Raids and Rewards

Each initial challenge consumes one Magic Stone. Once a stage is cleared, it can be raided for another Magic Stone to collect its repeat reward instantly.

**Prioritize progression** and completing newly unlocked stages before spending Magic Stones on raids. New stages provide their own first-clear rewards and may unlock additional progression, while raids primarily convert spare Magic Stones into more event resources.

The most immediately useful rewards are the **Magic Fishing Nets**, since these feed directly into the Pirate Festival Fishing Contest. Completing Alchemical Secrets can therefore help you reach additional fishing milestones without purchasing as many Nets directly.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-99-1024x523.png)

## Conclusion

Alchemical Secrets is one of the more enjoyable seasonal mini-games added to Infinity Kingdom. The basic objective is simple: sort every Primal Stone into a chest containing only one colour. The difficulty comes from hidden stones, permanent fixed chests and frozen chests that only open as other colours are completed.

The most important lesson is that the optional locked chest is not required. It can make difficult stages easier, but patient players can complete them without spending the Unlock currency. Preserve your empty spaces, complete accessible colours first and plan several moves ahead so each newly released frozen chest can be incorporated into the solution.

For players who enjoy puzzles, this is a welcome addition to the Pirate Festival. For everyone else, it remains worth completing because it provides valuable Magic Fishing Nets and other seasonal rewards.

---

title: Pirate Festival 2026 - Full Event Overview
summary: The Pirate Festival 2026 is now live in Infinity Kingdom and runs from September 14 to September 24, 2026 UTC. In most respects, this is a familiar seasonal festival with a login reward, festival pass, Fishing Contest…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-63-1024x572.png)

The **Pirate Festival 2026** is now live in Infinity Kingdom and runs from **September 14 to September 24, 2026 UTC**. In most respects, this is a familiar seasonal festival with a login reward, festival pass, Fishing Contest, Dazzling Wish, challenge stages, ranking activities and two event shops. If you participated in the Harvest Festival during August, you will immediately recognize most of the structure.

There is one genuinely new addition: **Alchemical Secrets**, a crystal-sorting puzzle that we have never seen in Infinity Kingdom before. It is surprisingly entertaining and also provides more Magic Fishing Nets for the Fishing Contest. We will examine its mechanics and solutions in a separate guide, while this article provides a general overview of the entire Pirate Festival.

---

## TL;DR

Pirate Festival follows the usual seasonal-event structure. Log in daily, progress the Temple of Edfu festival pass, complete Alchemical Secrets for Fishing Nets, use those Nets in the Fishing Contest and clear the available combat challenges. Free Proofs of Light can be used in Dazzling Wish, while Eternal Grails and Pirate Festival Coins are spent in the event shops.

The biggest new reward is **Horus**, who has been added to the Grail Shop. Alexander and Athena’s Summer Passion outfit fragments have also returned through the festival, while the Fishing Contest, Glorious Challenge and Pinnacle Trial provide additional progression and ranking rewards.

---

## Pirate Festival Overview

The live Pirate Festival contains eight main tabs:

1. Lucky Koi
2. Temple of Edfu
3. Alchemical Secrets
4. Fishing Contest
5. Dazzling Wish
6. Grail Shop
7. Pinnacle Trial
8. Glorious Challenge

Most of these systems have appeared in previous seasonal festivals under slightly different names or themes. The main exception is Alchemical Secrets, which replaces the more familiar festival mini-games with a new crystal-sorting puzzle.

The event uses several currencies and consumable items. **Magic Fishing Nets** are spent in the Fishing Contest, **Proofs of Light** are used for Dazzling Wish, **Eternal Grails** purchase premium rewards in the Grail Shop and **Pirate Festival Coins** are earned through combat challenges and spent in the Challenge Shop.

You do not need to complete everything immediately. Several rewards and harder challenges unlock gradually, so the safest approach is to participate every day and avoid spending all your event currency before you have inspected the full shop.

## Lucky Koi

Lucky Koi combines the festival’s daily login reward with an optional paid lottery.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-64-1024x523.png)

The free part is simple: open the tab each day and claim the available gift containing a **Proof of Light**. These free Proofs should be collected even if you do not intend to spend anything during Pirate Festival, as they provide free attempts in Dazzling Wish.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-65-1024x533.png)

Players can also purchase the optional **$4.99 Koi Gift Pack** to enter the current lottery round. Each round lasts two days and selects one participant for the Koi Grand Prize. The paid pack also contains Proofs of Light and Magic Fishing Nets, while players who participate in all five rounds without winning receive a consolation reward.

The lottery is entirely optional. The important free-to-play action is simply remembering to visit Lucky Koi and collect the free gift every day.

## Temple of Edfu

The **Temple of Edfu** is the Pirate Festival’s progression pass. The official announcement refers to this part of the event as Summer Vibe, but Temple of Edfu is the name displayed in the live event interface.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-66-1024x547.png)

Completing daily festival tasks grants experience and raises the pass through 30 levels. There is a free reward path available to everyone and an additional premium path for players who purchase the pass.

The paid pass rewards include festival currencies, Magic Fishing Nets, Proofs of Light and other progression materials. **Alexander the Great’s Summer Passion outfit fragments** have also returned among the pass rewards.

All in all you collect 120 Tokens of Light, 60 Alexander Outfit fragments, 5,000 Fishing Nets and 60 fragments for Temple of Edfu Castle Skin.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-67-1024x482.png)

As with previous festival passes, daily activity matters more than rushing. Complete the available tasks throughout the event and remember to claim the rewards you unlock.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-68-1024x523.png)

The Temple of Edfu Castle Skin provides 5% Physical and Magical Attack Bonus to Immortals as well as 5% Building Upgrade Speed.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-69-1024x470.png)

While this is a powerful combat skin, it is not as powerful as other combat skins (e.g. the Abyssal Skin) which provides Troop Attack % bonuses. These remain superior due to how the game calculates damage scaling off of troop count.

## Alchemical Secrets

Alchemical Secrets is the most interesting new feature in Pirate Festival. It is a level-based crystal-sorting puzzle in which players must organize differently coloured magical stones to complete each challenge.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-72-1024x547.png)

Completing stages provides rewards including **Magic Fishing Nets**, creating a direct connection between the new mini-game and the returning Fishing Contest. Cleared levels can also be raided, while additional groups of stages become available as the festival progresses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-71-1024x526.png)

The basic concept is easy to understand, but later stages require more careful planning because a poor early move can leave the remaining crystals impossible to arrange efficiently. Since this is a completely new Infinity Kingdom mini-game, we will cover its exact rules, solutions and best approach in a separate Alchemical Secrets guide.

For this general overview, the important point is that players should complete the available stages whenever they unlock. The rewards provide additional Fishing Nets without requiring direct purchases, and the game itself is a welcome change from the usual seasonal activities.

## Fishing Contest

The Fishing Contest returns with essentially the same mechanics used during the Harvest Festival.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-73-1024x559.png)

Players spend **Magic Fishing Nets** to launch their nets and catch fish of different qualities. Each catch awards points, with rarer fish generally contributing more toward milestone and ranking rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-74-1024x543.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-75-1024x520.png)

The event includes several overlapping reward systems:

- Total catch rewards
- Total point milestones
- Daily rankings
- Overall festival rankings
- Catch collections

Because Fishing Nets are awarded through Temple of Edfu, Alchemical Secrets, Glorious Challenge, Pinnacle Trial and other festival activities, there is no need to purchase or spend everything immediately. Collect the free Nets first and then decide how far you want to push the milestones or rankings.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-77-1024x526.png)

Now if you are collecting the Alexander Outfit skin and have not completed that yet, spending for more Fishing Nets is quite good value - something I am personally doing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-76-1024x478.png)

**[Read more about efficiency and fishing here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/seaonal-events/harvest-festival-august/harvest-festival-2026-fishing-and-net-cost-efficiency-guide/)**(this is from last months seasonal, but pricings and mechanics are identical so no need for a updated version).

The overall rankings are considerably more competitive than the basic milestones. Players interested only in efficient progression should focus on the guaranteed point and collection rewards rather than attempting to compete with major spenders.

A separate Fishing Contest value guide can be used for the detailed mathematics behind Nets, catches and expected cost.

## Dazzling Wish

Dazzling Wish is the festival’s wheel event and uses **Proofs of Light** for attempts. The wheel contains Eternal Grails, progression materials and a small chance of valuable premium rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-78-1024x558.png)

**Athena’s Summer Passion outfit fragments** have returned as one of the rare wheel rewards. The event also includes point milestones, daily rankings and an overall ranking, with the most valuable prizes reserved for the highest placements.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-79-1024x495.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-80-1024x518.png)

Players should claim every free Proof of Light from Lucky Koi and other festival sources before deciding whether to purchase additional attempts. The ordinary wheel rewards are useful, but the rare outfit fragments and high ranking positions can require substantial spending.

If your main target is Horus rather than Athena’s outfit, or well to be more precise. If your main objective is not to collect Athena's Outfit, then you should NOT be getting your Eternal Grails from Dazzling Wish, but instead be using the Grail Wheel introduced a two seasonals ago. This har much better efficiency. **[Read more here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/the-eternal-grail-wheel-new-as-of-harvest-festival-august-2026/)**

## Grail Shop

The Grail Shop contains two separate exchange sections: the **Challenge Shop** and the **Grail Shop**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-81-1024x190.png)

The Challenge Shop uses Pirate Festival Coins earned from Glorious Challenge and related festival activities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-82-1024x548.png)

It contains ordinary progression materials alongside cosmetics, challenge tickets, Stardust, artifact schematic selections and other limited rewards. Personally, I think players should prioritize Stardust, Token of Light and if in excess of currency / or in desperate need, go for elemental unique artifacts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-83-1024x389.png)

The Grail Shop uses **Eternal Grails**, the premium currency obtained mainly through Dazzling Wish and selected festival rewards. The most important new addition is **Horus**, the new Chaos back-row magical Immortal introduced in Patch 2.9.9.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-84-1024x542.png)

Horus is likely to become one of the festival’s main spending target for the biggest whales. His passive prevents any single instance of incoming damage from exceeding a percentage of his maximum HP, giving him unusual protection against the burst-heavy meta that has dominated the meta.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-85-1024x477.png)

The Grail Shop also contains Chaos Immortal selection rewards, artifact schematic fragments and other high-value items. I think many players like me, are especially happy to collect the 250 Grail Chaos Immortal Chest and the Chaos Artifact Selection Chest.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-86-1024x630.png)

These are incredibly cheap and the most efficient way to progress chaos immortals like Apollo, Medusa, Tengu, or the older ones.

## Glorious Challenge

Glorious Challenge is the festival’s main PvE progression activity. Normal difficulty is available first, while Hard difficulty opens later during the event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-87-1024x551.png)

Players receive challenge tickets each day, with the system replenishing the total to five at the daily reset when fewer than five remain. Cleared stages can be swept, making it easier to use later tickets without repeating every battle manually.

Rewards include Pirate Festival Coins for the Challenge Shop, Magic Fishing Nets and additional festival items. Hard difficulty also provides access to more valuable rewards.

Do not allow your ticket supply to remain at five or above when the next daily reset arrives, as you may miss the free replenishment. Use the available tickets, progress as far as your marches allow and return when the harder stages become available.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-88-1024x360.png)

Make sure you get enough Coins to collect the items in the Challengers Shop that you are most in need of, note the shop has a daily stock refresh. Conserve as many of the extra Challenge Ticket purchases as you can in preparation for hard mode to unlock.

## Pinnacle Trial

Pinnacle Trial is the more competitive combat section of Pirate Festival. Players challenge increasingly powerful formations to earn first-clear and stage rewards, after which qualifying players can participate in the ranking challenge.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/image-89-1024x550.png)

The stage rewards include Magic Fishing Nets, Dazzling Wish attempts and season-appropriate Immortal fragments. Ranking rewards provide additional premium materials, cosmetics and Insignias, with their exact contents varying according to season and placement.

Most players should treat Pinnacle Trial as a source of free rewards rather than feeling pressured to compete for the top positions, only the biggest of whales can care about that. Clear every stage your account can reasonably defeat, collect the Fishing Nets and other materials, and leave the highest rankings to accounts built for that level of competition.

## Summary

Pirate Festival 2026 is largely a traditional Infinity Kingdom seasonal festival, but that is not necessarily a bad thing. Fishing Contest, Dazzling Wish, the festival pass and the two combat activities provide a familiar mixture of free progression and optional competitive spending.

The major additions are **Horus in the Grail Shop** and the completely new **Alchemical Secrets** crystal-sorting game. Alchemical Secrets is also an important free source of Magic Fishing Nets, so everyone should complete the available stages even if they are not chasing the Fishing Contest rankings.

Log in daily, collect the free currencies, avoid wasting replenishing challenge tickets and inspect the entire Grail Shop before committing your resources. We will return with a separate guide dedicated entirely to Alchemical Secrets and how to solve its crystal-sorting challenges efficiently.

### Related Guides

- [Harvest Festival 2026 Overview](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/seaonal-events/harvest-festival-august/harvest-festival-2026/)
- [Fishing Contest and Net Cost-Efficiency Guide](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/seaonal-events/harvest-festival-august/harvest-festival-2026-fishing-and-net-cost-efficiency-guide/)
- [Pirate Festival 2026 - Alchemical Secrets Mini-Game](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/seaonal-events/pirate-festivals-september/pirate-festival-2026-alchemical-secrets-new-mini-game/)
- [Eternal Grail Roulette - Cost Efficiency](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/the-eternal-grail-wheel-new-as-of-harvest-festival-august-2026/)
