title: Pirate Festival 2023
summary: Title: Pirate Festival 2023: Cost, Value, and Player Choices
markdown:
***Title**: **Pirate Festival 2023: Cost, Value, and Player Choices***

The Pirate Festival, an annual seasonal event, has set sail once again, bringing with it a treasure trove of rewards for players. In previous years, participants could acquire coveted items like the Bon Voyage skin. This year, the event offers new frame and chatbox designs, making it a must-attend occasion for collectors and enthusiasts.

**Daily Rewards:** The festival spoils players with daily sign-in rewards, including 5 Explosive Cannonballs, 300 gems, one 8-hour bubble, and three philosopher stones.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-17-1024x557.png)

**Daily Tasks:** As part of the festival experience, daily tasks present players with a series of objectives such as training troops, engaging in the Well of Time 50 times, and summoning immortals. Completing these tasks yields rewards, notably 5 Athena shards per day. It's worth noting that these tasks are time-sensitive, disappearing once the day rolls over. Completion of all tasks is required to claim the rewards. Some players may find the speedups and action points required for these tasks not worthwhile unless they are specifically building Athena or have surplus resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-18-1024x584.png)

**Missions and Bounty:** The Pirate Festival introduces missions that send immortals on elemental requirement-based quests and tasks players with eliminating gnome camps. These missions and tasks offer cannonball crafting materials and various speedups as rewards. Each completed mission or task earns stars that accumulate and can be redeemed for rewards such as cannonballs, cannonball crafting materials, and speedups. Tasks can be refreshed for free every hour or for 20 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-19-1024x591.png)

**Ocean of the Dead:** A central feature of the festival is the Ocean of the Dead, where players utilize two types of cannonballs, Explosive and Solid, each with a 25% chance of dealing double damage. Solid Shots deal 20 damage, while Explosive Shots deal 50 damage on average. Based on these statistics, it can be inferred that every Explosive Shot is equivalent to 2.5 Solid Shots, and thus, every Solid Shot is valued at 40 gems.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-23-1024x523.png)

The festival introduces progressively challenging levels, each with varying HP requirements.

**Levels**
1 – 50 HP
2 – 70 HP
3 – 90 HP
4 – 110 HP
5 – 130 HP
6 – 150 HP
7 – 170 HP
8 – 200 HP
9 – 230 HP
10 – 260 HP
11 – 290 HP
12 – 320 HP
13 – 360 HP
14 – 400 HP
15 – 450 HP
16 – 500 HP
17+ – 550 HP

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-20-1024x599.png)

Players are able to obtain some Canon Balls and Explosive Canon Balls for free, but not enough to complete the event. Gem spend is a requirement to obtain the end rewards. Let's have a look at how much it is going to cost ya.

***Please make note, that these calclations DO NOT take overkill into consideration, as such you are going to waste a little and spend just a few more. But it gives us a clear indication of what to expect.***

**All levels in total have 16980 HP.**

**Explosives**and **Canon Balls**have their 25% chance to crit, making their avg. damage respectively**62.5 and 25 damage.**

Canon Balls can be obtained in a finite number: We get 50 from Island Adventure and 50 from Kingdom Bounty. At a total of 100 canon balls with an avg. damage of 25 hence a total of 2500 damage all in all.

This will take us to around level 12-13 on it's own. But no where near the level 40 we need if we want to complete the event. As such, we need to include some Explosive Balls! These are obtained free via Island Adventure and Kingdom Bounty, but only a total of 15 are awarded for free. Let's see how many we need to buy using gems.

Total HP: 16980 minus 2500 damage from canon balls, divided by the avg. dmg of explosives 62.5 = gives us a total need for 232 Explosives on average with the 15 free, that means we need to buy 217 using gems = at 100 gems each that nets us a **total average cost of 21.668 gems to max this event (not including overkill).**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-21-1024x474.png)

**Gem cost analysis:** To assess the value of the Ocean of the Dead event, we'll consider gems, philosopher stones, and speedups (converted to their gem equivalent) since these are the primary items of interest for most players.

- For the free path, you’d get 400 gems, 7 philosopher stones (roughly 2,100 gems based on their cost), and four 1-hour speedups (280 gems or roughly 70 gems each based on market prices) for a total of 2,780 gems of value.
- For the 3,500 gem path, you’d get 1,600 gems, 12 philosopher stones (roughly 3,600 gems), and four 3-hour speedups (1,080 gems), totaling around 6,280 gems of value without including the exclusive artifact chest you would also get.
- For the $20 path, you’d get 18 philosopher stones (5,400 gem value) and ten 3-hour speedups (2,700 gems value), totaling 8,100 gems. You would also get the frame, chatbox, exclusive artifact chest for Alex, and 60 chests for light and dark immortals pieces.

**Conclusion:** The Pirate Festival presents players with a tantalizing array of rewards, but its cost-effectiveness varies depending on individual preferences and in-game priorities. Whether the event is worth pursuing depends on your specific goals. For some, certain rewards may hold little value, while others may covet exclusive items like frames and chatboxes. Ultimately, the Pirate Festival offers an exciting opportunity for players to acquire new items and enhance their gameplay experience.

title: Placement Schematics for City Sieges
summary: Sieging cities and capitals is a fundamental part of the Infinity Kingdom experience, whether you’re fighting for control of Norheim, engaging in the Contention of Relics (CoR), or participating in the Legion of…
markdown:
### Beginners’ Guide to Sieging Cities and Capitals in Infinity Kingdom

Sieging cities and capitals is a fundamental part of the Infinity Kingdom experience, whether you’re fighting for control of Norheim, engaging in the Contention of Relics (CoR), or participating in the Legion of Frostborne (LoF). These battles require strategy, teamwork, and careful preparation to ensure success. This guide will provide new players with the essential information needed to master sieging cities, capitals, and larger objectives like the World Heart.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-154-1024x462.png)

---

### Understanding Siege Mechanics

City sieges are an alliance-wide effort to capture key territories on the map. Successfully capturing a city grants your alliance benefits such as additional resources, buffs, and control over strategic areas. The size and layout of cities vary depending on their type, and understanding these layouts is crucial for effective sieging.

- **Norheim Cities and CoR Relics:** These are designed in a **4×4 grid**, making them relatively straightforward to siege. Proper positioning of castles ensures efficiency and minimizes travel time.
- **Norheim Capitals, CoR World Heart, and LoF Cities:** These targets are larger and use a **5×5 grid**, requiring more careful planning due to the odd dimensions. Incorrectly placed castles can create gaps, increasing march times and weakening your siege.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-141.png)

---

### Siege Schematics: The Blueprint for Success

#### 1. 4×4 Cities

For 4×4 cities, position your castles tightly around the city in a grid formation, leaving no gaps. This reduces march times and ensures all alliance members can contribute effectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-142.png)

#### 2. 5×5 Cities

The larger 5×5 cities are more challenging to siege because their odd dimensions don’t align perfectly with the 2×2 size of castles. To minimize gaps, plan your placements meticulously:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-143.png)

1. Assign specific spaces to each member participating in the siege.
2. Ensure castles are positioned as close to the city as possible, filling the grid efficiently.
3. Avoid random placements, as they can create inefficiencies that strain the alliance.

---

### Adjusting Talents for Sieging

Your talent setup can significantly impact your siege performance, especially during difficult battles. Before engaging in a siege, switch to military talents that enhance your offensive and defensive capabilities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-144.png)

- **Ruin:** Boosts your siege attack power, making it easier to break through defenses.
- **Survival Methods:** Increases troop durability, helping them survive longer against city defenses.
- **Shock:** Enhances the damage output of your troops, ensuring maximum efficiency in combat.

Always activate buffs before a siege to further strengthen your army. These buffs can be applied individually or through alliance-wide bonuses.

---

### Strategic Considerations for Sieging

#### 1. Communication and Coordination

Effective sieges rely on teamwork. Communicate with your alliance to coordinate placements, decide who will lead the siege, and plan attack waves. A well-organized alliance can capture even the most fortified cities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-151-1024x451.png)

#### 2. Siege Timing

Choose the right time to launch your siege. Avoid attacking when your alliance is spread thin or during off-peak hours when fewer members are online.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-152-1024x423.png)

#### 3. Maximizing Rewards

Focus on cities that provide the greatest strategic or resource benefits for your alliance. Capturing capitals and relic cities can significantly boost your alliance’s influence and economy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-153-1024x386.png)

---

### Contention of Relics and Legion of Frostborne

As your server progresses new cities become available during the PvP events Contention of Relics and Legion of Frostborne.

- **Contention of Relics (CoR):** This event introduces relic cities and the World Heart, which require large-scale coordination. The**World Heart’s 5×5 layout** makes precise castle placement essential for reducing downtime and maximizing participation.
- **Legion of Frostborne (SvS):** In later seasons, alliances will face even greater challenges sieging cities and capitals in the frozen lands of the gnomes. These sieges demand high levels of preparation, coordination, and talent optimization.

---

### Final Tips for Beginners

1. **Plan Your Placements:** Always use the appropriate schematic for the city you’re attacking. Proper planning prevents gaps and inefficiencies.
2. **Prepare in Advance:** Adjust your talents and activate buffs before the siege begins. Small preparations can make a big difference.
3. **Work as a Team:** Successful sieges require alliance-wide coordination. Communicate and cooperate to maximize your chances of success.
4. **Learn from Experience:** Each siege provides an opportunity to refine your strategy. Pay attention to what works and improve your tactics over time.

By following this guide, you’ll be well-equipped to participate in city and capital sieges, paving the way for your alliance’s dominance in Infinity Kingdom. Good luck, and may your sieges be swift and victorious!

title: Introduction and Tips for the Harbour
summary: With the release of patch 2.6.8, Infinity Kingdom introduced a revamped Harbour feature, transforming it into a continuous exploration activity where players dispatch immortals on their ship to gather resources and…
markdown:
With the release of patch 2.6.8, Infinity Kingdom introduced a revamped Harbour feature, transforming it into a continuous exploration activity where players dispatch immortals on their ship to gather resources and experience. This guide delves into the mechanics of the new Harbour, offering strategies to optimize your rewards. This guide is a beginners guide to understanding the Harbour. I will include some recommendations with what I am doing as a player in Preperation stage on the verge of entering season 1 queueing. As such, this guide is most relevant for newer players who want to understand how it works as well as for players that are looking for quick tips on how to manage their Harbour.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-180-1024x567.png)

## Basics at the Harbour Mechanics

### Continuous Sailing

- **Continuous Exploration**: Unlike the previous long voyages, the new system allows the ship to continuously sail, collecting rewards and EXP.
- **EXP and Leveling**: Experience points increase your ship's level, which in turn enhances the quality and quantity of rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-128.png)

### Dispatching Immortals

- **Crew Assignment**: Immortals assigned to the ship's crew cannot participate in marches but remain available for Arena and Throne activities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-130-1024x343.png)

- **Rotating Immortal Compositions**: Periodically, certain immortals will offer bonus rewards when dispatched. It's crucial to rotate your crew according to these bonuses to maximize gains.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-129-1024x441.png)

### Weather Conditions

- **Impact on Rewards**: Weather changes can affect the reward probability:  - **Sunny**: +5% other rewards
- **Overcast**: No change
- **Downpour**: -2%
- **Windy**: -3%

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-131.png)

## Strategies for Optimizing Rewards

### Utilizing Bonus Immortals

- **Bonus Rewards**: Deploying bonus immortals can significantly increase the likelihood of obtaining rare and other rewards.
- **Regular Checks**: Always check for updates on the bonus immortals and adjust your crew accordingly to ensure you are receiving the optimal bonuses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-132.png)

### Immortal Levels and Star Ratings

- **Reward Boosts Based on Crew Quality**: The level and star rating of your immortals can improve your drop rates:  - **Basic threshold**: 5 immortals at minimum level 1 and star level 1 for a 3% bonus.
- **Higher thresholds**: Increase in increments as your ship levels up and allows more immortals on board, with the highest being 16 immortals at level 60 and star level 8 for a 25% bonus.
- ![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-133.png)

Thresholds (bonus applies to both rare and other):
3% bonus: 5 Epic immortals at min. level 1, tier level 0 and at star level 0.
5% bonus: 6 Epic immortals at min. level 10, tier level 0 and at star level 0.
**7% bonus: 7 Epic immortals at min. level 15, tier level 0 and at star level 0.**
**9% bonus: 8 Epic immortals at min. level 20, tier level 0 and at star level 1.**
11% bonus: 9 Epic immortals at min. level 25, tier level 5 and at star level 2.
13% bonus: 10 Epic immortals at min. level 30, tier level 8 and at star level 3.
15% bonus: 11 Epic immortals at min. level 35, tier level 10 and at star level 4.
17% bonus: 12 Epic immortals at min. level 40, tier level 15 and at star level 5.
19% bonus: 13 Epic immortals at min. level 45, tier level 18 and at star level 6.
21% bonus: 14 Epic immortals at min. level 50, tier level 20 and at star level 7.
23% bonus: 15 Epic immortals at min. level 55, tier level 25 and at star level 7.
25% bonus: 16 Epic immortals at min. level 60, tier level 30 and at star level 7.

Needless to say, reaching the higher levels of bonuses requires a massive investment in terms of EXP, Gold and Immortal Fragments (that could have been Purple Crystals). As such, only in late conquest should anyone get anywhere close to reaching the higher end of these bonuses.

**Preperation** **Stage Servers**: In a preperation stage server, you will not have anything to spare. Everything you have should be used to max out your main and the little you spare goes into a secondary team once season 2 of arena comes out and in time to have something to use for season 1 of Legion of Frostborne in the secondary slot. This means you want to aim for a % bonus that is easily doable with minimal investment.

My personal favorite level is around 7% or 9%. This is because it requires relatively little EXP, getting level 15 or 20 is quite easily doable. Moreover, you do not have to invest any gold what so ever into tier levels and 7% requires no immortal fragments made into Star levels and 9% requires just a single star (30 fragments).

**Season 1-2 ish an onwards**: Once you progress into the next seasons with your server, resources quickly become more abundant. Therefore, you should begin moving a bit up the ladder on the bonus chart. I would aim for the 11% or 13% bonus by then, simply because they are not getting into the super Gold expensive tiers in terms of Tier Levels yet. You will need a bit of Fragments for this, but with the new Golden Path and having progressed beyond C40 at this stage, you should be able to collect enough. If you are strained for crystals for your ToK skills on your main and secondary team, stay at 7-9%.

As you progress into later seasons and eventually Conquest, you should be starting to stockpile EXP and Immortal Fragments are still abundance, hence you are able to move further if you want to. Gold may still be a strain, but if you do Infernal events correctly you should have plenty of that in the end on Conquest servers. Hence you can progress onto the later levels.

Is it worth the investment though? I would say so. As you upgrade your Harbour level past level 40 you begin to collect Shadow Immortal Fragments. Past level 45 you begin to collect Holy Immortal Fragments and after level 50 you even collect Chaos Immortal Fragments at a quite decent rate! That means that adding a few % bonus can yield a quite significant payout for end-game players and save you a lot of real money as you progress into Holy or even Chaos!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-179.png)

## Rewards and Progression

- **Early Rewards**: Initial levels yield speedups, gold, resources, and Random Immortal Fragments, which summon an Epic immortal of a random element.
- **Progressive Enhancement**: Rewards improve as the ship levels up, emphasizing the importance of continuously upgrading and managing your crew effectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-135-1024x488.png)

## Conclusion

The new Harbour feature in Infinity Kingdom offers a dynamic way to engage with the game, providing continuous rewards while demanding strategic management of your crew and their assignments. By effectively utilizing the rotating immortal bonuses, adapting to weather conditions, and strategically leveling your ship and crew, you can maximize your gains from this feature. Stay tuned for future updates as more insights become available on later-tier rewards. Keep your crew prepared and ready to set sail on profitable adventures in the ever-expanding seas of Norheim!

### Guide to "Poison Thorn" Skill in the Tower of Knowledge (Infinity Kingdom Patch 2.6)

The "Poison Thorn" skill, introduced in Patch 2.6 of Infinity Kingdom, is a remarkable addition to the Tower of Knowledge. This skill empowers magical damage-dealing Immortals to not only inflict more damage but also apply a healing-dampening effect to the enemy. In this guide, we'll delve into the mechanics and strategic advantages of the "Poison Thorn" skill.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-97-1024x454.png)

## Key Features of "Poison Thorn"

### 1. Universal Healing Reduction:

"Poison Thorn" marks a significant advancement in Infinity Kingdom as it introduces a healing reduction effect that can be applied by any magical damage-dealing Immortal. This extends the utility of healing reduction beyond just Genghis Khan and Emperor Qin, allowing a broader range of Immortals to contribute to your strategy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-98.png)

### 2. Targeting the Most Dangerous:

One of the standout features of "Poison Thorn" is its unique targeting mechanism. Instead of randomly selecting an enemy to deal damage and apply the healing dampening effect, it specifically targets the enemy with the highest physical attack. This tactical approach ensures that the enemy taking the damage and receiving the dampening debuff will almost always be the most formidable physical damage dealer on the opposing side.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-99.png)

## Strategic Advantages of "Poison Thorn"

### 1. Troop Reduction on Key Targets:

The ability to consistently target the enemy with the highest physical attack is a game-changer. It enables you to focus your damage and healing reduction on the opponent you most want to weaken. By reducing the troops of the most dangerous enemy, you can disrupt their offensive capabilities and tilt the battle in your favor.

### 2. Optimized Damage Output:

"Poison Thorn" not only serves as a healing reduction tool but also amplifies the damage output of magical Immortals. This dual functionality makes it a versatile and invaluable skill in battles where healing reduction and damage are paramount.

### 3. Strategic Synergy:

Consider pairing Immortals with the "Poison Thorn" skill with those who can capitalize on the weakened enemies. Combining it with crowd control Immortals or those with AoE (Area of Effect) damage can result in devastating effects, as it ensures the right enemies are softened up for maximum impact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/image-100-1024x533.png)

## Conclusion

"Poison Thorn" is a groundbreaking addition to the Tower of Knowledge in Infinity Kingdom. Its capacity to reduce healing on key targets while enhancing magical damage output cannot be understated. The skill's unique targeting mechanism, honing in on the most dangerous physical damage dealer, makes it an essential choice for any magical Immortal.

Incorporate "Poison Thorn" into your Immortal lineup strategically to gain a significant advantage in battles, whether against formidable opponents or challenging PvE encounters. Mastering the utilization of this skill will undoubtedly elevate your gameplay and provide an edge in the ever-evolving world of Infinity Kingdom.

Immortal Portraits in *Infinity Kingdom* are a pivotal feature introduced in patch 2.6.3, allowing players to enhance their Immortals' attributes through the use of a resource called Stardust. Upgrading these portraits can significantly boost your Immortals' combat effectiveness, making strategic investment in this system crucial for competitive play.​

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-1024x539.png)

---

## Understanding Immortal Portraits

Each Immortal has a unique portrait that can be leveled up to increase their stats. These enhancements include boosts to physical/magical attack and defense, accuracy, dodge, and critical rates, depending on the Immortal's role (e.g., Tank, Mage, Support). **[Portait guide video here!](https://youtu.be/xAXWN3w0iU4)**

Notably, at certain milestone levels, Immortals receive percentage-based bonuses, which are particularly impactful:​

- **Level 10:** Grants a 5% boost to a specific attribute, varying by Immortal type.
- **Level 20:** Provides an additional 5% bonus, such as increased physical/magical damage or damage resistance.​

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-4-1024x317.png)

These percentage bonuses are substantial and can turn the tide in battles, especially in PvP scenarios. ​[Wiki & Tools | Infinity Kingdom](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortal-portraits/portrait-level-table/?utm_source)

---

## Stardust Costs for Portrait Upgrades

Upgrading an Immortal's portrait requires Stardust, with the cost increasing at higher levels. The total Stardust needed to reach level 50 is approximately 6,341. Here's a breakdown of the costs:​

- **Levels 1–10:** 117 Stardust
- **Levels 11–20:** 466 Stardust
- **Levels 21–30:** 1,104 Stardust
- **Levels 31–40:** 1,684 Stardust
- **Levels 41–50:** 2,715 Stardust​

title: Portals - How many?
summary: Changing servers is a big project for most players. Even for spenders, migration can be a very expensive and cumbersome task simply because you need quite a lot of portals to migrate to a new server in Infinity Kingdom.
markdown:
Changing servers is a big project for most players. Even for spenders, migration can be a very expensive and cumbersome task simply because you need quite a lot of portals to migrate to a new server in Infinity Kingdom.

In this guide, we are going to have a look at how many portals players need to migrate, how to figure out how many YOU need.

## Portals requirement table - Server migration

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/www.reallygreatsite.com-3024-×-1500px-1024x508.png)

The number of Portals required to migrate from one server to another is based on your Lord’s maximum achieved power. If you are planning to migrate, it may be wise to stop boosting your power beyond the maximum power level you have already reached.

Say for instance, I have an account at power 865K max. I would need 15 portals to migrate, however if I at any point in time reach beyond 900K power, I now need 20 Portals to migrate.

What you want to do if you are trying to migrate but also want to grow while you collect portals, is make sure you do not have troops loaded into at least a few of your marches. This will significantly drop your power allowing you to still grow but without hitting a new portal requirement threshold.

**Can I remove troops or Immortals and drop to a lower power requirement?** No. Migration requirements are based on the MAXIMUM achieved power, meaning once you have been beyond e.g. 900K power, you will ALWAYS need atleast 20 portals to migrate.

**Check your maximum power under the statistics tab on the Profile Interface in-game.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-68-1024x573.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/image-69-1024x595.png)

**[If you want to know more about how to obtain Portals both via Free-to-Play methods and through spending, you can read everything about obtaining portals here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/infinity-kingdom-game-updates/how-many-portals-to-change-server/everything-about-how-to-obtain-portals/)**

## Infinity Kingdom Portrait Levels Guide

In Infinity Kingdom, portrait levels play a crucial role in enhancing the power of your Immortals. These portrait levels offer various attribute gains as you level up your Immortals, and understanding how to strategically invest in them can significantly impact your gameplay. In this guide, we will delve into the details of portrait levels, including costs, rewards, and the best strategies to follow.

## Immortal Type-Specific Progression

As you embark on the journey of upgrading portrait levels in Infinity Kingdom, it's vital to understand how each type of Immortal evolves uniquely at different levels. The cost associated with each level increases, and so do the attribute bonuses. Let's delve into the specific progression for each Immortal type:

### Tank Immortals

Tank Immortals are the frontline protectors of your team. They focus on absorbing damage and maintaining the stability of your formation. Here's how they progress as you invest in portrait levels:

- Attribute gains are Physical Attack, Magical Defense and Physical Defense.
- As you continue upgrading, you'll unlock a 5% Damage Resistance bonus at level 20. This bonus provides them with additional resilience against various forms of damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-38-1024x518.png)

### Attack Immortals

Attack Immortals specialize in dealing physical damage to enemies. Their progression is vital for boosting your team's offensive capabilities. Here's how they evolve with portrait level upgrades:

- Attribute gains are Physical Defense, Magical Defense and Physical Attack.
- The first % bonus at level 10 provides a 5% Accuracy Rate, improving their precision in combat.
- At level 20, you unlock a 5% Physical Damage bonus, significantly amplifying their damage output.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-42-1024x545.png)

### Ranged Immortals

Ranged Immortals provide crucial support from a safe distance, making them valuable for controlling the battlefield. Their progression is as follows:

- Attribute gains are Physical Defense, Magical Defense and Physical Attack.
- The first % bonus at level 10 grants a 5% Accuracy Rate, making their ranged attacks more precise.
- Reaching level 20 rewards them with a 5% Physical Damage bonus, enhancing their ranged damage output.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-40-1024x529.png)

### Magic Immortals

Magic Immortals unleash the power of spells and magical attacks. They play a pivotal role in your team's ability to deal magical damage. Here's how they progress:

- Attribute gains are Physical Defense, Magical Defense and Magical Attack.
- The first % bonus at level 10 provides a 5% Crit Rate, increasing their chances of landing critical hits.
- At level 20, they receive a 5% bonus to Magical Damage, significantly amplifying their magical damage potential.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-41-1024x514.png)

### Support Immortals

Support Immortals are the backbone of your team, providing valuable assistance and healing. Their unique progression is as follows:

- Attribute gains are Physical Attack, Physical Defense and Magical Defense.
- The first % bonus at level 10 grants a 5% Dodge Rate, making them more evasive and challenging to hit.
- At level 20, they unlock a 5% Damage Resistance bonus, making them more resilient and capable of enduring damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-43-1024x542.png)

It's essential to consider these unique progressions and the associated costs as you plan your portrait level investments. Understanding the strengths and weaknesses of each Immortal type and prioritizing the right ones for your strategy can make a significant difference in your overall performance in Infinity Kingdom.

## Portrait Level Rewards

As you progress through the portrait levels, each Immortal type gains different attributes. The following table outlines the rewards for each type as you level up their portraits:

It's important to note that the first % bonus varies depending on the Immortal type, aligning with their respective roles. For example, Attack Immortals receive an accuracy bonus, while Magic Immortals gain a critical hit bonus. These bonuses are valuable, but the true power lies in reaching the second % bonus.

## The Power of the Second % Bonus

Reaching level 20 in portrait levels unlocks the second % bonus, which provides substantial boosts to your Immortals:

- **Attack and Ranged Immortals**: Receive a 5% increase in physical damage.
- **Magic Immortals**: Gain a 5% increase in magical damage.
- **Tank and Support Immortals**: Acquire a 5% damage resistance bonus.

These upgrades are incredibly potent and can make a significant difference in your Immortals' performance on the battlefield.

## Managing Costs

One important factor to consider is that the cost of leveling up portrait levels increases as you progress. This means that, while you keep receiving attribute bonuses, they come at a much higher cost. For example, at portrait level 4, you gain 56.7 physical attack for just 7 Stardust, but at level 21, you get the same 56.7 physical attack for the price of 85 Stardust.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-39-1024x524.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-42-1024x545.png)

This highlights the importance of strategic management when upgrading portrait levels. Here's what you should keep in mind:

1. **Different Upgrade Paces**: Avoid upgrading all your Immortals at the same pace. As the levels get more expensive, the returns diminish until you reach the major boost % slot.
2. **Low-Level Investments**: Take advantage of the extremely low cost at lower levels. The attribute boosts at these levels are still valuable. Consider stopping at either level 4 or 6, depending on your resources.
3. **Focus on Key Immortals**: Invest heavily in one or a few Immortals to unlock the major upgrades at level 10 and 20. Choose the most valuable Immortals for your strategy, such as Alex in a hybrid team or Wu in a Fire-focused lineup.

By following these strategies and understanding the value of portrait levels, you can optimize your Immortal's power and dominate the battlefield in Infinity Kingdom.

Remember, the journey to the second % bonus is where your Immortals truly shine, so plan your portrait level investments wisely and lead your team to victory!

title: Poseidon (chaos)
summary: Poseidon sits in an unusual position in the current Infinity Kingdom landscape. As a Chaos-element spearmen immortal, he adapts to any elemental lineup while benefiting from a troop type that many players underinvest in…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-84-1024x586.png)

### Introduction

Poseidon sits in an unusual position in the current Infinity Kingdom landscape. As a **Chaos-element spearmen immortal**, he adapts to any elemental lineup while benefiting from a troop type that many players underinvest in during early and mid progression.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-85.png)

While most players are not naturally building into Spearmen, the meta has quietly shifted in a way that favors him as more cavalry-centered builds—especially those revolving around Alexander—are becoming more common again, and spearmen naturally counter cavalry. If you prepare for Poseidon early in seasons or reach a point where your tech is broadly developed, he becomes one of the most threatening damage dealers available.

---

### Ultimate Ability – Giant Wave

### Official description:

> Inflicts Physical Damage (400%) to all enemies, and has a 50% chance of Biting them, inflicting physical damage (240%) every 3s for 9s. Bitten targets are unable to gain shields.

#### Damage Breakdown

- Base AoE hit: **400%**
- DoT (Bite): **240% × 3 ticks = 720% per target**
- Total potential per cast (5 targets): **3760%**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-86-1024x480.png)

This places Poseidon among the **highest raw ultimate damage dealers in the game**.

From testing and compiled data:

- **Ultimate value ranking:** ~Top 4 (realistically Top 2–3)
- **Base DPS ranking:** ~10th
- **Base energy regen:** 53 (very low)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-87-1024x265.png)

The discrepancy is important. His raw output is elite, but his **low energy regen limits frequency**, which is why builds that accelerate his casting cycle dramatically increase his effectiveness.

---

### Energy Scaling & Skill Synergies

Poseidon is one of the clearest examples of an immortal who benefits disproportionately from energy acceleration.

- **Energy Master value:** Disregard, Poseidon unable to wield it as a frontline attack immortal.
- **Corrosive Power value:** 752%

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-95.png)

These are among the highest returns in the game and directly tied to:

1. High ultimate scaling
2. Poor base regen

#### Why This Matters

When you increase Poseidon’s cast frequency:

- You’re not just increasing uptime—you’re multiplying one of the strongest ultimates in the game.
- This is why he dominates environments like Open Arena where optimized skill setups are common.

From experience, once you give him consistent access to faster ult cycles, the difference is immediate. In one of my own test setups, shifting from a standard DPS configuration to a Corrosive Power-focused build increased total damage output by a noticeable margin even before artifact optimization.

---

### Utility – Anti-Shield Mechanic

The most understated part of Poseidon’s kit is this line:

> *“Bitten targets are unable to gain shields.”*

This is extremely impactful in the current meta:

- Hard counters **shield-based sustain**
- Disrupts **dual tank setups**
- Weakens **Charles-centered compositions**
- Combines well with **Wound effects** (Qin / Khan)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-89-1024x346.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-90-1024x483.png)

#### Practical Impact

When paired with Wound application:

- No shields
- Reduced or nullified healing

This effectively **turns off sustain mechanics entirely**, forcing fights into pure damage races—where Poseidon excels.

---

### Core Weakness – Nine Tails Counter

Poseidon’s viability is directly tied to one major problem: **Nine Tails**.

Her ultimate:

- Removes **Bite**
- Removes **Serious Wound**
- Removes **all DoTs**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-92-1024x626.png)

#### What This Means

Against Nine Tails:

- No DoT damage
- No shield denial
- Reduced overall output to just base hit
- Low regen becomes a real liability

In practice, this doesn’t just weaken Poseidon—it **invalidates his core design**.

After her recent buffs, Nine Tails has re-entered the meta in a meaningful way. You will encounter her regularly in competitive environments, especially in main marches.

---

### Strategic Role – Where Poseidon Fits

Given his strengths and hard counter, Poseidon is best positioned as:

#### 1. Open Arena Specialist

- Optimized energy builds
- High uptime on ultimate
- Punishes non–Nine Tails teams heavily

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-91-1024x607.png)

#### 2. Second-Team Carry (Recommended)

This is where he shines the most strategically.

### Reasoning:

- Forces opponent to commit Nine Tails to counter him
- Most players run Nine Tails in their **main team**
- Your Poseidon team:  - Destroys secondary teams
- Loses predictably to main
- Your main team:  - Fights without facing Nine Tails

This sequencing advantage is extremely valuable in multi-march formats.

From experience, running Poseidon as a second march creates a consistent pattern: clean wins across weaker lines, followed by a controlled loss into the enemy’s main—setting up favorable main vs main engagements.

---

### Unique Artifact & Build Priorities

#### Artifact Effect

- Increases Bite chance to **75%**

This is **essential**, not optional. All meaningful damage calculations assume this is active.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-94-1024x694.png)

#### Recommended Stats

- **Primary:** Physical Attack %
- **Secondary:**  - Physical Attack
- Surge (high priority)
- Crit (secondary consideration)

#### Why Surge Matters

Poseidon’s entire kit revolves around ultimate casts. Surge directly increases:

- Frequency
- Consistency of damage output

---

### Talents & Setup

For non-Arena use:

- **Destroyer Stance:**  - Crit scaling
- Raw damage amplification

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-93-1024x544.png)

This aligns with his role as a burst-heavy AoE damage dealer rather than a sustained DPS unit.

---

### Skill Synergy – Building Around Energy and DoT Scaling

Poseidon’s skill setup is very straightforward once you understand his limitation: **low base energy regen**. Everything revolves around compensating for that while amplifying the value of his already high-impact ultimate.

#### Core Foundation: Corrosive Power

If you’re building Poseidon properly, **Corrosive Power is non-negotiable**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-96.png)

- Offsets low energy regen through additional triggers
- Scales extremely well due to his high ultimate value
- Provides consistent supplemental damage tied to skill usage

In practice, Corrosive doesn’t just “help”—it stabilizes his entire damage profile. Without it, his output becomes too dependent on slow natural casts.

---

#### Primary Damage Synergy: Executioner

Executioner pairs naturally with Poseidon because of how his kit applies damage over time.

- Amplifies **DoT ticks from Bite**
- Converts sustained damage into meaningful burst over time
- Synergizes especially well when Bite uptime is high (artifact assumed)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-97.png)

From testing, this combination is where Poseidon starts to feel oppressive against teams lacking cleanse. The longer fights go, the more value Executioner extracts from each Bite application.

---

#### Flexible Third Slot (Epic Builds)

This slot depends on what you need in the matchup:

- **Fighting Master**  - Adds **control resistance**
- Useful into stun-heavy or control-based teams
- Stabilizes consistency in real fights
- **Blade Vortex**  - Adds **additional DoT instances**
- Increases Executioner value
- Best when committing fully to damage-over-time stacking
- **Time to Shine**  - Provides **damage amplification**
- Strongest in shorter fights or burst-oriented setups
- Less consistent than Vortex, but higher ceiling

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-98.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-99.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-100.png)

There isn’t a single correct choice here. It depends on whether you need reliability, scaling, or raw damage amplification.

---

#### Legendary Skill Options

Once you have access to legendaries, Poseidon scales even harder.

- **Last Stand**  - Excellent survivability and damage timing
- Keeps Poseidon active long enough to cycle more ultimates
- **Attack & Defense**  - One of the most efficient stat-scaling skills for him
- Improves both output and durability without complicating the build
- **Drastic Action**  - Adds **damage + healing reduction**
- Particularly valuable if you’re *not* pairing him with Qin or Khan
- Helps maintain pressure against sustain teams

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-103.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-101.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/image-102.png)

From experience, Last Stand and Attack & Defense are the most universally reliable. Drastic Action becomes situationally excellent depending on your overall team composition.

---

### Conclusion Summary

Poseidon remains one of the **highest-impact damage immortals in the game**, defined by:

- Exceptional ultimate scaling
- Strong synergy with energy acceleration
- Unique and powerful anti-shield utility

However:

- He is **hard-countered by Nine Tails**
- This limits his viability as a main march centerpiece

### Best use case:

- Open Arena dominance
- Second-team carry in multi-march formats

If built correctly and positioned strategically, Poseidon is not just viable—he’s one of the most efficient ways to dismantle non–Nine Tails compositions in the current meta.

---

title: Power impact T7 to T8 (lvl 55)
summary: The ever-evolving world of Infinity Kingdom continues to push the boundaries of power and strategy. With the introduction of Troop Tier 8, players unlock a new level of strength and resilience in their armies. In this…
markdown:
### Unleashing the Power: Exploring the Troop Tier 8 Upgrade in Infinity Kingdom

The ever-evolving world of Infinity Kingdom continues to push the boundaries of power and strategy. With the introduction of Troop Tier 8, players unlock a new level of strength and resilience in their armies. In this article, we delve into the significance of the Tier 8 upgrade, highlighting its power-boosting effects and providing valuable insights into the attribute values associated with each troop tier.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Single-InfoGrafic-Portals-2-1024x508.png)

## Unlocking the Power of Troop Tier 8

Troop Tier 8 becomes accessible to players as they reach the pinnacle of progression in the game - Barracks level 55. As the highest available level, it signifies a significant milestone and grants players access to Tier 8 troops, which boast higher attribute values compared to their Tier 7 counterparts.

**Understanding the Power Boost**: Many players wonder how substantial the power increase is with the introduction of Tier 8 troops. To provide a rough estimation, upgrading all troop types to Tier 8 results in an overall increase of around 5,000 Strategic Troop Power (STP) per troop type, equating to a total of approximately 20,000-22,000 STP across all troop types.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-53-1024x473.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-52-1024x473.png)

**Real-World Example**, **Elboran's Power Surge**: To put the Tier 8 upgrade's power boost into perspective, let's examine the experience of player Elboran, who was among the first to reach Tier 8. By upgrading only their Cavalry troops to Tier 8, Elboran's STP increased from 509,000 to 514,500. This demonstrates a significant leap in power, underscoring the impact of Tier 8 on overall army strength.

## Comparing Previous Tier Jumps

When assessing the Tier 8 upgrade, it's useful to compare it to the power gains achieved through previous troop tier advancements. The following table provides an overview of the attribute values for each tier:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-50.png)

## Conclusion

With the arrival of Troop Tier 8 in Infinity Kingdom, players can expect a significant power boost for their armies. Unlocking Tier 8 troops at Barracks level 55 introduces higher attribute values, enhancing the overall strength and resilience of the forces. While the precise power gain may vary based on troop types and individual strategies, a rough estimation suggests an increase of around 5,000 STP per troop type, resulting in an impressive total boost of approximately 20,000-22,000 STP across all troop types. As players continue to advance and conquer in the realm of Infinity Kingdom, embracing the power of Tier 8 becomes a crucial step toward dominion and victory.

title: Pre-Event Speculations Halloween Seasonal
summary: Infinity Kingdom’s October 20 update has added another set of clues
markdown:
![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190010-3xqxtp.png)



For players wondering whether Tycoon’s Club had replaced the usual monthly seasonal, the additions are encouraging. The collection entries point to several familiar festival activities alongside the new Witch Forest event, making a **full seasonal lineup look increasingly likely**.

Ghost Fiesta itself was already named in the official 3.0.0 patch notes. What today’s additions help reveal is the festival’s activity lineup, while a Discord reply from IKVIP points to **Thursday, October 22** as a possible start date. The complete schedule and reward routes still need confirmation.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190036-crmu0h.png)

## What Today’s Update Reveals

The clearest information comes from the new Ghost Fiesta entries in the Festival collection. Their acquisition descriptions identify several activities directly.

These descriptions give us more to work with than the artwork alone. **Pinnacle Trial, Dazzling Wish, Alchemical Secrets and Witch Forest** are all named as sources within the festival collection.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190029-sdy0w1.png)

The Halloween presentation is equally clear. Pumpkins, ghostly imagery, eerie backgrounds and the Night of Terror outfits all fit the Ghost Fiesta theme.

## A Full Seasonal Alongside Tycoon’s Club?

The main question this month has been whether Tycoon’s Club would take the place of the traditional seasonal festival. The new entries strongly suggest that October will still receive a broader event lineup.

Pinnacle Trial and Dazzling Wish are particularly useful clues because they fit the familiar seasonal format: a festival built from several activities, progression rewards and rankings rather than a single event tab.

A **battle pass, Glorious and an event exchange shop** would also fit that pattern. However, those remain expectations based on previous seasonals; the insignias listed above do not confirm every part of the usual structure.

Taken together, the additions point to Ghost Fiesta as October’s main Halloween seasonal, with familiar components and at least one new activity.

## Alchemical Secrets Looks Set to Return

The Alchemists insignia explicitly lists **Alchemical Secrets** as its acquisition source, pointing to the return of the gem-alchemy activity.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190046-w3tlys.png)

Its presentation matches the version seen during September’s Pirate Festival. That suggests a familiar format, although the Halloween edition’s costs, rewards and limits still need to be checked once the event opens.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190106-qpxyu4.png)

For players who participated last month, Alchemical Secrets should therefore be one of the more recognisable parts of the upcoming festival. The important detail will be whether its value remains the same.

## Witch Forest Brings a New Board Event

Witch Forest is the most distinctive addition to the lineup, and its basic gameplay has already been outlined in the [official 3.0.0 notes](https://ik-wiki.com/posts/patch-3-0-0-jadwiga-gilded-club-and-ghost-fiesta-arrive?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Players use **Magic Wands** to move around a board, landing on spaces that award resources, generate candy or trigger special events. Candy contributes points toward progression chests, while special effects can increase rewards or grant another move.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190216-t9lmxo.png)

That establishes Witch Forest as a board activity. Whether it takes over an outfit reward previously associated with Fishing Contest is a separate question that the available information does not settle.

The new insignia confirms its place in the Ghost Fiesta collection. Its reward track and any connection to Louis IX’s outfit remain details to watch when the event becomes available.

## Fu Fei and Louis IX Receive Night of Terror Outfits

The update also brings the Halloween appearances for **Fu Fei and Louis IX** into view. Both belong to the **Night of Terror** series, which the official patch notes link to Ghost Fiesta.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190153-0e72h6.png)

The individual acquisition routes are less certain. Dazzling Wish is the most obvious candidate for Fu Fei, following the route previously used for Athena’s outfit. However, an insignia tied to Dazzling Wish rankings does not by itself establish where her outfit fragments will be available.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261020-190203-gbtsm5.png)

Louis IX’s outfit may be distributed through a separate festival activity. Witch Forest is a possible candidate, but we should wait for the reward lists before treating it as the replacement for Fishing Contest.

The distinction matters for anyone planning their event spending: the featured outfits are known, while their exact reward sources and development costs still need confirmation.

## Could Ghost Fiesta Begin on October 22?

A Discord reply from IKVIP indicates that the **“Holy Grail Event” will begin on Thursday, October 22**. That makes October 22 a plausible date for the seasonal launch, especially with the related content now appearing in-game.

However, the reply uses the Holy Grail Event name. It does not on its own establish the full Ghost Fiesta timetable or confirm that every activity begins on the same day.

A launch on October 22 would place the festival comfortably within the Halloween period. Exact activity durations and the closing date of any exchange shop should be taken from the event timers once they appear.

For now, **October 22 is a date to watch**, rather than an officially established full festival schedule.

## What We Can Expect

Today’s additions make a full Halloween seasonal look much more likely, even with Tycoon’s Club already running this month. The collection entries point to Pinnacle Trial, Dazzling Wish, Alchemical Secrets and Witch Forest, while Fu Fei and Louis IX provide the featured Halloween outfits.

The remaining questions are the complete schedule, the outfit reward routes and whether the usual battle pass and Glorious activities return alongside them. Ghost Fiesta is taking shape; the next step is seeing how its rewards and costs compare with previous seasonal events.
