markdown:
### In-Depth Player Guide: Mastering the "Sniper" Skill in Infinity Kingdom

The Sniper skill emerges as a formidable asset in the arsenal of backline physical damage dealers (ranged type Immortals) within the strategic depths of Infinity Kingdom. Obtainable through participation in the Legion of Frostborne event or via a **[special 5-day bundle](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/tower-of-knowledge-passives/all-passives/snipe-new-bundle/)**, Sniper specializes in delivering devastating physical damage to a singular enemy target, prioritizing the unit positioned furthest from the skill's wielder. This guide delves into the nuances of leveraging Sniper to its fullest potential, elucidating tactics for precise targeting, synergistic play, and strategic applications that can elevate your combat effectiveness.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-87.png)

## Becoming a sniper

Sniper is distinguished by its capacity to inflict significant damage on key enemy combatants, particularly those stationed in the rear echelons of the opposing formation. The skill's design allows players to tactically eliminate or weaken pivotal backline adversaries, such as a primary damage dealer, thereby disrupting the enemy's strategic framework and diminishing their overall combat efficacy.

### Key Features:

- **Target Specificity**: Automatically targets the enemy furthest from the skill's holder.
- **High Damage Output**: Deals substantial physical damage, making it ideal for taking out high-value targets quickly.
- **Strategic Positioning**: Enables precise manipulation of target selection through strategic placement of your Immortals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-88-1024x395.png)

## Strategic Deployment

### Aligning with Battle Formations

Understanding the enemy formation is crucial. By positioning your Sniper-equipped Immortal appropriately, you can ensure the skill targets the enemy's key backline unit. This requires careful observation of opponent setups and predicting their strategic placements.

### Synergistic Pairings

The synergy between Sniper and control skills, such as those possessed by Himiko, amplifies its strategic value. For instance, pairing Sniper with Himiko’s ability to target the backliner with the highest troop count allows for tailored control and damage focus. Utilizing Sniper to eliminate or weaken secondary backline targets ensures Himiko's control effects are directed towards the intended primary target, like Loki, maximizing the disruption to the enemy’s tactical setup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-90.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/image-89.png)

### Tactical Examples

- **Against High-Value Targets**: If the enemy formation features a potent damage dealer like Loki in the backline, equipping Sniper on a backline Immortal such as Bathory and positioning her to target the enemy's secondary backline Immortal can isolate Loki as Himiko's control target.
- **Disrupting Enemy Formations**: In scenarios where the enemy deploys multiple backline threats, Sniper can be used to systematically weaken these threats, thereby reducing the pressure on your frontline and allowing your own damage dealers and controllers to operate with greater efficiency.

## Conclusion

While Sniper may not be categorized as an obligatory S-tier must-have skill, its strategic value and potential for high-impact plays render it a formidable option for backline physical damage dealers. When wielded with tactical foresight and in synergy with complementary skills and strategies, Sniper becomes an absolute game-changer on the battlefield. Mastery of this skill involves not only understanding its mechanics but also integrating it into a broader combat strategy that leverages positioning, synergy, and timing to outmaneuver and outdamage your adversaries. Embrace the precision and power of snipes to elevate your Infinity Kingdom gameplay to new heights.

title: Snow Festival (Christmas) december 2025
summary: Infinity Kingdom’s Christmas celebrations kick off December 22 and bring back the familiar seasonal loop—Glorious Challenge → Stockings shop, a 30-level Battle Pass, and Dazzling Wish / Grail Shop—with at least one…
markdown:
### Snow Festival Christmas Event Guide (Starts December 22)

Infinity Kingdom’s Christmas celebrations kick off **December 22** and bring back the familiar seasonal loop—**Glorious Challenge → Stockings shop**, a **30-level Battle Pass**, and **Dazzling Wish / Grail Shop**—with at least one genuinely new tab in the UI this time: **Winter Star**, a daily gift exchange feature aimed at alliance interaction.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-139-1024x576.png)

### Disclaimer

This article is written **before** the event goes live on servers. Information is based on the material shared with the press officer team ahead of release, so it should be highly credible, but **minor changes can happen** between test implementation and live rollout—especially around shop stock and pricing.

---

## Christmas Press Officer letter-hunt

I have **one letter** hidden in a riddle in this article. Before scrolling down, do click play here and simply enjoy the Christmas riddle as **music**while you read all about the coming Christmas event! That way you will also have solved the riddle before you even get to the riddle-text (bottom of this article)! Happy holidays and happy hunting <3

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-138-1024x585.png)

*Thanks MagicMage for making this wonderful music to the riddle!*

---

## Snow Festival Koi Gift Pack (Paid, Optional)

If you’re the kind of player who only buys a few “value” packs per month, this one is consistently among the best bang-for-buck options we see in seasonal events.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-140-1024x566.png)

For **$4.99**, you get:

- **5 Tokens of Light** (for Dazzling Wish)
- **520 Gems**
- **500 VIP Points**
- A **chance** at **4,250 Eternal Grails every two days** (jackpot odds, but real upside)

The key efficiency note: even if you buy it **five times** and never hit the lucky draw, you still end up with **850 Grails**, which should equal **80 Chaos immortal shards** via the Grail Shop, that is quite exceptional shard value for a $25 spend compared to most alternatives.

---

## Lunar Grace Pavilion Battle Pass (30 Levels)

Like past seasonal passes, this Snow Festival pass has a **free track** and a **paid track** (expected price: **$49.99**, based on prior patterns).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-141-1024x567.png)

### Expected Rewards

### Free tier (expected):

- Around **30 Tokens of Light** across the full pass

### Paid tier (expected):

- **58 additional Tokens of Light**
- **30 fragments** of **Goddess of Victory** castle skin
- **60 fragments** of the new **Lunar Grace Pavilion** castle skin

### Castle Skin Value Notes (Veteran Take)

- **Lunar Grace Pavilion:** **+5% troop defense** and **+5% gathering speed** (base line which is all obtainable thus far). This isn’t a top-tier combat skin by raw impact, but it’s a strong quality-of-life skin and a great cosmetic target—plus the pass is mainly about the **Token of Light volume** anyway.
- **Goddess of Victory:** baseline **+2% troop HP** and **-3% death rate**; additional fragments may push upgrades (example expectation in the provided notes: **Rank 3 ~2.3% HP / -3.9% death rate**). This is a practical PvE/siege comfort skin—especially for gnome farming where shaving deaths matters. For pure PvP optimization, many players still default to more aggressive attack-focused skins where available.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-143-1024x532.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-142-1024x553.png)

### How hard is it to finish?

No official mission list was provided, but seasonal passes typically run on the same structure: **7 daily missions**, **100 EXP each**, and enough total tasks that you can **miss a few per day** without failing to hit level 30. Common tasks usually include training troops, Arena, Well of Time, Market purchases, Pinnacle Trial, Glorious Challenge, and gnome bosses.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-144.png)

---

## Glorious Challenge (Your Main Stockings Engine)

This is the seasonal backbone: clear stages, collect **gems + Christmas Stockings**, then convert Stockings into the main event shop rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-145-1024x565.png)

### Normal Mode

- Available **day 1**
- **16 levels**
- Generally very easy for established accounts

### Hard Mode

- Unlocks **day 3**
- Comparable to **Elite campaign** difficulty
- More punishing puzzle setups and skill checks

### Practical Play Tip: Save Your Extra Attempts

Mechanically, this mode works like previous seasonals: you’ll eventually want to **raid the highest stage you can clear**, and because rewards scale by stage, the best value for purchased attempts is usually **the last Hard stage**.

So, if you buy extra entries with gems, the efficient play is to **wait until day 3** when Hardmode opens, push as far as you can, and then spend attempts on your best available raid target.

### Speed Rankings

Each stage shows server fastest clear times. This is largely **bragging rights** unless you’re competing with top spenders for prestige.

---

## Pinnacle Trial (The “Elite” Seasonal Mode)

Pinnacle is basically Glorious Challenge’s sharper older sibling: fewer stages, better rewards, and less room for mistakes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-146-1024x567.png)

- **5 levels total**
- **1 attempt per day**
- **No extra entries** (can’t buy more)

If you clear a level, you can **raid it for the rest of the event**. Rewards listed / assumed based on previous events include:

- **25 random Immortal fragments**
- **30 Goddess of Victory castle skin fragments**
- **10 Tokens of Light**

Difficulty ramps hard near the end because enemy marches use **legendary skills**, so mid-game players should expect a real wall on the last couple of stages.

---

## PvP Ranking Section (Mini-Arena Ruleset)

This section runs like a compact competitive ladder:

- Challenge among the **top 10** matches
- **5 attempts per day**
- Wins give points
- Losses have **no penalty**

Specific rewards weren’t confirmed, but seasonal precedent suggests it may pay out more **Goddess of Victory fragments** (last seasonal example: 1st 24 / 2nd 18 / 3rd 12 / 4th–10th 6). In most mature servers, whales tend to own this board; in quieter servers, a strong Chaos or Earth march can sometimes slip into top 10.

---

## Dazzling Wish + Grail Shop (Tokens of Light Sink)

This looks like the newer Dazzling Wish format (as seen in Serpent’s Gaze seasonal): spend **Tokens of Light** to roll a board, with chances to pull **Eternal Grails** plus other rewards like dragon crystal chests and random elemental fragments.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-147-1024x567.png)

### Expected Grail Drop Rates (Based on Last Event)

Provided prior drop chances were:

- 0.1% for 1000 Grails
- 0.15% for 500 Grails
- 0.8% for 100 Grails
- 1.5% for 50 Grails
- 10% for 5 Grails

These are not yet confirmed for live, but are a reasonable expectation assuming the board is unchanged from last seasonal (Medusa Gaze event).

### Grail Shop Expectations (Most Uncertain Area)

The shop appears “different” in test materials. What’s shown suggests:

- Chaos fragments possibly in selectable chests (notably “80 chaos fragments” implied via stock/limits)
- **2 full artifacts**
- Pricing shown: **850 Grails for Immortal**, **1100 for Artifact** (matching Medusa pricing last seasonal)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-150-1024x571.png)

Player expectation (not confirmed) is that the live shop may expand - potentially including other Chaos immortals at lower costs (e.g., 750/1000 style pricing). **But this is the part to treat most cautiously until reset confirms the real stock limits and catalog.**

### Value vs Chaos Roulette (Veteran Take)

If Dazzling Wish rates stay similar, **Chaos Roulette** usually remains the better “pure value” Token of Light sink for most accounts. The strategic exception is availability: **Medusa** not being in Roulette means that this seasonal can become one of the few ways for whales to keep progressing on her (assuming she is in the chest). Like I said, this part about the Grail Shop is what I have the least info on, but it looks like **selection chaos immortal chests, selection chaos immortal unique artifacts, and castle skin selection chests as the main rewards**. We will have to wait and see what goes live at reset.

---

## Main Event Shop: Redeem Your Stockings

This is where your Glorious Challenge work turns into guaranteed rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-148-1024x568.png)

### Confirmed / Shown Items

- **Tokens of Light** (looks like a **daily limit**, shown as 5/day; which could mean a sizeable increase over previous seasonals if it goes live looking like this. Usually we get total of 25 in total during a seasonal event).
- Christmas-themed **avatar frame**
- Christmas-themed **chatbox**
- **25 Philosopher stones**

### Expected (Not Confirmed Yet)

- **2 Artifact Selection Chests**
- **600 Stardust**

### Cost Notes

- Cosmetics + collectibles: **1,700 stockings total**
- Artifact chests usually: **2,000 each**
- Stardust often: **1,000 per 100**
- Tokens of Light pricing appears consistent with prior seasonals (~2,000 stockings for 5 tokens), just potentially delivered through daily stock instead of a fixed total cap.

### How many Stockings can you get?

Based on previous seasonal totals (32 total stages across Normal + Hard):

- Normal 1–16: **1,890**
- Hard 1–16: **3,670**
- Total: **5,560**

If you skip artifact chests, you can often clear the “best” shop items without spending gems.

There’s also the optional gem sink: a **100-ticket**purchase for **8,000 Gems**, and raiding Hard 16 has historically produced enough currency (~28,000) to buy out the shop, usually with currency to spare, but we may be more in demand of currency this time to get all the Tokens (we will see if it goes live like this).

---

## Brand New Event Tab: Winter Star

This is the true new feature this year: **Winter Star**, described as a **gift-exchange event** where you can send gifts to alliance members daily. The official wording is limited, so details (gift types, limits, and rewards) will have to be confirmed once the tab goes live.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-149-1024x544.png)

---

## Press Officer Christmas Code Hunt Riddle

Now let’s pause the article, just for a bit - If you’ve made it this far, you’re likely quite fit. You may be hunting for **letters**, scattered about. So I won’t give it away or spell it straight out. Instead, play along—no rush, no strain: And enjoy a small riddle, as a seasonal game:

**A single little letter, hiding in a *winter*squall,
I am unseen by the *star*and the *tree*in the hall.
You won’t see me in *holly*nor in *merry*appear,
Yet I stand at the start when the *new year* is here.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-138-1024x585.png)

**Marry Christmas everybody!**

---

## Conclusion on what to expect from this year's Snow Festival

Snow Festival looks like a familiar, efficient seasonal cycle with a strong emphasis on **Tokens of Light**, plus a potentially high-impact spending option in the **Koi Gift Pack** and a still-to-be-confirmed but intriguing **Grail Shop** lineup. The practical plan remains the same: clear Normal early, push Hard on day 3, raid your best Hard stage for Stockings, and treat Dazzling Wish as either a targeted unit progression tool (if your target isn’t in Roulette) or a secondary option behind Roulette efficiency.

### TL;DR

- **Starts Dec 22**; structure mirrors prior seasonal events.
- **Koi Gift Pack ($4.99)** is excellent small-spender value, especially for Chaos shard efficiency via Grails.
- **Battle Pass (30 levels):** free tokens, paid track expected to include lots more tokens + Lunar Grace Pavilion + Goddess of Victory fragments.
- **Glorious Challenge:** save extra attempt spending for **day 3 Hard mode**, then raid your highest Hard stage.
- **Pinnacle Trial:** harder, limited entries, strong rewards - expect a difficulty wall late.
- **Winter Star** is the new tab: daily alliance gift exchange, details TBD live.

---

title: Soul Synergy
summary: Soul Synergy is one of the more mechanically interesting Tower of Knowledge skills introduced in Infinity Kingdom, largely because it challenges how most players think about healing. It is Conquest-exclusive and…
markdown:
### Introduction

Soul Synergy is one of the more mechanically interesting Tower of Knowledge skills introduced in *Infinity Kingdom*, largely because it challenges how most players think about healing. It is Conquest-exclusive and obtainable only through the USD 20 seven-day recharge bundles, which makes it paywalled but still relatively accessible compared to Wisdom Well–locked skills. Because of that, it often gets evaluated too quickly as either “underwhelming” or “situational,” when in reality its value depends almost entirely on whether the player understands how different healing mechanics interact with troop distribution, energy regeneration, and damage scaling.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-12-1024x617.png)

This article takes a practical look at how Soul Synergy actually functions, why it feels weak in standard marches, and why it becomes genuinely valuable once you deliberately build around it.

---

### Understanding the Skill’s Core Mechanic

Soul Synergy establishes a permanent mental link with all allies at the start of battle. Every time a linked Immortal casts an Ultimate Skill, that same Immortal restores HP based on a 240% recovery rate. There is no cooldown and the targeting logic is unique as it simply goes for “whoever cast the Ultimate gets healed.”

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-13.png)

That detail is what makes the skill unusual. Most healing in *Infinity Kingdom* is reactive or blind splashed AoE (e.g. Vitality Touch targeting the immortal with the highest troop losses, meaning rarely your main carry. Or Divine Gift from Theodora spashing AoE heals blindly to everyone). Soul Synergy is unique as it does not attempt to save whoever is closest to dying, instead Soul Synergy does the opposite: It keep whoever is *active* topped.

On paper, 240% recovery does not look especially impressive. In isolation, a single trigger is rarely fight-deciding. The power of the skill lies in repetition. Every additional Ultimate cast is another instance of sustain, and over a long fight those instances add - if, and only if, your march is built to generate them.

---

### Why Healing Targeting Matters More Than Raw Numbers

To understand where Soul Synergy fits, it helps to compare it properly to Vitality Touch, which has been a meta skill for a long time so most players are well versed with it by now making it a nice comparison to Soul Synergy as we go over how to think about your setup and build when picking healing skills:

Vitality Touch is a single-target healing skill that always heals the Immortal who has lost the most troops. In practice, that almost always means frontline tanks or support Immortals running Assist or defensive passives. Those units are designed to take damage, so they frequently sit at the lowest troop count and therefore absorb the bulk of Vitality Touch’s healing.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-14.png)

There is nothing wrong with that. Keeping tanks alive is essential. However, from a damage perspective, this kind of healing is inefficient. Your primary damage dealer is usually the Immortal you invest the most into protecting, positioning, and troop preservation. Because of that, they are *rarely* the lowest-troop Immortal, which means they benefit the least from Vitality Touch even though maintaining their troop count has a massive impact on total damage output.

Soul Synergy changes that equation. Healing is no longer tied to who is suffering the most losses, but to who is casting the most Ultimates. If you deliberately build energy regeneration on your damage carry, Soul Synergy will funnel healing directly into the Immortal whose troop count matters most for winning the fight.

This is the key distinction. Soul Synergy does not heal “better” than Vitality Touch by default. It heals *differently*, and that difference dramatically alters the value of each point of healing depending on how your march is constructed.

---

### Energy Regeneration as the Enabling Factor

Without energy regeneration, Soul Synergy is mediocre. With it, the skill starts to make sense.

Every Ultimate cast triggers healing, so any build that increases casting frequency directly increases sustain. Skills like Energy Mastery, Psionic, Energy Burst, Adrenaline Rush and Corrosive, as well as Surge artifact investment, and Immortal passives or Matilda's energy regen ultimate skill all help boost energy gain all amplify Soul Synergy’s effectiveness. In these setups, your damage dealer is not just outputting more damage through faster casting; they are also sustaining themselves in parallel.

This creates a feedback loop. Faster energy leads to more Ultimates. More Ultimates lead to more healing. More healing preserves troop count, which increases damage output and prolongs the fight long enough for the loop to repeat.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-15-1024x505.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-16.png)

In contrast, in slower marches where Ultimates are infrequent, Soul Synergy simply does not trigger often enough to justify occupying a support slot.

---

### Practical Performance From Testing

In practical testing, Soul Synergy has performed best in marches already designed around tempo rather than raw durability.

Fire compositions with strong energy generation are a good example. When paired with Energy Master Wu, Soul Synergy provides steady sustain that noticeably improves long-fight consistency without sacrificing offensive pressure. The healing is not explosive, but it is reliable and, more importantly, it lands on the Immortals doing the work.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-17-1024x553.png)

Regen-centric builds also benefit, particularly when combined with Immortals that naturally scale energy. Matilda-based setups are a good illustration of this. When her energy regeneration is properly supported through skills and artifacts, Soul Synergy becomes a meaningful contributor to survivability. Without that support, it quickly falls behind more traditional healing options.

---

### Immortals That Naturally Fit the Skill

Soul Synergy is at its best on marches built around Immortals with high or scalable energy regeneration, such as **Anubis**, **Hippolyta**, **Matilda of Flanders**, and **Theodora** when paired with Surge artifacts. These Immortals can trigger the skill frequently enough that the cumulative healing becomes relevant over the course of a battle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-18.png)

That being said, you should synergize further with regen skills like Rage Blessing, Energy Master, Psionic, Corrosive, Burst, etc. and with Matilda's ultimate if possible to get full effect. If you are doing a hyper regen build like this focusing on regen on perhaps multiple different immortals - then Soul Synergy is very good! If you are NOT building into regen, then you will get very very low value out of it. It is a highly niche skill that requires synergy to shine.

---

### Acquisition and Real Cost Context

Soul Synergy is only available during Conquest and only through the USD 20 seven-day recharge bundles. Each daily purchase provides five skill stones, and completing five purchases within the same chain grants a twenty-five stone bonus. One completed chain therefore yields fifty stones for USD 100.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-11-1024x660.png)

Since Soul Synergy requires sixty stones, the effective cost is best evaluated using average stone value rather than marginal spending. Veteran players repeatedly buy these chains for the broader skill pool and long-term value, which places the average cost at roughly USD 2 per stone. Under that model, Soul Synergy effectively costs around USD 120.

Compared to Wisdom Well acquisition, Soul Synergy remains one of the less expensive premium sustain skills available.

---

### Conclusion

Soul Synergy is not a universal healing skill, and it is not meant to be. It is a precision tool that rewards players who understand how energy regeneration, troop scaling, and healing targeting interact.

Used without intent, it feels underwhelming. Used correctly, it allows you to redirect sustain toward the Immortals that actually decide fights. For players willing to build around tempo and Ultimate uptime, Soul Synergy offers a level of control over healing distribution that few other skills can match.

---

title: Sparks of Galaxy 101
summary: In this guide we are going to have a closer look at a new event called \"Sparks of Galaxy\". In this event, you are able to spend both gems and purchase bundles in order to earn Frosty Orbs which you in turn use to unlock…
markdown:
In this guide we are going to have a closer look at a new event called "Sparks of Galaxy". In this event, you are able to spend both gems and purchase bundles in order to earn Frosty Orbs which you in turn use to unlock strong rewards.

This event is quite special and in my opinion an awesome event because it offers rewards which has previously been very expensive, for mid-spenders! Yes, you heard correct. In this first itteration we are looking at shadow Immortals and Unique Artifacts available for gems and low-cost bundles! This means that more players will be able to afford and access (heck, even slow grind) shadow Immortals and their unique artifacts via this event. You do not have to participate in the expensive Triss Roulette and Theia's Roulette anymore!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-50.png)

## Event rewards

In the first itteration of this event we are able to reap in Siegfried and Himiko Immortal fragments, as well as Unique Artifact fragments for these two Immortals. In addition, we are able to get Shadow Dragon Crystals and a solid pile of Philosopher stones in the process!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-52.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-53.png)

## How does it work?

The event works much like the Stellar Compass event, but with a new unique event currency and a new set of rewards.

As you spend Frosty Orbs in the Horoscope, you have a chance to gain all the rewards available. As you spend your Orbs, the event bar will increase, improving the chances of the big jackpot Immortal Fragment reward.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-54.png)

## Stock limitations

There are a few limitations on this event though! Unlike most other events, big spenders are not able to spend on a ton of expensive and low-efficiency 99$ bundles to quickly empty the event. Instead, we have an event shop where the stock limits are quite strict.

### Over the course of this 3-day event you can purchase each day:

20 x 5 Frosty Orbs at a cost of = 20,000 gems

title: Sparks of Galaxy Updated (written 2.8.7)
summary: The Sparks of Galaxy event is one of the main ways to obtain rare Immortal fragments and Artifact fragments for Shadow and Holy immortals. It’s structured like a gacha draw with pity, meaning you spend draws on a prize…
markdown:
The **Sparks of Galaxy** event is one of the main ways to obtain rare **Immortal fragments** and **Artifact fragments** for Shadow and Holy immortals. It’s structured like a gacha draw with pity, meaning you spend draws on a prize pool that includes Immortal fragments, Artifact fragments, Dragon Essences, and Dragon Crystals. There is also a **pity system**, which guarantees Immortal fragment drops if you go too long without one (100 draws).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-2-1024x564.png)

This guide covers the event mechanics, drop rates, pricing breakdowns, and practical plans for targeting both **Immortal** and **Artifact fragments** efficiently.

---

## Event Mechanics

- Each draw has a chance to give a reward from the pool:  - **Immortal Fragments (10x)**: 4 slots at **1.30% each** → **5.2% total chance**
- **Artifact Fragments (5x)**: 3 slots at **1.20% each** → **3.6% total chance**
- **Dragon Essence (1x)**: 2 slots at **17% each** → **34% total chance**
- **Dragon Crystal Chests (10x)**: 28% chance
- **Pity rule**: If you go **100 pulls without an Immortal fragment**, the next pull is guaranteed to give one (10 frags). Pity resets after each Immortal fragment drop.
- **No pity** for Artifact fragments.
- Rewards are selection chests for Shadow/Holy Immortals or Artifacts, so duplicates aren’t a risk.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-84-1024x612.png)

---

## Drop Math & Expectations

#### Immortal Fragments

- We get **10x Immortal frags** per hit.
- Chance per pull = **5.2%**.
- To reach **60 frags** (6 hits):  - Expected pulls: ~**115**
- Median: ~109 pulls
- 95% certainty: ~197 pulls
- Thanks to pity, bad luck is capped, but given the decent drop rate we are not going to run into pity very often. That being said, it will happen and it does reduce the average expected a bit.

#### Artifact Fragments

- Need **5x Artifact frags** per hit.
- Chance per pull = **3.6%**.
- To reach **60 frags** (12 hits):  - Expected pulls: ~**333**
- Median: ~324 pulls
- 95% certainty: ~500 pulls
- No pity = much wider variance.
- Artifact frags are harder to obtain than immortal fragments, which is standard in these events. Given you need 4750 immortal fragments to max out an immortal and only 900 artifact fragments (assuming good craft roll within the standard 15 to max) it is not as bad as it looks initially. But you are on average getting the 15 artifacts = 1 max in 4995 pulls on average whereas you need 9104 draws to get the total 4750 immortal fragments needed for a max + talents.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-128-1024x590.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-129-1024x571.png)

---

## Pricing Breakdown

You can buy pulls through cash packs or with gems.

#### Pack Options (per event stock)

- **$1** → 5 pulls ×12 = 60 pulls → **$12 total** → **$0.20/pull**
- **$2** → 10 pulls ×10 = 100 pulls → **$20 total** → **$0.20/pull**
- **$5** → 18 pulls ×8 = 144 pulls → **$40 total** → **$0.2778/pull**
- **$10** → 24 pulls ×6 = 144 pulls → **$60 total** → **$0.4167/pull**
- **$15** → 32 pulls ×5 = 160 pulls → **$75 total** → **$0.4688/pull**
- **$30** → 40 pulls ×2 = 80 pulls → **$60 total** → **$0.75/pull**
- **$50** → 50 pulls ×1 = 50 pulls → **$50 total** → **$1.00/pull**
- **All bundles combined:** 738 pulls for $317 → **$0.43/pull average**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-1-1024x537.png)

---

## Strategies depending on your spending level, the more time you have the cheaper you can get it!

### Three clean routes to farm ~1020 Immortal fragments from the draw event

Quick baseline:

- Immortal frags = **10 per hit**, hit rate **5.2%** per pull, with a **100-pull pity** that forces an Immortal frag if you haven’t hit one yet.
- To reach **~1020 frags** you need **~102 hits** → expected **~1,962 pulls**. Pity mostly just trims bad-luck streaks; the mean stays about the same over this many pulls.
- For these strategies or plans, we are going to be doing three different versions. In plan A we are using only the cheapest 1 and 2 dollar bundles. This will be most efficient (see below) but also take more time given the stock caps. In Plan B we are including the slighly less efficient but still very good value 5$ bundle and for Plan C we are going fast and getting the 10 and 15 dollar bundles too.
- Bundle reminder:  - **$1**: 12× (5 pulls each) → 60 pulls total → $12 → **$0.20/pull**
- **$2**: 10× (10 pulls each) → 100 pulls total → $20 → **$0.20/pull**
- **$5**: 8× (18 pulls each) → 144 pulls total → $40 → **$0.2778/pull**
- **$10**: 6× (24 pulls each) → 144 pulls total → $60 → **$0.4167/pull**
- **$15**: 5× (32 pulls each) → 160 pulls total → $75 → **$0.4688/pull**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-131-1024x683.png)

---

## Plan A — Cheapest money (only $1 + $2 packs)

This is the budget grinder. You buy only the cheapest packs and accept more events.

- **Pulls per event:** 60 + 100 = **160** pulls for **$32**
- **Target pulls:** ~1,962
- **12 full events** = 12 × 160 = **1,920 pulls** → **$384**
- **Remainder since we are a bit short on draws (unles you got lucky):** 1,962 − 1,920 = **42 pulls** needed --> Grab **4× $2** (40 pulls, $8) + **1× $1** (5 pulls, $1) → **45 pulls** for **$9**.
- **Total Plan A:** **~1,965 pulls** i.e. **1020 immortal fragments** for a price of **$393** over the course of **~13 events** (12 full + a tiny top-up in the 13th)

This is the best $/pull you can get. It just takes the longest.

---

## Plan B — Fewer events (add $5 packs)

Here you still keep things pretty efficient, but you finish way faster.

- **Pulls per event:** ($1+$2+$5) = 60 + 100 + 144 = **304 pulls** for **$72**
- **6 full events** = 6 × 304 = **1,824 pulls** → **$432**
- **Remainder:** 1,962 − 1,824 = **138 pulls**  - Cheapest way to finish (still only using 1/2/5): **12× $1** (60 pulls, $12) + **8× $2** (80 pulls, $16) → **140 pulls** for **$28**
- **Total Plan B:** **~1,964 pulls**, i.e. 1020 immortal fragments for a price of **$460** over the course of **~7 events** (6 full + a small top-up)

This is the sweet spot if you value time without burning money on the worse-value packs.

---

## Plan C — Fastest timeline (also buy $10 + $15 )

Now we throw in the $10 and $15 bundles to compress the event count further.

- **Pulls per event:** ($1+$2+$5+$10+$15) = 60 + 100 + 144 + 144 + 160 = **608 pulls** for **$207**
- **3 full events** = 3 × 608 = **1,824 pulls** → **$621**
- **Remainder:** 1,962 − 1,824 = **138 pulls**  - Cheapest top-up: **12× $1** (60, $12) + **8× $2** (80, $16) → **140 pulls** for **$28**
- **Total Plan C:** **~1,964 pulls** (1020 immortal frags) for the price of **$649** so quite expensive, but done in just **~4 events** (3 full + a small top-up)

You’re paying for speed here. It’s noticeably more expensive than Plan B, but you’re done in roughly half the events of Plan A.

---

## Gems-only comparison

### Pricing of rewards, as you can expect if you are using only Gems

- 5 pulls = 1000 gems → **200 gems per pull**
- 115 pulls (60 Imm frags) ≈ **23,000 gems**
- 334 pulls (60 Art frags) ≈ **67,000 gems**
- 1020 immortal fragments for comparison, i.e. ~1,965 pulls → **~393,000 gems**

---

## What I’d do (player perspective)

- If you’re patient and care about value: **Plan A**. It’s the cheapest by far (**~$393**) but you’re in for ~**13 events**.
- If you want a good balance: **Plan B**. This is my preferred route: **~$460** and **~7 events**.
- If you just want it **done fast**: **Plan C**. You’ll likely wrap in **~4 events** for **~$649**.

Small tip: because pity triggers every 100 “no-hit” pulls, over a 2k-pull grind the variance is low. You don’t need a huge extra buffer—just don’t cut it to the exact pull on your last event (buy +20–40 extra pulls if you’re paranoid).

---

### Conclusion

- **Always buy the $1 and $2 packs** — they’re the best value in the event.
- If you’re patient, Plan A (just $1 + $2) is the best long-term strategy.
- If you want speed, add $5 packs for a balanced Plan B. Only go to $10/$15 if you want to finish in very few events.
- Gemming this event is expensive — only use if you have excess saved.
- Don’t be afraid of the pity system — failing pulls aren’t wasted since pity forces progress.
- Over long grinds (like 1k+ frags), variance smooths out and your average pulls will line up close to the math.

Sparks of Galaxy is a high-value but expensive event, offering one of the few reliable paths to Shadow/Holy Immortal and Artifact fragments.

## ⚡ New Spender Frame – Lightning Elegance for the Elite

Infinity Kingdom has always had a selection of flashy, thematic frames—some seasonal, some earned through grueling competition, and others locked behind very specific spend levels. With the latest update, the devs have quietly dropped one of the **cleanest and most elegant-looking frames to date**: a **minimalist lightning-themed frame** designed specifically for high-tier spenders.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-16.png)

If you’re a dedicated player, a style connoisseur, or just someone who likes to flex a bit of flair around their castle, **this frame might just be your new favorite**—if you qualify for it.

***Many players have been sending me DMs and asking me on Discord how to get this frame. Therefore, I have written this guide! Enjoy.***

---

## What Is the Lightning Frame?

This newly released frame is a **visually sleek, low-profile border** that pulses subtly with a **clean lightning effect**. Unlike some previous frames that leaned heavily into ornamental and bulky effects, this one is understated—**which is exactly why it looks so good**.

It doesn’t scream for attention with oversized art or gaudy colors. Instead, it gives off a high-class, sharp aesthetic—a kind of “you know if you know” vibe that veteran players tend to appreciate.

---

## How to Get the Frame

Now here’s the catch: **this frame is not available in-game by default**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-17.png)

### Requirements:

- You must have spent **at least $2,000 USD total** on Infinity Kingdom (accumulated over time—not all at once).
- This is **not automatically added** to your account.
- If you are below 2K, sorry!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-19.png)

- If you are above 2K, congratulations they will send!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-20.png)

### How to Claim It:

1. **Join the Official Infinity Kingdom Discord.**
2. Navigate to the **VIP Support** or **Spending Support** channel.
3. Open a support ticket and provide your player ID and server info.
4. Request the frame and wait for confirmation from the VIP support team.

Once approved, the frame should be **manually added to your cosmetics**—usually within a few hours.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/image-18-1024x471.png)

> 💡 *Pro Tip:* If you’re unsure whether you meet the spend threshold, you can still open a ticket and ask. The support team can confirm your total spending amount discreetly.

---

## Why This Frame Matters (Even If It's Cosmetic)

While this frame doesn’t impact gameplay directly, appearances do matter in Infinity Kingdom—especially in competitive kingdoms, alliances, and PvP arenas. A unique frame is often a **badge of experience, commitment, and prestige**. In this case, it’s also a symbol of:

- Long-term player loyalty.
- Contribution to supporting game development.
- Quiet flex: You’re a veteran, and the frame says so without shouting it.

It’s also perfect for players who don’t want over-the-top effects but still want something that **sets them apart from the crowd**.

***Most of all though, its just simply the prettiest frame in my opinion!***

---

## Final Thoughts

The new lightning-themed spender frame is, without question, one of the most **aesthetically refined frames** in the game. It’s sleek, subtle, and signals elite veteran status without being obnoxious.

If you’ve put in the time—and let’s be honest, the money—**make sure you claim your reward**. Many long-term spenders don’t even know this frame exists because it isn’t promoted heavily in-game.

So if you’re already supporting Infinity Kingdom at a high level, **hit up VIP Support and add this beauty to your collection**. You’ve earned it.

**Skill Analysis:** Spell Disintegration is a formidable skill that inflicts substantial magic damage and applies a debuff increasing the magical damage taken by the enemy. This makes it an essential skill for any player focusing on magic damage in their builds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-130.png)

- **High Damage Output:** The skill's primary feature is its ability to deal high magic damage, making it a game-changer in battles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-129-1024x307.png)

- **With Proc Skills:** The skill's frequent activation makes it synergize well with skills like Energy Burst and Chase, maximizing damage output.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-131-1024x617.png)

### Strategic Usage:

- **Mage Builds:** Incorporate it into mage-focused teams to maximize magic damage output.
- **Support Roles:** Use it on support immortals not just for damage but for the strategic application of debuffs in battles.
- **Balancing Teams:** Combine it with immortals and skills that complement its strengths and mitigate any team vulnerabilities.

**Conclusion:** The Spell Disintegration bundle is a highly advantageous deal for Infinity Kingdom players. Its cost-effectiveness, coupled with the skill's potent damage-dealing and debuffing capabilities, makes it an attractive addition to a wide range of builds. Whether used on a mage for direct damage or a support for strategic debuffing, Spell Disintegration can significantly enhance your battle effectiveness in the game. This bundle is a must-have for players looking to elevate their magic damage strategies.

**Note:** Always consider your current lineup and strategy when integrating new skills to ensure the best synergy and overall team performance.

title: Spender event during October 2025 on the Gtarcade App
summary: Gtarcade launched a new spender promo on the Gtarcade App for Infinity Kingdom. The title says “First Purchase Event,” but there are actually two parts running together in October:
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-9.png)

Gtarcade launched a new spender promo on the **Gtarcade App** for Infinity Kingdom. The title says **“First Purchase Event,”** but there are actually two parts running together in October:

1. a **First Purchase Reward**, and
2. a **Milestone Purchase Gift** that stacks as you spend more.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-10-461x1024.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-11-461x1024.png)

**Event window:** live now, ends **October 30, 2025**.
**Where to buy:** **Gtarcade App** specifically (not other platforms or the in-game shop). The App usually gives better value anyway; this just stacks extra rewards on top.

---

## 1) First Purchase Reward

On your **first** Gtarcade App purchase in October, you get:

- **60× William I fragments** *(Fire)* — Great in **Season 1** while you’re ramping. If you’re doing early Fire (which I still recommend for F2P/low spenders), he pairs with **Hippolyta**, then later **Empress Wu** and **Cyrus (or Qin)**. He’ll do work until you pivot into **Trajan** once **Golden Path** unlocks.
**OR** if you’re past the William phase, take **6,000 Soul Crystals**—still excellent value.
- Plus: **100 Gems**, **9 Philosopher’s Stones**, **3× Medium SP**, **3× Medium AP**, **100 VIP Points**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-12-1024x572.png)

**How it triggers:** make **any** first purchase in the App (the purchased item is instant; the bonus usually shows up after ~**1 hour**).
**Example:** buy a **$1 voucher**—you get the voucher **and** this whole First Purchase Reward.
**Tip:** if you buy **daily Pearl Bundles**, look for **voucher + AP** deals in the App to stack value.

---

## 2) Milestone Purchase Gift (October duration)

Tracks your **cumulative** spend through the App in October. Hit a threshold and you unlock that tier—**and you keep everything from all lower tiers** as you climb.

### Milestone Rewards Table

> Notes:
> – $5–$50 tiers give **Random Immortal Fragments** + **Artifact Selection Schematic Fragments** (not unique artifacts).
> – $99+ tiers switch to **Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments** and **Holy/Shadow Selection Artifact Fragments**, and add **Eternal dragon Soul chests** *(each chest contains **10** dragon crystals for **Shadow or Holy** dragon)*.

| Threshold | Immortal Fragments | Artifact Fragments | Gems | Eternal dragon Soul chests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $5 | 8 Random | 8 Selection (non-unique) | 520 | — |
| $10 | 12 Random | 12 Selection (non-unique) | 1,100 | — |
| $20 | 16 Random | 16 Selection (non-unique) | 2,300 | — |
| $50 | 24 Random | 24 Selection (non-unique) | 6,000 | — |
| $99 | 8 Random Holy/Shadow | 8 Holy/Shadow Selection | 12,500 | 20 |
| $198 | 14 Random Holy/Shadow | 14 Holy/Shadow Selection | 25,000 | 40 |
| $297 | 24 Random Holy/Shadow | 24 Holy/Shadow Selection | 37,500 | 60 |
| $396 | 32 Random Holy/Shadow | 32 Holy/Shadow Selection | 50,000 | 80 |
| $495 | 42 Random Holy/Shadow | 42 Holy/Shadow Selection | 62,500 | 100 |

> **Cumulative:** You receive **all** lower-tier rewards once you pass each threshold.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-13-461x1024.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-14-461x1024.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-15-461x1024.png)

---

## Total Rewards if You Go to the Full $500 (the $495 tier)

**From the Milestone event alone** (First Purchase Reward is separate):

- **Normal Immortal Fragments:** **60** total (8+12+16+24)
- **Normal Artifact Selection Fragments:** **60** total
- **Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments:** **120** total (8+14+24+32+42)
- **Holy/Shadow Artifact Selection Fragments:** **120** total
- **Eternal dragon Soul chests:** **300** total → **3,000 dragon crystals** (10 per chest) for **Shadow/Holy**
- **Gems:** **197,420** total

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-17-893x1024.png)

That’s a chunky stack, and it’s **in addition to** your **First Purchase Reward** (William or 6,000 Soul Crystals + goodies).

---

## Player Perspective (quick take)

If you’re **early/mid game**, the lower tiers help immediately—random frags and artifact picks you can use right away, plus a huge gem injection to speed up account growth.
If you’re **mid to late game**, you’re mainly here for the **Holy/Shadow** fragments and the **Eternal dragon Soul chests**—nice push for dragon progress without touching the in-game store.

I still wouldn’t spend **just** for milestones, but if you’re buying anyway, **do it through the App this month**. App pricing already beats in-game; these milestones are free value on top.

---

## All in all

Solid October promo. Clean First Purchase value for starters (or 6,000 SC if you’ve moved on), then cumulative Milestone tiers that ramp into Holy/Shadow progress and dragon crystals. Bottom line: if you’re spending, push it through the Gtarcade App in October to squeeze max value.

**Check back in November to see if they renew the event with new versions of these rewards, to be seen in November 2025, but I expect them to continue.**

---

## New to Gtarcade? See more below

### Player Perspective, i.e. what I will do:

- Grab the **free bundle immediately** (Philosopher’s Stones are always high value).
- Spend the 100 points on the **Moonlit Hearth skin** — not because the buff is good, but because it’s so cheap and it adds to my collection of skins. Its cute and passing it up seems a wasted opportunity given the incredibly low cost.

---

### What if my Account is not bound to a Gtarcade account?

First of all, I recommend that you fix that immediately. Simply the risk of account deletion, forgetting the password, loosing your phone, etc. is more than enough risk to make Gtarcade Account Binding an important step for you. **[If this is relevant for you, read more here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/accounts/gtarcade/linking-your-account/).**

### How to acces the Gtarcade App?

Using the Desktop app you find the giftpacks under “Point Shop” as you open the Gtarcade app as you would normally when starting the game. If you do not have the app, **[download available here.](https://clientweb.gtarcade.com/download/download.html)**

On Mobile, you can download the App via your preferred App Store or access directly using the in-game shop which has a link at the top. See more below.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Screenrecorder-2025-10-01-13-42-06-722.mp4)

title: Spending Strategy Guide: Shadow Immortals vs Legendary Skills vs Chaos Immortals
summary: At some point every mid-to-large spender in Infinity Kingdom reaches the same dilemma: where should the next major investment go?
categoryPath: tips and tricks for newer players
markdown:
## Introduction

At some point every mid-to-large spender in **Infinity Kingdom** reaches the same dilemma: where should the next major investment go?

The three main options competing for resources are:

- **Shadow Immortals**
- **Legendary (Red) Skills**
- **Chaos Immortals**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-210.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-1024x691.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-158.png)

At first glance the answer seems obvious. Many players see top opponents running Chaos immortals and assume that the strongest path is to unlock those immortals first and then build skills afterward. In practice, that assumption leads many players into inefficient spending.

The reality is that **skills usually provide far more power per dollar than new immortals**. A well-built elemental march with strong legendary skills can defeat many Chaos-based marches, especially when the skill combinations are optimized.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-1-1024x394.png)

Understanding this principle makes a significant difference when planning long-term account progression.

---

## The Core Spending Principle

A Chaos immortal may look impressive because of its ultimate ability, but the real performance of a march usually comes from:

- Skill synergy
- Damage amplification
- Sustain mechanics
- Control effects

Because of this, replacing a normal Epic or Epic+ skill with a **legendary skill** often produces a **much larger combat impact** than replacing one immortal with a Chaos Immortal.

This is why many experienced players recommend prioritizing legendary skills before chasing Chaos immortals.

---

## Why Legendary Skills Should Come First

Legendary skills offer several advantages that make them the best first investment for most mid-to-large spenders.

### 1. Immediate Power Increase

Replacing a standard skill with a legendary skill is often a massive upgrade. Damage modifiers, healing amplification, and control effects can dramatically change the outcome of battles.

For example:

- **Alexander + Knife Through Butter** dramatically increases damage output and enables an Alex in a simple Qin-Zeno build to hard counter hyper regen builds with chaos immortals and even ones with chaos immortals and legendary skills! The skills and skill synergy in build matter far more than immortal rarity.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-2-1024x666.png)

- Strong legendary skill combinations can turn traditional elemental marches into serious threats even against Chaos compositions.

In many cases, improving the skill setup of a march creates more power than adding a new immortal.

---

### 2. Long-Term Flexibility

Legendary skills are not tied to a single immortal.

They can be:

- Moved between immortals
- Tested in different march compositions
- Reused when you change builds later

This flexibility means legendary skills rarely become wasted investments.

---

### 3. Strong Elemental Marches Can Beat Chaos

A common misconception is that Chaos immortals automatically outperform elemental setups.

In practice, **a well-built elemental march with legendary skills can absolutely defeat Chaos setups**.

Many players running optimized skill combinations on traditional elemental immortals perform extremely well in PvP.

For detailed examples of these compositions, see the various **elemental build guides** on the wiki.

---

## The Role of Shadow Immortals

Shadow immortals sit in a middle ground between legendary skills and Chaos investments.

When **Sparks of Galaxy** existed, shadow immortals were extremely expensive and largely reserved for very high spenders.

After the removal of that system, many players assumed shadow immortals would remain prohibitively expensive. However, the **Rune Factory changes** have made them noticeably more accessible than the first version of Rune Factory.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-210.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/image-3-1024x567.png)

Even so, shadow immortals should still be evaluated carefully.

A powerful skill upgrade can often provide more value than adding another premium immortal. That being said, a defensive mage build will require you to build out a Himiko. Thus make your decision as to what to main carefully. Make sure you are ready for the cost of a Himiko on top of skills before you go down that road. If you are not - do another build and prioritize top tier legendary skills (see build guides for plenty examples).

For instance:

- An **Alexander march with Knife Through Butter** frequently provides more performance improvement than replacing an immortal with a shadow unit.
- Many high-performing players are currently running **Khan Earth builds** instead of the classic **Himiko Earth build**, with excellent results.
- I am personally using Baldwin-Fire hybrid to beat chaos and meta Himiko and Khan builds.

These examples illustrate an important point: **march strength comes from legendary skills, skill- and build synergy, not simply rarity of immortals.**

---

## When Chaos Immortals Become Worthwhile

Chaos immortals are best viewed as a **late-stage investment**.

They become more valuable when:

- Your march already has strong legendary skills
- Your core elemental setups are optimized
- Additional skill upgrades provide diminishing returns

At that point, Chaos immortals can offer unique mechanics and specialized roles that enhance advanced builds.

However, unlocking a Chaos immortal is only the beginning. Their real performance depends on further investments such as:

- Specialization
- Artifact upgrades
- Dust levels

Because of this, Chaos immortals represent a **long-term progression path rather than an early upgrade target**.

---

## Player Perspective

After years of testing different setups across multiple seasons, one pattern becomes very clear.

The players who rush Chaos immortals often end up with impressive-looking marches that perform inconsistently because their skill setups are weak. Meanwhile, players who focus on strong skill combinations frequently outperform them using standard elemental immortals.

For example, a properly built elemental lineup using legendary skills can reliably challenge Chaos compositions, especially when the matchup and synergy are favorable.

In other words, **the strength of the build matters far more than the rarity of the immortal.**

---

## Conclusion Summary

When deciding where to invest resources, most mid-to-large spenders should prioritize upgrades in the following order:

1. **Legendary (Red) Skills**
2. **Shadow Immortals**
3. **Chaos Immortals**

Legendary skills provide the most efficient power increase because they strengthen the entire march and remain useful across many builds.

Chaos immortals are powerful but require extensive additional investment, making them better suited for late-stage progression.

Players who focus first on **building strong skill combinations** will usually see far better performance than those who chase new immortals too early.

---

title: Spider round 12 begin! New event update
summary: Announcing the Revamped Cross-Server Spider Competition in Infinity Kingdom!
markdown:
***Announcing the Revamped Cross-Server Spider Competition in Infinity Kingdom!***

Attention, Lords and Ladies of Infinity Kingdom! Get ready to embark on a thrilling new chapter in one of our most beloved events—the Cross-Server Spider Competition! After eleven intense seasons, we're shaking things up to bring you an even more exciting and competitive experience.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-9.png)

## What's New?

This time around, we're introducing **four distinct brackets** based on your march's Strategic Troop Power (STP). This innovative change aims to level the playing field, ensuring that battles are matched more fairly and focus on player strategies and builds. Say goodbye to the days of David versus Goliath matchups and hello to competitions where tactics truly shine!

### Bracket Breakdown:

- **Bracket A:** 500K+ STP
- **Bracket B:** 400K-500K STP
- **Bracket C:** 300K-400K STP
- **Bracket D:** 0-300K STP

Your placement in these brackets will be determined by your march's STP, verified through screenshots submitted via our official submissions channel.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-10-1024x542.png)

## Exciting Rewards Await!

Competing in these brackets not only brings glory but also gems! Here's what's up for grabs in each bracket:

- **1st Place:** 1200 gems
- **2nd Place:** 800 gems
- **3rd Place:** 500 gems
- **4th & 5th Places:** 300 gems each
- **6th - 10th Places:** 100 gems each

**And for our aspiring conquerors below level 100, a special lower bracket ensures everyone gets a slice of the action:**

- **1st Place:** 500 gems
- **2nd**: 300 gems
- **3rd - 5th Places:** 200 gems each

### Important to Note:

For this inaugural revamped competition, players are allowed to compete in **one bracket only**. Keep your eyes peeled, though, as this may evolve in future competitions.

**Mark Your Calendars!**

The 12th round of the Spider Competition kicks off on **Sunday, 17th of March at 00:01 UTC**, running through to the **28st of March at 23:59 UTC**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-59-1024x558.png)

## How to Join?

Ready to prove your might and strategy? Participation is easy! Simply head over to the **official Infinity Kingdom Discord** to submit your entry and stay updated on all competition-related announcements.

### Infinity Kingdom Discord - Spider Event Submissions

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/image-13.png)

This reimagined Cross-Server Spider Competition is more than just an event; it's a testament to our commitment to continuously improving your gameplay experience. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a budding strategist, this competition has something for everyone. So, sharpen your swords, strategize your builds, and may the best lord or lady win!

title: Spring Fiesta 2023
summary: Spring is upon us in the world of Infinity Kingdom! In this guide we are going to have a look at the Spring Fiesta event and the rewards. What we need to watch out for and what you should prioritize doing for this years…
markdown:
Spring is upon us in the world of Infinity Kingdom! In this guide we are going to have a look at the Spring Fiesta event and the rewards. What we need to watch out for and what you should prioritize doing for this years event!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Spring-Fiesta-1024x576.jpeg)

## Rewards

So this year, we are getting a pretty mediocer event for Spring Fiesta. We are not getting the discounts that we are used to from these events (especially compared to the awesome Christmas Winter Festival event) but on the other hand we do get awesome free hidden rewards.

**First of all, you are able to get Attila, Saladin, El Cid or Alexander.** Spending 35 Silver Lotus'.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-59-1024x294.png)

Secondly, you can get a **unique artifact** for your brand new Immortal for 100 Silver Lotus'.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-58-1024x321.png)

Third, if you are in need of **dragon crystals**, there are a few in there for not much cost, likewise, there are a few **purple crystals** to be earned.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-60.png)

Fourth and last, you have the usual cosmetic stuff. Getting the **Nameplate**, **Chatbox**and **Profile Frame** costs you a few Lotus'.

This years **Spring Profusion castle skin** will cost you 100 Spring Lotus', but more importantly, it is the same box as the unique which means you are unable to get both unique artifact and event skin this time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-58-1024x321.png)

## How does it work?

In order to unlock the good rewards for this event, you need some Spring Lotus'!

**These are available in the Shop to be purchased spending real fiat currency**. In addition to the event currency Spring Lotus' you get quite awesome rewards from these bundles. Namely, **Dragon Essences** and a bunch of gems.

**The bundles have 1 stock for the entire event, meaning you have to be careful what you spend on.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-63.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-62.png)

The bundles offer quite a lot of Dragon Essences at a standard price compared to the monthly bundles. As such, if you are looking to max out some dragon talents quickly then this event is an excellent opportunity to do that. However, you will not get the holy or shadow dragon crystals that we are used to from the monthly bundles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-64.png)

## The full event shop is as follows (one time purchases)

| Price | Lotus | Dragon Essence | Epic Immortal Spirit Chest (Purple Crystals) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4.99$ | 5 | 1 |  |
| 9.99$ | 15 | 2 |  |
| 19.99$ | 30 | 3 |  |
| 49.99$ | 40 |  | 10 |
| 99.99$ | 60 |  | 15 |
| 174.96$ | 150 | 6 | 25 |

## Cost of main rewards

**So what does the big juicy rewards cost?**On the face of it, it seems you are forced to purchase all bundles to get these rewards. Getting the 100 Lotus' you need to get all bundles. Buying all other bundles than the last big 99.99$ one only gets you 90 Lotus' as such, you are unable to get the **skin or unique artifact** without purchasing the entire event shop. If you do, you have 150 Lotus' and can get skin/unique artifact + immortal unlock and a single dragon crystal box or some cosmetics.

**Alternatively**, you can be a bit more **efficient**about it and spend 3,500 gems AND making sure you complete the entire**Spring Color's side event**. This in itself it pretty time consuming and spending the gems does mean you can skip on the last big box but it still costs you 85$ and 3,500 gems to obtain the unique Immortal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-67-1024x607.png)

If you are only looking to **unlock one of the** **Immortals**, you will need to spend 35 bucks to get the first three bundles and 60 lotus' meaning you have 25 unspent lotus's you can use on dragon crystals and/or cosmetics.

**Alternatively**, you can also complete the **Spring Colors Side**event thus reducing your spend to only 15$ and 3,500 gems. This is the most value you will get from the standard rewards of this event. **15$ and a few gems is good price for 60x Immortal Fragments for one of the four pay-wall Immortals.**

**All in all the bundle structure for this event is not very good and makes it hard to purchase anything very efficiently.**

## Good news! Loki for free

Despite the lackluster event reward costs of this event, there is one hidden treat in here for us. Loki!

Our favorite Chaos Immortal is hiding in the Rainy Spring tab of the event. By unlocking all five will get you a **total of 40 Loki Fragments, simply by completing the daily quests** that release as the event progresses. This is massive reward as Loki is currently the most expensive Immortal of all Infinity Kingdom. **All players should pay careful attention to this and make sure you complete all of the quests this year!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-65-1024x282.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-66-1024x280.png)

## More free rewards

This event offers some pretty good free-to-play rewards, they are very easy to get and you get decent value if you like most players need Purple Crystals and speedups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-68.png)

title: Spring Fiesta 2024
summary: Hey there! The Spring Fiesta 2024 in Infinity Kingdom is upon us, and it's packed with familiar sub-events that we've come to know and love. Let's dive into what this season has in store for us.
markdown:
Hey there! The Spring Fiesta 2024 in Infinity Kingdom is upon us, and it's packed with familiar sub-events that we've come to know and love. Let's dive into what this season has in store for us.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-109-1024x576.png)

### Rewards Tab Highlights

- **Free Tier**: You can grab a full 60 fragments of Immortal selection chests for big names like Attila, Saladin, El Cid, or Alexander. Plus, up to 100 Stardust!
- **Spender Tier**: For 30 Lotus, grab a full schematic for almost any Immortal's Unique Artifact. And 60x Shadow or Holy Immortal fragments for just 75 Lotus - that's a steal!
- **Fate of Chaos Selection Chests**: Available for 75 Lotus, meaning 80 Chaos Fragments for just $20 if you play your cards right.

## The event in detail

### Rainy Spring

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-95-1024x575.png)

There are the usual categories of sub-events that we are used to with these seasonals. They are all very similar. For this one, we have the typical daily quests to be completed. Completing the Rainy Spring quests and getting the final reward chest will get you the main reward from this event: 40 free Chaos Immortal selection chests, **here you can choose the chaos immortal you want and get 40x fragments.** Very very nice and free! In addition you will get 10 silver lotus' and some stardust, gems and other stuff from the quests. Make sure to complete this event tab during Spring Fiesta 2024.

### Spring Fiesta

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-96-1024x585.png)

The second event tab is the standard 'send your immortals on expeditions' mini-game. Here you simply send out your immortal all day and complete the event to earn a 10 more locus and a bit of side rewards. Not bad but also not very impressive. The Lotus are going to be important though!

### Gnomes and Farming Resources

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-97-1024x636.png)

For the third event tab, you got the usual: Kill gnomes and farm resources to earn free-to-play currency and buy decent rewards. Just keep playing the game, send out gnome raids and harvest your resources and nodes.

### Spring Colors

![Billede](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1095780688894103674/1196848666841981079/image.png?ex=65b91f2e&is=65a6aa2e&hm=d17e87b49c3b221bfbbd04b924dafb1f50e08ea4d4c79ece5b55333d69542b80&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=705&height=394)

The fourth event tab is the Spring Colors, again one of the usual suspects in terms of mechanics. You spend the water currency you have earned duing daily quests in the Rainy Spring (tab 1) to complete the 20 levels. The cost will increase continuously, but worry not. Just do your daily quests like you would anyway for chaos fragments and you will complete this event.

The important thing to note here are the Lotus. This is the main source of cheap Lotus currency for this years event. We get 2 in the free tier, 10 in the 2500 gem tier and a whopping 45 from the 20$ tier. Very good value! Comparitively you get only 10 Lotus spending 20$ on the Spring Fiesta bundles. So make sure you complete this event and buy the 20$ tier if you are looking for the main rewards from this years event!

### Bundles:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-108-1024x518.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-107.png)

### Rewards in more detail

The rewards tab: Here you redeem event currency for big rewards. Let's look at the highlights here. First up, for **FREE**you can farm and buy a full 60 fragments of Immortal selection chests for Attila, Saladin, El Cid or Alexander. A free full Immortal unlock (i.e. 60x fragments). Moreover, you can farm your way to a whopping 100 Stardust!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-100.png)

In the spender tier we have the Lotus rewards. For 30 Lotus you can get a full schematic for basically any of your Immortal's Unique Artifact. They are almost all in there and 30 Lotus, quit cheap! You can get that in the 20$ tier alone! Insane.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-101.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-102.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-103.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-104.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-105.png)

Moreover, you can buy 60x Shadow or Holy Immortal fragments for just 75 Lotus. Not too bad and quite cheap! With the 45 from the 20$ event tier, 10 from the 2500 gem tier, 10 from the Spring Fiesta, 10 from the Rainy Spring you are home safe! Just 20$ and you can get a full Holy or Shadow Immortal, insane value!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-98.png)

Lastly, we have **40x Fate of Chaos selection chests also on sale for just 75 Lotus.**This means that you can get 40x Chaos fragments on top of the 40 from Rainy Spring netting you 80 Chaos Fragments for just 20$ if you spend Lotus only on this. Incredible for all of us who are done with Holy but still need more Chaos fragments. **HUGE value, in fact this is the most value I have ever seen in any event.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-99-1024x586.png)

Spring Fiesta 2024 is an easy-going, rewarding event with realistic objectives and doesn't demand overspending. There's a generous sprinkle of gems and Stardust as rewards. The 75 Silver Lotus mark for buying chaos or holy/shadow immortal is easily achievable with diligence in tasks. It's a thumbs up from me, a fun and fruitful event, and definitely worth diving into!
