markdown:
### Player Guide: Maximizing the "Spring of Life" Skill in Infinity Kingdom

"Spring of Life" stands out as a top-tier skill in Infinity Kingdom, especially effective in sustain-focused setups. Its dual benefits of enhancing healing received and providing damage mitigation make it a crucial skill for maintaining high troop counts and enhancing overall battlefield endurance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-99-1024x611.png)

## Capabilities of Spring of Life

"Spring of Life" is an aura skill that significantly bolsters the resilience of your troops by:

- **Increasing Healing Received**: All friendly units benefit from a 25% increase in healing received, which can be pivotal in prolonged engagements.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-102-1024x603.png)

- **Damage Mitigation Buff**: After receiving healing, units gain a 15% reduction in damage taken for 3 seconds. This not only boosts survival but also ensures that your immortals can withstand high bursts of enemy damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-101-1024x487.png)

## Strategic Deployment of Spring of Life

### Ideal Setups

To maximize the effectiveness of "Spring of Life," integrate it into lineups that naturally include healing capabilities. Immortals such as Theodora, Zenobia, and Fu Fei, known for their strong healing outputs, are perfect candidates for this skill. The synergy between their healing abilities and the "Spring of Life" ensures that your troops not only recover faster but also become tougher to take down.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/image-98.png)

### Skill Synergy

- **Combination with Purification**: Pairing "Spring of Life" with skills like Purification, which provides periodic healing ticks, can optimize the frequency of the damage mitigation buff. This combination ensures that your immortals consistently benefit from both enhanced healing and reduced damage intake.
- **Use with Other Healing Modifiers**: Consider using "Spring of Life" alongside other skills or items that boost healing effectiveness or frequency. This can turn your formation into a highly resilient force capable of sustaining through most of the damage that enemy formations can output.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Tactical Considerations

- **High Uptime on Damage Mitigation**: Aim to maintain as high an uptime as possible on the damage mitigation buff by ensuring regular healing. The more frequently your troops are healed, the more consistently they will benefit from reduced damage, which can be decisive in tight battles.
- **Counter to High-Damage Setups**: "Spring of Life" is particularly effective against enemy setups that rely on high bursts of damage. By increasing healing received and continuously activating the damage mitigation buff, you can effectively blunt the enemy's offensive spikes.

## Conclusion

"Spring of Life" is an invaluable skill in any healer’s toolkit within Infinity Kingdom, providing crucial benefits that can turn the tide of battle in sustain-heavy or healer-centric lineups. By strategically pairing this skill with the right immortals and complementary skills, you can create a nearly indomitable formation that thrives under pressure and sustains through the toughest battles. Whether used in defensive stances or as part of a balanced strategy, "Spring of Life" ensures your forces remain fighting fit throughout the fray.

title: Squad Survival: A New Era in Infinity Kingdom
summary: Hey, have you heard about the new game mode, Squad Survival, that’s coming to the conquest servers in Infinity Kingdom? This is going to be a game-changer, and I can’t wait to try it out! It’s not just another addition…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-26-1024x566.png)

Hey, have you heard about the new game mode, Squad Survival, that’s coming to the conquest servers in Infinity Kingdom? This is going to be a game-changer, and I can’t wait to try it out! It’s not just another addition; it’s a fresh, adrenaline-pumping battleground that brings a whole new level of excitement. If you’ve been around for features like Illusion Battlegrounds or Prime League, you know how much those spiced things up. Now, get ready for a true king-of-the-hill experience. Let me break it down for you!

This is a huge deal, we are getting a brand new battleground and new game within Infinity Kingdom. In the past, additions like Illusions Battlegrounds and Prime League and others have proven hugely succesful and given the game a lot of energy and drive - particularly for older players who has been playing the games current contents for years. Thus it's awesome to see that the developers keep making new additions to the game, and even better, they are adding new awesome gamemodes inspired by the best games out there. Introducing, a true king of the hill battlegrounds: Squad Survival! Awesome! Let's have a look at what we know so far.

With the news article from the 27th of december, we can learn a lot about this new battle royale format battleground.

Read the official news article here: [https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7021798.html](https://infinitykingdom.gtarcade.com/en/news/7021798.html)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-27-1024x412.png)

## Overview of Squad Survival

First off, Squad Survival is a ranked player-versus-player battleground that’s introducing a battle royale-style gameplay. Think of games like PUBG or Warzone, but with our favorite Infinity Kingdom twist. Brand new player versus player ranked battlegrounds where players will be ranked and rewarded based on the **highest single-match score**. The battles last three days and a total of 6 matches, squads can choose to participate in just a single battle or more up to six.

### Key Points:

- Players are ranked and rewarded based on their highest single-match score.
- Tournaments span three days with six matches total.
- Flexibility to participate in one or multiple matches.

## Squad Setup Phase

The setup phase is where you build your squad. You can team up with your friends to create your dream squad, or if you’re flying solo, the in-game matchmaking system has you covered.

Each squad consists of 1-3 members and squad leaders may freely adjust the members and setting during the team-up phase. Once the battle stages begin, your squad will be locked in as the battlegrounds begin.

There will be two battlefield skills to choose from, I expect these to work like the IBL skills we are used to and most likely you want to strategize in your squad who chooses what.

In battle you are going to be using your own immortals and dragons and tok skills but will have a fixed troop count for this game mode, akin to Illusion Battlegrounds.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-28-1024x522.png)

### Key Points:

- Squads consist of 1-3 members.
- Squad leaders control team adjustments during setup.
- Squads are locked once battles begin.

## Dynamic Gameplay Mechanics

Now, the actual gameplay—this is where things get spicy. When the match begins, you and your squad spawn together on the map. The battlefield is dynamic, with zones that shift over time.

**There are no bubbles / castle shields in this gamemode and no bloody rage effects. Furthermore, there are no teleports of any kind, instead relocation speed is greatly increased and cooldown is just 1 minute.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-34-1024x405.png)

### Zone Breakdown:

- **Green Zones:** Safe areas.
- **Purple Zones:** Danger areas that will soon be flooded.
- **Dark Zones:** Lava-filled areas causing rapid prosperity loss.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-29-1024x188.png)

If your prosperity hits zero, you’re “downed,” and your squadmates must rescue you by restoring a bit of prosperity. If the whole squad is eliminated, it’s game over.

Basically, it is a King of the Hill styled battleground, think of PUBG or Warzone. Players of a squad spawn close to each other at random on the map and the map will gradually shrink as lava floods the map killing anyone in the lava through a gradual prosperity loss. There are three different zones on the map, green safe zones, purple areas are areas that are safe for now but will soon be flooded in lava and dark zones where your castle rapidly lose prosperity from the lava floods.
If you are reduced to 0 prosperity through lava or combat, you are "downed" meaning you will be eliminated if not rescued fast. Your team members can send troops to you and rescue you, giving you back a bit of prosperity to escape certain death. If you are not rescued you are eliminated. If all squad members are eliminated your squad is out of the game. Last ones to stay alive wins. You cannot replenish prosperity using gems while in this gamemode.

### Key Points:

- Shrinking battlefield due to lava adds strategic pressure.
- No shields, bloody rage effects, or teleports.
- Faster relocation speeds with a one-minute cooldown.
- Rescue "downed" team members before they are eliminated!

## Boost Nodes and Strategy

Another cool feature is the boost nodes scattered across the map. These structures grant your squad special bonuses like increased attack, defense, or healing. **Your squad can occupy multiple structures and the boosts will stack.** I expect this to be key in strategies to win the game by getting advantages.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-30-1024x331.png)

### Key Points:

- Occupying nodes grants stackable boosts.
- Strategic decisions are vital—go for nodes, survival, or combat.

## Battle Duration and Scoring

Each battle lasts for maximum 30 minutes or until only one squad remain. If multiple squads are left at the 30 min. mark, their "squad Points" will determine the winner (up to five winners). Squad Points consists of Battlefield Points, i expect these to be earned as if they where honor. You can gain multiple points through winning streaks or by killing enemies with a win-streak bonus active. Survival Points based on the squads survival ranking and time they stay alive.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-32-1024x395.png)

### Squad Points:

- **Battlefield Points:** Earned by defeating enemies and achieving streak bonuses.
- **Survival Points:** Based on how long your squad stays alive.

Battlefield Points are converted into honor for your lord after the battle, capped at 2 million points.

## Reward Structure

There are very good rewards from this game mode: Random Holy/Shadow Immortal fragments, Artifact fragments and healing speedups. Moreover, the rewards structure is very good as it rewards up to 10000 players with ranking rewards, and good rewards for all making it a game mode that anyone should participate in and enjoy. While whale squads will likely win out, there will be very good battles and rewards for all levels of players, this is a huge thing and very important as I think this will drive the event to be a big success. There is nothing worse than good game events where only a very select few can earn rewards. Here we see a ranking mechanic that ensures good battles and a reward structure that offer rewards for everyone. Very good!

### Key Rewards:

- Random Holy and Shadow Immortal fragments.
- Artifact fragments.
- Healing speedups.

The ranking rewards benefit up to 10,000 players, making it accessible and rewarding for all.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-33-1024x568.png)

## Conclusion

So, what do you think? Doesn’t this sound like the most exciting addition to Infinity Kingdom in ages? Squad Survival is bringing the thrill of battle royale to our favorite game, and I’m ready to jump in and see what it’s all about. Let’s get our squads together and make history in this brand-new tournament. See you on the battlefield!

title: Stallar Compass, how does it work and what are the chances of artifact rewards?
summary: The Stellar Compass event is a relatively new Event to grace the Lords of Norheim. It is a very important event for all players because some of the core-unique artifacts of the game can be found here. If you main earth…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-70-1024x325.png)

The Stellar Compass event is a relatively new Event to grace the Lords of Norheim. It is a very important event for all players because some of the core-unique artifacts of the game can be found here. If you main earth you need Alexander's if you main water you need Attila's and so on. These unique artifacts can be extreemly expensive to get and you need 15 uniques to max a single one.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-80-1024x557.png)

**This is a rare opportunity to both get cheap unique artifacts via bundles and also getting FREE unique artifacts if you grind and bank right!**

**This means that free to play players are able to grind and bank Crystal Balls to ensure Unique Artifact rewards.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image-1-1024x741.png)

## Redeem event for F2P crystal balls

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-81-1024x645.png)

This event is a solid way to obtain rewards, much **cheaper for spender than Triss and is also available for Free-To-Play players**since the side-event “**Redeem Event**” offers you **Crystal Balls** rewards by spending event currency farmed killing gnomes, gathering resources, etc.

## Wonderful Journey, more F2P crystal balls

Futhermore, you can obtain a lot of Crystal Balls by completing the Wonderful Journey event that will also be happening at the same time. Here you spend Dice obtained by spending gems and/or purchasing in the shop. **Also a F2P method for obtaining Unique Artifact Fragments.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-82-1024x618.png)

I spent a **total of 80 dice to complete the bonus wheel**. Your experiance may vary, seen as any hits on the jackpot tile make a huge difference. Theoretically, you are 100% sure to max out points by lapping the board 13 times. With 29 tiles to land on and a 6-sided dice, your absolute maximum required number of rolls (without EVER hitting any of the jackpots small of large) is **377**.

### AV = ( (M + 1 )/ 2 ) * N

- Where AV is the average dice value
- M is the max value of all dice
- N is the total number of die

( 6 + 1 )/ 2 ) * 106 = **377**

However, there is a 3.4% chance to hit the big jackpot and a 10.32% chance to hit one of the small ones on every lap. I got a little lucky and spent 80 dice. You could do with fewer or a few more averaging around 80-100 dice to complete event with resonable certainty.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/image-83-1024x577.png)

## Stellar Rewards

In addition to the unique artifact fragments, you are going to be getting a lot of speedups and other very nice resources from farming this event. All in all this is a VERY high value event for most all players in Infinity Kingdom and one you should pay careful attention to. Make sure you grind out the entire free to play Redeem Event every time it comes around, you will be able to get F2P artifacts and speedups very quickly.

Moreover, try to make sure you spend your gems while Spending Rewards and Wonderful Journey events are live. For instance, growing and developing players are going to be spending gems on summoning for Purple Crystals. When you do that you spend a ton of gems and thus you should always do that during a spender-event. That way you get a lot of Dice to be used later in many events. Take note, that Dice are an inventory ressource and as such carry over for the next event.

markdown:
### Player Guide: Fire Setup for Illusion Battlefield Prime League Season 5

Season 5 of the Illusion Battlefield Prime League has just begun, with the first round scheduled to be played this Sunday. As players scramble to set up new builds to gain the upper hand in a leveled playing field, it's essential to have a solid, reliable build that will perform consistently well. In Prime League, there are no spender advantages, so everyone has the same pieces available to them. Success relies on strategy and superior builds.

In this guide, we will focus on a tried and tested fire setup that will always perform well. This build can serve as a reliable baseline while you experiment with other formations to test the waters and attempt to break the meta.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-105-1024x598.png)

## Reliable Fire Setup for Prime League

### Immortal and Skill Configuration

1. **Khan**  - **Skills:** Malice, No Escape, Assist
- **Role:** Khan serves as a frontline damage dealer with the ability to disrupt and debuff the enemy team. The combination of Malice and No Escape increases his survivability while Assist helps redirect damage from key backline immortals.
2. **Empress Wu**  - **Skills:** Death Breath, Annihilation, Concentration
- **Role:** Empress Wu is your primary damage dealer. Death Breath provides significant AoE damage, Annihilation boosts her magical damage, and Concentration amplifies all magical damage dealt, making her a formidable force on the battlefield.
3. **Hippolyta**  - **Skills:** Rage Blessing, Defense Blessing, Adrenaline Rush
- **Role:** Hippolyta plays a dual role of damage and support. Rage Blessing and Defense Blessing enhance the team's overall performance by boosting their attack and defense stats. Adrenaline Rush ensures that her ultimate ability is ready more frequently, keeping the pressure on the enemy.
4. **William**  - **Skills:** Weakness, Oaken Guard, Resist
- **Role:** William serves as the tank and support unit. Weakness debuffs enemy attacks, Oaken Guard boosts his defense, and Resist provides additional resilience, making him hard to take down and allowing him to protect your backline effectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-106-1024x570.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-107-1024x560.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-108-1024x559.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-109-1024x560.png)

### Optional Variations

You can adjust this setup by swapping out William for other immortals like Ashoka and Attila to introduce more control into your build. Multiple variations of this fire setup work well, but sticking to the outlined configuration will ensure a strong, reliable performance.

- **Full Fire Setup:** Use Ashoka to complement the fire synergy, enhancing overall damage output and providing a consistent theme to your team.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-111-1024x374.png)

- **Control Variation:** Replace William with Attila to introduce more control elements, disrupting enemy formations and providing additional utility.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-110-1024x305.png)

## Conclusion

The fire setup outlined in this guide is a solid, reliable build that will perform consistently well in the Illusion Battlefield Prime League. Use this build as a baseline while experimenting with other formations to find the best combination for your team. Remember, the key to success in Prime League is adaptability and strategy, so be ready to adjust and innovate as the season progresses.

Good luck, and may your battles be victorious!

This guide is part of my article series on fire builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the shadow build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

**This article is on a standard shadow main build in the 2.2 meta. The build is a well balanced nuke setup, well equiped for the current meta. Shadow is a very complete element, which offers both strong sustain, insane burst damage, high sustained damage and the best control in the game. It is in my oppinion the absolute best element in the game, not even rivaled by holy. In fact, toss in Qin or Khan and you can use your shadow to kill holy.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Screenshot_20220722-222656-1024x384.png)

**This build is a big spender build! We are using shadow here, meaing you have to spend quite a lot to ever run this.**

This build performs well against anything. It will even impact holy marches, though you will be defeated by any holy near in power. It is an awesome baseline march that you should default to when running shadow main. When faced with unique encounters, or if you have to countr holy. Swap into a more niche shadow spec (see shadow build page).

**Can be altered to include Khan / Qin (see guide) if you are having issues with holys.**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Screenshot_20220722-220608-1-1024x314.png)

## How does it work?

This setup is pretty standard and revolves around pumping big magic burst damage from Himiko whilst your dragon and Himiko controls the battlefield. After the initial burst, you are ensured to be at higher troop count than your opponent, at which point your Bathony and Siegfried takes it home with high sustained damage.

Bjorn is in my oppinion the weakest link in the build, and can be swapped for other alternatives. e.g. Charles or K-Khan. That being said, Bjorn is a strong Immortal and provides both strong sustain and a nice damage debuff.

## ToK passive setup (main)

This build can both function as a main and as a secondary march. Please see my guide on running this as a secondary march here.

title: Star of Popularity
summary: The Star of Popularity is a limited-time, 10-day cross-server celebration event in Infinity Kingdom where players and servers compete in a gifting war to achieve glory, rare cosmetics, and massive server-wide rewards.…
markdown:
---

The **Star of Popularity** is a limited-time, 10-day **cross-server celebration event** in *Infinity Kingdom* where players and servers compete in a **gifting war** to achieve glory, rare cosmetics, and massive server-wide rewards. It's not just about **who can spend the most**, but **who can organize and strategize most effectively**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-133.png)

This guide will walk you through:

- How the event works
- How to earn and use gift boxes
- Individual vs. server rankings
- Key tips for optimizing rewards
- Free-to-play participation strategies

---

## 📜 Event Overview

- **Duration:** 10 days  - Days 1–9: Active gifting
- Day 10: **Settlement Day** – no gifting allowed
- **Type:** Cross-server, both **individual** and **server-wide** competition
- **Goal:** Accumulate **Popularity Points** by sending or receiving **Rose Gift Boxes**

---

## 🎁 How the Gifting System Works

There are **two ways** to gain **Popularity Points**:

1. **Sending Rose Gift Boxes to another player**  - Increases **that player’s popularity**
- You earn **valuable reward chests** for gifting
2. **Sending Rose Gift Boxes without selecting a player**  - Increases **your own popularity**
- BUT: **You don’t receive rewards** for sending to yourself

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-135.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-134.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-132.png)

💡 **Tip:** Always gift to someone else if you want rewards back—preferably your server’s designated “popularity candidate.”

---

## 🏆 Server Strategy – Why It Matters

This event isn't just about the individual leaderboard—it's also a **server competition**. The **highest-ranked individual player** from each server determines **the server’s ranking**. Based on that rank, **all players level 25+ who participated get server-wide rewards**.

### 🔥 Why Servers Should Focus Their Efforts

- Choose **one main spender** as your server’s ranking candidate
- All other players should **gift to this one player only**
- This maximizes the individual’s rank and secures **the highest possible reward tier** for everyone

💡 **If you gift randomly or to yourself**, you’ll lose out on both **rewards** and **server rank progression**.

---

## 🎟️ How to Get Rose Gift Boxes (And What They’re Worth)

You earn **gift boxes by spending** in-game. The more you spend—and what tier of items you buy—determines **what type of box you get** and **how much popularity** you’re contributing.

| Purchase Tier | Box Type | Popularity Value | Boxes per $ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $5 – $10 items | Standard Gift Box | 1 point | ~1 box per $2 |
| $20 – $49 items | Exquisite Box | 2 points | Unknown |
| $50 – $100 items | Deluxe Gift Box | 3 points | ~10 Deluxe for $50 |

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-138.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-139.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-140.png)

✔ You can **accumulate a lot of points fast** by buying higher-tier bundles, but lower-tier bundles still help.
✔ For $50, you’ll usually get **10 Deluxe Gift Boxes**, equaling **30 popularity points** if sent to another player.

💡 **Efficient Spending Tip:** Mixing in $5 and $10 bundles gives you **more total gift boxes**, which means **more reward chests** back when gifting to the designated player.

---

## 📦 Daily Gift Box Claims – Freebies You Shouldn’t Miss

Even if you’re not spending, you can **claim 10x Deluxe Gift Boxes daily** during the event!

🎁 **Claim these every day!** They include:

- AP bottles
- SP bottles
- Random Immortal Fragments
- Dazzling Summons
- And more

title: Immortal Star Upgrade Costs
summary: In this article we shall dive into the fundamentals of Immortals - their fragments. These fragments are what allow you to unlock the Immortal and are required in abundance in order to upgrade your immortal with…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-35.png)

In this article we shall dive into the fundamentals of Immortals - their fragments. These fragments are what allow you to unlock the Immortal and are required in abundance in order to upgrade your immortal with Star-levels (cap lvl 7).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/image-36-1024x553.png)

These levels are super important, not only because they give the Immortal new power boosts, but most importantly because you unlock 3 passive-slots and an artifact slot on your immortals as you progress through the star-ranks (**[read about artifacts](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/artifacts/)**)

- 1st passive slot requires 3 stars
- 2nd passive slot requires 5 stars
- 3rd passive slot requires 7 stars
- Artifact slot requires 120 fragments AFTER 7th star has been unlocked

## Upgrade Stars - Immortal Fragments Required

The requirements in terms of Fragments to upgrade an Immortal's Star Rank is very different based on the rarity of the Immortal in question. With the added new Quality Chaos (as of patch 2.4 with Loki and Wokung) we now have five tiers of quality.

**Below you will find a table of the required Framents for each star level.**

| Immortal Stars | Uncommon | Rare | Elite | Epic | Chaos |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Summon/unlock | 20 | 30 | 40 | 60 | 80 |
| 1 | 5 | 10 | 20 | 30 | 50 |
| 2 | 10 | 20 | 40 | 60 | 100 |
| 3 | 15 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 150 |
| 4 | 20 | 40 | 80 | 120 | 200 |
| 5 | 25 | 50 | 100 | 150 | 250 |
| 6 | 30 | 60 | 120 | 180 | 300 |
| 7 | 35 | 70 | 140 | 210 | 350 |
| Artifact Slot | 20 | 40 | 80 | 120 | 160 |
| Totals | 180 | 350 | 680 | 1,020 | 1,640 |

## Earning Immortal Fragments

Earning Immortal Fragments can be done is variety of ways. Some Immortals require you to unlock them via the [**in-game store**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/infinity-kingdom-game-updates/in-game-shop-all-the-bundles/all-bundles-available/), some via **[King of the Hill](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/king-of-the-hill/complete-guide-for-all-stages/)**, some can be summoned in the Hall, and others are earned in the **[Lucky Spin](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/lucky-spin-wheel-of-fortune/)** or in **[Theia's Roulette](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/wheels-roulette/holy-shadow-immortals-roulette/)**. You can see many more event guides **[here](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/)**.

After you have unlocked an Immortal, you need to keep earning fragments. This can be done in a platitute of ways:

- **[Gems only Immortals in the Market](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#gems-only-immortals-in-the-market)**
- **[Mysterious Pearl Shop Immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#mysterious-pearl-shop-immortals)**
- **[Lucky Spin / Wheel of Fortune Immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#lucky-spin-immortals)**
- **[Theia’s Roulette Immortals (Holy & Shadow)](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#theia-s-roulette-immortals-holy-shadow)**
- **[Arena Season Immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#arena-season-rewards)**
- **[Contention of Relics Immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#contention-of-relics-immortals)**
- **[Legion of Frostborne (SvS) Immortals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/how-to-get-immortals/#legion-of-frostborne-svs-immortals)**

## Other ways to increase Immortal Power

Immortal's power is dependent on multiple factors:

1. **[Boost level](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/immortal-boost-level-up/)**
2. **[Exp level](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/immortal-boost-level-up/)**
3. **[Star rank](#)**

Moreover, their strength grow as you increase your:

1. **[Soldier tier](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/buildings/tier-upgrade-requirements/)**
2. **[Technology](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/content/)**
3. Honor rank

title: Season 1 Stardust Wheel - actual droprates, pricing of stardust and stardust per pearl
summary: While the in-game Lucky Spin displays theoretical drop rates, any seasoned player knows that actual results can vary significantly in practice. So, how can you know what to expect for your pearls and dollars spent?
markdown:
## Introduction: Why Test Drop Rates?

While the in-game Lucky Spin displays theoretical drop rates, any seasoned player knows that *actual results can vary significantly in practice*. So, how can you know what to expect for your pearls and dollars spent?

That’s exactly what we’ll break down here: **real-world test results from nearly 500 pearls spent**, what kind of **stardust return** you can realistically expect, and why **Season 1 is the best time to invest** in this wheel.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-84-1024x424.png)

---

## Lucky Spin – Stardust Edition: What Makes It Unique?

The Stardust Edition of the Lucky Spin is arguably one of the most generous resource events *Infinity Kingdom* has ever introduced.

Key features:

- Every slot on the wheel contains **Stardust** (season 1).
- **Jackpot prize**: 400x Stardust (0.3% drop chance).
- **Mini jackpot**: 250x stardust (0.4%)
- **Micro jackpot** 200x stardust (0.9%)
- Tons of low-stardust fields (8x per slot, 12.3% each).
- A bonus bar granting additional Stardust every few spins.
- Accessible using **Pearls of Finding**, acquired via event bundles.

Most importantly: **In Season 1, the wheel is *pure stardust***. In later seasons, **chaos portrait items** are added, diluting drop rates considerably—especially for non-chaos players.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-85.png)

---

## The Real Drop Test: 494 Pearls Used

To test actual value, we spun the wheel **494 times** (using Pearls of Finding) and tracked the total **Stardust gained only from wheel drops** (not including bonus bar rewards).

### 🔍 Results:

- **494 Pearls spent**
- **6,714 Stardust gained**
- **Average Stardust per Pearl: 13.59**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-86-1024x301.png)

This is a much more useful figure than the theoretical 0.3% jackpot math—because it gives you a clear expectation when budgeting pearls.

---

## Value Per Dollar: Incredible ROI

Now, let’s translate that into spending efficiency.

### 📦 The Best Bundle: $5 = 18 Pearls

- At 13.59 Stardust/Pearl → **18 Pearls = 244.62 Stardust**
- That’s **49 Stardust per $1 spent**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-89-1024x538.png)

For context: Stardust in the **Marketplace costs 120 Gems per 1 Stardust**. So...

### 💎 Gem Value Comparison:

- 244.62 Stardust × 120 Gems = **29,354 Gems worth**
- For **$5** spent!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-87-1024x493.png)

That’s an **incredible gem-to-dollar conversion**—outclassing nearly every other bundle in the game.

---

## Why Season 1 Players Should Prioritize This Event

This guide and test were conducted on **Season 1 servers**, where the **wheel contains only Stardust**. That means:

- **No chaos items** to dilute drops
- **Maximum average Stardust return**
- **Better long-term value** if you're building non-chaos teams (which most players are in Season 1-3)

In later seasons, chaos portrait upgrade materials (like Crimson Ashes) are added to the wheel. For players not investing in chaos immortals, those drops are **dead slots**, which significantly **lowers your stardust-per-pearl average**.

So if you're in Season 1 and ever considered buying pearls, **now is the time**.

---

## What If I’m In a Chaos-Enabled Server?

Even if you're on a Chaos-enabled server (Season 4+), the wheel still provides **decent value**, though significantly less than in Season 1.

Assuming drop efficiency is halved due to dilution:

- ~6.79 Stardust per Pearl
- 18 Pearls = ~122.31 Stardust
- That’s still **24.46 Stardust per $1 spent**

While not as amazing as Season 1, it's still a viable option—especially during periods of high resource need (e.g., when preparing for immortal portrait upgrades).

---

## Final Thoughts: Test-Proven, Budget-Friendly Stardust

If you’re looking to stockpile Stardust—especially for **portrait upgrades**, **boss builds**, or future events—**this is the most cost-efficient method available**. Testing confirms it.

### TL;DR Summary:

- ✅ 494 pearls = 13.59 Stardust per Pearl
- ✅ $5 bundle gives 244+ Stardust (worth ~29,000 Gems)
- ✅ Best ROI in-game for resource investment
- ✅ Must-do event for Season 1 players before Chaos dilutes the wheel
- ✅ Still useful on Chaos servers, just less efficient

Take advantage of this knowledge—plan your spending wisely, snipe the wheel, and walk away with a mountain of Stardust to power up your Immortals!

title: Stellar Compass event in season 2
summary: The Stellar Compass event is where you can earn artifact fragments, either for elemental selection chests or seasonal unique artifacts. It looks simple at first, but a lot of players get confused about why they see…
markdown:
The **Stellar Compass** event is where you can earn artifact fragments, either for **elemental selection chests** or **seasonal unique artifacts**. It looks simple at first, but a lot of players get confused about why they see different drops — that’s because there are actually **two separate reward sets** in this event, and you control which one you get.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-131-1024x581.png)

This guide explains exactly how it works, how the pity mechanic functions, where to get crystal balls, and how the bundle values compare.

---

### Event Mechanics

There are **two separate drop sets** in Stellar Compass:

- **Elemental Selection Fragments:** Fire, Water, Lightning, Earth, and Wind Immortals
- **Seasonal Selection Chests:** Unique artifacts for **Margret, YSS, Louis, Seondeok, Artemisia, Pakal, Tokugawa, Matilda, Trajan, Cao Cao, Toyotomi, Darius, Mehmed, and Ragnar**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-132-1024x719.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-134-1024x587.png)

You can’t get both at once — it’s one or the other depending on your **reward pool**. Which is nice, because having it mixed would get you just half the rewards you actually are out for! Very good.

If your board shows the wrong set (for example, you want Elemental but see Seasonal), tap **“Reward Refresh.”**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-133.png)

- First refresh: free
- After that: 10 gems per refresh
- Refreshing **resets your board** and any progress, so only do it *before* spinning.

Each board always includes:

- **4 fields** that can drop **15 artifact fragments** each
- **0.8% chance per field** (so 4 × 0.8% = **3.2% total per spin**)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-135.png)

That means every crystal ball gives you about a **3.2% chance** to land on one of those artifact fields.

---

### Pity System

There’s a **pity mechanic** in Stellar Compass:

- After **100 spins without any artifact drop**, you’re guaranteed one.
- The description says your “chance increases” after several misses, but no percentage change is visible.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-136.png)

So practically speaking, expect one artifact drop roughly every **30–35 spins on average**, or **100 spins at worst** (pity hit).

---

### Bundle Pricing

Here’s a full comparison between the **in-game shop** and **GTarcade bundles**.

#### In-Game Shop Bundles

| Bundle | Price | Balls | Balls per $ | Gems | Daily Stock |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | $1 | 4 | 4.0 | 100 | 12 |
| 2 | $5 | 10 | 2.0 | 520 | 10 |
| 3 | $10 | 18 | 1.8 | 1100 | 8 |
| 4 | $20 | 24 | 1.2 | 2300 | 6 |
| 5 | $50 | 56 | 1.12 | 6000 | 6 |
| 6 | $100 | 100 | 1.0 | 12500 | 6 |

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-137-1024x522.png)

#### GTarcade Bundles

| Bundle | Price | Balls | Balls per $ | Gems | Daily Stock |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | $1 | 5 | 5.0 | – | 10 |
| 2 | $5 | 12 | 2.4 | – | 10 |
| 3 | $10 | 22 | 2.2 | – | 8 |
| 4 | $15 | 30 | 2.0 | – | 6 |
| 5 | $100 | 132 | 1.32 | – | 6 |

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-138-1024x593.png)

---

### Value Comparison

If you only care about **crystal balls**, GTarcade gives you better value across every price point.
But if you’re also chasing **gems** for fast progression, the **in-game bundles** are still good because of the gem bonus.

Realistically, most players won’t hit the daily stock limits since both stores reset each day. However, if you’re trying to **push artifact progress quickly**, mixing **GTarcade’s cheaper bundles** with **in-game gem bundles** is the best approach — that way, you stretch your money without running out of stock early.

### Summary:

- Best raw value → **GTarcade $1 bundle (5 balls per $1)**
- Best mixed value (balls + gems) → **In-game $1 bundle (4 balls + 100 gems)**
- Mix both if you’re pushing hard and want both balls + gems daily

---

### Artifact Cost Estimate

Each artifact requires **60 fragments**.

Each drop gives **15 fragments**, so you need **4 successful drops** to complete one artifact.

With a **3.2% total drop rate**, you’ll average **~31 spins per artifact**.
At pity (100 spins), that’s the guaranteed upper limit.

Now let’s translate that into money based on the best bundles:

#### In-Game (Best Low Tiers)

| Bundle | Balls per $ | Avg Spins (31) | Est. Cost per Artifact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $1 | 4.0 | $7.75 | $25 |
| $5 | 2.0 | $15.5 | $50 |
| $10 | 1.8 | $17.2 | $56 |

#### GTarcade (Best Low Tiers)

| Bundle | Balls per $ | Avg Spins (31) | Est. Cost per Artifact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $1 | 5.0 | $6.2 | $20 |
| $5 | 2.4 | $12.9 | $41 |
| $10 | 2.2 | $14.1 | $45 |

So generally, GTarcade saves you around **15–25%** per artifact, depending on luck and bundle mix.

---

### Free Crystal Ball Sources

For free-to-play or light spenders, there are a few ways to earn crystal balls outside bundles:

#### Redeem Event

Use **Ancient Silvers** from standard gameplay (gnomes, gathering, etc.).

- 25 balls for **40 gems + 40 silvers each**
- 25 balls for **80 silvers each**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-139-1024x288.png)

That’s up to **50 balls total** if you do both.

#### Wonderful Journey

Earn **Dice** from spending gems or completing Golden Path levels during the event.

- Completing all stages = **100 crystal balls**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-140-1024x329.png)

If you line this up with the Redeem Event, you can collect **around 150 balls per event cycle** totally free.

In **Wonderful Journey**, your progress comes from rolling **Dice**, which move you around the board for rewards — and finishing all stages can net you up to **100 Crystal Balls**.

You **can’t buy Dice directly**; instead, you earn them through two main actions:

- **Recharge 400 gems** (by buying any in-game bundles) → **1 Dice**
- **Spend 800 gems** (for example, on Golden Path levels, Market refreshes, or building speedups) → **1 Dice**

So if you recharge and spend normally during events, you’ll pick up Dice naturally in the background.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/image-141-1024x717.png)

The key is timing — **try to line up your regular spending with Wonderful Journey’s duration**. You’ll earn Dice on both recharges and spending gems, for maximum efficiency.

---

### Player Perspective

So, the main thing is to **check your reward pool before you start**. If you’re after seasonal artifacts, make sure the board says so — otherwise, you’re wasting spins.
The **Reward Refresh** button is the switch between the two pools, but any progress on the pity-bar will reset with it.

For spending strategy:

- GTarcade is just better value per ball, no question.
- But if you’re also climbing Golden Path or chasing gem-based progress, mixing in-game bundles helps if you struggle with gems.
- Most players won’t hit daily stock caps, but for heavy spinners, running both stores in parallel ensures smooth progress.

I’d personally use GTarcade for the core rolls, and throw in the in-game $1 packs for the gems if you’re already active in events like Path of Gold or Dragon Treasure.

---

### Conclusion

- There are **two separate drop sets** — Elemental Selection and Seasonal Selection.
- Switch between them using **Reward Refresh** (resets progress).
- Artifact drop chance = **3.2% per spin**, with **pity at 100 spins**.
- **GTarcade bundles** give the best ball-per-dollar ratio, while **in-game bundles** give gem value.
- F2P can earn ~150 crystal balls per event through Redeem + Wonderful Journey.
- If you want fast progression, **mix bundle types** to expand daily stock — otherwise, **GTarcade alone is the best deal**.

title: Stellar Compass in Season 1
summary: The Stellar Compass event is a seasonal, high-value event in Infinity Kingdom that provides players with artifact crafting materials, speed-ups, purple crystals, and, most importantly, unique artifact fragments.
markdown:
### Stellar Compass Event Guide – Infinity Kingdom

The **Stellar Compass** event is a **seasonal, high-value event** in **Infinity Kingdom** that provides players with **artifact crafting materials, speed-ups, purple crystals, and, most importantly, unique artifact fragments**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-99-1024x561.png)

The first iteration of the event, **introduced in Season 1**, allows players to **choose their artifact fragments** through **universal elemental selection boxes**, making it a fantastic opportunity to **upgrade your Immortals**.

In this guide, we’ll cover:
✔ **How the event works**
✔ **How to participate (both free-to-play & spending players)**
✔ **Crystal Ball pricing & drop rates**
✔ **Comparing Stellar Compass vs. Standard Artifact Bundles**

If you’re looking to efficiently **upgrade your unique artifacts**, this guide will help you make the **most cost-effective choices**.

---

## How Stellar Compass Works

### 1. Participation & Currency – Crystal Balls

To participate in **Stellar Compass**, players need **Crystal Balls**, which can be obtained in several ways:

✔ **Through the spender-dice event** (a rolling event where purchases give dice rolls & rewards).
✔ **Through the redeem event** (kill Gnomes and farm resources to earn a currency that can be exchanged for Crystal Balls).
✔ **Direct purchase in the in-game shop**.

💡 **Tip for Free-to-Play Players**:

- **Do NOT spend Crystal Balls until you have collected 100**.
- There is a **guaranteed artifact jackpot at 100 draws** if you miss it 99 times.

---

## Understanding the Pricing of Unique Artifacts in Stellar Compass

While Stellar Compass **offers more than just artifact fragments**, **artifacts are the main draw** of the event. Let’s break down **the costs and compare them to the traditional artifact bundles in the in-game shop**.

### 1. Crystal Ball Pricing in Stellar Compass

Purchasing **Crystal Balls** comes at different price points:

| Bundle Price | Crystal Balls | Price per Ball |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $1 | 4 | $0.25 |
| $5 | 10 | $0.50 |
| $10 | 18 | $0.55 |
| $20 | 24 | $0.83 |
| $50 | 56 | $0.89 |
| $100 | 100 | $1.00 |

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-98-1024x537.png)

💡 **Realistic Price Per Crystal Ball**:

- If you’re **spending efficiently**, you’ll likely buy **a mix of $5, $10, and $20 bundles** rather than just large packs.
- **On average, this brings the price to around $0.50 per Crystal Ball**.

---

### 2. How Many Crystal Balls Do You Need for a Unique Artifact?

**Through testing**, spending **530 Crystal Balls** resulted in:
✔ **3x 60 Fragments (180 total)**
✔ **On average, 176.66 Crystal Balls per unique artifact**

💡 **Estimated Cost per Unique Artifact in Stellar Compass**:

- **176.66 Balls x $0.50 per Ball = ~$90 per full artifact**
- **Per fragment cost: ~$1.50**

---

## Comparing Stellar Compass vs. Standard Artifact Bundles

Now, let’s compare the **cost of acquiring artifact fragments** through **Stellar Compass** and **the standard daily artifact bundles in the in-game shop**.

### 1. Standard In-Game Shop Pricing

| Bundle Price | Schematic Fragments | Price per Fragment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $5 | 4 | $1.25 |
| $10 | 8 | $1.25 |
| $20 | 12 | $1.66 |

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Screenshot_20250313-213709-1024x473.webp)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Screenshot_20250313-213714-1024x473.webp)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Screenshot_20250313-213720-1024x473.webp)

💡 **Observations:**

- **Stellar Compass costs ~$1.50 per fragment on average.**
- **Daily artifact bundles cost ~$1.25 per fragment.**
- **The standard bundles are slightly cheaper per fragment, but Stellar Compass includes extra rewards**, namely upgrade materials and purple crystals which are quite attractive for players in season one looking to quickly scale and upgrade.

---

## Which Method is More Cost-Effective?

✔ **Stellar Compass:**

- **Pros:** Additional rewards like **crafting materials, speed-ups, and purple crystals**.
- **Cons:** Slightly **higher cost per fragment (~$1.50 vs. $1.25)**.

✔ **Daily Artifact Bundles:**

- **Pros:** **More predictable pricing** and slightly lower cost per fragment (~$1.25).
- **Cons:** No extra rewards beyond **fragments**.

💡 **Final Recommendation:**

- **For whales (big spenders):** Buying **daily artifact bundles AND participating in Stellar Compass with cheap bundles** is the **most efficient strategy**.
- **For mid-spenders:** Participate in **Stellar Compass only with $5 and $10 bundles**, while also buying daily artifact packs.
- **For free-to-play players:** **Only use free-earned Crystal Balls** and **save 100 before participating**.

---

## Conclusion: Should You Participate in Stellar Compass?

✔ **Yes!** Stellar Compass **is worth participating in** because of **bonus materials and speed-ups**, but don’t expect massive savings on artifact fragments.
✔ **Use a mix of daily bundles and cheaper Stellar bundles** for optimal artifact progression.
✔ **If you’re free-to-play, save 100 Crystal Balls before pulling to guarantee at least one jackpot.**

💡 **Final Thought:**
While **Stellar Compass isn't the absolute cheapest way to get artifacts**, it **offers valuable side rewards that make it worth participating in**—as long as you’re **strategic with your spending**. 🚀

title: Stormeye in the 5-day bundle
summary: Hey there, Infinity Kingdom enthusiasts! There's an exciting new 5-day bundle in town, featuring the Stormeye skill. Let's break down what this bundle offers and how you can make the most of it.
categoryPath: 5-day-bundles: High Value Dragon Essences and Immortals
markdown:
### Guide to the New Stormeye Bundle in Infinity Kingdom

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-110-1024x490.png)

Hey there, Infinity Kingdom enthusiasts! There's an exciting new 5-day bundle in town, featuring the Stormeye skill. Let's break down what this bundle offers and how you can make the most of it.

### What's on Offer

- **Daily Stormeye Stones**: For five consecutive days, you have the opportunity to purchase 5 Stormeye stones per day. Each daily bundle costs $20.
- **5-Day Cumulative Reward**: If you purchase the daily bundle for all five days, you'll unlock an additional reward of 25 Stormeye fragments. That's not all – you also get 25 earth artifact fragment chests. These chests are super valuable as they let you choose from any of the Earth Immortal Unique Artifacts.

## What is Stormeye?

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-112.png)

- **Strategic Advantage**: Stormeye is a coveted skill in the game, known for its prowess in battles. It deals high amounts of magical damage - especially if you can activate it's bonus damage and hit while the enemy is rooted with e.g. Fighting Will.
- **Boosting Earth Immortals**: The earth artifact fragment chests are particularly beneficial for players focusing on strengthening their Earth Immortals. These unique artifacts can significantly enhance your Immortal's capabilities.

## Investment Consideration

- **Worth it?** It is my personal opinion that Stormeye is a fine skill, but it is not worth spending money on. You have more powerful magical skills available in Spell Disintegration, Concentration, Annihilation, Chase, etc. hence you are going to use Stormeye most likely in your third march. I would not spend to build a third march like that but rather focus on getting more Triss skills or something else instead while you get Stormeye for free in Legion of Frostborne. Each daily bundle costs $20, so you're looking at a total investment of $100 over five days. It's essential to weigh this against the benefits of the Stormeye skill and the unique Earth artifacts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/image-111.png)

- **Long-term Benefits**: While the upfront cost is significant, the long-term benefits, especially for competitive players, can be substantial. Consider how the Stormeye skill and the unique artifacts align with your current strategy and goals in the game.

The new Stormeye 5-day bundle in Infinity Kingdom is an enticing offer, especially for players aiming to elevate their gameplay with strategic skills and powerful artifacts. While the investment is noteworthy, the potential gains will most likely not equate the cost of this. As always, balance your budget with your in-game objectives, and happy gaming!

title: Stormeye
summary: Stormeye, a Tower of Knowledge skill in Infinity Kingdom, often finds itself overshadowed by more potent damaging and debuff skills. This guide aims to shed light on its effectiveness, strategic use, and an often…
markdown:
### Player Guide: The most important bad skill in Infinity Kingdom

Stormeye, a Tower of Knowledge skill in Infinity Kingdom, often finds itself overshadowed by more potent damaging and debuff skills. This guide aims to shed light on its effectiveness, strategic use, and an often overlooked benefit of strategically not completing its acquisition.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-48-1024x261.png)

#### Overview of Stormeye

**Stormeye** is designed primarily as a damage-dealing skill with the following mechanics:

- **Official Skill Description**: "Every 6 seconds after the battle starts, has a 55% chance of causing Magical Damage (250%) to 3 random enemy units. If the target is under Root effects, Stormeye's damage increased by 50%."

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-49.png)

Despite its potential for higher damage under specific conditions, Stormeye generally offers lower damage output compared to other skills available in the game.

#### Comparing DPS Efficiency

When evaluated against other magical damage-dealing skills, Stormeye falls short:

- **DPS without Root**: Stormeye averages 68.75% DPS, significantly lower than Toxin Nova and Fire Nova, both of which average around 81.25% DPS.
- **DPS with Root**: Potential DPS can rise to 103% if the target is rooted, but achieving this consistently is challenging due to the sporadic nature of Root effects in most battle setups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-50.png)

#### Strategic Limitations

The key limitation of Stormeye lies in its reliance on Root effects to maximize its damage output. The narrow window for exploiting this feature, coupled with the lack of additional debuff effects (which skills like Spell Disintegration and Poison Thorn offer), severely limits its utility:

- **Root Dependency**: Effective only when used in conjunction with immortals or skills that can reliably apply Root, such as Fighting Will.
- **Inconsistent Performance**: Without consistent Root effects, Stormeye's damage output is often outperformed by other skills that also bring valuable debuffs or higher base damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-51.png)

## An Unconventional Strategic Advantage

So why is Stormeye the most important bad skill in Infinity Kingdom? We see that it dosen't deal great damage, but it isn't useless. It's just not as good as the other skills in the same category. **What makes this skill extreemly valuable is actually not owning it.**

Stormeye's relative underperformance can be turned into a strategic advantage. As one of the weaker skills in terms of battle impact, it becomes an ideal candidate for a strategic non-completion in the Legion of Frostborne rewards:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-52-1024x547.png)

- **Continuous Skill Stone Acquisition**: By intentionally not completing Stormeye, players can continue to purchase its skill stones, convert them into Cinders, and use those to acquire more impactful skills or other valuable items in the Triss shop.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-53-1024x487.png)

- **Resource Management**: This approach allows players to optimize their use of Cold Coins or Gems by continually accessing a resource exchange pathway, thus maximizing the efficiency of their in-game spending.
- **OBS**: If you complete all skills available as KvK rewards, you **WILL NOT BE ABLE TO EARN ANY REWARDS.**

#### Conclusion

While Stormeye does not stand out for its combat effectiveness, its strategic value in resource management strategies should not be overlooked. Players are encouraged to evaluate their current roster and battle strategies to decide if investing beyond the minimal necessary level in Stormeye is beneficial. For many, keeping Stormeye as an open channel for resource conversion might prove more valuable than any damage it could potentially contribute on the battlefield.

## How to use alts for strategic advantage in SvS

### Thermal Towers

In **[Legion of Frostborne aka. SvS](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pvp/legion-of-frostborne/)** we are limited by the number of **[Thermals](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/pvp/legion-of-frostborne/thermal-towers/)**we can put down. The more thermals you have, the longer new ones takes construct. However, new alliances instantly hold 1 free thermal tower and ressources to build another thermal right off the bat. I.e. when I create a new alliance on one of my alts it has 2x thermals to place down with minimum build time (less than 1hour).

This is very powerful in SvS battles, as you can use an army of alts to block strategically important areas such as the area around Ymir or around important gates.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-61.png)

This can also be used to chain thermals quickly via inter-alliance diplomacy settings.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-60.png)

### Bubble blocks

Just like with your thermals, you can use your castle to block off space in important areas. For instance, by using 15-20 alts placed within the shield-able green area close to a gate - you make sieging that gate VERY difficult for your opponent who now must either attack from the snow, or with very few people staying inside the yellow no-shield zone.

You want to spread them out with 1-tile of space in between, as to block as much area as possible, see below:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/right-way-1024x461.png)

*Done right*

Dont be the dude who places down all ur alts on top of each other or parks too close so u don't block extra tiles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-62.png)

*Done wrong*

If we combine thermals in the yellow area with alts in the green area. We can essentially block off an entire gate making it near impossible to capture the gate as you have to attack from snow with long-march times on a gate easily fortified by the defender from the safety of other side.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-63.png)

title: Summer Carnival - Mini event
summary: The Summer Carnival is the seasonal event scheduled to run from July 10 to July 20, 2026 (UTC). Unlike previous seasonal events focused primarily on spending resources, Summer Carnival mixes several smaller activities…
markdown:
![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-32-1024x571.png)

### Infinity Kingdom Summer Carnival Event Guide (Preview)

The **Summer Carnival** is the seasonal event scheduled to run from **July 10 to July 20, 2026 (UTC)**. Unlike previous seasonal events focused primarily on spending resources, Summer Carnival mixes several smaller activities together, including a daily mini-game, cosmetic packs, returning player invitations, and community rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-31-1024x523.png)

Most of the event is straightforward, but the daily mini-game and task system are worth understanding if you want to collect every available reward.

---

## Event Overview

The Summer Carnival consists of six sections:

- Heat Echoes
- Summer Carnival
- Carnival Supplies
- Celebrate Together
- Carnival Rewards
- Event Reminder

Each serves a different purpose.

---

## Heat Echoes

The Heat Echoes page is primarily a nostalgic feature.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-33-1024x501.png)

Players can revisit artwork and memories from previous summer events by selecting their favorite versions. This section does not appear to include gameplay or progression mechanics and mainly functions as a celebration of past Summer events.

---

## Summer Carnival (Diamond Tycoon)

This is the main gameplay feature of the event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-34-1024x530.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-35-1024x535.png)

Players earn attempts by completing daily tasks, then spend those attempts in a 30-second fishing mini-game called **Diamond Tycoon: Deep Sea Adventure**.

## How to unlock attempts

Each completed daily objective grants **one play attempt**.

Daily tasks include:

- Defeat Gnomes 10 times
- Gather 100,000 Resources
- Log in once
- Complete 5 Arena battles

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-36-1024x465.png)

Maximum attempts each day: **4**

The task list resets every day at **UTC 00:00**, so unused opportunities do not carry over.

#### How the Mini-game Works

Once the game starts, you have **30 seconds**. Your goal is to hook valuable underwater items while avoiding crabs.

Items award different point values:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-37-1024x166.png)

However, every item requires a different amount of time to reel in. Higher-value items take noticeably longer. Because the timer is short, efficiency matters more than simply targeting the most valuable object. Prioritize diamonds if possible, but beware that if its far away!

Pearls provide good value while taking much less time than diamonds. If no diamond is available, collecting pearls generally offers the best balance between speed and score.

---

## Point Milestone Rewards

Your highest score unlocks milestone rewards.

All milestones are cumulative.

| Score | Rewards |
| --- | --- |
| 300 | 100 Gems, 10 Stardust, Major AP Recovery, 5 Homer's Epic Artifact Fragments |
| 500 | 200 Gems, 50 Stardust, 2 Major AP Recovery, 10 Fragments |
| 800 | 300 Gems, 80 Stardust, 3 Major AP Recovery, 15 Fragments |
| 1000 | 500 Gems, 100 Stardust, 5 Major AP Recovery, 30 Fragments, Bright-Eyed Goddess (30 Days) |

The final milestone also grants an exclusive temporary avatar frame. Reaching **1,000 points** will likely require a clean run with multiple diamonds and very few mistakes (unless you play bad like I did today, see below).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-38.png)

---

## Server Rankings

The mini-game also features a server-wide leaderboard. Rankings update every hour throughout the event.

Final rankings lock when the event ends. Top 50 players receive exclusive profile badges.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-39-1024x190.png)

Unlike milestone rewards, leaderboard rewards are purely cosmetic.

---

## Carnival Supplies

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-40-1024x467.png)

Players can purchase the new **Midsummer Festival Packs**, which include exclusive skins and appearance items. While I currently do not see any special Midsummer Packs in my shop, I suspect that is most likely because these will become available soon when the real Midsummer Festival begins in Norheim and related realms. According to the rules, these will be available:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-44.png)

Completing associated contract missions grants additional rewards.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-41-1024x473.png)

If the structure follows previous seasonal events, expect a mixture of cosmetic purchases alongside bonus mission rewards.

---

## Celebrate Together

Celebrate Together is the returning player event. Current players can generate invitation codes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-42-1024x435.png)

Returning players who meet the eligibility requirements may enter those codes to receive the **Gift of Coming-back**.

Both players receive rewards for participating. These events typically work best if you already have inactive friends or alternate accounts eligible to return.

---

## Carnival Rewards

The Carnival Rewards page is a community activity.

Instead of giving a code directly, players are encouraged to visit Infinity Kingdom's official social media pages.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/image-43-1024x427.png)

The complete redemption code is revealed through community channels. Once discovered, everyone can redeem the gift code in-game.

---

## Daily Checklist

Every day during the event you should complete:

- Log in
- Defeat 10 Gnomes
- Gather 100,000 Resources
- Complete 5 Arena battles
- Use all earned mini-game attempts
- Claim milestone rewards
- Check mailbox

Missing a day's attempts means permanently losing those play opportunities.

---

## Player Perspective

Summer Carnival feels much more relaxed than previous seasonal events that revolved around heavy resource spending. Most of the rewards come from simply logging in, completing everyday activities, and playing the Diamond Tycoon mini-game.

From what we've seen so far, the fishing game is where most players should focus their attention. The milestone rewards are generous, especially the Gems, Stardust, and Homer's Epic Artifact Schematic Fragments, while the leaderboard adds a bit of friendly competition for players chasing exclusive badges. Based on the current mechanics, avoiding crab penalties is usually more important than grabbing every item on screen, and a clean run will often outscore an aggressive but mistake-filled one.

Overall, Summer Carnival looks like one of the more accessible seasonal events, with the majority of rewards available simply by participating every day rather than making purchases.

---

## Conclusion

Summer Carnival is built around short daily participation rather than marathon grinding. Completing four simple daily tasks unlocks your attempts in the Diamond Tycoon mini-game, where efficient play earns milestone rewards and cosmetic ranking badges. Outside of the mini-game, the event also introduces new summer-themed skins, a returning player invitation campaign, nostalgic Heat Echoes artwork, and a community gift code.

As long as you complete your daily checklist and avoid missing resets, most players should be able to collect the bulk of the available rewards over the course of the ten-day event.

---

| USD | Artifact Fragments | USD per fragment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $5 | 2 | $2.5 |
| $10 | 4 | $2.5 |
| $20 | 8 | $2.5 |
| $50 | 16 | $3.1 |
| $100 | 30 | $3.3 |
| $185 | 60 |  |

## Summer Event 101

The Summer Festival 2023 begins on **June 28th and last until July 3rd** (available for servers that have been open for more than 7 days; the event will last for the first 5 days, and the sixth day is the settlement day in which you can continue to claim rewards). Let's check out the event details together!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/image-55-1024x568.png)

1. **Summer Carnival**:****complete daily tasks to obtain firewood and other goodies. More importantly, you earn points towards the juicy star chests with amazing rewards.

Once your task completion progress reaches certain points, you can get a progress chest that contains more firewood as well as Loki fragments! I was personally worries with the last seasonal events introduction of Wukong that we were not getting more free Loki fragments - I am super hyped and excited to see that this is not the case! We are getting a nice 40 more Loki fragments for free this event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/image-56-1024x324.png)

2. **Sail Adventure**: This is also a complete copy of previous side events, but it is fine since we quite like this one! It is a decent way to earn some free rewards and you can turn gems into speed ups if you have the time and AP to reset and farm camps.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/image-58-1024x506.png)

Otherwise, send your Immortals on an adventure at sea and claim rewards that way.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/image-57-1024x573.png)

## 🎉 Infinity Kingdom Guide: Summer Party Event 2025 – How to Get the Green Typhoon Frame & More!

---

## 🌴 Introduction: Welcome to the Summer Party!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-1024x564.png)

Infinity Kingdom just kicked off a brand-new mini-event called the **Summer Party**, a charming little event designed as a prelude to the much-anticipated Summer Harvest Festival and the upcoming C60 update. It features a unique reward, the new **Green Typhoon Frame**, along with easy quests, insightful summaries of your progress, and incentives for returning players.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-1-1024x432.png)

This quick guide will explain everything you need to know, from getting that sought-after Green Typhoon Frame to understanding each element of this fun-filled mini-event!

---

## 💚 How to Obtain the Green Typhoon Frame

The most common question since the event started has been:

> "**How do I get the new Green Typhoon Frame?**"

Here’s the simple answer:

- Open the event panel and navigate to the **"Mid-Year Review."**
- Click through the interactive summary of your Infinity Kingdom journey this year.
- **At the end of the review**, you’ll find a claim button.
- Click this button to immediately receive your Green Typhoon Frame!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-2-1024x461.png)

It's really that simple!

### TL;DR:

- Go to *Mid-Year Review* → Scroll to the final page → Click claim → Enjoy your Green Typhoon Frame!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-3-1024x461.png)

---

## 📜 Mid-Year Review: Celebrate Your Journey!

The Mid-Year Review provides a personalized overview of your achievements in Infinity Kingdom from the past months, including:

- Logins
- Enemies killed
- Nemisis enemy
- Best friend
- Favorite Skin

It’s an enjoyable snapshot of your progress and a nice way to look back on how far you've come.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-4-1024x510.png)

**Why it Matters:**
While mostly just a fun feature, this is also where you obtain your exclusive Green Typhoon Frame, a fantastic cosmetic reward.

---

## 🎖️ Quests and Rewards

The Summer Party event includes a set of easy-to-complete quests providing some great little bonuses for playing as usual.

### Free Quest Tier Rewards:

Complete various simple tasks like training troops, logging in daily, defeating gnomes, and gathering resources to earn rewards such as:

- Philosopher stones
- Gems
- Speedups
- Resource chests

These quests are straightforward and require no extra effort beyond daily gameplay.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-5-1024x427.png)

### Paid Quest Tier (Spender Rewards):

If you choose to spend money on bundles during the event, you can unlock additional valuable rewards, including:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-6-1024x393.png)

- **Random Epic Immortal Fragments**
- **Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments**

These paid rewards are excellent for players looking to accelerate their immortal upgrades.

**Why it Matters:**
Free-to-play players get easy resources for minimal effort, while spenders earn valuable immortal fragments, making it beneficial for all player types.

### TL;DR:

- **Free:** Complete easy tasks → Philosopher stones, gems, speedups.
- **Paid:** Purchase bundles → Earn additional rare immortal fragments.

---

## 🎁 Returning Player Invite Codes

Another cool new feature is the **Returning Player Gift Code** system: **My Invitation Code: 3CKG3M**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-8.png)

- Current players can generate unique gift codes to invite friends who stopped playing Infinity Kingdom.
- Returning players who use these codes receive immediate rewards upon logging back in.
- This helps players reconnect, and it encourages old friends to come back to the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-7-1024x457.png)

**Why it Matters:**
It’s a nice incentive to re-engage your alliance members or friends who've gone inactive—making your server stronger and more active for upcoming events and battles.

---

## 🎯 Event Summary & Why It Matters

The Summer Party event serves as an enjoyable warm-up for the upcoming major events (Harvest Festival, C60 Update). It is:

- Easy to participate in and offers a variety of immediate rewards.
- An excellent opportunity for free resources and valuable fragments.
- A way to earn an exclusive cosmetic item (**Green Typhoon Frame**).
- Perfect for reconnecting with inactive friends, strengthening alliances, and boosting server activity.

---

title: Sun Chariot
summary: Alright, so the Pirate seasonal event dropped a new skin this month called Sun Chariot, and it’s a new version of tank-skins not like previously released combat skins. Moreover, it is drop dead gorgeous, but that is…
markdown:
### Sun Chariot Skin Guide – Pirate Event (September 2025)

Alright, so the Pirate seasonal event dropped a new skin this month called **Sun Chariot**, and it’s a new version of tank-skins not like previously released combat skins. Moreover, it is drop dead gorgeous, but that is just visuals ofcourse! Normally when we get a “tank” skin, it’s some mix of HP% and a sub-stat like troop death rate reduction, for example with Goddess of Victory. This one however changes things on its head and gives **Immortal Physical Defense, Immortal Magical Defense, and March Speed**. That last part is the kicker — march speed completely changes how you play out fights.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-60-1024x548.png)

## Obtaining Sun Chariot

You can get Sun Chariot straight up with the $50 battle pass, or you can try your luck with the Dazzling Wish, but that’s a 0.05% jackpot roll. I wouldn’t bank on that. If you want it, you’re basically buying it through the pass.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-57-1024x479.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-53-1024x633.png)

---

## What makes Sun Chariot different

The Immortal defenses here are decent, and I actually like them more than the 2–3% HP we’ve had on earlier defensive skins. But the real standout is the **march speed**. Being able to move faster means you can hit someone and recall before their march lands, which is a huge advantage if you’ve got fast fingers. You can play poke games, stall out rallies, and just generally force your opponent to fight on your terms. That kind of mobility on a defensive skin is something we haven’t had before, and it makes Sun Chariot a lot more flexible than the usual “just tank longer” approach.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-64.png)

Personally, I am using the Mt. Paradise skin a lot for this very reason, as it gives me an option to fight with offensively and defensively with my main at the same time if at range against enemies who do not run a movespeed skin.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-65-1024x470.png)

---

## Comparing Sun Chariot to Abyssal and Skyriver

So let’s talk comparisons, because that’s the real question everyone has: is Sun Chariot actually better than Abyssal or Skyriver?

**Abyssal Throne** gives flat out **Troop Attack (5-15)%**, plus the little bit of death rate reduction. And honestly, troop stats scale way harder than Immortal stats. A 10% boost to Troop Attack gets multiplied by all 60k+ soldiers in your march late game, which is why Abyssal feels so insanely strong no matter what march you’re running. It’s just pure power, and since we’re seeing Abyssal fragments show up more often in passes, it’s also way easier to upgrade consistently than the new Sun Chariot.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-61-1024x533.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-67-1024x567.png)

**Skyriver** is a bit different. That one gives Immortal Attack % (both physical and magical) plus death rate reduction. So it’s kind of a hybrid: makes your Immortals hit harder while also softening troop losses. It’s not as universally good as Abyssal, but if you’re damage-focused it can still be a strong option.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-66-1024x554.png)

Now, **Sun Chariot** gives Immortal Defense and march speed. Compared to Skyriver and Abyssal, the defenses are weaker long-term because they don’t multiply through your whole march. But that march speed is what keeps it in the conversation — if you’re the type of player who’s quick with recalls, Sun Chariot lets you play hit-and-run in a way the other two skins can’t.

---

## Why troop stats win in the long run

Here’s the part that’s easy to miss: Immortal stats don’t scale nearly as well as troop stats. Your Immortal is just one unit. If you give them +10% defense, that makes them harder to kill, but it doesn’t do anything for the 60,000 troops backing them up. Troop Attack or Troop Defense, on the other hand, applies to every single soldier in the march. That means it’s multiplied across tens of thousands of units, and that multiplier makes troop stats exponentially stronger than Immortal stats once you’re late game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-68-1024x397.png)

That’s why **Abyssal’s Troop Attack % is still the best skin bonus in the game** **in my opinion**. And honestly, if we ever get a **Troop Defense % skin** — which feels like it’s only a matter of time — that’ll probably outclass Sun Chariot too (*pure speculation, but would follow the current release pattern*). Troop Defense would be like the perfect tank option, because it would scale across your entire march instead of just making your Immortals sturdier.

---

## My personal take

So if you’re asking me straight up which skin to invest in, I’d say Abyssal Throne still wins every time and luckily, you get both the Sun Chariot unlock and the Abyssal Fragments in the Pirate Battle Pass! Yay, go ahead and get that. **Should you in future invest in Sun Chariot if more options come available? Should you invest in the Dazzling Wish to upgrade it? No. It is not good enough for that.**

That said, Sun Chariot isn’t worthless. If you’re already stacked on Abyssal and you’re looking for a situational tool, Sun Chariot can give you some really nasty tricks with march speed. The unlock will be useful to replace Mt. Paradise when speed is needed. Being able to smack an opponent and instantly recall before they hit you — that’s huge in IBL, KvK, or just castle brawls when you’re trying to bleed an enemy without over-committing. If you’re quick, it actually feels broken in the right situations.

But if we’re talking raw power, Troop Attack beats Immortal Defense. And if/when Troop Defense shows up, that’ll be even stronger. So for now, Abyssal is still the king, Skyriver has its place, and Sun Chariot is more of a specialty skin for people who want to play smart with mobility.

---

## Final thoughts

At the end of the day, **Sun Chariot is fun and unique, but it doesn’t dethrone Abyssal**. Immortal Defense is nice, march speed is amazing if you can take advantage of it, but it doesn’t scale the way troop stats do. If you’re only picking one skin, go Abyssal. If you’re a spender and already have Abyssal maxed out, then yeah, Sun Chariot adds some spicy new options to your toolkit.

The bottom line? Abyssal is power. Sun Chariot is flexibility. And when troop defense eventually drops, that’ll probably be the new tank king.
