title: Thanksgiving 2023
summary: Welcome, Commanders, to this year's Thanksgiving Event in Infinity Kingdom! This guide will help you navigate the event tabs, understand the tasks, and maximize your rewards. Let's dive in!
markdown:
### Infinity Kingdom Thanksgiving Event Player Guide

Welcome, Commanders, to this year's Thanksgiving Event in Infinity Kingdom! This guide will help you navigate the event tabs, understand the tasks, and maximize your rewards. Let's dive in!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-140-1024x1024.png)

## 1. Delicious Feast

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-141.png)

**Objective:** Log in daily to claim rewards.

In this tab, simply log in each day to receive rewards such as gems, philosopher stones, shields, and event currency. While not extraordinary, these rewards add up, so don't miss out on your daily feast!

## 2. City of Warmth

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-142.png)

**Objective:** Complete stages for Turkey Chest rewards.

This year's event quests are presented in five stages, allowing you to complete tasks at your own pace. For every two completed tasks, you earn a Turkey Chest, totaling 50 chests. These chests contain valuable rewards, including 40 Loki Fragments, speed-ups, AP and SP flasks, resources, buffs, soul crystals, and market orders. Ensure you complete all five stages to claim the full 50 Turkey Chests.

## 3. Gratitude Gift

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-143-1024x550.png)

**Objective:** Earn Gratitude Chests by playing the game.

Engage in various in-game activities such as resource farming, gnome and boss battles to earn Gratitude Chests. These chests contain Tasty Sweet Corn, the primary Free-to-Play currency for the event. Accumulate Sweet Corn to unlock rewards in the event shop.

## 4. Amnesty Ceremony

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-144.png)

**Objective:** Upgrade your Turkey using earned hearts.

As you progress in the City of Warmth, you earn hearts. Spend 8 hearts to upgrade your Turkey and unlock rewards. There are 20 levels in total, offering various rewards. While not the most exciting, completing all levels grants a 3-day temporary castle skin and other minor rewards. The spender option is available but may not be a priority due to the rewards not being exceptionally enticing.

## 5. Sweetness Gathering (Event Shop)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-152-1024x573.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-149.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-151-1024x579.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-145.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-150-1024x570.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-146.png)

**Objective:** Spend Sweet Corn and Pumpkin Pies for rewards.

In the event shop, use the Free-to-Play currency, Sweet Corn, and the spender currency, Pumpkin Pies, to redeem rewards. Key free-tier rewards include elite immortal fragments, speed-ups, fragments of Alexander, Cid, Saladin, or Atilla, and a Philosopher's Offer. Spender-tier highlights are 60 fragments of a holy or shadow immortal for just 30 Pumpkin Pies, Stardust, Crimson Moonlights, and more. Prioritize based on your needs.

## 6. King's Feast

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-155-1024x573.png)

**Objective:** Explore special event bundles for cosmetic items.

Visit the King's Feast tab for special event bundles containing cosmetic items. While these may appeal to collectors, the overall value is lower compared to regular event bundles. Only consider these if you aim to complete the entire shop.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/image-154.png)

Remember, Commanders, plan your strategy wisely, focus on your priorities, and enjoy the Thanksgiving festivities in Infinity Kingdom! May your rewards be bountiful!

title: Thanksgiving Festival 2026 – Pet Paradise: Ginger Cat Event Guide,
markdown:
![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151823-4dw8gp.png)

If you've participated in the previous seasonal festivals, most of the activities will already be familiar. Lucky Koi, the festival Battle Pass, Grail Shop, Pinnacle Trial, and Glorious Challenge all return, while Enchanted Forest continues the cooperative reward-collection gameplay introduced during Ghost Fiesta.

However, there is one notable change.

**Dazzling Wish has been replaced by Touch of Surprise, a new scratch-card lottery offering Immortal outfit fragments and Eternal Grails.**

Unfortunately, the new system doesn't appear to offer particularly attractive value for players simply looking to collect Eternal Grails. As with Dazzling Wish before it, we generally recommend treating it as an optional activity for players specifically pursuing outfits.

Let's go through the festival, what's new, and where players should focus their time and resources.

The Thanksgiving Festival runs from **November 16 to November 26, 2026**, with some shop redemption timers extending beyond the main activities.

## TL;DR – What Should You Focus On?

The event is largely business as usual, with several familiar opportunities to collect valuable rewards.

* **Lucky Koi:** Collect your daily free Token of Light. For spenders, the five-purchase consolation reward remains one of the best sources of Eternal Grails.
* **Pet Paradise: Ginger Cat:** The $49.99 Battle Pass provides 120 additional Tokens of Light, 60 Ginger Cat decoration fragments, 60 selectable Immortal outfit fragments, and 5,000 Magic Wands.
* **Enchanted Forest:** Collect food, complete progression milestones, and obtain additional outfit fragments. It follows a similar reward structure to Witch Forest.
* **Touch of Surprise:** The new scratch-card lottery replacing Dazzling Wish. Interesting for outfit collectors, but generally poor value if your main objective is Eternal Grails.
* **Fruit Frenzy:** The returning 2048-style puzzle. Complete its tasks for Magic Wands and additional progression rewards.
* **Grail Shop:** Horus returns alongside valuable Chaos Immortal and artifact selection chests.
* **Pinnacle Trial and Glorious Challenge:** Complete as many stages as possible for free event currencies, Magic Wands, and additional rewards.

For most players, the best strategy remains collecting every free reward, investing in the Battle Pass only if its contents are useful to your account, and prioritizing **Wish Grail over Touch of Surprise when converting Tokens of Light into Eternal Grails**.

## Lucky Koi – Still One of the Best Purchases

Lucky Koi returns with exactly the kind of rewards we've come to expect from seasonal events.

Every player can claim a free daily reward, including a Token of Light. Over the festival, this provides up to ten free Tokens of Light simply for remembering to visit the event page.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-152038-gdmgiu.png)

These tokens can be saved for future seasonal activities, so even players who don't intend to spend anything should collect them.

For spenders, the familiar $4.99 Koi Gift Pack is once again available.

Each purchase provides:

* 5 Tokens of Light
* 1,500 Magic Wands
* Entry into the Lucky Koi lottery

The lottery takes place every two days, with one lucky player receiving 4,250 Eternal Grails and an exclusive insignia.

However, the grand prize isn't the main reason we recommend Lucky Koi.

Players who participate in all five rounds without winning receive a guaranteed consolation reward of **850 Eternal Grails**, alongside a special insignia.

Buying all five $4.99 packs costs approximately $24.95.

That's already an excellent source of Eternal Grails, even before accounting for the 25 Tokens of Light and 7,500 Magic Wands included with those purchases.

For players planning to spend money on Chaos Immortals or artifact progression, this continues to be one of the most attractive purchases available during seasonal events.

**Our recommendation:** Collect the free rewards every day. For moderate spenders, completing all five Lucky Koi purchases remains a very high priority, provided you participate in every required round.

## Pet Paradise: Ginger Cat – The $50 Festival Battle Pass

The festival Battle Pass returns with its usual 30-level progression system.

Players complete daily objectives to earn EXP and unlock rewards across the free and premium tracks.

This month's featured reward is **Pet Paradise: Ginger Cat**, a new decoration featuring an orange cat relaxing on a colorful miniature castle.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-152055-vtqut8.png)

The premium Battle Pass costs **$49.99**, equivalent to the usual $50 seasonal pass.

### What Do You Get?

The complete Battle Pass provides:

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151723-ffebfp.png)

The premium pass also includes additional progression rewards distributed across its 30 levels.

The Immortal Outfit Fragment Selection Chests are particularly interesting because they allow players to choose between:

* Louis IX – Night of Terror
* Alexander the Great – Summer Passion

This means players can continue progressing outfits introduced during previous seasonal events rather than being forced to collect only the latest reward.

Sixty fragments are enough to unlock an outfit requiring 60 fragments, provided you've selected the corresponding reward throughout the pass.

The Ginger Cat decoration is the other main collectible. Its fragments are available through the premium track, making it primarily a reward for paying participants.

### Is the Battle Pass Worth $50?

As usual, this depends on what you actually want.

The 120 additional Tokens of Light are valuable because they can be converted into Eternal Grails through Wish Grail, and the 60 outfit fragments are particularly useful if you're working toward Alexander's or Louis IX's appearance.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151906-voos51.png)

The 5,000 Magic Wands also provide additional progression through Enchanted Forest.

However, I wouldn't purchase the Battle Pass simply because it's available.

If you don't care about the outfits or Ginger Cat decoration, much of the additional value comes down to whether the Tokens of Light justify the cost compared with other available bundles.

**Our recommendation:** A reasonable purchase for players actively collecting outfits or seeking a combination of seasonal currencies and collectible rewards. Not necessarily the most efficient purchase if you only want Eternal Grails.

## Enchanted Forest – The Return of Cooperative Reward Collection

Enchanted Forest is this month's version of the cooperative collection event introduced through Witch Forest during Ghost Fiesta.

The Halloween setting has been replaced by a much more cheerful Thanksgiving theme, featuring a sleeping orange cat surrounded by delicious food.

The underlying concept is familiar.

Players spend Magic Wands to activate spaces around the event board and collect food, resources, and additional rewards.

The food contributes points toward daily progression chests, while special spaces can provide additional multipliers or rewards.

### How the Event Works

The main board contains several types of spaces, including reward chests, special events, and Magic Wand reward tiles.

Players can select different spending multipliers before activating the board, allowing them to consume larger amounts of Magic Wands in exchange for proportionally larger rewards.

The event includes cooperative participation, with players able to team up and contribute toward shared progression.

As with the Halloween version, the daily progression rewards and ranking systems provide additional incentives to participate regularly.

The main difference is the seasonal presentation and the items being collected.

Instead of collecting Halloween candy, players now gather Thanksgiving-themed food such as Savory Drumsticks, Fruit Pies, and Savory Cheese.

These contribute different point values toward the event's milestones.

### Outfit Fragments and My Food

An important feature is the **My Food** collection system.

Players collect specific foods to progress through separate milestone rewards, including Immortal Outfit Fragment Selection Chests.

The visible milestones include:

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151737-zlte99.png)

The selection chests provide another opportunity to progress the returning outfits without relying entirely on the premium Battle Pass.

However, reaching the higher milestones can require considerable participation and potentially significant spending on additional Magic Wands.

Like Fishing Contest and Witch Forest before it, this is an activity where chasing the final rewards can become expensive.

**Our recommendation:** Collect all free Magic Wands from the Battle Pass, Fruit Frenzy, and combat challenges before purchasing additional ones. If you're pursuing an outfit, calculate how far you need to progress toward its next milestone rather than spending blindly.

## Touch of Surprise – The New Scratch-Card Lottery

The biggest new feature of November's seasonal event is **Touch of Surprise**, which replaces Dazzling Wish.

Instead of spinning a wheel, players use Tokens of Light to purchase Wonder Cards.

Each Wonder Card can then be scratched to reveal symbols and determine the reward.

The possible rewards include Eternal Grails and Immortal outfit fragments, with larger rewards requiring specific combinations of matching symbols.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-152113-novacx.png)

There's also an **UP mechanic**, where collecting five UP symbols increases the level of the event and improves future winning probabilities.

### How Good Are the Rewards?

At first glance, the new lottery is entertaining enough. But when you examine the probabilities, the familiar problem with Dazzling Wish becomes apparent.

At the starting level, some of the rarer rewards shown are:

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151746-jdocwd.png)

These are the starting-level probabilities displayed in-game. The full reward distribution changes as the UP system progresses, so they shouldn't be treated as the average probabilities for an entire spending session.

The event also displays a grand-prize guarantee counter. In our recording, it indicated that approximately 1,200 scratches were required to reach the guaranteed grand prize from a fresh starting point.

That's a very large number of Tokens of Light.

Even though the UP progression improves the lottery as you continue, the basic problem remains: players must commit substantial resources to a system where the most attractive outfit rewards are rare.

### Is Touch of Surprise Worth Spending On?

For players specifically pursuing the available Immortal outfits, Touch of Surprise may be worth considering.

After all, outfit fragments are the primary reason this event exists.

However, if your main objective is obtaining Eternal Grails, I would strongly recommend considering the alternative.

**Wish Grail remains the better general-purpose destination for Tokens of Light when you're trying to maximize Eternal Grail income.**

Unlike Touch of Surprise, the dedicated Wish Grail wheel focuses on Grail rewards, cumulative milestones, and a grand-prize system that can be evaluated more directly.

Touch of Surprise instead mixes Grails with outfit fragments and low-probability combinations, making it a much less attractive option for players who simply want a predictable source of Grails.

We haven't yet calculated the complete expected return across every UP level, so this is a practical recommendation rather than a finalized mathematical comparison.

But for players primarily interested in long-term Chaos Immortal progression, the choice is straightforward.

**Our recommendation:** Only invest heavily in Touch of Surprise if you're specifically chasing the outfit fragments. Otherwise, save your Tokens of Light and use Wish Grail for Eternal Grails.

## Fruit Frenzy – The 2048 Puzzle Returns

Fruit Frenzy returns from previous seasonal events with its familiar 2048-style gameplay.

Players combine matching fruits on a board, gradually creating higher-level fruits and completing progression objectives.

The event includes several separate tasks, with rewards for merging specific fruits and reaching different milestones.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-152124-iqccbf.png)

The main reason to participate is the opportunity to collect additional Magic Wands and other seasonal resources.

These can then be used in Enchanted Forest without purchasing extra event bundles.

Fruit Frenzy is also a welcome change of pace from the recurring combat activities, offering players a puzzle-based alternative.

For most players, there isn't much reason to spend additional money here. Simply complete the available free attempts and tasks whenever possible.

**Our recommendation:** Treat Fruit Frenzy as a source of free Enchanted Forest progression. Collect its rewards before spending anything on additional Magic Wands.

## Grail Shop – Horus and Valuable Selection Chests

The Grail Shop returns with another familiar selection of Immortal fragments, artifact progression materials, and other valuable rewards.

Horus remains one of the main featured Immortals, alongside his exclusive artifact schematic.

The shop also includes several discounted selection chests that deserve serious attention, particularly for players still progressing their Chaos Immortals.

Among the more interesting rewards are:

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151758-j9h919.png)

Availability and stock limits depend on the specific item and may also vary with server age.

### Where Is the Best Value?

For most players, I'd recommend checking the discounted Chaos Immortal selection chests before committing to Horus.

The Fate of Chaos Selection Chest VIII is particularly attractive because it offers valuable Immortal fragments from a selection of powerful Chaos Immortals.

At 250 Eternal Grails for 80 fragments, it can represent considerably better practical progression value than purchasing more expensive fragments simply because they're featured.

The artifact schematic selection chests also offer useful progression opportunities, particularly for accounts that already have their priority Immortals unlocked.

Meanwhile, the Shadow and Light selection chests are worth checking for players working on premium Holy and Shadow formations.

The best purchase ultimately depends on which Immortals and artifacts your account is developing.

### Challenge Shop

The event also has a separate Challenge Shop where players can exchange festival currency for additional rewards.

These include Magic Wands, artifacts, decorations, and progression materials.

The shop has daily purchase limits on some items, so check it regularly and avoid leaving useful currency unspent.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-152150-ec81xm.png)

**Our recommendation:** Don't assume Horus is automatically the best choice simply because he's the featured Immortal. Compare the discounted selection chests against your current account needs.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-152210-v7vmop.png)

## Pinnacle Trial – Complete the Available Stages

Pinnacle Trial returns with its usual series of increasingly challenging battles.

Players progress through stages, earn event rewards, and eventually unlock additional ranking-related challenges.

Rewards include Tokens of Light, Immortal fragments, and seasonal progression materials.

The higher stages become available as the festival progresses, so you won't necessarily be able to complete everything immediately.

As usual, progress as far as your account allows, then return when additional stages unlock.

The event provides valuable free rewards without requiring any direct spending.

**Our recommendation:** Complete every stage you can reasonably clear, particularly when it awards Tokens of Light or materials used elsewhere in the festival.

## Glorious Challenge – Free Festival Currency and Magic Wands

Glorious Challenge also returns in its familiar format.

Players battle through increasingly difficult encounters to earn festival currency, Magic Wands, and other rewards.

Normal difficulty is available from the beginning, while harder stages unlock later in the festival.

The daily challenge system also allows players to repeat previously completed stages through the raid feature.

For many players, this remains one of the most important free sources of seasonal currency.

The festival currency can be spent in the Challenge Shop, while Magic Wands contribute to Enchanted Forest progression.

Even if your account cannot clear the highest difficulty stages, there's still meaningful value in completing the content available to you.

**Our recommendation:** Use your free challenge attempts consistently, clear new stages as they unlock, and make sure to spend your earned event currency before the shop closes.

## Where Is the Best Value During Thanksgiving Festival?

The festival offers several different spending opportunities, but their value varies significantly depending on what you're trying to obtain.

For most players, I would prioritize the event as follows.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261121-151812-fpgrth.png)

### Free-to-Play Players

The priorities are straightforward.

Collect your daily Lucky Koi reward, complete the free Battle Pass objectives, progress through Fruit Frenzy, and clear the available combat challenges.

Use the Magic Wands earned through these activities in Enchanted Forest to collect as many free rewards as possible.

Save your Tokens of Light for activities where they'll provide the best long-term progression value.

You don't need to participate in every paid lottery or chase every outfit to get worthwhile rewards from the festival.

### Low and Moderate Spenders

For players spending modest amounts, Lucky Koi remains the standout purchase.

Completing all five $4.99 purchases provides an excellent consolation reward alongside useful Tokens of Light and Magic Wands.

After that, consider whether the $49.99 Battle Pass offers enough value for your particular account.

If you're actively progressing the Alexander or Louis IX outfits, the 60 selectable outfit fragments can be particularly attractive.

If you don't care about those outfits, I wouldn't automatically recommend buying the pass simply for its seasonal currencies.

### Heavy Spenders and Outfit Collectors

For players collecting every outfit, Touch of Surprise and Enchanted Forest may be unavoidable.

However, the important consideration is identifying how much you're actually prepared to spend to reach the desired outfit reward.

The scratch-card probabilities are extremely low at the starting level, and progressing through the UP system can require substantial investment.

Before committing, make sure you're comfortable with the possibility of needing a very large number of scratches.

For players primarily interested in competitive combat progression, however, I would generally favor acquiring Eternal Grails and spending them on important Immortals and artifacts rather than chasing cosmetic collectibles with uncertain returns.

## Final Thoughts – A Familiar Festival With a New Lottery

The Thanksgiving Festival is another traditional Infinity Kingdom seasonal event, with most activities returning in familiar forms.

Lucky Koi remains an excellent purchase for players collecting Eternal Grails, while the $49.99 Battle Pass offers a substantial collection of Tokens of Light, outfit fragments, and the new Ginger Cat decoration.

Enchanted Forest continues the cooperative progression introduced during Halloween, with additional outfit fragments available through its collection milestones.

Fruit Frenzy, Pinnacle Trial, and Glorious Challenge provide several useful opportunities to collect free resources throughout the event.

The main novelty is Touch of Surprise.

Although the scratch-card format is new, its practical role is very similar to Dazzling Wish: an expensive, luck-dependent activity aimed primarily at players collecting limited Immortal outfits.

For most players, that doesn't change where the best value lies.

**Our recommendation:** Collect every free reward, consider Lucky Koi if you're spending, and prioritize Wish Grail when converting Tokens of Light into Eternal Grails. Only commit heavily to Touch of Surprise or Enchanted Forest if you're specifically pursuing the outfit rewards.

The Thanksgiving theme might be new, but the most efficient strategy remains the same: identify which rewards actually improve your account, collect everything available for free, and avoid spending heavily on lotteries unless their exclusive rewards are genuinely important to you.

title: The basics about Open Arena
summary: Open Arena exists to answer a simple question: who understands Infinity Kingdom the best, when power advantages are removed? Unlike most PvP modes, Open Arena is not about account age, spending level, or long-term…
markdown:
### Introduction: The Purpose of Open Arena

Open Arena exists to answer a simple question: *who understands Infinity Kingdom the best, when power advantages are removed?* Unlike most PvP modes, Open Arena is not about account age, spending level, or long-term progression. It is a controlled competitive environment where every participant plays with the same resources and limitations.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-137.png)

Because of this, Open Arena is a mode that most accurately measures mechanical understanding, draft awareness, and strategic planning. Wins are earned through correct decisions rather than raw stats. That being said, players beware that results in the Open Arena are not transferable 1 to 1 to the general game, given how all skills and abilities scale off of your specific development, technology, attributes, buffs, etc.

---

## What Open Arena Is

Open Arena is a **free-for-all PvP mode** where players compete using standardized immortals, skills, and dragons. All participants enter with equalized levels and access to the same pool of options for the duration of the season.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-130-1024x555.png)

There are no alliances, no reinforcements, and no external buffs. Every match is a direct comparison of team construction and in-fight interactions.

The defining feature of Open Arena is that **no immortal or skill is guaranteed to be available every season**. Instead, each season introduces a rotating ban list that reshapes the meta from the ground up.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-132.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-133.png)

In terms of rewards, the event offer quite decent Stardust rewards, while it may not look like much for a seasonal event reward, Stardust is incredibly hard to obtain - especially for free to play players!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-134-1024x545.png)

---

## Equalization: How Open Arena Levels the Playing Field

One of the most important aspects of Open Arena is its **full normalization system**.

Immortals are treated as if they are fully leveled for the mode, regardless of a player’s actual progression. Skill availability is capped at a predefined Tower of Knowledge level set for the season. Dragons are similarly normalized, with fixed stat values and selectable specializations.

This means that a new player and a long-time veteran enter Open Arena with the **same raw power**. The only differences come from understanding how immortals, skills, and dragons interact under the season’s constraints.

Because of this, Open Arena heavily rewards players who understand:

- Scaling versus burst
- Energy generation and denial
- Control immunity windows
- Damage-over-time versus healing thresholds
- How fights evolve past 20 and 30 seconds

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-135-1024x502.png)

---

## The Role of Seasons in Open Arena

Open Arena runs in **seasons**, and each season functions almost like a soft reset of the meta.

At the start of a season, the game defines:

- Which immortals are banned
- Which skills are banned

These rules remain fixed for the entire season. There are no mid-season change to immortals, but the skills are on a timer which you should make note of as you select elements and build setups. This allows the seasonal meta to be changed up and possibly for someone to make a comeback during a season.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-136-1024x534.png)

---

## How Immortal and Skill Bans Work

The ban system is the core mechanic that keeps Open Arena from becoming stale.

Each season removes a **curated selection of immortals and skills** from play. Banned immortals and skills means that the game mode is constantly different from season to season as well as within seasons, meaning the game mode does not become stale as we figure out one build to rule them all. Instead, you must mix it up from season to season and test new combinations, ideas and strategies.

Bans often target:

- Key enablers rather than raw damage dealers
- Immortals that define an element’s identity
- Skills that create overly consistent outcomes

For example, banning a primary support can be more impactful than banning a carry, because it removes an entire class of compositions rather than a single unit.

Skill bans function the same way. Removing defensive staples or universal safety tools forces players to rethink sustain, protection, and timing.

The result is that **every season feels structurally different**, even when some immortals remain available.

---

## Elemental Identity Under Bans

Elements in Open Arena are not inherently strong or weak. Their viability is entirely dependent on which immortals survive the ban list.

An element may become unplayable if it loses:

- Its primary sustain engine
- Its energy accelerator
- Its only reliable frontline

Conversely, an element can rise sharply in value if its natural counters are banned.

This is why high-rank Open Arena play always begins with **ban analysis**, not team building. Experienced players first ask *what is no longer possible*, then build around what remains functional.

---

## Team Structure: Why Open Arena Uses Multiple Marches

Open Arena is not about creating one unbeatable team. It is about constructing a **set of teams** that work together.

Most competitive players approach Open Arena with a three-march mindset:

- One march designed to win cleanly and efficiently
- One march designed to trade health, disrupt sustain, or force attrition
- One march designed to finish weakened opponents reliably

Because fights happen in sequence, damage and losses carry strategic weight. A team that loses but leaves the enemy severely weakened can still be considered successful.

This layered approach is one of the defining skills of high-level Open Arena play. **[Read more about an examples from veteran players and winners of open arena seasons here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/elements/free-arena-builds/)**

---

## Conclusion: Why Open Arena Matters

At its core, Open Arena rewards:

- Understanding of fight pacing rather than raw damage
- Awareness of how bans reshape value
- Ability to plan across multiple fights, not just one
- Knowledge of skill synergies and anti-synergies
- Comfort with long-fight scaling and inevitability

Open Arena is Infinity Kingdom in its purest form. By removing progression advantages and enforcing seasonal constraints, it turns the game into a strategic puzzle rather than a power race.

For players who want to understand *why* certain builds work, how bans influence value, and what true competitive balance looks like, Open Arena is not just another mode—it is the reference point.

Every strong Open Arena season teaches lessons that apply everywhere else in the game.

---

In this guide we are going to have a look at the Magic Artifacts of Infinity Kingdom. For this one, we are going to look at the world of Primary and Secondary rolls on your magic artifacts. We will go over which rolls are better in what scenarios.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-11-08-104018.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-11-08-103953.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-11-08-103912.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Skaermbillede-2022-11-08-103857.png)

## Magic Artifact rolls

For mages, both crit and magic damage is very very powerful. Which matter the most depends on your build. If you are building a chase-crit build you want crit rate. If you are building a concentration-build, pure % is your friend. These are the rolls you should be looking for on your Magic Artifact.

**Crit-builds (chase)**: If you are above VIP 13 and you have high enough crit-rate, then the **Chase build**is a very powerful tool in your arsenal. You want to roll artifacts with

| Priority | Special | Primary Attribute | Secondary Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Deadly / Annihilation | Crit rate (%) | Crit rate (%) |
| 2 |  | Magical attack (%) | Crit rate Value |
| 3 |  | Crit Value / Magical Attack Value | Crit Damage Value |
| 4 |  |  | Magical (%) / Magical attack |
| 5 |  |  | Resilience/Dodge/Defenses |

**Non-Chase Magic Builds:**These are more tricky. Let's have a look at how the rolls you want change if you are not running chase.

| Priority | Special | Primary Attribute | Secondary Attribute |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Annihilation / Deadly | Magical attack (%) | Magical (%) |
| 2 |  | Magical Attack Value | Magical attack |
| 3 |  | Crit rate (%) | Crit rate (%) / Crit rate Value |
| 4 |  | Crit Value | Crit Damage Value |
| 5 |  |  | Resilience/Dodge/Defenses |

## Summation

**Basically you do not want to boost your crit-rate above all else unless you are building towards massive Chase-procs.**Instead we want to boost our magic damage in general to increase all the damage we are dealing.

**Be aware that if you are running Fire with Seon, this equation may change but that ultimately depends on your specific crit-rate of each and every Immortal as well as the build you are running. Anyone with Seon Fire's need to test for themselves and find the right level of crit-rate to ensure reliable procs with the passive setup and Immortal composition of choice.**

The Bonus you want is not given in advance, but is based on the critical hit rate you have and we need to figure out if Annihilation crit bonus is still better than the Deadly damage buff. We know above which stats we want to roll as primary and secondary. However it is a bit more tricky to figure out what Bonus is the best for you.

To help you figure this out, please see my **guide on Annihilation Versus Deadly Magic Artifact Bonuses here.**

title: Wish Grail October 2026 – Outfit Jackpots, Eternal Grail Odds & Best Spin
markdown:
![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134125-urdwhz.png)

The new jackpot options include Athena's *Summer Passion* outfit, Alexander the Great's *Summer Passion* outfit, and the familiar 300 Eternal Grails.

This potentially creates a new way for players to obtain older outfits after their original seasonal release. If Infinity Kingdom continues this approach, Wish Grail could become the place where previous seasonal outfits return.

But choosing an outfit means giving up the 300-Grail jackpot. So how much does that decision cost, how does it compare with Dazzling Wish, and which spin milestones provide the best value?

We've recalculated the probabilities, expected rewards, and milestone bonuses to find out.

## Wish Grail vs. Dazzling Wish – Which Is Better?

Both Wish Grail and Dazzling Wish use Tokens of Light, but they now offer distinctly different approaches to obtaining outfit fragments.

During Ghost Fiesta, **Dazzling Wish offers 20 Fu Fei *Night of Terror* fragments at a 0.2% drop chance**, while Wish Grail offers older Immortal outfits at a 0.45% jackpot chance.

The difference in Eternal Grail rewards is also substantial.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134229-t6xdjx.png)

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134334-g8t3vb.png)

Let's compare spending **200 Tokens of Light**, a realistic milestone for many active players.

*Wish Grail totals include the 100- and 200-spin milestone rewards. Dazzling Wish Grails are calculated from its published draw probabilities, excluding unspecified Surprise Event rewards.*

### Why Does Dazzling Wish Give Only 8 Expected Fragments?

The Dazzling Wish outfit reward contains 20 Fu Fei fragments, but its probability is only 0.2% per draw.

Over 200 draws, that's an expected 0.4 successful outfit drops:

**200 × 0.002 × 20 = 8 expected fragments.**

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134326-1y96ut.png)

That doesn't mean you'll actually receive eight fragments. In practice, you'll usually receive none, while lucky players receive 20 or more.

In fact, the probability of obtaining at least one outfit drop in 200 draws is approximately 33%.

To unlock Fu Fei's outfit from zero, players need 80 fragments, equivalent to four successful 20-fragment drops. The probability of achieving that through 200 ordinary draws is only about 0.076%, excluding other reward sources.

By comparison, Wish Grail offers a 59.4% chance of at least one selected outfit jackpot within 200 spins.

### Which Event Should You Choose?

For farming Eternal Grails, Wish Grail is clearly superior.

Even when selecting an outfit jackpot, its 787 expected Grails from 200 spins are almost twice the 408 expected from Dazzling Wish.

Wish Grail also offers better direct outfit drop probabilities, although the featured rewards are different.

**Choose Dazzling Wish if you specifically want the newest seasonal outfit**, such as Fu Fei's *Night of Terror*, or are competing for its ranking rewards.

**Choose Wish Grail if you want older outfits or want to maximize Eternal Grail income.**

## What's Changed in Wish Grail?

The Wish Grail now allows players to select one of three grand prizes:

The jackpot probability is identical regardless of which reward you select.

The normal wheel rewards remain available, including 50, 25, 5, and 1 Eternal Grail prizes.

The wheel also has a **pity mechanic guaranteeing a selected jackpot by the 300th consecutive spin without one**, according to the reported rule. The counter resets after a jackpot.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134405-oq3hfv.png)

### How Many Spins Does a Jackpot Take?

With a 0.45% drop chance, a jackpot would take an average of approximately **222 spins without pity**.

However, because Wish Grail guarantees a jackpot after 300 consecutive spins without one, the actual average waiting time becomes considerably shorter.

Including the pity mechanic, players need approximately **165 spins per jackpot on average**.

That means the expected waiting time is the same whether you select:

* 300 Eternal Grails
* 60 Alexander outfit fragments
* 20 Athena outfit fragments

The reward changes, but the probability does not.

This is a long-run average across repeated jackpot cycles. Individual players may hit their jackpot on the first spin, while others may need to reach the pity threshold.

## How Many Eternal Grails Can You Expect?

The regular wheel probabilities produce an average of **2.935 Eternal Grails per spin**, excluding the selected grand prize.

If you choose 300 Eternal Grails as your jackpot, the natural 0.45% jackpot probability contributes another 1.35 Grails per spin before pity effects.

This produces the familiar baseline of **4.285 Eternal Grails per Token of Light**, excluding milestone bonuses and pity improvements.

Choosing an outfit instead removes the 300-Grail jackpot reward, but leaves all ordinary Eternal Grail prizes and milestone bonuses intact.

### Comparing 200 Spins

Choosing the outfit jackpot costs an expected **270 Eternal Grails over 200 spins**.

In return, players have a 59.4% chance of receiving at least one outfit jackpot.

The expected rewards are:

* **Alexander:** 54 fragments from 200 spins.
* **Athena:** 18 fragments from 200 spins.

These are statistical averages, rather than the number of fragments a player will necessarily obtain.

Alexander fragments are awarded in batches of 60, meaning one successful jackpot is enough to unlock his outfit. Athena fragments come in batches of 20, so players may require multiple jackpots depending on their existing fragment balance.

**MY takeaway:** Outfit jackpots offer an attractive tradeoff. You're giving up approximately 26% of your expected Grail income at 200 spins, but gaining a meaningful chance of obtaining an older Immortal outfit.

## Wish Grail Milestones – How Far Should You Spin?

Wish Grail continues to award guaranteed Eternal Grails at specific spin milestones, regardless of the selected jackpot.

These bonuses substantially improve the total rewards, particularly for players who can reach a milestone rather than stopping just short of one.

### Expected Eternal Grails at Every Milestone

The following estimates include ordinary wheel prizes, the selected Grail jackpot where applicable, milestone bonuses, and the reported 300-spin pity rule.

*Expected averages rounded to whole Grails. Calculations assume that the pity counter resets after each jackpot and guarantees a hit on the 300th consecutive unsuccessful spin.*

The difference between the two jackpot configurations becomes more significant as the number of spins increases.

At 200 spins, choosing an outfit "costs" an expected 270 Grails.

At 1,000 spins, the difference grows to approximately 1,735 Grails.

At 1,500 spins, players selecting outfit jackpots give up approximately 2,645 expected Eternal Grails in exchange for their chances of obtaining outfit fragments.

### Which Milestone Is Most Efficient?

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134529-f4tr0r.png)

A useful way to evaluate the milestones is to examine how many Eternal Grails players receive per Token of Light spent.

![Screenshot](/uploads/screenshot-20261022-134309-y1h5lf.png)

At these milestones, the 300-Grail configuration reaches its highest average efficiency at 1,000 spins.

Interestingly, the outfit configuration also performs particularly well at 1,000 spins, thanks to the accumulated milestone bonuses.

However, reaching 1,000 spins requires substantially more Tokens of Light than most casual players will want to spend.

For most players, **200 spins remains a particularly accessible and attractive stopping point**, providing the first two milestone rewards and a meaningful chance at an outfit jackpot.

Higher-spending players should consider progressing toward 1,000 spins, particularly when maximizing Eternal Grail income is their main objective.

## Final Recommendations – Which Jackpot Should You Choose?

**Choose 300 Eternal Grails if:** Your priority is maximizing Eternal Grail income for Immortals, artifacts, and other seasonal shop purchases. This remains the strongest option for players focused on progression resources.

**Choose Alexander's outfit if:** You want *Summer Passion*. A single jackpot awards the full 60 fragments needed to unlock the outfit, making it a particularly attractive option.

**Choose Athena's outfit if:** You specifically want to unlock or upgrade *Summer Passion*. Her jackpot awards 20 fragments, so consider your existing fragment balance before committing Tokens.

**Choose Dazzling Wish if:** You want the newest seasonal outfit, such as Fu Fei's *Night of Terror*, or are interested in its ranking rewards.

For most casual spenders, 200 spins remains my recommended milestone. It offers excellent bonus rewards and allows players to participate without committing to the much more expensive 400–1,500-spin milestones.

## Final Thoughts

The October 2026 Wish Grail update is a meaningful improvement for players interested in collecting Immortal outfits.

Rather than obtaining new outfits only during their original seasonal release, players may now have opportunities to collect older designs through the Wish Grail.

Most importantly, selecting an outfit doesn't mean abandoning Eternal Grail farming entirely.

At 200 spins, players can still expect approximately 787 Eternal Grails while having a 59.4% chance of obtaining at least one outfit jackpot.

For players who don't care about outfits, selecting 300 Eternal Grails remains the better choice, providing approximately 1,057 Grails at the same milestone.

The long-run jackpot frequency is also relatively generous once the pity mechanic is considered, averaging approximately one jackpot every 165 spins.

**My recommendation:** Decide whether you value the selected outfit more than the Eternal Grails you're sacrificing. If the outfit matters to you, Wish Grail is now a compelling option. Otherwise, stick with the traditional 300-Grail jackpot and maximize your seasonal currency.

If Infinity Kingdom continues rotating previous seasonal outfits into the Wish Grail, this may become one of the game's most important recurring activities for outfit collectors.

title: The Forge: A Basic Introduction to Transmutation of Gold and Artifact Crafting
summary: I have received a lot of questions via my question channel from new players asking about how the forge works: Should they transmute gold and lose resources? How to make artifacts? How to get the right artifact…
markdown:
I have received a lot of questions via my question channel from new players asking about how the forge works: Should they transmute gold and lose resources? How to make artifacts? How to get the right artifact attributes? And so on. So in this little guide, we are going to take a look at how the forge works.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-17.png)

This will be a basic introduction to the forge, some tips and tricks, and a bit of mechanics on artifact crafting.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-18.png)

## The Forge: Functions and Priorities

The Forge has three primary functions:

1. **Transmuting Gold**
2. **Transmuting Artifact Materials**
3. **Crafting Artifacts**

### Transmuting Gold

Yes! You should always be transmuting. Never let your forge have downtime. You are going to need **a massive amount of gold** for dragons and immortal upgrades, so always keep your forge working on something.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-20-1024x420.png)

Prioritize transmuting gold and be mindful to time it correctly:

- Always transmute gold while in your **Dragon-Mint talents** (which give you a 10% increased gold transmutation speed).
- Plan out your transmutation of Artifact Materials and **possibly speed them up** just to get back to gold transmutation.
- **No downtime** means never letting the forge sit idle!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-19-1024x512.png)

### Important Tip:

- **Upgrade your Forge level as a priority!** It increases the **Minting Boost timer** as you upgrade. The **Linting Proportion thresholds** are extremely valuable to hit.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-21-1024x596.png)

## Artifact Crafting

**What Are Artifacts?**

Artifacts are **extremely powerful items** that you can equip to an immortal once they are **maxed**. "Maxed" means unlocking all **seven stars/diamond ranks**. After that, you unlock the **Artifact Slot** by spending an additional **120 immortal fragments**. Then, and only then, can you equip an artifact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-23-1024x561.png)

Note that there are **four different types of artifacts** corresponding to the immortal types:

- **Magic** (for mages)
- **Attack** (for frontline attackers)
- **Ranged** (for ranged attackers)
- **Support** (for healers and support-type immortals)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-22-1024x569.png)

## How Do You Get Artifacts?

You need **two things** to craft artifacts:

1. **Schematics** – Earned via events and the Mysterium. *(See my standalone guide on schematic collections for details.)*
2. **Materials** – Forged in the Forge by spending a significant amount of resources.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-24-1024x521.png)

### Important Tip:

- **Prioritize your most important damage dealer** with your first artifacts and artifact upgrades. Examples:  - **Water:** Merlin
- **Earth:** Alexander
- **Shadow:** Himiko
- **Fire:** Seondeok or Wu

### Artifact Materials

There are **four types of Materials**, and each type of artifact requires **two different materials**. Take note of which materials you need the most and ensure you are not wasting resources on artifacts you do not need.

### Artifact Rarity and Unlock Levels

Artifacts have different **rarity levels**:

- **Green** (Common) – Unlocked at Forge Level 20
- **Blue** (Uncommon) – Unlocked at Forge Level 25
- **Purple** (Rare) – Unlocked at Forge Level 30
- **Orange** (Epic) – Unlocked at Forge Level 35 *(the most important one!)*

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-25-1024x396.png)

### Should I Wait Until I Can Craft Epic Artifacts?

No! If you can **complete Stage 4 of Mysterium** and earn **green/blue/purple schematics**, **collect them for your best immortal and build**! Even a blue or purple artifact can be an improvement early on.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-26-1024x519.png)

## Building the Artifacts: Attributes and Bonuses

**How Do Artifact Attributes Work?**

When crafting an artifact, **its attributes roll randomly**:

1. **One main attribute modifier (top stat)**
2. **A range of affixes (sub-stats)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-28.png)

[**Read more here.**](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/artifacts/all-artifact-primary-secondary-and-bonus-rolls/)

Each of these rolls is random from a **pool of possible attributes**. For example, if you want **Physical Attack for your Ranged artifact on Seondeok**, you will have to craft multiple artifacts until you get the desired roll. You are not crafting in vain even if you do not get good rolls, since you will need a lot of artifacts to upgrade both the level EXP and bonus skill once you get a powerful roll with a bonus.

Additionally, **Artifacts can roll a Bonus Effect**, such as:

- **Attack Artifacts:** Physical Damage Boost or Attack Speed Bonus
- **Support Artifacts:** Healing Boost or Energy Regen Boost

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-29-1024x356.png)

Since these are also random, **you have to craft many artifacts** to get the perfect one.

### Important Tip:

- I personally **bank a lot of green schematics and materials**. Then, when I’m ready to craft an **Epic artifact**, I first **craft several greens** until I get **3 or 4 green artifacts in a row without a Bonus Roll**. I believe this increases the chance of getting a Bonus Roll on the Epic artifact that follows. *(This is not officially confirmed, but it feels like it works!)*

---

### Conclusion

The Forge is **one of the most essential features in the game** for long-term growth. Whether you’re minting gold for dragon upgrades, transmuting artifact materials, or crafting artifacts, **you should never let your forge sit idle**. Mastering artifact crafting will give you a huge advantage in battles, so start collecting schematics and forging materials early on. And remember— **patience is key when crafting the perfect artifact!**
