markdown:
Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on. We have a new Dragon Castle skin coming to Norheim! Today the 15th of july 2023 Infinity Kingdom releases a brand new and AWESOME looking castle skin with amazing bonuses and just brilliant animation.

**Introducing the Howling Wind, Wind dragon Castle skin!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-38.png)

## What does "the Howling Wind" do?

Every castle skin has unique beneficial effects, from building speed to rss gathering and troop HP. The Wrath of Thunder castle skin increases **Marching Speed by 5%** AND**increase resource gathering speed by 5%**. It is following the line made by the development team on these unique element dragon skins as this much like the Frozen Dragon Hive, the Wrath of Thunder and the Mountain barricade. We are getting two different 5% boosts.

Unfortunately, the boosts for this skin are horrible. Let's be honest here, 5% marching speed is not doing to do you any favours, it would be awesome if it could be used as speed-relocation in an Illusion Battlefield environment, but it cannot. It is simply army march speed and pretty close to useless for a skin boost. The second bonus to resource gathering is okay. With the new level 11 nodes we are collecting 15million ressources from a node in less than 3 hours by default. 5% speed is fine, but not something that is going to be valuable to anyone.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-39.png)

Basically, this is a COSMETIC and not a buff.

## How to get it?

You have to purchase bundles (any bundles) which yield a total of 50K gems. It dosen't matter what bundles you purchase, as long as there is a gem reward it counts towards your castle skin.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-40-1024x652.png)

In addition to the Castle skin, you are also recieving a brand new avatar frame

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-43.png)

You also recieve a new Msg Chatbox with a nice purple lightning look.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-41.png)

and lastly, you ofcourse get a nameplate to go with that new skin of yours!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/image-44.png)

## Bundles with gems

Most all bundles have gem rewards, but how to they scale?

Usually, a 5$ bundle yield 520 gems, a 10$ bundle yields 1,100 gems, a 20$ bundle yields 2,300 gems, a 50$ bundle yields 6,000 gems and a 99$ bundle yields 12,500 gems. These are the standard rewards and can be slightly different on special bundles.

### Read more about shop bundles

| USD | 4.99 | 9.99 | 19.99 | 49.99 | 99.99 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gems | 520 | 1100 | 2300 | 6000 | 12500 |
| 1 USD = in Gems | 104.21 | 110.11 | 115.06 | 120.02 | 125.01 |

As you can see, the more expensive bundles are finally worth buying! They offer a higher gem/USD spent reward.

Do however take note, that the contents of expensive bundle tiers is MUCH worse than the cheaper ones. Overall, it would still be FAR MORE value to purchase many small bundles despite the lower gem reward.

At an average cost between 104-125 gems per dollar you are doing to be spending around 400$-480$ to unlock the new Castle Skin.

title: The Icon, Day of Gratitude and Starlight Tribute mini event (november 2025)
summary: Day of Gratitude & Starlight Tribute Mini Event Guide - (aka the “Icon & Thanksgiving Mini Event”)
markdown:
***Day of Gratitude & Starlight Tribute Mini Event Guide** - (aka the “Icon & Thanksgiving Mini Event”)*

## Introduction

So this mini-event is basically IK’s seasonal Thanksgiving celebration, and it’s split into three parts: missions that give you “Exchange Coins,” the big *Icon Vote* contest, and a set of returner/inviter rewards tied to GTarcade’s backend system. If you’ve played any of the previous IK holiday mini-events, the structure will feel familiar — but this one’s definitely more community-focused than usual.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-95-1024x573.png)

You’ll also notice they added a small “Relive Your Saga” feature that gives you a neat little history certificate and some freebies. It’s not as deep as past versions, but hey, free rewards are always awesome!

Event runs: **November 24, 2025 → December 1, 2025 (00:00 UTC)**
So don’t wait too long to claim or exchange coins — IK *does* wipe unclaimed stuff at the end.

### Accession the event through the in-game button:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-96.png)

---

## Event Breakdown

## 1. Missions & Exchange Coins

The basic loop is simple: do missions → earn Exchange Coins → redeem them for cosmetics or upgrade materials. Most missions are F2P-friendly, but they definitely sprinkled in spender tasks that line up with Black Friday.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-97-1024x567.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-98-1024x569.png)

Honestly, the Exchange Shop isn’t the strongest one we’ve seen — the costs feel a bit steep. But the mission path itself is easy enough to clear daily if you’re even semi-active.

---

## 2. The Icon Vote (The Heart of the Event)

So this is the fun social part. IK picked **10 community candidates** based on server impact and contributions, and each one has a short story you can read on the event page. Seriously — read them. A bunch of players put real heart into those and they are all very good! I know it means quite a lot for me to be in there for the competition of IK-Icon, and I am sure it does for the others too. I encourage you to read them all and vote for whoever you find has the best story!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-103-1024x525.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-104-1024x538.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-105-1024x517.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-99-1024x510.png)

*Change note: I was in there as Charizard (server joke name) when writing this, but if you are reading this on the 28th or after, they have updated me to Myrahk.*

### How it works:

- Vote once per day from **Nov 24 to Dec 1**.
- Every vote gives you **1 Exchange Coin**.
- No “right” choice — literally vote for whoever resonates with you.

**Rewards for the top 3 Icons:**
This is actually pretty huge compared to past mini-events:

- **Hall of Fame Quote** on the loading screen
- **Territory Patrol NPC** across all players’ maps for one month
- **Official Interview** and feature via community channels

So yeah, it’s a cool way to support them!

---

## 3. Grateful Gift → GTarcade Store

This tab basically routes you to GTarcade to buy bundles. Since Black Friday hits mid-event, the timing is… well, exactly what you'd expect.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-106-1024x459.png)

If you’re a spender, you’ll probably get natural progression on several of the mission tasks anyway — good synergy.

---

## 4. “Relive Your Saga” – Small Bonus Reward Page

This is tucked at the bottom of the Reward Redemption page. It shows your starting date and generates a little certificate. It’s kinda stripped down compared to the older anniversary mini-features, but there’s a free gift. For me that was:

- **3x Philosopher Stones**
- **200 Gems**
- **81 Market Refreshes**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-107-1024x497.png)

Not mind-blowing, but definitely worth clicking!

---

## Returner & Inviter Event Details

## Who counts as a returner?

- Must have **not logged in since Oct 31, 2025 (00:00 UTC)**
- Must be **Castle Level 15+**

## What they get:

After entering your invitation code, returners receive:

- **Miraculous Descent x1**
- **Philosopher’s Stone x9**
- **Superior Resource Chest x10**
- **Speedy Construction x5**

Good chunk for someone jumping back in.

## What YOU get for inviting:

This is split into three milestones:

### Invite 1 returner:

- 9 Philosopher Stones
- 10 Stardust
- 10 Random Immortal Fragments

### Invite 5 returners:

- 1 Uncommon Dragon Crystal Selection Chest
- 20 Stardust
- 20 Random Immortal Fragments

### Invite 10 returners:

- 30 Stardust
- 1 Miraculous Descent
- 30 Random Immortal Fragments

Everything gets mailed to you in-game. Just don’t forget to claim before the event expires — IK *does* purge leftover progress.

---

## Reward Redemption – What’s Actually Worth Getting

Alright, so the shop has a mix of cosmetics and progression items. Opinions incoming.

### Cosmetics

- **King’s Feast Castle Skin** – 30 coins
- **Turkey Frenzy Avatar Frame**

If you’re into matching your city with the holiday vibe, go for it. IK doesn’t throw these skins around often.

### Progression Items

- Token of Lights
- AP / SP bottles
- Stardust / Crimson Moonlights if you need them bad.
- Epic Dragon Crystal Selection Chest

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/image-108-1024x496.png)

Here’s the take from someone who burns AP like crazy:

**AP & SP Bottles** → **top priority** if you're pushing gold farming or trying to climb Boost Levels. AP farming weekends hit hard, and I never feel like I have enough SP when trying to hit late-tier boost levels on immortals (SP if your main isnt max yet).

**Stardust** → expensive at **15 coins for 15**. But if you’re a someone who did not have the opportunity to use the Stardust Wheel event to bank Stardust, then this is a way to get some atleast.

**Token of Lights** → worth grabbing. These become lottery tickets when the next seasonal rolls in, and I’ve gotten lucky with big pulls in the past (not often… but it happens).

---

## My(rahk's) perspective

So if it were me playing this event right now:

- I’d hit the missions if not just for the AP/SP value.
- I wouldn’t chase cosmetics unless I was feeling festive — they’re nice, but Exchange Coins are tight.
- AP is king for farming infernal gold, and I have yet to regret hoarding SP—Boost Level pushes soak it up like crazy.
- Token of Lights are “future me” items, but I always try to grab at least a few just in case the next seasonal jackpot is spicy.
- For the Icon Vote, I’d genuinely read all 10 stories carefully and go with your heart whatever that may be!

---

title: The “Kamikaze” Rally
summary: This guide covers the Frosty Double Tank Crit Mage March, more commonly known as the Kamikaze march. The build and its underlying philosophy belong entirely to the player Alifer, who has been kind enough to openly share…
markdown:
## Frosty Double Tank Crit Mage March The “Kamikaze” Rally & Assist Composition

## Introduction & Credit

This guide covers the **Frosty Double Tank Crit Mage March**, more commonly known as the **Kamikaze march**.
The build and its underlying philosophy belong entirely to the player **Alifer**, who has been kind enough to openly share both the setup and the reasoning behind it with the community.

That generosity matters. This is not a surface-level build you arrive at by accident. It comes from testing, fighting real opponents, and understanding how Infinity Kingdom combat actually resolves in live KvK conditions.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-175-1024x887.png)

The march has proven extremely effective in **KvK rallies and assists**, especially against high-STP opponents. It is aggressive, deliberately expendable, and built to do one thing very well:
**deal overwhelming damage early, before the fight has time to stabilize**.

This article stays true to Alifer’s original intent while expanding the explanation into a clear, detailed reference for players who want to understand not only *what* to run, but *why* it works.

> **Full credit for this build goes to Alifer.**
> Thank you for sharing both the concept and the thought process behind it with the community.

---

## Build Identity & Intended Use

The Frosty Double Tank Crit Mage March is designed specifically for rally and assist play in **Infinity Kingdom**.

It is **not** designed to:

- Replace Energy Mastery marches
- Serve as a general PvE or Elemental Domain solution
- Win long, sustain-heavy duels on its own

Instead, it exists for a very clear purpose:

> **To land massive, front-loaded damage that sharply reduces enemy troop count before the fight settles into sustain.**

This march is expected to die. In fact, that is part of the design. Once its damage has been delivered, allowing it to fall prevents enemy supports from slowly healing through your tanks while maintaining safe troop numbers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-172.png)

In practical terms, this means:

- You lead rallies
- You clear weaker marches quickly
- You heavily damage enemy “problem” setups you may not kill yourself
- Your teammates finish the job with more rounded marches

It is an impact march, not a finisher.

---

## Core Combat Philosophy: Troop Count Is Everything

Even though this build is designed for team play, it still needs to be built intelligently.

Infinity Kingdom combat is brutally simple once you strip it down:
**almost everything scales with troop count.**

That includes:

- Damage output
- Healing values
- Shield strength
- Overall sustain

If you reduce an enemy’s troop count early, their ability to recover drops dramatically. This march is built around forcing that advantage in the **first few seconds of combat**, then letting damage scaling do the rest.

That is why the focus is on:

- Fast damage
- Consistent damage
- Damage that does not depend entirely on ultimates

---

## What Makes This Different From a Standard Double Tank Mage March

At first glance, this looks like a normal double-tank crit mage setup. The differences only become obvious once you understand the intent.

| Standard Double Tank Mage | Kamikaze March |
| --- | --- |
| Tank damage reduction | Tank shield specialization |
| Long-term sustain | Short-term HP preservation |
| Energy-centric damage | Cooldown-based damage |
| Designed to survive | Designed to trade |

This build deliberately abandons longevity. Everything is optimized around **damage delivered per second alive**, not around staying on the field as long as possible.

---

## Double Tank Shield Specialization Explained

Instead of stacking damage reduction, both tanks are specialized for **shield generation** with the Sturdy Barrier talent specialization.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-176.png)

In practice, this gives:

- ~70% shield proc chance per tank
- 6-second shield duration
- ~95% effective uptime with two tanks

Why this matters:

- Energy Shield lasts 3 seconds
- Tank specialization shields last **twice as long**
- Running two tanks massively increases overlap consistency

The result is near-constant shielding through the early and mid-fight. This absorbs chip damage and weaker alpha strikes without keeping the tanks alive longer than they should be. For rallies, this is ideal. You get protection while your damage matters, and you don’t leave behind durable tanks that allow the enemy to stabilize.

Furthermore, given how many players are running Wounds through either Qin or Khan, make note that shield values as a sustain is not impacted. The value of shielding is particularly important fighting into big Khan builds - which this build has proven to be able to handle!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-192.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-193-1024x640.png)

---

## Infinite Firepower + Chase: The Engine of the Build

The real heart of this march is the interaction between two skills:

- **Infinite Firepower** – 3-second cooldown
- **Chase** – 3-second internal cooldown

That timing is not a coincidence. It is the core of the build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-177-1024x640.png)

With sufficient crit rate:

- Crits reliably trigger Chase
- Chase lines up perfectly with Infinite Firepower
- The carry can output **~570 damage every 3 seconds**, even without ultimates

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-178.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-180.png)

This keeps the march dangerous even in the current *Knife Through Butter* meta, this matters a lot! The carry stays relevant even when energy flow is disrupted. And ofcourse, we are pushing for quick damage and you do not get much faster than some IF + Chase procs!

---

## Controlled Sustain: Staying Alive Just Long Enough

At first glance, it may seem strange to talk about sustain in a march that is explicitly designed to die. However, *when* a march dies is just as important as *that* it dies. The Frosty Double Tank Crit Mage March is not meant to outheal or outlast opponents, but it **does need to preserve troop count during the opening seconds of combat**, when damage scaling is at its most impactful.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-181.png)

This is where controlled sustain comes in. The goal is not recovery over time, but **short-term stability**. You want your troops to remain at high numbers long enough to deliver maximum front-loaded damage, then allow the march to collapse once its purpose has been fulfilled. First part of that is the shielding as discussed above. Second element is mitigation effects, stacking Earth Dragon, YSS, Oaken/Resist, Weakening Curse / No Escape and lastly the combo of Fountain of Life and Spring of Life - these two skills work together to achieve perfect uptime.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-184.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-185.png)

**Fountain of Life** plays a critical role despite being traditionally associated with healing-focused setups. In this build, its value lies elsewhere. With its short cooldown, Fountain of Life provides reliable **control immunity against silence effects**, which is especially important in rally scenarios where you need to counter ***No Escape*** commonly used to suppress early damage rotations.

Preventing crowd control during the opening moments ensures that the carry is allowed to crit, trigger Chase, and cycle Infinite Firepower on time. If those first few seconds are disrupted, the entire concept of the march begins to fall apart.

**Spring of Life** is taken specifically because it triggers off Fountain of Life. While it does not turn the march into a sustain comp, it provides **temporary damage mitigation** in synergy with frequent Fountain of Life healing. Together, these skills stabilize the march during the most dangerous phase of combat - before troop-based scaling locks in the advantage or disadvantage for the rest of the fight.

---

## Immortal Lineup Philosophy

The immortal selection for this march is not about survivability or late-game dominance. Each immortal is chosen because they either **enable early damage**, **prevent enemy recovery**, or **support shield uptime**.

### Emperor Qin Shi Huang

Emperor Qin serves as more than just a generic backline support-buff. His biggest contribution is the **wounds debuff**, which directly interferes with enemy healing. This ensures that even if the march loses the fight, it still leaves lasting damage behind. Ensuring the enemy is unable to to recover troop count through healing, which is exactly what you want in a rally chain. In rallies, even when losing the fight, you ensure that the enemy is wounded and at reduced troopcounts as it enters the next fight.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-186-1024x547.png)

Additionally, Qin is easy to raise to level 8 specialization, making him an efficient and accessible choice for this role.

### Emperor Qin’s Skill Choices

- **Fountain of Life** – CC immunity vs No Escape
- **Assist** – Protects the carry
- **Weakness** – One crit can permanently shift troop math

Qin runs **Fountain of Life** primarily to counter No Escape's initial silence effect. This ensures the march can function even when targeted by control-heavy rally defenses. **Assist** is included to keep pressure off Himiko, protecting the carry during the early exchanges. Finally, **Weakness** is chosen because even a single crit can permanently alter troop math, especially in rally chains where multiple marches follow.

---

### Himiko — Primary Carry

Himiko is the centerpiece of the build. She provides top-tier mage damage, a strong Shadow elemental advantage, and most importantly, an **AoE ultimate** that ranks amongst the best nukes in the game.

### Himiko’s Skill Choices

- **Chase** – Mandatory
- **Concentration** – Damage amplification
- **Infinite Firepower** – Preferred legendary

**Alternatives:** Spell Disintegration / Annihilation

**[*Note: Infinite Firepower works fine at low levels. If unavailable, prioritize Chase first.*](Note: Infinite Firepower works fine at low levels. If unavailable, prioritize Chase first.)**

Himiko’s setup is non-negotiable at its core. **Chase** is mandatory and forms the backbone of the damage engine. **Concentration** amplifies all outgoing damage, further rewarding early troop preservation. **Infinite Firepower** is the preferred legendary skill, not because of burst alone, but because its cooldown lines up perfectly with Chase.

If Infinite Firepower is unavailable, **Spell Disintegration** or **Annihilation** can be used instead. However, it is important to understand that Infinite Firepower functions well even at low levels. If resources are limited, prioritizing Chase first is always the correct decision.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-187-1024x569.png)

Her kit allows the march to pressure multiple targets and generate consistent crit-based procs, even when ultimate timing is delayed. Note that you want to be running a Crit % + Annihilation Artifact as usual. This gives the highest performance through burst damage in ultimate hits as well as in synergy with Chase.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-188.png)

---

### Charles

Charles plays a dual role. First, he contributes to the **double tank shield strategy**, providing long-duration shields that mitigate early damage without prolonging the fight unnecessarily. Second, his unique ability reduces enemy crit chance, which directly weakens opposing burst setups during the opening exchanges.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-189-1024x551.png)

This combination makes Charles an excellent candidate for shield specialization and a natural fit for an aggressive rally march.

### Charles's Skill Choices

- **Oaken Guard** or **Resist** (enemy-dependent)
- **Spring of Life** – Synergy with Fountain
- **Rage Blessing** – Ensures early ultimate timing

Charles adapts slightly depending on the opponent. **Oaken Guard** or **Resist** should be selected based on whether the enemy relies more heavily on physical or magical damage. **Spring of Life** is taken specifically for its synergy with Fountain of Life, reinforcing the controlled sustain window. **Rage Blessing** ensures that at least one early ultimate is cast, which is critical since damage scales heavily with troop count at that stage.

---

### Yi Sun-sin

Yi Sun-sin rounds out the frontline with reliable mitigation and consistency. He does not dominate any single aspect of combat, but he supports the march’s overall stability with a powerful mitigation effect as well as a heal buff that stacks with Spring of Life through his Unique Artifact, while we are not building into healing, Fountain of Life alone provides quite a lot of healing (note that increased healing effects do NOT work on shield values).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-191-1024x617.png)

His presence helps smooth incoming damage just enough to keep the carry operational while the damage engine does its work.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-190-1024x560.png)

### Yi Sun-sin’s Skill Choices

- **Weakening Curse** or **No Escape** (match opponent)
- **Heart of Arcana** – Carry amplification
- **Energy Suppression** – Energy tempo control

Yi Sun-sin’s setup focuses on disruption and amplification. **Weakening Curse** is excellent against burst-heavy opponents, while **No Escape** can be selected against ultimate-centric marches that are not running Fountain of Life. **Heart of Arcana** amplifies the carry’s output, and **Energy Suppression** helps control the energy tempo, increasing the likelihood that your damage lands before the enemy can respond.

---

## Strengths and Weaknesses in Practice

The greatest strength of this march is its **early damage output**. Combined with near-constant shield uptime and strong anti-healing effects, it excels at rally pressure and garrison breaking. It punishes troop-scaling mechanics extremely hard and creates favorable conditions for follow-up marches.

However, there are clear trade-offs. The build performs poorly in PvE content that requires Energy Mastery and sustained damage cycles. It is also hard-countered by specific tools, most notably **Poseidon** and **Iron Curtain**, which can blunt or negate its early impact. Finally, the march requires solid investment into crit to function at its intended power level.

---

## Player Experience & Results

In live KvK testing, this march has:

- Defeated multiple T8 marches using T7 troops
- Absorbed **as much as 59 million damage** through tank shields alone across a rally
- Consistently weakened whale marches for follow-up kills

The march does not succeed by surviving. It succeeds by **forcing bad damage math on the enemy from the opening seconds onward**.

---

## Conclusion

The Frosty Double Tank Crit Mage March is a deliberately aggressive, mechanically efficient rally tool. It exploits cooldown alignment, shield probability, and troop-based scaling to create decisive early advantages.

Used alone, it is risky.
Used in coordination, it is devastating.

All credit for this build goes to **Alifer**, whose willingness to share both results and reasoning has given the community access to a genuinely effective rally concept.

---

title: The Merchant and his goods
summary: Commanders, brace yourselves for the latest addition to Infinity Kingdom— the enigmatic Deep Sea Merchant. As a beacon of opportunities, this Mysterious Merchant Ship docks at your shores every Saturday, bringing with…
markdown:
### Navigating the Depths: A Player's Guide to the Deep Sea Merchant in Infinity Kingdom

Commanders, brace yourselves for the latest addition to Infinity Kingdom— the enigmatic Deep Sea Merchant. As a beacon of opportunities, this Mysterious Merchant Ship docks at your shores every Saturday, bringing with it a trove of treasures and bargains waiting to be explored. In this comprehensive guide, we'll delve into the intricacies of the Deep Sea Merchant, providing insights on how to make the most of this weekly event.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-184-1024x473.png)

### 1. Unlocking the Secrets: Requirements and Availability

Unlocking the Deep Sea Merchant requires servers to have progressed to at least season 2. Once this milestone is achieved, the Mysterious Merchant Ship graces your kingdom every Saturday, remaining accessible for a duration of two days.

### 2. Feature Rules:

#### A. Diverse Offerings:

1. **Shop with Gems:** The Deep Sea Merchant presents a unique opportunity to spend Gems on a variety of valuable items, including Crimson Moonlight, Stardust, Gold, Loren's Heart, and more.
2. **Changing Prices:** Unlike conventional shops, the pricing of items within the Deep Sea Merchant is not fixed. The first few purchases are accompanied by a discount, but as you continue, the prices will progressively increase.

#### B. Strategic Purchases:

While the Mysterious Merchant Ship offers a range of items, two stand out as crucial acquisitions:

1. **Crimson Moonlight for Chaos Portrait Levels:** Commanders seeking to enhance their Chaos Portrait levels should prioritize purchasing Crimson Moonlight. These items can significantly contribute to the progression of Chaos Portraits.
2. **Stardust for Epic Portrait Levels:** For those aiming to elevate their Epic Portrait levels, investing in Stardust is paramount. Keep an eye on Stardust bundles available at the merchant, as they play a pivotal role in your portrait level advancements.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-186-1024x551.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-188-1024x555.png)

### 3. Strategic Insights:

#### A. Resource Management:

The pricing of certain items, such as gold and resources, may escalate rapidly. It's advisable to exercise caution and avoid spending Gems on these unless absolutely necessary.

#### B. Personal Experience:

The author, not having Chaos portraits, has found immense value in purchasing Stardust from the merchant. **[For a detailed breakdown of Stardust bundle costs and their implications, refer to the guide here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/the-deep-sea-eye-merchant/cost-of-maxing-stardust-for-portrait-levels/)**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/image-190.png)

### 4. Conclusion:

The Deep Sea Merchant stands as a dynamic marketplace, offering strategic commanders the chance to enrich their kingdoms with coveted items. Whether you are seeking Chaos Portrait advancements or striving for higher Epic Portrait levels, the Deep Sea Merchant has something to offer. Navigate the changing tides, make informed choices, and let the treasures of the Deep Sea Merchant enhance the strength and prosperity of your kingdom. Happy sailing, commanders!

markdown:
This guide is part of my article series on lightning builds. If this build is not to your likeing, have a look at the rest of my builds on the lightning build page. I have multiple builds for any taste available, IB, PvE, arena/ToS builds and F2P/cheap builds.

This article is on magic lightning. As you know, there are many water and earth mains, which makes lightning a strong team to master. Moreover, Lightning is surprisingly strong as a F2P or low-spender! If you are patient and smart about it, you can **unlock Genghis Khan for free** via events like Spring Fiesta + you can unlock **Hammurabi through the KoH**(needs to be maxed via Pearl shop tho). **This makes our BiS lightning team one of the cheapest top tier marches.**

**[Tokugawa](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/combat/immortals/new-immortal-tokugawa-lightning/)**is unlocked through the Conquest P2 seasonal rewards and in shop bundles post-P2 conquest. At the time of writing (15th Oct. 2022) we have P2 in the very oldest server group. Hence, Tokugawa is about to be released, but is not actually avilable to anyone yet.

This is a very strong build that works as an allround lightning build for the player who needs lightning to do everything. Beware, that you may struggle a bit on bosses. As such, you should check out my lightning boss build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/L03-Next-meta-Khan-Hammu-Louis-Tokugawa-Lightning-1024x576.png)

## Setup

This setup is pretty standard and revolves around pumping big burst damage while maintaining "**wounds**" from Khan as well as to allow Tokugawa to shield and sustain the team.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-05-215920-1024x624.png)

Moreover, Louis and Khan adds a very nice DPS. This setup is NOT built as a counter to holy, you can do more to counter holy marches (see Lightning holy-counter guide).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-7-1024x599.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/image-8.png)

This setup performs well versus all marches and especially kills earth teams (if your tech is too low for energy regen. You might need to setup your Khan with adrenaline so you get wounds off before water dragon heals).

Since Tokugawa has not been released yet, I have been using Charles to test things in his place. And oh boy does it work! This team wrecks everything. It deals so much damage from Khan and especially from Hammurabi. Moreover, having shields in lightning, means you are no longer the glass-canon type setup.

What are the differences from Charles testing and into Tokugawa? Tokugawa's shield is not as strong as Charles'. First of all it is 300% where Charles' is 400%. Moreover, Tokugawa's shield is only defending against physical damage, which means you are VERY weak to big magic setups. This will kill you. However, Tokugawa adds insanely strong debuffs to the enemy, which both hamstring the enemy damage dealer AND improve you damage by as much as 60% from the added debuffs on your target boosting damage from Hammurabi, since you will be running 3-4 stacks of debuffs consistently whilst shields are up.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-15-131228.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-15-131219.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-15-131158.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Skaermbillede-2022-10-15-131210.png)

### You want to run this passive loadout:

**Hammurabi**: Annihilation + Nova + Chase // concentration (*based on your crit tech*).

**Genghis Khan**: Death Breath + Anger + Energy Burst (Fighting Master to counter earth)

**Louis**: Fighting Will + Weakness + Energy Suppression

**Tokugawa**: Oaken Guard + Malice + Adrenaline Rush

title: The Rewards of Contention of Relics (CoR): A Treasure Trove for All
summary: The Contention of Relics (CoR) event an epic event in Infinity Kingdom, most of all because of its insane rewards for players of ALL sizes. This is an amazing event for Free to Play players and whales alike. CoR isn’t…
markdown:
### The Rewards of Contention of Relics (CoR): A Treasure Trove for All

The *Contention of Relics (CoR)* event an epic event in *Infinity Kingdom*, most of all because of its insane rewards for players of ALL sizes. This is an amazing event for Free to Play players and whales alike. CoR isn’t just a competition—it’s a kingdom-wide opportunity for growth, progression, and unity. Whether you’re an individual player aiming for glory or a leader strategizing for your alliance, CoR offers a dazzling array of rewards that make every effort worthwhile.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-169-1024x435.png)

Let’s break down the rewards from CoR, their significance, and how to maximize their benefits for yourself, your alliance, and your kingdom.

---

### How Rewards Work in CoR

CoR rewards come in two main forms:

1. **Alliance Rewards (Energy Cubes)**:  - Measured by the total **Energy Cubes** your alliance gathers during the event.
- Energy Cubes are earned by:  - Killing Chaos Beasts.
- Farming Energy Nodes.
- Occupying Relics in the Forbidden Zone.
2. **Individual Rewards (Honor)**:  - Based on the **Honor Points** you personally earn during battles in the Forbidden Zone.
- PvP combat within the zone is the key to racking up Honor Points.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-168.png)

Both types of rewards translate into **Valor Marks**, a currency that can be spent in the exclusive CoR Shop. Note: Alliance Valor Marks are distributed by R6 leaders, so maintaining good standing with your leadership is important!

---

### The CoR Shop: Your Gateway to Progress

Depending on your faction’s placement in CoR (1st, 2nd, or 3rd), your shop’s offerings will differ. However, even for lower placements, the shop is a massive source of resources and key progression items.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-170-1024x541.png)

#### Top-Tier Rewards

1. **Empress Wu Immortal Fragments**:  - First-place alliances gain access to Wu fragments, essential for building a powerful Fire march.
- Wu is also available in Arena rewards during Season 1, but CoR provides a critical boost for players focusing on Fire.
2. **Philosopher’s Stones**:  - Regardless of your placement, these are available and invaluable for upgrading immortals and for simply melting into Purple Crystals to upgrade those vital Tower of Knowledge skills.
3. **Fragments for Ashoka or Frederik**:  - Even second- and third-place alliances can secure valuable fragments to strengthen Fire and other marches. These can perform fine to run in a fire-setup if you are short Trajan and Seondeok.

---

### Kingdom Rewards: Buffs and Bonuses for All

#### Crowning a King

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-171.png)

The faction that wins CoR appoints a **King**, who holds the power to:

- Distribute exclusive gifts to alliance members.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-172.png)

- Grant the **Forbidden Zone Sovereign** castle skin to a deserving player.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-173.png)

#### Royal Buffs

The King can activate **Royal Orders**, which provide buffs for the entire kingdom. These buffs can be used strategically during wars or server-wide events to ensure dominance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-174.png)

#### Post-Event Special Nodes

Winning CoR triggers the appearance of special resource nodes in the Forbidden Zone.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-175.png)

These nodes are extreemly important as they offer:

- **Gold**: Critical for technology upgrades and troop training.
- **Speedups**: Essential for healing, training, and construction during and after intense battles.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/image-176.png)

**TIP**: The amount of Arcane Treasure Nodes made available after a CoR event is complete, is based on the winning factions collection of Energy Cubes. As such, even if you do pass the 300K mark for maximum event rewards, you should keep farming nodes and keep repeatedly sieging the World Heart for as many Energy Cubes as possible! These nodes make a huge difference, especially in younger servers!

---

### Why CoR Rewards Are Vital

#### For Free-to-Play (F2P) Players

- The CoR Shop is a vital source of fragments for building a second march, particularly the Fire march, which becomes essential as you progress.
- Valor Marks allow access to resources that are otherwise challenging to acquire for F2P players.

#### For Alliances

- Energy Cubes boost alliance progression and morale.
- Winning alliances receive significant rewards, enabling them to stand stronger in future battles, including the **Legion of Frostborne** and **Kingdom vs. Kingdom (KvK)** events.

#### For the Kingdom

- The event’s rewards help unify a server by fostering collaboration and growth.
- Strategic management of CoR ensures all factions within the server grow stronger, an absolute necessity for succeeding in KvK.

---

### Maximizing CoR Rewards

1. **Coordinate with Your Alliance**  - Work together to secure relics, nodes, and Energy Cubes. Unity is the key to victory.
2. **Farm Efficiently**  - Focus on Chaos Beasts and Energy Nodes to maximize contributions to alliance rewards.
3. **Prioritize Honor Farming**  - Engage in PvP combat within the Forbidden Zone to climb individual rankings.
**Tip**: Use Honor Talents to farm Honor by sending talent-attacks against a castle where you have stacked maximum garrisons. Read more in my Honor Guides.
4. **Plan Ahead**  - Save resources, speedups, and healing items before CoR begins. Prepared players earn more rewards.

---

### Final Thoughts

The *Contention of Relics* is not just about winning battles; it’s about building a stronger kingdom. The rewards—from exclusive Immortal fragments to special resource nodes—make it a cornerstone event for every player in *Infinity Kingdom*.

So, roll up your sleeves, rally your alliances, and take advantage of every opportunity CoR provides. Whether you’re chasing Empress Wu fragments, Philosopher’s Stones, or the glory of being crowned King, this event has something for everyone.

**Don’t just participate—dominate. And remember, in CoR, every contribution counts.**

title: Theias Roulette - Pricing, chance calculations, and more
summary: Patch 2.9.8 significantly changed the value of Theia’s Roulette by adding selectable Holy and Shadow Dragon Crystal rewards. The event can still be used to target Holy and Shadow Immortal fragments, but it is now also…
markdown:
Patch 2.9.8 significantly changed the value of **Theia’s Roulette** by adding selectable **Holy and Shadow Dragon Crystal** rewards. The event can still be used to target Holy and Shadow Immortal fragments, but it is now also one of the most direct ways to collect the crystals needed to develop the two premium dragons.

This guide focuses on the new Dragon Crystal wheel: how the rewards work, what the pity system actually does, how many crystals you can expect per spin, and what those crystals cost through the different ticket options.

## Table of Contents

- What Is Theia’s Roulette?
- How the Dragon Crystal Wheel Works
- Drop Rates and the 25-Spin Guarantee
- Expected Dragon Crystals per Spin
- Expected Rewards at Each Milestone
- Raffle Ticket Prices
- Which Milestones Are Worth Reaching?
- Final Thoughts

## 1. What Is Theia’s Roulette?

Theia’s Roulette is a recurring three-day event that currently runs from Thursday through Saturday. Players choose a featured grand prize and spend **Raffle Tickets** to spin the wheel. One free spin is available each day, while additional spins require tickets obtained with Gems or purchased through bundles.

The selectable grand prizes include Holy and Shadow Immortal fragments, Exclusive Artifact fragments, and, following Patch 2.9.8, **350 Holy Dragon Crystals or 350 Shadow Dragon Crystals**.

The reward table changes according to the grand prize you select. The calculations in this article apply specifically when **Holy or Shadow Dragon Crystals** are selected. They should not be used to estimate the fragment or artifact versions of the wheel.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-113-1024x573.png)

Players can make up to 9,999 spins per day, so the daily spin limit will not matter to anyone outside the most extreme spending levels.

## 2. How the Dragon Crystal Wheel Works

When Holy or Shadow Dragon Crystals are selected, the roulette contains 12 reward slots:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-109-1024x160.png)

If you select the Holy Crystal reward, both the 350-crystal jackpot and the five 45-crystal rewards provide Holy Dragon Crystals. Selecting the Shadow version changes those rewards to Shadow Dragon Crystals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-114.png)

The wheel therefore has an **8.2% displayed chance to award Dragon Crystals on an ordinary spin**. Most spins still produce resource packages, but the short jackpot guarantee greatly improves the long-term crystal return.

## 3. Drop Rates and the 25-Spin Guarantee

The 350-crystal grand prize has a natural drop rate of 3%. Without any protection, a 3% reward would appear once every 33.3 spins on average.

Theia’s Roulette does not make players wait that long. If the grand prize has not appeared earlier, it is guaranteed by the 25th spin. Whenever the 350-crystal reward is won, including an early natural hit, the counter immediately resets and a new 25-spin cycle begins.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-115-1024x193.png)

This is the important correction to the previous guide. The system is not a fixed block in which players make 25 spins and then receive a separate bonus. An early jackpot ends the current cycle immediately. You might win the jackpot on spin five, reset the counter, and win another one several spins later.

With the 3% natural rate and the 25-spin guarantee combined, the average jackpot cycle lasts approximately **17.8 spins**. The effective long-term jackpot rate is therefore much better than the displayed 3% chance alone suggests.

## 4. Expected Dragon Crystals per Spin

The expected return comes from two parts.

### The 350-Crystal Jackpot

The average jackpot cycle is approximately 17.8 spins: **350 ÷ 17.8 = approximately 19.7 Dragon Crystals per spin**

### The Five 45-Crystal Slots

The five smaller crystal slots have a combined drop rate of 5.2%: **45 × 5.2% = 2.34 Dragon Crystals per spin**

### Total Expected Value

Adding the two sources together gives: **19.7 + 2.34 = approximately 22.04 Dragon Crystals per spin**

For practical planning, it is easiest to use a rounded figure of:

> ### Approximately 22 Holy or Shadow Dragon Crystals per Raffle Ticket

This is an average, not a promise. The 25-spin guarantee prevents an extremely long jackpot drought, but results can still vary because early jackpots and the five smaller crystal slots are random.

One recorded 180-spin run produced **3,330 Holy Dragon Crystals**, equal to 18.5 crystals per spin. The theoretical return from 180 spins is approximately 3,967 crystals, so that result was around 16% below the expected average. A different run could finish above the average if several jackpots arrive early.

## 5. Expected Rewards at Each Milestone

The following estimates use the average return of 22.04 Dragon Crystals per spin:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-110-1024x254.png)

The milestone rewards remain separate from the Dragon Crystals won on the wheel. Players receive **10 Shadow and Light Selection Chest II** at 50, 100, 200, 350, 500 and 700 spins, followed by **60 chests at 900 spins**. Reaching every milestone therefore provides 120 selection chests in total.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-116.png)

These milestone chests are still important when judging the event’s overall value, but they should not be counted as additional Dragon Crystals.

## 6. Raffle Ticket Prices

Raffle Tickets can be obtained with Gems, through the in-game shop, or through GTArcade bundles.

### Gem Tickets

One ticket costs **1,000 Gems**. The current event offers up to 50 Gem tickets per day, and players also receive one free spin on each of the event’s three days.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-117-1024x526.png)

At the expected rate of 22.04 crystals per ticket: **1,000 Gems = approximately 22 Dragon Crystals**

### Approximately 4,537 Gems = 100 expected Dragon Crystals

### GTArcade Bundles

The three smaller GTArcade packs provide the strongest direct ticket value:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-111-1024x192.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-118-1024x576.png)

At $0.50 per spin, the expected cost is approximately:

> ### $2.27 per 100 Holy or Shadow Dragon Crystals

The $5, $10 and $20 GTArcade packs should therefore be purchased before the larger packs when they are available.

### In-Game Cash Bundles

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/image-112-1024x194.png)

The first three in-game packs cost approximately $1 per spin, twice the price of the equivalent smaller GTArcade packs. At that rate, 100 expected Dragon Crystals cost approximately **$4.54**.

Prices can vary slightly by region, tax and platform, so always check the live shop before purchasing.

## 7. Which Milestones Are Worth Reaching?

The best stopping point depends on whether you mainly want Dragon Crystals or whether the Selection Chest II milestones also matter to your account.

### Free and Low-Spending Players

Always use the three free spins. Beyond that, only spend Gems if you are actively developing the Holy or Shadow Dragon and are comfortable committing a meaningful amount of Gems to it.

The **50-spin milestone** is the first sensible target. It produces approximately 1,100 Dragon Crystals on average and awards 10 Selection Chest II rewards. Because three spins are free, reaching it requires 47 purchased tickets if you complete all three free spins first.

The **100-spin milestone** is also efficient because the additional 50 spins award another 10 selection chests. For players making a controlled investment, 50 or 100 spins are the cleanest stopping points.

### Medium Spenders

The 200-spin milestone provides approximately 4,400 Dragon Crystals and 30 cumulative selection chests. It is a reasonable target when the Dragon Crystals themselves are the priority, but the milestone value becomes weaker after the first 100 spins.

The 350, 500 and 700 milestones each add only 10 selection chests. They are not especially attractive stopping points on milestone value alone. Continue into this range because you need the crystals, not because the reward bar is offering an exceptional bonus.

### Heavy Spenders

If you are already planning to pass 700 spins, the **900-spin milestone** is worth completing. The final 200-spin segment awards 60 Selection Chest II rewards, compared with only 10 at the preceding milestones.

A full 900-spin run produces approximately **19,836 Dragon Crystals** and all 120 selection chests on average. Using the smaller GTArcade packs at roughly $0.50 per ticket, the ticket value is approximately **$450**, before allowing for the three free spins and any tickets bought with Gems.

This does not make 900 spins appropriate for everyone. It simply means that stopping between 700 and 900 is poor milestone planning if you already intend to spend at that level.

## 8. Final Thoughts

Patch 2.9.8 has given Theia’s Roulette a much clearer purpose. Players can now directly target the extremely scarce Holy or Shadow Dragon Crystals instead of relying on less focused reward sources.

The key number is approximately **22 Dragon Crystals per spin**. That makes the smaller GTArcade packs the best cash option at roughly $2.27 per 100 expected crystals, while Gem tickets offer a no-cash route at 1,000 Gems per spin.

For most players, 50 or 100 spins provide the best combination of manageable cost, Dragon Crystal progress and milestone rewards. The middle milestones are mainly worthwhile when the crystals themselves are urgently needed. The 900-spin target is reserved for major investment, but its final 60-chest reward makes it the logical finish for anyone already pushing beyond 700.

Most importantly, choose the Dragon Crystal reward that supports a dragon you are actually building. Theia’s Roulette is much better after the update, but 1,000 Gems or real money spent on the wrong dragon is still wasted progression.

title: Thermal Towers
summary: In the Legion of Frostborne battleground of Infinity Kingdom, Thermal Towers play a pivotal role in alliance strategy, providing both vision and protection against the harsh blizzard conditions. Understanding their…
markdown:
In the **Legion of Frostborne** battleground of **Infinity Kingdom**, **Thermal Towers** play a pivotal role in alliance strategy, providing both **vision** and **protection** against the harsh blizzard conditions. Understanding their mechanics is crucial for any alliance aiming for dominance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-21-1024x472.png)

---

## Overview of Thermal Towers

Thermal Towers serve dual purposes:

- **Vision Proximity:** They illuminate surrounding areas, revealing enemy movements and strategic points.
- **Geothermal Zones:** These zones negate blizzard damage, ensuring safe passage and stationing for your troops.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-123-1024x561.png)

Constructing and managing these towers effectively can significantly influence the outcome of the battleground.

---

## Production and Storage

- **Alliance Resources:** Producing Thermal Towers requires alliance resources. As members gather resources in the Frozen Realm, a portion is converted into alliance reserves without diminishing individual collections.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-126-1024x568.png)

- **Production Process:** Only alliance leaders (R6) and officers (R5) can initiate tower production. Each tower is produced sequentially, consuming time and resources, with an option for "Quick Production" at an increased resource cost to expedite the process.
- **Storage Capacity:** The alliance warehouse can store up to **20 unplaced Thermal Towers**. It's advisable to maintain this maximum to ensure rapid deployment when necessary.

---

## Construction and Deployment

- **Initial Placement:** The first tower can be placed anywhere within your alliance's vision and outside the geothermal zones of other alliances.
- **Subsequent Placements:** New towers must be within the vision range of existing ones and cannot overlap with geothermal zones of other alliances.
- **Unbuilt-chaining**: You can build a thermal tower off the chain-range of another thermal tower immediately upon placing the initial tower. This means that you do not have to complete each thermal tower before placing a new in the chain. Long chains of unbuilt towers means you can quickly chain to key objectives.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-121.png)

- **Construction Speed:** Alliance members can dispatch up to 70 marches to accelerate building. More participants lead to faster completion.
- **Fast Build Option:** Utilizing the "Quick Production" or "Wonder Builder" tactics can significantly reduce construction time, but the tactics have a high cooldown timer.

---

## Strategic Management

- **Continuous Production:** To maintain momentum, ensure the production queue operates 24/7. Rotate R5 officers to oversee this process, as only they and the R6 leader have the authority to initiate production.
- **Skill Utilization:** As your alliance progresses, you'll unlock skills like **Wonder Builder**, which instantly completes the next tower's construction. These skills have limited uses and cooldowns but reset daily, so plan their activation strategically.
- **Dismantling and Abandoning:** Unnecessary towers can be dismantled by allied attacks, a process that takes time. Alternatively, unbuilt towers can be abandoned within an hour of placement.
- **Diplomatic Expansion:** You can place a tower within the range of an allied alliance's tower, leveraging diplomatic relations for strategic positioning.
- **Enemy Engagement:** Attacking an enemy's tower grants visibility of that tower, offering tactical advantages.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-22.png)

---

## Advanced Tactics

- **Alt Alliances:** Creating alternate alliances (which must be at least level 4 to enter the battleground) allows for the placement of initial Thermal Towers anywhere on the map. By allying these alt alliances through diplomacy, you can chain towers from these positions, facilitating rapid expansion.
- **Blocking Strategies:** Use alt alliances to strategically block areas, such as regions around Ymir or critical gates. By placing Thermal Towers and shielded alt castles, you can hinder enemy movement and control key zones.
- **Offensive Operations:** Encourage all alliance members to target enemy Thermal Towers aggressively. Deploying smaller players or alt castles into enemy territories to dismantle towers forces opponents to spread their defenses thin, covering multiple fronts simultaneously.
- **Defensive Measures:** Assign your strongest players to defend critical areas. When constructing a tower in a contested zone, have multiple troops garrison it, with top players sending their strongest marches last. This setup ensures that any enemy attack must first overcome the formidable defense of your strongest members. Also, there are a number of defensive tactics - shielding thermals and instantly healing thermals.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-124.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/image-125.png)

---

## Conclusion

Mastering the use of Thermal Towers in the Legion of Frostborne battleground is essential for any alliance aiming for supremacy. By understanding their mechanics, maintaining continuous production, and employing advanced strategies, your alliance can secure strategic advantages, control vital areas, and pave the way to victory.

title: Throne of Blood
summary: The new Throne of Blood castle skin released during the May 2026 Hunting Festival is, in my opinion, one of the strongest all-around battle-pass skins Infinity Kingdom has introduced in quite a while.
markdown:
## Introduction

The new **Throne of Blood** castle skin released during the May 2026 Hunting Festival is, in my opinion, one of the strongest all-around battle-pass skins Infinity Kingdom has introduced in quite a while.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-102-1024x533.png)

The reason is not simply because it gives combat stats. Many skins do that. What makes Throne of Blood stand out is that it combines what is arguably the best combat attribute in the game with what I consider the best long-term development attribute.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-103.png)

That combination gives the skin immediate PvP relevance while also quietly accelerating account progression every single day.

To properly evaluate the skin, however, it helps to first understand how castle skin buffs actually work and why some stats scale dramatically better than others at high account progression.

---

## Understanding Combat and Development Buffs

Castle skins in Infinity Kingdom generally provide two categories of bonuses:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-104.png)

Combat buffs themselves can further be divided into two subcategories:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-105.png)

This distinction matters because not all combat buffs scale equally well. Some buffs directly increase your actual combat power. Others instead improve efficiency, positioning, or troop preservation. And among all combat-power stats currently available on castle skins, **troop attack is, in my opinion, the strongest overall.**

---

## Why Troop Attack Is So Strong

The key reason troop attack scales so aggressively is because of how damage is calculated in Infinity Kingdom.

An immortal has two sources of attributes that feeds into the damage equation:

- Their own embedded immortal stats
- The stats of the troops they command

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-107-1024x565.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-106-1024x596.png)

At end-game troop counts, the troop portion of the equation massively outweighs the immortal portion.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-108-1024x522.png)

For example, an immortal leading 18,000 troops gains far more total offensive scaling from troop attributes than from their personal immortal attributes alone.

That means:

- 5% troop attack scales across the entire troop stack
- 5% immortal attack only scales the immortal side

And those are not remotely equal in practice. This is why troop attack buffs consistently outperform immortal attack buffs during actual combat. Especially in late-game PvP environments with massive troop counts, troop attack scaling becomes extremely noticeable.

---

## Why Technology Speed Is the Best Development Bonus

The second part of Throne of Blood is the 5% technology speed bonus.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-109-1024x544.png)

At first glance, development stats rarely look exciting compared to direct combat buffs. But technology speed is different because of how account progression works in Infinity Kingdom.

Most active accounts eventually complete buildings and dragons but technology, however, is usually the final major progression bottleneck.

Research trees are enormous, expensive, and time-intensive. Even heavy spenders often remain behind on technology for a very long time. That is why I personally consider technology speed the best development bonus among castle skins.

And because the Throne of Blood skin combines that progression value with top-tier combat scaling, it avoids the usual problem where a skin is either:

- Good for combat
or
- Good for development

This one does both.

---

## Comparing Throne of Blood to Other Major Combat Skins

To understand where Throne of Blood fits in the current skin hierarchy, it helps to compare it against the other major combat skins currently worth considering.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-110.png)

This comparison highlights something important:

## Troop Stats Are King

In practical combat performance:

1. Troop Attack
2. Troop Defense
3. Troop HP
4. Immortal stats

That is generally how I would rank them overall. Naturally, the ranking does depend on your troop count and your immortal attribute values. If you are behind on troop count (or low) and have incredible artifacts etc. you may well scale better off of immortal attack than troop HP for example. But in general troop attack and troop defense will always be the two best attribute buffs you can obtain.

---

## Why Sun Chariot Is Secretly Interesting

One skin I personally value more than many players do is Sun Chariot.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/image-112-1024x590.png)

On paper, the combat stat itself is not particularly impressive. Immortal defense scales noticeably worse than troop-based stats at higher account progression because troop attributes make up such a large portion of the actual combat equation once marches reach very high troop counts.

If you purely compare raw combat scaling, skins focused on troop attack, troop defense, or troop HP will usually outperform immortal defense skins quite clearly. Troop stats simply scale harder because they affect the much larger troop portion of the march rather than only the immortal side.

What makes Sun Chariot interesting is the movement speed bonus. March speed is one of those attributes that looks minor on a stat sheet but becomes extremely impactful during real PvP situations where positioning and timing decide fights.

The extra speed allows marches to move across the battlefield more efficiently, which creates tactical opportunities that direct combat stats cannot replicate. Faster movement means you can reinforce structures sooner, intercept enemy marches more reliably, reposition between objectives faster, and respond to map pressure before opponents can react properly.

Where the skin becomes especially strong is during active war scenarios involving fast attack-and-return timing. With additional movement speed, your main march can attack an enemy position and still return quickly enough to reinforce or garrison another objective immediately afterward. In practice, this often means you can pressure enemy targets while still maintaining defensive coverage elsewhere because your march simply covers distance faster.

That type of battlefield flexibility becomes extremely valuable during for example Legion of Frostborne, Norheim combat, etc. likewise it also means it is quite useless in e.g. arena or throne where there is no movement at all. Moreover, rallying you want to have the most powerful buffs over move speed. This is a niche one-on-one castle skin when you need to attack and defend using your main march at the same time.

---

## Final Verdict

The new **Throne of Blood** castle skin succeeds because it combines the strongest combat scaling stat with the strongest long-term development stat.

Its:

- 5% Troop Attack
- 5% Technology Speed

…give it immediate PvP impact while also permanently accelerating one of the slowest progression systems in Infinity Kingdom.

The skin is especially strong for:

- Competitive mid-game accounts
- PvP-focused players
- Active spenders
- Players still progressing advanced research

And unlike many older skins, neither stat feels wasted. That is what ultimately makes Throne of Blood so impressive. Most skins force players to choose between combat and development. Throne of Blood is one of the rare cases where you genuinely get both.

---

title: Time Breaker - Everything you need to know
summary: Greetings, fellow commanders! As the first week of the Time Rift Breaker event in Infinity Kingdom comes to a close, it's time to delve into the intricacies of this exciting weekly event. Join us as we explore the…
markdown:
### An In-Depth Analysis of the Time Rift Breaker Event in Infinity Kingdom

Greetings, fellow commanders! As the first week of the Time Rift Breaker event in Infinity Kingdom comes to a close, it's time to delve into the intricacies of this exciting weekly event. Join us as we explore the event's rules, optimal team compositions, coveted rewards, and strategies for success.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-58-1024x480.png)

With the latest patch, the Time Rift Breaker event has made its debut in the world of Infinity Kingdom. This event is not to be missed, as it offers a unique and rewarding experience. The Rift Breaker makes its appearance in every server within the same Legion of Frostborne season, with the caveat that the server must have reached at least season two to participate.

### Rules

Rift Breakers emerge every Monday, ready to face the onslaught of fearless commanders. The battle window extends from Thursday to Sunday, providing ample opportunities for players to engage. Each player is granted three daily attacks to take down these formidable foes. While Immortals can only be deployed once a day, dragons can be utilized more liberally. If you possess a maxed-out dragon, you can use it consecutively on all three teams.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Infinity-Kingdom-2023-09-21-08-53-36.mp4)

### Team Compositions

Crafting the ideal team composition is crucial for achieving victory in the Time Rift Breaker event. We'll assume access to all free Immortals and King of the Hill Immortals for our examples. However, if you lack specific Immortals, don't fret – experimentation can lead to effective substitutes. Additionally, perusing the damage rankings and observing other players' choices can offer valuable insights.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-63-1024x381.png)

***Checkout my YouTube Channel for build compositions as well as the boss-build section here on the wiki.***

Notably, rare single-target skills may outperform epic skills in certain scenarios. For instance, consider using skills like Root and Poison Thorn for Hammurabi, as they prove more effective than Annihilation and Death Breath. While Immortals can only be used once per battle, skill changes can be made as frequently as desired. To streamline the process, it's advisable to have multiple formation presets, sparing diligent players from constant skill adjustments.

There are three distinct types of Rift Breakers to contend with: Venom, Vampirism, and Amplify. Each presents unique challenges and demands tailored team compositions:

- **Venom Rift Breaker:** Inflicts magical continuous damage and is weak against Holy, Lightning, and Fire elements. An example team might feature Hippolyta, William, Empress Wu, and Hammurabi, focusing on single-target damage and exploiting the Rift Breaker's elemental vulnerabilities.
- **Vampirism Rift Breaker:** Deals magical damage while healing itself and is susceptible to Shadow, Wind, and Lightning. An effective lineup could consist of Hannibal Barca, Alexander, Hammurabi, and Qin, capitalizing on synergies despite Alexander's elemental mismatch.
- **Amplify Rift Breaker:** Unleashes buffed physical damage and is vulnerable to Water, Earth, and Fire elements. A well-rounded team may include Hippolyta, Alexander, Yoshitsune, and Empress Wu, benefiting from elemental strengths and prioritizing single-target damage.

## Rewards

The Time Rift Breaker event boasts a treasure trove of rewards that are well worth the effort:

**Daily Attempts:** Each attack can yield a maximum of 1,500 Glory Points, totaling 4,500 Glory Points per day. Accumulated Glory Points unlock chests containing badges once you reach specific thresholds: 1k, 3k, 5k, 8k, and 12k points per week. These chests offer 1.5k, 2.5k, 4k, 5k, and 7k badges, culminating in a weekly total of 20,000 badges.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-59-1024x99.png)

**Total Damage Ranking:** Players earn badges based on their total damage output at the end of the week. Rankings determine badge rewards, ranging from 20,000 to 40,000 badges. To maximize your standing, strategically distribute your strongest Immortals to complement each other and achieve the highest total damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-60-1024x422.png)

**Highest Damage Ranking:** A separate ranking is awarded for the highest damage dealt in a single attack. Players can earn between 12,000 and 25,000 badges based on their ranking. Concentrate your most potent Immortals on one attack team to secure a top spot in this category.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-61-1024x436.png)

**Kill Count Rewards:** The event also encourages teamwork, as rewards are distributed based on the number of Rift Breakers collectively defeated during the week. Individual achievements contribute to a team objective, with players earning 1k, 1.5k, 2k, 2.5k, and 3k badges for 1, 3, 5, 8, and 15 kills, respectively.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/image-64-1024x436.png)

### Summary

The Time Rift Breaker event offers a captivating extension of the Infinity Kingdom experience, blending individual and team dynamics. While it demands continuous skill adjustments for optimal damage output, the event provides an opportunity to unlock exclusive artifacts and amass Glory Points with ease. With rewards aplenty and a collaborative element, every commander should participate and strive for excellence.
