title: What are Random Immortal Fragments?
summary: Random Immortal Fragments are basically IK’s off-brand Philosopher Stones — but honestly, they’re way better for most players because the pools aren’t limited to a specific list of select few immortals like the Halls…
categoryPath: tips and tricks for newer players
markdown:
### Understanding Random Immortal Fragments in Infinity Kingdom

Random Immortal Fragments are basically IK’s off-brand Philosopher Stones — but honestly, they’re way better for most players because the pools aren’t limited to a specific list of select few immortals like the Halls is. Instead, you gather 60 fragments of a type, and boom: you summon one random Immortal from the associated pool.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-1.png)

The best part is that these pools cover almost all Immortals, including expensive heavies like **Baldwin**, **Genghis Khan**, and paywalled immortals like **Zenobia, Himiko**, etc. So even a low spender or free player can pull immortals that used to be locked behind pretty rough paywalls.

There are ten kinds of Random Immortal Fragments, each tied to a specific pool of immortals.

---

## The 10 Types of Random Immortal Fragments

| Fragment Type | What It Summons | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Random Epic Immortal Fragments | Any Epic Fire, Water, Earth, Lightning, or Wind Immortal | Verified by testing: no Holy or Shadow included. Premium Epics (Baldwin, Genghis, Zenobia, etc.) are in the pool. |
| Random Holy Immortal Fragments | Any Epic Holy Immortal | e.g., Theodora, Manco, Gilgamesh. |
| Random Shadow Immortal Fragments | Any Epic Shadow Immortal | Bathory, Himiko, Bjorn, etc. (Flavius excluded since he’s not Epic.) |
| Random Holy/Shadow Immortal Fragments | A random Holy or Shadow Immortal | Mixed pool. No bias confirmed toward either side. |
| Random Chaos Immortal Fragments | A random Chaos Immortal | Very slow to collect. Pool probably excludes the very newest Chaos release temporarily, but this is unconfirmed and cannot be treated as fact. |
| Random Fire Immortal Fragments | Any Fire Immortal | Element-locked. |
| Random Water Immortal Fragments | Any Water Immortal | Element-locked. |
| Random Earth Immortal Fragments | Any Earth Immortal | Element-locked. |
| Random Lightning Immortal Fragments | Any Lightning Immortal | Element-locked. |
| Random Wind Immortal Fragments | Any Wind Immortal | Element-locked. |

---

## The Data Project: Helping the Community Map Drop Chances

**The community needs you!** Right now, the **actual summon odds for these fragment types are unknown**. IK never releases the internal gacha weights. So the only way to figure out the real probability distribution is for the playerbase to log every single random fragment summon we can get our hands on.

A group of us has already started a big shared sheet to record summons across:

- Random Epic
- Element-specific
- Holy
- Shadow
- Holy/Shadow
- Chaos (when someone actually gets enough…)

This is the only realistic path to uncover how weighted the pools are, and which Immortals show up more often.

👉[**If you want to help the community reveal the true drop rates, please join the shared Google Sheet and log your summons.**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-KYFAbLB98oYLtei3_pQzROKqo2wluMkA-fc5UOzYB4/edit?usp=sharing)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-2-1024x312.png)

**The more data points we collect, the more accurate the drop-rate estimates becomes.**

---

## Quick overview on how to Collect Random Immortal Fragments

### Golden Pass

Still the most consistent source for newer players:

- Random Epic
- Elemental random fragments

Honestly, this is the backbone for most people’s early and mid-game fragment collection.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-3-1024x407.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-4-1024x638.png)

### Seasonal Events

You’ll see many types of random fragments there - even chaos!

### Harbour (long-term grind)

The Harbour drip-feed is slow but steady:

- Early levels → Random Epic
- Mid → Holy & Shadow
- High → Chaos

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image.png)

[Read more about the harbour here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/development/harbour/harbour-rewards-incl-chaos-holy-shadow-immortal-fragments/)

---

## Why These Fragments Actually Matter (Player Perspective)

So here’s the real talk — and this is the stuff players feel immediately in their account growth:

### 1. They give free-to-play and light spenders access to premium immortals

Back when the game launched, guys like **Baldwin**, **Genghis Khan**, **Zenobia**, etc. were entirely paywalled and spend-to-collect.

Now? A random Epic or element fragment can legitimately pop one of these. And the same is true for holy, shadow and even chaos! Insane compared to how expensive it was to get these back in the day.

This changes the entire power curve for F2P players — you can actually build full meta marches just from fragments and events.

### 2. They massively improve your Soul Crystal income

And this part is huge but many players overlook it. Every time you pull a duplicate you don’t need, you melt it in the Alchemy Lab → **purple crystals (Soul Crystals)**. And those Soul Crystals go into your **Tower of Knowledge skill upgrades** (which are insanely expensive long-term).

Your ToK growth rate can be a very big bottleneck in the game, and these fragments help you push through it.

---

## Conclusion Summary

Random Immortal Fragments aren’t just a fun gacha mechanic — they’re legitimately one of the most important progression systems in the entire game now. They let every player, from F2P to whale, access strong immortals, build Soul Crystals faster, and grow their roster without being tied to Philosopher Stone banners or paywalls.

**Bottom line:** **Collect every random fragment you can. Always melt your dupes. And please log your summons in the shared sheet — the more data we have, the faster we crack the real drop rates.**

---

title: What are Schematics and how to obtain and craft Artifacts
summary: Artifact schematics are essential for maximizing the power of your Immortals in Infinity Kingdom. Artifacts significantly boost Immortal performance, providing key attribute enhancements and, in the case of Unique…
markdown:
Artifact schematics are essential for maximizing the power of your Immortals in *Infinity Kingdom*. Artifacts significantly boost Immortal performance, providing key attribute enhancements and, in the case of Unique Artifacts, granting powerful special effects. Since artifacts play a major role in strengthening your team, consistently acquiring artifact schematics should be a priority.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-39-1024x533.png)

There are four main types of artifacts, each corresponding to a different Immortal type:

- **Attack Artifacts** – Used by frontline attackers
- **Defense Artifacts** - Used by frontline tanks/supports
- **Magic Artifacts** – Used by mages
- **Ranged Artifacts** – Used by ranged DPS
- **Support Artifacts** – Used by healers and buffers

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-30.png)

Each artifact can roll different attributes, and you will need a vast number of schematics because crafting artifacts is a numbers game. Even if you don’t get perfect rolls immediately, you still benefit by accumulating artifacts to use as upgrade materials for boosting both *Artifact Level EXP* and *Bonus Skill Rank* once you roll a powerful artifact with a bonus effect. So, no schematic is ever truly wasted!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-31.png)

For more details on artifact crafting, materials, and rolling mechanics, refer to the [Forge Guide](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/beginners-guides-forge-and-artifacts/the-forge-a-basic-introduction-to-transmutation-of-gold-and-artifact-crafting/).

## Earning Schematics

You can obtain artifact schematics primarily through two sources: **Calendar Events** and **Mysterium**.

### Calendar Events

Regular game events are the best source of artifact schematics. Some key events to watch out for include:

- **Contention of Lords (Kill Event / KE)** – Rewards a full set of Epic schematics.
- **Golden Path** – Grants an entire set of schematics + more through Medallion.
- **Arms Race** – Offers a decent amount of schematics as you progress.
- **Asteria (not yet available in my preperation server)** – A great source of schematic fragments.
- **Seasonal Events** – Special events like the *Spring Festival* often include artifact schematics, sometimes even schematics for Unique/Exclusive Artifacts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-32-1024x490.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-33-1024x522.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-34-1024x598.png)

### Mysterium

Mysterium can be completed **twice a day**, and from *Floor 4* onward, you start collecting artifact schematics. When selecting rewards, always prioritize schematics for the most important Immortal in your team.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-35-1024x535.png)

### Purchasing Schematics

While schematics are available in the in-game shop, their abundance from events makes them a **low-value purchase** in most cases. Your money is typically better spent elsewhere.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-36-1024x638.png)

### Collecting Schematics Early

Even if you are not yet **Castle Level 35** and thus unable to craft Epic artifacts, you should still **focus on collecting as many schematics as possible**. Once you unlock artifact crafting at a high level, you will need a massive number of schematics to:

- Upgrade **Artifact Level EXP**
- Increase the **Bonus Skill Rank** on high-quality artifacts

Since rolling good artifacts takes a lot of attempts, saving schematics early will help you in the long run. For more information on rolling mechanics and crafting, check out the [Forge Guide](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/beginners-guides-forge-and-artifacts/the-forge-a-basic-introduction-to-transmutation-of-gold-and-artifact-crafting/).

### Normal vs. Unique/Exclusive Artifacts

There are two main types of artifacts:

1. **Normal Artifacts** – Usable by all Immortals of a given type.
2. **Unique/Exclusive Artifacts** – Provide a special effect but only when equipped on a specific Immortal.

**TIP**: Unique Artifacts have higher max values for attributes, hence you want them even on immortals they dont provide unique benefits to if you do not own the immortal's specific artifact.

While Unique Artifacts can technically be equipped on any Immortal of the corresponding type, their special effects only apply to their designated Immortal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-38-1024x530.png)

Some Unique Artifacts are much stronger than others. Here are the best Unique Artifacts to prioritize for each element:

- **Lightning** – Khan, Hammurabi
- **Water** – Attila, Herald
- **Fire** – *All Unique Artifacts are important*, but prioritize **Hippo** and **Seon** first
- **Earth** – **Alexander** → **Zenobia** → **Charles**
- **Shadow** – **Himiko** first
- **Hybrid (Earth-Wind)** – You need all four, but prioritize **Alexander**

## Unique Artifact Availability

Some Unique Artifacts are locked behind the **Wisdom Well**, which is only available later in a server’s lifespan. However, many Unique Artifacts can be obtained through the **Mysterium Shop**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/image-37-1024x551.png)

The **best Unique Artifacts** available for purchase in the Mysterium Shop (Preparation Server) include:

- **Hippolyta**
- **Herald**
- **Hannibal Barca**
- **Qin**
- **Zenobia**
- **Hammurabi**

Prioritize spending Mysterium currency on these schematics to build powerful artifacts for your strongest Immortals.

### Conclusion

Consistently acquiring artifact schematics is crucial for building powerful Immortals. Whether through **event participation** or **daily Mysterium runs**, always be on the lookout for ways to increase your schematic collection. Even if you can’t craft Epic artifacts yet, collecting schematics early will ensure you’re ready to maximize your Immortal’s potential as soon as you hit **Castle Level 35**.

For more detailed information on crafting, materials, and rolling artifacts, check out the [Forge Guide](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/new-player-guides/beginners-guides-forge-and-artifacts/the-forge-a-basic-introduction-to-transmutation-of-gold-and-artifact-crafting/).

title: What does the new Diplomacy limitations mean?
