title: Wonderful World
summary: Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.

**Castle Skins serve two purposes:**(**1)** they provide **unique buff effects**to specific activities such as e.g. tech speed, dragon speed, combat buffs, recovery speed, resource collection rate, etc. and **(2)** they provide **unique cosmetic effects** that change the way your castle looks inside the game. The cosmetic effects work in all aspects of the game, any game mode, and provides some awesome customization to make youself more unique and your castle look.. well.. more awesome!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-55-1024x533.png)

In this article we shall look to the cosmetic castle skin called**: Wonderful World**

## What does Wonderful Worl d do?

Every castle skin has unique beneficial effects, from building speed to rss gathering and troop HP. The **Wonderful World** provides you a 3% increase to hospitals healing speed. This is a very solid buff and when this skin was first released it was a major priority for me personally to unluck it as fast as possible purely for it's effect. You are going to be healing millions of troops spending a ton of speed-ups. This saves you 3%. That's solid!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-57.png)

HOWEVER. There is a major change since this skin was first released. We have gotten a new skin in Norheim: the Frozen Dragon Hive. This skin does the same as Wonderful world, just better. It's 5% as well as a solid 5% boost to production of resources. This obviously makes our Wonderful World skin a lot less powerful by comparison. However, it remains a solid skin if you are unable to obtain the Frozen Dragon Hive.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-58-1024x513.png)

## How to get it?

There is only one way to obtain this skin**: (1) Original Easter Festival**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-60.png)

The Original Easter Festival of Infinity Kingdom is an annual event that offers players a chance to obtain the exclusive Castle Cosmetic skin "Wonderful World." This skin can only be obtained during the festival and is not available through any other means.

The 2023 edition of the Easter Festival is on it's first day as I am writing this, and players can acquire the "Wonderful World" skin for a price of $185. While this may seem steep, the skin is highly coveted among players, and this is the only opportunity to obtain it.

Players can participate in a variety of festive activities during the event, including Easter egg hunts, special battles, and more. They can also earn rewards such as in-game currency and rare items.

Overall, the Original Easter Festival of Infinity Kingdom is a highly anticipated event among players, as it offers a unique opportunity to obtain the exclusive cosmetic skin Wonderful World that cannot be obtained through any other means.

title: Wrath of Thunder
summary: Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on.…
markdown:
Infinity Kingdom has a ton of cool city skins. You get skins from purchases during events, performance from in game activities such as contention of relics and/or Legion of Frostborne, Throne of the Supreeme, and so on. We have a new Dragon Castle skin coming to Norheim! Today the 21st of april 2023 Infinity Kingdom releases a brand new and AWESOME looking castle skin with amazing bonuses and just brilliant animation.

**Introducing the Wrath of Thunder lightning dragon Castle skin!**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-82.png)

## What does "Wrath of Thunder" do?

Every castle skin has unique beneficial effects, from building speed to rss gathering and troop HP. The Wrath of Thunder castle skin increases **SP recovery rate by 5%** AND**increase building speed 5%**. It is following the line made by the development team on these unique element dragon skins as this much like the Frozen Dragon Hive. SP recovery is a pretty decent buff although not anything on par with healing.

Contrary, the 5% buff to production speed is a big one. We expect the progression of our castle buildings to continue slowly as time passes. We started with level 40 as the max which was then increased to level 50. It is more than likely that level 60 is coming up in which case you want this skin buff ready!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-83.png)

## New unique troop cosmetic effect

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-88.png)

As with the water and shadow dragon castle skins as well as the Contention of Relics skin, we are also getting a brand new unique troop cosmetic effect for when your armies are marching across the battlefield. This is soooo cool and I really like that we are getting more of these as ways to cusomize a more personal feel.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-4-1.png)

I have to say, this is in my opinion the best looking army cosmetics yet!

    https://youtu.be/kB4aoIQ9fvs

## How to get it?

You have to purchase bundles (any bundles) which yield a total of 50K gems. It dosen't matter what bundles you purchase, as long as there is a gem reward it counts towards your castle skin.

This means, that if you have not yet purchased gems with a bonus, this could be a good time.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-81-1024x644.png)

In addition to the Castle skin, you are also recieving a brand new avatar frame

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-84.png)

You also recieve a new Msg Chatbox with a nice purple lightning look.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-85.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-87.png)

and lastly, you ofcourse get a nameplate to go with that new skin of yours!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/image-86.png)

## Bundles with gems

Most all bundles have gem rewards, but how to they scale?

Usually, a 5$ bundle yield 520 gems, a 10$ bundle yields 1,100 gems, a 20$ bundle yields 2,300 gems, a 50$ bundle yields 6,000 gems and a 99$ bundle yields 12,500 gems. These are the standard rewards and can be slightly different on special bundles.

### Read more about shop bundles

| USD | 4.99 | 9.99 | 19.99 | 49.99 | 99.99 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gems | 520 | 1100 | 2300 | 6000 | 12500 |
| 1 USD = in Gems | 104.21 | 110.11 | 115.06 | 120.02 | 125.01 |

As you can see, the more expensive bundles are finally worth buying! They offer a higher gem/USD spent reward.

Do however take note, that the contents of expensive bundle tiers is MUCH worse than the cheaper ones. Overall, it would still be FAR MORE value to purchase many small bundles despite the lower gem reward.

At an average cost between 104-125 gems per dollar you are doing to be spending around 400$-480$ to unlock the new Castle Skin.

title: Wukong (Chaos)
summary: Wukong – Chaos Immortal: Wukong is one of the most iconic and powerful Chaos Immortals in Infinity Kingdom, offering a rare mix of survivability, self-sustain, and incredible damage potential. With a skill set that…
markdown:
**Wukong – Chaos Immortal**: Wukong is one of the most iconic and powerful Chaos Immortals in *Infinity Kingdom*, offering a rare mix of **survivability, self-sustain, and incredible damage potential**. With a skill set that enables him to block damage and deal massive bursts in return, Wukong has become a staple in many Conquest and Chaos-season PvP lineups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-8-1024x541.png)

This guide will walk you through his **mythological origins**, how to **obtain him**, his **ultimate ability**, the **best skills**, and the **team compositions** where he shines the most.

---

## 📚 Mythological Origins: The Monkey King

Wukong originates from **Journey to the West**, a 16th-century Chinese novel where he is born from stone and acquires supernatural powers through Taoist practices. Though fictional, his story is inspired by a real Buddhist monk's pilgrimage for sacred scriptures. In mythology, Wukong is clever, rebellious, and nearly unstoppable — traits reflected perfectly in his in-game design.

---

## How to Obtain Wukong

Wukong is a **Chaos Immortal**, meaning his availability is limited and highly exclusive.

### Main Methods:

- **Chaos Roulette Event** – The primary method to obtain Wukong and his exclusive artifact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-10-1024x635.png)

- **Seasonal Events** – Occasionally offers Chaos Immortal Selection Chests (containing his shards).

Because of this exclusivity, unlocking Wukong typically requires significant investment and careful planning — but for many players, he’s well worth it.

---

## 💥Ultimate Skill: Stone Armor

Wukong’s ultimate is one of the most **unique and powerful defensive-offensive hybrid abilities** in the game:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-9.png)

### Effect:

- Deals high **physical damage** (600%) to all enemies.
- Grants **Absolute Defense**, which:  - Reduces incoming damage significantly.
- **Applies to Wukong**, and also to **the allied Immortal with the highest troop loss**.

This not only makes Wukong incredibly tanky but also allows him to **shield allies** in dire moments. When timed correctly, it can **swing battles in your favor** or outright **prevent your team from being wiped**.

### Why it’s special:

- Self-sufficient: Needs no support to survive.
- Game-changer: Can turn around losing fights through clutch protection.
- Scales well in both solo play and coordinated team marches.

---

## Recommended Skill Builds

### 1. Ramping Damage Build

**Battle Stance + Demonic Contract** **+ Drastic Action**

- *Strategy*: Wukong is supported by full sustain/heal immortals, allowing him to survive the first 20–30 seconds while these skills build up to peak damage.
- *Benefit*: Once charged, Wukong's damage becomes explosive, able to delete enemy frontlines with ease.
- *Ideal for*: Long fights where Wukong is the sole damage dealer.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-13-1024x577.png)

### 2. Below 70% HP Build

**Last Stand + Unyielding** **+ Drastic Action**

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-11-1024x405.png)

- *Strategy*: Capitalizes on passive, which increases damage below 70% HP.
- *Last Stand*: Increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken when under 70% HP.
- *Unyielding*: Restores HP and boosts crit rate by 50% in the same health window.
- *Synergy*: His ultimate adds survivability while he shreds the opponent.

### 2. Hyper regen Build

### Corrosive Power + Battle Frenzy + Last Stand / Drastic Action / Unyielding

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-12-1024x561.png)

- *Strategy*: Capitalizes on regen skill synergy providing incredibly high cast rate.
- Can be used both in a defensive setup providing high uptime on shields
- Or be used offensively with e.g. Drastic for high cast per min, and thus high damage per second.

---

## Team Compatibility & Sample Marches

### 🔹 Sustain Damage Dealer Setup

- **Holy Dragon**: Fu Fei, Ninetails, Anubis, Wukong
- **Earth Dragon**: Fu Fei, Theodora, Wukong, Anubis

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-15.png)

In these setups:

- Wukong is the **only damage dealer**.
- All other Immortals provide **healing, shielding, and sustain**.
- Battle Stance + Demonic Contract ramp up Wukong’s damage over time.
- His ultimate shields himself and allies, **making him nearly unkillable** once rolling.

### 🔹 Burst Chaos Setup

- **Shadow Dragon**: Tomyris/Loki, Ninetails, Anubis, Wukong

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/image-16.png)

This is a high-damage, low-duration PvP burst comp:

- Loki and Anubis **contribute massive AoE or debuff-heavy damage**.
- Wukong provides **protection and finish potential**.
- Aimed at **bursting down teams** before they can scale or retaliate.

---

## Final Thoughts: Why Use Wukong?

Wukong is:

- **Durable** – With built-in damage immunity and no reliance on support.
- **Versatile** – Works well in solo-damage or burst-team comps.
- **Scalable** – Performs even better in late-game due to his synergy with chaos artifacts and deep specializations.

Whether you’re building a hybrid comp, aiming to dominate in Conquest PvP, or just looking for a true damage-dealing tank, **Wukong is one of the most complete Immortals in Infinity Kingdom**.

If you manage to unlock him, **build around him**. He won’t disappoint.

title: Yawg's top tier shadow part 1: Countering physical damage teams (written patch 2.8.9)
summary: This is the first part of a two-guide series built around the Shadow formations used by the player Yawgmoth, widely known in the community as one of the most experienced and reliable Shadow specialists in Infinity…
markdown:
This is the first part of a two-guide series built around the Shadow formations used by the player Yawgmoth, widely known in the community as one of the most experienced and reliable Shadow specialists in Infinity Kingdom. If you’ve spent any time in the IK community, you probably already know Yawg as one of the sharpest players around. The guy basically treats Shadow like a science project — testing weird talent paths at 3am, reverse-engineering dragon timings. And thank god he does, because Shadow after the buffs is straight-up monstrous, especially for spenders who want to punch up against whales.

[Embedded media](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/ScreenRecording_12-03-2025_12-27-43_1.mov)

After the Shadow buffs, the element has become one of the strongest options outside of fully developed Chaos teams, and naturally it attracts many spenders who want high-impact, high-pressure builds. Shadow is fast, explosive, and extremely punishing when played correctly, but it also demands a proper structure to reach its potential.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-38-1024x472.png)

Since Shadow now sits comfortably among the top elements for competitive players, requests for reliable build guides have been overwhelming to say the least. While I do **not**consider myself the top Shadow expert, Yawg has spent countless hours refining his setups and has kindly shared **two of the strongest Shadow teams** he uses regularly. These builds allow him to win against players with march costs far higher than his own. Each formation is specifically designed to counter a different type of opponent: one to defeat physical-damage teams and one to defeat magical-damage teams.

This first guide covers the **Shadow formation designed to counter physical-damage enemies**, including the normal-attack focused setups commonly seen in young and mid-game servers. If the enemy relies primarily on physical output, this build performs exceptionally well.

---

## Core Immortals and Their Roles

Here is the full build. In the following we go through each immortal's setup to explain further why this works so well! Note that at their core, the roles of each of the immortal's and their usefulness is very similar if not precisely the same as for the Part 2 guide on shadow versus magical damage. The changes you want to make are primarily the tower of knowledge skills (as well as swapping out Growth for Guard on Bjorn).

That means, that**if you have already read the Part 2 guide** because you needed to learn about countering magical teams before you are reading this guide - then you can simply checkout the image here to see the new skill setup that you should be running in this vs physical damage build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-39.png)

For all of you who are reading this two-part guide starting with ways to counter physical damage, or for anyone who does not instantly recognize all the skills being used, please see details below on each immortal and their setup.

---

## Himiko

Himiko is the central damage dealer of the team. Her ultimate is capable of extremely high repeatable burst, and against opponents who fail to protect their key backline units with Fighting Master or Fu Fei, she also brings heavy control pressure. She is the reason this formation wins the fight in the first 20–25 seconds.

**Talent:**
Stormeye is the correct choice here, offering higher damage output and improved crit potential to scale her burst.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-44.png)

**Artifact:**
Crit percentage as the top stat is ideal, and Annihilation is the preferred bottom bonus. For secondary attributes you want to reroll until you get as much crit % as possible. If you can roll crit % on a secondary you are off to a great start and if combined with e.g. crit rate and magical damage % you are getting to the max of what an artifact can be. The goal is to maximize both burst and consistency.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-41.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Fighting Master: Mandatory for control immunity. Without it, Himiko becomes unreliable.
- Energy Master: Key to enabling her extremely fast energy cycles once the fight begins.
- Corrosive Power: Combines with Energy Master to allow repeated ultimates and overwhelming pressure.

Once Tomyris accelerates the first ultimate cycle through her talent Battle Excitation, Himiko enters a “hyper-regen” rhythm where she casts continuously and forces the enemy formation to collapse extreemly fast.

---

## Tomyris

Tomyris functions as the primary utility and support piece in this build. Her confusion control is one of the most valuable disruption tools available, and in this setup she also brings substantial sustain and defensive stability through Tower of Knowledge skills.

**Talent:**
Battle Excitation is chosen to ensure Tomyris casts quickly at the start of combat. This early cast is essential to activating Himiko’s regeneration loop and is one of the most important things in the build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-43.png)

**Artifact:**
Surge is generally the best option here, improving uptime on her control. Dodge percentage is theoretically optimal on paper, but most high-end opponents have enough accuracy by default to ignore dodge, making it much less relevant in practice. Surge is the important part here.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-42.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Spring of Life
- Fountain of Life (swap if the enemy also runs it)
- No Escape *or* Heart of Arcana:  - Use **No Escape** if the opponent does not run Fountain of Life.
- Use **Heart of Arcana** if you want stronger damage amplification for Himiko.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-48.png)

This combination provides defensive sustain while also helping counter No Escape opponents when needed. The defensive layer Tomyris provides through skills is part of what allows Shadow to survive the opening physical burst.

---

## Bjorn

Bjorn is the frontline tank of the team and is extremely effective into physical opponents. He contributes both damage amplification and substantial mitigation, and his debuffs directly support Himiko’s ability to crit and burst through the enemy formation.

**Talent:**
Yawg uses the **Sturdy** immortal talent. Bjorn already has very high innate tankiness, and Sturdy adds additional shielding that helps maintain the troop counts on both Himiko and Tutankhamun. Since this build relies heavily on early survivability to enable its damage cycle, those shields are more valuable than raw defensive stats on Bjorn.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-32.png)

**Artifact:**
Physical Defense percentage is the preferred top stat.
For bottom bonuses:

- Guard is best versus physical opponents.
- Growth HP is better in the magic-counter variant, but also has an impact on physical damage enemies. Hence, if you can only reliably get one maxed, growth is the default choice. If you can get both and swap, Guard is the best choice for this build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-26-1024x710.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Weakening Curse: Reduces enemy physical output dramatically.
- Oaken Guard: Additional physical damage mitigation.
- Weakness Aura: Improves crit chance for your damage dealers by reducing enemy resilience, synergizing with Bjorn’s resilience reduction from his ultimate.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-46.png)

When executed correctly, Bjorn reduces incoming physical damage to manageable levels and sets up your explosive damage output.

---

## Tutankhamun

Tutankhamun is the second damage dealer in the formation. He requires time to ramp up, but he becomes extremely threatening once his ultimate begins dealing multiple rapid hits. That being said, given the Himiko centered build here, one - if not the best - reason for why Tutankhamun is in here instead of e.g. Rangar for added magical damage or YSS for added defense, is Tut's ability to control. Through his unique artifact he provides very consistent stuns on the enemy which is invaluable. Loosing a couple seconds to a stun means the world in high burst fights lasting only a 20-25 seconds tops (seconds of impactful gametime before one side overtakes troop count and wins eventually). That being said, he is also kind of failsafe, that if you do not annihilate the enemy in the first himiko burst cycles, he then has time to ramp up and nuke the enemy.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-18.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-16.png)

**Talent:**
Destroyer Stance provides strong offensive scaling and crit, matching his role in the build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-35.png)

**Artifact:**
Physical Attack percentage is the correct top stat.
Surge is the preferred bottom bonus, as it outperforms Iron Fist in practice in terms of damage but also provides more stuns through more rapid ultimate casts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-19-e1764949952215-961x1024.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Blade Dodge: Works exceptionally well due to the large number of damage instances in his ultimate.
- Toxin Barrier: Reduces incoming physical damage and applies reflect pressure.
- Blessing of Rage: Adds additional energy regeneration to keep his damage consistent.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-47.png)

Now the way Blade Dodge works, we are not reliant on it reaching the full stack effect for ramping damage (that is our failsafe backup which is awesome) but when paired with WC + Toxin Barrier, it makes Tut be able to facetank even an Alexander while punishing it for the 20s where Tut will take 70% reduced damage (from alex being disarmed and BD in total applying a 70% damage reduction dealt and recieved for 20s).

So this is really a tank-setup that allow you to survive the first seconds of a battle - with the added bonus of going mental on the damage IF your enemy survives long enough. At worst we are going to stall out the enemy so tut can ramp and keep applying pressure.

---

## Dragon Choice and Talents

Yawg specifically uses the **Fire Dragon** for this physical-counter formation. This may seem unusual at first, but it is the correct choice for several reasons.

1. Fire Dragon talents are effectively free to max, while the Shadow Dragon requires extremely large crystal investments.
2. This Shadow build aims to win the fight in the first 20–25 seconds, and Fire Dragon is the strongest early-game pressure dragon in the game.
3. The Prairie Fire talent path provides the strongest crit-damage spike available, offering a 12-second window of extremely elevated burst.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-37-1024x418.png)

Prairie Fire enhances the damage of fire breath and adds a 66% crit damage increase for a 12-second window. On average, this buff hits three out of four immortals with a 98% probability, giving you reasonable consistency. The 12s window aligns well with Himiko’s hyper-regen ult cycle, because we run both Energy Master and Corrosive here, we will get multiple casts off in this short window. During this window, the enemy front and backline collapse rapidly as they cannot sustain the incredible burst.

Calamity is also viable when fights tend to extend past 25 seconds, offering longer uptime at 50% crit damage, but it does not match Prairie Fire’s opening explosiveness, which is the defining strength of this build.

---

## Conclusion

This Shadow formation is the physical-damage counter used by Yawgmoth in high-level competitive play. It relies on early survivability, rapid ultimate cycling, and a frontloaded burst window created by the Fire Dragon’s Prairie Fire talents. Himiko is the centerpiece, Tomyris accelerates the entire tempo and provides incredibly control, Bjorn stabilizes the frontline while amplifying crit conditions, and Tutankhamun adds a ramping damage and a ton of stuns.

In real matches, this is the formation you use when facing opponents who rely on physical damage, whether through direct physical scaling or through normal attack pressure.

If the enemy relies heavily on magical burst or sustain, then this is not the formation you want, and the second guide in this series will cover the Shadow build tuned specifically to beat those teams.

When used correctly, this build consistently defeats physical-damage opponents even when they are running significantly more expensive setups or other top meta builds.

**Bottom line:** If the enemy’s damage is physical, this Shadow formation is one of the most reliable and explosive answers in the current meta.

title: Yawg's top tier shadow part 2: Countering magical damage teams (written patch 2.8.9)
summary: This is the second part of the two-guide Shadow series built around the formations used by the player Yawgmoth, one of the most respected and knowledgeable Shadow specialists in Infinity Kingdom. As mentioned in the…
markdown:
This is the second part of the two-guide Shadow series built around the formations used by the player Yawgmoth, one of the most respected and knowledgeable Shadow specialists in Infinity Kingdom. As mentioned in the first guide, Yawg has refined these teams through extensive testing, fighting opponents with far higher spending levels and still securing consistent wins. His experience with Shadow is unmatched, and these two builds together form a complete toolkit for dealing with both physical and magical opponents.

While the first guide covered the Shadow formation designed to counter physical damage, this second guide focuses on the **Shadow formation tailored to defeat magical-damage teams** commonly found in competitive mid- and late-game environments.

Shadow remains one of the strongest elements outside of fully optimized Chaos teams, and with this frontloaded tempo, rapid ultimate cycling, and natural synergy with heavy disruption, it performs exceptionally well when properly configured. However, like all top builds, Shadow’s effectiveness depends heavily on correct skill and artifact choices for the matchup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-29-1024x472.png)

This guide outlines Yawg’s full configuration for countering magical damage teams with great consistency. Shadow players should have this saved in a designated formation, giving you a quick way to swap between the vs magic and vs physical setups as you battle.

---

## Core Immortals and Their Roles

Here is the full build. In the following we go through each immortal's setup to explain further why this works so well! Note that at their core, the roles of each of the immortal's and their usefulness is very similar if not precisely the same as for the Part 1 guide on shadow versus physical damage. **The changes you want to make are primarily the tower of knowledge skills (as well as swapping out Guard for Growth on Bjorn).**

That means, that **if you have already read the Part 1 guide** because you needed to learn about countering physical teams before you are reading this guide - then you can simply checkout the image here to see the new skill setup that you should be running in this vs magical damage build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-30.png)

For all of you who are reading this two-part guide starting with ways to counter magical damage (this guide), or for anyone who does not instantly recognize all the skills being used, please see details below on each immortal and their setup.

Let's dive on further into each immortal and their setup.

---

## Himiko

Himiko is the core of the build and remains the primary source of damage and control pressure. Her rapid ultimate cycle allows the Shadow formation to maintain constant threat, and her performance is tightly linked to energy regeneration and troop preservation.

**Talent:**
Stormeye is recommended for increased damage output and crit scaling.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-45.png)

**Artifact:**
A crit-percentage main stat is ideal, paired with Annihilation as the bottom bonus. Secondary attributes should aim for crit %, crit rate, and magical damage %. Ensuring high crit consistency is key to maximizing her burst during each ultimate cycle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-28-1024x472.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Fighting Master: Required to keep her active under heavy control environments.
- Energy Master: Enables fast cycling of her ultimate.
- Corrosive Power: Works with Energy Master to create extremely frequent ultimates and sustained pressure.

With proper protection and support, Himiko maintains overwhelming tempo throughout the match with some of the higest ult-cycle rates possible.

---

## Tomyris

Tomyris continues to serve as the centerpiece of utility and defensive stability, but her Tower of Knowledge configuration shifts to suit the requirements of magic-heavy opponents. In this matchup, her role is centered on troop preservation through assist, No Escape management, and optional damage amplification. Her ultimate provides invaluable control effects to disrupt the enemy while buying Himiko time to cycle thrugh ultimate casts.

**Talent:**
Battle Excitation is kept to ensure she casts early, accelerating Himiko’s first ultimate cycle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-43.png)

**Artifact:**
Surge remains the recommended option, offering the most control uptime and thus reliable disruption.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-27-e1764949813428-994x1024.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Assist: Protects Himiko’s troop count, maintaining her damage output.
- Fountain of Life: Essential when facing opponents using No Escape.
- No Escape *or* Heart of Arcana:  - Use **No Escape** if the opponent does not run Fountain of Life.
- Use **Heart of Arcana** if you want stronger damage amplification for Himiko.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-34.png)

Tomyris is critical for keeping the main damage Himiko dealer at high troop count long enough to overwhelm the enemy.

---

## Bjorn

Bjorn provides the frontline stability required to survive magical burst compositions. His skill and artifact setup shifts toward magic mitigation and maintaining energy flow for the backline.

**Talent:**
Sturdy is recommended to maintain shields that preserve troop counts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-32.png)

**Artifact:**
The main stat should remain **Physical Defense %**, which is optimal for Bjorn in both setups.
For the bottom bonus:

- **Growth (HP)** is preferred in the magic-counter variant due to its overall durability value.
Guard is not particularly effective here, as it mitigates physical damage rather than magical.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-26-1024x710.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Resist: Reduces magical damage taken.
- Aegis: Adds additional magical damage mitigation.
- Blessing of Rage: Enhances energy regeneration for faster ult cycling across the team.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-33.png)

In this configuration, Bjorn functions as the anchor that buys enough time for Himiko and Tutankhamun to decide the match.

---

## Tutankhamun

Tutankhamun contributes damage and control. His artifact synergy and multi-hit ultimate make him valuable just for the stuns alone, and his skill configuration focuses on maintaining pressure while reducing enemy energy generation.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-18.png)

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-16.png)

**Talent:**
Destroyer Stance remains the recommended choice for offensive scaling and crit-oriented performance.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-35.png)

**Artifact:**
Physical Attack % is still the best main stat for maximizing his damage.
The preferred bottom bonus is Surge, which increases his cast frequency and therefore the number of stuns and damage instances he contributes.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-19-e1764949952215-961x1024.png)

### Tower of Knowledge Skills:

- Blade Dodge: Synergizes with his multi-hit ultimate.
- Weakness Aura: Supports crit scaling for both Tutankhamun and Himiko.
- Energy Suppression: Reduces enemy energy regen, which is particularly important against magical teams reliant on heavy ultimate bursts.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-36.png)

Tutankhamun’s damage, control pressure and suppression of enemy energy flow play a major role in stabilizing the matchup.

---

## Dragon Choice and Talents

The Fire Dragon remains the recommended choice for this Shadow formation. The reasoning is identical to the physical-counter variant:

- Fire Dragon talents are far cheaper to max than Shadow Dragon talents.
- The build aims to win through overwhelming tempo in the first 20–25 seconds.
- Prairie Fire provides the strongest short-window crit-damage spike available.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/image-37-1024x418.png)

Prairie Fire enhances fire breath and grants a 66% crit damage buff for 12 seconds, with an extremely high probability of applying to three out of four immortals. This window aligns with Himiko’s accelerated casting pattern, allowing the Shadow formation to apply decisive burst before magic-heavy formations can unleash multiple rounds of ultimates.

Calamity remains an optional alternative for players who expect prolonged fights, but for the majority of magic-oriented matchups, the tempo advantage of Prairie Fire is far more important.

---

## Conclusion

This guide presents the Shadow formation Yawgmoth uses to counter magical-damage opponents in high-level play. It focuses on early survivability, enemy energy suppression, and maintaining heavy ultimate pressure through quick Himiko cast cycles. Tomyris preserves key troop count and applies essential controls, Bjorn anchors the frontline with magic mitigation, and Tutankhamun contributes both damage and frequent stuns.

Against magical formations, controlling the enemy’s energy flow and surviving the first wave of burst while dishing out massive damage through the maximized hyper regen setup on Himiko, is the deciding factor.

**Bottom line**: If the enemy relies on magical damage, this Shadow configuration is one of the most reliable answers available in the current competitive meta.

title: Yi Sun-Shin and the Spear Ship
summary: Yi Sun-Shin’s unique artifact is one of those upgrades that quietly flips a march from “hard to kill” to “why won’t this team die?”. Base YSS is already a frontline tank with Guard of Devotion, a team-wide 6-second 30%…
markdown:
Yi Sun-Shin’s unique artifact is one of those upgrades that quietly flips a march from “hard to kill” to “why won’t this team die?”. Base YSS is already a frontline tank with **Guard of Devotion**, a team-wide 6-second **30% damage taken reduction** window. But with the artifact equipped, that same window also **boosts healing received by 30%**, which is exactly what sustain cores want — you mitigate the spike and then slurp the HP right back while the enemy alts cycle.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-20-1024x655.png)

In practice, that means your defensive swing turns into a full reset if your heals land inside YSS’s uptime.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-170.png)

So the artifact isn’t about making YSS hit harder; it’s about **turning his ult into a bigger sustain moment** for the whole squad. That’s why you see him stapled into modern Earth/Himiko builds with Theodora or Fu Fei — the mitigation buys time, and the +healing pushes those bars up fast enough to shrug off much of the enemy's damage pressure. If you’re building around layered damage reduction (DR effects like Earth dragon, Oaken, Resist, etc.), this artifact is the glue that lets the comp outlast opponents instead of trading blows.

- **[Read more about YSS here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/immortals/specific-immortal-deepdives/immortal-yi-sun-shin-incl-artifact/)**
- **[And more about top meta YSS builds here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/elements/season-2-builds/earth-himiko-build-for-season-2-a-top-meta-build-short-of-chaos/)**

---

## What does the Artifact do then?

Yi Sun-Shin's ultimate ability **Guard of Devotion** gives you a buff which reduces damage taken by **all allied immortals** by **30% for 6s**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-18.png)

Through his Unique Artifact we can get another layer of defensive on top of the already very powerful damage reducion, because we will gain his **Unique Artifact effect** which adds **+30% healing received** to all allies under **Guard of Devotion** (same 6s).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-19.png)

**Main stat priority (frontline tank):** When it comes to optimizing this artifact, the primary attribute you should aim for is: **Physical Defense (Preferably as a Percentage)**: This enhances YSS’ ability to absorb physical attacks, crucial for his role as a frontline shield.

Secondary attributes that are beneficial include: **Resilience**: Adds an extra layer of survivability and can be good especially in season 1 and 2 where you can resiliance stack (and use Malice) to counter critical damage far better than in Conquest where crit-rates scale beyond resiliance being very useful.

**TL;DR**: **Physical Defense %** as the **top main attribute** is the safest and most consistent pick — he’s frontline and eats a ton of physical poke/auto damage.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-179.png)

### Bonus roll preference:

- If you’re lucky enough to land **Physical Defense %** *and* a bonus: **Guard** > **Growth** in most lobbies. The extra physical defense you get from Guard generally outperforms Growth.
- **Edge case:** if your shard is stacked with **mage‑solo‑carry** teams (e.g., **Himiko, Fu Fei, Bjorn, YSS** type mirrors where the big hits are magic‑weighted), **Growth** can catch up a bit — but marginal.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-180.png)

**Crafting reality check:** the **unique effect** unlock is the main power spike. If you’re tight on coins, get **one copy** to turn on the healing buff first; perfecting sub rolls can come later.

---

## How to obtain

Yi Sun-Shin is a 'GP-Immortal' also sometimes referred to as a 'seasonal immortal', in essence that refers to him being available through the Golden Path season pass. This is also the main method I recommend to obtain and farm his artifact. As a 'seasonal immortal' his artifact is NOT part of the regular elemental selection chests.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-23.png)

You can however obtain his artifact in the Golden Path shop and the Mysterious Pearl shop (daily store).

---

### Obtaining via Golden Path Shop

In the Golden Path, you get a max of **1 in stock per season**, **600 coins**. If you’re gem‑rich you can keep buying every season to star it up; if not, **buy one** to unlock the effect ASAP — that single unlock is huge.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/image-175.png)

### Obtaining via Daily Pearl Shop

The Mysterious Pearl Shop has 1 in stock per day, but at a price of 240 Pearls. If you have been banking a lot of pearls prior to the recent update where the unique artifacts from GP immortals was released into Pearl Shop, you may want to use a few here. Or if you are looking for that one crucial unlock this can be good value.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-21-1024x436.png)

The price however is quite steep and it will be a long grind to obtain the 15 artifacts you need to max one unique artifact (bonus maxing in forge) using Pearls alone. The daily max you can gain through the daily bundles is 20 Pearls.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/image-22-1024x421.png)

## Conclusion

YSS’s artifact isn’t flashy, but it’s a win-condition for sustain comps. You’re taking his already solid 6-second, 30% teamwide DR and layering **+30% healing received** on top—so your “don’t die” window turns into a mini-reset if heals land inside it.

Build it like a real frontline, best crafted attribute stats are: **Physical Defense %** most consistent main stat. For bonuses, **Guard > Growth** in most battles; the extra phys-def soaks auto attacks and physical damage. Strickly mage-battles: if your Battlegroup or main rivals are relying on solo-carry-mage setups, then Growth can provide a bit more value than Guard.

Acquisition-wise, the power spike is the **first unlock**. Grab one copy from **Golden Path** (600 coins, 1 per season) or the **Mysterious Pearl Shop** (240 pearls, 1/day) to turn the effect on, then min-max rolls later when your wallet/pearls recover.

Bottom line: if your plan is to outlast and/or relies on healing sustain, YSS’s artifact is basically mandatory to unlock and nice to upgrade if possible—turn on the healing buff first, then worry about perfect stats after.

---

---

title: Your first Legion of Frostborne
summary: Complete Guide to Legion of Frostborne (LoF) for First-Timers.
categoryPath: Things you must know about Legion of Frostborne
markdown:
**Complete Guide to Legion of Frostborne (LoF) for First-Timers**.

The **Legion of Frostborne** is Infinity Kingdom’s most intense **server vs. server (SvS)** event, where players and alliances battle for dominance over **gates, cities, and ultimately, the Gnome Capital, Ymir**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-72-1024x345.png)

This guide will cover everything you need to know before entering your first season, including:
✔️ **How to prepare for LoF**
✔️ **Alliance coordination and map progression**
✔️ **Thermal Tower placement and chaining**
✔️ **Best offensive and defensive strategies**
✔️ **Advanced tactics using alt-alliances**
✔️ **Tips for dealing with stronger servers**

First things first, this being your very first Legion of Frostborne, you are playing in season 1. That means we are using the "old" format, where servers are fighting against other servers. Later in the game the format changes into a Faction based battleground where alliances are matches across servers into Factions that compete. For now, this dosen't matter to you. What you are going to be playing is a format where your server will be matched against three other servers (in chronological order).

***Note: The official in-game guide will tell you the format is for 8 servers, this was true back in the day on the first servers, but in todays version we are playing in a 4-server format.***

---

## Preparation Phase: Before Entering Frostborne

### 1. Understanding the Map and Objectives

Frostborne has a **hex-grid map** divided into **provinces (zones)** that gradually unlock as your server makes progress. The goal is to **conquer territory, capture strategic cities, and push towards the center**, where the **Gnome Capital, Ymir**, is located.

Each zone is unlocked in stages. Upon entering the frozen lands, your server will be inside your starting area. Here you can construct your first thermals and farm resources as you prepare for the later combat stages. After a few days the cities in the starting areas become available and you will be playing some PvE siege encounters as you capture your starting zone.

Then you need to make your battle plans as you await the shields on the side-gates to drop. Once these drop, the outer ring of the map is made available for combat.

Later, the inner gates open and the middle 4 areas become contested battlegrounds as the servers try to claim these lands. These are the most important zones in the game because they hold all gates to the inner most area where the ultimate objective "Ymir" is located.

The Thermal Towers are key in Legion of Frostborne, as you are only able to siege an area when you have an allied Thermal Tower covering the City or Gate you want to siege. Moreover, enemy alliances cannot build thermal towers within the control area of your towers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-63-1024x731.png)

On the above map, the green area are the starting zones. The red lines are area-walls with multiple gates on all sides. Yellow is inner area (important zone of control) and the red circle in the middel is where you will find Ymir.

🔹 **Key Objectives on the Map:**

- **Gates (Checkpoints)** – Unlocks new areas, essential for expansion.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-69.png)

- **Thermal Towers** – Allow territory expansion; your thermal chain must connect to gates and cities to siege them.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-70-1024x472.png)

- **Cities & Fortresses** – Provide ongoing rewards and zone-wide combat buffs.
- **Ymir (Final Battle)** – Controlling this capital city determines event winners.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-64.png)

---

### 2. Alliance and Cross-server Coordination & Communication

Your **server needs to work as one unit** to win Frostborne. Coordination happens at two levels:
✔️ **Server-wide cooperation** between multiple alliances (or servers).
✔️ **Alliance-level strategy** for individual objectives.
✔️ **Cross-server alliances**can claim victory even in the face of a much more powerful server!

There will always be a power differential between the servers matched in a Legion of Frostborne battlegroup. As such, diplomacy become key for victory! If you are not part of the strongest server in the battlegroup, alliances with the other servers can often be the key to claiming victory!

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-65.png)

✅ **Set up external communication (Discord, WeChat, etc.)**
✅ **Assign battle roles in your alliance (rally leaders, defenders, thermal deployers)**
✅ **Create a chain-of-command and decision-makers**

💡 **Tip**: Strong alliances must coordinate with secondary and farm alliances to create a **unified front**.

---

### 3. Resource & Troop Preparation

LoF is **resource-heavy**, so **before the event begins**, prepare:

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-66.png)

✔️ **Healing Speed-ups** – Troop losses will stack up FAST.
✔️ **March Speed-ups** – Crucial for capturing Thermals and Gates quickly.
✔️ **Teleportation Scrolls** – Needed for quick repositioning.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-71-1024x457.png)

✔️ **Troops** – Max out your training grounds before the side gates drop!

💡 **Tip**: If you plan to go all-in for LoF, **stockpile resources on your farms before the event begins!**

---

## Executing Your Strategy in LoF

## 1. Thermal Tower Tactics & Chaining

**Thermal Towers are the most critical mechanic in LoF.** They allow your **alliance to expand territory and teleport closer to objectives**.

### Advanced Thermal Tactics:

#### 1️⃣ Using Alt-Alliances to Bypass Enemy Defenses

- **Alt-alliances (level 4+)** can drop their first **Thermal anywhere** on the map.
- Your **main alliance allies** with them via **the diplomacy function**, allowing you to **chain thermals from unexpected locations**.
- This lets you **rush key objectives before enemies react**.

#### 2️⃣ Instant Wonder Build to Secure Objectives

- When capturing a **Gate, City, or Fortress**, **immediately use the Wonder Build feature** (unlocked in the mid-stages) to drop a **Thermal Tower** on-site.
- This locks in your claim, prevents counterattacks, and allows **faster reinforcements via teleportation**.

#### 3️⃣ Thermal Stacking Defense – Whale Babysitting

- When building a **Thermal in contested areas**, **fill it with troops** and have **whale players send the last march**.
- If attacked, the **enemy must defeat the last march first**, allowing **whales to repeatedly reinforce the last spot** to keep the Thermal Tower protected.
- **More troops in the Thermal = Faster construction speed.**

💡 **Tip**: **Using multiple alt-alliances to chain thermals rapidly** lets you **outmaneuver stronger enemies and reach critical locations first**.

---

## 2. Offensive Strategy – Destroying Enemy Thermals & Spreading Chaos

### Breaking the Enemy's Map Control

✔️ **Destroy enemy Thermal Towers** – A **top priority** for any offensive push.
✔️ **Use small marches to harass enemy Thermals** – Even a **1-troop march** forces enemies to spread their defenses.
✔️ **Sneak small players and alts into enemy land** – Teleport **weak castles and alt-accounts** into enemy zones to **deconstruct Thermals constantly**, this will stress and spread enemy activity thin.
✔️ **Use multiple alliances to chain** – using **multiple alliances for Thermal chaining**, means you can rapidly reach key objectives - especially once Wonder Build is unlocked and you have fresh level 4 alliances available.

💡 **Tip**: **Keep enemies constantly on the defensive.** The more they have to protect, the weaker their offensive efforts will be.

---

## 3. Defensive Strategy – Holding Ground & Stalling Enemies

If your server is **on the defensive**, you can **stall stronger enemies** using these tactics:

✔️ **Shielded Castles Block Movement** – Use **alt castles with shields** to **block key areas** and **prevent enemy castle movements**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-68.png)

✔️ **Hide Behind Captured Gates** – If overwhelmed, **retreat behind a Gate**.
✔️ **Fake Attacks** – Send **small, fake rallies** to distract enemies and waste their time.
✔️ **Exploit Enemy Rage Debuffs** – If their whales are fatigued and can't heal fast, **launch counterattacks to take advantage**.
✔️ **Use instant healing tactics**for Thermal Towers to prolonge a defense of key thermals

💡 **Tip**: Defense is about **wasting the enemy’s time and resources**—every hour you hold out makes a **future comeback more likely**.

---

## Final Tips & Tricks

✔️ **Save Speed-Ups for the Endgame** – The final **week of LoF is the most intense**.
✔️ **Diplomacy Can Win Wars** – Weaker servers can **unite to overwhelm a stronger one**.
✔️ **Don't Overextend Early** – Many Alliances **exhaust themselves too quickly**—pace your aggression!
✔️ **Always Deconstruct Enemy Thermals** – Never let the enemy **rebuild their thermal network**.

---

## Summary

The **Legion of Frostborne** is all about **coordination, map control, and strategic execution**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/image-67.png)

✔️ **Use alt-alliances to chain Thermals and expand unpredictably.**
✔️ **Deconstruct enemy Thermals relentlessly to keep them on defense.**
✔️ **Defend wisely using shielded castles, whale babysitting, and stalling tactics.**
✔️ **Leverage diplomacy to unite weaker servers against powerful ones.**

🔥 **Most importantly: Work together with your Alliance and faction to dominate the battlefield!** 🔥

Good luck in your **first Legion of Frostborne**—**go claim Ymir for your server!** 💪❄️

title: Zenobia and the Silver of Palmyra
summary: In the world of Infinity Kingdom, unique artifacts offer a significant enhancement to an immortal's combat capabilities, tailoring specific powerful effects to their skills. One such artifact, the Silver of Palmyra, is…
markdown:
### Zenobia and Her Unique Artifact: Silver of Palmyra

In the world of Infinity Kingdom, unique artifacts offer a significant enhancement to an immortal's combat capabilities, tailoring specific powerful effects to their skills. One such artifact, the Silver of Palmyra, is designed exclusively for the immortal Zenobia. This guide explores Zenobia's unique artifact, its effects, and how to acquire it for those looking to optimize their strategies in the game.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-31-1024x625.png)

#### Overview of Silver of Palmyra

The Silver of Palmyra is a unique artifact that enhances Zenobia's ultimate ability, "Empress' Favor," by adding a substantial boost to attack speed. When equipped, the artifact grants the following effect:

- **Empress' Favor Enhancement**: Increases the attack speed of the healing target by 25%.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-32.png)

This effect is particularly potent considering Zenobia's role as a healer in the game. The increase in attack speed can be crucial in battles, especially when paired with immortals like Alexander or Hannibal, who benefit immensely from faster attack speeds due to their high base stats in this area.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-33-1024x387.png)

The synergy created with these immortals can significantly amplify a team's damage output, making Zenobia an even more valuable asset in your lineup.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-34-1024x607.png)

## How to Obtain Silver of Palmyra

The Silver of Palmyra can be acquired through two main avenues in Infinity Kingdom:

- **Stellar Compass Event**:  - In this event, players earn or purchase Crystal Balls, which are then redeemed for artifact fragments. This method is straightforward and accessible during the event period, making it a primary source for players looking to equip Zenobia with her unique artifact.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-35-1024x580.png)

- **5-Day Bundles**:  - Zenobia's artifact can also be obtained through the game's 5-day bundles, where players purchase skill stones. Each day of purchasing yields 5 selection chests containing various rewards, including artifact fragments. On the fifth consecutive day, a bonus is awarded, which can include the Silver of Palmyra. This method is more costly, as it involves daily purchases, but it also provides valuable skill stones and other benefits that can enhance your immortals' abilities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/image-36.png)

#### Strategic Implications

Equipping Zenobia with the Silver of Palmyra can drastically alter your battle strategies, particularly in prolonged engagements where sustained healing and increased attack speed can turn the tide. This setup is especially effective in formations that are designed to outlast and overpower the enemy through superior healing and rapid, consistent damage output.

### Conclusion

Zenobia’s unique artifact, Silver of Palmyra, is a game-changer for players who utilize her in their formations. By boosting the attack speed of key immortals, this artifact not only enhances Zenobia's healing efficiency but also significantly increases the overall damage potential of the team. Whether you choose to acquire it through the Stellar Compass event or invest in 5-day bundles, the strategic advantages of equipping this artifact are undeniable. Make sure to integrate it thoughtfully with other team enhancements for maximum effectiveness in your quest for dominance in Infinity Kingdom.

title: Zephyr finally able to complete the Hybrid team 2.8.2

markdown:
### Using Zephyr (Wind Dragon) in Hybrid Setups

With the release of **Patch 2.8.2**, a groundbreaking shift has finally arrived in Infinity Kingdom: the **Wind Dragon, Zephyr**, is no longer locked to exclusively buffing Wind-element Immortals. That’s right—**Zephyr’s powerful skills can now be applied to all elements**, which means one of the game’s most stat-rich and synergistic dragons is finally unlocked for **Hybrid teams**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-53-1024x499.png)

For players running the **popular Earth-Wind Hybrid team** (think Alexander + Hannibal), this is **huge news**. Let’s break down why the Wind Dragon is about to **replace Earth Dragon (Dimitr)** as the go-to option for hybrid setups.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-52.png)

---

## 🌪️ Why Zephyr Over Dimitr in Hybrid?

### 🔋 1. No More Wind Restriction

Previously, all of Zephyr’s active and passive abilities were **tied to Wind-element Immortals only**, which meant hybrid players couldn’t use him effectively. That’s now changed. **All allied Immortals** can benefit from the dragon’s effects—**Alex, Hannibal, Peter, etc.** This finally opens the door for full Zephyr integration in your hybrid build.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-54-1024x179.png)

### 💥 2. Massive Normal Attack Synergy

Hybrid setups thrive on **high attack speed and normal attack damage**, which is where Zephyr shines:

- **Passive Bonus**: +25% **Normal Attack Damage** — a flat and consistent boost that scales perfectly with the attack-speed-heavy builds of hybrid teams.
- **High Crit and Dodge**: Zephyr grants both, making your frontlines tankier and your damage more consistent.

The Earth Dragon is great for survivability and decent stat boosts, but it lacks the **raw offensive synergy** that Zephyr brings to a hybrid comp.

---

## 💣 Zephyr's Key Skills for Hybrid Builds

### 🌀 Turmoil Breath

- Deals damage to all enemies.
- **Reduces Accuracy**.
- Applies a debuff that **increases the physical damage taken by enemies by 24%**.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-55-1024x385.png)

> This is HUGE for Alex, Hannibal, and any physical damage dealer. That 24% increased physical damage taken is one of the most powerful debuffs for hybrid burst strategies.

### 🌿 Stormy Breath

- On **normal attack triggers**, has a **60% chance** to recover HP over **15.6 seconds**.
- Applies to any allied troops (not just wind troops anymore).

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-56-1024x380.png)

> This gives your march **sustain** without sacrificing offensive power. It also helps protect your key damage dealers like Alex or Hannibal during longer engagements.

### 🔧 Squall Howling Passive Effects

- +25% **normal attack damage**
- +Crit Rate and +Dodge

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/image-57-1024x325.png)

> This set of passives is uniquely tailored to the **high-tempo combat style** of hybrid teams, enabling huge damage output while keeping your frontliners hard to kill.

---

## 📊 Zephyr vs. Dimitr – A Quick Comparison

| Feature | Zephyr (Wind) | Dimitr (Earth) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Buff Type | Physical Damage / Normal Attacks | Damage Reduction / Sustain |
| Element Restriction | None (Post 2.8.2) | None |
| Healing | Yes (Stormy Blessing regen) | Yes (Sandstorm sustain) |
| Physical Damage Amp | +24% (from Breath debuff) | ❌ |
| Normal Attack Damage | +25% Passive | ❌ |
| Crit & Dodge Buffs | ✅ | ✅ |
| Stat Growth (Base Dragon) | Higher | Standard |

> Verdict: Zephyr now outshines Dimitr in almost every way for offensive hybrid builds.

---

## 💡 How to Use Zephyr in Hybrid Marches

If you're running a classic hybrid like:

- **Alexander (Main DPS)**
- **Hannibal Barca (Secondary DPS)**
- **Support Zenobia and Qin in the backline**

Then Zephyr will enhance all of them by:

- Amplifying normal attack damage
- Increasing team sustain
- Boosting crit output
- Applying a critical physical damage debuff to enemies

Hybrid marches already rely on **stacking attack speed**, **Combo**, **Demonic Rage**, and **Blade Vortex**. With Zephyr’s bonuses, these skills scale even harder.

> 🔁 **Pro Tip**: Use Zephyr alongside Adrenaline Rush or Time to Shine on Alex to trigger more normal attacks and capitalize on his +25% normal damage buff.

---

## ✅ Final Thoughts – The Hybrid Revolution Begins

After **four years** of waiting, **Hybrid teams can finally harness the full power of Zephyr**. With Patch 2.8.2 lifting element restrictions, the Wind Dragon becomes the **new best-in-slot dragon** for hybrid builds, offering unmatched offensive synergy and better stats.

If you’ve been running Dimitr and looking for that next step in optimizing your team—**this is it**. Time to ascend your Zephyr and let the winds of conquest carry you forward!

> 🛡️ Recommended for: Hybrid mains, PvP players, Alex/Hannibal users, and anyone who loves fast-paced, damage-heavy playstyles.

Unleash the storm, and dominate the battlefield! 🌪️

title: Zuma Tower Guide – Mechanics, Rewards, And Best Practices
summary: Zuma Tower is a newly released event that replaces the old Primal
markdown:
## Introduction

Zuma Tower is a newly released event that replaces the old Primal Pinball as a primary source of Stardust and Crimson Moonlight. While it is presented as a high‑risk, high‑reward climbing mode, its real value lies in understanding how the probabilities, costs, and reward tiers actually function on live servers.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-86-1024x550.png)

This guide breaks down Zuma Tower as it exists now: how the event works, what rewards you truly receive, and how players should approach it to avoid common and expensive mistakes. The goal is to help players engage with the event efficiently, not emotionally.

---

## What Zuma Tower Is

Zuma Tower is a repeatable climbing event that uses **Zuma Visions** (the updated currency replacing Pearl of Finding). Each run begins at Floor 1 and continues until the player chooses to stop and claim rewards. Claiming rewards immediately ends the run and resets progress back to Floor 1.

Movement within the tower is determined by spending Zuma Visions on exploration attempts. Each attempt can:

- Move you up 1 or 2 floors
- Keep you on the same floor
- Drop you down 1 or 2 floors

Your **current floor at the moment you claim** determines the reward tier you receive. You do not earn rewards for every floor you pass, only for the final floor reached when claiming.

---

## Rewards and Floor Tiers

### Floors 1–6: Stardust or Crimson Moonlight

For Floors 1 through 6, you must choose **one** reward when claiming:

- Stardust
- Crimson Moonlight

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-81-1024x602.png)

You do *not* receive both. The interface can give the impression that multiple rewards are granted, but this is not the case. Every claim is a single-choice reward.

Floor 6 represents the highest tier for direct Stardust and Crimson Moonlight rewards and is the realistic stopping point for most players.

### Floor 7: Mystic Ancient Coins

Floor 7 replaces Stardust and Crimson Moonlight with **Mystic Ancient Coins**. A full clear provides enough coins to purchase **two copies of a castle skin**, allowing players to either unlock multiple skins or upgrade an existing one.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-82-1024x578.png)

Reaching Floor 7 consistently is expensive and highly dependent on luck. This tier is aimed primarily at high spenders and collectors rather than the general player base.

---

## Understanding the Probability System

The largest pitfall in Zuma Tower is how probabilities are presented versus how they behave in practice.

### Initial Exploration

At the start of a run, the first exploration has favorable odds:

- A very high chance to move up at least one floor
- A small chance to move up two floors

Most runs will begin on Floor 1 or Floor 2, with Floor 3 being possible but uncommon.

### Subsequent Exploration Attempts

After the first move, probabilities shift dramatically:

- Roughly **90%** chance to move downward
- About **10%** chance to move up one floor
- Around **1%** chance to move up two floors

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-83-1024x535.png)

Despite being displayed as “plus or minus” movement, free exploration attempts overwhelmingly result in downward movement. Treating these attempts as neutral or gambling-friendly is a mistake.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-85.png)

In practical terms, repeatedly clicking free exploration after the first move almost always ends the run by dropping the player back to Floor 1.

---

## Safe Exploration vs Free Exploration

### Safe Exploration

Safe Exploration consumes Zuma Visions but guarantees upward movement. It is the **only reliable method** for climbing intentionally. However, its cost escalates quickly. Multiple attempts are often required per floor, and the value gained diminishes the higher you go.

A common mistake is assuming that free exploration offers reasonable odds once you are already on a higher floor. In reality, free attempts nearly always result in losing progress. For example, it is not unusual to spend 30 Zuma Visions attempting to gain rewards worth only 20 additional Stardust. This negative value becomes more severe at higher floors.

---

## The True Baseline Value of Zuma Tower

At its most basic level, Zuma Tower functions as a **currency conversion system**:

- **1 Zuma Vision ≈ 1 Stardust (minimum)**
- Worst-case outcome: spend 5 Zuma Visions → claim 5 Stardust

This establishes a hard floor value for the event. Even with extremely poor luck, players will not receive less than this baseline unless they overspend chasing higher floors. The cost of Safe Exploration rise quite significantly and as such it is generally not worth doing if you are after Stardust here. Climbing is for players who are after Castle skins.

- Farming **Crimsons**, do the first exploration then claim, repeat.
- If looking for **Stardust,**do the first exploration and then chance a free exploration - since levels 1 and 2 both holds 5 stardust you have nothing to lose! Claim 5 stardust or a bonus if you are lucky on the free attempt.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-87-1024x341.png)

### High Spenders and Collectors

Floor 7 is achievable but expensive. Efficiency depends heavily on luck and any available drop-protection mechanics and players should expect and budgets with a skin on average costing around 75$. Which honestly is pretty decent value and a lot cheaper than many castle skins we have seen previously, so for big spenders looking to max castle skins this is decent value. **[Read more about Zuma efficiency and average cost estimates here.](https://ik-wiki.com/docs/events/zuma-tower/zuma-towers-efficiency-and-cost-estimated/)**

---

title: Zuma Towers - efficiency and cost estimated
summary: With Zuma Tower now live, players have begun testing its real cost
markdown:
## Introduction

With Zuma Tower now live, players have begun testing its real cost structure across all reward tiers. While the core mechanics are relatively simple, the **economic efficiency** of the event is far less obvious. This article focuses exclusively on **costs, averages, and efficiency**, based on repeated testing rather than theoretical probabilities.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-88-1024x536.png)

The goal here is to answer two practical questions:

1. How expensive is it to reach the final tier and obtain Mystic Ancient Coins?
2. How does Zuma Tower compare to previous events—specifically Primal Pinball—for Stardust and Crimson Moonlight acquisition?

To answer this, I have written the guide below to give you a detailed look into the cost analysis of this new event. This would not be possible if not for awesome player GMNikson who has been kind enough to provide us with his data and results from testing Zuma quite extensively. Thank you GMNikson! **[I recommend everyone to go and watch his testing-video that is available on YouTube here.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ec1-VV0epk8)**

---

## Reaching the Final Floor: Mystic Ancient Coins

Testing focused first on breaching **Floor 7**, which grants Mystic Ancient Coins used for castle skin upgrades. The **average cost of 1,500 Zuma Visions** to reach Floor 7.

Player GMNikson has been kind enough to share testing results with us all spending:

Across three full attempts to reach the final tier:

| Attempt | Zuma Visions Spent |
| --- | --- |
| Attempt 1 | 1575 |
| Attempt 2 | 1475 |
| Attempt 3 | 1435 |

This results in an **average cost of 1,495 Zuma Visions** to reach Floor 7.

At current pricing, this corresponds to roughly $125USD with only cheap 5$ bundles and around $185 USD using the 15$ bundles per successful run. Let's call that an **average around 150$** (also fitting Gtarcade bundles and the large quantity needed if you are going for multiple skin upgrades) meaning around **$75 per single castle skin upgrade**, since one completion yields enough coins for two upgrades. This is actually quite cheap compared to what some castle skins have had for price tags in the past.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-89-1024x550.png)

### Variance and Luck Factor

A small number of players reported reaching the final tier for as little as **900 Zuma Visions**. These cases should be considered **highly fortunate outliers** rather than realistic expectations. The observed average remains a more reliable benchmark for planning purposes.

---

## Crimson Moonlight and Stardust Efficiency

Crimson Moonlight was used as the primary test metric, as Stardust shares the same reward pool and scales identically. Results can therefore be applied to both resources. Again this is based on player testing, thanks GMNikson!

### Total Test Investment

- **Total Zuma Visions spent:** 3,360
- **Approximate cost:** $300 USD (GT Arcade packs)

### Tier-by-Tier Results

| Tier | Cost per Claim | Reward per Claim | Average Total Gained |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tier 2 | 5 Visions | 1 Crimson | 224 Crimson |
| Tier 3 | 35 Visions | 4 Crimson | 128 Crimson |
| Tier 4 | 155 Visions | 18 Crimson | 130 Crimson |
| Tier 5 | 515 Visions | 60 Crimson | 130 Crimson |
| Tier 6 | 995 Visions | 120 Crimson | 135 Crimson |

### Key Observation

Despite higher tiers offering larger single-claim rewards, **total returns remain remarkably flat** across tiers once costs are accounted for. The increased expense of climbing effectively cancels out the larger payouts.

---

## The Most Efficient Strategy: Staying Low

After testing, one conclusion became clear: **The most cost-efficient way to obtain non-castle skin rewards is to focus on the lowest guaranteed tier.**

Tier 2 rewards are always accessible after spending a single pool of **5 Zuma Visions**, with occasional lucky rolls allowing progression to Tier 3. This creates a steady baseline with limited downside risk.

![](https://ik-wiki.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/image-90-1024x423.png)

### Optimized Outcome

When factoring in natural critical rolls:

- **Total Crimson gained:** 262
- **Total Zuma Visions spent:** 1,120

This approach significantly outperforms deliberate attempts to climb higher tiers in terms of cost efficiency. Note that if you are after Stardust, you may use a Free Exploration if you land on level 2 initially, since there is no downside to dropping to level 1 in terms of Stardust. This is however not recommended for players looking for Crimson.

---

## Comparison: Zuma Tower vs Primal Pinball

To contextualize these numbers, Zuma Tower must be compared against its predecessor, the **Primal Pinball** event. Under comparable spending levels, Zuma Tower produces roughly **one-third** of the Crimson Moonlight obtained from Primal Pinball.

This makes Zuma Tower:

- ~**3× more expensive** for Crimson Moonlight
- Even worse in relative terms for Stardust

---

## Final Assessment

From a pure efficiency standpoint, Zuma Tower represents a **significant downgrade** compared to Primal Pinball for Stardust and Crimson Moonlight acquisition.

- High-tier rewards do not meaningfully improve overall returns.
- Floor 7 provides a new premium avenue for castle skin upgrades, but at a steep cost.
- The event’s economic design strongly discourages climbing beyond guaranteed tiers.

In exchange for introducing upgradable castle skins, the developers have substantially reduced the volume of core progression resources traditionally associated with these events.

For players focused on Crimson Moonlight or Stardust efficiency, Zuma Tower should be approached conservatively. Its real value lies in **premium cosmetic progression**, not resource farming.

---
